papers.title: ParliView: An Experiment-Driven Platform for Parliamentary Transparency
papers.abstract: ParliView is a modular, agentic retrieval-augmented generation platform for querying European Parliament records. It provides a natural language interface for citizens to explore parliamentary debates and activities, and a controlled experimentation environment in which different users can be exposed to systematically varied system behaviours. This enables rigorous study of how design choices, such as verbosity, interactivity, and source presentation, affect user trust, comprehension, and reliance. We describe the system architecture and demonstrate its two core interfaces.

translation.title: ParliView：一个面向议会透明度的实验驱动平台
translation.abstract: ParliView 是一个模块化的、基于智能体的检索增强生成平台，用于查询欧洲议会记录。它为公民提供自然语言界面以探索议会辩论和活动，并提供一个受控实验环境，使不同用户可以接触到系统性变化的系统行为。这使得能够严格研究设计选择（如冗长度、交互性和来源呈现方式）如何影响用户信任、理解和依赖。我们描述了系统架构并展示了其两个核心界面。
translation.brief: 为解决公民查询议会记录及研究系统设计对用户影响的问题，构建了一个基于检索增强生成的模块化智能体平台，兼具自然语言查询与受控实验功能。

papers.title: Rethinking Edge-Device Collaborative LLM Inference for 6G AI Edge: An Empirical Evaluation
papers.abstract: 6G ubiquitous intelligence requires generative AI capabilities that far exceed the compute, memory, and energy budgets of mobile terminals. By pushing large language model (LLM) inference to proximate network edge, 6G is shifting to the AI Edge era via four edge-device collaborative paradigms: edge inference, model routing, model split, and speculative decoding. However, existing evaluations are predominantly conducted in idealized datacenter settings, masking the practical challenges posed by heterogeneous hardware and stochastic wireless channels at 6G AI Edge. This article presents the first unified, hardware-in-the-loop empirical study that re-examines these paradigms under practical network conditions. Our stage-wise latency evaluation reveals that network dynamics can inflate Time-to-First-Token (TTFT) by up to 6x, while massive tensor transmissions delay speculative decoding by 246 ms and consume over 150 ms in model split. Because no single paradigm universally dominates across all performance dimensions, we advocate for a context-aware adaptive orchestration framework that dynamically selects collaboration strategies based on network conditions, terminal capabilities, and task semantics, and outline a research roadmap toward 6G AI Edge deployment.

translation.title: 重新思考面向6G AI边缘的端边协同LLM推理：一项实证评估
translation.abstract: 6G泛在智能需要远超移动终端计算、内存和能耗预算的生成式AI能力。通过将大语言模型（LLM）推理推送到邻近的网络边缘，6G正通过四种端边协同范式迈向AI边缘时代：边缘推理、模型路由、模型切分和投机解码。然而，现有评估主要在理想化的数据中心环境中进行，掩盖了6G AI边缘上异构硬件和随机无线信道带来的实际挑战。本文提出了首个统一的硬件在环实证研究，在实际网络条件下重新审视这些范式。我们的分阶段延迟评估表明，网络动态可使首Token时间（TTFT）膨胀高达6倍，而大规模张量传输使投机解码延迟246毫秒，模型切分消耗超过150毫秒。由于没有任何单一范式在所有性能维度上普遍占优，我们倡导一个情境感知的自适应编排框架，根据网络状况、终端能力和任务语义动态选择协同策略，并勾勒了迈向6G AI边缘部署的研究路线图。
translation.brief: 针对端边协同LLM推理范式缺乏真实网络条件下评估的问题，通过硬件在环实证研究量化各范式的延迟表现，并提出情境感知的自适应编排框架。

papers.title: Scrub Data: A Framework for Reproducible Data Curation with AI Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Data curation---the process of collecting, cleaning, and joining raw datasets for unified analysis---is a time-consuming yet crucial part of any data science project. With the emergence of powerful agentic coding tools, it is tempting to "vibe curate"---i.e., to prompt AI agents to perform data curation operations and blindly trust their outputs in order to finish work more quickly. However, this can exacerbate two key challenges that already plague manual data curation workflows: reproducibility---the ability to trace the exact set of modifications applied to raw datasets---and verifiability---the ability to audit changes and confirm that data is processed properly. To address these issues, we introduce Scrub Data, a framework that enables the use of AI agents in data curation workflows while transparently maintaining both reproducibility and verifiability. The framework involves an interactive data curation loop between a user and an AI agent, backed by a data provenance graph that tracks and versions all dataset updates. The data graph requires that all updates are formatted as self-contained executable steps, allowing any version of a dataset to be reconstructed from raw data by playing forward the transformations stored in the graph. This workflow takes place within a lightweight web application that is designed to be modified by users and agents in real-time to create custom visualization tools for identifying data curation needs and verifying outcomes. We demonstrate the usefulness of the framework with a real data curation use case from animal movement ecology. Starting with 89M raw GPS coordinates, we use the framework to curate a benchmark dataset of 2.5M coordinates to be used for machine learning or statistical analysis. The framework is available for use and extension at this https URL.

translation.title: Scrub Data：一个基于AI编程智能体的可复现数据整理框架
translation.abstract: 数据整理——即收集、清洗和连接原始数据集以进行统一分析的过程——是任何数据科学项目中耗时却至关重要的部分。随着强大的智能体编程工具的出现，人们很容易进行"氛围式整理"（vibe curate），即提示AI智能体执行数据整理操作并盲目信任其输出以更快完成工作。然而，这会加剧本已困扰手动数据整理工作流的两个关键挑战：可复现性——追踪应用于原始数据集的确切修改集合的能力——和可验证性——审计更改并确认数据被正确处理的能力。为解决这些问题，我们引入 Scrub Data，一个在数据整理工作流中使用AI智能体的同时透明地保持可复现性和可验证性的框架。该框架包含用户与AI智能体之间的交互式数据整理循环，并由一个追踪和版本化所有数据集更新的数据溯源图支撑。数据图要求所有更新都被格式化为自包含的可执行步骤，从而可以通过回放图中存储的转换从原始数据重建任何版本的数据集。该工作流在一个轻量级Web应用中进行，该应用设计为由用户和智能体实时修改，以创建自定义可视化工具，用于识别数据整理需求并验证结果。我们通过来自动物运动生态学的真实数据整理用例展示了该框架的实用性。从8900万条原始GPS坐标开始，我们使用该框架整理出250万条坐标的基准数据集，用于机器学习或统计分析。该框架可在该 https URL 上使用和扩展。
translation.brief: 为解决AI智能体数据整理中可复现性与可验证性缺失的问题，提出基于数据溯源图的框架，将所有更新记录为可执行步骤以支持任意版本重建。

papers.title: The Agent Is Not Your Driver: Clarifying the Implied Capabilities of In-Vehicle Anthropomorphic Agents
papers.abstract: This position paper considers how the gap between an anthropomorphic agent in an autonomous vehicle and the automated driving system of the vehicle can create psychological risks if the agent inaccurately presents itself as integrated into the driving system. This gap is under-explored both because of the evolving nature of these agents and because of study limitations in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) research. Nevertheless, this gap may cause the agent to misrepresent itself as more knowledgeable about the car than it is, creating a risk of dependence and, in the worst case, betrayal if the occupant feels that the agent has misled them. This paper proposes a research agenda for future work to understand the psychological risk that exists in the gap between agents and driving systems and to narrow this gap in a manner aligned with safety assurance. As these agents evolve to hold greater capabilities and increased anthropomorphism, future research must investigate risks which may emerge from richer interaction with them. The impact of how an agent presents itself and its knowledge becomes greater.

translation.title: 智能体不是你的司机：厘清车载拟人化智能体的隐含能力
translation.abstract: 这篇立场论文探讨了自动驾驶汽车中的拟人化智能体与车辆自动驾驶系统之间的差距如何在智能体不准确地将自己呈现为已集成到驾驶系统时产生心理风险。由于这些智能体不断演进的性质以及人机交互（HCI）研究的局限性，这一差距尚未得到充分探索。然而，这种差距可能导致智能体将自己伪装得比实际更了解汽车，从而产生依赖风险，最坏的情况下，如果乘员感到智能体误导了他们，则会产生背叛感。本文提出了一个未来研究议程，以理解智能体与驾驶系统之间差距中存在的心理风险，并以符合安全保证的方式缩小这一差距。随着这些智能体演进到拥有更强的能力和更高的拟人化程度，未来研究必须调查与它们更丰富的交互可能产生的风险。智能体如何呈现自身及其知识的影响将变得更大。
translation.brief: 针对车载拟人化智能体与自动驾驶系统之间的能力差距可能引发心理风险的问题，提出研究议程以理解并安全地缩小这一差距。

papers.title: Evaluating the Participation of Proactive Scouting Agents in Real-time Human Team Meetings
papers.abstract: An open research question is whether the addition of conversational AI agents to real-time discussions among human teams enhances group performance. This study tested the value of adding proactive scouting agents to teams engaged in collaborative forecasting tasks. These agents were designed to (i) monitor the groupwise discussion in real-time, (ii) identify critical information gaps in the group deliberation, (iii) autonomously find and retrieve relevant information, and (iv) express the acquired content into the conversation using emulated groupwise human etiquette. In a controlled set of trials, small human teams of 4 or 5 members were tasked with collaboratively predicting the outcome of 34 Major League Baseball (MLB) games, either by forecasting the winning team or by predicting the total number of runs scored. In half the trials, the groups were assisted by proactive scouting agents. The other half were human-only deliberations. When tasked with predicting the winning team, the addition of proactive scouting agents to the group discussion significantly increased forecasting accuracy, reducing the predictive mean-absolute error by 25% (p=0.006) and improving raw predictive accuracy from 60.0% to 76.4% (p=0.050). When predicting the total number of runs scored across both teams, the addition of proactive scouting agents yielded no statistical change in group performance. It should be noted that the human participants in this study were significantly worse at predicting the number of runs scored. This may have led to random outcomes in those forecasting trials. Still, the results of this study demonstrate that deploying proactive scouting agents can significantly boost forecasting accuracy during real-time team deliberations when participants possess baseline forecasting skill.

translation.title: 评估主动侦察智能体在实时人类团队会议中的参与
translation.abstract: 一个开放的研究问题是，在人类团队的实时讨论中加入对话式AI智能体是否能提升群体绩效。本研究测试了在从事协作预测任务的团队中加入主动侦察智能体的价值。这些智能体被设计为：(i) 实时监控群体讨论，(ii) 识别群体审议中的关键信息缺口，(iii) 自主查找和检索相关信息，以及 (iv) 使用模拟的群体人类礼仪将获取的内容表达进对话。在一组受控试验中，4或5名成员的小型人类团队被要求协作预测34场美国职业棒球大联盟（MLB）比赛的结果，或预测获胜球队，或预测总得分。在一半的试验中，团队由主动侦察智能体辅助；另一半为纯人类审议。在预测获胜球队的任务中，在群体讨论中加入主动侦察智能体显著提高了预测准确性，将预测平均绝对误差降低了25%（p=0.006），并将原始预测准确率从60.0%提升至76.4%（p=0.050）。在预测两支球队总得分时，加入主动侦察智能体未带来统计上的群体绩效变化。值得注意的是，本研究中的人类参与者在预测得分方面明显较差，这可能导致那些预测试验出现随机结果。尽管如此，本研究的结果表明，当参与者具备基线预测能力时，部署主动侦察智能体可以显著提升实时团队审议中的预测准确性。
translation.brief: 研究在团队实时讨论中加入能监控讨论、发现信息缺口并自主检索信息的主动侦察智能体能否提升群体预测绩效。

papers.title: Beyond Code and Pixels: Co-Generating Editable and Visually Rich Presentations
papers.abstract: Generating PPTX presentations is a structured task that requires semantic planning, visual composition, precise layout, and editability, motivating collaboration among specialized agents. However, programmatic methods offer editability but often produce rigid designs, while image-based methods provide visual richness but flatten content into difficult-to-edit pixels. A hybrid system can combine these strengths, but must coordinate interdependent decisions across content, layout, and appearance. To address this challenge, we propose SlidesWeaver, a hybrid multi-agent system that coordinates language and vision agents through shared deck- and slide-level states. Specifically, it uses staged multimodal commitment, diffusion-based composition planning, and two generation schedules for different priorities between composition freedom and accurate text preservation, while preserving native text and geometry. Across 1,728 generations spanning 24 system-model configurations, SlidesWeaver achieves consistently superior overall quality across all evaluated dimensions while maintaining structural control, editability, and practical generation efficiency.

translation.title: 超越代码与像素：协同生成可编辑且视觉丰富的演示文稿
translation.abstract: 生成 PPTX 演示文稿是一项结构化任务，需要语义规划、视觉构图、精确布局和可编辑性，这促使专业化 agent 之间进行协作。然而，程序化方法虽然提供可编辑性，但往往产生僵硬的设计；而基于图像的方法虽然视觉丰富，却将内容扁平化为难以编辑的像素。混合系统可以结合两者的优势，但必须协调内容、布局和外观之间相互依赖的决策。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 SlidesWeaver，一个混合多 agent 系统，通过共享的 deck 级和 slide 级状态协调语言与视觉 agent。具体而言，它采用分阶段多模态承诺、基于扩散的构图规划，以及针对构图自由度与文本精确保留之间不同优先级的两种生成调度，同时保留原生文本和几何信息。在涵盖 24 种系统-模型配置的 1,728 次生成中，SlidesWeaver 在所有评估维度上均取得持续领先的总体质量，同时保持结构控制、可编辑性和实用的生成效率。
translation.brief: 解决演示文稿生成中可编辑性与视觉丰富性难以兼得的问题，提出通过共享状态协调语言与视觉 agent 的混合多 agent 系统 SlidesWeaver。

papers.title: Social sycophancy differs across access modes of large language models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can display sycophancy, a tendency to excessively praise, agree with, or validate a user. Existing studies have tested LLMs for sycophancy primarily through application programming interfaces (APIs) rather than the consumer user interfaces (UIs) through which the public commonly interacts with LLMs. Access mode (API vs. UI) may affect observed sycophancy rates. However, it remains unknown to what extent prominent models show API-UI differences in social sycophancy, which includes behaviors potentially more likely in UIs (e.g., softening warranted criticism). We tested ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and DeepSeek through both APIs and UIs on four dimensions of social sycophancy. Across models, UI access was generally associated with greater social sycophancy, with odds ratios up to 7.56 (95% CI [6.22, 9.20]). However, UI-API differences varied significantly across models for all sycophancy dimensions, including a pronounced reversal for DeepSeek moral sycophancy (43% UI vs. 82.3% API). Overall, our results suggest that API-based LLM evaluations may underestimate the prevalence of sycophancy in corresponding consumer-facing systems, making access conditions consequential for the external validity of LLM evaluation. To facilitate research on access-mode effects, we release 57,000 model responses and SycoUI, a browser-automation pipeline for standardized cross-interface LLM evaluation.

translation.title: 大型语言模型的社交谄媚行为因访问方式而异
translation.abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）可能表现出谄媚（sycophancy），即过度赞美、附和或迎合用户的倾向。现有研究主要通过应用程序编程接口（API）而非公众常用的消费级用户界面（UI）来测试 LLM 的谄媚行为。访问方式（API vs. UI）可能影响观察到的谄媚率。然而，知名模型在社交谄媚（包括 UI 中更可能出现的行为，如软化本应给出的批评）方面存在多大的 API-UI 差异仍不清楚。我们通过 API 和 UI 两种方式测试了 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 和 DeepSeek 在社交谄媚四个维度上的表现。在所有模型中，UI 访问通常与更高的社交谄媚相关，比值比最高达 7.56（95% CI [6.22, 9.20]）。然而，UI-API 差异在所有谄媚维度上均因模型而显著不同，包括 DeepSeek 道德谄媚的明显反转（UI 43% vs. API 82.3%）。总体而言，我们的结果表明基于 API 的 LLM 评估可能低估相应面向消费者系统中谄媚行为的普遍性，使访问条件对 LLM 评估的外部效度具有重要影响。为促进访问方式效应的研究，我们发布了 57,000 条模型响应和 SycoUI——一个用于标准化跨接口 LLM 评估的浏览器自动化流水线。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 谄媚行为在 API 与 UI 两种访问方式下的差异，通过跨接口标准化测试发现 UI 访问通常导致更高谄媚率且因模型而异。

papers.title: Do as I Say, Not as You Do: Assessing Public Versus Practitioner Perspectives on the Development of Artificial Intelligence and Language Technologies
papers.abstract: With the public awareness of artificial intelligence (AI) applications such as large language models (LLMs) and generative text-to-video models reaching unprecedented levels, there is an increasing need to reconcile the perspectives held by informed practitioners, who research and develop these technologies, with the interests and opinions of the general public, who constitute the majority of people impacted by technological developments. In this work, we survey practitioners (i.e., academics and industry professionals) alongside members of the general public on perspectives relating to pertinent areas of artificial intelligence, including perceived benefit and risk, the ability for models to achieve consciousness and output art, and the use of copyright protected material for model training. Alongside comparisons of diverse perspectives on these topics, we additionally contextualise the findings with a discussion of relevant literature that supports and refutes the myriad observed stances.

translation.title: 照我说的做，而非照你做的做：评估公众与从业者对人工智能和语言技术发展的看法
translation.abstract: 随着公众对大型语言模型（LLM）和生成式文生视频模型等人工智能（AI）应用的认知达到前所未有的水平，越来越需要协调知情的从业者（研究和开发这些技术的人）与普通公众（受技术发展影响的大多数人）之间的观点和利益。在这项工作中，我们同时对从业者（即学术界和业界专业人士）和普通公众进行调查，了解他们对人工智能相关领域的看法，包括感知的收益与风险、模型实现意识和产出艺术的能力，以及使用受版权保护的材料进行模型训练等。除了对这些主题上多元观点的比较之外，我们还结合相关文献对研究结果进行讨论，这些文献既支持也反驳了所观察到的诸多立场。
translation.brief: 通过问卷调查对比 AI 从业者与普通公众在收益风险、模型意识、艺术产出和版权训练等议题上的观点差异。

papers.title: Misalignment Between Educators' Testing and End Users' Behavior: What 17,000+ Chatbot Messages Reveal About AI Literacy Training for Teachers
papers.abstract: AI literacy training for educators is expanding rapidly, but its effectiveness rests largely on self-report, knowledge tests, or interviews, revealing little about whether learning carries into practice or affects students and colleagues who use what educators build. We implemented AI for Learning, an asynchronous online course that trained 87 higher-education educators to recognize AI's capabilities, limitations, and ethics; apply prompt engineering; and evaluate AI outputs. Its central assignment asked educators to build, test, and voluntarily deploy chatbots for their practice on an educational chatbot authoring platform. Using LLM-assisted qualitative coding validated against human annotation, we analyzed the resulting 214 chatbots and their builder-bot, peer-bot, and end user-bot conversations, 17,000+ messages spanning 1.5 years. Educators 1) specified what bots should do more often than what they should not; 2) adopted templated prompt components but rarely untemplated strategies; and 3) tested routine use but seldom iterated, leaving 74% of end users' adversarial use untested. Still, 36 bots (17%) reached end users and 63 (29%) were adopted by peers. We contribute two successes and two lessons spanning the lifecycle of educator AI literacy training.

translation.title: 教育者测试与终端用户行为之间的错位：17,000+ 条聊天机器人消息对教师 AI 素养培训的启示
translation.abstract: 面向教育者的 AI 素养培训正在迅速扩展，但其有效性主要依赖自我报告、知识测试或访谈，很少揭示学习是否转化为实践，或影响使用教育者所构建工具的学生和同事。我们实施了 AI for Learning，一门异步在线课程，培训了 87 名高等教育教育者认识 AI 的能力、局限与伦理；应用提示工程；并评估 AI 输出。其核心作业要求教育者在一个教育聊天机器人创作平台上构建、测试并自愿部署用于其教学实践的聊天机器人。使用经人工标注验证的 LLM 辅助定性编码，我们分析了由此产生的 214 个聊天机器人及其构建者-机器人、同伴-机器人和终端用户-机器人对话，共 17,000+ 条消息，跨越 1.5 年。教育者：1）更多说明机器人应该做什么而非不应该做什么；2）采用模板化提示组件但很少使用非模板化策略；3）测试常规使用但很少迭代，导致 74% 的终端用户对抗性使用未被测试。尽管如此，36 个机器人（17%）触达了终端用户，63 个（29%）被同伴采用。我们贡献了两个成功案例和两条贯穿教育者 AI 素养培训生命周期的经验教训。
translation.brief: 通过分析 87 名教育者构建的 214 个聊天机器人及 17,000+ 条对话消息，揭示教师 AI 素养培训中测试行为与终端用户实际使用之间的错位。

papers.title: Do Simulated Users Push Back Like Real Users? Correctness vs. Stance
papers.abstract: LLM-simulated users stand in for people in multi-turn evaluations, on the assumption that they react to what the assistant says. We test this for pushback. From WildChat, we take conversations in which the assistant explicitly challenges or endorses a position the user stated, and compare the real next user turn with simulated turns from the same prefix. Among users who replied, real users push back more after a challenge than after an endorsement (20.5% vs. 8.2%); a GPT-based simulator does not (27.1% vs. 27.1%): stance gap D = -0.12 [-0.17, -0.08]. After a challenge the simulator instead often re-states or re-interprets its request ("I meant ..."); about half of these turns are disguised insistence, which puts D between -0.08 and -0.05. What drives the simulator's disputing is whether the assistant's position is judged correct (21% vs. 49% after challenges; 16% vs. 58% after endorsements), while real users change little (19% vs. 24%; 7% vs. 12%), under every outcome definition we tried. Real same-stance examples do not fix this, and another GPT-based simulator and two Claude simulators show stance effects close to real users. Stance sensitivity should be measured for each simulator, not assumed.

translation.title: 模拟用户会像真实用户一样反驳吗？正确性 vs. 立场
translation.abstract: LLM 模拟用户在多轮评估中代替真人，其假设是它们会对助手所说的话做出反应。我们针对反驳（pushback）行为检验了这一假设。从 WildChat 中，我们选取助手明确挑战或赞同用户所持立场的对话，并将真实的下一轮用户发言与相同前缀下的模拟发言进行比较。在回复的用户中，真实用户在受到挑战后比受到赞同后更常反驳（20.5% vs. 8.2%）；而基于 GPT 的模拟器则不会（27.1% vs. 27.1%）：立场差距 D = -0.12 [-0.17, -0.08]。受到挑战后，模拟器反而常常重申或重新解释其请求（"我的意思是……"），其中约一半是变相的坚持，使 D 介于 -0.08 和 -0.05 之间。驱动模拟器争辩的因素是助手立场的正确性判断（挑战后 21% vs. 49%；赞同后 16% vs. 58%），而真实用户变化不大（19% vs. 24%；7% vs. 12%），在我们尝试的所有结果定义下均如此。真实的同立场示例无法解决这一问题，而另一个基于 GPT 的模拟器和两个 Claude 模拟器则表现出接近真实用户的立场效应。立场敏感性应当对每个模拟器分别测量，而非默认存在。
translation.brief: 检验 LLM 模拟用户是否像真实用户一样对助手立场做出反驳，发现模拟器主要依据正确性而非立场做出反应。

papers.title: Measuring Human-AI and AI-AI Teams in Multi-turn Layout Creation
papers.abstract: Co-creating layouts such as websites and slides is a useful testbed for evaluating multi-turn instruction following of LLM systems. Since an intended layout's appearance cannot be well expressed in a single turn, the user must wait for the LLM to generate a layout then iteratively refine it with the LLM over multiple turns. We present a small-scale, exploratory (n=6) study of this multi-turn process to compare the differences of human-AI and AI-AI teams on the same layout-generation task. Given a reference wire-frame layout, a participant or a language model 'speaker' issues natural-language instructions to a fixed 'listener' LLM over multiple turns until the speaker is satisfied. Rather than an LLM as the judge, we fit a scoring function over geometric layout features using curated human preference data (n=19). We find that LLMs tend to encode the entire layout in the first turn, while humans iterate over many turns on average, writing much shorter instructions. We also find that human-AI teams consistently scored lower than AI-AI teams. This gap is driven by a limiter of human participants in specifying precise sizes and positions (e.g. 42 pixels to the right). Humans perform almost at par with language models on other features like ordering the elements into nested structures. We then perform interventions on the speaker LLMs to make them more human-like, and find it difficult. This raises the challenge of using LLMs as user models to evaluate multi-turn co-creation tasks.

translation.title: 多轮布局创作中人机与AI-AI团队的测量
translation.abstract: 共同创作网站和幻灯片等布局是评估LLM系统多轮指令遵循能力的有效测试平台。由于目标布局的外观无法在单轮中充分表达，用户必须等待LLM生成布局，然后在多轮中与LLM迭代改进。我们针对这一多轮过程开展了一项小规模探索性研究（n=6），比较人机团队与AI-AI团队在相同布局生成任务上的差异。给定一个参考线框布局，参与者或语言模型'说话者'在多轮中向固定的'倾听者'LLM发出自然语言指令，直到说话者满意。我们不使用LLM作为评判者，而是利用精心整理的人类偏好数据（n=19）拟合一个基于几何布局特征的评分函数。我们发现，LLM倾向于在第一轮就编码整个布局，而人类平均在多轮中迭代，且指令要短得多。我们还发现人机团队的得分始终低于AI-AI团队。这一差距源于人类参与者在指定精确尺寸和位置（如向右42像素）方面的限制。人类在将元素组织成嵌套结构等其他特征上几乎与语言模型表现相当。随后我们对说话者LLM进行干预使其更像人类，但发现这很困难。这提出了使用LLM作为用户模型来评估多轮共创任务的挑战。
translation.brief: 研究人机与AI-AI团队在多轮布局共创中的差异，通过基于人类偏好数据拟合几何特征评分函数进行评估。

papers.title: Choosing a Side is not Enough: Epistemic Transparency Under Knowledge Conflict
papers.abstract: LLMs are increasingly used in professional knowledge work, where their outputs can influence decisions with real-world consequences. When a model encounters information that contradicts its prior knowledge, it should communicate this conflict transparently to the user. Existing work on knowledge conflicts focuses on which source, parametric or contextual, a model chooses, rather than whether models disclose the presence of the conflict. Moreover, existing work primarily studies multiple-choice questions under simplified counterfactual evidence generation schemes. In this work, we address the first gap by scoring model responses against a taxonomy of epistemic transparency, rather than measuring accuracy alone. We address the second gap by proposing a general framework for generating knowledge conflicts grounded in advanced domain knowledge, which we instantiate in this work as a set of real-world tasks based on counterfactual evidence. These contributions allow us to measure epistemic transparency under realistic knowledge conflicts, as well as the impact of the format and plausibility of the evidence, and the real-world stakes of the task. We find substantial differences in transparency across five evaluated frontier models, with none fully matching our definition of optimal, risk-sensitive epistemic alignment. We hope that our work will ground future discussion of epistemic transparency in real-world applications of LLMs, and help establish a risk framework for epistemic transparency across domains and deployment scenarios.

translation.title: 选边站还不够：知识冲突下的认知透明性
translation.abstract: LLM越来越多地用于专业知识工作，其输出可能影响具有现实后果的决策。当模型遇到与其先验知识相矛盾的信息时，应向用户透明地传达这一冲突。现有关于知识冲突的研究关注模型选择参数化知识还是上下文信息，而非模型是否披露冲突的存在。此外，现有研究主要在简化的反事实证据生成方案下研究多选题。在本工作中，我们通过依据认知透明性分类法对模型响应进行评分而非仅测量准确率来填补第一个空白。我们通过提出一个基于高级领域知识生成知识冲突的通用框架来填补第二个空白，并在本工作中将其实例化为一组基于反事实证据的现实任务。这些贡献使我们能够测量现实知识冲突下的认知透明性，以及证据的格式和合理性、任务的现实风险的影响。我们发现五个被评估的前沿模型在透明性上存在显著差异，没有一个完全符合我们对最优的、风险敏感的认知对齐的定义。我们希望我们的工作能为未来关于LLM现实应用中认知透明性的讨论奠定基础，并帮助建立跨领域和部署场景的认知透明性风险框架。
translation.brief: 提出认知透明性分类法和基于反事实证据的知识冲突生成框架，评估LLM在知识冲突时是否向用户披露冲突。

papers.title: What Counts as Attack Success? Evaluating Harmfulness in Red Teaming LLMs
papers.abstract: Judging whether a model response is harmful requires contextual and normative choices, yet red-teaming studies often delegate this judgment to automated evaluators. We examine how harmfulness criteria are specified in red-teaming research and how they carry through to reported results. Reviewing 76 papers, we find that many adopt their criteria from prior datasets, classifiers, or judge prompts rather than defining harmfulness themselves. Applying evaluators from these papers to identical outputs, we find that they can reach different judgments on the same response, which can change conclusions when comparing models. These differences arise partly because evaluators draw the boundary of harm in different places: some count any response that does not refuse, while others count only output that could plausibly cause harm. We argue that red-teaming studies should state their harmfulness criteria and report how they chose and validated their evaluators to support more reliable measurement and interpretation.

translation.title: 什么才算攻击成功？评估红队测试LLM中的有害性
translation.abstract: 判断模型响应是否有害需要情境性和规范性的选择，但红队测试研究常将这一判断委托给自动化评估器。我们考察红队测试研究中如何规定有害性标准，以及这些标准如何延续到报告的结果中。通过回顾76篇论文，我们发现许多研究采用先前数据集、分类器或评判提示中的标准，而非自行定义有害性。将这些论文中的评估器应用于相同的输出，我们发现它们对同一响应可能得出不同判断，这在比较模型时可能改变结论。这些差异部分源于评估器在不同位置划定危害边界：有些将任何不拒绝的响应都算作有害，而有些只计算可能实际造成危害的输出。我们认为红队测试研究应说明其有害性标准，并报告如何选择和验证其评估器，以支持更可靠的测量和解释。
translation.brief: 通过回顾76篇红队测试论文并交叉应用其评估器，揭示有害性判定标准不一致导致评估结论不可靠的问题。

papers.title: Benchmarking and Adapting LLMs for English-Swedish Medical Question Answering
papers.abstract: Large language models do well on English medical exams, but less is known about Swedish. This matters most for small open models that hospitals can run locally. To reduce this gap, we first build an item-aligned English-Swedish benchmark from ten medical multiple-choice datasets; each Swedish item keeps the options and answer of its English source. A conservative refinement loop repairs the translations: open models from three families find errors, ground them in a Swedish medical term base, and keep a model-written edit only if blind judges vote for it. On this benchmark, small models lose much more accuracy in Swedish than large ones, especially when they answer without reasoning. Second, we ask whether English data and open teacher models can close this gap. We translate the training data, let teachers write reasoning traces, and fine-tune two small students on gold answers or traces in English, Swedish, or both. Training on reasoning traces that include Swedish closes the gap and lifts the 1.2B student from 23.5\% to 52.0\% in Swedish, slightly above a 20B open model in its fast mode, with a sixth of its memory. We release the benchmark, its edit history, and the code.

translation.title: 面向英瑞（英语-瑞典语）医疗问答的LLM基准测试与适配
translation.abstract: 大型语言模型在英语医学考试中表现出色，但对瑞典语知之甚少。这对医院可在本地运行的小型开放模型尤为重要。为缩小这一差距，我们首先从十个医学多选题数据集构建了一个条目对齐的英瑞基准；每个瑞典语条目保留其英语源条目的选项和答案。一个保守的精修循环用于修复翻译：来自三个家族的开放模型查找错误，将其锚定于瑞典语医学术语库，且仅在盲评评判者投票通过时才保留模型撰写的编辑。在该基准上，小型模型在瑞典语上的准确率损失远大于大型模型，尤其是在不进行推理直接作答时。其次，我们探究英语数据和开放教师模型能否弥合这一差距。我们翻译训练数据，让教师模型撰写推理轨迹，并在金标准答案或轨迹上以英语、瑞典语或两者混合微调两个小型学生模型。在包含瑞典语的推理轨迹上训练弥合了差距，将1.2B学生模型的瑞典语成绩从23.5%提升至52.0%，略高于一个20B开放模型的快速模式，而内存占用仅为其六分之一。我们发布了基准、其编辑历史和代码。
translation.brief: 构建条目对齐的英瑞医疗问答基准，并通过翻译数据与教师模型生成推理轨迹微调小型模型来弥合瑞典语性能差距。

papers.title: VTree: Question-Driven Growth of Hierarchical Memory for Agentic Long-Video Understanding
papers.abstract: Long videos spanning tens of minutes to hours far exceed the context window of today's vision-language models, and the standard remedy of sparse uniform frame sampling discards exactly the fine-grained evidence that specific questions depend on. Existing video agents explore on demand but re-explore from scratch for every question and discard their exploration state once an answer is produced, so per-question cost scales with video length. Hierarchical-memory methods instead fix the scope of each depth in advance and deepen along a pre-committed pyramid rather than toward the question. We observe that a video's coarse structure (where its scenes and topics begin and end) is question-independent, whereas which part a question must zoom into, and how deep, is question-dependent. We propose VTree, which builds a coarse hierarchical memory tree over a video once and then, for each question, grows branches only where that question needs depth. The growth is globally routed so any part of the timeline is reachable, sufficiency-gated so drilling stops when the evidence suffices, and query-conditioned so a branch unfolds into the sub-intervals that answer \emph{this} question. Crucially, every expansion is written back into the video memory, allowing later questions to reuse previously discovered structure and evidence without repeating the corresponding expansion process. Across five long-video understanding benchmarks, VTree consistently improves the accuracy of diverse vision-language backbones while substantially reducing the context length and execution time required for each question.

translation.title: VTree：面向智能体长视频理解的问题驱动分层记忆增长
translation.abstract: 跨越数十分钟到数小时的长视频远超当今视觉语言模型的上下文窗口，而标准的稀疏均匀帧采样方法恰恰丢弃了特定问题所依赖的细粒度证据。现有视频智能体按需探索，但每个问题都要从头重新探索，并在产生答案后丢弃探索状态，因此每个问题的成本随视频长度扩展。分层记忆方法则预先固定每个深度的范围，沿预先确定的金字塔加深，而非朝向问题。我们观察到视频的粗粒度结构（场景和主题的起止位置）与问题无关，而问题必须放大到哪一部分以及多深则与问题相关。我们提出VTree，它先对视频构建一次粗粒度分层记忆树，然后针对每个问题只在该问题需要深度的地方生长分支。分支生长是全局路由的，因此时间线的任何部分都可达；由充分性门控，当证据足够时停止深入；且以查询为条件，使分支展开为回答该问题的子区间。关键在于，每次扩展都会写回视频记忆，使后续问题可以复用先前发现的结构和证据，而无需重复相应的扩展过程。在五个长视频理解基准上，VTree持续提升多种视觉语言骨干的准确率，同时大幅降低每个问题所需的上下文长度和执行时间。
translation.brief: 提出VTree，通过问题驱动的分层记忆树分支生长并写回探索结果，实现长视频理解中跨问题复用证据以降低成本。

papers.title: ORDO: Fine-Grained Motion Understanding in Video LLMs via Order-Dependent Supervision
papers.abstract: Video large language models (video LLMs) answer a wide range of questions about real videos, yet they remain weak at fine-grained motion such as whether an object speeds up or slows down. Existing methods train these models on synthetic motion clips, on order pretext tasks such as reordering shuffled clips, or with rewards that compare ordered and perturbed frames. None of them requires that the label be unrecoverable from the frames once their order is discarded, so a model can fit such data from static cues without learning to use frame order. We propose ORDO, a framework that builds this requirement into the training data. We define order-necessary supervision as data in which the unordered set of frames has the same distribution under competing labels, and we realise it for motion attributes with three constructions, time-reversal pairing, matched spatial extent and uniform interval coverage. A procedural curriculum of six motion primitives instantiates these constructions, and low-rank adapters of the language model are trained on it with an answer-level objective and self-distillation replay on real videos. With 4,000 synthetic clips, ORDO raises the mean accuracy over four motion benchmarks by +7.6, +4.9 and +5.1 points on Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3-VL-8B and Molmo2-8B, while the same training with shuffled frames changes it by less than one point. Code and generator will be made publicly available.

translation.title: ORDO：基于顺序依赖监督的视频大语言模型细粒度运动理解
translation.abstract: 视频大语言模型（video LLM）能够回答关于真实视频的各类问题，但在细粒度运动（如物体加速或减速）方面仍然薄弱。现有方法在合成运动片段上训练这些模型，或使用重排打乱片段等顺序前置任务，或使用比较有序帧与扰动帧的奖励。这些方法都不要求标签在丢弃帧顺序后无法从帧中恢复，因此模型可以仅凭静态线索拟合此类数据，而无需学会利用帧顺序。我们提出ORDO，一个将这一要求内建于训练数据的框架。我们将顺序必要监督定义为：在竞争标签下，无序帧集合具有相同分布的数据，并通过三种构造在运动属性上实现它：时间反转配对、匹配空间范围和均匀间隔覆盖。一个由六种运动基元组成的程序化课程实例化了这些构造，语言模型的低秩适配器在其上以答案级目标和真实视频上的自蒸馏回放进行训练。仅用4,000个合成片段，ORDO在四个运动基准上将Qwen3.5-9B、Qwen3-VL-8B和Molmo2-8B的平均准确率分别提升+7.6、+4.9和+5.1个百分点，而使用打乱帧的相同训练变化不足一个百分点。代码和生成器将公开发布。
translation.brief: 解决视频LLM无法利用帧顺序理解细粒度运动的问题，通过构造标签在无序帧下不可区分的顺序必要监督数据（时间反转配对等三种构造）训练模型。

papers.title: VidRouteBench: A Benchmark for Budgeted Video-Generation Routing
papers.abstract: Text-to-video generators differ by two orders of magnitude in price, and a cheap configuration of a strong model is often good enough for a prompt. Routing prompts across such arms (model x sampling configuration) should buy quality at fixed budget, but no dataset supports studying it: public video-preference sets contain only closed models, one configuration each. We release VidRouteBench: 16 arms from 7 open families spanning 121x in measured cost ($0.0025-$0.298 per clip), 27,110 clips (1,421 A800-hours) over 1,625 grouped prompts, a quality score frozen after calibration against human preferences (68.7% CV accuracy vs 66.2% for the best single scorer), per-clip scores on 9 identifiable quality dimensions, repeated seeds, an encrypted test split, and a sealed newest family for cold start. The evaluator compares a router against the best prompt-agnostic mixture of arms, not the best single arm. Per-prompt specialisation here is real and predictable (oracle gap 0.642, 47% reproducible across seeds, prompt-arm interaction F=4.47 at p=1.6e-63), unlike LLM-routing arms, where the same pipeline finds none. We then propose OPMU (one probe, many utilities): label a new arm on K probe prompts, predict its 9 dimensions once, and serve any scenario utility by scalarising afterwards. Over 215 utility directions OPMU Pareto-dominates the prompt-agnostic baseline for 94% of directions versus 90% for per-scenario routers, with no per-scenario retraining. Three baselines fail instructively: bag-of-words features lose almost all routing gain in the low-data regime (0.009 vs 0.168); crediting a new arm with its probe average is harmful (-3.32 recovery) although it is the strong baseline on RewardBench-style arms (0.786); Chebyshev scalarisation does not help, our cost-utility front being convex.

translation.title: VidRouteBench：面向预算约束视频生成路由的基准
translation.abstract: 文本到视频生成器的价格相差两个数量级，而强模型的廉价配置往往足以满足提示需求。在多个臂（模型×采样配置）之间路由提示应在固定预算下换取质量，但目前没有数据集支持这一研究：公开的视频偏好数据集只包含闭源模型，且每个模型只有一种配置。我们发布VidRouteBench：来自7个开源家族的16个臂，实测成本跨度121倍（每片段$0.0025-$0.298），27,110个片段（1,421个A800小时），覆盖1,625个分组提示；一个经人类偏好校准后冻结的质量评分（CV准确率68.7%，优于最佳单一评分器的66.2%）；9个可识别质量维度的逐片段评分；重复种子；加密测试集；以及用于冷启动的密封最新家族。评估器将路由器与最佳提示无关的臂混合策略比较，而非最佳单一臂。这里的逐提示特化是真实且可预测的（oracle差距0.642，47%可跨种子复现，提示-臂交互F=4.47，p=1.6e-63），而LLM路由臂中同一流程未发现特化。我们随后提出OPMU（一次探测，多种效用）：在K个探测提示上标注新臂，一次性预测其9个维度，之后通过标量化服务任意场景效用。在215个效用方向上，OPMU对94%的方向Pareto支配提示无关基线，而逐场景路由器为90%，且无需逐场景重训练。三个基线的失败颇具启发性：词袋特征在低数据 regime 中几乎失去全部路由收益（0.009 vs 0.168）；用探测平均值评价新臂是有害的（-3.32恢复），尽管它是RewardBench式臂上的强基线（0.786）；Chebyshev标量化无帮助，因为我们的成本-效用前沿是凸的。
translation.brief: 解决文本到视频生成路由缺乏研究数据集的问题，构建多臂多配置的VidRouteBench基准并提出OPMU方法：一次探测标注新臂后通过标量化服务任意场景效用。

papers.title: VideoGym: An Adaptive RL Environment for Long-Video Agents
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) trains video agents to locate sparse evidence for long-video question answering through structured memory retrieval and temporal re-observation. This training, however, faces a long-tail modality distribution in the data. In our source pool, text-heavy questions account for 58% of samples, compared with 15% graph-heavy, 17% visual-heavy, and 10% time-range questions. Fixed-distribution RL therefore allocates fewer rollouts to underperforming question types. Reweighting these types could increase their sampling frequency but repeatedly reuses the same finite banks of original questions. To solve this problem, we introduce VideoGym, a curriculum-based RL environment that jointly constructs video-grounded training tasks and allocates rollouts among them. Within the environment, a memory-augmented VideoAgent is trained to coordinate retrieval from text, graph, and visual memories with temporal re-observation. Across episodes, VideoGym adapts VideoAgent's training distribution online: it casts per-period sample selection as an adversarial bandit over (modality, mode) arms and applies the EXP3 update to shift sampling toward arms with low answer accuracy. To supply the augmented-mode arms, a TaskGenerator-Verifier pipeline produces harder variants of existing questions that remain answerable within the same video. Across five long-video benchmarks, VideoGym lifts RL accuracy from 60.4% to 64.8% on average and by up to 10.5 pp on underrepresented graph-heavy questions with 3.3x sample efficiency. Together, these results show that task expansion and adaptive allocation can improve video agent learning from limited, imbalanced training data.

translation.title: VideoGym：面向长视频智能体的自适应强化学习环境
translation.abstract: 强化学习（RL）通过结构化记忆检索和时间重观察，训练视频智能体为长视频问答定位稀疏证据。然而这种训练面临数据中的长尾模态分布。在我们的源池中，文本密集型问题占样本的58%，而图密集型占15%、视觉密集型占17%、时间段问题占10%。固定分布的RL因此会给表现不佳的问题类型分配更少的rollout。重新加权这些类型可以提高其采样频率，但会反复重用同一有限的原有问题库。为解决这一问题，我们引入VideoGym，一个基于课程的RL环境，联合构建基于视频的训练任务并在其间分配rollout。在该环境中，训练一个记忆增强的VideoAgent协调文本、图和视觉记忆的检索与时间重观察。跨回合地，VideoGym在线调整VideoAgent的训练分布：将每期样本选择转化为（模态，模式）臂上的对抗性老虎机问题，并应用EXP3更新将采样转向答案准确率低的臂。为提供增强模式臂，TaskGenerator-Verifier流水线生成现有问题的更难变体，且这些变体在同一视频中仍可回答。在五个长视频基准上，VideoGym将RL准确率平均从60.4%提升至64.8%，在代表性不足的图密集型问题上提升高达10.5个百分点，样本效率提升3.3倍。这些结果表明，任务扩展和自适应分配可以在有限、不平衡的训练数据下改进视频智能体学习。
translation.brief: 解决RL训练视频智能体时问题类型分布长尾不均衡的问题，通过课程式环境联合生成更难任务变体并用EXP3对抗性老虎机自适应分配rollout。

papers.title: ABCoord: An Artificial Bee Colony (ABC)-Based Decentralized Distributed Two-Layer Decision-Making Architecture for the Coordination of AI Agents
papers.abstract: Rapid progress in large language models (LLMs) is turning AI agents into multi-agent systems that jointly solve complex tasks, and the architecture that coordinates the agents toward a common goal is gaining fundamental importance in these systems. Since centralized architectures can become bottlenecks as the number of agents grows, whereas distributed architectures incur increasing communication costs, a decentralized coordination architecture that scales with low communication cost is needed. Recently, the structure of the artificial bee colony (ABC) algorithm has been defined for the first time as a two-layer decentralized information-processing and decision-making architecture. ABCoord is built on this proposed architecture. The results show that ABCoord, used for the coordination of AI agents, performs at a level comparable to existing architectures on the BigCodeBench benchmark in the self-test condition, in which the tests are also written by the language model. In the oracle condition, in which the solutions are evaluated with the official tests, the number of solved problems increases considerably.

translation.title: ABCoord：基于人工蜂群（ABC）的去中心化分布式两层AI智能体协调决策架构
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展正在使AI智能体成为共同解决复杂任务的多智能体系统，而将智能体协调向共同目标的架构在这些系统中变得至关重要。由于集中式架构在智能体数量增长时会成为瓶颈，而分布式架构会产生不断增长的通信成本，因此需要一种以低通信成本扩展的去中心化协调架构。最近，人工蜂群（ABC）算法的结构首次被定义为一种两层去中心化信息处理与决策架构。ABCoord即建立在这一提出的架构之上。结果表明，ABCoord用于AI智能体协调时，在自测条件（测试也由语言模型编写）下的BigCodeBench基准上表现与现有架构相当；在oracle条件（用官方测试评估解）下，解决的问题数量显著增加。
translation.brief: 解决多智能体系统中集中式协调易成瓶颈、分布式通信成本高的问题，将人工蜂群算法结构用作两层去中心化决策架构来协调AI智能体。

papers.title: Gradient-Free Few-Shot Adaptation of Vision Models via Agentic Coding
papers.abstract: Adapting a vision model to new classes from a few labeled images usually relies on gradient fine-tuning, which is unstable with so few images. We ask whether a coding agent can replace gradient descent for this task. We propose the Agent edit, a method in which a coding agent writes a program that sets the new class weights in the class head of a frozen COCO-trained detector, with no gradient step. The agent runs the detector on the labeled images a limited number of times and sees how much its edit lowers COCO mAP; the program rebuilds the weights without the agent. In the same head and with the same labels, the Agent edit outperforms full-decoder fine-tuning at five shots on 2 of four fine-grained sets, by 11.2 and 12.3 F1 points, and ties on the rest. At ten shots, fine-tuning ties with or outperforms it. Moreover, when the new classes are scored jointly with the COCO classes, the AP of the COCO class to which they belong falls by up to 33.3 points, and limiting that loss lowers F1 on the new classes. Most of the agent's programs share three parts, which we write as a formula that needs no agent. A classifier on frozen backbone features reaches a higher F1 than every method inside the head on every set. Hence a coding agent can replace gradient descent only in part: inside the head and at five shots.

translation.title: 基于智能体编码的无梯度少样本视觉模型适配
translation.abstract: 将视觉模型从少量标注图像适配到新类别通常依赖梯度微调，而图像如此之少时微调并不稳定。我们探究编码智能体能否在此任务中替代梯度下降。我们提出Agent edit方法：编码智能体编写一个程序，在冻结的COCO训练检测器的类别头中设置新类别权重，全程无梯度步骤。智能体以有限次数在标注图像上运行检测器，观察其修改对COCO mAP的降低程度；程序随后无需智能体即可重建权重。在相同的头和相同的标签下，Agent edit在四个细粒度数据集中的两个上于五样本设置下优于全解码器微调，分别高出11.2和12.3个F1点，其余持平。在十样本设置下，微调持平或更优。此外，当新类别与COCO类别联合评分时，其所属COCO类别的AP最多下降33.3点，而限制该损失会降低新类别的F1。智能体的大多数程序共享三个部分，我们将其写成一个无需智能体的公式。在冻结骨干特征上训练的分类器在每个数据集上都达到比头内所有方法更高的F1。因此，编码智能体只能部分替代梯度下降：仅在头内和五样本设置下。
translation.brief: 解决少样本下梯度微调不稳定的问题，让编码智能体编写程序直接设置冻结检测器类别头的新类权重，以无梯度方式完成适配。

papers.title: Is It the Agent or the Retry? Separating Selection from Agency in Text-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract: Agentic text-to-image systems wrap generators in loops of planning, routing, verification and refinement, and report large gains on compositional benchmarks, almost always relative to a single sample. We ask how much of the gain survives against Single-tool Rejection Retry (\ours): the strongest generator already in the system's pool, an off-the-shelf verifier, and retries that stop at the first accepted image under the system's own budget. Auditing four recent systems with official evaluators, we find that on GenEval SRR matches the accuracy of OctoT2I (0.962 vs.\ 0.96), recovers 63 to 90% of the gain of GEMS depending on the verifier, and exceeds GenPilot by 12 points with 2.3 generations per image; the effect persists with generators not tuned to the benchmark and on T2I-CompBench++. A closed-form analysis predicts the accuracy of SRR at every budget and shows that its gain is capped by the verifier's likelihood ratio. The same analysis also exposes genuine agentic gains: on GenEval 2, even the best of five samples chosen by the evaluator stays 15 points below the score GEMS reports (12 at the upper end of its 95% interval). We prove a ceiling on the accuracy that routing across generators can add, bracket it between one and three points on OctoT2I's own pool, and show that what OctoT2I's routing buys is compute (about 2.5 less than SRR at equal accuracy), not accuracy. In our offline distillation experiments selected samples teach the generator no more than random ones, which a short information argument explains. We end with a reporting checklist for agentic generation papers.

translation.title: 是智能体还是重试？在文生图生成中分离选择与智能体作用
translation.abstract: 智能体化文生图系统将生成器包裹在规划、路由、验证与精炼的循环中，并在组合性基准上报告了相对于单次采样的大幅提升。我们探究其中多少增益在面对单工具拒绝重试（SRR）时依然成立：SRR 使用系统池中已有的最强生成器、现成的验证器，并在系统自身预算内于第一张被接受的图像处停止重试。通过用官方评估器审计四个近期系统，我们发现：在 GenEval 上 SRR 达到与 OctoT2I 相当的准确率（0.962 对 0.96），根据验证器不同可恢复 GEMS 增益的 63% 至 90%，并以每张图 2.3 次生成超出 GenPilot 12 个百分点；该效应在未针对基准调优的生成器上以及 T2I-CompBench++ 上依然存在。一个闭式分析可预测 SRR 在任意预算下的准确率，并表明其增益受验证器似然比的上限约束。同一分析也揭示了真正的智能体增益：在 GenEval 2 上，即使由评估器从五个样本中选出最优者，仍比 GEMS 报告的分数低 15 个百分点（其 95% 区间上端为 12）。我们证明了跨生成器路由所能增加的准确率上限，在 OctoT2I 自身的池中将其限定在 1 至 3 个百分点之间，并表明 OctoT2I 的路由所换来的是计算节省（同等准确率下比 SRR 少约 2.5 次生成），而非准确率。在我们的离线蒸馏实验中，被选中的样本对生成器的教学效果并不优于随机样本，一个简短的信息论论证可以解释这一点。最后我们给出一份面向智能体生成论文的报告清单。
translation.brief: 该论文要解决的问题是量化智能体化文生图系统的真实增益，核心方法是用单工具拒绝重试（SRR）作为基线并结合闭式分析来分离选择效应与真正的智能体作用。

papers.title: PhoneQC: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs for Order-Level Smartphone Trade-in Inspection
papers.abstract: As vision-language models enter remote smartphone trade-in, sellers already upload six views and a diagnostic screen, which makes it easy to treat the human quote as a step a model can take over. A model may mark a crack or read the screen, yet the quote is a staff form: appearance fill stays near 0.25, and the closed models that score a little higher do so only on the orders they answer, so human appraisal remains necessary. Two obstacles stand in the way. (1) Single-view defect sets and attribute benchmarks do not score an order-level form under a fixed input contract, so a box or a leaked field can be mistaken for a finished quote. (2) The unread half of the form is the staff fields, and a model left to emit boxes or captions does not learn them. We present PhoneQC, a 335-order iPhone-heavy cut that ranks systems by a 0 to 100 form score (Score100) only inside matched protocols (images alone; images plus a detector sidecar), with a declared upper bound that is not ranked as a peer. As a case study on that board, field-only LoRA freezes the backbone, adapts attention projections, and supervises staff fields while leaving the defect list empty; the adapter sees the same images as the zero-shot model. On image-only T1 the 3B model rises from 26.6 to 33.3 at coverage 0.928; without the empty-blocker item the open ranking still favors the adapter, while the remaining gap to a person stays large on this cut.

translation.title: PhoneQC：面向订单级智能手机以旧换新质检的多模态大模型基准
translation.abstract: 随着视觉-语言模型进入远程智能手机以旧换新领域，卖家已经会上传六个视角的图片和一张诊断屏幕截图，这使得人们很容易认为人工报价是模型可以接管的步骤。模型或许能标记裂缝或读取屏幕，但报价是一份员工填写的表单：外观成色得分停留在 0.25 左右，而得分稍高的闭源模型也只在其作答的订单上表现更好，因此人工估价仍然不可或缺。这中间存在两个障碍：（1）单视角缺陷数据集和属性基准并未在固定输入契约下对订单级表单进行评分，因此一个检测框或一个泄露字段就可能被误认为是一份完成的报价；（2）表单中未被读取的一半是员工字段，而任由模型输出检测框或描述文字并不能学会这些字段。我们提出 PhoneQC，一个包含 335 个订单、以 iPhone 为主的数据切片，通过 0 到 100 的表单分数（Score100）仅在匹配的协议内（仅图像；图像加检测器辅助模块）对系统进行排名，并声明一个不参与排名的上限。作为该榜单上的案例研究，field-only LoRA 冻结主干、适配注意力投影，并在缺陷列表留空的情况下监督员工字段；该适配器与零样本模型看到相同的图像。在仅图像的 T1 上，3B 模型从 26.6 提升到 33.3，覆盖率为 0.928；去掉空块阻塞项后，开源排名仍然偏向该适配器，而在此切片上与人工的剩余差距依然很大。
translation.brief: 该论文要解决的问题是多模态大模型在订单级手机以旧换新质检表单填写上缺乏评估标准，核心方法是构建 PhoneQC 订单级基准并提出 field-only LoRA 微调来学习员工字段。

papers.title: ReMiC: Representation-Driven Token Pruning for 3D VLMs via Minimax Hierarchical Clustering
papers.abstract: 3D vision-language models (3D VLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in 3D scene understanding and spatial reasoning. However, their reliance on multi-view inputs produces long visual token sequences, imposing substantial computational overhead during inference. Existing pruning methods often rely on token salience or feature diversity as proxies for representativeness, without explicitly modeling the representation gap between the original token set and the retained subset, thereby leading to suboptimal representation of the original scene. In this paper, we propose ReMiC, a training-free, representation-driven token pruning framework based on minimax hierarchical clustering. ReMiC treats retained tokens as prototypes for the original observations, formulating pruning as minimizing the maximum representation error under a fixed token budget. Local prototype initialization allocates tokens according to regional representation needs, while global prototype refinement updates the selected prototypes using cross-region information to further reduce the maximum representation error. Extensive experiments conducted on three representative 3D VLMs across five 3D scene understanding benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization of our method. Notably, by retaining only 10% of visual tokens, ReMiC preserves 93.2% of the performance of Video-3D LLM and achieves a $2.04\times$ faster inference speed.

translation.title: ReMiC：基于极小极大层次聚类的表示驱动 3D VLM 视觉 token 剪枝
translation.abstract: 3D 视觉-语言模型（3D VLM）在 3D 场景理解和空间推理方面展现出强大能力。然而，其对多视角输入的依赖产生了冗长的视觉 token 序列，在推理时带来巨大的计算开销。现有剪枝方法通常依赖 token 显著性或特征多样性作为代表性的代理指标，而没有显式建模原始 token 集合与保留子集之间的表示差距，从而导致对原始场景的次优表示。本文提出 ReMiC，一个免训练的、基于极小极大层次聚类的表示驱动 token 剪枝框架。ReMiC 将保留的 token 视为原始观测的原型，将剪枝形式化为在固定 token 预算下最小化最大表示误差。局部原型初始化根据区域表示需求分配 token，而全局原型精炼利用跨区域信息更新所选原型，进一步降低最大表示误差。在三个代表性 3D VLM 上、跨五个 3D 场景理解基准的大量实验证明了我们方法的有效性和泛化性。值得注意的是，仅保留 10% 的视觉 token，ReMiC 保持了 Video-3D LLM 93.2% 的性能，并实现 2.04 倍的推理加速。
translation.brief: 该论文要解决的问题是 3D VLM 多视角输入导致的视觉 token 冗长与推理开销大，核心方法是将剪枝形式化为固定预算下最小化最大表示误差的极小极大层次聚类。

papers.title: Choose What Returns: Object-Aware KV Memory for Selective Recall in Interactive Video Generation
papers.abstract: Interactive long-video generation lets users build a story through successive prompts and reuse earlier characters and settings under new instructions. Existing memory methods retain past content, yet they often fail at precise selective recall, returning the wrong appearance of a person, mixing different people, or keeping an unrequested background. Based on our analysis of memory form and retrieval, we introduce an object-aware key--value (KV) memory framework for a frozen autoregressive diffusion generator. It keeps the original KV of tracked object regions, selects background KV outside them by attention-scores, and links each memory with a readable record of its source scene and observed appearance. An LLM selects the requested records, and a memory integrator supplies their KV for generation under the current prompt. We also introduce a six-scene evaluation that tests selective attribute modification, time-specific appearance recall, and multi-object composition, in which each person's requested past appearance changes across requests. Experiments show that our framework more reliably preserves each person's identity while reproducing their requested past appearance than existing memory methods, under both explicit scene references and natural-language cues.

translation.title: Choose What Returns：面向交互式视频生成中选择性回忆的对象感知 KV 记忆
translation.abstract: 交互式长视频生成让用户通过连续的提示构建故事，并在新指令下复用早先的角色和场景。现有记忆方法能够保留过去的内容，但在精确的选择性回忆上常常失败：返回某个人物错误的外观、混淆不同的人物，或保留未被要求保留的背景。基于我们对记忆形式与检索的分析，我们为一个冻结的自回归扩散生成器引入了对象感知的键-值（KV）记忆框架。它保留被追踪对象区域的原始 KV，通过注意力分数选择对象之外区域的背景 KV，并将每条记忆与一份可读的记录（其来源场景和观测到的外观）关联。一个 LLM 选择被请求的记录，一个记忆整合器在当前提示下为生成提供它们的 KV。我们还引入了一个六场景评估，测试选择性属性修改、特定时刻外观回忆和多对象组合，其中每个人物被请求的过去外观会随请求而变化。实验表明，在显式场景引用和自然语言线索两种条件下，我们的框架都比现有记忆方法更可靠地保持每个人物的身份，同时再现其被请求的过去外观。
translation.brief: 该论文要解决的问题是交互式长视频生成中记忆方法无法精确选择性回忆过去内容，核心方法是提出对象感知 KV 记忆框架，保留对象区域 KV 并由 LLM 选择记录供生成使用。

papers.title: SYLVA: Self-Correcting Multi-Agent Markets over Frozen LLMs via Escrow Settlement, Step-Level Fault Isolation, and Contextual Routing
papers.abstract: Open agent standards like the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent2Agent (A2A) connect independent AI tools, yet open multi-agent markets fail under three real-world hazards: local rules shift silently outside pretraining, copycat wrappers and confident hallucinators game ratings, and uniform chain scoring punishes accurate specialists whenever another stage fails (blame collapse). We present SYLVA, a market protocol turning frozen foundation models (no weight updates, $\Delta W = 0$) and human-maintained services into a self-correcting ecosystem. SYLVA combines an on-chain clearinghouse for escrow settlement and configurable creator royalties (85%/15% in our experiments), a boundary verifier for penalty-free out-of-domain (OOD) abstention and 3-peer step replay, a verifiable context-aware router compiling proven chains into 1-call skills with drift circuit breakers, and plain-English rule updates. We prove sufficient conditions for honest abstention, specialist protection against blame collapse, and wrapper elimination, and validate SYLVA across a 64-agent simulation, 6,543 live deepseek-flash API calls, and a Rust MCP SDK (rmcp) + Cairo clearinghouse deployed on Starknet Sepolia (19 live transactions). Without updating weights, SYLVA reaches 82.1% completion in 64-agent simulations and 98.3% on live LLM workflows (vs. 0.0% single frozen LLM and 45.6% static MCP/A2A), cuts false specialist penalties by 6.79x-10.8x, retains 86.2% creator revenue under wrapper/Sybil floods, and recovers rapidly after rule drift. Furthermore, 1-call skill compilation saves 78.3% of real LLM tokens, while our Starknet contracts verify zero-oracle quorum slashing and 32.32-bit fixed-point (Q32.32) routing on-chain. Code and contracts are at this https URL.

translation.title: SYLVA：通过托管结算、步骤级故障隔离与上下文路由在冻结 LLM 上构建自纠错多智能体市场
translation.abstract: 像 Model Context Protocol（MCP）和 Agent2Agent（A2A）这样的开放智能体标准连接了独立的 AI 工具，然而开放的多智能体市场在三种现实风险下会失效：本地规则在预训练之外悄然变化，山寨包装者和自信的幻觉者操纵评分，以及统一的链式评分在其他环节失败时惩罚了准确的专家（责任坍塌）。我们提出 SYLVA，一个将冻结的基础模型（无权重更新，ΔW = 0）和人工维护的服务转变为自纠错生态系统的市场协议。SYLVA 结合了用于托管结算和可配置创作者版税（实验中为 85%/15%）的链上清算所、支持无惩罚的域外（OOD）弃答和 3 节点步骤重放的边界验证器、将经过验证的链编译为带漂移熔断器的单调用技能的可验证上下文感知路由器，以及自然语言规则更新。我们证明了诚实弃答、专家免受责任坍塌以及消除包装者的充分条件，并通过 64 智能体仿真、6,543 次 live deepseek-flash API 调用，以及部署在 Starknet Sepolia 上的 Rust MCP SDK（rmcp）+ Cairo 清算所（19 笔链上交易）验证了 SYLVA。在不更新权重的情况下，SYLVA 在 64 智能体仿真中达到 82.1% 的完成率，在 live LLM 工作流中达到 98.3%（对比单冻结 LLM 的 0.0% 和静态 MCP/A2A 的 45.6%），将错误的专家惩罚降低 6.79 至 10.8 倍，在包装者/女巫攻击洪泛下保留 86.2% 的创作者收入，并在规则漂移后快速恢复。此外，单调用技能编译节省了 78.3% 的真实 LLM token，而我们的 Starknet 合约在链上验证了零预言机法定人数罚没和 32.32 位定点（Q32.32）路由。代码与合约见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 该论文要解决的问题是开放多智能体市场在规则漂移、评分操纵和责任坍塌下失效，核心方法是提出 SYLVA 协议，结合链上托管结算、步骤级故障隔离与上下文路由，使冻结 LLM 形成自纠错生态。

papers.title: STEGOGUARD-LM: Evaluating End-to-End Protection Against LLM Covert Channels
papers.abstract: A defense that disrupts hidden messages may still provide little protection if its detector rarely triggers an intervention. We present StegoGuard-LM, a controlled framework for evaluating defenses against covert messages in large language model outputs. We examine token-rank and synonym channels, with Unicode concealment as a structural control, and track messages through detection, intervention, and recovery. Deterministic rewriting prevented full recovery of 103 of 104 synonym-encoded messages when applied unconditionally, but only one when intervention depended on a detector set to limit false alarms. In a four-round replay on a 48-response subset, an attacker selecting from a fixed catalog recovered more bits by switching channels, although paired gains were not statistically significant after correction for multiple comparisons. Randomized rewriting showed no sustained advantage in this pilot. A more sensitive detector improved protection but modified about one-third of clean responses. These findings show how uneven detection can undermine effective rewriting and why protection must be evaluated alongside attacker adaptation and intervention on legitimate text.

translation.title: StegoGuard-LM：评估针对大语言模型隐蔽信道的端到端防护
translation.abstract: 一种破坏隐藏消息的防御，如果其检测器很少触发干预，可能提供的保护仍然有限。我们提出StegoGuard-LM，一个用于评估针对大语言模型输出中隐蔽消息的防御的受控框架。我们研究了token秩信道和同义词信道，并以Unicode隐藏作为结构性对照，追踪消息经过检测、干预和恢复的全过程。无条件应用时，确定性改写阻止了104条同义词编码消息中103条的完整恢复，但当干预依赖于为限制误报而设置的检测器时，仅阻止了1条。在48条响应子集上的四轮重放中，从固定目录中选择的攻击者通过切换信道恢复了更多比特，尽管在多重比较校正后配对增益在统计上不显著。在此试点中，随机化改写未显示出持续优势。更敏感的检测器提高了保护效果，但修改了约三分之一的正常响应。这些发现表明检测的不均衡如何削弱有效改写，以及为什么必须结合攻击者适应性和对合法文本的干预来评估保护效果。
translation.brief: 研究针对LLM输出隐蔽信道的防御评估问题，提出StegoGuard-LM框架，通过检测、干预、恢复全流程追踪来分析检测器灵敏度与改写策略对防护效果的影响。

papers.title: From Observation to Explanation: Mechanistic Interpretability of LLM-Generated Code for Principled Repair
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have transformed software development, yet our understanding of how they generate code remains critically underdeveloped. We address this gap by triangulating evidence across three layers. Longitudinally, autonomous agent-attributed code is statistically indistinguishable from human code under a semantic modification definition (HR = 1.019, p = 0.490), yet attracts disproportionately corrective modifications in production (49.1% vs 37.9% human baseline). This finding demands a causal explanation. Empirically, existing benchmarks overestimate LLM capabilities: models that achieve 84 to 89% correctness on synthetic tasks attain only 24 to 35% on real-world class-level code. Behaviourally, detection systems reveal puzzling asymmetries: GPT-3.5 is far more detectable than modern models (AUC-ROC = 0.96, a 27-point gap), even though modern models produce mutually similar code structures; yet no single feature reliably distinguishes AI-generated from human code at the class level, and the leading commercial detector achieves only 15 to 64% recall. Together, these findings raise a question that empirical studies cannot answer: why do LLMs generate code with these properties? This thesis proposes mechanistic interpretability, a causal token-level circuit tracing, as the bridge between empirical observation and principled correction. By identifying the transformer circuits responsible for detectable stylistic signatures, hallucination patterns, and systematic defects, we aim to drive an agentic repair framework that intervenes at the causal source of defects rather than patching surface symptoms.

translation.title: 从观察到解释：面向原则性修复的LLM生成代码的机制可解释性
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）已经改变了软件开发，但我们对它们如何生成代码的理解仍然严重不足。我们通过在三个层面进行证据三角验证来弥补这一空白。纵向来看，在语义修改定义下，自主智能体生成的代码在统计上与人类代码无法区分（HR = 1.019，p = 0.490），但在生产环境中却吸引了不成比例的纠正性修改（49.1% 对比人类基线37.9%）。这一发现需要因果解释。实证上，现有基准高估了LLM的能力：在合成任务上达到84%至89%正确率的模型，在真实世界的类级代码上仅达到24%至35%。行为上，检测系统揭示了令人困惑的不对称性：GPT-3.5远比现代模型更易被检测（AUC-ROC = 0.96，差距达27个百分点），尽管现代模型产生彼此相似的代码结构；然而没有任何单一特征能在类级别可靠地区分AI生成代码与人类代码，领先的商业检测器的召回率仅为15%至64%。这些发现共同提出了一个实证研究无法回答的问题：为什么LLM会生成具有这些性质的代码？本论文提出机制可解释性——一种因果的token级电路追踪——作为连接实证观察与原则性修正的桥梁。通过识别负责可检测风格特征、幻觉模式和系统性缺陷的transformer电路，我们旨在驱动一个智能体修复框架，在缺陷的因果源头进行干预，而非修补表面症状。
translation.brief: 针对LLM生成代码在生产中缺陷率偏高但原因不明的问题，提出用机制可解释性（token级电路追踪）定位缺陷的因果电路，以驱动原则性的智能体修复框架。

papers.title: Measuring and Teaching Language Model Agents to Act on Delayed Consequences
papers.abstract: Language model agents are increasingly asked to run ongoing multi-day operations rather than finish isolated single-turn tasks. In daily operations, today's choices reshape later observations and cash constraints because empty shelves hide lost walk-in demand, short-shipped customers quietly shrink future orders weeks later, and emergency buying drains working capital. We introduce SMB Bench, a calibrated 90-day wholesale simulator with 18 causally paired tasks and an 859-run frontier trace dataset, to ask what experience and learning signal make an agent better at noticing, attributing, and acting on the delayed consequences of its own decisions in unseen businesses. Across 16 frontier models, only 3 outperform a fixed buying rule; models often record a relevant diagnosis in their notes without changing later purchases in time, showing that diagnosing a problem, changing behavior, and improving a business are separate achievements. To study how experience improves those failures in an open model (Qwen3.8-27B), we used training-business records to identify operational rules and archived frontier quarters as starting states to continue from rather than transcripts to copy. On an unseen test business under identical evaluation instructions, the trained policy followed customer-protection commitments more consistently and reduced severe-loss quarters, while the additional profit benefit remained uncertain. Carrying those commitments through the quarter exposed the cost of fulfilling them, as early-quarter stocking habits left the buyer relying on emergency supply and a deteriorating supplier. The results separate recognizing a delayed effect, acting on it consistently, and coordinating surrounding decisions so that the response improves profit. SMB Bench connects these observations to a learning method by turning archived decisions and their consequences into reusable training experience.

translation.title: 测量并教会语言模型智能体应对延迟后果
translation.abstract: 语言模型智能体越来越多地被要求运行持续多天的运营，而非完成孤立的单轮任务。在日常运营中，今天的决策会重塑后续的观察和现金约束，因为空货架掩盖了流失的进店需求，短装的客户会在数周后悄然缩减未来订单，紧急采购会消耗营运资金。我们提出SMB Bench，一个经过校准的90天批发模拟器，包含18个因果配对任务和859次运行的前沿模型轨迹数据集，以探究什么样的经验和学习信号能让智能体更善于察觉、归因并应对自身决策在未见业务中的延迟后果。在16个前沿模型中，仅有3个优于固定的采购规则；模型常常在笔记中记录相关诊断却不及时改变后续采购，这表明诊断问题、改变行为和改善业务是三种不同的能力。为了研究经验如何改善开源模型（Qwen3.8-27B）中的这些失败，我们使用训练业务的记录来识别运营规则，并将存档的前沿模型季度作为可继续的起始状态，而非可供照抄的对话记录。在相同评估指令下的未见测试业务上，训练后的策略更一致地履行客户保护承诺并减少了严重亏损季度，而额外的利润收益仍不确定。在整个季度中贯彻这些承诺暴露了履行它们的成本，因为季度初的备货习惯使采购者依赖紧急供应和不断恶化的供应商。结果区分了识别延迟效应、持续对其采取行动，以及协调周边决策以使应对措施改善利润。SMB Bench通过将存档决策及其后果转化为可复用的训练经验，将这些观察与学习方法联系起来。
translation.brief: 针对语言模型智能体难以察觉并应对自身决策延迟后果的问题，构建90天批发运营模拟器SMB Bench进行测量，并利用存档运营记录转化为训练经验来改进智能体行为。

papers.title: How Far Can LLMs Go in Generating Android Lint Checks from Natural Language?
papers.abstract: Static analysis tools such as Android Lint, PMD, and CodeQL let developers add custom checks for project-specific rules. However, authoring a check is a demanding programming task: a rule can be stated in a few sentences, yet turning it into a working, tested check requires detailed knowledge of the analysis framework and its issue-detection logic. Recent work generates such checks with large language models (LLMs), but each system needs more than the natural language description a developer always has: a bug-fix patch, a CVE record, or a developer-written test suite to repair against. No prior work measures whether an LLM can turn a description into a working check, or what external knowledge it needs to do so. We introduce LintBench, a human-validated benchmark of 113 real-world Android Lint checks, each paired with a natural language description and its original test suite as a held-out oracle. We evaluate four LLMs, including proprietary and open-weight models. We compare prompting strategies, then evaluate execution-guided repair with and without retrieved API knowledge. Prompting alone reaches 30%-65% (pass@5) across models. Execution-guided repair and retrieval reach 57%-85% test-passing rates within five calls. Our results show that execution feedback raises the pass rate, while retrieved framework knowledge raises the compile rate, which reaches up to 99%. The framework knowledge helps the low-performing models the most, providing the knowledge they need to fix compilation errors. Of the generated checks that compile but fail their tests, 87% have false negatives, missing an issue the generated check should report. Based on our findings, getting the issue-detection logic right remains an open challenge. We release LintBench and the evaluation harness to support future work on generating Android Lint checks.

translation.title: LLM在从自然语言生成Android Lint检查方面能走多远？
translation.abstract: Android Lint、PMD和CodeQL等静态分析工具允许开发者为项目特定规则添加自定义检查。然而，编写一个检查是一项高要求的编程任务：一条规则可以用几句话描述，但将其转化为可运行、经过测试的检查需要详细了解分析框架及其问题检测逻辑。近期工作使用大语言模型（LLM）生成此类检查，但每个系统都需要开发者自然语言描述之外的东西：bug修复补丁、CVE记录或开发者编写的测试套件用于修复。此前没有工作测量LLM能否仅凭描述生成可用的检查，或需要哪些外部知识。我们提出LintBench，一个经人工验证的基准，包含113个真实世界的Android Lint检查，每个都配有自然语言描述，其原始测试套件作为留出的判定标准。我们评估了四个LLM，包括专有和开放权重模型。我们比较了提示策略，然后评估了有无检索API知识的执行引导修复。仅靠提示在各模型上达到30%至65%（pass@5）。执行引导修复和检索在五次调用内达到57%至85%的测试通过率。结果表明执行反馈提高了通过率，而检索的框架知识提高了编译率，最高达99%。框架知识对低性能模型帮助最大，为其提供了修复编译错误所需的知识。在编译通过但测试失败的生成检查中，87%存在假阴性，即遗漏了生成检查本应报告的问题。基于我们的发现，正确实现问题检测逻辑仍然是一个开放挑战。我们发布LintBench和评估工具以支持未来生成Android Lint检查的工作。
translation.brief: 针对LLM能否仅凭自然语言描述生成可用的Android Lint检查这一问题，构建LintBench基准并评估提示、执行引导修复与API知识检索等策略的效果。

papers.title: VideoJSON: A Minimal Harness Beats Purpose-Built Memory for Ultra-Long Video Understanding
papers.abstract: Answering questions over days or weeks of video requires searching for scattered clues across long timelines. Existing video agents rely on complex memory graphs and fixed retrieval pipelines, which restrict how the agent can search. We propose VideoJSON, a minimal harness for ultra-long video understanding that keeps the memory simple and lets a coding agent write its own search programs. During indexing, a vision-language model turns each minute of video into a single JSON record containing a dense caption and structured fields such as events, entities, places, and speech transcripts. At query time, the agent writes Python or Bash programs in a sandboxed container to filter, link, and read these records over multiple steps, without task-specific training or raw video access. On four ultra-long video benchmarks, VideoJSON with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash outperforms MAGIC-Video by 7.0, 20.0, and 24.75 points on EgoLifeQA, Ego-R1-Bench, and MM-Lifelong Week, and beats the best prior EgoMemReason score by 12.6 points. Across four policy models of increasing capability, VideoJSON's average score rises by up to 11.58 points over the weakest model, compared with at most 5.50 points for MAGIC-Video. Ablations show that both agentic code search and the structured JSON records drive these gains, while adding hourly summaries, extra tools, or video access changes the average score by less than 1.5 points. In addition, fine-tuning Qwen-3.5-Flash on 64 VideoJSON trajectories from an unrelated 100-hour livestream improves its MM-Lifelong scores by up to 8.25 points. Code will be open-sourced after publication.

translation.title: VideoJSON：极简框架在超长视频理解上胜过专用记忆机制
translation.abstract: 回答跨越数天或数周视频的问题需要在长时间线上搜索分散的线索。现有视频智能体依赖复杂的记忆图和固定的检索流水线，限制了智能体的搜索方式。我们提出VideoJSON，一个用于超长视频理解的极简框架，它保持记忆简单，并让编码智能体编写自己的搜索程序。在索引阶段，视觉语言模型将每分钟视频转化为单条JSON记录，包含密集描述和结构化字段，如事件、实体、地点和语音转录。在查询时，智能体在沙箱容器中编写Python或Bash程序，多步骤地过滤、关联和读取这些记录，无需任务特定训练或原始视频访问。在四个超长视频基准上，使用DeepSeek V4.1 Flash的VideoJSON在EgoLifeQA、Ego-R1-Bench和MM-Lifelong Week上分别超过MAGIC-Video 7.0、20.0和24.75分，并比此前最佳的EgoMemReason分数高出12.6分。在四个能力递增的策略模型上，VideoJSON的平均分数比较弱模型最多提升11.58分，而MAGIC-Video最多提升5.50分。消融实验表明，智能体代码搜索和结构化JSON记录共同驱动了这些增益，而添加小时级摘要、额外工具或视频访问对平均分数的改变不足1.5分。此外，在与任务无关的100小时直播的64条VideoJSON轨迹上微调Qwen-3.5-Flash，使其MM-Lifelong分数最多提升8.25分。代码将在发表后开源。
translation.brief: 针对超长视频问答中复杂记忆机制限制搜索的问题，提出VideoJSON极简框架：用JSON记录索引视频，让编码智能体自行编写搜索程序进行多步检索。

papers.title: How Behavioral Structure Shapes Agent Strategy in Language-Based Economic Games
papers.abstract: In competitive multi-agent economic games, agents continuously interact, strategize, and make decisions within a shared market. Consequently, every message produced by a language agent changes both the current economic state of the market and the opponent's subsequent behavior. Although terminal rewards can indicate whether a decision was effective and broad behavioral labels can provide a coarse interpretation of the interaction, neither specifies the concrete response that should be taken next. We therefore ask whether explicitly providing an opponent's operational structure to a focal agent changes the value of its task-specific executable response strategies and the resulting game outcome. Using Games in Language-based Economic Environments (GLEE) as a controlled environment, we investigate this question across bargaining, negotiation, and persuasion games. We analyze 298,357 trajectories using seven relational profiles and decompose each task's dominant profile into ten Act$\cdot$onomy structures, finding that dominant profiles have task-specific operational compositions. We then compare structure-blind and structure-aware policies in matched offline simulation and prospective online play. In fixed 334-game online cohorts for each task, the aware-minus-blind official-percentile point estimates of the profile-gated eligible samples are +2.52, +1.90, and +5.91 points in bargaining, negotiation, and persuasion, respectively (corresponding 95% confidence intervals include zero). Taken together, the results distinguish strategy selection from response realization: structure re-ranks strategies, while in persuasion the online point estimate becomes positive only when the policy also changes the submitted message or purchase action.

translation.title: 行为结构如何塑造基于语言的经济博弈中的智能体策略
translation.abstract: 在竞争性多智能体经济博弈中，智能体在共享市场中持续互动、制定策略并做出决策。因此，语言智能体产生的每条消息都会同时改变市场当前的经济状态和对手的后续行为。尽管终端奖励可以表明某个决策是否有效，宽泛的行为标签可以对交互提供粗略解释，但两者都无法指明下一步应采取的具体响应。因此我们提出问题：向焦点智能体显式提供对手的操作结构，是否会改变其任务特定的可执行响应策略的价值以及由此产生的博弈结果。我们以 Games in Language-based Economic Environments（GLEE）作为受控环境，在讨价还价、谈判和说服博弈中研究这一问题。我们使用七种关系画像分析了 298,357 条轨迹，并将每个任务的主导画像分解为十种 Act·onomy 结构，发现主导画像具有任务特定的操作构成。随后，我们在匹配的离线模拟和前瞻性在线对局中比较了结构盲视与结构感知策略。在每个任务固定 334 局的在线队列中，画像门控合格样本的感知减盲视官方百分位点估计在讨价还价、谈判和说服中分别为 +2.52、+1.90 和 +5.91 分（相应的 95% 置信区间包含零）。综合来看，结果区分了策略选择与响应实现：结构会对策略进行重排序，而在说服任务中，只有当策略同时改变所提交的消息或购买动作时，在线点估计才变为正值。
translation.brief: 研究向语言智能体显式提供对手操作结构是否改变其响应策略价值，方法是在 GLEE 环境中用关系画像与 Act·onomy 结构分解分析轨迹，并对比结构盲视与结构感知策略的离线模拟与在线对局表现。

papers.title: Selective Verification in Multi-Agent Orchestration with Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Agents can agree because they relied on the same flawed evidence. We use an exact model of nine binary votes to examine when a verifier should intervene. In the main comparison, workers err 20 percent of the time under ordinary conditions, shared failures occur in 10 percent of cases, and the verifier errs 2 percent of the time in either state. When worker error during a shared failure is 80 percent, checking close votes yields 7.93 percent verdict error, compared with 9.06 percent for random checks at the same expected check rate. The ordering reverses at 90 percent worker error during failure. At the matched check rate for that regime, checking close votes yields 9.98 percent error, random checks yield 9.41 percent, and ranking checks by their expected error reduction yields 6.73 percent. The model also shows that passing branch vote counts preserves the flat majority and reduces the number of messages the root receives. A design guide and a documentation audit of four Python frameworks translate these findings into implementation choices.

translation.title: 基于大语言模型的多智能体编排中的选择性验证
translation.abstract: 智能体可能达成一致，仅仅因为它们依赖了同样有缺陷的证据。我们使用一个九次二元投票的精确模型来考察验证者何时应当介入。在主要对比中，工人在普通条件下出错率为 20%，共享失败发生在 10% 的情形中，验证者在任一状态下出错率为 2%。当共享失败期间工人错误率为 80% 时，检查接近的投票产生 7.93% 的判定错误率，而在相同期望检查率下随机检查为 9.06%。当失败期间工人错误率达到 90% 时，排序发生逆转。在该情形的匹配检查率下，检查接近投票产生 9.98% 的错误率，随机检查为 9.41%，而按期望错误降低量对检查排序则为 6.73%。该模型还表明，传递分支投票计数可以保持平坦的多数并减少根节点接收的消息数量。我们通过一份设计指南和对四个 Python 框架的文档审计，将这些发现转化为实现选择。
translation.brief: 研究多智能体编排中验证者应何时及如何介入，方法是用九次二元投票的精确模型分析不同检查策略的错误率并给出实现指南。

papers.title: Jailbreaks Are Global or Regional? A Controlled Study of Scale and Geolocation Effects on LLM Safety Verification
papers.abstract: Safety tests are used to compare language models and to decide where they can be deployed. Their main number, the attack success rate (ASR), can only be compared across models if nothing but the model changes. We test two factors that are usually assumed away: the size of the model and the place a request seems to come from. We evaluate twelve models from 0.5B to 671B parameters with a paired two-phase protocol (plain harmful prompts, then the same requests inside published jailbreak templates). We also send identical prompts through VPN exit nodes in five cities on three continents. Inside the Llama and Qwen families, Phase~2 ASR falls steeply with size (Qwen2.5: 70.8\% at 0.5B, 51.2\% at 7B, 12.6\% at 72B). Wrapping shifts every model by a similar amount on the log-odds scale (1.7 to 2.9); small models shift slightly more, but that gap nearly vanishes when we allow for judge false positives. Parameter count is a weak proxy for safety: Phi-3.5-mini (3.8B) has less than half the ASR of Llama-3.2-3B and Gemma-2-2B, and Mixtral-8x7B is far weaker than 70B dense models. Judge agreement falls as ASR rises ($r=-0.96$), so ASR gaps between sizes carry unequal measurement error; the size gap survives a stress test, but Phi-3.5-mini's lead does not. A small activation probe is consistent with Phi-3.5-mini keeping a clear refusal/compliance split under wrapping while Qwen2.5-0.5B loses it. We detect no effect of request location (permutation $p\ge0.18$ for three models). The test is limited: it could only detect a true between-city spread of about 2--5 points or a single-city shift of about 5--8 points, and most hosted models were reached through a gateway that may hide the exit city from the model provider. We close with a reporting checklist for safety verification.

translation.title: 越狱是全球性还是区域性？规模与地理位置对 LLM 安全验证影响的受控研究
translation.abstract: 安全测试被用于比较语言模型并决定其可部署的位置。其主要指标攻击成功率（ASR）只有在除模型外其他因素都不变时才能跨模型比较。我们检验了两个通常被默认忽略的因素：模型规模和请求看似来自的地点。我们采用配对两阶段协议（先普通有害提示，再将相同请求嵌入已发表的越狱模板），评估了从 0.5B 到 671B 参数的十二个模型。我们还通过三大洲五个城市的 VPN 出口节点发送相同提示。在 Llama 和 Qwen 家族内部，第二阶段 ASR 随规模急剧下降（Qwen2.5：0.5B 为 70.8%，7B 为 51.2%，72B 为 12.6%）。越狱包装在对数几率尺度上使所有模型产生相近的偏移（1.7 至 2.9）；小模型偏移略大，但在考虑裁判误报后该差距几乎消失。参数量是安全性的弱代理：Phi-3.5-mini（3.8B）的 ASR 不到 Llama-3.2-3B 和 Gemma-2-2B 的一半，而 Mixtral-8x7B 远弱于 70B 稠密模型。裁判一致性随 ASR 上升而下降（r=-0.96），因此不同规模间的 ASR 差距带有不等的测量误差；规模差距在压力测试中依然存在，但 Phi-3.5-mini 的领先则不然。一个小的激活探针结果与 Phi-3.5-mini 在包装下仍保持清晰的拒绝/顺从分离、而 Qwen2.5-0.5B 丧失该分离相一致。我们未检测到请求地点的影响（三个模型的置换检验 p≥0.18）。该测试存在局限：只能检测约 2–5 分的真实城市间差异或约 5–8 分的单城市偏移，且大多数托管模型经由可能向模型提供方隐藏出口城市的网关访问。我们最后给出一份安全验证报告清单。
translation.brief: 研究模型规模与请求地理位置是否影响 LLM 安全验证中的 ASR，方法是对十二个模型采用配对两阶段越狱协议并通过多城市 VPN 节点发送相同提示进行受控评估。

papers.title: Med-Agentic: Distilling Agentic Medical Reasoning with Internalized Meta-Capabilities
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) in expert domains face a trade-off between agentic tool use, which externalizes expertise behind brittle multi-turn runtimes, and end-to-end specialization, which internalizes expertise only implicitly at task-level granularity. We propose internalized meta-capabilities: atomic, parametrically internalized, and composable reasoning units that an LLM can select and combine within a single chain-of-thought (CoT). We instantiate this idea as Med-Agentic for medical visual diagnosis, where the model emits a capability-tagged structured CoT in one forward pass, turning capability invocation into tagged token generation rather than external tool calls. For training, Med-OPD performs multi-teacher on-policy distillation with token-level dual-factor teacher routing conditioned on both the image and the active capability tag, strictly generalizing per-prompt teacher routing. We show that this routing gives an unbiased estimator of the same expected teacher-KL gradient. Across public medical imaging datasets spanning nine anatomies and eight modalities, Med-Agentic consistently improves in-distribution and out-of-distribution diagnostic accuracy over the strong competitors.

translation.title: Med-Agentic：通过内化元能力蒸馏智能体医学推理
translation.abstract: 专家领域中的大语言模型（LLM）面临权衡：智能体式工具使用将专业知识外化于脆弱的多轮运行时之后，而端到端特化仅在任务级粒度上隐式内化专业知识。我们提出内化元能力：原子化、参数化内化且可组合的推理单元，LLM 可在单条思维链（CoT）中选择和组合它们。我们将这一思想实例化为面向医学视觉诊断的 Med-Agentic，模型在单次前向传播中输出带能力标签的结构化 CoT，将能力调用转化为带标签的 token 生成而非外部工具调用。在训练方面，Med-OPD 执行多教师在线策略蒸馏，采用同时以图像和当前能力标签为条件的 token 级双因子教师路由，严格推广了逐提示教师路由。我们证明该路由给出同一期望教师-KL 梯度的无偏估计量。在涵盖九个解剖部位和八种模态的公开医学影像数据集上，Med-Agentic 在分布内和分布外诊断准确率上均持续优于强竞争者。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 在专家领域中工具使用与端到端特化之间的权衡问题，方法是将元能力参数化内化并通过能力标签结构化 CoT 与多教师在线策略蒸馏实现医学视觉诊断。

papers.title: From Point Clouds to Engineering Models: Benchmarking Agentic 3D Reconstruction in the Built Environment
papers.abstract: Coding agents can translate 3D measurements into CAD geometry, but reconstructing engineering models for the built environment demands semantic interpretation and consistent construction constraints beyond surface fitting. We formulate scene-level Scan-to-BIM (Building Information Modeling) as an agentic 3D coding task and introduce S2Bench, comprising public and proprietary scans of 128 real-world scenes across five domains, paired with expert-curated reference models spanning diverse spatial scales. A shared framework lets agents measure scans in Python, build class-labeled components in a live CAD/BIM kernel, and iteratively refine their code. We also propose parallel asynchronous collaboration, where a lead delegates versioned tasks, continues modeling while workers execute, and integrates revision-bound proposals. Evaluating five agents and a collaborative team across 1,028 reconstructions shows that scan-to-model residuals directly guide geometric repair, whereas inferring semantic classes and construction relations requires joint geometric, visual, and engineering reasoning that agents struggle to ground and verify. Consequently, the leading agent fits scan geometry closely ($96\%$ coverage within $5\,\text{cm}$) yet reaches only $63\%$ mIoU, and no agent passes all engineering checks on more than $38\%$ of scenes. Coverage and engineering conformance drop with scene scale, whereas running a smaller model as a team improves all three axes with greater coverage gains on larger scenes. The project page is available at this https URL

translation.title: 从点云到工程模型：建成环境中智能体 3D 重建的基准测试
translation.abstract: 编码智能体可以将 3D 测量转化为 CAD 几何，但为建成环境重建工程模型需要超越表面拟合的语义解释和一致的构造约束。我们将场景级 Scan-to-BIM（建筑信息建模）形式化为智能体 3D 编码任务，并推出 S2Bench，包含五个领域 128 个真实场景的公开与专有扫描，以及覆盖多样空间尺度、由专家整理的参考模型。一个共享框架让智能体用 Python 测量扫描、在实时 CAD/BIM 内核中构建带类别标签的构件并迭代改进其代码。我们还提出并行异步协作：由主导者委派带版本的任务，在工作者执行的同时继续建模，并整合带修订约束的提案。对五个智能体和一个协作团队共 1,028 次重建的评估表明，扫描到模型的残差可直接指导几何修复，而推断语义类别和构造关系则需要智能体难以落地和验证的几何、视觉与工程联合推理。因此，领先的智能体能紧密拟合扫描几何（5 cm 内覆盖率达 96%），但 mIoU 仅 63%，且没有智能体在超过 38% 的场景上通过全部工程检查。覆盖率和工程符合度随场景规模增大而下降，而以较小模型组队运行则在三个维度上均有提升，且在大场景上覆盖率提升更大。项目页面见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 解决建成环境中 Scan-to-BIM 重建缺乏基准的问题，方法是构建 S2Bench 基准并提出并行异步协作框架来评估智能体从点云重建工程模型的能力。

papers.title: AutoPILOT: A Visual Agent Harness for Real-Time Gameplay
papers.abstract: Multimodal foundation models can play video games well when the game waits for them, but often fail when it keeps running. We find that much of this gap lies in the harness, which decides what the model sees, what it remembers, and how its outputs become actions over time. Existing harnesses such as VISTA improve the first two, yet turn each model call into at most one action, so the agent acts only as often as its model thinks. We introduce AutoPILOT, which changes the third: in each model call, the model can send a primitive action, start an open-loop macro, or write a closed-loop controller that keeps playing from the screen without further model calls until it hands control back. To evaluate agents in real-time games, we build AFK-Bench, 120 diverse browser games grouped by how they respond to inaction and playable in real time or with the clock paused. With GPT-6.1 Sol under the same budgets, AutoPILOT reaches 68.6% real-time success against 38.3% for VISTA, and on GameWorld it keeps 80.0% in real time while VISTA drops from 84.1% to 42.9%. Its gains hold across models, and it reaches VISTA's final success rate at a fifth of its API cost. Our results suggest that how a harness turns model outputs into actions over time is a central yet underexplored part of agent design, and we hope AutoPILOT and AFK-Bench will serve as a foundation for agents in a world that does not wait.

translation.title: AutoPILOT：面向实时游戏的视觉智能体框架
translation.abstract: 多模态基础模型在游戏等待它们时能玩得很好，但在游戏持续运行时往往失败。我们发现这一差距很大程度上源于框架（harness），它决定模型看到什么、记住什么，以及其输出如何随时间转化为动作。现有框架如 VISTA 改进了前两者，但每次模型调用最多产生一个动作，因此智能体的行动频率受限于模型的思考频率。我们提出 AutoPILOT，改变了第三点：在每次模型调用中，模型可以发送一个原子动作、启动一个开环宏，或编写一个闭环控制器，该控制器直接根据屏幕持续操作而无需进一步模型调用，直到交还控制权。为在实时游戏中评估智能体，我们构建了 AFK-Bench，包含 120 个多样化的浏览器游戏，按其对不作为的反应方式分组，可实时游玩或在时钟暂停时游玩。在相同预算下使用 GPT-6.1 Sol，AutoPILOT 实时成功率达 68.6%，而 VISTA 为 38.3%；在 GameWorld 上，AutoPILOT 实时保持 80.0%，而 VISTA 从 84.1% 降至 42.9%。其收益在不同模型上均成立，且仅用 VISTA 五分之一的 API 成本即达到其最终成功率。我们的结果表明，框架如何将模型输出随时间转化为动作是智能体设计中核心却未被充分探索的部分，我们希望 AutoPILOT 和 AFK-Bench 能为在不等待的世界中运行的智能体奠定基础。
translation.brief: 解决实时游戏中智能体因每次模型调用只能产生一个动作而行动过慢的问题，方法是在每次调用中让模型可发出原子动作、开环宏或编写无需再调用模型的闭环控制器。

papers.title: Evaluating Memanto on DolphinBench for AI Agents
papers.abstract: Memory benchmarks built on question answering tell an agent which fact to recall. Workplace requests often leave that need implicit: to post an update in the team's channel, an agent must work out which channel from earlier interactions and use it in a tool call. We evaluate Memanto, a memory agent that ranks memories with an information-theoretic relevance score, on DolphinBench, which tests memory through 600 simulated workplace tasks, each validated as requiring memory. Running in the Hermes agent harness with GPT-6-Luna and at most 6 iterations per conversation, Memanto completes 503 tasks (83.83%). The strongest configuration reported by the benchmark's authors, Mem0 with GPT-5.6-Luna and up to 60 iterations, completes 424 (70.67%). Memanto's run also has the lowest total cost ($10.86, against $61.48 for the cheapest reported run) and the shortest median task latency (15.32s). Grading uses the benchmark's own judge, but the agent model differs, so these results compare complete systems. The memory system affects both whether an agent completes such tasks and what completion costs.

translation.title: 在 DolphinBench 上评估面向 AI 智能体的 Memanto
