translation.abstract: 基于问答的记忆基准会告诉智能体需要回忆哪条事实。职场请求往往让这一需求隐含：要在团队频道发布更新，智能体必须从早先交互中推断出是哪个频道并在工具调用中使用它。我们在 DolphinBench 上评估 Memanto——一个用信息论相关性分数对记忆排序的记忆智能体。DolphinBench 通过 600 个模拟职场任务测试记忆，每个任务均经验证需要记忆。在 Hermes 智能体框架中使用 GPT-6-Luna、每次对话最多 6 次迭代运行，Memanto 完成 503 个任务（83.83%）。基准作者报告的最强配置——Mem0 配 GPT-5.6-Luna、最多 60 次迭代——完成 424 个（70.67%）。Memanto 的运行总成本也最低（10.86 美元，对比最便宜报告运行的 61.48 美元），任务中位延迟最短（15.32 秒）。评分使用基准自带的评判器，但智能体模型不同，因此这些结果比较的是完整系统。记忆系统既影响智能体能否完成此类任务，也影响完成成本。
translation.brief: 解决记忆智能体在隐含记忆需求的职场任务上的评估与效率问题，方法是用信息论相关性分数对记忆排序并在 DolphinBench 上与 Mem0 等系统对比。

papers.title: FinEvo: Recursive Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Financial Modeling
papers.abstract: Advances in large language models (LLMs) have expanded their role in high-value productivity tasks, including financial analysis and modeling, while enabling models to play an increasingly active role in their own improvement. This motivates two complementary lines of inquiry: can financial modeling capabilities provide a foundation for model self-evolution, and can self-evolution, in turn, advance financial capabilities? We introduce FinEvo, a self-evolution framework that integrates autonomous experience construction with financial capability improvement. FinEvo prepares financial models, iteratively evolves challenges through self-play, and learns from the resulting interactions using executable rewards, relying on the same model throughout. An end-to-end execution with Qwen3.6-27B shows that solving feedback supports both increasing reasoning demands and identifying specification issues that executable checks can miss. Learning from these experiences raises whole-task success from 22.73 to 29.09 on held-out within-source tasks and from 13.13 to 19.19 on SpreadsheetBench 2 Financial. Comparable gains across task sources and evaluation settings, together with improvement on a task category absent from training, suggest that FinEvo strengthens underlying financial modeling capabilities shared across tasks. These findings support self-evolution as a path toward broader financial competence, advancing the empirical exploration of recursive self-improvement (RSI) in professional domains. Code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: FinEvo：面向长程金融建模的递归自我改进
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的进展扩展了其在高价值生产力任务中的作用，包括金融分析与建模，同时使模型在自身改进中扮演越来越积极的角色。这引出两条互补的研究路线：金融建模能力能否为模型自我进化提供基础，以及自我进化能否反过来推进金融能力？我们提出 FinEvo，一个将自主经验构建与金融能力提升相结合的自我进化框架。FinEvo 准备金融模型，通过自我博弈迭代演化挑战，并使用可执行奖励从产生的交互中学习，全程依赖同一模型。使用 Qwen3.6-27B 的端到端执行表明，求解反馈既支持不断提高的推理需求，也能识别可执行检查可能遗漏的规格问题。从这些经验中学习使同源 held-out 任务上的整任务成功率从 22.73 提升至 29.09，在 SpreadsheetBench 2 Financial 上从 13.13 提升至 19.19。跨任务来源与评估设置的可比收益，以及在训练中缺失的任务类别上的改进，表明 FinEvo 强化了跨任务共享的底层金融建模能力。这些发现支持自我进化作为通向更广泛金融能力的路径，推进了专业领域中递归自我改进（RSI）的实证探索。代码见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 解决如何让 LLM 通过自我进化提升金融建模能力的问题，方法是自主构建经验、自我博弈演化挑战并用可执行奖励学习。

papers.title: Demystifying the Autoresearch Harness: How Context and Skills Shape Self-Evolving Agents
papers.abstract: Autoresearch agents, which autonomously design, run, and refine experiments, are accelerating scientific progress, particularly in AI research. However, existing agents rely on harnesses that combine multiple mechanisms, making it difficult to determine how individual components contribute to performance. We systematically study harness design for long-horizon, self-evolving autoresearch agents along two dimensions: context management, which determines what an agent retains from its past attempts, and skill management, which governs how it stores and reuses lessons from those attempts. Across MLE-Bench and KernelBench with gpt-oss-120b, gpt-6-luna, and gpt-6-sol, we isolate the effects of individual harness design choices by evaluating each against a recency-truncation baseline within a shared agent framework. For context management, we find that preserving individually accessible records of past attempts is more effective than maintaining a rolling summary, with context folding performing best across all six settings and improving upon the baseline by up to 19.2%. For skill management, selectively discarding persistently unused lessons is more effective on average than consolidating them or promoting them to standing rules. Building on these findings, we combine context folding and skill deletion in MLEvolver, which achieves a 72.7% medal rate on MLE-Bench Lite and a 94% $\mathrm{fast}_1$ score on KernelBench Level 3, substantially outperforming AIDE and OpenEvolve under the same inference budget. Overall, our study distills design principles for preserving experimental history and curating reusable lessons in autoresearch harnesses, paving the way for agents that turn accumulated experience into sustained progress.

translation.title: 揭秘自动科研框架：上下文与技能如何塑造自我进化智能体
translation.abstract: 自动科研智能体能够自主设计、运行和改进实验，正在加速科学进步，尤其是在 AI 研究中。然而，现有智能体依赖组合了多种机制的框架，难以确定各组件对性能的贡献。我们沿两个维度系统研究长程、自我进化自动科研智能体的框架设计：上下文管理（决定智能体从过往尝试中保留什么）和技能管理（决定它如何存储和复用这些尝试的经验教训）。在 MLE-Bench 和 KernelBench 上使用 gpt-oss-120b、gpt-6-luna 和 gpt-6-sol，我们在共享智能体框架内将每种设计选择与近期截断基线对比，以隔离各框架设计选择的效果。对于上下文管理，我们发现保留每条可单独访问的过往尝试记录比维护滚动摘要更有效，其中上下文折叠在全部六个设置中表现最佳，较基线最多提升 19.2%。对于技能管理，选择性地丢弃持续未使用的经验教训平均比合并它们或将其提升为常设规则更有效。基于这些发现，我们在 MLEvolver 中结合上下文折叠与技能删除，在 MLE-Bench Lite 上达到 72.7% 的奖牌率，在 KernelBench Level 3 上达到 94% 的 $\mathrm{fast}_1$ 分数，在相同推理预算下大幅超越 AIDE 和 OpenEvolve。总体而言，我们的研究提炼了自动科研框架中保存实验历史和整理可复用经验教训的设计原则，为将积累经验转化为持续进步的智能体铺平道路。
translation.brief: 解决自动科研智能体框架中各组件贡献不明的问题，方法是在统一框架内系统消融上下文管理与技能管理的设计选择并提炼设计原则。

papers.title: Learning a Rule Bank to Revise 3D CT Reports with Independent Evidence
papers.abstract: Vision--language models can generate fluent radiology reports from 3D chest CT scans, yet they may still omit abnormalities or misstate findings. Independent image analysis using models separate from the report model provides additional observations, but acting on uncertain evidence may introduce new errors. We propose an agent system that learns a revision policy represented as an executable rule bank for each report model. Inspired by experience banks, the agent proposes and refines rules using revision outcomes across development cases. During inference, the retained rules guide local edits using independent classifier predictions and quantitative image measurements without retraining the report model. Unedited sentences are preserved, and each change is linked to the rule that triggered it. On CT-RATE, revision increases CE-F1 by 11.5 points for SelfCue-KD and 0.9 points for NV-Reason-CT, with gains across five draft-sampling seeds. SelfCue-KD's CT-FineBench score also increases by 15.2 points. Draft-only rule learning yields limited gains, while the two image-evidence sources provide complementary benefits for abnormality detection. Measurements also supply numerical details missing from the drafts. These results support learning model-specific rules to control how independent image evidence informs report revision. Code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: 学习规则库以利用独立证据修订 3D CT 报告
translation.abstract: 视觉-语言模型能从 3D 胸部 CT 扫描生成流畅的放射学报告，但仍可能遗漏异常或错误陈述发现。使用与报告模型分离的模型进行独立图像分析可提供额外观察，但基于不确定证据行动可能引入新错误。我们提出一个智能体系统，为每个报告模型学习一个表示为可执行规则库的修订策略。受经验库启发，智能体利用开发案例上的修订结果提出并精炼规则。推理时，保留的规则利用独立分类器预测和定量图像测量指导局部编辑，无需重新训练报告模型。未编辑的句子被保留，每处修改都链接到触发它的规则。在 CT-RATE 上，修订使 SelfCue-KD 的 CE-F1 提升 11.5 分，NV-Reason-CT 提升 0.9 分，且在五个草稿采样种子上均有收益。SelfCue-KD 的 CT-FineBench 分数也提升 15.2 分。仅用草稿学习规则收益有限，而两种图像证据来源对异常检测提供互补收益。测量值还补充了草稿中缺失的数值细节。这些结果支持学习模型特定规则来控制独立图像证据如何指导报告修订。代码见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 解决视觉-语言模型生成的 CT 报告遗漏或误述发现的问题，方法是为每个报告模型学习可执行规则库，用独立分类器预测和定量测量指导局部修订。

papers.title: Intelligence as a Founding Principle: The O-RAN Architecture for Artificial Intelligence and Its Reference Implementations
papers.abstract: Since its inception, O-RAN has established openness and intelligence as founding principles of the RAN, transforming closed base stations into disaggregated, multi-vendor systems with a hierarchical RIC. This article traces AI/ML in O-RAN through open specifications and reference implementations to 6G design. We examine how open fronthaul, RIC interfaces, cloud orchestration, and AAL profiles support control loops across multiple timescales, model management, and hardware acceleration. Commercial deployments and OTIC testing demonstrate multi-vendor interoperability. Open-source stacks and testbeds support pre-standardization studies of in-node dApps. Within this architecture, GPU-based AI-RAN platforms realize the inline High-PHY split on shared RAN and AI compute, providing one reference implementation path for the O-RAN AAL alongside other implementations on heterogeneous hardware. Vector instruction sets and analog in-memory computing offer longer-term options for improving energy efficiency. For 6G, extending intelligence to time-critical radio processing and mobile agent services calls for deadline-bounded third-party inference, energy-efficient RAN/Edge-AI silicon co-design, and agent session continuity across handovers. We propose a RAC that coordinates agents across tiers through local shells and a shared exposure gateway, with in-node operating bounds delivered asynchronously. We also propose Recursive Standardization, in which results from federated open labs inform candidate 6G requirements and standards review guides the next round of implementation and testing.

translation.title: 以智能为奠基原则：面向人工智能的O-RAN架构及其参考实现
translation.abstract: 自诞生以来，O-RAN将开放性与智能确立为无线接入网（RAN）的奠基原则，把封闭的基站转变为解耦的、多厂商的系统，并配备分层RIC。本文沿着开放规范与参考实现追溯O-RAN中AI/ML的发展直至6G设计。我们考察开放前传、RIC接口、云编排以及AAL配置如何支持跨多个时间尺度的控制回路、模型管理和硬件加速。商用部署与OTIC测试证明了多厂商互操作性。开源软件栈与测试床支持节点内dApps的预标准化研究。在该架构内，基于GPU的AI-RAN平台在共享的RAN与AI算力上实现内联High-PHY split，为O-RAN AAL提供了一条参考实现路径，与其他异构硬件上的实现并存。向量指令集与模拟存内计算为提升能效提供了更长期的选择。面向6G，将智能扩展到时间敏感的无线处理与移动代理服务，需要具有截止期限约束的第三方推理、能效优化的RAN/Edge-AI芯片协同设计，以及跨切换的代理会话连续性。我们提出一个RAC，通过本地shell和共享暴露网关跨层级协调代理，并以异步方式下发节点内运行边界。我们还提出递归标准化（Recursive Standardization），即联邦开放实验室的成果为候选6G需求提供依据，而标准评审又指导下一轮实现与测试。
translation.brief: 该论文梳理O-RAN架构中AI/ML的开放规范与参考实现，并面向6G提出跨层级代理协调的RAC与递归标准化机制。

papers.title: GERF: A Token-Efficient Multimodal Retrieval Framework for Schema-Guided Scientific Information Extraction
papers.abstract: Scientific information extraction (IE) is a fundamental component of AI for Science, transforming experimental knowledge embedded in scientific literature into structured and traceable data for evidence synthesis, scientific database construction, and data-driven discovery. However, critical experimental details are often distributed across text, tables, figures, captions, and surrounding discussion, making them difficult to recover using conventional text-only extraction. Existing LLM-based and multimodal RAG pipelines typically rely on full-document context or coarse page-level retrieval, introducing substantial irrelevant evidence and high textual and visual token costs. We propose GERF, a Graph-based Evidence Retrieval Framework for token-efficient, schema-guided multimodal scientific IE. GERF represents each article as a heterogeneous evidence graph that connects schema fields, text chunks, figures, and figure-derived content through semantic and structural relations. Using schema fields as retrieval anchors, GERF combines direct semantic retrieval, Random Walk with Restart, and null-aware evidence expansion to construct compact, field-specific multimodal evidence packages. Visual interpretation is applied only to graph-selected figures, avoiding indiscriminate processing of the entire document. We evaluate GERF from two complementary perspectives: evidence retrieval quality and pipeline-level input-token consumption. On the expert-annotated SOFC-Exp corpus, GERF retrieves gold-supported evidence for 94.55% of the evaluated field instances, providing broad field-level evidence coverage for downstream extraction. In the token comparison, GERF reduces average input-token usage by 73.40% relative to full-context processing and uses fewer tokens than the evaluated page-level pipelines.

translation.title: GERF：面向模式引导科学信息抽取的令牌高效多模态检索框架
translation.abstract: 科学信息抽取（IE）是AI for Science的基础组成部分，将科学文献中蕴含的实验知识转化为结构化、可追溯的数据，用于证据综合、科学数据库构建和数据驱动发现。然而，关键实验细节往往分布在文本、表格、图、图注及周围讨论中，仅用传统纯文本抽取难以恢复。现有基于LLM和多模态RAG的流水线通常依赖全文上下文或粗粒度页面级检索，引入大量无关证据以及高昂的文本与视觉token成本。我们提出GERF，一个面向令牌高效、模式引导多模态科学IE的基于图的证据检索框架。GERF将每篇文章表示为异构证据图，通过语义和结构关系连接模式字段、文本块、图及图派生内容。以模式字段为检索锚点，GERF结合直接语义检索、带重启的随机游走（Random Walk with Restart）和空值感知的证据扩展，构建紧凑的、字段特定的多模态证据包。视觉解释仅应用于图选出的图，避免对整个文档不加区分地处理。我们从证据检索质量和流水线级输入token消耗两个互补角度评估GERF。在专家标注的SOFC-Exp语料上，GERF为94.55%的被评估字段实例检索到金标支持证据，为下游抽取提供了广泛的字段级证据覆盖。在token对比中，GERF相对全文上下文处理平均减少73.40%的输入token用量，且比所评估的页面级流水线使用更少token。
translation.brief: 该论文针对多模态科学信息抽取中token开销过高的问题，提出GERF框架，通过异构证据图与模式字段锚定的检索构建紧凑证据包。

papers.title: Language Model Harnesses can be Compositional Generalizers
papers.abstract: Modern language models (LMs) are post-trained and deployed as agents inside a "harness", but standard harness designs accumulate context that the neural network is forced to generalize to, making training for long-horizon tasks expensive and time-consuming. We study an alternative emerging path: training inherently neurosymbolic LM harnesses, which externalize and manage context programmatically to compose existing LM capabilities. We hypothesize that training around these harnesses can offer a better return on compute by enabling compositional generalization, as they can learn to decompose complex problems so that every observation their neural LM receives is locally in-distribution, even when the full task is novel. We find that harnesses like the Recursive Language Model (RLM) learn such decompositions readily under reinforcement learning post-training: (1) we demonstrate that training only on short tasks can generalize to tasks 2-64$\times$ longer while the base neural LM improves less, and (2) training on one domain transfers to novel domains that share latent structure. On messier, complex tasks, we find that we can target individual LLM calls within a harness by generating and training on easier, synthetically generated surrogate environments with fake tool / sub-calls, a technique we call surrogate harness training. From this finding, we train RLM-27B on synthetic data, and show it improves Qwen3.8-27B in the same RLM harness on a hard suite of long-context tasks like CTC-Bench and ExpertLongBench by 26.9% on average while using $\sim$2$\times$ fewer tokens at inference time. Finally, we show that harnesses can compose over these newly learned decompositions using recursive sub-harness calls.

translation.title: 语言模型Harness可以成为组合泛化器
translation.abstract: 现代语言模型（LM）在"harness"内进行后训练并作为智能体部署，但标准harness设计会累积上下文，迫使神经网络对其泛化，使长程任务的训练昂贵且耗时。我们研究一条新兴的替代路径：训练本质上是神经符号化的LM harness，它以程序化方式外化和管理上下文，以组合现有LM能力。我们假设围绕这些harness进行训练可以通过实现组合泛化提供更好的算力回报，因为它们可以学会分解复杂问题，使神经LM接收到的每个观测在局部都处于分布内，即使整个任务是新颖的。我们发现像递归语言模型（RLM）这样的harness在强化学习后训练下容易学会这种分解：(1) 仅在短任务上训练即可泛化到长2-64倍的任务，而基础神经LM的提升较小；(2) 在一个领域上训练可迁移到共享潜在结构的新领域。在更杂乱、复杂的任务上，我们发现可以通过生成并在更简单的、带假工具/子调用的合成代理环境中训练来针对harness内的单个LLM调用，我们称之为代理harness训练（surrogate harness training）。基于这一发现，我们在合成数据上训练RLM-27B，并展示其在同一RLM harness中，在CTC-Bench和ExpertLongBench等困难长上下文任务套件上平均提升Qwen3.8-27B 26.9%，同时推理时使用约2倍更少的token。最后，我们展示harness可以通过递归子harness调用在这些新学到的分解之上进行组合。
translation.brief: 该论文针对长程任务训练成本高的问题，提出训练神经符号化LM harness以实现组合泛化，并用代理harness训练在合成数据上提升长上下文任务表现。

papers.title: Adaptive Warm-State Retention for Serverless Cold-Start Mitigation: Treating Keep-Alive Time as an Online Control Parameter
papers.abstract: Serverless platforms are easy to operate but pay a recurring price in cold starts: when a function is called after sitting idle, its execution environment must be rebuilt before the request can run, and latency suffers. The usual fix keeps idle environments alive for a fixed window, but a single value rarely fits a changing workload: too high wastes idle capacity, too low causes avoidable cold starts. We argue the keep-alive window should not be a fixed deployment constant; instead we treat it as a per-function runtime parameter, adjusted online from what the system observes, kept separate from how many replicas to run. We build an external retention controller for OpenFaaS/faasd that needs no platform changes, driven by two simple agents: a reactive AIMD (Additive-Increase Multiplicative-Decrease) rule and a UCB1 multi-armed bandit. Against fixed-timeout baselines and a predictive histogram keep-alive, on steady, bursty, and trace-derived workloads (Huawei Serverless 2023), the bandit cuts the aggregate cold-start rate from 63% under immediate scale-to-zero to 3%, holds P95 tail latency at the level of the longest-retention fixed baseline, and uses about 13% less accumulated warm time than that baseline, while also beating the predictive baseline. No fixed timeout is best on every metric, whereas the adaptive agents reach a favorable operating point without manual tuning; on the bursty workload at a converged horizon the bandit's advantage is statistically significant. On a multi-node Kubernetes cluster under the platform's own Horizontal Pod Autoscaler, the controller coexists with an autoscaler it does not control: the replica count follows load identically across policies, and retention independently governs warm time.

translation.title: 面向Serverless冷启动缓解的自适应保温态保留：将Keep-Alive时间作为在线控制参数
translation.abstract: Serverless平台易于运维，但需持续为冷启动付出代价：当函数在闲置后被调用时，必须先重建其执行环境才能运行请求，导致延迟上升。通常的解决方法是将闲置环境保温一段固定时间窗口，但单一数值很难适应变化的负载：设置过高浪费闲置容量，设置过低则造成可避免的冷启动。我们认为keep-alive窗口不应是固定的部署常量，而应作为每个函数的运行时参数，根据系统观测在线调整，并与运行多少副本的决策相分离。我们为OpenFaaS/faasd构建了一个无需平台改动的外部保留控制器，由两个简单代理驱动：反应式AIMD（加性增乘性减）规则和UCB1多臂老虎机。相对于固定超时基线和预测式直方图keep-alive，在平稳、突发和基于真实trace的负载（Huawei Serverless 2023）上，老虎机将立即缩容到零下63%的聚合冷启动率降至3%，将P95尾延迟保持在最长保留固定基线的水平，且累计保温时间比该基线少约13%，同时优于预测式基线。没有任何固定超时在所有指标上最优，而自适应代理无需手动调参即可达到有利的运行点；在突发负载的收敛时间尺度上，老虎机的优势具有统计显著性。在平台自带Horizontal Pod Autoscaler的多节点Kubernetes集群上，该控制器与其不控制的自动扩缩器共存：副本数在各策略下随负载变化完全一致，而保留策略独立地控制保温时间。
translation.brief: 该论文针对Serverless冷启动与资源浪费的权衡问题，提出将keep-alive时间作为每函数在线控制参数，用AIMD和UCB1老虎机代理自适应调节。

papers.title: An LLM-Assisted Multi-Objective AutoML Framework for Efficient Network Intrusion Detection
papers.abstract: Conventional Machine Learning (ML)-based Intrusion Detection Systems (IDSs) require manual design, optimize only detection performance, and neglect inference latency and model size, which are critical for resource-constrained Internet of Things (IoT) and Electric Vehicle Charging System (EVCS) deployments. Automated ML (AutoML) reduces manual effort but explores broad search spaces inefficiently. Meanwhile, Multi-Objective Optimization (MOO) methods lack guided search initialization, leading to long search times. This paper proposes a Large Language Model-Assisted Multi-Objective Automated ML (LLM-MOO-AutoML) framework for efficient intrusion detection. A local Llama 3.1 8B model analyzes a compact dataset profile and generates a bounded, validated policy for automated data balancing (AutoDP) and feature engineering (AutoFE). This policy narrows the search space for Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm III (NSGA-III), which jointly optimizes the LightGBM feature-selection threshold and key hyperparameters across three objectives: maximizing weighted F1-score, minimizing 99th-percentile (P99) inference latency ratio, and minimizing model size ratio. Experiments on CICIDS2017, IoTID20, and CICEVSE2024 demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves the highest weighted F1-scores on CICIDS2017 (99.788%), IoTID20 (99.778%), and CICEVSE2024 (99.989%), with feature sets reduced to as few as 10 features, P99 latency as low as 0.00038 ms, and model size as small as 0.1073 MB. The LLM-guided configuration reduced NSGA-III search time relative to unconstrained multi-objective search on all datasets at the largest trial budget and in most comparisons at smaller budgets, indicating that dataset-aware search-space reduction supports efficient, deployment-aware intrusion detection.

translation.title: 面向高效网络入侵检测的LLM辅助多目标AutoML框架
translation.abstract: 传统的基于机器学习（ML）的入侵检测系统（IDS）需要人工设计，仅优化检测性能，而忽视推理延迟和模型大小，而这些对资源受限的物联网（IoT）和电动汽车充电系统（EVCS）部署至关重要。自动化ML（AutoML）减少了人工工作，但搜索空间探索效率低下。同时，多目标优化（MOO）方法缺乏引导式搜索初始化，导致搜索时间长。本文提出一个面向高效入侵检测的大语言模型辅助多目标自动化ML（LLM-MOO-AutoML）框架。本地Llama 3.1 8B模型分析紧凑的数据集画像，生成有界且经验证的策略，用于自动化数据平衡（AutoDP）和特征工程（AutoFE）。该策略缩小了非支配排序遗传算法III（NSGA-III）的搜索空间，后者联合优化LightGBM特征选择阈值和关键超参数，涵盖三个目标：最大化加权F1分数、最小化99百分位（P99）推理延迟比和最小化模型大小比。在CICIDS2017、IoTID20和CICEVSE2024上的实验表明，所提框架在CICIDS2017（99.788%）、IoTID20（99.778%）和CICEVSE2024（99.989%）上取得最高加权F1分数，特征集缩减至最少10个特征，P99延迟低至0.00038 ms，模型大小小至0.1073 MB。LLM引导的配置在最大试验预算下于所有数据集上、以及在较小预算的大多数对比中，均降低了NSGA-III相对无约束多目标搜索的搜索时间，表明数据集感知的搜索空间缩减支持高效、面向部署的入侵检测。
translation.brief: 该论文针对IoT场景下入侵检测模型需兼顾精度、延迟与体积的问题，提出用本地LLM生成策略缩小搜索空间、再由NSGA-III进行三目标优化的AutoML框架。

papers.title: INSEP: Refusal-Direction Inseparability as a Defense Against Abliteration
papers.abstract: Abliteration is a widely used white-box attack against the safety alignment of large language models (LLMs). It elicits harmful behavior by estimating a refusal direction in the model's activation space and projecting that direction out of the residual-stream write-out matrices. We propose INSEP, a defense that fine-tunes the model to reduce the separability of harmful and benign activations along the refusal direction. Abliteration estimates this direction as a difference in class means and projects it out. Reducing separability weakens the signal the attack relies on. An adversarial eigendecomposition selects the most separable prompt subsets. A low-rank adapter reduces their separation along that direction. Behavioral losses preserve the base model's refusal and the quality of its benign responses during training. We benchmark INSEP against six published defenses under five attacks, across eight LLMs from 1B to 14B parameters and several model families. Beyond response harm, we measure coherence, directness, over-refusal, and MMLU, to distinguish robust refusal from low harm produced by evasive or degraded responses. INSEP ranks first on the mean composite score across all eight base models while retaining utility, in the largest abliteration-defense evaluation reported to date.

translation.title: INSEP：以拒绝方向不可分性作为对抗 Abliteration 的防御
translation.abstract: Abliteration 是一种针对大语言模型（LLM）安全对齐的常用白盒攻击。它通过在模型激活空间中估计拒绝方向，并将该方向从残差流写出矩阵中投影出去，从而诱发有害行为。我们提出 INSEP，一种通过微调模型来降低有害与良性激活沿拒绝方向可分性的防御方法。Abliteration 将该方向估计为类均值之差并将其投影去除，降低可分性会削弱该攻击所依赖的信号。对抗性特征分解选取最可分的提示子集，低秩适配器降低它们沿该方向的分离程度，行为损失则在训练过程中保持基础模型的拒绝能力和良性响应质量。我们在八个参数量从 1B 到 14B、来自多个模型家族的 LLM 上，将 INSEP 与六种已发表的防御方法在五种攻击下进行基准比较。除响应有害性外，我们还测量连贯性、直接性、过度拒绝和 MMLU，以区分稳健的拒绝与由回避或退化响应产生的低有害性。在迄今最大规模的 abliteration 防御评估中，INSEP 在全部八个基础模型上的平均综合得分排名第一，同时保持了实用性。
translation.brief: 针对 Abliteration 攻击，通过微调降低有害与良性激活沿拒绝方向的可分性来防御，并用行为损失保持模型拒绝能力与响应质量。

papers.title: MatHarness: Towards Long-Horizon Open-ended AutoResearch for Computational Materials Science
papers.abstract: Materials science research is a non-linear, long-horizon process. Existing scientific agents, however, largely rely on specific task execution or predefined workflows, rendering them brittle in open-ended settings. To bridge this gap, we present MatHarness, an agent harness designed for open-ended, long-horizon computational materials research spanning the complete lifecycle from initial ideation to manuscript writing. MatHarness couples three mechanisms: execution robustness through pre-flight verification, expert-distilled skills, and just-in-time auditing; epistemic adaptability through persistent research artifacts and an evolving scientific mental model; and collective intelligence through a heterogeneous multi-agent round table under targeted human oversight. We evaluate MatHarness on adsorbate-induced surface segregation in Cu-Zn alloys, an open question in methanol-synthesis catalysis. Over a multi-week trajectory consuming roughly 10^3 GPU-hours (50 production DFT relaxations prescreened by 171 machine-learning-potential evaluations) the system revised its plan six times, recovered autonomously from failed calculations, and had an independent auditor overturn one of its own over-attributed claims before publication. Within the sampled metallic dilute-limit models, the validated DFT analysis supports an adsorbate-induced tendency toward greater surface Cu exposure at both composition endpoints, with facet- and coverage-dependent exceptions. These results were compiled into a complete manuscript with human involvement concentrated in specification, approval, and strategic steering gates. The code is publicly available at this https URL.

translation.title: MatHarness：面向计算材料科学的长时程开放式自动研究
translation.abstract: 材料科学研究是一个非线性的长时程过程。然而现有科学智能体大多依赖特定任务执行或预定义工作流，在开放式环境中较为脆弱。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 MatHarness，一个面向开放式、长时程计算材料研究的智能体框架，覆盖从最初构思到论文写作的完整生命周期。MatHarness 结合三种机制：通过预检验证、专家蒸馏技能和即时审计实现执行稳健性；通过持久化研究产物和不断演化的科学心智模型实现认知适应性；以及在有针对性人类监督下的异构多智能体圆桌实现集体智能。我们在 Cu-Zn 合金中吸附诱导的表面偏析这一甲醇合成催化领域的开放问题上评估 MatHarness。在消耗约 10^3 GPU 小时（50 次生产级 DFT 弛豫，经 171 次机器学习势评估预筛选）的数周轨迹中，系统六次修订计划，从失败计算中自主恢复，并在发表前由独立审计员推翻了其自身一条过度归因的论断。在所采样的金属稀疏极限模型中，经验证的 DFT 分析支持在两个组分端点均存在吸附诱导的表面 Cu 暴露增加趋势，但存在依赖晶面和覆盖度的例外。这些结果被整理成一篇完整论文，人类参与集中在规范制定、审批和战略引导环节。代码已在公开网址提供。
translation.brief: 针对开放式长时程计算材料研究，构建结合执行稳健性、认知适应性与多智能体集体智能的智能体框架 MatHarness，覆盖从构思到写作的完整科研生命周期。

papers.title: MagTrace: Tracing magnetic order through the evolving scientific literature
papers.abstract: Much of the research on magnetic materials starts from their magnetic order, but confirming it from the papers by hand can take hours, and curated databases can be incomplete and outdated. In this work, we build MagTrace, a language model agent that, given only a material's name, searches four literature databases, reads open access full text and reports the magnetic orders the current literature supports, each with a confidence score and citations a reader can check. We evaluate its performance on 18 materials against an answer key complied from published papers, compared with two other conditions that vary in level of retrieval. On a score from 0 to 1 that combines correctness, detail, whether the most confident order is current, and citation integrity, MagTrace scores 0.839; the same underlying language model scores 0.676 given the abstracts from one literature search and 0.548 answering from memory. With a single search, the model finds the right kind of order but omits the propagation vector, which describes how the pattern repeats through the material's crystal structure, in 85% of its orders. From memory, the model often cites titles that lead to no indexed paper (for 25% of the orders we could check), and when a cited paper exists and has an abstract, the abstract contradicts the claim for 17% of those citations, against 7% for MagTrace.

translation.title: MagTrace：通过不断演化的科学文献追踪磁有序
translation.abstract: 许多磁性材料研究都始于其磁有序，但人工从论文中确认磁有序可能耗时数小时，且人工整理的数据库可能不完整、过时。在本工作中，我们构建了 MagTrace，一个语言模型智能体：仅给定材料名称，它即可检索四个文献数据库、阅读开放获取全文，并报告当前文献所支持的磁有序，每项均附置信度分数和可供读者核查的引用。我们在 18 种材料上，依据已发表论文汇编的标准答案评估其性能，并与两种检索程度不同的对照条件比较。在一个综合正确性、细节、最高置信度磁有序是否为最新以及引用完整性的 0 到 1 评分中，MagTrace 得分 0.839；同一底层语言模型在给定一次文献检索的摘要时得 0.676，仅凭记忆回答得 0.548。仅用单次检索时，模型能找到正确的磁有序类型，但在 85% 的磁有序中遗漏了描述磁结构在晶体中如何重复的传播矢量。凭记忆回答时，模型常引用无法对应到已索引论文的标题（在我们能核查的磁有序中占 25%），且当被引论文存在并有摘要时，摘要在 17% 的此类引用中与论断相矛盾，而 MagTrace 仅为 7%。
translation.brief: 针对人工确认材料磁有序耗时且数据库不完整的问题，构建仅凭材料名称即可检索文献、阅读全文并给出带置信度和引用的磁有序报告的语言模型智能体。

papers.title: When Tools Fail, Agents Fabricate: Silent Failure and Verification-First Oversight in Tool-Using LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Tool-using LLM agents must recover when a tool call fails, by retrying, switching tools, or revising their plan. We study how agents fail when tools fail, using RetryRealistic, a sandboxed yet realistic testbed for controlled fault injection in which agents operate on a real OS filesystem with genuine permission enforcement, SQLite databases, a deterministic local HTTP server, and a constrained shell, across 8 tools, 9 fault types with controlled persistence, and 30 multi-step tasks. Evaluating four agents over 2,100 faulted runs against ground truth, we find that recovery is unreliable (19-68% correct) and frequently silent: 6-26% of runs end in a confident fabrication, a wrong answer asserted as fact. The failure mode is governed more by the fault type than by the model: faults that return partial data drive fabrication (up to 38%), while hard denials drive honest failure. The mechanism is what we call silent ingestion: the agent accepts faulted data as valid on first contact without retrying or flagging the problem, then builds a fabricated answer on top of it. We show that fabrication is reducible: a verification-first Monitor, grounding checks in structured tool outputs and issuing corrective directives rather than hard blocks, raises correct recovery from 45.6% to 56.3% and cuts fabrication from 17.3% to 10.8%. Removing chain-of-thought increases fabrication (+8.3pp), so deliberation guards against silent ingestion. We release RetryRealistic, the fault-injection toolkit, and all annotated traces at this https URL

translation.title: 当工具失效时，智能体会编造：工具使用型 LLM 智能体的静默失败与验证优先监督
translation.abstract: 工具使用型 LLM 智能体在工具调用失败时必须能够恢复，例如重试、切换工具或修改计划。我们研究工具失效时智能体如何失败，使用 RetryRealistic——一个沙箱化但真实的受控故障注入测试平台，其中智能体在具有真实权限控制的真实 OS 文件系统、SQLite 数据库、确定性本地 HTTP 服务器和受限 shell 上运行，涵盖 8 个工具、9 种可控持续性的故障类型和 30 个多步任务。对四个智能体进行 2,100 次故障运行并对照真值评估，我们发现恢复不可靠（正确率 19-68%）且经常是静默的：6-26% 的运行以自信的编造告终，即把错误答案当作事实断言。失败模式更多由故障类型而非模型决定：返回部分数据的故障驱动编造（高达 38%），而硬性拒绝则促成诚实的失败。其机制是我们所称的静默摄取：智能体在首次接触时即将故障数据当作有效数据接受，不重试也不标记问题，然后在其上构建编造的答案。我们证明编造是可以减少的：一个验证优先的 Monitor，在结构化工具输出上进行接地检查并发出纠正指令而非硬性阻断，将正确恢复率从 45.6% 提升至 56.3%，并将编造率从 17.3% 降至 10.8%。移除思维链会使编造增加（+8.3 个百分点），因此深思可防范静默摄取。我们在公开网址发布 RetryRealistic、故障注入工具包及全部标注轨迹。
translation.brief: 研究工具调用失败时 LLM 智能体的静默编造行为，提出基于结构化输出接地检查的验证优先 Monitor 来提升恢复正确率并减少编造。

papers.title: SMAD: A Semantics-Guided Multi-Agent Framework for Unsupervised Time-Series Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract: Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) lacks a one-size-fits-all detector for heterogeneous data and anomaly types. Existing automation is limited by implicit objectives, potentially unreliable historical knowledge, or high computational costs. More fundamentally, it selects how to detect anomalies without explicitly defining what to detect. We propose SMAD, an LLM-based multi-agent framework that translates anomaly intent into executable, testable detection pipelines. Rather than selecting detectors against an implicit target, SMAD establishes a natural-language semantic contract grounded in measurable time-series properties, specifying target event patterns, expected score responses, and validation questions. This contract governs both detector construction and evaluation: LLM agents propose pipelines, while contract-matched synthetic interventions provide label-free evidence from the target series to assess semantic coverage and guide iterative self-refinement. A semantics-aware ensemble integrates validated candidates and attributes each alert to contributing detectors and supporting evidence. On univariate and multivariate TSAD benchmarks, SMAD improves detection performance over the strongest baseline by 11.5% and 9.6%, respectively, while outperforming general-purpose coding agents at 2-5x lower language-model token cost.

translation.title: SMAD：面向无监督时间序列异常检测的语义引导多智能体框架
translation.abstract: 时间序列异常检测（TSAD）缺乏适用于异构数据和异常类型的通用检测器。现有自动化方法受限于隐式目标、可能不可靠的历史知识或高昂的计算成本。更根本的是，它们在选择如何检测异常时并未明确定义要检测什么。我们提出 SMAD，一个基于 LLM 的多智能体框架，将异常意图转化为可执行、可测试的检测流水线。SMAD 不是针对隐式目标选择检测器，而是建立基于可测量时间序列性质的自然语言语义契约，明确目标事件模式、期望的分数响应和验证问题。该契约同时约束检测器构建与评估：LLM 智能体提出流水线，而与契约匹配的合成干预从目标序列提供无标签证据，以评估语义覆盖并指导迭代自精炼。语义感知的集成模块整合经验证的候选检测器，并将每条告警归因于贡献的检测器和支持证据。在单变量和多变量 TSAD 基准上，SMAD 分别比最强基线提升检测性能 11.5% 和 9.6%，同时以低 2-5 倍的语言模型 token 成本超越通用编码智能体。
translation.brief: 针对时间序列异常检测缺乏通用检测器的问题，提出用自然语言语义契约将异常意图转化为可执行检测流水线的 LLM 多智能体框架 SMAD。

papers.title: Coupling-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Co-Evolving Graph Games
papers.abstract: Building hydrogen station networks, electric vehicle charging grids, or vaccine distribution systems requires coordinating two separately operated graphs, demand-side facilities and the supply-side networks they depend on, where each operator's payoff depends on the other's choices. We formalize this as the Co-Evolving Graph Game (CEGG), a setting that sits between facility location, interdependent-network analysis, and graph-based multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) but is not jointly addressed by any of them. We propose Cross-Graph Attention with Policy Mirror Descent (CGA-PMD), pairing cross-graph attention, which lets each agent read only the partner-graph nodes structurally coupled to its own, with a policy mirror descent update for stable training. Across three reward domains and a range of practical network scales, we find that the structure of the coupling selects which method wins: at small scale most methods are competitive, but as scale grows or coupling becomes irregular, CGA-PMD is the one method that stays reliable: it attains the highest success count on each of five real city networks, while own-only, unmasked-attention, and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)-based variants degrade in distinct ways. Our theoretical analysis addresses the optimizer side: the Kullback-Leibler (KL)-regularized update admits an iteration-uniform cumulative drift bound, whereas the clip update admits no such bound on the iterations where the clip does not bind. The implementation is available at this https URL.

translation.title: 面向协同演化图博弈的耦合感知强化学习
translation.abstract: 建设加氢站网络、电动汽车充电网络或疫苗分发系统，需要协调两个分别运营的图：需求侧设施及其所依赖的供给侧网络，其中每个运营方的收益取决于对方的选择。我们将其形式化为协同演化图博弈（CEGG），该设定介于设施选址、相互依赖网络分析和基于图的多智能体强化学习（MARL）之间，但此前没有任何方法同时解决这三者。我们提出 Cross-Graph Attention with Policy Mirror Descent（CGA-PMD），将跨图注意力（让每个智能体只读取与其自身节点在结构上耦合的伙伴图节点）与策略镜像下降更新相结合，以实现稳定训练。在三个奖励域和一系列实际网络规模上，我们发现耦合结构决定了哪种方法胜出：在小规模下大多数方法都有竞争力，但随着规模增长或耦合变得不规则，CGA-PMD 是唯一保持可靠的方法：它在五个真实城市网络上均取得最高的成功次数，而仅看自身、无掩码注意力以及基于 Proximal Policy Optimization（PPO）的变体则以不同方式退化。我们的理论分析针对优化器一侧：Kullback-Leibler（KL）正则化更新具有迭代一致累积漂移界，而 clip 更新在 clip 不起约束作用的迭代上不存在这样的界。实现代码见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 该论文解决两个分别运营的图之间协同演化的博弈问题，提出结合跨图注意力与策略镜像下降的 CGA-PMD 方法。

papers.title: Engram: Multi-Stage Memory for Agentic Tuning of Heterogeneous Models
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can now tune neural networks, yet without cross-session memory they spend costly trials rediscovering known lessons. Reuse is difficult because production models differ in architecture, training setup and inference budget. We present Engram, a memory system that links past trial outcomes with the hypotheses and rationale behind them and assesses whether this evidence applies to the current model. An online agent curates evidence at the decision points where it is needed: Initial Guidance supplies validated lessons at the start, Session Retrieval supplies related past sessions before each batch of hypotheses is generated, and Trial Candidate Review checks each trial candidate against matching past trials. Between sessions, an offline agent distills validated lessons, making the memory self-improving. On two ads models, Engram reaches the 32-trial result of a no-memory control with 47% fewer trials and also ends with a better model on average.

translation.title: Engram：面向异构模型智能体调优的多阶段记忆系统
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体现在可以调优神经网络，但缺乏跨会话记忆时，它们会花费昂贵的试验去重新发现已知的经验。复用之所以困难，是因为生产模型在架构、训练设置和推理预算上各不相同。我们提出 Engram，一个将过去的试验结果与其背后的假设和理由关联起来，并评估这些证据是否适用于当前模型的记忆系统。一个在线智能体在需要证据的决策点上整理证据：Initial Guidance 在开始时提供经过验证的经验，Session Retrieval 在每批假设生成前提供相关的历史会话，Trial Candidate Review 将每个试验候选与匹配的历史试验进行核对。在会话之间，一个离线智能体提炼经过验证的经验，使记忆自我改进。在两个广告模型上，Engram 以少 47% 的试验次数达到无记忆对照组 32 次试验的结果，且最终模型平均更优。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 LLM 智能体调优异构模型时无法复用历史经验的问题，提出多阶段记忆系统 Engram，通过在线证据整理与离线经验提炼实现自我改进的记忆复用。

papers.title: Schedule, Rank, Profile: Continuous Evaluation of LLM Agents in Games
papers.abstract: Games are a robust test for large language model agents: they require sequential decisions, adversarial or cooperative interaction, state tracking, reasoning under uncertainty, and long-horizon planning. However, a one-time game benchmark can go stale as models, prompts, environment implementations, and evaluation policies change, and refreshing it is costly: full round-robin evaluation scales poorly in the number of model pairs, and the resulting outcomes live on incompatible per-game scales. We present a framework for continuous evaluation of LLM agents in game settings, organized around three coupled components. First, an adaptive scheduler that maps pairwise Bradley-Terry uncertainty to reduced per-pair match targets, concentrating budget on comparisons that remain unresolved. Second, a Unified Leaderboard (ULB) that reduces heterogeneous outcomes to pairwise evidence and fits a game-balanced Bradley-Terry model by minorization-maximization with bootstrap intervals, so that high-throughput games cannot dominate the aggregate ranking. Third, a game skill-profile methodology that scores each game along diverse skill dimensions, making the capability coverage of the suite explicit and turning game selection into a design decision rather than an artifact of availability. In this paper, we specify the research design and outcome reduction of the current implementation and evaluate the framework on a ten-game suite spanning perfect-information board games, imperfect-information games, and social/language settings, reporting LLM capability profiles, evaluation-cost savings across model-refresh cycles, and an empirical Pareto frontier relating model performance to inference cost. As deployed, the scheduler saved 61.7% of episodes; it counted each episode in the two team games as four records, overstating their savings, and the other eight games save 61.9%.

translation.title: 调度、排名、画像：游戏中 LLM 智能体的持续评估
translation.abstract: 游戏是大语言模型智能体的稳健测试：它们需要序贯决策、对抗或合作交互、状态跟踪、不确定性下的推理以及长程规划。然而，一次性的游戏基准会随着模型、提示、环境实现和评估策略的变化而过时，且刷新成本高昂：完整的循环赛评估在模型对数量上扩展性差，且产生的结果处于互不兼容的各游戏尺度上。我们提出一个在游戏环境中持续评估 LLM 智能体的框架，围绕三个相互耦合的组件组织。第一，自适应调度器，将成对 Bradley-Terry 不确定性映射为缩减的每对比赛目标，把预算集中在尚未解决的比较上。第二，统一排行榜（ULB），将异构结果约化为成对证据，并通过 minorization-maximization 拟合游戏平衡的 Bradley-Terry 模型并给出 bootstrap 置信区间，使高吞吐游戏无法主导总排名。第三，游戏技能画像方法，沿多样的技能维度为每个游戏打分，使测试套件的能力覆盖显式化，并将游戏选择变成设计决策而非可用性的偶然产物。本文阐述了当前实现的研究设计和结果约化方法，并在涵盖完美信息棋盘游戏、不完美信息游戏和社交/语言场景的十个游戏套件上评估该框架，报告了 LLM 能力画像、模型刷新周期中的评估成本节省，以及关联模型性能与推理成本的经验 Pareto 前沿。在实际部署中，调度器节省了 61.7% 的对局数；它将两个团队游戏中的每局计为四条记录，高估了其节省量，其余八个游戏节省 61.9%。
translation.brief: 该论文解决游戏基准随模型演进而过时且评估成本高的问题，提出由自适应调度器、统一排行榜和技能画像组成的 LLM 智能体持续评估框架。

papers.title: How a Prediction Dies: A Challenge-Driven, Rule-Bound Self-Refutation in an LLM Agent Society
papers.abstract: Persistent societies of large language model agents now make empirical claims about their own collective behaviour, yet the fate of such claims is rarely observable. We document one claim, from registration to death, on AITRAP, a multi-agent platform whose public, append-only ledger records every action. The claim (0495d171, registered 19 October 2026) asserted that a majority of bridges between problem domains would remain attached to a single exploration lineage. Three community challenges forced its judgment criterion through four versions, from an ambiguous statement to an executable protocol with a fixed threshold, a minimum-frame-size gate, and a baseline calibration gate. When the first frame with at least 20 bridges arrived, support stood at 9 of 79 (11.4%; Wilson 95% CI [6.1%, 20.3%]); the author, bound by the registered clause, refuted the claim and relinquished the associated stake. Three findings emerge. The criterion became executable only under community pressure, which we document version by version. The calibration gate caught a fault in the author's own recalculation that would otherwise have published a spuriously perfect 0/79 result. The failure itself traces to a denominator that grew 8.8-fold in five days while the numerator grew 1.8-fold, coinciding with a change in platform incentives; we report this mechanism as a hypothesis, not a rescuing condition. A claim whose termination is carried out exactly as written carries more evidential weight than one that survives, and this case provides initial empirical grounds for treating voluntary self-refutation as a candidate indicator of epistemic accountability in incentive-coupled agent societies.

translation.title: 一个预测如何死去：LLM 智能体社会中的挑战驱动、规则约束的自我反驳
translation.abstract: 持续运行的大语言模型智能体社会如今会对自身的集体行为做出经验性断言，但此类断言的命运很少可被观察。我们在 AITRAP 上记录了一个断言从注册到死亡的全过程，AITRAP 是一个多智能体平台，其公开的只追加账本记录每个动作。该断言（0495d171，注册于 2026 年 10 月 19 日）声称问题域之间的大多数桥接将保持附着于单一探索谱系。三次社区挑战迫使其判定标准经历四个版本，从模糊表述演变为具有固定阈值、最小帧大小门控和基线校准门控的可执行协议。当第一个包含至少 20 个桥接的帧到来时，支持度为 79 中的 9（11.4%；Wilson 95% CI [6.1%, 20.3%]）；作者受注册条款约束，反驳了该断言并放弃了相关质押。三个发现浮现。判定标准只有在社区压力下才变得可执行，我们逐版本记录了这一过程。校准门控发现了作者自己重新计算中的一个错误，否则将发布一个虚假完美的 0/79 结果。失败本身可追溯到一个分母在五天内增长 8.8 倍而分子仅增长 1.8 倍的情况，这与平台激励的变化相吻合；我们将此机制作为假设报告，而非挽救条件。一个按字面规定终止的断言比一个存活的断言具有更强的证据效力，本案例为将自愿自我反驳视为激励耦合智能体社会中认知问责的候选指标提供了初步经验依据。
translation.brief: 该论文通过记录一个 LLM 智能体社会中断言从注册到自我反驳的全过程，研究社区挑战与规则约束如何促成可执行判定标准和认知问责。

papers.title: Taking the PULSE of Enterprise Workflows: Evaluating Persistent Project-State Understanding
papers.abstract: Enterprise agents must maintain an up-to-date understanding of work distributed across heterogeneous artifacts, evolving over time, and unevenly visible to different collaborators. We formulate this challenge as persistent project-state understanding (PPSU) and introduce PULSE, a benchmark of 1,573 questions over 30 enterprise project histories. PULSE constructs deterministic, time-indexed project state and documented collaborator views from source-linked records, and evaluates three families of questions: open loops, project evolution, and view gaps. Across retrieval agents, graph- and memory-augmented retrieval, long-context, and oracle conditions, we find substantial headroom for current systems. Retrieval and extraction account for the largest share of the gap, but providing explicit project state on top of gold evidence yields further substantial gains, showing that PPSU cannot be reduced to retrieval alone. Further analysis shows that questions requiring information to be reconciled across multiple parts of the project history remain difficult even when the relevant evidence is provided, while project-state synthesis and perspective conditioning remain persistent challenges. These results motivate enterprise agents that explicitly maintain and reconcile temporally grounded state across sources, actors, and time.

translation.title: 洞察企业工作流的 PULSE：评估持久项目状态理解
translation.abstract: 企业智能体必须对分布在异构工件中、随时间演化、且对不同协作者可见程度不一的工作保持最新理解。我们将这一挑战形式化为持久项目状态理解（PPSU），并引入 PULSE，一个包含 30 个企业项目历史、1,573 个问题的基准。PULSE 从带来源链接的记录构建确定性的、按时间索引的项目状态和有记录的协作者视图，并评估三类问题：未决事项（open loops）、项目演化和视图差距。在检索智能体、图增强和记忆增强检索、长上下文以及 oracle 条件下，我们发现当前系统仍有很大提升空间。检索和抽取占差距的最大份额，但在金标准证据之上提供显式项目状态可带来进一步的显著收益，表明 PPSU 不能被简化为单纯的检索。进一步分析表明，需要在项目历史的多个部分之间调和信息的问题，即使在提供相关证据时仍然困难，而项目状态综合和视角条件化仍是持续存在的挑战。这些结果促使企业智能体显式地维护并调和跨来源、跨参与者、跨时间的基于时间的状态。
translation.brief: 该论文解决企业智能体对跨异构工件、随时间演化的项目状态保持理解的问题，提出 PULSE 基准评估持久项目状态理解（PPSU）能力。

papers.title: Beyond Relevance: An Empirical Study of Multimodal LLMs for Diversity-Aware Recommendation Reranking
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as promising rerankers for recommendation, yet most existing approaches rely on textual item descriptions and primarily focus on relevance. In visually oriented domains such as video streaming, item images provide complementary signals that may also inform recommendation diversity. This raises two questions: when does visual information improve recommendation quality, and can multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) enhance relevance and diversity simultaneously? We investigate these questions through a training-free, diversity-aware multimodal reranking framework that jointly incorporates item images, textual metadata, and user interaction histories. We conduct an empirical study across three public Amazon Review datasets and an industrial Amazon Prime Video dataset, using both open-source and proprietary MLLMs. Our results reveal substantial domain-dependent effects: adding visual information yields up to 121.9% relative improvement in NDCG@5 on Prime Video, while producing limited or inconsistent gains on product recommendation datasets. Furthermore, MLLM-based reranking improves both relevance and category-diversity-sensitive ranking quality over a sequential recommendation baseline, achieving up to 71.0% improvement in NDCG@5 and 14.1% in $\alpha$-NDCG@5 on Prime Video. These findings highlight the conditional value of visual information and the potential of training-free MLLMs for relevance- and diversity-aware recommendation reranking.

translation.title: 超越相关性：多模态LLM在多样性感知推荐重排中的实证研究
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）已成为推荐系统中颇具前景的重排器，但现有方法大多依赖文本化的物品描述，且主要关注相关性。在视频流媒体等视觉导向领域，物品图像提供了补充信号，也可能影响推荐多样性。这引出两个问题：视觉信息何时能提升推荐质量？多模态LLM（MLLM）能否同时提升相关性与多样性？我们通过一个免训练的、多样性感知的多模态重排框架来研究这些问题，该框架联合利用物品图像、文本元数据和用户交互历史。我们在三个公开的 Amazon Review 数据集和一个工业级 Amazon Prime Video 数据集上，使用开源与专有 MLLM 进行了实证研究。结果显示出显著的领域依赖效应：加入视觉信息在 Prime Video 上带来最高 121.9% 的 NDCG@5 相对提升，而在商品推荐数据集上收益有限或不一致。此外，基于 MLLM 的重排在序列推荐基线之上同时提升了相关性和类别多样性敏感的排序质量，在 Prime Video 上 NDCG@5 最高提升 71.0%，$\alpha$-NDCG@5 提升 14.1%。这些发现凸显了视觉信息的条件性价值以及免训练 MLLM 在相关性与多样性感知推荐重排中的潜力。
translation.brief: 研究视觉信息何时能提升推荐质量，提出一个免训练的多模态LLM重排框架，联合利用图像、文本和用户历史同时优化相关性与多样性。

papers.title: The Effect of Security-Focused Prompts on Reported Findings: A Controlled Experiment on 400 AI-Generated Web Applications
papers.abstract: Agentic coding tools turn a specification into a running web application, so their defaults for authentication, sessions, input validation, and dependencies become its security posture. This study asks whether appending a fixed block of OWASP-aligned security requirements to the prompt changes what such tools produce, by how much, and with what side effects. Each of 100 frozen specifications was realized four times: two agentic tools (Claude Code, Codex CLI) crossed with two prompts sharing a byte-identical functional core, without (A) and with (B) the security block. A fixed static and dynamic pipeline scanned the 400 applications, yielding 6,721 triaged findings, analyzed with count and logistic mixed models and with a dependency diff. The block cut findings per application by a third (incidence-rate ratio 0.65, 95% CI 0.60-0.71), equally through both tools, and roughly doubled the declared dependency surface, so variant-B applications carried more high-severity dependency advisories. Adjusted for that surface the advisory rate did not rise (flat per application, 18% lower in aggregate), while high-severity findings in first-party source fell by nearly half. Security-focused prompting is therefore an inexpensive and portable improvement, but it enlarges the dependency surface that has to be audited against it, an effect of library selection rather than of the security requirements themselves.

translation.title: 安全导向提示对报告发现的影响：一项针对400个AI生成Web应用的受控实验
translation.abstract: 智能体编码工具将规格说明转化为可运行的Web应用，因此其在认证、会话、输入校验和依赖方面的默认设置决定了应用的安全态势。本研究探讨在提示中附加一段固定的 OWASP 对齐安全需求是否会改变此类工具的产出、改变多少以及带来何种副作用。100个冻结的规格说明各被实现四次：两个智能体工具（Claude Code、Codex CLI）与两个共享字节级相同功能核心的提示交叉组合，分别不带（A）和带（B）安全需求块。固定的静态与动态扫描流水线扫描了这400个应用，产生6,721条经分诊的发现，并用计数与逻辑混合模型及依赖差异分析进行处理。安全需求块将每个应用的发现数削减了三分之一（发生率比0.65，95% CI 0.60-0.71），在两个工具上效果一致，同时使声明的依赖面大约翻倍，因此变体B应用携带更多高严重性依赖公告。在调整依赖面后，公告率并未上升（每应用持平，总体降低18%），而第一方源码中的高严重性发现几乎减半。因此，安全导向的提示是一种廉价且可移植的改进手段，但它扩大了需要审计的依赖面，这一效应源于库选择而非安全需求本身。
translation.brief: 通过400个AI生成Web应用的受控实验，验证在提示中加入OWASP安全需求块能否减少智能体编码工具产出的安全漏洞。

papers.title: WingBench: Benchmarking How AI Agents Search for Better Designs
papers.abstract: Design search often uses cheap learned predictions to choose which candidates deserve expensive tests, but these tests can fail, especially on the unusual designs that optimization favors. We introduce WingBench, a multifidelity benchmark in which optimizers and AI agents design transonic wings with computational fluid dynamics (CFD) inside the search. They can query a learned aerodynamic surrogate and spend a fixed budget of sequential CFD evaluations, each returning a score or a failure type. WingBench grades the design each method recommends, reporting separately whether it receives a valid score and how good that score is. Using WingBench, we contribute a study of five baseline optimizers and a comparison of three AI agent methods, which produced 6,629 CFD evaluation records. Feedback helps baseline optimizers deliver valid designs when it changes their later proposals, but the differential-evolution variant does so with lower aerodynamic quality. An open-ended research agent finds designs of similar quality to the strongest baselines over 32 CFD queries, with different prior information and unmatched total computation. In early search, our reflection and planning implementations do not consistently improve on it. We release the data, code, agent prompts, and analysis scripts for reproducibility.

translation.title: WingBench：基准测试AI智能体如何搜索更优设计
translation.abstract: 设计搜索常使用廉价的学习型预测来决定哪些候选值得进行昂贵的测试，但这些测试可能失败，尤其是在优化所偏好的非常规设计上。我们提出 WingBench，一个多保真度基准，其中优化器和AI智能体在搜索过程中使用计算流体力学（CFD）设计跨音速机翼。它们可以查询学习型气动代理模型，并花费固定预算进行顺序CFD评估，每次评估返回一个分数或一种失败类型。WingBench 对每种方法推荐的设计进行评分，分别报告其是否获得有效分数以及分数的优劣。基于 WingBench，我们贡献了对五个基线优化器的研究以及三种AI智能体方法的比较，共产生6,629条CFD评估记录。当反馈能改变基线优化器后续提案时，反馈有助于其产出有效设计，但差分进化变体虽能如此却气动质量较低。一个开放式研究智能体在32次CFD查询内找到与最强基线质量相当的设计，且其先验信息不同、总计算量也不对等。在搜索早期，我们的反思与规划实现并未稳定超越它。我们发布了数据、代码、智能体提示和分析脚本以保证可复现性。
translation.brief: 提出多保真度基准 WingBench，用CFD评估跨音速机翼设计搜索中优化器与AI智能体在昂贵测试失败情况下的表现。

papers.title: Diversity over Scale: Recursive Self-Improvement with Ensembles of Small Open-Weight Models
papers.abstract: The advancement of large language models (LLMs) has significantly enhanced the capabilities of agents across various tasks. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) loops, in which a language model repeatedly rewrites a program and builds on its previous version, now perform well in machine-learning tasks, but they rely on frontier models and hundreds of calls per run. Small open-weight models are far cheaper, yet when used alone, their programs often crash and their improvements stall. We propose DiVE (diverse models evolve), an ensemble method for RSI that aims to improve creativity and diversity of generated solutions. DiVE uses three components: a shared memory, a failure log, and best-idea-wins rounds. This allows models to write candidate solutions from the same context and retain the best idea at each iteration. On 22 MLE-bench Lite competitions, an ensemble of five 8-12B open-weight models has 25.4% less test error than its average member and 16.7% less than Llama 3.3 70B, and comes within 7.1% of Qwen 3.5 122B-A10B at 75% of its cost. Diversity among small models can thus stand in for part of the scale that RSI relies on.

translation.title: 多样性胜过规模：基于小型开源权重模型集成的递归自我改进
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的进步显著增强了智能体在各类任务上的能力。递归自我改进（RSI）循环——即语言模型反复重写程序并在其先前版本上迭代构建——如今在机器学习任务中表现良好，但它们依赖前沿模型且每次运行需要数百次调用。小型开源权重模型便宜得多，但单独使用时其程序经常崩溃且改进停滞。我们提出 DiVE（diverse models evolve），一种旨在提升生成方案创造力与多样性的RSI集成方法。DiVE 包含三个组件：共享记忆、失败日志和最优方案胜出轮次。这使各模型能基于相同上下文撰写候选方案，并在每次迭代中保留最佳方案。在22个 MLE-bench Lite 竞赛上，由五个8-12B开源权重模型组成的集成比其平均成员的测试误差低25.4%，比 Llama 3.3 70B 低16.7%，并以75%的成本达到与 Qwen 3.5 122B-A10B 相差7.1%以内的水平。因此，小模型之间的多样性可以部分替代RSI所依赖的规模。
translation.brief: 提出 DiVE 集成方法，通过共享记忆、失败日志和最优方案胜出机制，让小型开源模型集成实现递归自我改进以替代前沿大模型。

papers.title: Human-in-the-Loop Runbook Improvement with Agentic Support Automation
papers.abstract: Operational support is an important component of production software services. Support requests are often emergent and can come in many forms such as customer escalations or unplanned service interruption. Engineers across organizations have been successful in implementing automation to help streamline support processes but many solutions remain in the hands of human operators. A successful strategy to improve operator response times is to maintain up-to-date runbooks which are documents enumerating triage steps and remediation procedures in the face of identified incidents. This paper is an investigation into an operational system which incorporates Agentic AI into a runbook based incident resolution pattern. The bot uses information in the runbook corpus along with some system-specific tooling to guide the manual operator through the mitigation process then evaluate the outcome and suggest edits to the runbook where it found gaps and in its ability to triage the situation. By using the runbook as a medium to bridge humans and automation, the process maintains explainability and can be decoupled from the agent system. This paper demonstrates a collaboration between human operators and Agentic AI with results from an 17 week study involving 232 production incidents. We conclude with lessons on integrating LLMs into DevOps workflows, related work in AI-assisted operations, and guidance for reproducibility.

translation.title: 基于智能体支持自动化的人在回路运行手册改进
translation.abstract: 运维支持是生产级软件服务的重要组成部分。支持请求往往是突发性的，形式多样，如客户升级或计划外的服务中断。各组织的工程师已成功实施自动化来简化支持流程，但许多解决方案仍掌握在人工操作员手中。提升操作员响应时间的一个成功策略是维护最新的运行手册（runbook），即列举针对已识别事件的三分步骤和修复程序的文档。本文研究了一个将智能体AI融入基于运行手册的事件解决模式的运维系统。该机器人利用运行手册语料库中的信息以及一些系统专用工具，引导人工操作员完成缓解流程，然后评估结果，并在发现运行手册存在缺口或其三分能力不足之处时建议修改。通过将运行手册作为连接人与自动化的媒介，该流程保持了可解释性，并可与智能体系统解耦。本文展示了人工操作员与智能体AI的协作，结果来自一项为期17周、涉及232起生产事件的研究。最后我们总结了将LLM集成到 DevOps 工作流的经验、AI辅助运维的相关工作以及可复现性指导。
translation.brief: 提出一个将智能体AI融入运行手册事件处理流程的系统，由机器人引导操作员完成缓解并自动发现和修补运行手册的缺口。

papers.title: Muted Distillation: Sealing Reasoning from Teacher Unlocks Token-Efficient Agents
papers.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is commonly adopted as one of the components in post-training of large language models (LLMs), but in multi-turn agentic tasks we find that the student model increases their reasoning lengths after training. Our empirical analysis shows that the reasoning token lengths is affected by how much the student can distract the teacher's scores. We introduce Muted Distillation (MD), a simple variant of OPD that hides the student's reasoning from the teacher, so the teacher judges what the student does without the interference of student's reasonings. MD takes a few lines of code and adds no extra data or hyperparameters. On the knowledge-work benchmarks OfficeQA Pro and SpreadsheetBench, it reduces output tokens per episode by 57\% and 53\% compared with standard OPD, making the student more concise than it was before training. At the same time, it matches OPD's accuracy on OfficeQA Pro and improves pass@1 by 4.8 points on SpreadsheetBench.

translation.title: Muted Distillation：对教师屏蔽学生推理，解锁高Token效率的智能体
translation.abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）常被用作大语言模型（LLM）后训练的组件之一，但我们发现在多轮智能体任务中，学生模型在训练后推理长度会增加。我们的实证分析表明，推理token长度受学生能在多大程度上干扰教师评分的影响。我们提出Muted Distillation（MD），这是OPD的一个简单变体，它对教师隐藏学生的推理过程，使教师在不受学生推理干扰的情况下评判学生的行为。MD只需几行代码，不增加额外数据或超参数。在知识工作基准OfficeQA Pro和SpreadsheetBench上，与标准OPD相比，它将每回合输出token分别减少57%和53%，使学生比训练前更加简洁。同时，它在OfficeQA Pro上保持与OPD相当的准确率，并在SpreadsheetBench上将pass@1提升4.8分。
translation.brief: 解决在线策略蒸馏中学生推理长度膨胀的问题，方法是对教师屏蔽学生的推理内容使其评分不受干扰。

papers.title: When a Permitted Action Completes a Forbidden Workflow: Designing Consequence-Oriented Approval for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Tool-using language-model agents increasingly ask people to approve consequential actions, yet an approval prompt shows only the next step. A request to send a file to an approved recipient can look harmless even when that file was assembled, several steps earlier, from data the user said must never leave. We call this a cumulative authorization failure and argue that it is an interaction design problem as much as a security problem. The evidence a reviewer needs is spread across the trajectory, and listing it in time order leaves the reviewer to reconstruct the causal chain. We present the Cumulative Consent Ledger (CCL), an approval interface built on four design principles that restate the user's intent, bind the review to the exact action, compose the cumulative consequence, and keep every claim checkable. A trusted monitor that tracks artifact lineage supplies the evidence. In a between-subjects study with 80 participants and 960 approval decisions, CCL was associated with fewer unsafe approvals than an evidence-matched chronological log (24.2% vs. 32.5%), higher comprehension, and faster decisions, although the adjusted difference in unsafe approvals remained uncertain (-7.9 points, 95% CrI [-19.7, 3.8]). In a system evaluation, the monitor detected 89.2% of 120 violating checkpoints and, used as an execution gate, reduced executed unsafe effects from 43.3% to 5.0% for one agent at a small cost to benign completion. We derive implications for designing consent around consequences rather than individual calls.

translation.title: 当被允许的动作完成被禁止的工作流：面向后果的LLM智能体审批设计
translation.abstract: 使用工具的语言模型智能体越来越多地要求人们审批有后果的操作，但审批提示只显示下一步。向已获批准的接收者发送文件的请求看起来无害，即使该文件在几步之前是由用户声明绝不能外发的数据组装而成。我们将此称为累积授权失败，并认为它既是安全问题也是交互设计问题。审阅者所需的证据分散在整个轨迹中，按时间顺序罗列会让审阅者自行重建因果链。我们提出累积同意账本（Cumulative Consent Ledger, CCL），一个基于四项设计原则的审批界面：重述用户意图、将审查绑定到确切动作、组合累积后果、并使每项声明可核查。一个追踪工件谱系的可信监控器提供证据。在一项包含80名参与者和960次审批决策的受试者间研究中，与证据匹配的时间顺序日志相比，CCL带来更少的不安全审批（24.2% vs. 32.5%）、更高的理解度和更快的决策速度，尽管不安全审批的调整后差异仍不确定（-7.9分，95% CrI [-19.7, 3.8]）。在系统评估中，监控器检测出120个违规检查点中的89.2%，作为执行门控使用时，将某个智能体执行的不安全后果从43.3%降至5.0%，同时对良性任务完成的代价很小。我们据此提出围绕后果而非单次调用设计同意机制的启示。
translation.brief: 解决LLM智能体多步操作累积导致越权授权的问题，方法是设计基于后果组合与工件谱系追踪的审批界面CCL。

papers.title: Automated Safety Analysis for Agentic Workflows
papers.abstract: LLM applications are increasingly built as agentic workflows: programs that combine model calls, external tools, and control logic to act autonomously on a user's behalf. Because these workflows execute real-world actions, logical flaws in how a workflow is wired can cause severe harm in deployed systems. Unlike prompt injections or malformed API calls, these workflow bugs stem from defects in the workflow's design, yet no existing tool can statically validate workflow logic across frameworks prior to deployment. We present Apsis, a static safety analyzer that detects workflow bugs before deployment. To operate across frameworks, Apsis lifts framework-specific code into a common intermediate representation (IR). This IR models a workflow as a semantic graph of steps, data dependencies, and shared state, while annotating each component with behavioral properties such as whether an input is mandatory or how a shared channel merges concurrent writes. Building on this representation, we introduce a bug description language that formalizes recurring classes of agentic failures as declarative patterns over the IR. By matching these patterns against the IR, Apsis detects structural and behavioral flaws and pinpoints the exact step responsible for each bug. To evaluate Apsis, we construct, to our knowledge, the first corpus of workflow bugs, distilled from real-world reports across 13 widely used frameworks. On a reproducible benchmark suite drawn from this corpus, Apsis detects workflow bugs with 91% precision and 84% recall, and uncovers 36 previously unknown bugs in real-world workflows.

translation.title: 面向智能体工作流的自动化安全分析
translation.abstract: LLM应用越来越多地以智能体工作流的形式构建：将模型调用、外部工具和控制逻辑组合起来、代表用户自主行动的程序。由于这些工作流会执行真实世界的操作，工作流连接方式中的逻辑缺陷可能在部署系统中造成严重危害。与提示注入或格式错误的API调用不同，这些工作流缺陷源于工作流设计中的缺陷，然而目前没有工具能在部署前跨框架静态验证工作流逻辑。我们提出Apsis，一个在部署前检测工作流缺陷的静态安全分析器。为跨框架运行，Apsis将框架特定代码提升为统一的中间表示（IR）。该IR将工作流建模为步骤、数据依赖和共享状态的语义图，并为每个组件标注行为属性，例如输入是否必需、共享通道如何合并并发写入。基于该表示，我们引入一种缺陷描述语言，将反复出现的智能体失败类别形式化为IR上的声明式模式。通过将这些模式与IR匹配，Apsis检测结构和行为缺陷并精确定位导致每个缺陷的步骤。为评估Apsis，我们构建了据我们所知首个工作流缺陷语料库，提炼自13个广泛使用框架的真实报告。在基于该语料库的可复现基准套件上，Apsis以91%的精确率和84%的召回率检测工作流缺陷，并发现了36个此前未知的工作流缺陷。
translation.brief: 解决智能体工作流设计缺陷无法在部署前静态检测的问题，方法是将框架代码提升为统一IR并用声明式缺陷模式进行匹配分析。

papers.title: ImCDN: An Immersive Content Delivery Network for Cooperative Tile-level 360 Video Streaming
papers.abstract: Delivering immersive 360 video over Content Distribution Networks (CDNs) demands ultra-high bitrates, yet each user's viewport covers only a small fraction of the full panorama. Therefore, conventional segment-level architectures waste scarce edge resources on unseen regions. This paper presents ImCDN, an immersive end-to-end tile-granularity CDN framework that integrates field-of-view (FoV)-driven cloud pre-distribution with hybrid segment-tile caching at edge servers, edge compute for on-demand tile transcoding, and an edge-to-edge relay mechanism for cooperative content sharing. We formulate the CDN optimization problem, comprising cache admission, compute scheduling, and serving-node selection, as a long-term utility maximization that balances cache hit-rate, edge sharing, end-to-end latency, backhaul traffic, energy consumption, viewport video quality, and cache replacement cost. We solve it via multi-agent proximal policy optimization (MAPPO) under centralized training and decentralized execution across edge servers. Simulations on a realistic topology with real 360 head-tracking traces show that ImCDN improves edge hit rate and reduces user waiting time, reduces origin traffic by approximately 18% compared to the non-cooperative edge variant, and outperforms segment-only CDN baselines at comparable immersive quality (e.g., 4K/6K) and standard caching heuristics.

translation.title: ImCDN：面向协作式瓦片级360视频流媒体的沉浸式内容分发网络
translation.abstract: 通过内容分发网络（CDN）传输沉浸式360视频需要超高码率，而每个用户的视口仅覆盖全景的一小部分。因此，传统的分段级架构将稀缺的边缘资源浪费在未被观看的区域上。本文提出ImCDN，一个端到端的瓦片粒度沉浸式CDN框架，它集成了由视场（FoV）驱动的云端预分发、边缘服务器的分段-瓦片混合缓存、用于按需瓦片转码的边缘计算，以及用于协作内容共享的边缘到边缘中继机制。我们将CDN优化问题（包括缓存准入、计算调度和服务节点选择）形式化为长期效用最大化，以平衡缓存命中率、边缘共享、端到端延迟、回源流量、能耗、视口视频质量和缓存替换成本。我们通过在边缘服务器间采用集中训练、分散执行的多智能体近端策略优化（MAPPO）求解该问题。在真实拓扑和真实360头部追踪轨迹上的仿真表明，ImCDN提高了边缘命中率并减少了用户等待时间，与非协作边缘变体相比减少约18%的回源流量，并在相当沉浸质量（如4K/6K）下优于仅分段CDN基线和标准缓存启发式方法。
translation.brief: 解决360视频CDN在分段粒度上浪费边缘资源的问题，方法是构建瓦片粒度的协作式CDN框架并用MAPPO联合优化缓存、调度与节点选择。

papers.title: PAMS: Preconditioned Activation-Metric Subspace for Zeroth-Order LLM Fine-tuning
papers.abstract: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization provides a computationally efficient approach to fine-tuning large language models (LLMs), but conventional methods typically rely on isotropic perturbations that ignore the anisotropic structure of neural-network parameter spaces. We introduce Preconditioned Activation-Metric Subspace (PAMS), a ZO optimization framework that uses forward-pass activation statistics to construct structured, layer-wise perturbation geometries without computing gradients or forming dense curvature matrices. PAMS tracks a low-rank approximation of the dominant activation subspace and its associated spectrum online, and uses the spectrum to softly reweight perturbation variance while preserving exploration in directions outside the retained subspace. A trace normalization separates the perturbation geometry from its overall scale, enabling consistent perturbation magnitudes across layers. We show theoretically that the resulting perturbation covariance induces right-side preconditioning of the gradient of the corresponding Gaussian-smoothed objective. We further characterize the estimator's smoothing bias and second moment and derive a nonconvex convergence guarantee that captures the effects of the perturbation geometry and smoothing radius. The proposed low-rank tracking procedure requires $\mathcal{O}(n_l r)$ persistent memory for a layer with input dimension nl and retained rank r, avoiding the $\mathcal{O}(n_l^2)$ memory required by a dense activation covariance. Experiments on transformer-based language-model fine-tuning tasks across GLUE and SuperGLUE demonstrate that PAMS improves the effectiveness and stability of zeroth-order optimization while retaining its gradient-free and objective-evaluation-based advantages.

translation.title: PAMS：用于零阶LLM微调的预条件激活度量子空间
translation.abstract: 零阶（ZO）优化为微调大语言模型（LLM）提供了计算高效的方法，但传统方法通常依赖各向同性扰动，忽略了神经网络参数空间的各向异性结构。我们提出预条件激活度量子空间（PAMS），一个ZO优化框架，它利用前向传播的激活统计量构建结构化的逐层扰动几何，而无需计算梯度或构造稠密曲率矩阵。PAMS在线追踪主导激活子空间的低秩近似及其相关谱，并利用该谱对扰动方差进行软重加权，同时在被保留子空间之外的方向上保持探索。迹归一化将扰动几何与其整体尺度分离，使各层扰动幅度保持一致。我们从理论上证明，所得扰动协方差对相应高斯平滑目标的梯度实施右侧预条件。我们进一步刻画了估计器的平滑偏差和二阶矩，并推导出能刻画扰动几何与平滑半径影响的非凸收敛保证。所提出的低秩追踪过程对输入维度为nl、保留秩为r的层仅需$\mathcal{O}(n_l r)$的持久内存，避免了稠密激活协方差所需的$\mathcal{O}(n_l^2)$内存。在GLUE和SuperGLUE上基于transformer的语言模型微调任务实验表明，PAMS在保留零阶优化无梯度、基于目标函数评估的优势的同时，提升了其有效性和稳定性。
translation.brief: 解决零阶优化中各向同性扰动忽略参数空间结构的问题，方法是利用前向激活统计在线构建低秩预条件扰动几何。

papers.title: ESM-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Whether AI Agents Understand Earth System Model Physics and Code
papers.abstract: AI coding agents that modify Earth System Model (ESM) code must preserve both software interfaces and the physical assumptions encoded in them. We introduce ESM-Bench, a benchmark of 60 developer-commit tasks from 6 repositories: Noah-MP, CLM5, SUMMA, ParFlow, MOM6, and VIC. The v5 corpus contains 17 physics-based bug fixes, 16 process-representation modifications, 13 parameterization-scheme selections, and 14 parameter-optimization tasks. Each task includes a scientific objective, parent-commit source files, a reference diff, and three stored prompt variants. An artifact audit confirms that all 60 reference diffs apply to their supplied starting files. We define an eight-item patch-review rubric and audit five archived patch fixtures against the implemented local checkers. None of the five fixture diffs applies to its supplied starting files, yet three text-pattern checkers return a pass. A ParFlow expression replay disagrees with the reference slopes, and a MOM6 pattern check detects an omitted update. Inspection also identifies a retained VIC reference assignment that overwrites the intended vegetation-specific albedo. These findings expose limits of reference patches and local proxies as correctness evidence. The release provides a reproducible corpus and diagnostic tools; complete expert validation, comparative agent performance, and full-model execution remain unmeasured on v5.

translation.title: ESM-Bench：评估AI智能体是否理解地球系统模式物理与代码的基准
translation.abstract: 修改地球系统模式（ESM）代码的AI编程智能体必须同时保留软件接口及其编码的物理假设。我们提出ESM-Bench，一个包含来自6个代码库（Noah-MP、CLM5、SUMMA、ParFlow、MOM6和VIC）的60个开发者提交任务的基准。v5语料库包含17个基于物理的bug修复、16个过程表示修改、13个参数化方案选择和14个参数优化任务。每个任务包含一个科学目标、父提交源文件、参考diff和三个存储的提示变体。工件审计确认所有60个参考diff均可应用于其提供的起始文件。我们定义了一个八项补丁审查评分标准，并对五个存档补丁夹具对照已实现的本地检查器进行审计。五个夹具diff均不适用于其提供的起始文件，但三个文本模式检查器却返回通过。一个ParFlow表达式重放与参考斜率不一致，一个MOM6模式检查检测到遗漏的更新。检查还发现一个被保留的VIC参考赋值会覆盖预期的植被特定反照率。这些发现暴露了参考补丁和本地代理作为正确性证据的局限性。该发布版本提供了可复现的语料库和诊断工具；完整的专家验证、智能体对比性能和全模式执行在v5上仍未测量。
translation.brief: 该论文构建了包含60个真实开发者任务的ESM-Bench基准，用于评估AI智能体修改地球系统模式代码时能否保持物理正确性，并通过审计揭示参考补丁与本地检查器的局限。

papers.title: Digital Knockoffs
papers.abstract: Social simulations often use language model agents to represent people who differ on several measurable traits. However, describing a trait profile in a prompt does not guarantee the agent will express each trait at its intended level. We propose a method that calibrates agents to multidimensional profiles using activation steering: (i) extract steering directions for each trait, (ii) learn a shared mapping from steering strengths to measured trait scores, and (iii) search for a steering intervention for each target. We use Bayesian optimization for this search and evaluate the method on the Big Five personality scores of 500 OpenPsychometrics respondents. In each of five rounds, the assigned interventions yield lower mean absolute error across respondents than the prompting and steering baselines. Further, the model's responses to a given intervention yield the same trait profile regardless of whose target motivated it, so a poor match for one respondent can be the best match for another. When we match each respondent to the closest profile found across all tested interventions, Bayesian optimization yields 16.6% lower mean absolute error than uniform random search at the same evaluation budget. Our method thus offers a way to build social agents whose measured traits dovetail with those of the people they seek to represent. Whether this closer fit translates to improved predictions of downstream behavior remains an open question.

translation.title: 数字替身（Digital Knockoffs）
translation.abstract: 社会模拟常使用语言模型智能体来代表在多个可测量特质上各不相同的人。然而，在提示中描述一个特质画像并不能保证智能体会在预期水平上表达每个特质。我们提出一种使用激活引导（activation steering）将智能体校准到多维画像的方法：(i) 为每个特质提取引导方向，(ii) 学习从引导强度到测量特质分数的共享映射，(iii) 为每个目标搜索引导干预。我们使用贝叶斯优化进行搜索，并在500名OpenPsychometrics受访者的大五人格分数上评估该方法。在五轮中的每一轮，所分配的干预在受访者上的平均绝对误差均低于提示和引导基线。此外，模型对给定干预的响应产生相同的特质画像，而与激发它的目标无关，因此对某一受访者匹配不佳的干预可能是对另一受访者的最佳匹配。当我们将每个受访者匹配到所有测试干预中发现的最接近画像时，在相同评估预算下，贝叶斯优化比均匀随机搜索的平均绝对误差低16.6%。因此，我们的方法提供了一种构建社会智能体的途径，使其测量特质与其试图代表的人的特质相吻合。这种更紧密的拟合是否能转化为对下游行为的更好预测仍是一个开放问题。
translation.brief: 该论文提出用激活引导加贝叶斯优化校准语言模型智能体，使其多维度人格特质测量值匹配目标人群画像。

papers.title: Don't Train It, Write It: An AI Agent Writes New Capabilities into Language Model Weights
papers.abstract: We show that an AI agent can write new capabilities into a pretrained language model by adding gated attention heads and MLP neurons inside its existing layers, without backpropagation and without fitting any weight to the answers of task examples. It has a budget of 50 model passes and sees no validation or test instance. Composed in one model, its modules for six BIG-Bench Hard (BBH) subtasks raise the normalized BBH score of Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct from 19.95 to 41.05 (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct: at most 35.01) and that of Gemma-3-1B-it from 10.25 to 32.86. Against the unmodified model at the same precision, both composites leave the next-token distribution on 1,023,000 WikiText tokens unchanged (KL exactly 0), give identical answers on 15,845 items of five other Leaderboard tests and identical scores on the other 18 BBH subtasks. The agent also writes exact multiplication up to 20 digits, running the model only up to 6 (100.0% on the absent lengths of the sealed test in both models; a LoRA with the same budget: at most 2.1%). Sets, rules and report sentences were sealed in git before the first session (manifests timestamped in Bitcoin), with dated amendments listed in Appendix D; a frozen evaluator ran the sealed test once. Verdicts (H5: tracking; H6: composite; H8: one pass vs. chain of thought; H9: fresh and rewritten instances; H10: side effects; H12: multiplication), on the preregistered sealed test, Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct: H5 success, H6 success, H8 (web_of_lies) success, H9 success, H10 (composite) success on (i) to (iii), (iv) confirmed, H12 success; Gemma-3-1B-it (H7: H5, H6, H8 and H9 in this model): H5 success, H6 success, H8 (web_of_lies) success, H8 (tracking 3) success, H9 partial, H10 (composite) success on (i) to (iii), (iv) confirmed, H12 success. Not everything worked: 4 of 45 single modules show small side effects and 5 of 50 sessions hit the 12-hour limit without a module.

translation.title: 别训练它，写出来：AI智能体将新能力写入语言模型权重
translation.abstract: 我们证明AI智能体可以通过在预训练语言模型的现有层内添加门控注意力头和MLP神经元，将新能力写入模型，无需反向传播，也无需将任何权重拟合到任务示例的答案上。它有50次模型调用的预算，且不接触任何验证或测试实例。组合在一个模型中，其针对六个BIG-Bench Hard（BBH）子任务的模块将Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct的归一化BBH分数从19.95提升到41.05（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct：最高35.01），将Gemma-3-1B-it从10.25提升到32.86。与相同精度下的未修改模型相比，两个组合模型在1,023,000个WikiText token上的下一token分布保持不变（KL恰好为0），在五个其他Leaderboard测试的15,845个条目上给出相同答案，在其他18个BBH子任务上得分相同。该智能体还写出了最高20位的精确乘法，模型调用最多仅6次（在两个模型的密封测试缺失长度上均为100.0%；相同预算的LoRA：最高2.1%）。集合、规则和报告句子在第一次会话前已在git中密封（清单在Bitcoin上加盖时间戳），带日期的修订列于附录D；一个冻结的评估器对密封测试运行了一次。判定结果（H5：追踪；H6：组合；H8：单次调用vs思维链；H9：新实例与重写实例；H10：副作用；H12：乘法），在预注册的密封测试上，Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct：H5成功，H6成功，H8（web_of_lies）成功，H9成功，H10（组合）在(i)至(iii)成功，(iv)确认，H12成功；Gemma-3-1B-it（H7：本模型中的H5、H6、H8和H9）：H5成功，H6成功，H8（web_of_lies）成功，H8（tracking 3）成功，H9部分成功，H10（组合）在(i)至(iii)成功，(iv)确认，H12成功。并非一切都成功：45个单模块中有4个显示小副作用，50个会话中有5个触及12小时限制而未产出模块。
translation.brief: 该论文提出一种AI智能体，通过在预训练模型层内添加门控注意力头和MLP神经元（无需反向传播）直接写入新能力，如BBH子任务和20位精确乘法。

papers.title: Digital Twins for Multi-Agent Systems: When to Trust, What to Change
papers.abstract: Digital twins of agent networks need to flag unreliable forecasts and help users choose interventions. Both decisions depend on what happens over several steps: an error can spread through the network, and an edit whose trajectory is easy to predict may still yield a poor collective outcome. We ask when information about error propagation improves failure detection and whether a learned twin can select effective network edits despite imperfect forecasts. We propose Propagation-Aware Validation for Networked Digital Twins (PAV-Twin). Its monitor combines Jacobian-based propagation features with recent errors and ensemble disagreement to estimate the risk that a forecast exceeds an error threshold. Its planner simulates each candidate edit and ranks the edits by their predicted collective outcomes. In simulations, the monitor gained 0.13 in area under the precision-recall curve on larger oscillator networks with familiar topologies and 0.09 on larger networks with held-out topologies, relative to a graph baseline without propagation features. Gains were small in contractive consensus. Giving the graph baseline the same features narrowed the gap. In a separate planning study, ensemble simulation recovered about 99% of the possible improvement over random intervention selection in oscillators and nearly all of it in consensus. With a simplified oscillator twin, selecting by predicted outcome also gave lower regret than selecting by trajectory fidelity. These results show when propagation features help flag unreliable forecasts and why the quality of intervention choices should be measured directly.

translation.title: 多智能体系统的数字孪生：何时信任、改变什么
translation.abstract: 智能体网络的数字孪生需要标记不可靠的预测并帮助用户选择干预措施。这两个决策都取决于多步内发生的情况：误差可能在网络中传播，而一个轨迹易于预测的编辑仍可能产生糟糕的集体结果。我们探究误差传播信息何时能改进故障检测，以及学习到的孪生能否在预测不完美的情况下选择有效的网络编辑。我们提出面向网络化数字孪生的传播感知验证（PAV-Twin）。其监视器将基于雅可比矩阵的传播特征与近期误差和集成分歧相结合，以估计预测超过误差阈值的风险。其规划器模拟每个候选编辑，并按预测的集体结果对编辑进行排序。在模拟中，与没有传播特征的图基线相比，该监视器在拓扑熟悉的较大振荡器网络上AUC-PR提升0.13，在保留拓扑的较大网络上提升0.09。在收缩共识中收益较小。给图基线提供相同特征缩小了差距。在另一项规划研究中，集成模拟在振荡器中恢复了约99%相对随机干预选择的可能改进，在共识中几乎全部恢复。使用简化的振荡器孪生，按预测结果选择也比按轨迹保真度选择产生更低的遗憾。这些结果表明传播特征何时有助于标记不可靠预测，以及为何应直接衡量干预选择的质量。
translation.brief: 该论文提出PAV-Twin框架，利用误差传播特征判断多智能体网络数字孪生预测的可信度，并通过集成模拟按预测集体结果选择网络编辑。

papers.title: DisSparse: Pipelined Top-$p$ Sparse Attention for Long-Context LLM Serving
papers.abstract: Long-context LLM inference is bottlenecked by the memory demands of the key-value (KV) cache, whose size scales linearly with context length. Dynamic sparse attention reduces this bottleneck by fetching and attending only to a critical subset of tokens. The dominant primitive in dynamic sparse attention research and deployment is fixed-budget top-$k$ selection, which is favored because its deterministic block count aligns with the static memory allocation that systems like vLLM rely on. Top-$k$ uses a fixed budget regardless of how attention mass is distributed across heads, layers, and decode steps, leading to either wasted bandwidth on heads with peaky attention or dropped context on heads with diffuse attention. Top-$p$ (nucleus) selection adapts naturally to this variation but has seen limited adoption in production serving systems due to two system-level challenges: variable block counts that break deterministic block allocation and computationally expensive selection kernels that exceed the cost of attention itself. We present DisSparse, a serving system that integrates top-$p$ sparse attention into vLLM end-to-end. DisSparse decouples block selection from the scheduler's critical path, hides selection latency behind layer computation via a two-stream pipeline, and introduces a single-pass histogram-based top-$p$ kernel. We further observe intra-block sparsity, the inflation of selection budgets caused by mixing high- and low-importance tokens within fixed-size KV cache blocks, and address it with a token relocation kernel guided by accumulated prefill attention scores. Across long- and medium-context benchmarks on multiple models, DisSparse achieves 1.17x to 1.80x speedup in sparsity analysis (block selection) over state-of-the-art top-$p$ methods with negligible accuracy loss and supports up to 8x larger maximum batch sizes than dense vLLM under the same memory budget.

translation.title: DisSparse：面向长上下文LLM服务的流水线化Top-$p$稀疏注意力
translation.abstract: 长上下文LLM推理受限于键值（KV）缓存的内存需求，其大小随上下文长度线性增长。动态稀疏注意力通过仅获取并关注关键token子集来缓解这一瓶颈。动态稀疏注意力研究与部署中的主导原语是固定预算的top-$k$选择，其受青睐是因为其确定性的块数量与vLLM等系统依赖的静态内存分配相契合。Top-$k$无论注意力质量如何在头、层和解码步骤间分布，都使用固定预算，导致要么在注意力尖锐的头浪费带宽，要么在注意力分散的头丢失上下文。Top-$p$（核）选择能自然适应这种变化，但由于两个系统级挑战而在生产服务系统中采用有限：破坏确定性块分配的可变块数量，以及超过注意力本身成本的计算昂贵的选择内核。我们提出DisSparse，一个将top-$p$稀疏注意力端到端集成到vLLM的服务系统。DisSparse将块选择与调度器的关键路径解耦，通过双流流水线将选择延迟隐藏在层计算之后，并引入单遍基于直方图的top-$p$内核。我们进一步观察到块内稀疏性，即固定大小KV缓存块内混合高、低重要性token导致的选择预算膨胀，并用由累积prefill注意力分数引导的token重定位内核加以解决。在多个模型的长、中上下文基准上，DisSparse在稀疏性分析（块选择）中相比最先进的top-$p$方法实现1.17倍至1.80倍加速且精度损失可忽略，并在相同内存预算下支持比稠密vLLM最多8倍的最大批大小。
translation.brief: 该论文提出DisSparse系统，通过流水线化top-$p$稀疏注意力选择、单遍直方图内核和块内token重定位，将自适应稀疏注意力高效集成到vLLM以加速长上下文LLM服务。

papers.title: Information Access and Gain-Loss Framing in Six Large Language Models and Human Decision Makers
papers.abstract: A risky choice can be described by what will be saved or what will be lost, and people often choose differently depending on that wording. We test whether six large language models (LLMs) show this gain-loss framing effect, and whether it shrinks when they can first read more about the options. GPT-4.1, GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Qwen3 235B and Llama 4 Maverick made 11,519 choices across four risk scenarios, each in its original wording, two paraphrases and a mirrored version in the opposite wording. Before choosing, a model could open up to 0, 2, 3 or 4 of seven information cards. With no cards, all six models showed large framing effects: the share choosing the safe option was 27 to 79 percentage points lower under loss than under gain wording. The gap was smaller at 2 cards than with no cards in every model. Against a 10-point threshold set in our analysis plan, GPT-4.1 fell within it at 4 cards and Qwen3 only at 2 cards; in the plan's pooled comparison over all versions, GPT-4.1 was within it from 2 cards and GPT-4o from 3. GPT-4o-mini and Llama 4 Maverick kept gaps of 28 to 66 points with cards, and for GPT-4o-mini and Qwen3 the gap grew again from 2 to 4 cards. Part of the drop from 0 to 2 cards may reflect a change in prompt format, and most card content counted against the risky option, which may favor the safe choice. In an exploratory comparison with 198 students who saw the same scenarios and cards but opened cards one at a time and chose how many, decisions made after opening 0 or 1 cards showed a 19-point difference between the gain scenarios, asked first, and the loss scenarios, asked later, and no clear difference appeared in decisions made after opening more, though this design cannot show that cards reduced framing in people. With these cards, in the balanced comparison 17 of 18 card gaps were below the model's no-card gap, but few were within the threshold.

translation.title: 六个大语言模型与人类决策者的信息获取与得失框架效应
translation.abstract: 一个风险选择可以用“将获得什么”或“将失去什么”来描述，而人们往往会因措辞不同而做出不同选择。我们检验六个大语言模型（LLM）是否表现出这种得失框架效应，以及当它们可以先阅读更多选项信息时该效应是否缩小。GPT-4.1、GPT-4o、GPT-4o-mini、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Qwen3 235B 和 Llama 4 Maverick 在四个风险场景中共做出 11,519 次选择，每个场景包含原始措辞、两个改写版本和一个措辞相反的镜像版本。选择之前，模型可以打开七张信息卡片中的 0、2、3 或 4 张。在不打开卡片时，所有六个模型都表现出较大的框架效应：损失措辞下选择安全选项的比例比收益措辞下低 27 到 79 个百分点。在所有模型中，打开 2 张卡片时的差距都小于不打开卡片时。按照我们分析计划中设定的 10 个百分点阈值，GPT-4.1 在 4 张卡片时落入阈值内，Qwen3 仅在 2 张卡片时落入；在该计划对所有版本的汇总比较中，GPT-4.1 从 2 张卡片起、GPT-4o 从 3 张卡片起落入阈值内。GPT-4o-mini 和 Llama 4 Maverick 在有卡片时仍保持 28 到 66 个百分点的差距，且 GPT-4o-mini 和 Qwen3 的差距从 2 张到 4 张卡片时再次扩大。从 0 张到 2 张卡片的部分下降可能反映了提示格式的变化，且大多数卡片内容不利于风险选项，这可能偏向安全选择。在一项与 198 名学生的探索性比较中（学生看到相同的场景和卡片，但逐张打开卡片并自行决定打开数量），打开 0 或 1 张卡片后的决策在先问的收益场景与后问的损失场景之间显示出 19 个百分点的差异，而打开更多卡片后的决策未出现明显差异，但该设计无法证明卡片减少了人类的框架效应。使用这些卡片时，在平衡比较中，18 个卡片差距中有 17 个低于模型无卡片时的差距，但落入阈值内的很少。
translation.brief: 研究六个 LLM 是否像人类一样表现出得失框架效应，以及提供信息卡片能否缩小该效应，通过多措辞风险场景与可打开信息卡片的实验进行检验。

papers.title: Weight-Space Backdoors in Open-Weight LLMs: Cross-Architecture Attacks and Blind Model Forensics
