papers.abstract: Open-weight language models are vulnerable to trigger-conditioned behaviors introduced through sparse post-training weight modifications, creating supply-chain risks beyond conventional provenance checks. We present Neural Sentinel, a cross-architecture study of gradient-guided backdoor insertion and model forensics spanning 18 checkpoints across 14 architecture families (124M-31.3B parameters), including state-space and recurrent models. On Phi-2, modifying approximately 0.0002% of parameters induced an exact short-marker output after 300 steps (332 seconds), with mean next-token KL divergence of $1.5 \times 10^{-5}$ and 100% top-1 agreement over evaluated positions of eight fixed reference prompts. Separate experiments produced structured tool-call-formatted outputs without establishing downstream execution. We identify three procedure-dependent response regimes -- Gradient-Permeable, Scale-Threshold, and Gradient-Fragmented -- and evaluate PPO-based weight-space exploration, which showed no statistically significant advantage over random search. For defense, Neural Sentinel combines weight-difference analysis, trigger discovery, activation probing, and contextual output inspection. In a 22-artifact development cohort, its reference-optional scanner classified 4/5 backdoored artifacts as BACKDOORED; the remaining positive and all 17 clean artifacts were SUSPICIOUS. These findings establish the feasibility of sparse conditional-output insertion and evidence-producing forensic triage, while identifying limitations in behavioral-drift assessment and clean-model admission.

translation.title: 开放权重 LLM 中的权重空间后门：跨架构攻击与盲模型取证
translation.abstract: 开放权重语言模型容易受到通过稀疏训练后权重修改植入的触发条件行为的影响，这带来了超出常规来源检查的供应链风险。我们提出 Neural Sentinel，一项涵盖 14 个架构家族（1.24 亿至 313 亿参数）18 个检查点（包括状态空间模型和循环模型）的跨架构梯度引导后门插入与模型取证研究。在 Phi-2 上，修改约 0.0002% 的参数即可在 300 步（332 秒）后诱导出精确的短标记输出，平均下一词元 KL 散度为 $1.5 \times 10^{-5}$，且在八个固定参考提示的评估位置上 top-1 一致率为 100%。单独的实验产生了结构化的工具调用格式输出，但未建立下游执行。我们识别出三种依赖流程的响应模式——Gradient-Permeable、Scale-Threshold 和 Gradient-Fragmented——并评估了基于 PPO 的权重空间探索，其相对随机搜索未显示出统计显著优势。在防御方面，Neural Sentinel 结合了权重差异分析、触发器发现、激活探测和上下文输出检查。在一个包含 22 个样本的开发队列中，其可选参考扫描器将 4/5 的后门样本分类为 BACKDOORED；剩余的阳性样本和全部 17 个干净样本被分类为 SUSPICIOUS。这些发现确立了稀疏条件输出植入的可行性以及产生证据的取证分流的可行性，同时指出了行为漂移评估和干净模型准入方面的局限。
translation.brief: 研究开放权重 LLM 通过稀疏权重修改植入触发后门的可行性，并提出结合权重差异分析、触发器发现与激活探测的取证防御方法 Neural Sentinel。

papers.title: WorldWeave: Rethinking Embodied Navigation through Cross-Task World Modeling
papers.abstract: Mobile embodied agents continuously alter their observations through their own motion, while external dynamics further shape future interactions. Different mobile embodied tasks therefore capture complementary patterns of state evolution, yet jointly learning world dynamics across such interactions remains less explored. We investigate this problem through Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) and Embodied Visual Tracking (EVT), which respectively involve navigation toward a stationary goal and interaction with a moving target. We propose WorldWeave, a cross-task world model that couples shared predictive dynamics with task-specific adaptation. Instead of conditioning state transitions on heterogeneous physical actions, WorldWeave learns latent actions from observed state changes via inverse-forward dynamics, establishing a shared transition representation across tasks. The resulting future-state predictions are adaptively integrated into task-specific representations for downstream decision making. Experiments across multiple VLN and EVT benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over specialized baselines.

translation.title: WorldWeave：通过跨任务世界建模重新思考具身导航
translation.abstract: 移动具身智能体通过自身运动不断改变其观测，而外部动态进一步塑造未来的交互。因此，不同的移动具身任务捕捉了互补的状态演化模式，但跨此类交互联合学习世界动态仍较少被探索。我们通过视觉语言导航（VLN）和具身视觉跟踪（EVT）研究这一问题，二者分别涉及向静止目标导航和与移动目标交互。我们提出 WorldWeave，一个将共享预测动态与任务特定适配相耦合的跨任务世界模型。WorldWeave 不以异构物理动作为条件进行状态转移，而是通过逆-前向动力学从观测到的状态变化中学习潜在动作，从而建立跨任务的共享转移表示。由此得到的未来状态预测被自适应地整合到任务特定表示中，用于下游决策。在多个 VLN 和 EVT 基准上的实验表明，其相对专用基线取得了一致的改进。
translation.brief: 针对 VLN 与 EVT 两类具身任务，提出通过逆-前向动力学学习潜在动作、共享预测动态并任务适配的跨任务世界模型 WorldWeave。

papers.title: From Reward Engineering to Data-Centric Reinforcement Learning for Effective Agentic Visual Tool Use
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly use external visual tools to acquire evidence during reasoning, yet learning when to invoke these tools remains challenging. Existing tool-use reinforcement learning (RL) methods often rely on call-contingent rewards to encourage beneficial tool use, but such reward engineering can distort the task objective and lead to degenerate calling behaviors. We argue that effective tool-use learning requires identifying not merely which questions are difficult, but which failures are attributable to missing visual evidence and can therefore be corrected through tool observations. We propose AOVO, a data-centric framework that enables MLLMs to learn effective tool use through perception attribution and policy-adaptive data sampling (PADS), without introducing tool-specific rewards. It counterfactually probes the model's reasoning states to identify observation-sensitive questions, distinguishing them from reasoning-dominated ones. PADS then periodically estimates category-level observation effects from recent policy rollouts and dynamically reallocates the training distribution toward questions where visual observations provide informative learning signals, while optimizing solely for final-answer correctness. Experiments across diverse visual perception and multimodal reasoning benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over competitive tool-use MLLMs, with causal analysis further validating the data-centric perspective for learning effective visual tool use.

translation.title: 从奖励工程到以数据为中心的强化学习：实现有效的智能体视觉工具使用
translation.abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）越来越多地在推理过程中使用外部视觉工具获取证据，但学习何时调用这些工具仍然具有挑战性。现有的工具使用强化学习（RL）方法通常依赖与调用挂钩的奖励来鼓励有益的工具使用，但这种奖励工程可能扭曲任务目标并导致退化的调用行为。我们认为，有效的工具使用学习不仅需要识别哪些问题困难，还需要识别哪些失败可归因于缺失的视觉证据、因而可以通过工具观测加以纠正。我们提出 AOVO，一个以数据为中心的框架，使 MLLM 通过感知归因和策略自适应数据采样（PADS）学习有效的工具使用，而无需引入工具特定奖励。该框架通过反事实探测模型的推理状态来识别对观测敏感的问题，将其与推理主导的问题区分开。PADS 随后定期从最近的策略 rollout 中估计类别级的观测效应，并动态地将训练分布重新分配到视觉观测能提供有效学习信号的问题上，同时仅针对最终答案的正确性进行优化。在多个视觉感知和多模态推理基准上的实验表明，其相对有竞争力的工具使用 MLLM 取得了一致的改进，因果分析进一步验证了学习有效视觉工具使用的以数据为中心的视角。
translation.brief: 针对 MLLM 视觉工具调用学习中的奖励工程失真问题，提出通过感知归因识别观测敏感问题并以策略自适应数据采样动态分配训练数据的以数据为中心框架 AOVO。

papers.title: Beyond Unit Tests: Path-Aware Rubric-Guided LLM Autograding of Notebooks
papers.abstract: Jupyter notebooks support open-ended, multi-step assessments in which students build one logical flow across interdependent steps, combining code, written analysis, and generated outputs such as plots. These reflect authentic scientific practice but are hard to grade consistently, since students may make different yet equally valid choices at each step, so a later answer can only be judged in light of the choices a student made earlier. We present an LLM-based autograder for such flow-structured notebook questions. It generates a rubric from a reference solution, then applies a softening pass that relaxes criteria tied to the reference so legitimate alternative paths are not penalized. Each question group is graded in a single model call, so later answers are judged against the student's own earlier choices, using question-type tags and schema-constrained, low-temperature outputs. Evidence is scored multimodally: code, text, numerical outputs, and figures from code cells. We deployed the tool in a machine-learning course, integrated with Gradescope, with a pre-submission format check and prompt-injection defenses, and evaluate it both in that live course and against archived submissions graded by staff in earlier terms. We report agreement, cross-model variance, cost, student perceptions, and injection resilience. With low-temperature models, agreement with human scores is often strong, including on the open-ended items the design specifically targets, while run-to-run stability depends sharply on the model's temperature support.

translation.title: 超越单元测试：面向 Notebook 的路径感知、评分标准引导的 LLM 自动评分
translation.abstract: Jupyter notebook 支持开放式的多步骤评估，学生在其中跨相互依赖的步骤构建一条逻辑流，结合代码、书面分析和生成的输出（如图表）。这些反映了真实的科学实践，但难以一致地评分，因为学生可能在每一步做出不同但同样有效的选择，因此后续答案只能结合学生之前的选择来评判。我们提出一个针对此类流结构 notebook 问题的基于 LLM 的自动评分器。它从参考解答生成评分标准，然后应用一个软化步骤，放宽与参考解答绑定的标准，以免惩罚合理的替代路径。每个问题组在单次模型调用中评分，因此后续答案会结合学生自己之前的选择来评判，并使用问题类型标签和模式约束、低温度输出。证据以多模态方式评分：代码、文本、数值输出和代码单元格生成的图表。我们将该工具部署在一门机器学习课程中，与 Gradescope 集成，包含提交前格式检查和提示注入防御，并在该实际课程以及与往期由教师评分的存档提交进行对比中评估它。我们报告了一致性、跨模型方差、成本、学生感知和注入韧性。使用低温度模型时，与人工评分的一致性通常很强，包括该设计专门针对的开放式题目，而运行间稳定性则很大程度上取决于模型对温度的支持。
translation.brief: 针对流结构 Jupyter notebook 难以一致评分的问题，提出从参考解答生成并软化评分标准、结合学生先前选择进行多模态证据评分的 LLM 自动评分器。

papers.title: EvoViM: Recursively Self-Evolving Visual Agents for Exploration with Deferred Queries
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language model (MLLM) agents have shown promising capabilities in task-oriented environments. However, they still struggle when queries are deferred until after exploration, requiring them to retain visual evidence before knowing which details will matter. We introduce EvoViM, a recursively self-evolving framework in which a frozen multimodal model turns its own interaction experience into one visual program for memory and skills. The program retains images and computes directly on pixels, and its operations decide how this evidence is used in each task. During memory evolution, the same model traces failures in its visual trajectories to the operations that lost or misused evidence and revises them. It also rewrites the notes and analysis tools that guide later revisions, which then build on earlier findings and skip changes that have already failed. We evaluate EvoViM with three multimodal models on six tasks covering visual matching, spatial recall, and sequential decision-making, including three tasks with deferred queries. Across the six tasks, EvoViM improves the average score over AutoMem, the strongest baseline in the main comparison, by 31.3-47.6 points on held-out episodes. Programs written once from the initial environment instructions perform substantially worse, highlighting the value of interaction experience in shaping how visual evidence is retained and used. Code and dataset are available at this https URL.

translation.title: EvoViM：面向延迟查询探索的递归自进化视觉智能体
translation.abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）智能体在任务导向环境中展现出可观的能力。然而，当查询被延迟到探索之后才给出时，它们仍然表现不佳，这要求它们在不知道哪些细节重要之前就保留视觉证据。我们提出 EvoViM，一个递归自进化框架，其中冻结的多模态模型将自身的交互经验转化为一个用于记忆和技能的视觉程序。该程序保留图像并直接在像素上进行计算，其操作决定这些证据在每个任务中如何被使用。在记忆进化过程中，同一模型追踪其视觉轨迹中的失败，定位到丢失或误用证据的操作并加以修订。它还会重写指导后续修订的笔记和分析工具，使后续修订建立在早期发现之上，并跳过已经失败过的更改。我们在六个任务上用三个多模态模型评估 EvoViM，涵盖视觉匹配、空间回忆和序列决策，其中包括三个延迟查询任务。在六个任务上，EvoViM 在留出回合上将平均得分较主对比中最强基线 AutoMem 提升 31.3-47.6 分。仅根据初始环境指令一次性编写的程序表现明显更差，凸显了交互经验在塑造视觉证据保留与使用方式上的价值。代码和数据集见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 解决延迟查询下智能体需在未知查询内容时保留视觉证据的问题，核心方法是让冻结多模态模型将交互经验递归自进化为可修订的视觉程序。

papers.title: CLASP: Deciding Structure and Claims Before Decoding for Whole-Slide Pathology Report Generation
papers.abstract: Whole-slide pathology report generation has advanced through stronger slide encoders, retrieved knowledge, and, recently, slide-level multimodal LLMs. However, these generators leave every report-level choice to the decoder: how long the report is, how it is organised, and which findings it states and where. On the standard PathText-BRCA benchmark, we find that these choices dominate n-gram overlap, as reports from the query's hospital selected without learning approach the state of the art, while decoders under-generate and fall back to the most frequent findings. We present CLASP, a decide-then-decode generator that makes these choices explicitly, once per slide. Before decoding, an Exemplar Structure Prior (ESP) takes the sentence plan and length from reports of image-similar cases, a Calibrated Claim Decision (CCD) selects the findings from calibrated slide posteriors, and a Claim-to-Sentence Placement (CSP) assigns each finding to a planned sentence. A Plan-Conditioned Decoder (PCD), refined by structure-anchored sequence training, then writes the report under these decisions. With 35M parameters, CLASP outperforms retrained report generators and slide-level LLMs of up to 7B parameters, matches the strongest published results, and generalises to lung cancer from unseen hospitals. Its decisions change what the reports state, not only their length, transfer to an LLM decoder, and can withhold what H&E cannot show: withholding receptor status leaves 23% fewer contradictions with clinical records than the same network without decisions.

translation.title: CLASP：在解码前决定结构与论断的全切片病理报告生成
translation.abstract: 全切片病理报告生成已通过更强的切片编码器、检索知识以及近期的切片级多模态 LLM 取得进展。然而，这些生成器把所有报告层面的选择都留给解码器：报告多长、如何组织、在何处陈述哪些发现。在标准 PathText-BRCA 基准上，我们发现这些选择主导了 n-gram 重叠度——未经学习、仅选取来自查询医院的历史报告即可接近最先进水平，而解码器则生成不足并退回到最常见发现。我们提出 CLASP，一个先决定后解码的生成器，对每张切片显式地一次性做出这些选择。在解码之前，示例结构先验（ESP）从图像相似病例的报告中获取句子计划和长度；校准论断决策（CCD）从校准的切片后验中选择发现；论断到句子放置（CSP）将每个发现分配到计划好的句子中。随后，经结构锚定序列训练精炼的计划条件解码器（PCD）在这些决策下撰写报告。仅 3500 万参数的 CLASP 超越了重新训练的报告生成器和高达 70 亿参数的切片级 LLM，匹配已发表的最强结果，并能泛化到来自未见医院的肺癌数据。其决策改变的是报告陈述的内容而不仅是长度，可迁移到 LLM 解码器，并能保留 H&E 无法显示的信息：保留受体状态判断可使与临床记录的矛盾比无决策的同一网络减少 23%。
translation.brief: 解决病理报告生成中报告级选择全交给解码器导致质量受限的问题，核心方法是在解码前显式决定结构、论断及其放置，再用计划条件解码器生成报告。

papers.title: Right Verdict, Right Reason? An Execution-Grounded Study of Whether LLM Vulnerability Detectors Understand Vulnerabilities
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to detect vulnerabilities, and their benchmark scores are often read as evidence that they understand the vulnerabilities they report. We test this reading against program execution. For 515 C and C++ functions from BigVul and PrimeVul whose vulnerability we reproduce with a proof of concept, we identify the line at which the fault occurs and the statements on which the faulting run depended. These facts ground a ladder of five tests, from telling a vulnerable function from its fixed version, through locating the fault and reacting to its removal, to judging execution-confirmed edits and predicting the outcome of a concrete run. Each test is paired with a baseline that needs no understanding, such as a rule that picks lines with risky calls, and we repeat the study on 195 vulnerabilities published after the training cutoffs of the models. Four findings emerge. First, telling a vulnerable function from its fixed version is hard. The open-weight models separate no more pairs than chance, although five of them show a weak sensitivity to the fix, and the commercial models still label many screened fixed versions vulnerable. Second, the commercial models locate the fault beyond a keyword rule, while removing that evidence changes the verdicts of the strongest model only on the newer vulnerabilities. Third, given the program input, the commercial models predict whether a run faults better than a rule that looks for added checks, and the prediction follows the input. Fourth, on the newer vulnerabilities this advantage disappears and the lead of the strongest model narrows, while localization persists. We release the framework, the per-function evidence, and an execution-confirmed counterfactual benchmark.

translation.title: 正确的判定，正确的理由？基于程序执行研究 LLM 漏洞检测器是否理解漏洞
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于检测漏洞，其基准分数常被解读为它们理解所报告漏洞的证据。我们用程序执行来检验这一解读。对于来自 BigVul 和 PrimeVul 的 515 个 C 和 C++ 函数（其漏洞我们已用概念验证复现），我们确定故障发生的行以及故障运行所依赖的语句。这些事实支撑起一个由五个测试构成的阶梯：从区分漏洞函数与其修复版本，到定位故障并对故障移除做出反应，再到判断经执行确认的编辑和预测具体运行的结果。每个测试都配有一个无需理解的基线，例如选择含风险调用语句的规则，并且我们在模型训练截止日期之后发布的 195 个漏洞上重复该研究。研究得出四项发现。第一，区分漏洞函数与其修复版本很难。开源权重模型区分的配对数不超过随机水平，尽管其中五个模型对修复表现出微弱敏感性，而商业模型仍将许多已筛查的修复版本标记为漏洞。第二，商业模型定位故障的能力超过关键词规则，但移除该证据只会改变最强模型在较新漏洞上的判定。第三，给定程序输入，商业模型预测某次运行是否出错的能力优于查找新增检查的规则，且预测随输入变化。第四，在较新漏洞上这一优势消失，最强模型的领先幅度缩小，而定位能力仍然保持。我们发布了该框架、逐函数证据以及一个经执行确认的反事实基准。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 漏洞检测器是否真正理解漏洞的评估问题，核心方法是基于程序执行事实构建五级测试阶梯并与无理解基线对比。

papers.title: Bridging Teacher-Student Capability Gaps with Recurrent Computation
papers.abstract: Knowledge distillation transfers capabilities from large language models to smaller students, yet stronger teachers do not always yield better students. Recent studies report diminishing or even negative returns from teacher scaling. We hypothesize that these limitations arise in part from insufficient student capacity to absorb the teacher's knowledge. We therefore investigate loop and recurrent computation as a way to expand the student's effective capacity by modifying its computation graph while keeping the backbone parameter count fixed. Under teacher-forced KD during pretraining, weight-shared looping improves performance but retains teacher-size saturation, whereas cross-token recurrence avoids the observed reversal with larger teachers. In mathematical post-training under both teacher-forced KD and on-policy distillation (OPD), recurrent students scale better with increasing teacher size than looped and vanilla LLMs do. Crucially, we show that a pretrained LLM can be readily fine-tuned into a looped or recurrent architecture jointly with OPD, without repeating pretraining. Our recurrent Qwen model improves with larger teachers and consistently outperforms looped and vanilla LLMs. This suggests a new post-training paradigm that integrates architectural conversion into distillation, avoiding a separate conversion stage while substantially improving student performance and maintaining near-vanilla inference latency.

translation.title: 用循环计算弥合师生能力差距
translation.abstract: 知识蒸馏将大语言模型的能力迁移到更小的学生模型，但更强的教师并不总能带来更好的学生。近期研究报道教师规模扩大带来收益递减甚至负收益。我们假设这些局限部分源于学生模型容量不足以吸收教师的知识。因此，我们研究循环（loop）和递归（recurrent）计算，通过修改学生模型的计算图同时保持骨干参数量不变，来扩展其有效容量。在预训练期间的教师强制 KD 下，权重共享的循环提升了性能但仍保留教师规模的饱和现象，而跨 token 递归则避免了更大教师带来的性能反转。在数学后训练中，无论教师强制 KD 还是 on-policy 蒸馏（OPD），递归学生随教师规模增大的扩展性都优于循环和普通 LLM。关键的是，我们证明预训练 LLM 可以在与 OPD 联合的微调中直接转换为循环或递归架构，而无需重复预训练。我们的递归 Qwen 模型随教师增大而提升，并持续优于循环和普通 LLM。这提示了一种新的后训练范式：将架构转换融入蒸馏，避免单独的转换阶段，同时显著提升学生性能并保持接近普通的推理延迟。
translation.brief: 解决知识蒸馏中学生容量不足导致强教师收益递减的问题，核心方法是通过循环/递归计算在不增加参数的情况下扩展学生有效容量。

papers.title: MADRec: Reliable Multi-Agent Reasoning with Evidence-Grounded Debate for Recommendation
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are transforming recommender systems from conventional preference matching toward reasoning-driven and explainable decision-making. Multi-agent collaboration further advances this paradigm by distributing recommendation reasoning across specialized agents. However, existing frameworks rarely assess the reliability of intermediate reasoning during collaboration, allowing erroneous judgments to propagate across agents and ultimately degrade recommendation quality. To address this issue, we propose Multi-Agent Debate-based Recommendation (MADRec), an evidence-grounded multi-agent framework that enhances the reliability of multi-agent recommendation reasoning. MADRec consists of three coordinated modules. First, the Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) module enables an Interaction Agent and a Semantic Agent to analyze interaction signals and content-level semantic signals from complementary perspectives, generating diverse recommendation judgments through structured debate. Second, the Evidence-Grounded Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning (EG-RAR) module grounds the Semantic Agent's reasoning in item-level evidence and refines candidate scores by assessing how well the evidence supports the corresponding semantic claims. Third, the Judge-based Ranking Calibration (JRC) module leverages debate-derived reliability cues to adaptively calibrate interaction-based and semantic ranking results for the final recommendation. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that MADRec consistently outperforms competitive baselines and enhances the reliability of multi-agent recommendation reasoning.

translation.title: MADRec：基于证据支撑辩论的可靠多智能体推荐推理
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正在将推荐系统从传统的偏好匹配转变为推理驱动、可解释的决策。多智能体协作通过将推荐推理分配给专门的智能体进一步推进了这一范式。然而，现有框架很少评估协作过程中间推理的可靠性，使错误判断在智能体间传播并最终降低推荐质量。为解决这一问题，我们提出基于多智能体辩论的推荐（MADRec），一个以证据为支撑的多智能体框架，用于增强多智能体推荐推理的可靠性。MADRec 由三个协同模块组成。首先，多智能体辩论（MAD）模块使交互智能体和语义智能体从互补视角分析交互信号和内容级语义信号，通过结构化辩论生成多样的推荐判断。其次，证据支撑的检索增强推理（EG-RAR）模块将语义智能体的推理锚定在条目级证据上，并通过评估证据对相应语义论断的支持程度来精炼候选分数。第三，基于裁判的排序校准（JRC）模块利用辩论产生的可靠性线索，自适应地校准基于交互和基于语义的排序结果以生成最终推荐。在三个真实数据集上的大量实验表明，MADRec 持续优于竞争基线，并增强了多智能体推荐推理的可靠性。
translation.brief: 解决多智能体推荐中中间推理错误传播的问题，核心方法是通过证据支撑的检索增强推理和基于裁判的排序校准来提升辩论推理的可靠性。

papers.title: BitShare: Sensitivity-Aware Binning and Bit Sharing for Compacting LLM Weight Storage
papers.abstract: Decoding with large language models at small batch sizes is limited by memory bandwidth, so the bits stored per weight largely set its cost. Group-wise integer quantization stores every weight of a group at the same precision, although the input channels of a group differ in sensitivity. We present BITSHARE, a codebook-free weight format that keeps the integer grid and the dequantizer of group-wise quantization but varies precision within each group. Sensitivity-aware binning places the channels of each group into three bins at fixed positions, and static bit sharing with optimal bit-value allocation lets the less sensitive weights share their lower bits, each stored once per group or once per pair of weights. A sharing-aware version of GPTQ chooses every stored value, with no fine-tuning and no codebook. BITSHARE has two modes. BITSHARE-U gives every group the same layout, so its decoder routes bits by fixed wiring, while BITSHARE-N chooses a layout per group within the same bit budget. With calibration on the Pile and at the same storage, both modes have lower perplexity than GPTQ at 3 and 2 bits on WikiText-2 and C4. At 2 bits across Llama-2 and Llama-3 models, BITSHARE-N lowers WikiText-2 perplexity by up to 70% against SliM-LLM and up to 35% against GPTAQ. At the 2-bit perplexity of SliM-LLM, BITSHARE-U stores 13.6-19.4% fewer bits per weight, cutting DRAM weight traffic by the same fraction. A verified hardware decoder implementation synthesized in SkyWater 130 nm reconstructs BITSHARE weights at the throughput of INT-n and SliM-LLM decoders.

translation.title: BitShare：面向 LLM 权重存储压缩的敏感度感知分箱与位共享方法
translation.abstract: 小批量下使用大语言模型解码受内存带宽限制，因此每个权重存储的位数在很大程度上决定了其成本。分组整数量化将一组内每个权重以相同精度存储，尽管组内各输入通道的敏感度不同。我们提出 BITSHARE，一种无需码本的权重格式，它保留分组量化的整数网格和反量化器，但在每组内部改变精度。敏感度感知分箱将每组通道按固定位置划分到三个箱中，静态位共享与最优位值分配让不太敏感的权重共享其低位，每位在每组存储一次或在每对权重间存储一次。一个共享感知版本的 GPTQ 选择每个存储值，无需微调，也无需码本。BITSHARE 有两种模式：BITSHARE-U 为每组使用相同布局，其解码器通过固定布线路由比特；BITSHARE-N 在相同位预算下为每组选择布局。在 Pile 上校准并在相同存储量下，两种模式在 WikiText-2 和 C4 上 3 比特和 2 比特的困惑度均低于 GPTQ。在 Llama-2 和 Llama-3 模型上的 2 比特设置中，BITSHARE-N 相比 SliM-LLM 最多降低 WikiText-2 困惑度 70%，相比 GPTAQ 最多降低 35%。在 SliM-LLM 的 2 比特困惑度水平下，BITSHARE-U 每权重少存储 13.6-19.4% 的比特，并按相同比例削减 DRAM 权重流量。一个在 SkyWater 130 nm 工艺综合的经过验证的硬件解码器实现，能以与 INT-n 和 SliM-LLM 解码器相同的吞吐量重建 BITSHARE 权重。
translation.brief: 解决小批量 LLM 推理中权重存储带宽开销大的问题，核心方法是在分组量化内按通道敏感度分箱并通过静态位共享实现组内变精度存储。

papers.title: Agent Money Benchmark: Can AI Agents Be Trusted to Spend Money?
papers.abstract: Giving an AI agent a wallet lets it buy data and services on a client's behalf. Trust then depends on how it spends money and what that spending achieves. We introduce Agent Money Benchmark (AMB) to test whether agents spend a client's money well, starting with purchases of information for financial decisions. We link seller quotes and payments to final answers, evaluating 12 models on 80 payment tasks with simulated sellers and 76 research questions using live data. Purchases settled in USDC on Solana mainnet via x402, a protocol for paying per web request. Three of the 12 models passed 79 of 80 payment tasks without payment or budget errors. Nine fell for a seller's trap at least once; repeat charges and above-list quotes accounted for 79% of scam events. We estimate waste from data and inference costs, counting failed payment tasks in full and research answers in proportion to missed points. With spending split equally between tracks, estimated waste ranged from \$21.0 per \$100 for Claude Fable 5.2 to \$70.8 for GPT-6 Luna.

translation.title: Agent Money Benchmark：AI 智能体花钱值得信任吗？
translation.abstract: 给 AI 智能体一个钱包，让它代表客户购买数据和服务。信任取决于它如何花钱以及花钱取得了什么成果。我们提出 Agent Money Benchmark（AMB），测试智能体是否能善用客户的资金，首先从为金融决策购买信息开始。我们将卖方报价和付款与最终答案关联起来，在 80 个使用模拟卖方的支付任务和 76 个使用实时数据的研究问题上评估 12 个模型。购买通过 x402（一种按 Web 请求付费的协议）在 Solana 主网上以 USDC 结算。12 个模型中有 3 个通过了 80 个支付任务中的 79 个，没有支付或预算错误。九个模型至少上过一次卖方的当；重复扣费和高于标价的报价占诈骗事件的 79%。我们根据数据和推理成本估算浪费，失败的支付任务全额计入，研究答案按失分比例计入。在两条赛道支出均分的情况下，估计浪费从 Claude Fable 5.2 的每 100 美元 21.0 美元到 GPT-6 Luna 的 70.8 美元不等。
translation.brief: 解决评估 AI 智能体能否可信地替客户花钱的问题，核心方法是构建包含真实链上支付（Solana/USDC、x402）的基准，将购买行为与最终答案质量关联来衡量浪费。

papers.title: Action-Conditioned Transition Irreversibility for Out-of-Distribution Detection in Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement-learning agents shape the observations they encounter; consequently, detecting out-of-distribution (OOD) states requires analysing action-conditioned trajectories rather than treating inputs as independent samples. We propose Action-Conditioned Transition Irreversibility (ACTI), a detector that evaluates forward and backward transition likelihoods, calibrates this comparison against the in-distribution profile at each timestep, and smooths the score over a short window, using no future information. We tested ACTI across six environments and fifteen detectors within OOD-RL-Bench, using the four anomaly mechanisms that qualified in every environment, with ten policy replicates per environment. All primary metrics are matched-time: each score after anomaly onset is compared with a clean twin rollout's score at the same timestep. Our method secured the top macro matched-time AUROC, outperforming the dynamics-model baseline (PEDM), while scoring transitions roughly two orders of magnitude faster. Compared to the state-only variant, ACTI achieved a small but consistent AUROC gain and a shorter detection delay. The capacity-matched forward-only baseline, ACTI-Forward, secured a statistically significant advantage in AUPRC alongside a reduced detection delay. The discrepancy in AUROC did not reach statistical significance. Ablation studies suggest instead that performance improvements stem from action conditioning, calibration at each timestep, and smoothing of the transition-likelihood scores. Based on these results, we recommend using ACTI-Forward.

translation.title: 用于强化学习分布外检测的动作条件转移不可逆性
translation.abstract: 强化学习智能体会塑造其遇到的观测；因此，检测分布外（OOD）状态需要分析动作条件下的轨迹，而不是将输入视为独立样本。我们提出动作条件转移不可逆性（ACTI），一种评估前向和后向转移似然的检测器，它在每个时间步根据分布内特征校准该比较，并在短窗口上平滑分数，不使用任何未来信息。我们在 OOD-RL-Bench 的六个环境和十五个检测器上测试了 ACTI，使用在每个环境中都合格的四种异常机制，每个环境十个策略副本。所有主要指标均为匹配时间：异常发生后的每个分数都与同一时间步干净孪生 rollout 的分数进行比较。我们的方法取得了最高的宏平均匹配时间 AUROC，优于动力学模型基线（PEDM），同时转移评分速度快约两个数量级。与仅状态变体相比，ACTI 取得了小幅但一致的 AUROC 提升和更短的检测延迟。容量匹配的仅前向基线 ACTI-Forward 在 AUPRC 上取得了统计显著的优势，并缩短了检测延迟；AUROC 上的差异未达到统计显著性。消融研究表明，性能提升源于动作条件化、每个时间步的校准以及转移似然分数的平滑。基于这些结果，我们推荐使用 ACTI-Forward。
translation.brief: 解决强化学习中 OOD 状态检测问题，核心方法是通过动作条件下的前向与后向转移似然比较并逐时间步校准、平滑来构造检测分数。

papers.title: Internalized Experience: How Training Data Shapes Memory Formation in LLMs
papers.abstract: Parametric memory enables large language models (LLMs) to retain information from past experience and reuse it in subsequent tasks. Yet how training data supports the internalization of reusable task rules remains unclear. We introduce FSMem (Finite-State Machine Memory), a state-transition framework for constructing training data and studying how data content and organization shape memory formation. We evaluate rule reuse across synthetic worlds, classical planning, and code execution through valid-action identification and execution-outcome prediction, complemented by next-operation prediction in code. Our experiments reveal several systematic learning patterns. Under matched training conditions, even unchanged task rules become harder to internalize when learned alongside a larger variety of action types; by contrast, scaling the training data to provide broader state-action coverage generally improves rule learning. We further find that training at a single execution depth produces depth-specialized behavior, with models performing best when training and test executions have similar lengths. Motivated by this finding, we construct cumulative corpora that combine short and long trajectories, which can outperform long-trajectory-only training while using fewer training tokens. Together, these results demonstrate that the same task rules can be internalized differently depending on how execution experience is constructed, and that understanding these learning patterns can guide the design of more effective training data for parametric memory.

translation.title: 内化经验：训练数据如何塑造 LLM 的记忆形成
translation.abstract: 参数化记忆使大语言模型（LLM）能够保留过去经验的信息并在后续任务中复用。然而，训练数据如何支持可复用任务规则的内化仍不清楚。我们提出 FSMem（有限状态机记忆），一个用于构建训练数据并研究数据内容与组织如何塑造记忆形成的状态转移框架。我们通过有效动作识别和执行结果预测，以及代码中的下一步操作预测，在合成世界、经典规划和代码执行上评估规则复用。实验揭示了若干系统性学习模式。在匹配的训练条件下，即使任务规则不变，当与更多样的动作类型一起学习时也变得更难内化；相反，扩展训练数据以提供更广的状态-动作覆盖通常会改善规则学习。我们进一步发现，在单一执行深度上训练会产生深度特化行为，模型在训练与测试执行长度相近时表现最佳。受此发现启发，我们构建了结合短轨迹和长轨迹的累积语料库，在使用更少训练 token 的同时可以超越仅用长轨迹的训练。这些结果表明，同一任务规则会因执行经验的构建方式不同而被不同地内化，理解这些学习模式可以指导为参数化记忆设计更有效的训练数据。
translation.brief: 解决训练数据如何影响 LLM 参数化记忆中任务规则内化的问题，核心方法是构建基于有限状态机的状态转移训练数据框架并系统分析数据内容与组织方式的影响。

papers.title: VeriLadder: A Multi-Agent Specification Refinement System for Tool-Verified Verilog Datasets
papers.abstract: Training data is a bottleneck in AI, especially for large language models (LLMs) that write Verilog, because register-transfer-level (RTL) code is rarely published and existing datasets mostly check code for syntax, not instruction correctness. This paper presents VeriLadder, a five-level Verilog dataset, and the multi-agent framework that builds it, in which LLM agents write and revise specifications, and EDA tools (a synthesizer and a formal equivalence checker) decide what is accepted. Its levels follow an engineer's checks. Level 1 labels designs from two large Verilog corpora, namely RTLCoder and PyraNet, with synthesis results, failure causes, critical warnings and post-synthesis metrics. 28% of RTLCoder designs fail synthesis and are kept as negatives. Level 2 grades each instruction on four specification qualities, and low grades predict failed rebuilds. Level 3 rewrites each instruction into a refined specification and accepts it only if an LLM from another model family, reading only that specification, writes a circuit formally equivalent to the original. This raises the share of rebuildable designs from 26.1% to 78.2%, keeping every failed specification with its counterexample. Levels 4 and 5 add verified paraphrases and one-fact variants, hard negatives that differ only in one behavior from the verified design. VeriLadder labels the synthesizability of 716,627 designs and, from RTLCoder, provides 11,247 refined specifications, 32,393 paraphrases and 8,397 one-fact variants. Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct on VeriLadder raises functional pass@1 from 31.7% to 50.0% on VerilogEval v2 and from 35.0% to 45.2% on RTLLM v2. The dataset and fine-tuned models are publicly available.

translation.title: VeriLadder：用于工具验证 Verilog 数据集的多智能体规格精化系统
translation.abstract: 训练数据是 AI 的瓶颈，对于编写 Verilog 的大语言模型（LLM）尤其如此，因为寄存器传输级（RTL）代码很少公开发表，且现有数据集大多只检查代码语法而非指令正确性。本文提出 VeriLadder，一个五级 Verilog 数据集，以及构建它的多智能体框架，其中 LLM 智能体编写和修订规格，EDA 工具（综合器和形式等价性检查器）决定接受什么。其级别遵循工程师的检查流程。Level 1 为来自两个大型 Verilog 语料库（RTLCoder 和 PyraNet）的设计标注综合结果、失败原因、关键警告和综合后指标。RTLCoder 中 28% 的设计综合失败，被保留为负样本。Level 2 从四个规格质量维度为每条指令评分，低分可预测重建失败。Level 3 将每条指令改写为精化规格，只有当另一个模型家族的 LLM 仅阅读该规格就能写出与原电路形式等价的电路时才接受。这将可重建设计的比例从 26.1% 提高到 78.2%，并保留每个失败规格及其反例。Level 4 和 Level 5 添加了经验证的改写和单事实变体——与已验证设计仅在一个行为上不同的困难负样本。VeriLadder 为 716,627 个设计标注了可综合性，并从 RTLCoder 提供 11,247 个精化规格、32,393 个改写和 8,397 个单事实变体。在 VeriLadder 上微调 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct，使 VerilogEval v2 上的功能 pass@1 从 31.7% 提升到 50.0%，RTLLM v2 上从 35.0% 提升到 45.2%。数据集和微调模型已公开。
translation.brief: 解决 Verilog 训练数据缺乏且指令正确性验证不足的问题，核心方法是用多智能体编写与修订规格并以综合器和形式等价性检查等 EDA 工具验证来构建五级数据集。

papers.title: Distilling Visual Agents from Limited Interaction Experience
papers.abstract: How much interaction experience is needed to distill a capable visual agent? We study learning from few tasks and recorded interaction histories. Our framework selects representative trajectories using skill-context coverage and ordered visual-decision similarity. On-policy distillation (OPD) learns through fresh interaction on selected tasks or fresh student responses at fixed histories. Across Navigation, Sokoban, and spatial mapping, even one online training task supports transfer to other tasks. Four fixed trajectories raise a 4B student's success from 49.17% to 82.08% on standard Navigation and from 60.16% to 85.55% on Sokoban, recovering over 90% of the measured gap to a 27B teacher on these panels. On an independent Navigation panel, replay improves success from 45.83% to 76.67%, retaining 91.36% of the same-task online gain without new interaction during optimization. Training repetitions, matched supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and a 9B extension further support the value of compact experience.

translation.title: 从有限交互经验中蒸馏视觉智能体
translation.abstract: 需要多少交互经验才能蒸馏出一个能力强的视觉智能体？我们研究了从少量任务和记录的交互历史中学习。我们的框架使用技能-上下文覆盖度和有序视觉决策相似度来选择代表性轨迹。在策略蒸馏（OPD）通过在选定任务上进行新鲜交互，或在固定历史上生成新鲜的学生响应来学习。在Navigation、Sokoban和空间映射任务上，即使只有一个在线训练任务也能支持向其他任务的迁移。四条固定轨迹将4B学生模型在标准Navigation上的成功率从49.17%提升到82.08%，在Sokoban上从60.16%提升到85.55%，在这些测试集上恢复了与27B教师模型之间测量差距的90%以上。在一个独立的Navigation测试集上，回放将成功率从45.83%提升到76.67%，在优化期间无需新交互的情况下保留了同任务在线增益的91.36%。训练重复次数、匹配的监督微调（SFT）以及9B扩展进一步支持了紧凑经验的价值。
translation.brief: 研究如何用极少量任务和交互历史蒸馏出强视觉智能体，核心方法是基于技能-上下文覆盖度与视觉决策相似度选择代表性轨迹并进行在策略蒸馏（OPD）。

papers.title: IndexerStage: Staging Indexer-K across Memory Tiers for Sparse-Attention LLM Serving
papers.abstract: Long-context sparse-attention serving can remain limited by graphics processing unit (GPU) memory after attention data is offloaded. DeepSeek Sparse Attention retains Indexer-K state to select the tokens that attention will read. Its indexer scans this growing state in full at every layer and decode step. A full scan requires the current layer's state, however, not simultaneous residency of every layer. We present IndexerStage, a serving runtime that externalizes Indexer-K state while preserving native GPU score, top-k, and attention kernels. It stages completed pages through shared execution buffers and preserves new entries locally. Joint memory-and-transfer admission checks storage and each layer's transfer demand before accepting a growing batch. The backing tier gathers pages; the model-serving GPU controls transfer timing and byte budgets. We implement IndexerStage in SGLang on 16 model-serving and 16 backing H800 GPUs. Across 16K--64K inputs, local streaming storage occupies 0.65--0.70 GiB per model-serving GPU. Relative to host-memory-backed HiSparse, batch size increases by 12.28--23.08% and decode throughput in tokens per second (TPS) reaches 1.08--1.14x. At 64K with the latent-KV backing path fixed, the larger batch achieves 1.10x decode TPS; enabling streaming at batch size 24 adds 2.42% to time per output token. Mixed-length dynamic serving increases mean generating batch size by 12.07% and delivers 1.31x decode TPS.

translation.title: IndexerStage：面向稀疏注意力LLM服务的跨内存层级Indexer-K分级
translation.abstract: 长上下文稀疏注意力服务在注意力数据被卸载后仍可能受GPU内存限制。DeepSeek Sparse Attention保留Indexer-K状态以选择注意力将要读取的token。其索引器在每一层和每个解码步骤都要完整扫描这个不断增长的状态。然而，完整扫描只需要当前层的状态，而不需要所有层同时驻留。我们提出IndexerStage，一个在保留原生GPU score、top-k和注意力内核的同时将Indexer-K状态外部化的服务运行时。它通过共享执行缓冲区分级存放已完成的页面，并在本地保留新条目。联合内存与传输准入检查在接受不断增长的批次之前检查存储和每层的传输需求。后端层级收集页面；模型服务GPU控制传输时机和字节预算。我们在SGLang中于16个模型服务GPU和16个后端H800 GPU上实现了IndexerStage。在16K至64K输入下，本地流式存储每个模型服务GPU占用0.65至0.70 GiB。相对于基于主机内存的HiSparse，批次大小增加12.28%至23.08%，每秒token数（TPS）的解码吞吐量达到1.08至1.14倍。在64K且latent-KV后端路径固定的情况下，更大的批次实现1.10倍解码TPS；在批次大小24时启用流式处理使每个输出token的时间增加2.42%。混合长度动态服务使平均生成批次大小增加12.07%，并提供1.31倍解码TPS。
translation.brief: 解决稀疏注意力LLM服务中Indexer-K状态占用GPU内存的问题，核心方法是将该状态分级外部化到后端存储层级并配合内存与传输联合准入控制。

papers.title: Nearly Minimax-Optimal Sample Complexity of Natural Policy Gradient with a Matching Information-Theoretic Lower Bound
papers.abstract: A fundamental question in reinforcement learning is how many sampled transitions are needed to learn a near-optimal policy, and whether direct policy optimization can attain this statistical limit. To answer this question, we consider natural policy gradient (NPG), a widely used policy optimization method. We study tabular finite-horizon Markov decision processes (MDPs) with known rewards and unknown horizon-dependent transition kernels, accessed through a generative model. Our sample-based NPG algorithms update the policy by backward sweeps and do not estimate transition probabilities. Under three different batch-size and step size schedules, we establish last-iterate guarantees with sample complexity $\widetilde O(SAH^4/\varepsilon^2)$, where $S$, $A$, and $H$ denote the number of states, the number of actions, and the horizon length, respectively. In this setting, horizon-dependent transition kernels contribute a factor of $H$ to our transition-query bound. Our information-theoretic lower bound of $\Omega(SAH^4/\varepsilon^2)$ shows that the resulting $H^4$ dependence is unavoidable in the worst case, even for agents that select their queries adaptively. To the best of our knowledge, these are the first last-iterate guarantees for NPG whose sample complexity matches an information-theoretic lower bound up to logarithmic factors. Consequently, our results demonstrate that direct policy-space optimization through NPG can achieve the fundamental statistical limits of reinforcement learning while guaranteeing the performance of the final policy. Furthermore, for known kernels, we prove that exact NPG with a constant step size $\eta=1/H$ requires $\Omega(H^2/\varepsilon)$ iterations in the worst case, matching the known upper bound for that step size.

translation.title: 自然策略梯度的近极小极大最优样本复杂度及匹配的信息论下界
translation.abstract: 强化学习中的一个基本问题是学习一个近优策略需要多少采样转移，以及直接策略优化能否达到这一统计极限。为回答这个问题，我们考虑自然策略梯度（NPG），一种广泛使用的策略优化方法。我们研究表格型有限时域马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），其中奖励已知而依赖时域的转移核未知，通过生成模型访问。我们基于样本的NPG算法通过反向扫描更新策略，且不估计转移概率。在三种不同的批次大小和步长调度下，我们建立了最后迭代保证，样本复杂度为$\widetilde O(SAH^4/\varepsilon^2)$，其中$S$、$A$和$H$分别表示状态数、动作数和时域长度。在此设定下，依赖时域的转移核为我们的转移查询界贡献了一个$H$因子。我们的信息论下界$\Omega(SAH^4/\varepsilon^2)$表明，即使在智能体自适应选择查询的情况下，$H^4$依赖在最坏情况下也不可避免。据我们所知，这些是NPG的首批样本复杂度在忽略对数因子后与信息论下界匹配的最后迭代保证。因此，我们的结果表明，通过NPG进行的直接策略空间优化可以在保证最终策略性能的同时达到强化学习的基本统计极限。此外，对于已知转移核，我们证明采用常数步长$\eta=1/H$的精确NPG在最坏情况下需要$\Omega(H^2/\varepsilon)$次迭代，与该步长下已知的上界匹配。
translation.brief: 研究NPG在表格型有限时域MDP中学习近优策略所需的样本复杂度，核心方法是基于反向扫描的样本NPG算法并给出匹配的信息论下界。

papers.title: LoopSeek: Decoupling System One Search from System Two Answering for Long Video Understanding
papers.abstract: Long video question answering requires finding relevant evidence before reasoning over it. With a limited frame budget, single-pass frame selection can miss critical evidence, while adaptive search often relies on repeated text generation to decide where to look. We introduce LoopSeek, a framework that decouples evidence search from answer generation through a division of labor between a non-thinking System I and a generative System II. Our key insight is that search can be expressed as a sequence of small, typed decisions, allowing System I to find the evidence that System II needs. Four System I role agents navigate a tree of video windows and coordinate through probability outputs to select frames, assess evidence, and revise the search without generating text. To align search with System II, System I learns from annotated evidence on questions that System II answers correctly only from that evidence, and the verifier's evidence estimates steer the search without calling System II, which stays frozen and answers once from the selected frames. On five long-video benchmarks, with a frozen Qwen3-VL-8B reading 32 frames, LoopSeek improves average accuracy from 53.5 to 63.9 over the uniform baseline and takes 32--80\% less GPU time per question than agentic methods.

translation.title: LoopSeek：面向长视频理解的系统一搜索与系统二回答解耦
translation.abstract: 长视频问答需要先找到相关证据再对其进行推理。在有限的帧预算下，单次帧选择可能遗漏关键证据，而自适应搜索通常依赖重复的文本生成来决定查找位置。我们提出LoopSeek，一个通过非思考的系统一和生成式系统二之间的分工将证据搜索与答案生成解耦的框架。我们的关键洞察是，搜索可以表示为一系列小型、类型化的决策，使系统一能够找到系统二所需的证据。四个系统一角色智能体在视频窗口树中导航，并通过概率输出进行协调，以选择帧、评估证据和修订搜索，而无需生成文本。为了使搜索与系统二对齐，系统一从标注证据中学习，这些问题是系统二仅凭该证据才能正确回答的；验证器的证据估计引导搜索而无需调用系统二，系统二保持冻结并仅从选定的帧回答一次。在五个长视频基准上，使用读取32帧的冻结Qwen3-VL-8B，LoopSeek将平均准确率从均匀基线的53.5提升到63.9，且每个问题的GPU时间比智能体方法少32%至80%。
translation.brief: 解决长视频问答中有限帧预算下证据搜索低效的问题，核心方法是用非思考的系统一角色智能体通过类型化概率决策进行树状搜索，与冻结的系统二回答解耦。

papers.title: Aegis: A Conversational Prototype for Lung Cancer Risk Information and Follow-up
papers.abstract: Collecting self-reported risk information and maintaining continuity between assessment, explanation, and follow-up are practical components of a lung cancer screening workflow. We present Aegis, a browser-based research prototype that combines a conversational questionnaire, rule-based risk categorization, downloadable reports, retrieval-augmented health information, and doctor-user communication. A session-oriented controller manages question progression and clarification, while a language model assists with answer validation. Structured responses are passed to a separate risk-analysis module, and reports are linked to user and session records through Firebase services. The project adopts a multi-agent design that separates information collection, validation, assessment, and report generation. Its documented verification scope comprises 45 functional test specifications covering account management, questionnaire interaction, reporting, doctor-side review, and consultation. The available evaluation describes workflow behavior qualitatively; it provides no per-case execution results, clinical cohort, predictive-performance measurements, or comparative experiments. We therefore present Aegis as an engineering prototype for organizing risk information and follow-up, with clinical validity and the benefits of its agent-based design remaining unestablished. The paper describes the implementation, distinguishes implemented workflows from incomplete extensions, and identifies the evidence required for reproducible and clinically meaningful evaluation.

translation.title: Aegis：肺癌风险信息与随访的对话式原型
translation.abstract: 收集自报风险信息并保持评估、解释和随访之间的连续性是肺癌筛查工作流的实际组成部分。我们提出Aegis，一个基于浏览器的研究原型，结合了对话式问卷、基于规则的风险分类、可下载报告、检索增强的健康信息和医生-用户沟通。面向会话的控制器管理问题推进和澄清，而语言模型协助答案验证。结构化响应被传递给独立的风险分析模块，报告通过Firebase服务与用户和会话记录关联。该项目采用多智能体设计，将信息收集、验证、评估和报告生成分离。其记录的验证范围包括45个功能测试规范，涵盖账户管理、问卷交互、报告、医生端审查和咨询。现有评估对工作流行为进行了定性描述；它不提供逐案例的执行结果、临床队列、预测性能测量或对比实验。因此，我们将Aegis作为组织风险信息和随访的工程原型提出，其临床有效性和基于智能体设计的益处尚未确立。本文描述了实现，区分了已实现的工作流与未完成的扩展，并指出了可复现且具有临床意义评估所需的证据。
translation.brief: 解决肺癌筛查中风险信息收集与随访连续性问题，核心方法是构建结合对话式问卷、规则风险分类和多智能体分工的浏览器原型系统。

papers.title: PROSPER: LLMs as Sparse Retrievers for First-Stage Product Search
papers.abstract: Product search is a crucial component of large-scale e-commerce platforms, where first-stage retrieval should achieve high recall while ensuring efficient online deployment. Sparse retrieval remains attractive for this setting due to its interpretability and deployability, yet it suffers from severe vocabulary mismatch challenges, especially for short queries and product titles. Large language models (LLMs) offer strong semantic capabilities, but directly applying them to sparse retrieval in product search introduces new challenges: (i) semantic expansion may distort critical literal signals such as brand names and model identifiers; and (ii) learning meaningful sparse representations is difficult in the high-dimensional vocabulary space induced by this http URL address these challenges, we propose PROSPER, a framework that uses LLMs as sparse retrievers for product search while explicitly preserving lexical fidelity. PROSPER combines (i) a literal residual network that alleviates lexical expansion hallucination by reinforcing underweighted literal terms through a residual compensation mechanism; and (ii) a lexical focusing window that uses top-k selection for rapid early sparsification and effective training initialization. Extensive offline evaluations and large-scale online A/B tests demonstrate that PROSPER consistently improves over existing sparse retrievers, and provides revenue gains for industrial hybrid retrieval systems.

translation.title: PROSPER：将LLM用作第一阶段商品搜索的稀疏检索器
translation.abstract: 商品搜索是大规模电商平台的关键组成部分，其第一阶段检索需要在保证高效在线部署的同时实现高召回率。稀疏检索因其可解释性和易部署性在此场景中仍具吸引力，但面临严重的词汇不匹配问题，尤其是短查询和商品标题场景。大语言模型（LLM）具备强大的语义能力，但直接将其应用于商品搜索的稀疏检索会带来新的挑战：(i) 语义扩展可能扭曲品牌名称和型号标识等关键的字面信号；(ii) 在由此 http URL 引出的高维词表空间中学习有意义的稀疏表示十分困难。为应对这些挑战，我们提出PROSPER，一个将LLM用作商品搜索稀疏检索器同时显式保持词汇忠实性的框架。PROSPER结合了：(i) 字面残差网络，通过残差补偿机制强化权重不足的字面词，缓解词汇扩展幻觉；(ii) 词汇聚焦窗口，利用top-k选择实现快速早期稀疏化和有效的训练初始化。大量离线评估和大规模在线A/B测试表明，PROSPER持续优于现有稀疏检索器，并为工业混合检索系统带来收入提升。
translation.brief: 针对LLM稀疏检索在商品搜索中扭曲字面信号和难以学习稀疏表示的问题，提出结合字面残差网络与词汇聚焦窗口的PROSPER框架。

papers.title: S-Mind: Internalizing Multi-View Geometry for Spatial Intelligence
papers.abstract: Spatial intelligence, the ability to reason about 3D space from visual observations, becomes essential as multimodal large language models (MLLMs) move into the physical world. Beyond perceiving each view, it rests on two cornerstones of human cognition: fusing multiple views into one coherent 3D scene and mentally transforming that scene to new viewpoints as reasoning unfolds. Yet our spatial probes reveal that MLLMs largely lack both capabilities, even after spatial fine-tuning. We therefore present S-Mind, which internalizes multi-view geometry within the MLLM through a compact set of spatial tokens. It supervises these tokens to hold the fused 3D scene and re-emits them to re-express this scene from every viewpoint the reasoning adopts. Across four spatial benchmarks, S-Mind improves its Qwen3.5 backbones by up to 22.26 points and surpasses frontier general models such as GPT-6-Astra (+0.45), Kimi-K3.1-Pro (+1.97), and GLM-5.3-Flash (+7.80) in average accuracy. Moreover, the same probes confirm that it acquires both capabilities, reaching fusion and transformation accuracies of 65.11% and 82.17%, against at most 16.02% and 37.28% for the baselines. At inference, S-Mind also runs about 100x faster than a tool-based agent on the same backbone. Instilled through these spatial tokens during training, spatial capability becomes intrinsic to the backbone and persists even when the tokens are withheld, offering a promising path toward spatial intelligence in MLLMs.

translation.title: S-Mind：内化多视图几何以实现空间智能
translation.abstract: 空间智能，即从视觉观察中对3D空间进行推理的能力，随着多模态大语言模型（MLLM）走向物理世界而变得至关重要。除了感知每个视图之外，它还依赖于人类认知的两大基石：将多个视图融合为一个连贯的3D场景，以及在推理过程中将该场景在心理上变换到新的视点。然而我们的空间探针测试显示，MLLM在很大程度上缺乏这两种能力，即使经过空间微调也是如此。因此我们提出S-Mind，通过一组紧凑的空间token在MLLM内部内化多视图几何。它监督这些token持有融合后的3D场景，并重新发射它们以从推理所采用的每个视点重新表达该场景。在四个空间基准上，S-Mind将其Qwen3.5骨干模型提升最多22.26分，平均准确率超过GPT-6-Astra（+0.45）、Kimi-K3.1-Pro（+1.97）和GLM-5.3-Flash（+7.80）等前沿通用模型。此外，同样的探针测试证实它获得了两种能力，融合和变换准确率分别达到65.11%和82.17%，而基线最高仅为16.02%和37.28%。在推理时，S-Mind在同一骨干上比基于工具的智能体快约100倍。通过这些空间token在训练中灌输的空间能力成为骨干模型的内在能力，即使在移除token后依然保持，为MLLM的空间智能提供了一条有前景的路径。
translation.brief: 针对MLLM缺乏多视图融合与视角变换能力的问题，提出通过空间token在模型内部内化多视图几何的S-Mind方法。

papers.title: Persuasion from Within: Model-Based Insider Attacks in Multi-Agent LLM Debate and Consensus
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems for collective decision-making, such as multi-agent debate and consensus games, in which agents exchange messages and update their answers over multiple rounds and a resolution mechanism aggregates them into a final outcome. Most multi-agent LLM frameworks assume that every participant shares the system objective. In practice, however, a malicious agent can join as a legitimate member of the group and persuade the other agents toward a hidden adversarial goal. We formalize such attacks as a sequential decision-making problem in which the insider seeks to degrade the utility of the collective outcome. We propose a model-based insider attack that learns to persuade a group of agents: the insider first learns a world model of the benign agents from offline trajectories and then uses it both to train a persuasion policy and to plan its messages. In two case studies involving a numerical consensus game and a multi-agent debate, the learned insider is the most effective and the stealthiest attack we evaluate, outperforming both prompt-based and trained LLM persuaders from prior work. The attack also transfers to other target models, larger groups, and unseen datasets, and remains effective under existing Byzantine-resilience defenses. The learned insider also enables a new defense: adversarially training benign agents on the attack data largely removes both our attack and the strongest prior persuasion attack. These results show that combining world models with reinforcement learning and planning is an effective route to both attacking and hardening language-based multi-agent systems.

translation.title: 来自内部的说服：多智能体LLM辩论与共识中的基于模型的内鬼攻击
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被部署于多智能体系统中进行集体决策，例如多智能体辩论和共识博弈，其中智能体在多轮中交换消息并更新答案，由决议机制将它们聚合为最终结果。大多数多智能体LLM框架假设所有参与者共享系统目标。然而在实践中，恶意智能体可以作为合法成员加入群体，并说服其他智能体朝向隐藏的对抗目标。我们将此类攻击形式化为一个序贯决策问题，其中内鬼试图降低集体结果的效用。我们提出一种基于模型的内鬼攻击，学习说服一组智能体：内鬼首先从离线轨迹中学习良性智能体的世界模型，然后利用该世界模型训练说服策略并规划其消息。在涉及数值共识博弈和多智能体辩论的两个案例研究中，学习到的内鬼是我们评估中最有效、最隐蔽的攻击，优于以往工作的基于提示和经过训练的LLM说服者。该攻击还能迁移到其他目标模型、更大群体和未见数据集，并在现有拜占庭容错防御下依然有效。学习到的内鬼还催生了一种新防御：在攻击数据上对良性智能体进行对抗训练，基本消除了我们的攻击和最强的既有说服攻击。这些结果表明，将世界模型与强化学习和规划相结合，是攻击和加固基于语言的多智能体系统的有效途径。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体LLM系统中恶意内鬼说服问题，提出先学习良性智能体世界模型、再据此训练说服策略并进行规划的基于模型的攻击方法。

papers.title: RecallWorld: Episodic Memory for Persistent Embodied Video World Models
papers.abstract: Video world models generate plausible novel views but often lack persistent memory, failing to preserve a place's geometry and appearance when an agent revisits a scene. A central challenge is how previous views should be effectively used for creating memory. Reconstructing them independently underutilizes geometric constraints between nearby views, while repeatedly reconstructing a growing history can propagate later prediction errors into earlier geometry. We introduce RecallWorld, a persistent embodied video world model that jointly reconstructs short multi-view episodes into Scenelets while keeping geometry independent across episodes. Starting from a single source image, camera-aware ray lifting places perspective and native fisheye images in a common world frame, retaining wide-field content for perspective generation. Each generated segment extends the Scenelet memory and conditions subsequent generation. Coverage-based retrieval selects complementary Scenelets from the full history, while target-view visibility is resolved geometrically before appearance fusion, providing consistent memory conditioning for guiding subsequent generation. Across four datasets, RecallWorld improves revisit PSNR over the strongest evaluated baseline by 2.6 dB on partial revisits and 3.9 dB on full cycles, demonstrating substantially stronger preservation of scene identity across exploration and return.

translation.title: RecallWorld：面向持久具身视频世界模型的情景记忆
translation.abstract: 视频世界模型能够生成合理的新视角，但往往缺乏持久记忆，当智能体重访场景时无法保留该地点的几何和外观。一个核心挑战是如何有效利用先前视图来构建记忆。独立重建它们无法充分利用邻近视图之间的几何约束，而反复重建不断增长的历史会将后期的预测误差传播到早期几何中。我们提出RecallWorld，一个持久的具身视频世界模型，它将短的多视图情景联合重建为Scenelet，同时保持各情景之间几何的独立性。从单张源图像出发，相机感知的光线提升将透视和原生鱼眼图像放置于统一的世界坐标系中，为透视生成保留广角内容。每个生成的片段扩展Scenelet记忆并条件化后续生成。基于覆盖率的检索从完整历史中选择互补的Scenelet，而目标视图的可见性在外观融合之前通过几何方式解决，为引导后续生成提供一致的记忆条件。在四个数据集上，RecallWorld在部分重访和完整循环场景下，重访PSNR分别比最强评估基线提升2.6 dB和3.9 dB，展现出在探索与返回过程中对场景身份的显著更强的保持能力。
translation.brief: 针对视频世界模型重访场景时缺乏持久记忆的问题，提出将多视图情景联合重建为Scenelet并基于覆盖率检索记忆的RecallWorld方法。

papers.title: When to Test, Repair, or Regenerate: Decision-Guided Efficient RTL Generation
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate register-transfer-level (RTL) designs from natural-language specifications. To improve functional correctness, many RTL agents use simulation feedback to guide refinement. However, without a reference testbench, generating one for every initial implementation incurs inference cost even when the RTL is correct. We therefore introduce an adaptive harness that uses a specialized decision model to orchestrate testing, refinement, and candidate selection. It accepts high-scoring initial implementations and generates testbenches for the rest. When further search is needed, the initial score guides repair--regeneration allocation, while defect rankings and simulation feedback guide repair. For final selection, the harness prioritizes test-passing candidates and ranks them using decision-model scores. Across three benchmarks, the harness with DeepSeek improves mean Pass@1 by 5.4--7.1 percentage points over initial implementations and reduces aggregate estimated inference cost by 11.0--14.3% relative to a testbench-guided repair baseline with the same candidate cap.

translation.title: 何时测试、修复或重新生成：决策引导的高效RTL生成
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以根据自然语言规范生成寄存器传输级（RTL）设计。为提高功能正确性，许多RTL智能体使用仿真反馈来引导改进。然而，在没有参考测试平台的情况下，为每个初始实现生成测试平台即使RTL本身正确也会产生推理成本。因此我们引入一个自适应框架，使用专门的决策模型来统筹测试、改进和候选选择。它接受高分初始实现，并为其余实现生成测试平台。当需要进一步搜索时，初始得分指导修复与重新生成的资源分配，而缺陷排序和仿真反馈指导修复。在最终选择时，该框架优先考虑通过测试的候选，并使用决策模型得分进行排序。在三个基准上，使用DeepSeek的该框架将平均Pass@1比初始实现提升5.4–7.1个百分点，并在相同候选数量上限下，相比测试平台引导的修复基线将总估计推理成本降低11.0–14.3%。
translation.brief: 针对LLM生成RTL时盲目生成测试平台造成推理浪费的问题，提出用决策模型统筹测试、修复与重新生成的自适应框架。

papers.title: Physical regime changes expose formula misuse in large language models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly employed for scientific computing across the Earth and environmental sciences, but problems in these fields often involve distinct physical regimes. LLMs may fail to recognize these regime-dependent constraints, applying formulas outside their domains of validity and producing plausible but physically incorrect results. We systematically investigate these failures through controlled experiments and assess whether post-training can improve regime-aware reasoning. Across 72 physical mechanisms, we find frontier LLMs frequently misapply formulas outside their regimes of validity, reducing accuracy by 13-57 percentage points. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards enables Qwen3.5-9B to match DeepSeek V4 Flash (284B) on regime-dependent tasks, but its effectiveness is limited by the formulas available in the base model. Combining supervised fine-tuning on a few worked examples with reinforcement learning improves accuracy by 61 percentage points, while distillation from a teacher supplied with the correct formula raises accuracy from 0% to 71%.

translation.title: 物理状态区间变化暴露大语言模型对公式的误用
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于地球与环境科学领域的科学计算，但这些领域的问题往往涉及不同的物理状态区间（regime）。LLM 可能无法识别这些依赖状态区间的约束，在公式有效域之外套用公式，产生看似合理但物理上错误的结果。我们通过受控实验系统地研究这些失败，并评估后训练能否改善状态区间感知的推理。在 72 种物理机制上，我们发现前沿 LLM 经常在公式有效区间之外误用公式，导致准确率下降 13-57 个百分点。基于可验证奖励的强化学习使 Qwen3.5-9B 在依赖状态区间的任务上达到 DeepSeek V4 Flash（284B）的水平，但其效果受限于基座模型中已有的公式。将少量完整示例的监督微调与强化学习相结合可将准确率提升 61 个百分点，而由提供正确公式的教师模型进行蒸馏可将准确率从 0% 提升至 71%。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 在公式有效域之外误用物理公式的问题，通过受控实验量化失败并探索强化学习、微调与蒸馏等后训练方法来提升状态区间感知推理能力。

papers.title: The Evaluation Substrate Matters: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Serving Substrates
papers.abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) usually coordinate heterogeneous models and tools to solve complex tasks, creating a growing need for reliable evaluation. However, a multi-agent workflow that is fastest in one serving environment can lose its advantage in another, even when its models, prompts, and task remain fixed. This makes a benchmark result conditional on how the workflow is executed. We introduce MASSys, a benchmark for measuring this dependence in multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems. MASSys executes the same candidate-task pairs across serving substrates and load regimes, using five workload families spanning software repair, research synthesis, financial analysis, interactive control, and diagram generation. It records task quality alongside delivery, latency, cost, resource pressure, and failure evidence. In a controlled motivation diagnostic, the Star workflow falls from first to fourth in mean-latency rank under KV-cache pressure, while Chain rises from fourth to first. The substrate sweeps further show that increasing load creates long runtime tails and timeout pressure. In several task families, quality among evaluated outputs changes less than effective quality over submitted jobs: the system delivers fewer usable results even when the surviving outputs remain competitive. Tool and runtime traces reveal that these outcomes involve both model serving and non-model execution. Together, the results motivate evaluating MAS designs over explicit operating conditions and reporting which tasks are delivered, how well they are solved, and where execution breaks down.

translation.title: 评测基底很重要：多智能体服务基底基准测试
translation.abstract: 多智能体系统（MAS）通常协调异构模型和工具来解决复杂任务，对可靠评测的需求日益增长。然而，在某一服务环境中最快的多智能体工作流，在另一个环境中可能失去优势，即使其模型、提示词和任务保持不变。这使得基准测试结果依赖于工作流的执行方式。我们提出 MASSys，一个用于衡量多智能体大语言模型（LLM）系统中这种依赖性的基准。MASSys 在不同服务基底和负载状态下执行相同的候选-任务对，使用涵盖软件修复、研究综合、金融分析、交互控制和图表生成五类工作负载。它记录任务质量以及交付情况、延迟、成本、资源压力和失败证据。在一项受控动机诊断中，Star 工作流在 KV-cache 压力下平均延迟排名从第一降至第四，而 Chain 从第四升至第一。基底扫描进一步表明，负载增加会造成长运行时间尾部和超时压力。在若干任务族中，已评测输出的质量变化小于已提交任务的有效质量：即使存活的输出仍具竞争力，系统交付的可用结果却更少。工具和运行时追踪显示，这些结果同时涉及模型服务和非模型执行。这些结果共同表明，应在明确的运行条件下评测 MAS 设计，并报告哪些任务被交付、解决得如何以及执行在哪里中断。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体系统评测结果依赖服务执行环境的问题，提出 MASSys 基准，在不同服务基底与负载下运行相同工作流并测量质量、延迟、成本与失败情况。

papers.title: Improving the Improver: Semantic PID Control for Medical Agent Self-Improvement
papers.abstract: High-stakes vertical medical tasks, such as postoperative pathological staging and long-term survival prediction, demand multi-step clinical reasoning over heterogeneous evidence under weak supervision and high outcome uncertainty. While we first orchestrate CliAgent, a domain-tailored clinical agent workflow that systematically grounds predictions in multi-modal patient evidence, manually designed medical agents remain constrained by static, brittle rules. Moreover, existing recursive self-improvement (RSI) methods suffer from feedback ambiguity and severe development-set overfitting when evolving agents in high-noise medical domains. Focusing on improving the improver, we propose Semantic PID-RSI, an evidence-guided control-theoretic framework for medical agent self-improvement. Inspired by PID control, our improver evaluates candidate modification batches via three diagnostic roles: P isolates current clinical failure modes, I synthesizes longitudinal evidence from past trials, and D estimates response dynamics and regression risks (D-pre/D-post). Selected plans are compiled into behavior contracts for staged probing and independent adoption judging. Instantiated and validated on challenging oncology tasks (pT/pN staging and survival prognosis), evolving CliAgent with Semantic PID-RSI on a 3B-activated open-weight model achieves substantial gains (up to +6.27 C-index points), outperforming overfitting-prone RSI baselines and approaching the performance of frontier proprietary models (e.g., GPT-6 series) equipped with CliAgent.

translation.title: 改进改进者：面向医疗智能体自我改进的语义 PID 控制
translation.abstract: 高风险的垂直医疗任务，如术后病理分期和长期生存预测，要求在弱监督和高结果不确定性下对异构证据进行多步临床推理。我们首先构建了 CliAgent，一个领域定制的临床智能体工作流，将预测系统地建立在多模态患者证据之上；但人工设计的医疗智能体仍受限于静态、脆弱的规则。此外，现有递归自我改进（RSI）方法在高噪声医疗领域中演化智能体时，存在反馈模糊和严重的开发集过拟合问题。着眼于改进改进者本身，我们提出 Semantic PID-RSI，一个证据引导的、基于控制论的医疗智能体自我改进框架。受 PID 控制启发，我们的改进者通过三个诊断角色评估候选修改批次：P 隔离当前的临床失败模式，I 综合来自历史试验的纵向证据，D 估计响应动态和回归风险（D-pre/D-post）。选定的方案被编译为行为契约，用于分阶段探测和独立的采纳判定。在具有挑战性的肿瘤学任务（pT/pN 分期和生存预后）上实例化并验证，在 3B 激活的开放权重模型上用 Semantic PID-RSI 演化 CliAgent 取得了显著提升（最高 +6.27 C-index 点），优于易过拟合的 RSI 基线，并接近配备 CliAgent 的前沿专有模型（如 GPT-6 系列）的性能。
translation.brief: 针对医疗智能体自我改进中反馈模糊与开发集过拟合的问题，提出受 PID 控制启发的 Semantic PID-RSI 框架，通过 P/I/D 三类诊断角色评估并采纳修改方案。

papers.title: Can Your AI Twin Meet People for You? It Can Hold a Conversation. But What Does It Need to Judge Like You?
papers.abstract: Should your AI twin go meet people on your behalf? We built LLM twins of 710 real people from their other conversations in the CANDOR corpus, sent them to meet each other in 5,680 simulated first conversations, and checked every rehearsal against what the real people said after meeting for real (355 held-out, participant-disjoint pairs, against baselines that include each person's rating history). The rehearsals work: a twin's conversation predicts real liking ($\rho$=0.277), carries information that questionnaires and rating history do not have (partial $\rho$=0.16 [0.05, 0.26]), and recovers most of what the same reader gets from the real conversation (0.321). Swap controls show that this signal travels through the conversation, not through the persona card. What, then, does a twin need to judge like you? Not your voice: making twins talk more like their owners, with person-specific activation steering and a LoRA trained on their own speech, did not help in a pre-specified test and lowered accuracy in an exploratory second round (-0.183 [-0.294, -0.066]). Nor simply your stated ratings: a persona-prompted twin that holds the conversation does not yet carry its owner's judgment, and when told its owner's past ratings it anchors on them instead of weighing them. Learning helps: a small appraisal head trained on other real conversations, which combines the twin's post-call answers with its owner's rating history, lifts rehearsal-based prediction above the history baseline out of fold (+0.059 [0.001, 0.115], against +0.022 without the twin's answers; pre-specified primary contrast +0.056 [-0.001, 0.111]). We propose an attribution protocol for twin-based social simulation and identify learned appraisal as the component twins need next.

translation.title: 你的 AI 分身能替你去见人吗？它能进行对话。但要像你一样做出判断还需要什么？
translation.abstract: 你的 AI 分身应该替你去见人吗？我们基于 CANDOR 语料库中 710 个真实人物的其他对话构建了 LLM 分身，让它们在 5,680 场模拟的初次对话中相互见面，并将每次演练与真人在真实见面后的表现进行对照（355 对留出的、参与者不重叠的配对，基线包括每个人的评分历史）。演练是有效的：分身的对话能预测真实的好感度（ρ=0.277），携带问卷和评分历史所不具备的信息（偏 ρ=0.16 [0.05, 0.26]），并恢复了同一读者从真实对话中获得的大部分信息（0.321）。交换对照表明这一信号通过对话本身传递，而非通过人格卡片。那么，分身需要什么才能像你一样做出判断？不是你的声音：通过特定人物的激活引导和在其本人话语上训练的 LoRA 让分身说话更像其主人，在预先设定的测试中没有帮助，并在探索性的第二轮中降低了准确率（-0.183 [-0.294, -0.066]）。也不是简单的主人的显式评分：仅进行对话的人格提示分身尚不具备主人的判断力，当被告知主人的历史评分时，它会锚定在这些评分上而不是权衡它们。学习有帮助：一个在其他真实对话上训练的小型评估头（appraisal head），将分身的通话后回答与其主人的评分历史相结合，使基于演练的预测在折外上超过历史基线（+0.059 [0.001, 0.115]，而不使用分身回答时为 +0.022；预先设定的主要对比为 +0.056 [-0.001, 0.111]）。我们提出了基于分身的社会模拟的归因协议，并指出学习到的评估能力是分身下一步所需的组件。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 个人分身在模拟初次对话中能否预测真实人际好感，发现对话本身携带预测信号，而学习到的评估头是让分身具备主人判断力的关键组件。

papers.title: HiPerfCC-KVCache: Accelerating Confidential LLM Serving with Hierarchical KV Caching
papers.abstract: Hierarchical key-value (KV) caching reduces repeated prefill computation in large language model serving by retaining reusable state beyond GPU memory. Under GPU confidential computing (CC), however, protected transfers can erase this benefit. We show that bulk KV copies hold driver locks during prolonged CPU-side processing, stalling independent serving operations despite separate threads and streams. Our characterization on Hopper and Blackwell GPUs shows how lock scope, copy granularity, and allocation ownership affect foreground progress and transfer parallelism. Guided by these findings, we present HiPerfCC-KVCache, which manages resource lifetimes, prioritizes ready token readback between bounded backup submissions, and parallelizes KV restores through auxiliary contexts with shared GPU staging. Implemented in SGLang, HiPerfCC-KVCache uses existing protected transfer interfaces without hardware or driver changes. Across three models and three workloads on H200, HiPerfCC-KVCache achieves a geometric-mean output-token throughput speedup of $1.74\times$ (up to $2.72\times$) over the staged KV-transfer HiCache-Workers baseline at the highest tested loads. Mean time to first token decreases by 36% on average and up to 59%. The benefits generalize to RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, with a geometric-mean throughput speedup of $1.28\times$ (up to $2.20\times$) over the same baseline. A capacity analysis further models and explains variation in gains and remaining gaps to CC-off serving.

translation.title: HiPerfCC-KVCache：利用分层 KV 缓存加速机密 LLM 服务
translation.abstract: 分层键值（KV）缓存通过在 GPU 显存之外保留可复用状态，减少大语言模型服务中重复的 prefill 计算。然而在 GPU 机密计算（CC）下，受保护的传输可能抵消这一收益。我们表明，批量 KV 拷贝会在长时间的 CPU 侧处理期间持有驱动锁，即使使用独立线程和流也会阻塞其他服务操作。我们在 Hopper 和 Blackwell GPU 上的特性分析揭示了锁范围、拷贝粒度和分配所有权如何影响前台进度和传输并行性。基于这些发现，我们提出 HiPerfCC-KVCache，它管理资源生命周期，在有限的备份提交之间优先执行就绪 token 的回读，并通过共享 GPU 暂存的辅助上下文并行化 KV 恢复。HiPerfCC-KVCache 在 SGLang 中实现，使用现有的受保护传输接口，无需硬件或驱动更改。在 H200 上跨三个模型和三种工作负载，HiPerfCC-KVCache 在最高测试负载下相比分阶段 KV 传输的 HiCache-Workers 基线实现了 1.74 倍（最高 2.72 倍）的输出 token 吞吐量几何平均加速。首 token 平均时间降低 36%，最高 59%。这些收益可推广到 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell，相比同一基线实现 1.28 倍（最高 2.20 倍）的几何平均吞吐量加速。容量分析进一步建模并解释了收益的变化以及与无 CC 服务相比的剩余差距。
translation.brief: 针对 GPU 机密计算下受保护 KV 传输因驱动锁阻塞服务的问题，提出 HiPerfCC-KVCache，通过资源生命周期管理、优先回读和辅助上下文并行恢复来加速分层 KV 缓存。

papers.title: Zero-Trust Formal Methods: AI Agents Build Verified Checkers for Untrusted Solvers
papers.abstract: AI coding agents now generate code faster than humans can review it. Security analyses rely on solver answers such as "unsatisfiable" (for example, no attack path exists) or "optimal." Unlike satisfying models, they cannot be checked by looking at them. Formal verification moves trust from code to specifications, but verifiers still place large SAT, SMT, and answer-set solvers, and the translation into solver queries, in their trusted computing base, and these have had soundness bugs. Unlike agent-based pipelines that trust their verifier and solver, our farm trusts no component by default: neither the AI agents, which might make mistakes or game their objectives, nor the solvers. A solver answer counts only if a verified checker accepts its certificate. Every theory, proof, and line of code is generated by AI. For each component, agents first create an Isabelle/HOL theory with a specification, a soundness proof, and a reference checker made by code generation, then a fast Rust implementation, verified with Verus against a specification that mirrors the Isabelle definitions line by line. Specifications are frozen after independent review and cannot be changed by the implementing agents. A trust manifest lists what is still trusted. We built trust chains for SAT (verified LRAT checking); SMT, with certificates from an extended z3 and verified bit-blasting for bit-vectors and floating point; answer-set programming, with native certificates from clingo, including weight rules and optimality; and, closing the loop, Verus's final verification-condition step, by translation validation. All 3,726 SMT queries from 20 crates are certified and validated, and 15,662 answer-set proofs are accepted by both the Isabelle and the Verus checker. We found soundness defects in three proof checkers, including drat-trim, and in five solvers, including clasp and z3, which report wrong unsatisfiability.

translation.title: 零信任形式化方法：AI 智能体为不可信求解器构建经验证的检查器
translation.abstract: AI 编程智能体生成代码的速度已超过人类审查的速度。安全分析依赖求解器的答案，如"不可满足"（例如不存在攻击路径）或"最优"。与满足模型不同，这些答案无法通过直接查看来检验。形式化验证将信任从代码转移到规约，但验证器仍将大型 SAT、SMT 和 answer-set 求解器以及生成求解器查询的翻译过程置于其可信计算基中，而这些组件曾出现过可靠性缺陷。与信任其验证器和求解器的基于智能体的流水线不同，我们的农场默认不信任任何组件：既不信任可能犯错或投机取巧的 AI 智能体，也不信任求解器。求解器答案只有在经验证的检查器接受其证书时才算数。每个理论、证明和代码行都由 AI 生成。对于每个组件，智能体首先创建一个包含规约、可靠性证明和通过代码生成得到的参考检查器的 Isabelle/HOL 理论，然后创建一个快速的 Rust 实现，用 Verus 针对逐行镜像 Isabelle 定义的规约进行验证。规约在独立审查后被冻结，实现智能体无法更改。信任清单列出仍然被信任的内容。我们为以下内容构建了信任链：SAT（经验证的 LRAT 检查）；SMT，证书来自扩展的 z3，并针对位向量和浮点数进行经验证的 bit-blasting；answer-set 编程，证书来自 clingo 的原生证书，包括权重规则和最优性；以及通过翻译验证闭合循环，验证 Verus 的最终验证条件步骤。来自 20 个 crate 的全部 3,726 个 SMT 查询均通过认证和验证，15,662 个 answer-set 证明同时被 Isabelle 和 Verus 检查器接受。我们在三个证明检查器（包括 drat-trim）和五个求解器（包括 clasp 和 z3）中发现了可靠性缺陷，后者会报告错误的不可满足性。
translation.brief: 针对求解器答案不可直接检验且可能出错的问题，提出零信任框架：由 AI 智能体生成 Isabelle/HOL 规约与证明及经 Verus 验证的 Rust 检查器，仅接受通过经验证检查器校验证书的求解器答案。

papers.title: SkillLens: An Interactive Human-LLM System for Diagnosing and Refining Agent Skills
papers.abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on reusable skills, yet maintaining them requires developers to connect revisions with changes in behavior and task outcomes. Existing workflows fragment evidence across versions, evaluation cases, and execution traces. We present SkillLens, an interactive human-LLM system for diagnosing and refining agent skills. A formative study with five developers and researchers identified challenges in prioritizing failures, reconstructing case-level evidence, and preserving context across revisions. SkillLens links performance changes, case transitions, skill diffs, invocation sequences, traces, and outputs in a recoverable workflow, while keeping model-generated explanations and refinements under human review. Through a between-subjects user study with 20 participants, we show that SkillLens supports developers in diagnosing and refining agent skills through a more usable and less demanding workflow than the baseline. These findings highlight the value of linking version comparisons, case-level evidence, and human-reviewed refinement across skill iterations.

translation.title: SkillLens：用于诊断和改进智能体技能的交互式人机协同系统
translation.abstract: LLM 智能体日益依赖可复用的技能，然而维护这些技能需要开发者将修订与行为变化和任务结果联系起来。现有工作流将证据分散在版本、评估用例和执行轨迹中。我们提出 SkillLens，一个用于诊断和改进智能体技能的交互式人机协同系统。一项针对五名开发者和研究者的形成性研究指出了在失败优先级排序、重建用例级证据以及在修订间保持上下文方面的挑战。SkillLens 将性能变化、用例转换、技能差异、调用序列、轨迹和输出关联在一个可恢复的工作流中，同时让模型生成的解释和改进建议处于人工审查之下。通过一项有 20 名参与者参与的组间用户研究，我们表明 SkillLens 通过比基线更可用、负担更小的工作流支持开发者诊断和改进智能体技能。这些发现凸显了在技能迭代中关联版本比较、用例级证据和人工审查改进的价值。
translation.brief: 针对维护 LLM 智能体技能时证据分散、难以关联行为变化的问题，提出 SkillLens 系统，将性能变化、用例证据与技能差异关联并辅以人工审查来诊断和改进技能。

papers.title: CoopOcc: Cooperative 3D Semantic Occupancy Perception via Multi-Agent and Cross-Modal Fusion
papers.abstract: Semantic occupancy perception has emerged as a promising paradigm for jointly modeling 3D scene geometry and semantic information. However, this unified representation cannot compensate for missing information caused by occlusion and sensor coverage. Multi-agent cooperation alleviates this limitation, but information from different agents is not equally useful across spatial regions. Meanwhile, feature representations from each agent form the basis of reliable multi-agent fusion. Cross?modal fusion constructs such representations by integrating complementary semantic and geometric information. Despite this complementarity, jointly establishing reliable 3D correspondence across agents and preserving modality-specific structures remains challenging. To address these limitations, we propose CoopOcc, which performs cooperative 3D semantic occupancy perception through multi-agent and cross-modal fusion. CoopOcc uses ego?query cross-agent attention (EQCA) to selectively aggregate aligned features across agents, and anchor-based bidirectional feature interaction (ABFI) for cross-modal exchange at matched coordinates. We further construct SemanticVVSim, a simulation dataset, and establish a unified benchmark. For simulation-to-real transfer, we propose confidence-aware hierarchical occupancy and relational distillation (CHORD). CoopOcc performs best overall among ten evaluated methods on SemanticVVSim. On Occ3D-nuScenes, CHORD improves performance using knowledge from SemanticVVSim. The code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: CoopOcc：基于多智能体与跨模态融合的协同 3D 语义占据感知
translation.abstract: 语义占据感知已成为联合建模 3D 场景几何和语义信息的一种有前景的范式。然而，这种统一表示无法弥补由遮挡和传感器覆盖造成的信息缺失。多智能体协同可以缓解这一局限，但来自不同智能体的信息在不同空间区域的有用程度并不相同。同时，每个智能体的特征表示是可靠多智能体融合的基础。跨模态融合通过整合互补的语义和几何信息来构建这种表示。尽管具有这种互补性，跨智能体联合建立可靠的 3D 对应关系并保留模态特定结构仍然具有挑战性。为解决这些局限，我们提出 CoopOcc，通过多智能体与跨模态融合实现协同 3D 语义占据感知。CoopOcc 使用 ego-query 跨智能体注意力（EQCA）选择性地聚合跨智能体的对齐特征，并使用基于锚点的双向特征交互（ABFI）在匹配坐标处进行跨模态交换。我们进一步构建了仿真数据集 SemanticVVSim 并建立了统一基准。对于仿真到真实的迁移，我们提出置信度感知的分层占据与关系蒸馏（CHORD）。CoopOcc 在 SemanticVVSim 上评估的十种方法中总体表现最佳。在 Occ3D-nuScenes 上，CHORD 利用 SemanticVVSim 的知识提升了性能。代码可在该 https URL 获取。
translation.brief: 针对单智能体语义占据感知因遮挡和覆盖不足导致信息缺失的问题，提出 CoopOcc，通过跨智能体注意力与跨模态双向特征交互实现多智能体协同 3D 语义占据感知。

papers.title: Legal Is Not Good: A Pre-Registered Benchmark of Low-Cost Language and Decision Models on a New Strategy Game
papers.abstract: Measure Before You Train argued that an agent's decisions should be measured against ground truth, under a protocol fixed in advance, before anyone trains or replaces the model behind them. We carry the method to a second, very different domain, a turn-based strategy game, and ask a deliberately modest question: how well do low-cost agents play under a pre-registered protocol? hexfolk is a minimal two-player 4X game written for this purpose, so no model has seen its rules or positions. A deterministic engine, one agent interface, a referee that never corrects an illegal or late move, and per-decision logs make every game replayable; questions and expected answers were committed before the games, on held-out seeds with mirrored seats and 95% Wilson intervals. Two small open language models (8B and 3B) lose every game to a few-line rule player. Answering in free text they are invalid on 98% of their decisions; constrained to legal moves they never play an invalid one, yet they lose to the uniformly random player (the 8B model wins 10.0 [4.3, 21.4]% of games), refuting our expectation that they would beat it; the result survives a control that shuffles the order of the options. Two native decision models never play an invalid move and both beat random; one loses all 50 games to the rule player, the other is not distinguishable from it in 50 games and beats a one-step search. The paid agents make tens to over a hundred model calls per game; against the same opponents a free 60 ms-per-move search, which makes none, outplays every paid model by the full range of the scale. Two 7-8B models served locally behave the same way. No frontier model is included.

translation.title: 合法不等于好：在新策略游戏上对低成本语言与决策模型的预注册基准测试
translation.abstract: 《Measure Before You Train》主张，在任何人训练或替换智能体背后的模型之前，应按照预先固定的协议将智能体的决策与真值进行对照测量。我们将该方法应用于第二个截然不同的领域——回合制策略游戏，并提出一个刻意谦逊的问题：低成本智能体在预注册协议下表现如何？hexfolk 是为此目的编写的极简双人 4X 游戏，因此没有模型见过其规则或局面。确定性引擎、单一智能体接口、从不纠正非法或超时走子的裁判以及逐决策日志使每局游戏可复现；问题和预期答案在游戏开始前提交，使用保留种子、镜像座位和 95% Wilson 区间。两个小型开源语言模型（8B 和 3B）在每局游戏中都输给几行代码的规则玩家。以自由文本回答时，它们 98% 的决策无效；在约束为合法走子时，它们从不走出非法走子，却输给均匀随机玩家（8B 模型赢得 10.0 [4.3, 21.4]% 的对局），推翻了我们认为它们会击败随机玩家的预期；该结果在打乱选项顺序的对照实验中依然成立。两个原生决策模型从不走出非法走子且都击败随机玩家；一个在 50 局中全部输给规则玩家，另一个在 50 局中与规则玩家难以区分并击败一步搜索。付费智能体每局进行数十到上百次模型调用；面对相同对手，一个每步 60 毫秒、零调用的免费搜索以满量程优势胜过所有付费模型。两个本地部署的 7-8B 模型表现相同。未包含任何前沿模型。
translation.brief: 针对低成本语言与决策模型在预注册协议下实际博弈能力未知的问题，构建可复现的极简策略游戏 hexfolk 基准，系统测量各模型与规则玩家、随机玩家及搜索的胜负表现。

papers.title: Data-Driven Trajectory Prediction via Probabilistic Modes and Constrained Optimization
papers.abstract: Predicting the future trajectories of surrounding agents is a fundamental requirement for safe autonomous driving. Since agent intent is inherently uncertain, multimodal prediction is essential to account for the full range of plausible future behaviors. We introduce Probabilistic Modes and Constrained Optimization trajectory prediction (ProMo-CoOp), a two-stage data-driven framework. At design time, trajectories are clustered into behavioral modes and a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) provides probabilistic mode assignments. At prediction time, a candidate trajectory is generated for each mode by solving a convex optimization problem that enforces consistency with the observed trajectory and uses the precomputed mode assignments to guide prediction toward the selected behavioral mode. The framework also supports Signal Temporal Logic (STL)-derived behavioral constraints, with predicate satisfaction probabilities estimated using Conditional Flow Matching (CFM). Experiments show that ProMo-CoOp outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, and that STL-based constraints can further improve performance when the predicted predicate satisfactions are reliable.

translation.title: 基于概率模式与约束优化的数据驱动轨迹预测
translation.abstract: 预测周围智能体的未来轨迹是安全自动驾驶的基本需求。由于智能体意图本质上是不确定的，多模态预测对于涵盖所有合理的未来行为至关重要。我们提出概率模式与约束优化轨迹预测（ProMo-CoOp），一个两阶段数据驱动框架。在设计阶段，轨迹被聚类为行为模式，高斯混合模型（GMM）提供概率化的模式分配。在预测阶段，通过求解一个凸优化问题为每个模式生成候选轨迹，该问题强制与观测轨迹的一致性，并使用预计算的模式分配引导预测朝向所选行为模式。该框架还支持由信号时序逻辑（STL）导出的行为约束，其谓词满足概率使用 Conditional Flow Matching（CFM）估计。实验表明，ProMo-CoOp 优于最先进的基线方法，且当预测的谓词满足可靠时，基于 STL 的约束能进一步提升性能。
translation.brief: 针对智能体意图不确定导致轨迹预测需多模态化的问题，提出 ProMo-CoOp 两阶段框架：用 GMM 进行行为模式分配，并通过带行为约束的凸优化生成各模式候选轨迹。

papers.title: CLAIR: Consistent LLM Adaptation via Index-free Reprogramming
papers.abstract: Time-series forecasting with pretrained large language models (LLMs) uses contextualized patch representations, raising the question of how to align them. Matching patches at the same temporal position is natural, but self-attention allows each patch state to incorporate information from elsewhere in the input window, suggesting that useful correspondences can extend across positions. This flexibility, however, does not necessarily translate into consistent forecasts: similar patch states may play different roles when used in their original temporal order. To address both issues, we propose CLAIR (Consistent LLM Adaptation via Index-free Reprogramming), a teacher-guided framework that combines patch-level transport alignment (PTA) and forecast-level consistency (FC). A clean-view exponential moving average (EMA) teacher guides a mildly perturbed student, with PTA establishing soft, representation-dependent correspondences and FC encouraging agreement at corresponding future steps. The forecasting head retains the original patch order. We test this combination through controlled comparisons: while PTA and index-wise alignment perform similarly without FC, PTA+FC under EMA supervision reduces horizon-averaged mean squared error (MSE) by 2.1% on ETTh1 and 2.6% on ETTm1 relative to Index+FC. The same preference for PTA+FC emerges in comparisons with alternative matching strategies on Weather and ETTh2. Beyond these controls, CLAIR achieves the lowest horizon-averaged MSE on five of six long-term benchmarks and the lowest aggregate overall weighted average (OWA) on M4 among evaluated methods, with competitive few-shot performance. As the teacher and transport are used only during training, inference requires only the student.

translation.title: CLAIR：基于无索引重编程的一致性LLM适配
translation.abstract: 使用预训练大语言模型（LLM）进行时间序列预测时需要利用上下文化的patch表示，这引出了如何对齐它们的问题。在相同时间位置匹配patch是自然的做法，但自注意力机制使每个patch状态能够吸收输入窗口中其他位置的信息，这表明有用的对应关系可以跨越位置扩展。然而这种灵活性并不一定转化为一致的预测：相似的patch状态在按原始时间顺序使用时可能扮演不同角色。为同时解决这两个问题，我们提出CLAIR（Consistent LLM Adaptation via Index-free Reprogramming），这是一个教师引导的框架，结合了patch级传输对齐（PTA）和预测级一致性（FC）。一个干净视图的指数移动平均（EMA）教师引导轻度扰动的学生模型，PTA建立软性的、依赖表示的对应关系，FC鼓励在对应未来步骤上的一致性。预测头保留原始patch顺序。我们通过受控比较测试了这一组合：在没有FC时，PTA与按索引对齐表现相近，而在EMA监督下，PTA+FC相对Index+FC在ETTh1上将水平平均均方误差（MSE）降低2.1%，在ETTm1上降低2.6%。在Weather和ETTh2上与其他匹配策略的比较中，同样出现了对PTA+FC的偏好。除这些对照实验外，CLAIR在六个长期预测基准中的五个上取得最低的水平平均MSE，并在M4上取得所评估方法中最低的总体加权平均（OWA），同时具有有竞争力的少样本性能。由于教师和传输仅在训练时使用，推理只需学生模型。
translation.brief: 解决LLM时间序列预测中patch对齐与预测一致性问题，提出教师引导的patch级传输对齐与预测级一致性相结合的框架CLAIR。

papers.title: Seeing Is Not Planning: Spatiotemporal Planning and Plan Repair in Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract: Planning in a visual world means reading the layout, foreseeing how the state will change, and following the task rules all at once. When a plan fails, a model should also use what went wrong to fix it. We call these two abilities spatiotemporal planning and plan repair, and test them with Railbound-Bench. A model sees a railway puzzle, adds tracks under a budget, and submits one complete layout; a simulator then moves all cars at once and decides whether the layout works. After a failure, the model sees what happened and may submit a new layout, up to five attempts in total.
