On the 200-puzzle main set, the best of nine models solves 59.5% within five attempts, the next 39.5%, and the other seven at most 10.0%; a 1,000-puzzle extended set with a wider range of difficulty is far easier, at 90.9% for the best model. Controlled studies on 180 fixed puzzles show that knowing the task is not the same as using it. GPT-6.1 Terra copies 97.2% of boards exactly and, given a correct layout as text, predicts all four requested future states in 91.3% of cases, yet only 22.8% of its first layouts work. Planning fails more often as the cars' routes interact, even among puzzles that a search solver finds equally easy. Visual feedback removes the reported fault in 175 of 417 first revisions, but only 43 of these revisions solve the puzzle, and at an equal budget of 40k tokens it does no better than fresh retries. The code and data are open-sourced on GitHub at this https URL.

translation.title: 看见不等于规划：多模态LLM中的时空规划与计划修复
translation.abstract: 在视觉世界中进行规划意味着同时读懂布局、预见状态如何变化并遵循任务规则。当计划失败时，模型还应利用出错的信息进行修复。我们将这两种能力称为时空规划和计划修复，并用Railbound-Bench进行测试。模型看到一道铁路谜题，在预算内添加轨道并提交一个完整布局；模拟器随后同时移动所有小车并判断布局是否可行。失败后，模型看到发生了什么并可提交新布局，总共最多五次尝试。在200题的主集合上，九个模型中最好的在五次尝试内解决59.5%，次优为39.5%，其余七个最多10.0%；难度范围更广的1000题扩展集合则容易得多，最佳模型达到90.9%。在180道固定谜题上的受控研究表明，知道任务不等于会用任务。GPT-6.1 Terra能精确复现97.2%的棋盘，给定文本形式的正确布局时能在91.3%的情况下预测全部四个未来状态，但其首次布局只有22.8%可行。当小车路线相互作用时规划失败更频繁，即使是在搜索求解器认为难度相同的谜题中也是如此。视觉反馈在417次首次修订中移除了175次所报告的故障，但其中只有43次修订解决了谜题，且在40k token的同等预算下并不比重新尝试更好。代码和数据已在GitHub上开源。
translation.brief: 提出Railbound-Bench评测多模态LLM的时空规划与计划修复能力，通过铁路谜题模拟器揭示模型能看懂场景却难以有效规划和修复计划。

papers.title: Multimodal LLMs Know the Game but Assume the Real World
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models can state the rules of a video game, but do they apply them when they only see the game? We introduce RuleCraft, 1,240 image questions over 155 Minecraft rules with outcomes verified in the game engine, each asked in text, on the image with the game named, and on the bare image. Six widely used models know the rules and recognize the game, yet answer the bare image by real-world physics: naming the game raises their accuracy on rules where the game departs from reality by 8.2-19.8 points on a main set and by 33.8-52.7 on a hard stress-test set. Their errors pick the real-world outcome, the gap is largest where the game leaves a scene unchanged, and reasoning traces state the game's rule, then answer by reality. On the main set, naming the game mostly swaps the real-world default for the game's. The pattern holds with reasoning, recurs in two more games, and persists on questions the models themselves take to be about the game; one neutral sentence asking for the rules of the world shown recovers much of the gap. Evaluations that name the game measure knowledge of its rules, not world selection.

translation.title: 多模态LLM知道游戏规则，却默认真实世界
translation.abstract: 多模态大语言模型能够陈述视频游戏的规则，但当它们只看到游戏画面时是否会应用这些规则？我们提出RuleCraft，包含1240道图像问题，覆盖155条Minecraft规则，其结果在游戏引擎中验证，每道题分别以纯文本、标注游戏名称的图像和裸图像三种形式提出。六个广泛使用的模型都知道规则并能识别游戏，但在回答裸图像问题时却依据现实世界物理：指出游戏名称使它们在游戏偏离现实的规则上，主集合准确率提升8.2-19.8分，高难度压力测试集合提升33.8-52.7分。它们的错误倾向于选择现实世界的结果，差距在游戏保持场景不变之处最大，且推理轨迹中先陈述游戏规则、再按现实作答。在主集合上，指出游戏名称主要是将现实世界默认替换为游戏规则。该模式在使用推理时依然成立，在另外两款游戏中重复出现，并在模型自认为与游戏相关的问题上持续存在；一句中性的、要求说明所示世界规则的句子即可恢复大部分差距。指出游戏名称的评测衡量的是规则知识，而非世界选择。
translation.brief: 提出RuleCraft基准，揭示多模态LLM虽知晓游戏规则，但在仅看图像时默认用现实世界物理作答，指出游戏名称可显著纠正这一偏差。

papers.title: Who Speaks for the Water? Simulating Discursive Closure and Power Asymmetries in Hydrosocial Governance
papers.abstract: Water governance conflicts stem not only from material scarcity, but from power asymmetries, institutional distrust, and the discursive frameworks through which actors assign meaning to water, infrastructure, and legitimate authority. Conventional simulation tools represent these dynamics via numerical opinion variables, missing the argumentative and narrative dimensions structuring real deliberation in hydrosocial territories. We present the Hydrosocial Agent-Based Model with Large Language Models (HSABM-LLM), a hybrid framework enabling heterogeneous agents to generate, evaluate, and adapt natural language arguments conditioned on institutional roles, interaction histories, and territorial context. Grounded in semi-structured interviews, a water-user survey, and 456 press and official documents from the Longaví River sub-basin (Maule Region, Chile), the model simulates deliberation over a contested large-scale reservoir proposal across four experimental scenarios. Opinion convergence toward unanimous opposition emerged within 7-14 months, operating through discursive closure driven by distributive equity and water security framings rather than argumentative dominance. Governance actors accelerated convergence by activating pre-existing institutional distrust rather than direct persuasion, while peer-based smallholder interactions drove 77-79% of all opinion changes. The formal authority of state institutions proved structurally decoupled from deliberative influence, revealing a legitimacy deficit that formal inclusion alone cannot resolve. These findings suggest participatory governance design must attend to the discursive conditions under which institutional actors enter deliberative spaces, rather than assuming inclusion is inherently consensus-building. HSABM-LLM offers a novel platform for integrating political ecology insights into computational social science.

translation.title: 谁为水发声？模拟水社会治理中的话语闭合与权力不对称
translation.abstract: 水治理冲突不仅源于物质稀缺，还源于权力不对称、制度不信任，以及行动者借以赋予水、基础设施和合法权威以意义的话语框架。传统模拟工具通过数值化的意见变量来表示这些动态，忽略了构建水社会领地中真实审议的论证与叙事维度。我们提出基于大语言模型的水社会基于主体模型（HSABM-LLM），这是一个混合框架，使异质主体能够基于制度角色、互动历史和领地情境生成、评估和调整自然语言论证。该模型基于智利马乌莱大区Longaví河子流域的半结构化访谈、用水户调查和456份新闻与官方文件，在四种实验场景中模拟围绕一个有争议的大型水库提案的审议过程。意见在7-14个月内收敛为一致反对，其机制是由分配公平和水安全框架驱动的话语闭合，而非论证上的压倒性优势。治理行动者通过激活既有的制度不信任而非直接说服来加速收敛，而小农户之间的同伴互动驱动了77-79%的意见变化。国家机构的正式权威在结构上与审议影响力脱钩，揭示了一种仅靠正式纳入无法解决的合法性赤字。这些发现表明，参与式治理设计必须关注制度性行动者进入审议空间的话语条件，而不能假设纳入本身必然促成共识。HSABM-LLM为将政治生态学洞见融入计算社会科学提供了新平台。
translation.brief: 提出结合LLM的基于主体模型HSABM-LLM，基于智利Longaví河流域实证数据模拟水治理冲突中的话语闭合与权力不对称动态。

papers.title: Analytical Modeling and Optimal GPU Provisioning for Disaggregated LLM Inference
papers.abstract: We present OSplit, an exact analytical method that enables efficient partitioning of a GPU L1 domain into prefill and decode workers, including sharding for classical and advanced GPUs. OSplit takes into consideration model parameters, enabling any inference model to be partitioned into prefill and decode workers with a goal of producing the maximum throughput possible. OSplit is based on a capacity model that takes as inputs the model, the loading scheme (batch size, max sequence length), and models an inference serving framework (vLLM) and computes the efficiency of each GPU. For this, we model H100 and GB300 GPUs, and model a scale-up domain, along with FlashAttention-based kernels. OSplit first computes an optimal collective generation policy, which gives inputs to the capacity model that enables optimal split of prefill and decode GPUs. We evaluate our scheme over H100 (NVL8) and GB300 (NVL72) using vLLM inference serving and show throughput, predicted and measured latency, showing near-perfect theoretical-to-measured values over leading LLMs (Llama and Qwen)

translation.title: 面向分离式LLM推理的解析建模与最优GPU配置
translation.abstract: 我们提出OSplit，一种精确的解析方法，可将GPU L1域高效划分为prefill和decode工作节点，包括对经典和先进GPU的分片。OSplit考虑模型参数，使任何推理模型都能以最大化吞吐量为目标被划分为prefill和decode工作节点。OSplit基于一个容量模型，其输入为模型、加载方案（批大小、最大序列长度），并对推理服务框架（vLLM）建模，计算每块GPU的效率。为此，我们对H100和GB300 GPU、scale-up域以及基于FlashAttention的内核进行建模。OSplit首先计算最优的集体生成策略，为容量模型提供输入，从而实现prefill与decode GPU的最优划分。我们在H100（NVL8）和GB300（NVL72）上使用vLLM推理服务评估该方案，展示吞吐量以及预测与实测延迟，在主流LLM（Llama和Qwen）上实现了理论值与实测值的近乎完美吻合。
translation.brief: 提出解析方法OSplit，通过容量建模与最优生成策略计算，实现分离式LLM推理中prefill与decode GPU的最优划分以最大化吞吐量。

papers.title: Who Is Prompt-Injecting Coding Agents? An Empirical Study of Hidden AI-Directed Text on GitHub
papers.abstract: AI coding agents now triage issues, review pull requests and pick up tasks inside GitHub repositories, and to do so they read text that anyone with a GitHub account can write. This makes GitHub a prime surface for indirect prompt injection, in which instructions embedded in untrusted content steer a model that later processes it. Prior work has demonstrated such attacks against agents on GitHub in controlled settings, but how often they occur in practice, who deploys them, and for what purpose remain unknown. We present the first large-scale empirical study of AI-directed hidden text on GitHub. We analyzed roughly 145 million issues, pull requests, comments and README files, detected text that GitHub does not render to a human reader but that an agent receives in full, and filtered it with a two-stage LLM classification, a template provenance check and an exhaustive manual review. We identify 2,281 validated findings in issues, pull requests and comments (16 per million items), and AI-directed hidden text in the READMEs of 107 repositories. We find a heterogeneous ecosystem of four uses: attacks on other parties' agents, defensive text that restricts agents, content override that steers what they write, and first-party orchestration, in which projects coordinate their own agents through hidden markers. Attacks are rare (about one in 3.3 million items) but aimed at maintainers' own triage, review and CI agents. Orchestration accounts for two thirds of the findings in issues, pull requests and comments, grew fivefold in four months, and forms a control channel that anyone who can comment can imitate. Replayed offline against five models we tested, the attacks succeed against one small, fast model in 19% of cases, and against none once HTML comments are stripped. We release our detection tool and every finding.

translation.title: 谁在对编码智能体进行提示注入？GitHub 上隐藏 AI 导向文本的实证研究
translation.abstract: AI 编码智能体现在可以在 GitHub 仓库中进行问题分诊、审查拉取请求和领取任务，为此它们需要阅读任何拥有 GitHub 账户的人都能写入的文本。这使得 GitHub 成为间接提示注入的主要攻击面——嵌入在不可信内容中的指令可以操纵后续处理该内容的模型。已有工作在受控环境中演示了针对 GitHub 上智能体的此类攻击，但它们在实践中发生的频率、由谁部署以及出于什么目的仍不得而知。我们首次对 GitHub 上的 AI 导向隐藏文本进行了大规模实证研究。我们分析了约 1.45 亿条 issue、拉取请求、评论和 README 文件，检测出 GitHub 不会向人类读者渲染但智能体会完整接收的文本，并通过两阶段 LLM 分类、模板来源检查和详尽的人工审查进行过滤。我们在 issue、拉取请求和评论中识别出 2,281 条经验证的发现（每百万条目 16 条），并在 107 个仓库的 README 中发现了 AI 导向的隐藏文本。我们发现了一个由四种用途构成的异构生态系统：针对他人智能体的攻击、限制智能体的防御性文本、引导智能体输出的内容覆盖，以及第一方编排——即项目通过隐藏标记协调自己的智能体。攻击较为罕见（约每 330 万条目中 1 条），但目标是维护者自己的分诊、审查和 CI 智能体。编排占 issue、拉取请求和评论中发现的三分之二，在四个月内增长了五倍，并形成了一种任何能发表评论的人都可以模仿的控制通道。在我们测试的五个模型的离线重放中，攻击对一个小型快速模型的成功率为 19%，而在剥离 HTML 注释后对所有模型均告失败。我们发布了检测工具和全部发现。
translation.brief: 研究 GitHub 上针对 AI 智能体的隐藏提示注入文本的实际规模与用途，采用大规模文本挖掘结合两阶段 LLM 分类与人工审查进行检测分析。

papers.title: JevNavAgent: A Single-Forward Visual Navigation Agent with Trajectory-Level RL for Gigapixel Pathology
papers.abstract: Gigapixel whole-slide images (WSIs) exceed single-pass vision-language model (VLM) capacity at cellular resolution, while multiple instance learning relies on query-agnostic offline patching without interactive reasoning. Multi-step VLM navigation agents inspect regions on demand, yet face two bottlenecks: (1) autoregressive action decoding incurs heavy latency, throttling exploration and online multi-trajectory RL; and (2) offline distillation suffers from an existential-versus-universal stopping asymmetry between positive detection and negative exclusion, inducing thumbnail and kinematic shortcuts while leaving policies prone to passing metastases without stopping. Under the Jev (System One) paradigm, a model predicts distributions over predefined decision spaces in one forward pass (0 generated tokens) while deterministic code executes navigation. We build JevNavAgent, a 2B-parameter agent combining factorized stopping, spatial-candidate, and contextual-bilinear answer heads with overview modality dropout. We pair Stage-1 offline counterfactual trajectory alignment (mitigating depth and panning shortcuts) with Stage-2 online trajectory-level GRPO (Traj-GRPO), using decoding-free rollouts to optimize branch-level lesion discovery, in-polygon stopping, and step-wise confidence gain. On Clean Visual WSI-VQA, JevNavAgent achieves 51.57% multi-scale (50.43% terminal-step) overall and 51.39% focal accuracy, outperforming frontier VLM agents and 4B-11B open-source cascades while running nearly 12x faster than frontier APIs (5.63s vs. 66.64-70.04s). On CAMELYON16 Official Test, Traj-GRPO reaches 22.45% localization (converting 11/12, or 91.7%, of visited tumors into grounded stops) with 93.75% specificity and 69.77% slide accuracy, surpassing Stage-1 SFT under matched stopping rules alongside zero-shot budget scaling.

translation.title: JevNavAgent：面向千兆像素病理的单次前向视觉导航智能体与轨迹级强化学习
translation.abstract: 千兆像素全切片图像（WSI）超出了视觉语言模型（VLM）在细胞分辨率下单次处理的能力，而多示例学习依赖于与查询无关的离线切片，缺乏交互式推理。多步 VLM 导航智能体可按需检查区域，但面临两个瓶颈：（1）自回归动作解码带来高延迟，限制了探索和在线多轨迹强化学习；（2）离线蒸馏在阳性检测与阴性排除之间存在存在性-普遍性停止不对称，导致模型依赖缩略图和运动学捷径，策略容易在转移灶处不停留而直接通过。在 Jev（系统一）范式下，模型在单次前向传播中预测预定义决策空间上的分布（0 个生成 token），由确定性代码执行导航。我们构建了 JevNavAgent，一个 2B 参数的智能体，结合了分解的停止头、空间候选头和上下文双线性答案头，并采用概览模态 dropout。我们将第一阶段离线反事实轨迹对齐（缓解深度和平移捷径）与第二阶段在线轨迹级 GRPO（Traj-GRPO）配对，利用无解码 rollout 优化分支级病灶发现、多边形内停止和逐步置信度增益。在 Clean Visual WSI-VQA 上，JevNavAgent 达到 51.57% 的多尺度（50.43% 终端步）总体准确率和 51.39% 的局灶准确率，超越前沿 VLM 智能体和 4B-11B 开源级联模型，同时运行速度比前沿 API 快近 12 倍（5.63 秒 vs 66.64-70.04 秒）。在 CAMELYON16 官方测试集上，Traj-GRPO 达到 22.45% 的定位率（将 12 个访问过的肿瘤中的 11 个，即 91.7%，转化为有依据的停止），特异性为 93.75%，切片准确率为 69.77%，在相同停止规则下超越第一阶段 SFT，并支持零样本预算扩展。
translation.brief: 解决千兆像素病理图像上多步 VLM 导航智能体解码延迟高和停止策略有偏的问题，采用单次前向预测决策分布加轨迹级 GRPO 强化学习的方法。

papers.title: Where Does a Weight-Editing Agent Help? Blind Diagnosis and Repair of Deployment Faults in Vision Models
papers.abstract: Language-model agents can read and edit the weights of neural networks without gradients, and this is increasingly presented as a new way of repairing models. We ask what such an agent adds, in a setting with a known answer. A vision model moved into a new system may be broken by a preprocessing, weight-conversion or output-convention fault; an agent restricted to forward passes must decide whether a fault exists, name it, and undo it by editing the weights. Over 183 runs on classification, segmentation and detection, scored against the fault-free model, we find three things. When the kind of fault is known, the agent is not needed: a script written afterwards repairs 30 of 48 faults against the agent's 33. But the agent did not have to be told: on five fault types outside every script it repairs 15 of 15 where that script repairs 4, and it never edits any of 21 fault-free models. And its limits are predictable: it needs a trustworthy per-layer reference for the model's activations and a fault that is an invertible structured transformation; without them, small faults are missed and repairs stay partial. We derive guidance on when to use an agent and when a script.

translation.title: 权重编辑智能体在何处有用？视觉模型部署故障的盲诊断与修复
translation.abstract: 语言模型智能体可以在无梯度的情况下读取和编辑神经网络权重，这日益被呈现为一种修复模型的新方式。我们探究此类智能体在一个答案已知的场景中能带来什么。迁移到新系统中的视觉模型可能因预处理、权重转换或输出约定故障而失效；一个仅限于前向传播的智能体必须判断是否存在故障、命名该故障，并通过编辑权重将其撤销。在分类、分割和检测任务上进行的 183 次运行中，以无故障模型为基准评分，我们得到三点发现。当故障类型已知时，并不需要智能体：事后编写的脚本可修复 48 个故障中的 30 个，而智能体修复 33 个。但智能体无需被告知故障类型：对于五种超出所有脚本范围的故障类型，它修复了 15 个中的 15 个，而脚本仅修复 4 个，且它从未对 21 个无故障模型进行任何编辑。其局限也是可预测的：它需要模型激活的可信逐层参考，且故障须为可逆的结构化变换；否则小故障会被漏检，修复也只能部分完成。我们据此给出了何时使用智能体、何时使用脚本的指导。
translation.brief: 研究无梯度权重编辑智能体能否盲诊断并修复视觉模型的部署故障，通过大规模受控实验对比智能体与脚本修复能力并归纳其适用条件。

papers.title: 3DCodeFactory: Scaling Training Data for 3D Code Agents
papers.abstract: As code agents evolve, their scope is expanding from generating simple static 3D meshes to constructing structurally complete, complex, interactive 3D scenes. However, existing datasets mainly rely on converting or captioning pre-existing 3D assets, consisting mostly of single-turn code data for static single objects and struggling to scale task diversity and scene complexity, leaving such training data scarce. We present 3DCodeFactory, an automated framework that directly constructs diverse, complex 3D training data from abundant raw text (e.g., diffusion prompts and product descriptions). The framework first leverages an image generator to synthesize 3D reference images from raw text as visual anchors, guiding the generation of concrete modeling specifications and interactive functional requirements; meanwhile, it jointly constructs visual, specification, and functional rubrics from the reference images and requirements to automatically score and filter multi-turn agent rollouts. Based on this framework, we release 3DCodeFactory-Data, comprising 5,045 high-quality task instances and multi-turn interaction trajectories. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.8-27B on 3DCodeFactory-Data significantly improves performance on BlenderWorld, P3D-Bench, and 3DCodeBench, consistently outperforming models trained on existing open-source 3D code datasets, with our 27B model further surpassing the same-series 2.4T flagship Qwen3.8-Max in overall performance.

translation.title: 3DCodeFactory：为 3D 代码智能体扩展训练数据
translation.abstract: 随着代码智能体的演进，其范围正从生成简单的静态 3D 网格扩展到构建结构完整、复杂且可交互的 3D 场景。然而，现有数据集主要依赖对既有 3D 资产的转换或描述，大多由面向静态单一对象的单轮代码数据组成，难以扩展任务多样性和场景复杂度，导致此类训练数据稀缺。我们提出 3DCodeFactory，一个直接从丰富的原始文本（如扩散提示词和产品描述）构建多样、复杂 3D 训练数据的自动化框架。该框架首先利用图像生成器从原始文本合成 3D 参考图像作为视觉锚点，引导生成具体的建模规范和交互式功能需求；同时，它从参考图像和需求中联合构建视觉、规范和功能评分标准，以自动评分和过滤多轮智能体 rollout。基于该框架，我们发布了 3DCodeFactory-Data，包含 5,045 个高质量任务实例和多轮交互轨迹。在 3DCodeFactory-Data 上微调 Qwen3.5-9B 和 Qwen3.8-27B，在 BlenderWorld、P3D-Bench 和 3DCodeBench 上的性能显著提升，持续超越在现有开源 3D 代码数据集上训练的模型，我们的 27B 模型在总体性能上进一步超越了同系列 2.4T 旗舰模型 Qwen3.8-Max。
translation.brief: 解决复杂交互式 3D 场景代码智能体训练数据稀缺的问题，提出从原始文本自动合成参考图像并构建评分标准以生成和过滤多轮训练数据的框架。

papers.title: DiscernBench: Evaluating Cooperative Discernment of LLM Agents in Institutional Settings
papers.abstract: The deployment of large language models in operational settings demands evaluation of judgment under institutional constraint. We introduce DiscernBench, a benchmark for evaluating cooperative discernment: the ability of an agent to determine whether to comply with, refuse, or escalate a request in an institutional setting. DiscernBench comprises scenarios derived from real-world incident reports across domains such as aviation, law enforcement, and emergency management. We evaluate eight LLMs across three decision-making configurations and analyze both final decisions and the intermediate judgments produced during multi-agent deliberation. Under disagreement, Final Responders exhibit model- and role-dependent aggregation patterns in which a lone specialist recommendation can disproportionately influence the collective decision, a phenomenon we term Minority-Signal Override. Role-specialized multi-agent deliberation raises average over-escalation from 3.79% under direct single-agent judgment to 28.27%, with the direction and magnitude of minority-signal influence varying substantially across models and specialist roles. These results reveal distinct collective decision behaviors that are not captured by final-answer accuracy alone. Trustworthy multi-agent systems therefore require evaluating not only individual specialist reasoning, but also how conflicting judgments are transformed into collective decisions. Code and data are available at this https URL.

translation.title: DiscernBench：评估 LLM 智能体在机构环境中的协作辨识能力
translation.abstract: 大语言模型在运营环境中的部署要求对其在机构约束下的判断力进行评估。我们提出 DiscernBench，一个用于评估协作辨识能力的基准：即智能体在机构环境中决定服从、拒绝还是上报请求的能力。DiscernBench 包含源自航空、执法和应急管理等领域的真实事件报告的场景。我们评估了八个 LLM 在三种决策配置下的表现，并分析了最终决策以及多智能体商议过程中产生的中间判断。在意见分歧时，最终响应者表现出依赖模型和角色的聚合模式，其中单个专家的推荐可能不成比例地影响集体决策，我们将这一现象称为少数信号覆盖。角色专门化的多智能体商议将平均过度上报率从单智能体直接判断下的 3.79% 提高到 28.27%，且少数信号影响的方向和幅度在不同模型和专家角色间差异显著。这些结果揭示了仅凭最终答案准确率无法捕捉的独特集体决策行为。因此，可信的多智能体系统不仅需要评估个体专家推理，还需要评估冲突判断如何转化为集体决策。代码和数据可在 https URL 获取。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 智能体在机构约束下服从/拒绝/上报判断缺乏评估的问题，构建基于真实事件报告的基准并分析多智能体商议中的集体决策行为。

papers.title: Synthetic EHR Generators Should Be Audited Like LLMs
papers.abstract: Synthetic electronic health record (EHR) generation is increasingly adopting large autoregressive models, yet privacy evaluation has not kept pace, relying heavily on similarity-based heuristics and aggregate metrics that can obscure patient-specific memorisation. We argue that these models should additionally undergo LLM-style memorisation audits at the level of individual patient records. We support this position by comparing membership-inference evaluations across four prominent autoregressive EHR generators, highlighting inconsistent evaluation practices in patient representations and attack procedures. We evaluate trajectory reconstruction from partial context and introduce randomly assigned patient-level canaries to distinguish memorised associations from clinical generalisation. We examine these methods in a GPT-2-style model deliberately overfit to 1,000 MIMIC-IV patient trajectories, creating a controlled setting in which memorisation should be readily detectable. The model systematically recovers training patients' canaries, and their trajectory reconstruction approaches perfect accuracy with increasing context. Held-out patients show no systematic canary recovery, while reconstruction remains low and improves only marginally with additional context. These experiments establish a positive-control baseline for further evaluation of these methods in realistically trained models.

translation.title: 合成电子健康记录生成器应像大语言模型一样接受审计
translation.abstract: 合成电子健康记录（EHR）生成正日益采用大型自回归模型，但隐私评估未能跟上步伐，仍严重依赖基于相似性的启发式方法和聚合指标，这些方法可能掩盖针对具体患者的记忆现象。我们主张这些模型还应像大语言模型那样，在单个患者记录层面接受记忆审计。为支持这一立场，我们比较了四个知名自回归EHR生成器的成员推断评估，指出在患者表示和攻击流程方面评估实践不一致。我们评估了从部分上下文重建轨迹的方法，并引入随机分配的患者级金丝雀（canary），以区分记忆的关联与临床泛化。我们在一个刻意对1,000条MIMIC-IV患者轨迹过拟合的GPT-2风格模型上检验这些方法，构建了一个记忆应易于被检测的受控环境。该模型系统性地恢复了训练患者的金丝雀，且随着上下文增加，其轨迹重建接近完美准确率。留出患者则没有系统性的金丝雀恢复，重建准确率保持较低，且仅随上下文增加略有提升。这些实验为在真实训练的模型上进一步评估这些方法建立了阳性对照基线。
translation.brief: 针对合成EHR生成器隐私评估不足的问题，提出在患者记录层面进行LLM式记忆审计，并通过患者级金丝雀和轨迹重建在过拟合的GPT-2模型上建立阳性对照基线。

papers.title: Pixel Auto-Encoder: Reconstructing Language Model Activations Through Pixel Art
papers.abstract: Interpreting the high-dimensional internal representations of large language models (LLMs) remains a challenging problem. Recent approaches have explored translating these representations into human-understandable forms, particularly natural language. In this work, we explore the use of images as an alternative target modality for interpreting LLM activations. As a first step toward this goal, we introduce Pixel Auto-Encoder, which converts intermediate LLM activations into $32 \times 32$, 32-color pixel art and reconstructs them for subsequent computation within the model. By encouraging the intermediate representations to resemble predefined concept images, we investigate whether LLM activations can be expressed visually while preserving the model's language capabilities. We find that the model can produce target-aligned images for some concepts, and that replacing pixel representations with concept images can influence next-token predictions. However, we also observe a trade-off between visual alignment and language-model performance, as well as sensitivity to pixel-level changes that are difficult to interpret visually. These findings demonstrate the feasibility and limitations of image-based representations of LLM activations.

translation.title: 像素自编码器：通过像素画重建语言模型激活
translation.abstract: 解释大语言模型（LLM）的高维内部表示仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题。近期方法探索将这些表示转换为人类可理解的形式，尤其是自然语言。在本工作中，我们探索使用图像作为解释LLM激活的另一种目标模态。作为实现该目标的第一步，我们提出Pixel Auto-Encoder，它将LLM的中间激活转换为32×32、32色的像素画并重建它们，以供模型内的后续计算使用。通过促使中间表示接近预定义的概念图像，我们研究LLM激活能否在保持模型语言能力的同时以视觉方式表达。我们发现模型可以为某些概念生成与目标对齐的图像，并且用概念图像替换像素表示能够影响下一个词的预测。然而，我们也观察到视觉对齐与语言模型性能之间存在权衡，以及对难以从视觉上解释的像素级变化的敏感性。这些发现展示了基于图像的LLM激活表示的可行性与局限性。
translation.brief: 针对LLM内部激活难以解释的问题，提出Pixel Auto-Encoder将激活转换为像素画并重建，探索图像作为解释模态的可行性与局限。

papers.title: Hidden Sensitivity in LLM Pre-training: A Dynamic System View
papers.abstract: In Large Language Model (LLM) pre-training, loss curves can conceal substantial instability, i.e., even small perturbations may lead to dramatically different predictions while leaving loss nearly unchanged. To investigate this phenomenon and reveal the underlying mechanisms, we first formulate LLM pre-training as a non-autonomous dynamical system that jointly evolves model weights and Adam optimizer states. Based on this formulation, we introduce a normalized sensitivity score in optimizer-relative coordinates to identify sensitive training checkpoints. At one such checkpoint, a weight perturbation of only 10^(-5) leads to 35.7% disagreement in top-1 predictions and 16.2% disagreement in benchmark answers after 200 training steps, with only 0.8% of greedy generations remaining identical despite similar validation losses. Furthermore, we find that perturbations to Adam's first and second moments induce comparably large effects, with similar sensitivity patterns observed in OLMo-1B. Finally, guided by our diagnostic, targeted stabilization reduces top-1 disagreement to 0.83% and increases generation exact match to 88.3%, at the cost of a 0.11-nat increase in validation loss. Our findings reveal a hidden form of optimizer-state-dependent sensitivity in LLM pre-training that conventional loss-based evaluations may overlook, while demonstrating its potential for diagnosis and mitigation.

translation.title: 大语言模型预训练中的隐藏敏感性：动态系统视角
translation.abstract: 在大语言模型（LLM）预训练中，损失曲线可能掩盖显著的不稳定性，即微小的扰动可能导致截然不同的预测，而损失几乎不变。为研究这一现象并揭示其内在机制，我们首先将LLM预训练表述为一个联合演化模型权重和Adam优化器状态的非自治动力系统。基于该表述，我们在优化器相对坐标中引入归一化敏感性分数，以识别敏感的训练检查点。在其中一个检查点，仅10^(-5)的权重扰动在200个训练步后导致35.7%的top-1预测不一致和16.2%的基准答案不一致，尽管验证损失相近，但仅有0.8%的贪心生成结果保持一致。此外，我们发现对Adam一阶和二阶矩的扰动也会引起相当大的影响，且在OLMo-1B中观察到类似的敏感性模式。最后，在我们的诊断指导下，针对性的稳定化将top-1不一致率降至0.83%，并将生成精确匹配率提升至88.3%，代价是验证损失增加0.11 nat。我们的发现揭示了LLM预训练中一种依赖优化器状态的隐藏敏感性，这是传统基于损失的评估可能忽视的，同时展示了其在诊断与缓解方面的潜力。
translation.brief: 针对LLM预训练中损失曲线掩盖的不稳定性问题，将预训练建模为动力系统并提出归一化敏感性分数来诊断和缓解优化器状态相关的隐藏敏感性。

papers.title: Operational Assurance for LLM-Based Systems under Governance Opacity
papers.abstract: In the contemporary artificial intelligence ecosystem, foundation models are increasingly deployed under AI-as-a-Service (AIaaS) schemes characterized by high technical opacity, technological concentration, and limited external auditing capability over governance, training, and internal operational processes. Under these conditions, traditional ethical oversight approaches that focus exclusively on corporate governance or on internal model inspection become insufficient to ensure effective control over AI systems deployed in real-world contexts. This work proposes a pragmatic operational assurance framework inspired by Zero-Trust principles from cybersecurity, which shifts effective auditing efforts toward the application layer, where risk acquires observable, contextualized, and operationally verifiable properties. The proposal articulates two complementary evaluation levels: a black-box evaluation aimed at characterizing general behaviors, vulnerabilities, and risky capabilities of foundation models through conversational scanning, and a grey-box evaluation focused on the operational contextualization of risk within the actual deployment environment of the audited application. The framework incorporates mechanisms to move from general, CVSS-inspired severity metrics toward contextualized operational risk assessments that take into account user profiles, industrial domains, and organizational knowledge. In addition, the proposal strengthens practical auditability through digitally signed explainability reports (signed XAI reports), designed to support verifiable traceability, continuous monitoring, and operational accountability in LLM-based sociotechnical systems.

translation.title: 治理不透明环境下基于LLM系统的运行保障
translation.abstract: 在当代人工智能生态系统中，基础模型越来越多地以AI即服务（AIaaS）模式部署，其特点是高度技术不透明、技术集中，以及对治理、训练和内部运营流程的外部审计能力有限。在这些条件下，仅关注企业治理或内部模型检查的传统伦理监督方法，已不足以确保对部署在真实环境中的AI系统进行有效控制。本工作提出一个受网络安全零信任原则启发的务实运行保障框架，将有效审计工作转向应用层，在应用层风险具有可观察、情境化和可运行验证的属性。该方案包含两个互补的评估层级：黑盒评估，旨在通过对话扫描刻画基础模型的一般行为、漏洞和风险能力；灰盒评估，聚焦于在被审计应用的实际部署环境中对风险进行运行层面的情境化。该框架引入了从通用的、受CVSS启发的严重性度量向情境化运行风险评估过渡的机制，后者考虑用户画像、行业领域和组织知识。此外，该方案通过数字签名的可解释性报告（signed XAI reports）强化了实际可审计性，旨在支持基于LLM的社会技术系统中的可验证追溯、持续监控和运行问责。
translation.brief: 针对AIaaS模式下基础模型治理不透明、难以审计的问题，提出基于零信任原则的应用层运行保障框架，结合黑盒与灰盒评估及签名XAI报告实现可验证问责。

papers.title: AgriManager: A Framework and Benchmark for LLM-RL Generalization in Agricultural Management
papers.abstract: Agricultural management is heterogeneous along two axes. The first is distributional shift within a fixed task interface: weather, crops, and prices vary across years and locations while sensors, actions, and objective stay fixed. The second is structural shift across interfaces: different farms expose different observed variables, available actions, and management objectives. We formalize the second axis as schema shift: variation in the policy-facing schema $\Sigma = (\Sigma_O, \Sigma_A, \Sigma_R)$ between training and deployment. We test whether LLM-RL generalizes across both axes with AgriManager, to our knowledge the first framework that trains LLM policies with RL across multiple process-based crop simulators, unifying DSSAT, WOFOST, and Cycles. We design a three-tier generalization ladder: Tier 1 within-schema distributional shift, Tier 2 single-axis schema shift along $\Sigma_O / \Sigma_A / \Sigma_R$, Tier 3 compositional schema shift across simulators, all scored on a frozen held-out test suite with three training seeds per method. Within fixed schemas, Qwen3-4B trained by RL with explicit reasoning exceeds neural-network PPO trained with the same interaction budget; without reasoning, training stalls near no-action where the reward penalizes input use. Under single-axis schema shift, $\Sigma_O$ transfer needs decision-critical state, $\Sigma_A$ results are consistent with joint action-menu coverage, and with reasoning a policy trained on yield alone transfers to unseen objectives. Under compositional schema shift, single-source training mostly hurts zero-shot transfer across simulators, and a unified policy trained only on other combinations of the same components recovers about 86% of the gain of a specialist trained on the target combination on DSSAT and stays below the specialists on the WOFOST and Cycles profit targets. Project page: this https URL

translation.title: AgriManager：面向农业管理中LLM-RL泛化的框架与基准
translation.abstract: 农业管理在两个维度上具有异质性。其一是固定任务接口内的分布偏移：天气、作物和价格随年份和地点变化，而传感器、动作和目标保持不变。其二是跨接口的结构偏移：不同农场暴露不同的观测变量、可用动作和管理目标。我们将第二个维度形式化为模式偏移（schema shift）：即训练与部署之间策略面对的模式 Σ = (Σ_O, Σ_A, Σ_R) 的变化。我们通过AgriManager检验LLM-RL能否在两个维度上泛化，据我们所知，这是首个跨多个基于过程的作物模拟器（统一DSSAT、WOFOST和Cycles）用RL训练LLM策略的框架。我们设计了三级泛化阶梯：Tier 1为模式内分布偏移，Tier 2为沿Σ_O/Σ_A/Σ_R的单轴模式偏移，Tier 3为跨模拟器的组合模式偏移，全部在冻结的留出测试套件上评分，每种方法使用三个训练种子。在固定模式下，经RL训练并带显式推理的Qwen3-4B超过了在相同交互预算下训练的神经网络PPO；没有推理时，训练停滞在无动作附近，此时奖励惩罚投入品使用。在单轴模式偏移下，Σ_O迁移需要决策关键状态，Σ_A结果与联合动作菜单覆盖一致，且带推理时仅以产量为目标的策略可迁移到未见过的目标。在组合模式偏移下，单源训练大多损害跨模拟器的零样本迁移，而仅在相同组件的其他组合上训练的统一策略，在DSSAT上可恢复约86%的专家策略增益，但在WOFOST和Cycles利润目标上低于专家策略。项目页面：this https URL
translation.brief: 针对农业管理中分布偏移与模式偏移两类泛化问题，构建统一DSSAT、WOFOST和Cycles的AgriManager框架与三级泛化基准，用RL训练带推理的LLM策略并系统评估其泛化能力。

papers.title: EA-Bench: Measuring information and action efficiency under imperfect instructions
papers.abstract: Personal agents help users complete everyday work across digital applications. Many standard benchmarks assume that users provide sufficient information to solve a task. However, agents often encounter incomplete, distracting, or inconsistent information in practice. To systematically study agent inefficiency under such imperfect information, we introduce Efficient Action (EA)-Bench, which evaluates both tool calls and user interactions in work-related tasks. To our knowledge, it is the first benchmark to jointly evaluate tool-call efficiency and user-interaction efficiency under controlled missing, redundant, and conflicting information. We construct 63 base-task instances adapted from existing work-related benchmarks. To guide perturbation design and quantify task requirements, we represent workflows as directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) and examine node-level dependencies to identify where information can be withheld, contradicted, or supplemented with distractors. We use a two-stage validation process combining AI-assisted checks with expert screening to select 232 conditions from 792 initial candidates. We organize these tasks into Easy and Hard tracks by task complexity. Experiments show that imperfect information can reduce accuracy and increase tool-use and user-interaction costs. More concerning, several models obtain apparently correct outcomes by guessing user-specific values without confirmation, revealing potential execution unreliability in current models under imperfect user information.

translation.title: EA-Bench：在不完美指令下度量信息与动作效率
translation.abstract: 个人智能体帮助用户在数字应用中完成日常工作。许多标准基准假设用户提供了解决任务所需的充分信息，但实践中智能体常常遇到不完整、有干扰或不一致的信息。为系统研究智能体在此类不完美信息下的低效问题，我们提出高效动作（EA）-Bench，在工作相关任务中同时评估工具调用与用户交互。据我们所知，这是首个在受控的缺失、冗余和冲突信息条件下联合评估工具调用效率与用户交互效率的基准。我们基于现有工作相关基准构建了63个基础任务实例。为指导扰动设计并量化任务需求，我们将工作流表示为有向无环图（DAG），并检查节点级依赖关系，以确定可以在何处扣留信息、制造矛盾或加入干扰项。我们采用AI辅助检查与专家筛选相结合的两阶段验证流程，从792个初始候选中选出232个条件，并按任务复杂度划分为Easy和Hard两条赛道。实验表明，不完美信息会降低准确率并增加工具使用与用户交互成本。更令人担忧的是，若干模型在未经确认的情况下通过猜测用户特定取值而获得表面正确的结果，揭示了当前模型在不完美用户信息下潜在的执行不可靠性。
translation.brief: 针对不完整、冗余或冲突信息下智能体效率缺乏评估的问题，提出基于DAG工作流建模、联合评估工具调用与用户交互效率的EA-Bench基准。

papers.title: CivilCADBench: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs for Understanding, Reconstructing, and Designing Civil Engineering Drawing Sets
papers.abstract: Civil infrastructure is designed, built, and maintained through engineering drawing sets, yet preparing and revising them remains labour-intensive and calls for automation. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are promising candidates, but assessing them requires a benchmark grounded in real engineering practice. We introduce CivilCADBench, a benchmark for understanding, reconstructing, and designing civil engineering drawing sets, built from real infrastructure drawings and source CAD files containing over 250,000 CAD entities. Unlike parametric 3D CAD models, these drawings are dense, layered, and multi-sheet; and since prints are lossy projections with no pixel trace of layers, a file can print correctly yet remain wrongly organised. CivilCADBench comprises three task families of increasing difficulty: understanding tasks are evaluated with 2,183 expert-reviewed questions ranging from single sheets to whole sets, while reconstruction and design tasks are agentic, requiring models to rebuild printed pages as editable CAD files, either as single pages or entire drawing sets, and to produce new designs. These tasks are performed across 232 pages, 28 sets, and 19 design tasks, and evaluated by a deterministic scorer that compares model outputs with the designers' source files on geometry, layers, text, and dimensions. We evaluate seven frontier MLLMs on CivilCADBench, and find that they read and redraw printed content accurately but recover the file structure poorly: the best model scores above 90% in understanding and single-page reconstruction, yet only 60% on layer assignment and 48% on design. Grounded in real engineering practice, CivilCADBench exposes both the capabilities and the limitations of frontier models in professional civil engineering, laying a foundation for next-generation models and agentic systems for intelligent civil engineering.

translation.title: CivilCADBench：面向土木工程图纸集理解、重建与设计的多模态大语言模型基准
translation.abstract: 民用基础设施通过工程图纸集进行设计、建造和维护，但图纸的编制与修改仍然耗费人力，亟需自动化。多模态大语言模型（MLLM）是有希望的候选方案，但评估它们需要一个扎根于真实工程实践的基准。我们提出CivilCADBench，一个用于理解、重建和设计土木工程图纸集的基准，其构建自真实基础设施图纸和包含超过25万个CAD实体的源CAD文件。与参数化3D CAD模型不同，这些图纸密集、分层且多页；由于打印件是有损投影、不保留图层的像素痕迹，一个文件可能打印正确但组织错误。CivilCADBench包含三个难度递增的任务族：理解任务通过2,183道经专家审核的问题进行评估，范围从单张图纸到整套图纸；重建与设计任务是智能体式的，要求模型将打印页面重建为可编辑的CAD文件（单页或整套图纸），并生成新设计。这些任务覆盖232页、28套图纸和19个设计任务，并由一个确定性评分器在几何、图层、文本和尺寸维度上将模型输出与设计师的源文件进行对比评估。我们在CivilCADBench上评估了七个前沿MLLM，发现它们能准确读取和重绘打印内容，但恢复文件结构的能力很差：最佳模型在理解和单页重建上得分超过90%，但在图层分配上仅60%，设计任务仅48%。CivilCADBench扎根于真实工程实践，揭示了前沿模型在专业土木工程中的能力与局限，为下一代智能土木工程模型和智能体系统奠定了基础。
translation.brief: 针对多模态大模型在真实土木工程图纸理解、重建与设计上缺乏评估基准的问题，构建基于真实CAD源文件的CivilCADBench，用确定性评分器评估模型对几何、图层、文本和尺寸的还原能力。

papers.title: Bias Cascade: Understanding the Gap Between Knowledge Alignment and Effect Replication in LLM-based Social Simulation
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate participants in social experiments. Existing research has primarily focused on aligning social knowledge and isolated responses, while overlooking whether simulations can reproduce the collective effects of social interventions. This distinction is critical due to a failure mechanism we call a $bias$ $cascade$: similar individual states can lead to different actions, while agreement on isolated actions can still produce divergent outcomes through dynamic interactions. As a result, models may produce accurate social judgments yet fail to reproduce the outcomes of classic human studies. To investigate this problem empirically, we introduce $REFLEX$ (Reproducing Effects of Foundational Literature EXperiments), a benchmark of 30 counterfactual social experiments grounded in classic human studies that compares knowledge judgment with effect simulation. Knowledge judgment directly predicts the direction of an intervention's effect, whereas effect simulation fixes the scenario and participants while varying one prespecified social factor, with agents generating actions from local observations that are aggregated into macro-level average treatment effects. Compared with human-study findings, the best-performing model achieves net directional scores of 0.847 for knowledge judgment and 0.453 for effect simulation. Moreover, longer causal chains are associated with poorer effect replication, consistent with the bias-cascade hypothesis. These findings reveal a substantial gap between knowledge alignment and effect replication, showing that current methods remain inadequate for reliably simulating collective human behavior.

translation.title: 偏差级联：理解基于LLM的社会模拟中知识对齐与效应复现之间的差距
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于模拟社会实验中的参与者。现有研究主要关注社会知识与孤立响应的对齐，而忽视了模拟是否能复现社会干预的集体效应。这一区分至关重要，原因在于我们称之为“偏差级联”的失效机制：相似的个体状态可能导致不同的行动，而对孤立行动的一致仍可能通过动态交互产生分歧的结果。因此，模型可能做出准确的社会判断，却无法复现经典人类研究的结果。为实证研究这一问题，我们提出REFLEX（Reproducing Effects of Foundational Literature EXperiments），一个基于经典人类研究、包含30个反事实社会实验的基准，用于比较知识判断与效应模拟。知识判断直接预测干预效应的方向，而效应模拟固定场景与参与者、仅改变一个预先设定的社会因素，由智能体根据局部观察生成行动，并聚合为宏观层面的平均处理效应。与人类研究结果相比，表现最佳的模型在知识判断上的净方向得分为0.847，而在效应模拟上仅为0.453。此外，更长的因果链对应更差的效应复现，与偏差级联假设一致。这些发现揭示了知识对齐与效应复现之间的显著差距，表明当前方法仍不足以可靠地模拟集体人类行为。
translation.brief: 针对LLM社会模拟中知识判断准确但无法复现社会干预集体效应的问题，提出“偏差级联”失效机制并构建REFLEX基准加以实证检验。

papers.title: Thakaa at StanceEval-2026: Inference-Time Target Grounding for Arabic Stance Detection
papers.abstract: StanceEval-2026 tests Arabic stance classification under target shift, with evaluation targets absent from the labelled task data. We test two ways to supply target information at inference time. For Track 1, we retrieve eight labelled Women Driving demonstrations from the external ArabicStanceX corpus and score the three label tokens with Gemma-4-31B-IT. For the unseen-target track, we prepend cached target context prompted to be factual and non-evaluative, then fuse label predictions and label-token scores from multiple LLMs, with final assignments constrained by published class totals. The systems obtain 85.22 and 91.78 Favg2 on Tracks 1 and 2, ranking sixth and fourth in the final standings. On held-out ArabicStanceX tweets, direct prompting scores 79.45 Favg2; eight random Women Driving demonstrations raise it to 84.78, and similarity retrieval reaches 89.04. Across three target-held-out Mawqif evaluations, a fixed target card raises Gemma-4-31B-IT from 86.54 to 86.93, whereas QLoRA lowers Gemma-4-12B-IT from 84.43 to 83.77. In these separate public evaluations, same-target demonstrations and retrieval improve performance, factual target context provides small, target-dependent gains, and the tested source-only adapter does not improve.

translation.title: Thakaa在StanceEval-2026：面向阿拉伯语立场检测的推理时目标锚定
translation.abstract: StanceEval-2026在目标偏移条件下测试阿拉伯语立场分类，评估目标未出现在带标注的任务数据中。我们测试了两种在推理时提供目标信息的方法。对于赛道1，我们从外部ArabicStanceX语料库检索八条带标注的Women Driving示例，并用Gemma-4-31B-IT对三个标签词元打分。对于未见目标赛道，我们在输入前拼接经提示要求事实性且非评价性的缓存目标上下文，然后融合多个LLM的标签预测与标签词元得分，最终分配受已公布的类别总数约束。两个系统在赛道1和赛道2上分别取得85.22和91.78的Favg2，最终排名第六和第四。在留出的ArabicStanceX推文上，直接提示得分为79.45 Favg2；八条随机的Women Driving示例将其提升至84.78，相似度检索则达到89.04。在三个目标留出的Mawqif评估中，固定的目标卡片使Gemma-4-31B-IT从86.54提升至86.93，而QLoRA使Gemma-4-12B-IT从84.43降至83.77。在这些独立的公开评估中，同目标示例和检索能提升性能，事实性目标上下文带来小幅且依赖目标的增益，而所测试的仅源数据适配器没有改进。
translation.brief: 针对阿拉伯语立场检测中评估目标未出现在训练数据的目标偏移问题，采用推理时检索同目标示例并融合多LLM标签词元得分的方法。

papers.title: Postpartum Sense-Making and AI in a Fragmented Care System
papers.abstract: Postpartum women must navigate health information across a fragmented landscape of clinicians, peers, online communities, influencers, and, increasingly, large language models (LLMs). Existing evaluations of LLMs in health contexts primarily ask whether systems provide accurate, safe, and readable information. We argue that these criteria, while essential, are insufficient for understanding how LLMs may affect postpartum care. LLMs enter an information ecology in which women are already required to reconcile competing forms of expertise, determine whether their experiences are normal or concerning, and decide when and where to seek care. At the same time, online representations of motherhood and femininity shape which postpartum experiences are made visible and what forms of self-management are expected of women. Drawing together research on postpartum care gaps, online help-seeking, influencer cultures, gendered responsibility, and AI-supported health information, we position LLMs as emerging intermediaries within this broader care infrastructure. We argue that evaluating postpartum AI requires examining not only information quality, but also how these systems shape epistemic coordination, transitions to formal care, and the distribution of responsibility for making fragmented systems of care work.

translation.title: 碎片化照护体系中的产后意义建构与AI
translation.abstract: 产后女性必须在碎片化的信息环境中穿行于临床医生、同伴、在线社区、网红博主，以及日益增多的大语言模型（LLM）之间。现有对LLM在健康场景中的评估主要关注系统是否提供准确、安全和可读的信息。我们认为，这些标准虽然必不可少，但不足以理解LLM可能如何影响产后照护。LLM进入了一个信息生态，在其中女性本就需要调和相互竞争的专业知识形式、判断自身经历是正常还是值得担忧，并决定何时何地寻求照护。与此同时，网络上对母职与女性气质的呈现塑造了哪些产后经历被看见，以及女性被期待采取何种自我管理方式。综合关于产后照护缺口、在线求助、网红文化、性别化责任以及AI辅助健康信息的研究，我们将LLM定位为这一更广泛照护基础设施中的新兴中介。我们认为，评估产后AI不仅需要考察信息质量，还需要考察这些系统如何塑造认知协调、向正式照护的过渡，以及让碎片化照护体系得以运转的责任分配。
translation.brief: 针对现有健康LLM评估仅关注信息准确性而忽视照护情境的问题，从认知协调、照护过渡与责任分配等角度提出评估产后AI的更全面框架。

papers.title: Eidetic Code World Model
papers.abstract: Executable code can preserve a world's structural layout, yet video renderers frequently alter the appearance of previously visited places once they leave the camera view. We present Paintress, a code-conditioned world model that couples an executable geometric proxy with an independently parameterized 3D Gaussian appearance memory in a shared metric coordinate frame. While the proxy enforces structural and visibility constraints, 3D Gaussians capture the visual realization synthesized by emitted observations. To balance stable incremental fusion with consistent readout, Paintress separates writing from reading: newly emitted frames update a persistent raw Gaussian map under confidence-gated selection, whereas a cloned reader copy is globally refined against the observation archive and rendered with coverage masks to condition generation. We also introduce Expedition-33, a benchmark for generated-appearance retention across 11 static scenes, five route families, and 15, 30, and 60 s target absences (165 settings per system). Excluded from the opening image, targets are synthesized during a shared prefix and scored against each system's own first visit at matched return cameras. Across ten systems (1,650 videos), Paintress achieves 0.1220 ROI-LPIPS, 0.0613 MAE, and 52.12% detail retention (vs. 0.2731, 0.1401, and 10.91% for CWM), with lower discrepancy at 60 s (0.1630) than CWM, AgentGarten, and Lyra 2.0 achieve at 15 s.

translation.title: Eidetic Code 世界模型
translation.abstract: 可执行代码能够保留世界的结构布局，但视频渲染器在相机离开视野后常常改变已访问地点的外观。我们提出 Paintress，一个代码条件化的世界模型，它在共享的度量坐标系中将可执行的几何代理与独立参数化的 3D Gaussian 外观记忆耦合起来。代理负责施加结构与可见性约束，而 3D Gaussians 则捕获由发射观测合成的视觉实现。为了在稳定的增量融合与一致的读取之间取得平衡，Paintress 将写入与读取分离：新发射的帧在置信度门控选择下更新一个持久的原始 Gaussian 地图，而一个克隆的读取副本则针对观测档案进行全局精炼，并使用覆盖掩码渲染以条件化生成。我们还引入 Expedition-33，一个用于评估生成外观保持能力的基准，涵盖 11 个静态场景、五类路线族以及 15、30 和 60 秒的目标缺席时长（每个系统 165 种设置）。目标被排除在开场图像之外，在共享前缀期间合成，并在匹配的返回相机处对照每个系统自己的首次访问进行评分。在十个系统（1,650 个视频）中，Paintress 达到 0.1220 ROI-LPIPS、0.0613 MAE 和 52.12% 的细节保持率（相比之下 CWM 为 0.2731、0.1401 和 10.91%），且在 60 秒时的差异（0.1630）低于 CWM、AgentGarten 和 Lyra 2.0 在 15 秒时的表现。
translation.brief: 解决世界模型在相机离开后遗忘已访问场景外观的问题，方法是将可执行几何代理与独立参数化的 3D Gaussian 外观记忆耦合，并分离写入与读取过程。

papers.title: FormaFin: Verifiable Financial Analysis with Solver-Guided Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Formally verifying financial analyses generated by large language models (LLMs) remains challenging as financial rules are largely expressed in natural language and rarely have corresponding formal specifications. Training language models to formalize these rules is hindered by the scarcity of labeled data and reliable training signals, while confidential financial data favor small models that run locally. We introduce FormaFin, a framework that trains small open language models to translate financial rules into reusable SMT formulas. FormaFin integrates teacher distillation with reinforcement learning using an SMT solver to compute rewards from numerical thresholds stated in financial rules. We evaluate FormaFin on corporate loan monitoring, in which lenders check borrowers' financial figures against loan agreements. To evaluate our framework, we curate \bench{}, a benchmark containing 143 loan agreements and 2,527 questions covering compliance, earnings cushion, and debt capacity. Our results show that a 7B formalizer achieves 94.8\% accuracy, outperforming open LLMs up to ten times larger. Across three model families, accuracy ranges from 92.6 to 96.8\%. Our framework also detects 95.6 to 99.7\% of errors in other LLMs' financial analyses. We make FormaFin and \bench{} publicly available.

translation.title: FormaFin：基于求解器引导强化学习的可验证金融分析
translation.abstract: 对大语言模型（LLM）生成的金融分析进行形式化验证仍然具有挑战性，因为金融规则大多以自然语言表达，很少具有对应的形式化规范。训练语言模型将这些规则形式化受到标注数据稀缺和训练信号不可靠的阻碍，而机密金融数据则倾向于使用可在本地运行的小模型。我们提出 FormaFin，一个训练小型开源语言模型将金融规则转化为可复用 SMT 公式的框架。FormaFin 将教师蒸馏与强化学习相结合，利用 SMT 求解器根据金融规则中陈述的数值阈值计算奖励。我们在企业贷款监控场景下评估 FormaFin，即贷方根据贷款协议检查借款人的财务数据。为评估该框架，我们构建了 \bench{}，一个包含 143 份贷款协议和 2,527 个问题的基准，涵盖合规性、盈利缓冲和债务容量。结果表明，一个 7B 的形式化模型达到 94.8% 的准确率，优于规模大十倍的开源 LLM。在三个模型家族中，准确率范围为 92.6% 至 96.8%。我们的框架还能检测出其他 LLM 金融分析中 95.6% 至 99.7% 的错误。我们公开了 FormaFin 和 \bench{}。
translation.brief: 解决金融规则缺乏形式化规范、难以验证 LLM 金融分析的问题，方法是用教师蒸馏结合 SMT 求解器提供奖励的强化学习训练小模型将规则转化为 SMT 公式。

papers.title: StudioBench: Benchmarking Agentic Multimodal Large Language Models for Productive Audiovisual Creation
papers.abstract: Video generators can now render convincing short clips, yet complete audiovisual works require coordinating visuals, sound, and editing across multiple stages. Existing benchmarks focus on individual generators or video agents under narrower production settings, leaving end-to-end creation by general multimodal large language models (MLLMs) underexplored. We introduce StudioBench, a benchmark comprising 160 tasks across eight video genres and five task types, spanning diverse audiovisual production requirements. Models produce minutes of finished audiovisual content using 33 atomic generation, editing, and inspection tools, without shell access or workflow templates. We evaluate the delivered films, while analyzing reconstructed workflow graphs to characterize production behavior and diagnose failures. Across seven MLLMs, explicit requirements are nearly saturated, yet production quality varies substantially in picture clarity and composition, object structure, motion, and lip sync. All models spontaneously organize multi-stage production workflows without predefined templates. However, higher-quality models exhibit more selective production workflows, whereas additional tool calls alone show little association with quality. These findings identify the missing quality loop of effective inspection, selection, and revision as a key bottleneck in productive audiovisual creation.

translation.title: StudioBench：面向生产级视听创作的智能体多模态大语言模型基准
translation.abstract: 视频生成器如今可以渲染出令人信服的短片段，但完整的视听作品需要在多个阶段协调视觉、声音和剪辑。现有基准聚焦于单个生成器或较窄制作设置下的视频智能体，对通用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的端到端创作探索不足。我们提出 StudioBench，一个包含 160 个任务、覆盖八种视频类型和五种任务类型的基准，涵盖多样的视听制作需求。模型使用 33 个原子化的生成、编辑和检查工具制作数分钟的成品视听内容，且无法访问 shell 或工作流模板。我们评估交付的影片，并通过分析重建的工作流图来刻画生产行为和诊断失败。在七个 MLLM 上，显式要求几乎被满足，但在画面清晰度与构图、物体结构、运动和口型同步方面的制作质量差异显著。所有模型都能在没有预定义模板的情况下自发组织多阶段制作工作流。然而，质量更高的模型表现出更具选择性的制作工作流，而单纯增加工具调用次数与质量几乎没有关联。这些发现表明，有效检查、选择和修订所缺失的质量闭环是生产级视听创作的关键瓶颈。
translation.brief: 解决通用 MLLM 端到端视听创作能力缺乏评估基准的问题，方法是构建包含 160 个任务、33 个原子工具的 StudioBench 并通过工作流图分析诊断失败。

papers.title: STRIDE: Strategy-to-Tactics Retrieval-Guided Skill Disclosure and Evolution for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Skill-augmented reinforcement learning enables LLM agents to reuse task-solving knowledge across episodes, but existing systems typically expose agents to a flat skill pool and update skills only from coarse, episode-level outcomes. This conflates two distinct uses of experience: a stable strategy that should frame the whole episode, and tactical know-how that should be retrieved only when the agent reaches a local execution gap. We propose STRIDE (Strategy-to-Tactics Retrieval-guided skIll Disclosure and Evolution), a framework that brings progressive skill disclosure into agentic reinforcement learning. STRIDE keeps the selected strategy visible as episode context, exposes a compact tactic menu, and loads full tactic content only after an explicit retrieval action. This interface turns each retrieval into an event-level credit unit: the same event provides process feedback for learning when to retrieve and supplies evidence for skill-bank evolution. On ALFWorld, STRIDE achieves a 92.7% average success rate with Qwen3-4B and a 94.9% average success rate with Qwen3-8B. On WebShop, it improves over the strongest reproduced skill-augmented baseline by 4.5 score points and 1.9 success-rate percentage points. These results show that skill reuse is most effective when persistent strategies preserve global task structure and tactics are disclosed only at local decision bottlenecks.

translation.title: STRIDE：面向智能体强化学习的策略到战术检索引导式技能披露与演化
translation.abstract: 技能增强的强化学习使 LLM 智能体能够在多个回合间复用任务求解知识，但现有系统通常让智能体面对一个扁平的技能池，并且仅从粗粒度的回合级结果更新技能。这混淆了经验的两种不同用途：应当贯穿整个回合的稳定策略，以及仅在智能体遇到局部执行缺口时才应检索的战术性诀窍。我们提出 STRIDE（Strategy-to-Tactics Retrieval-guided skIll Disclosure and Evolution），一个将渐进式技能披露引入智能体强化学习的框架。STRIDE 将选定的策略作为回合上下文保持可见，暴露一个紧凑的战术菜单，并且仅在显式检索动作之后才加载完整的战术内容。这一接口将每次检索转化为事件级的信用单元：同一事件既为学习何时检索提供过程反馈，也为技能库演化提供证据。在 ALFWorld 上，STRIDE 使用 Qwen3-4B 达到 92.7% 的平均成功率，使用 Qwen3-8B 达到 94.9% 的平均成功率。在 WebShop 上，它比最强的复现技能增强基线提升了 4.5 分和 1.9 个成功率百分点。这些结果表明，当持久的策略保留全局任务结构、而战术仅在局部决策瓶颈处披露时，技能复用最为有效。
translation.brief: 解决现有技能增强强化学习混淆回合级策略与局部战术、技能更新信号粗糙的问题，方法是将策略作为上下文常驻、战术仅在显式检索动作后加载，并把检索作为事件级信用单元。

papers.title: Ads for Agents: Measuring Ad-Serving MCP Servers
papers.abstract: AI agents call external tools through protocols such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Some MCP servers return paid advertisements (ads) into the model's context. The model then decides whether these ads and their disclosures reach the user. We trace these ads from their sources to the agent's tool results across public MCP servers and packages. We find the servers through their public traces in ad networks, package registries, certificate logs, hostnames, MCP directories, and GitHub configurations. We then query the ad-serving servers with read-only requests and inspect their ad links. Ads appear on only 0.57% of 101,363 open MCP endpoints and 0.04% of 122,656 local MCP packages. Although 173 ad networks target agents, operators insert the ads themselves on about half of the 226 ad-returning servers. Nearly all ad-serving packages likewise carry the operator's own affiliate identifier. While ads adapt to the topic and intent of the query, their disclosure stays fixed within each tool. Only 9.3% of the ads carry an explicit sponsored label. Most ad links also hide their destinations. Since operators insert most ads themselves and label them inconsistently, we propose a per-item ad annotation in MCP results. Clients can show this annotation to the user independently of the model's answer.

translation.title: 面向智能体的广告：测量广告投放 MCP 服务器
translation.abstract: AI 智能体通过 Model Context Protocol（MCP）等协议调用外部工具。一些 MCP 服务器会向模型上下文中返回付费广告。模型随后决定这些广告及其披露信息是否到达用户。我们在公开的 MCP 服务器和软件包中追踪这些广告从来源到智能体工具结果的路径。我们通过广告网络、软件包注册表、证书日志、主机名、MCP 目录和 GitHub 配置中的公开痕迹找到这些服务器。随后我们以只读请求查询投放广告的服务器，并检查其广告链接。在 101,363 个开放 MCP 端点中仅有 0.57%、在 122,656 个本地 MCP 软件包中仅有 0.04% 出现广告。尽管有 173 个广告网络以智能体为目标，但在 226 个返回广告的服务器中，约一半的广告是由运营者自行插入的。几乎所有投放广告的软件包同样携带运营者自己的联盟标识。虽然广告会根据查询的主题和意图进行调整，但其披露信息在每个工具内保持固定。仅有 9.3% 的广告带有明确的赞助标签。大多数广告链接还隐藏了其目的地。由于大多数广告由运营者自行插入且标注不一致，我们提出在 MCP 结果中进行逐条目的广告标注。客户端可以将该标注独立于模型的回答展示给用户。
translation.brief: 解决 MCP 服务器向智能体上下文注入广告且披露不一致、缺乏透明度的问题，方法是通过多渠道追踪广告来源并系统性测量，进而提出逐条目的广告标注方案。

papers.title: From Dense to Sparse: Morton-Ordered Sparse Mapping for Efficient 3D Mesh Generation
papers.abstract: Unified 3D understanding and generation require compact sequences preserving spatial structure. Dense grids yield long sequences, while serialization can separate spatial neighbors. We propose Sparse Proximity Aware Compression (SPAC), a shared sparse SDF vocabulary combining sparse encoding with reversible spatial merging. A Sparse SDF VQ-VAE quantizes near-surface features while retaining explicit coordinates, using reconstruction supervision for surface fidelity and detail. 3D Byte-Pair Encoding (3D-BPE) merges recurring face-adjacent patterns using relative offsets before serialization. Macro tokens expand exactly into leaf tokens and coordinates. After Morton serialization, a shared LLM reads geometry for captioning and predicts tokens that decode into meshes for text-conditioned generation. With fixed geometry, architecture, and band width in voxels, sparse encoder cost grows approximately quadratically with resolution. 3D-BPE reduces mean complete LLM sequence length by 45.4 percent, including coordinates, text, and control tokens. SPAC achieves strong results in both 3D captioning and text-conditioned mesh generation. Ablations show gains over leaf tokens and Morton 1D-BPE in both tasks. The project page at this https URL .

translation.title: 从稠密到稀疏：面向高效3D网格生成的Morton序稀疏映射
translation.abstract: 统一的3D理解与生成需要既紧凑又保留空间结构的序列。稠密网格会产生长序列，而序列化可能分离空间上相邻的元素。我们提出稀疏邻近感知压缩（SPAC），一种结合稀疏编码与可逆空间合并的共享稀疏SDF词表。Sparse SDF VQ-VAE在量化近表面特征的同时保留显式坐标，利用重建监督保证表面保真度与细节。3D字节对编码（3D-BPE）在序列化之前使用相对偏移合并重复出现的面相邻模式。宏token可精确展开为叶子token和坐标。经过Morton序列化后，一个共享LLM读取几何信息用于描述生成，并预测可解码为网格的token以实现文本条件生成。在几何、架构和体素带宽固定的情况下，稀疏编码器的开销随分辨率近似二次增长。3D-BPE将LLM完整序列（包括坐标、文本和控制token）的平均长度降低45.4%。SPAC在3D描述生成和文本条件网格生成两项任务上均取得优异结果。消融实验显示其在两项任务上均优于叶子token和Morton 1D-BPE。项目页面见此链接。
translation.brief: 解决3D统一理解与生成中序列过长且破坏空间结构的问题，提出结合稀疏SDF VQ-VAE与3D-BPE空间合并的SPAC压缩方法，并用共享LLM实现描述与文本到网格生成。

papers.title: Can Open LLMs Clear Sanctions-Screening Alerts? A Pre-registered Test on Public Sanctions Lists with Turkish Name Variants
papers.abstract: Sanctions screening raises name-based alerts that are mostly false positives, and level-1 analysts clear them by checking the customer's date of birth and name against a written policy. We test whether open-weight language models that a bank can run on its own premises can perform this level-1 disposition. From the UK and EU sanctions lists (7,103 natural persons) we built 12,200 synthetic customers: listed persons under six name conditions, including Turkish spellings of Arabic-origin names and Turkish romanisations of Cyrillic names, and two date-of-birth conditions, plus namesakes, near-name customers and a general population. A deterministic fuzzy and embedding screen raised 7,383 alerts, which three open models served on domestic infrastructure and three rule baselines dispositioned under the same policy. The models sent far fewer innocent customers to level 2 than a rule that applies the policy's date clause: 0.6 to 16.9 per 1,000 screened customers against 24.4, and they stated the date-of-birth status correctly in 98.3% to 98.5% of alerts. They also failed to escalate 1.5% to 2.2% of the listed persons. The pre-registered non-inferiority test against the rule was met, but only because of a construction error we found after the analysis: 21 customers in the "minor discrepancy" condition had dates that conflict under the policy. Without them the rule misses no listed person and no model meets the margin. The misses had model-specific causes: one model read minor date discrepancies as conflicts, one declared word-order and typing variants to be different names, and one discounted alerts that its own rationale said to escalate. Fuzzy matching found 69% of the Turkish spellings of Arabic-origin names; adding embeddings raised this to 74%. Open LLMs can cut level-1 workload, but on this evidence only behind a deterministic date check and with every name doubt escalated.

translation.title: 开源LLM能否处理制裁筛查警报？基于土耳其姓名变体的公开制裁名单预注册测试
translation.abstract: 制裁筛查会产生大量以姓名为基础的警报，其中多为误报，一级分析师需依据书面政策核对客户出生日期和姓名来处理这些警报。我们测试银行可在本地部署的开源权重语言模型能否胜任这一一级处置工作。基于英国和欧盟制裁名单（7,103名自然人），我们构建了12,200个合成客户：名单人员在六种姓名条件下出现，包括阿拉伯语源姓名的土耳其拼写和西里尔姓名的土耳其罗马化拼写，以及两种出生日期条件，另加同名者、近似姓名客户和普通人群。确定性模糊匹配与嵌入筛查共产生7,383条警报，由三个开源模型在本地基础设施上处置，三个规则基线在相同政策下处置。模型将无辜客户升级到二级的数量远低于应用政策日期条款的规则：每千名筛查客户中为0.6至16.9，而规则为24.4；模型在98.3%至98.5%的警报中正确陈述出生日期状态。但它们也漏掉了1.5%至2.2%的名单人员。针对规则的预注册非劣效性检验通过了，但这仅源于我们在分析后发现的一个构建错误："轻微差异"条件下的21名客户的日期在政策下存在冲突。剔除这些客户后，规则不会漏掉任何名单人员，也没有模型达到非劣效边界。漏报各有模型特异的原因：一个模型将轻微日期差异视为冲突，一个将词序和打字变体判定为不同姓名，一个则降级了其自身推理认为应升级的警报。模糊匹配找到69%的阿拉伯语源姓名土耳其拼写，加入嵌入后提升至74%。开源LLM可以减少一级工作量，但基于本证据，只有在确定性日期校验之后且对所有姓名疑点一律升级的前提下才可使用。
translation.brief: 测试开源LLM能否替代一级分析师处置制裁筛查警报，通过构建含土耳其姓名变体的合成客户数据集进行预注册非劣效性评估。

papers.title: When Rubrics Do Not Decide: Silent Value Completion in LLM Evaluation
papers.abstract: Multi-criterion LLM judges often evaluate responses without specifying how conflicting criteria resolve, leaving the winner undetermined even under exact criterion scores. Issuing a strict verdict without declaring the required trade-off premise constitutes silent value completion. We introduce TradeoffBench to isolate this failure by separating rule execution from response scoring. On authoritative criterion vectors, six open-weight non-reasoning judges pass all dominance and equality controls yet pick unsupported winners on 9%-81% of 1,345 conflicts. All 577 order-stable choices follow an explicitly banned majority rule. Reasoning-enabled configurations drop anonymous-vector violations to 2 in 9,720 judgments under an explicit rule, yet cannot bridge omitted trade-offs or divergent component scoring. On raw TradeoffBench text with unspecified trade-offs, GPT-6.1-sol omits its completion premise in 29.8% of 400 verified conflicts. Even under an explicit rule on four-rater-consensus MultiPref conflicts, four reasoning judges still issue strict verdicts on 16/45 (GPT-6.1-sol) up to 35/46 and 25/29 (open-weight judges) of valid presentations. We propose identified-first evaluation, decoupling specification support, explicit completion, and target agreement. In MultiPref human-score audits, peer-mean substitution raises directional disagreement from 0.6% to 28.8% on 2,707 shared targets. A single-peer ablation confirms a 29.38-point gap on 2,175 targets, ruling out averaging as the cause. In HUMAINE, declared partial trade-offs add 2.5 percentage points of coverage, yet newly decided pairs incur 3.9% disagreement versus 0.9% for Pareto. Reliable LLM judging, therefore, requires auditing, specification support, declared trade-offs, and human target agreement separately.

translation.title: 当评分标准无法裁决时：LLM评估中的隐性价值补全
translation.abstract: 多准则LLM评审在评估回复时往往不说明冲突准则如何取舍，即使准则分数完全确定，胜者仍无法判定。在不声明所需权衡前提的情况下给出严格裁决，即构成隐性价值补全。我们提出TradeoffBench，通过将规则执行与回复评分分离来隔离这一失败。在权威准则向量上，六个开源非推理评审模型通过了所有支配与相等控制，却在1,345个冲突中的9%至81%上选出无依据的胜者。全部577个顺序稳定的选择都遵循了被明确禁止的多数规则。在显式规则下，启用推理的配置将匿名向量违规降至9,720次判断中的2次，但仍无法弥补被省略的权衡或分歧的分量评分。在未指明权衡的TradeoffBench原始文本上，GPT-6.1-sol在400个已验证冲突中的29.8%省略了其补全前提。即使在四评分者一致的MultiPref冲突上应用显式规则，四个推理评审仍在16/45（GPT-6.1-sol）至35/46和25/29（开源评审）的有效呈现中给出严格裁决。我们提出"先识别后评估"方法，将规范支持、显式补全与目标一致性解耦。在MultiPref人工评分审计中，用同伴均值替代使2,707个共享目标上的方向性不一致从0.6%升至28.8%。单同伴消融在2,175个目标上确认了29.38个百分点的差距，排除了平均化作为原因。在HUMAINE中，声明的部分权衡增加了2.5个百分点的覆盖率，但新裁决对的不一致率为3.9%，而Pareto为0.9%。因此，可靠的LLM评审需要分别审计、规范支持、声明权衡和人工目标一致性。
translation.brief: 研究LLM多准则评审在准则冲突时未声明取舍前提的"隐性价值补全"问题，提出TradeoffBench基准和"先识别后评估"的解耦评估方法。

papers.title: ActWithin: Bounding Wrong-Payment Risk in Delegated Payment Batches
papers.abstract: A delegated payment agent can hold valid rights for incompatible revisions of a batch. We study the window in which the selected revision cannot be verified by the execution deadline. For batches that permit every subset of up to q revisions, ActWithin compiles the limit into a shared quota of q successful replacement payments. If approved plans are mutually replayable with the same observable inputs, deadlines, and resources, this quota preserves normal completion without additional approvals and minimizes worst-case wrong-payment principal for arbitrary positive amounts. A dynamic program computes its exact risk and witness. For amount-preserving recipient changes, we derive the exact risk of the tightest single amount cap on the same replacement group, provided mixed payment subsets can settle within the window. A two-phase result isolates the risk to payments due before trusted verification. Against the amount cap, an exploratory setting with 16-64 payments and one quarter of positions revisable yields aggregate reductions of 16.23-16.88% on adapted IBM AMLSim amounts and 10.12-12.52% on an adapted controlled catalog. The 760 funded original controlled paths with constructed single-position revisions yield 2.69%. In one local MetaMask fixture, both policies complete all 37 normal plans and the worst wrong debit falls from 93,962 to 81,056 test wei.

translation.title: ActWithin：委托支付批次中错误支付风险的界定
translation.abstract: 委托支付代理可能对同一批次的不兼容修订版本同时持有有效权利。我们研究所选修订在执行截止期限前无法被验证的时间窗口。对于允许至多q个修订的任意子集的批次，ActWithin将该限制编译为q次成功替换支付的共享配额。若已批准计划在相同可观测输入、截止期限和资源下可相互重放，该配额可在无需额外批准的情况下保证正常完成，并对任意正金额最小化最坏情况错误支付本金。动态规划可精确计算其风险及见证实例。对于保金额的收款人变更，在混合支付子集能在窗口内结算的前提下，我们推导出对同一替换组施加最紧单金额上限的精确风险。一个两阶段结果将风险隔离到可信验证之前到期的支付。相对于金额上限，在16至64笔支付、四分之一位置可修订的探索性设置中，在改编的IBM AMLSim金额上实现16.23%至16.88%的总体降低，在改编的受控目录上实现10.12%至12.52%的降低。760条有资金来源的原始受控路径加上构造的单位置修订产生2.69%的降低。在一个本地MetaMask测试环境中，两种策略均完成全部37个正常计划，最坏错误扣款从93,962降至81,056测试wei。
translation.brief: 研究委托支付代理在修订无法按时验证窗口内的错误支付风险，提出ActWithin将风险限制编译为共享替换支付配额并用动态规划精确计算。

papers.title: ChatGPT Can't Sell (And That's Probably a Good Thing): Buyer-Aligned AI Advice, the Sales-Representative Gap, and Evidence from Commercial Conversations
papers.abstract: AI assistants and merchant sales agents have different objectives: assistants should help buyers compare options and preserve the choice not to purchase, while sales agents also guide qualified buyers toward an authorized next step. We study this sales-representative gap with three evidence streams. In 12,178 historical English GPT-family conversations screened for commercial or transactional intent, a 279-request sample contained recommendation language in 63 first replies (22.6%) and no narrow transactional action wording. In a 56-conversation explicit-buying sample, 24 replies (42.9%) contained recommendation markers, 32 (57.1%) qualification phrases, and none transaction-specific phrases. These lexical measures do not estimate successful selling. A 2026 brand-monitoring cohort of 1,050 GPT-5.4--Gemini answer pairs over 383 purchase-related prompts showed transaction-specific phrases in 0.0% of recommendation-worded prompts, 0.21% of price/comparison prompts, and 9.52% of explicitly transaction-worded prompts. The prompts are selected, not organic shopping sessions. In a prospective pilot across five matched hypothetical product scenarios, sales instructions produced more next-step language than general-assistant instructions (5/5 vs. 2/5), but no increase in clean product choice (3/5 in both); unsupported offers and fit errors also occurred. This pilot cannot establish a population effect. A separate company-affiliated randomized field study reports higher engaged-visitor conversion for Javo, a commercially trained sales agent, than for a frontier-model agent in shared tooling, but does not identify the mechanism. We argue that apparent reluctance to sell can be appropriate for buyer-aligned assistants. Merchant agents should optimize qualified decision progress through catalog grounding, truthful authorization, and safeguards against unsuitable sales.

translation.title: ChatGPT卖不了货（这或许是好事）：买家对齐的AI建议、销售代表差距及来自商业对话的证据
translation.abstract: AI助手与商家销售代理的目标不同：助手应帮助买家比较选项并保留不购买的选择权，而销售代理还需引导合格买家走向授权的下一步。我们通过三路证据研究这一销售代表差距。在筛选出商业或交易意图的12,178条历史英语GPT系列对话中，279条请求样本里有63条首次回复（22.6%）包含推荐语言，且无狭义交易行动措辞。在56条明确购买意图的对话样本中，24条回复（42.9%）含推荐标记，32条（57.1%）含资格确认短语，无一含交易专用短语。这些词汇度量并不能估计成功销售。2026年一项品牌监测队列对383个购买相关提示的1,050对GPT-5.4与Gemini回答显示：推荐措辞提示中交易专用短语出现率为0.0%，价格/比较提示为0.21%，明确交易措辞提示为9.52%。这些提示是经过筛选的，并非自然购物会话。在五个匹配的假设产品场景的前瞻性试点中，销售指令比通用助手指令产生更多下一步语言（5/5对2/5），但干净的产品选择没有增加（两者均为3/5），且出现了无依据的报价和匹配错误。该试点无法确立总体效应。另一项公司关联的随机实地研究报告称，经过商业训练的销售代理Javo在共享工具环境下比前沿模型代理获得更高的参与访客转化率，但未识别其机制。我们认为，对买家对齐的助手而言，表面上的"不愿销售"可能是恰当的。商家代理应通过目录接地、真实授权和防止不当销售的保障措施来优化合格决策进展。
translation.brief: 研究AI助手与商家销售代理之间的"销售代表差距"，通过历史对话、品牌监测队列和前瞻试点三路证据分析AI的销售行为倾向。

papers.title: Don't Sleep, Keep Watch: Proactive Perception for Computer-Use Agents
papers.abstract: Computer-use agents (CUAs) built on vision-language models are increasingly entrusted with long-horizon tasks in live desktop, web, and mobile environments, where the screen keeps changing on its own. However, current CUAs lack real-time situational awareness: they perceive the environment through discrete snapshots, and the substantial inference latency of VLMs, compounded by highly dynamic interfaces, opens a perception-action gap in which the observed state frequently becomes stale before the corresponding action is executed. To bridge this gap, we present NightWatch, a plug-and-play framework that endows any CUA with continuous, temporally grounded perception without changing the agent's model, prompt, or action space. NightWatch couples the VLM agent with NightWatch-0.8B, a lightweight System-1 model that performs streaming monitoring of the interface state and keeps the agent synchronized with the evolving environment at low computational cost and latency, thereby grounding each decision in the current state rather than an outdated snapshot and reducing both stale actions and idle waiting while preserving task success. Experiments on desktop and dynamic web environments (OSWorld-Verified and DynaCU-Bench) show that NightWatch, driven by a watcher of only 0.8B parameters, reduces non-reasoning wall-clock time by 33% and wasted time by 53% on OSWorld while keeping task success on par, raises success on DynaCU-Bench from 39.5% to 44.2% with the large VLM agent, and is more efficient than passive-watching baselines such as AOI and PUSV under the same screenshot-only input, as well as a System-1 decision model more than $30\times$ its size. Overall, NightWatch demonstrates that the timing of perception is as critical as its content, marking a step toward agents that maintain continuous awareness of their environment rather than perceiving it turn by turn.

translation.title: 不要休眠，持续守望：面向计算机使用智能体的主动式感知
translation.abstract: 基于视觉语言模型（VLM）构建的计算机使用智能体（CUA）正越来越多地被委以在实时桌面、网页和移动环境中执行长时程任务，而这些环境中屏幕会自行不断变化。然而，当前的CUA缺乏实时情境感知能力：它们通过离散快照感知环境，VLM巨大的推理延迟加上高度动态的界面，造成了一个感知-行动鸿沟——观测到的状态在相应动作执行之前往往已经过时。为弥合这一鸿沟，我们提出NightWatch，一个即插即用框架，在不改变智能体的模型、提示或动作空间的前提下，赋予任意CUA连续的、时间对齐的感知能力。NightWatch将VLM智能体与NightWatch-0.8B——一个轻量级的System-1模型——耦合，后者对界面状态进行流式监控，以低计算成本和低延迟使智能体与不断演化的环境保持同步，从而使每个决策基于当前状态而非过时快照，在保持任务成功率的同时减少过时动作和空闲等待。在桌面和动态网页环境（OSWorld-Verified和DynaCU-Bench）上的实验表明，仅由0.8B参数的守望者驱动的NightWatch在OSWorld上将非推理墙钟时间减少33%、浪费时间减少53%，同时保持任务成功率持平；配合大型VLM智能体时，将DynaCU-Bench的成功率从39.5%提升至44.2%；并且在仅使用截图的相同输入下，比AOI和PUSV等被动观看基线以及一个规模超过其30倍的System-1决策模型更加高效。总体而言，NightWatch表明感知的时机与其内容同等重要，标志着向持续保持环境感知而非逐轮感知环境的智能体迈出一步。
translation.brief: 针对CUA因离散快照感知导致的感知-行动鸿沟问题，提出NightWatch框架，用一个轻量级0.8B System-1模型对流式界面状态进行持续监控，使智能体决策与动态环境实时同步。

papers.title: Micro Operational Robustness of LLMs on Code Generation
papers.abstract: It is now common practice in software development for large language models (LLMs) to be used to generate program code. It is desirable to evaluate the robustness of LLMs for this usage. This paper is concerned in particular with how sensitive LLMs are to variations in descriptions of the coding tasks. However, existing techniques for evaluating this robustness are unsuitable for code generation because the input data space of natural language (NL) descriptions is discrete and sparse. To address this problem, we propose a robustness evaluation method called scenario domain analysis, which aims to find the expected minimal change in the NL descriptions of coding tasks that would cause the LLMs to produce incorrect outputs. We have formally proved the theoretical properties of the method and also conducted extensive experiments to evaluate the robustness of four state-of-the-art LLMs: Gemini-pro, Codex, Llamma2 and Falcon 7B, and have found that we are able to rank these with confidence from best to worst. Moreover, we have also studied how robustness varies in different scenarios, including the variations with the topic of the coding task and with the complexity of its sample solution, and found that robustness is lower for more complex tasks and also lower for more advanced topics, such as multi-threading and data structures.

translation.title: LLM代码生成的微观操作鲁棒性
translation.abstract: 使用大语言模型（LLM）生成程序代码如今已成为软件开发中的常见做法，因此评估LLM在这种用途下的鲁棒性十分必要。本文特别关注LLM对编码任务描述变化的敏感程度。然而，现有的鲁棒性评估技术不适用于代码生成，因为自然语言（NL）描述的输入数据空间是离散且稀疏的。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种称为场景域分析（scenario domain analysis）的鲁棒性评估方法，旨在找到使LLM产生错误输出的编码任务NL描述的最小预期变化。我们对该方法的理论性质进行了形式化证明，并开展了大量实验评估四个最先进LLM——Gemini-pro、Codex、Llamma2和Falcon 7B——的鲁棒性，能够有把握地将它们从优到劣排序。此外，我们还研究了鲁棒性在不同场景下如何变化，包括随编码任务主题及其示例解复杂度的变化，发现任务越复杂鲁棒性越低，主题越高级（如多线程和数据结构）鲁棒性也越低。
translation.brief: 针对自然语言输入空间离散稀疏导致现有方法无法评估LLM代码生成鲁棒性的问题，提出场景域分析方法，寻找使LLM输出出错的任务描述最小变化。

papers.title: EmoRouter: Adaptive Modality Cascading for Multimodal Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract: Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) involves detecting the underlying emotion behind each utterance within a conversation, which is essential for emotionally aware human-computer interaction. While omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) demonstrate strong capability for MER by jointly processing modalities including text, audio, and vision, different modality combinations yield different prediction outcomes across utterances: acoustic and visual inputs can help recover annotated labels missed by text-only inference, but can also turn correct predictions into errors. Processing all modalities for every utterance is also computationally expensive. To this end, we introduce EmoRouter, a training-free, model-agnostic framework for adaptive modality cascading that selects an exit tier for each utterance along a predefined modality order. The routing is guided by prediction-uncertainty estimates derived from Conformal Prediction. EmoRouter routes each utterance through a sequence of increasing-cost modality levels and exits at the first level when the model is confident in the emotion. To determine when to exit, we propose Conformal Set Contraction, a structural calibration criterion that calibrates the per-tier CP error budgets used for these exit decisions. Comprehensive evaluations on 4 MER benchmarks and 3 Omni-LLMs reveal that EmoRouter matches or outperforms the full modalities while reducing inference latency by 67.9--94.5%. Furthermore, EmoRouter demonstrates high transferability across different models, validating its robustness. Code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: EmoRouter：面向多模态情感识别的自适应模态级联
translation.abstract: 多模态情感识别（MER）旨在检测对话中每条话语背后的潜在情感，这对具有情感感知的人机交互至关重要。虽然全模态大语言模型（Omni-LLM）通过联合处理文本、音频和视觉等模态在MER上展现出强大能力，但不同模态组合在不同话语上会产生不同预测结果：声学和视觉输入可以帮助恢复纯文本推理遗漏的标注标签，但也可能把正确预测变成错误。对每条话语处理所有模态的计算成本也很高。为此，我们提出EmoRouter，一个免训练、模型无关的自适应模态级联框架，沿预定义的模态顺序为每条话语选择一个退出层级。路由由基于Conformal Prediction的预测不确定性估计引导。EmoRouter让每条话语经过成本递增的模态层级序列，并在模型对情感有信心时在第一层退出。为确定何时退出，我们提出Conformal Set Contraction，一种结构化校准准则，用于校准各层级的CP错误预算以支持退出决策。在4个MER基准和3个Omni-LLM上的全面评估表明，EmoRouter在匹配或超越全模态性能的同时，将推理延迟降低67.9–94.5%。此外，EmoRouter在不同模型间展现出高可迁移性，验证了其鲁棒性。代码见此https URL。
translation.brief: 针对Omni-LLM多模态情感识别中全模态处理成本高且模态组合效果不一的问题，提出基于Conformal Prediction不确定性引导的免训练自适应模态级联框架EmoRouter。

papers.title: A Design Space for Data Agents: Insights from KDD Cup 2026
papers.abstract: Data agents interpret analytical requests, gather evidence from heterogeneous sources, and compute results within finite resource budgets. We analyze the final code submissions of the ten highest-ranked teams in the KDD Cup 2026 Data Agents for Complex Data Analysis competition. We organize the observed design choices into three interacting layers, covering workflow orchestration, analytical functions, and working state. The comparison reveals recurring patterns for allocating computation in response to task progress, structuring evidence for computation and assessment, and preserving reusable artifacts with their provenance. Candidates that rely on the same evidence can inherit the same error, so interpreting their agreement requires tracing those dependencies. The design space motivates controlled evaluations of how resource allocation, evidence sharing, and targeted recovery affect task completion and correctness.

translation.title: 数据智能体的设计空间：来自KDD Cup 2026的洞见
translation.abstract: 数据智能体需要解析分析请求、从异构数据源收集证据，并在有限的资源预算内计算结果。我们分析了KDD Cup 2026“面向复杂数据分析的数据智能体”竞赛中排名前十队伍的最终代码提交，将观察到的设计选择组织为三个相互作用的层次：工作流编排、分析函数和工作状态。对比揭示了若干反复出现的模式：如何根据任务进展分配计算、如何为计算和评估组织证据结构、以及如何保留可复用工件及其来源。由于依赖相同证据的候选方案可能继承相同错误，解读它们的一致性需要追溯这些依赖关系。该设计空间为受控评估资源分配、证据共享和针对性恢复如何影响任务完成与正确性提供了动机。
translation.brief: 通过分析KDD Cup 2026前十名队伍的代码提交，从工作流编排、分析函数和工作状态三个层次归纳数据智能体的设计空间与共性模式。

papers.title: DMPT-Swarm: A Directional Mass-Preserving Transform for Decentralized Swarm Navigation in Obstacle Environments
papers.abstract: This paper presents a decentralized microscopic control framework for swarm navigation in obstacle environments, given a precomputed macroscopic trajectory represented by Gaussian mixture models (GMMs). To generate obstacle-aware reference locations without inter-agent communication, we first employ affine transport between multivariate normal (MVN) distributions under the Wasserstein-2 metric. We then propose a directional mass-preserving transform (DMPT) to incorporate obstacle effects by modifying radial transport while preserving directional structure. Based on the transformed references, a local artificial potential field (APF)-based controller is applied for navigation. Each agent operates independently, reducing communication and computational burden. Simulation results demonstrate improved efficiency and obstacle avoidance compared to conventional APF-based methods

translation.title: DMPT-Swarm：面向障碍环境中去中心化蜂群导航的方向性保质量变换
translation.abstract: 本文提出一个去中心化的微观控制框架，用于在给定以高斯混合模型（GMM）表示的预计算宏观轨迹的条件下，实现障碍环境中的蜂群导航。为在不依赖智能体间通信的情况下生成障碍感知的参考位置，我们首先在Wasserstein-2度量下采用多元正态（MVN）分布之间的仿射输运。随后我们提出方向性保质量变换（DMPT），通过修改径向输运同时保持方向结构来纳入障碍影响。基于变换后的参考位置，采用基于局部人工势场（APF）的控制器进行导航。每个智能体独立运行，降低了通信和计算负担。仿真结果表明，与传统基于APF的方法相比，该方法在效率和避障方面均有提升。
translation.brief: 针对障碍环境中蜂群导航的通信与计算负担问题，提出基于Wasserstein-2仿射输运和方向性保质量变换（DMPT）生成障碍感知参考位置，并结合局部APF控制器实现去中心化导航。

papers.title: Consumer-Time Validity in Stateful AI Runtimes: Verifying Recovered State and Deferred Authority
papers.abstract: Stateful LLM serving engines and agent runtimes reuse execution state and deferred permissions across components and sessions. A cancellation, rollback, or approval is recorded by one component and relied on by another, and recording it does not make the later use valid: a downstream consumer may read state or dispatch an action whose identity, production status, allocation, or target revision has since changed. We call the missing check consumer-time validity and separate two forms. State validity governs what a consumer reads. On vLLM with LMCache, an interrupted KV load leaves unwritten blocks indexed, and a host-only counter rewind desynchronizes the GPU position, so a second tenant generates a schema-valid tool call naming the wrong tenant in 10/10 native-fault runs; the call is recorded and not executed. Authority freshness governs what a consumer executes: on a multi-session approval runtime, an unrevoked deferred grant overwrote a newer revision in one admitted live execution. Output equality cannot test state validity: a fault-free run diverges at token 30 through BF16 batching alone while attended-KV digests match. We therefore specify consumer-bound recovery contracts that, for state recovery, jointly require exclusion, retention, and task completion, and an admissible-witness standard realized as a GPU-free offline trace verifier over scheduler metadata and persisted tool artifacts. On recorded traces the verifier agrees with the reference verdicts in 42/42 frozen GPU-matrix scenarios. An allocation-aware repair satisfies 7/7 triggered vLLM fault predicates on a pinned scheduler-case matrix, where upstream PR 61769 satisfies 2/7, and revision-bound dispatch blocks all 160 deterministic conflicting overwrites in a separate dispatcher cohort. Recovery must be checked where state and authority are consumed, with evidence bound to the consuming request.

translation.title: 有状态 AI 运行时中的消费时有效性：验证恢复状态与延迟授权
translation.abstract: 有状态的 LLM 服务引擎和 agent 运行时会在组件和会话之间复用执行状态和延迟权限。取消、回滚或批准由一个组件记录，并被另一个组件依赖，但记录它并不能使后续使用有效：下游消费者可能读取状态或派发一个其身份、生产状态、分配或目标修订版本已经改变的动作。我们将缺失的检查称为消费时有效性，并区分两种形式。状态有效性约束消费者读取的内容。在带 LMCache 的 vLLM 上，被中断的 KV 加载会留下已索引但未写入的块，仅主机侧的计数器回退会使 GPU 位置失同步，因此在 10/10 的原生故障运行中，第二个租户生成了一个模式合法但指名错误租户的工具调用；该调用被记录但未执行。授权新鲜度约束消费者执行的内容：在一个多会话批准运行时上，一个未撤销的延迟授权在一次被准入的实时执行中覆盖了较新的修订版本。输出相等性无法检验状态有效性：一次无故障运行仅因 BF16 批处理就在第 30 个 token 处发散，而受监督的 KV 摘要却匹配。因此我们规定了面向消费者的恢复契约：对于状态恢复，联合要求排除性、保留性和任务完成性，并提出一种可采纳见证标准，实现为基于调度器元数据和持久化工具产物的无 GPU 离线轨迹验证器。在记录的轨迹上，该验证器在 42/42 个冻结 GPU 矩阵场景中与参考判定一致。一种分配感知的修复在固定的调度器用例矩阵上满足 7/7 个触发的 vLLM 故障谓词（上游 PR 61769 仅满足 2/7），且修订版本绑定的派发在单独的派发器队列中阻止了全部 160 次确定性冲突覆盖。恢复必须在状态和授权被消费之处进行检查，并将证据绑定到消费请求。
translation.brief: 针对有状态 LLM 运行时中状态与延迟授权被下游消费时可能已失效的问题，提出消费时有效性检查，通过面向消费者的恢复契约和无 GPU 离线轨迹验证器来验证恢复状态与授权新鲜度。

papers.title: Mind the Trap As LLMs Guess the Data Model: Grain-Aware Guards Against Fan-out in Text-to-SQL and Its Benchmarks
papers.abstract: Text-to-SQL systems built on large language models (LLMs) often aggregate over one-to-many and many-to-many joins, a classic trap: when the joined rows repeat an entity, a SUM or COUNT counts it more than once, yet the query runs and returns a plausible number. We characterize these fan-out errors by one condition on the relation an aggregate reads, which depends on two facts a schema does not show: each measure's grain, and how many rows a join on each key repeats. An audit that tests the condition on the data finds distorted gold answers for 4.2% of the dev questions of BIRD, a widely used benchmark, and BIRD's later, independent revision changed 44% of the answers the audit flags as definite fan-out, against 16% of unflagged ones. We release BIRD-FanOut, 486 BIRD questions with reviewed gold, and GrainTraps, synthetic questions that set this trap and related ones.
