Across eight LLM agents, functional dependencies (FDs) computed from the data help no more than per-column statistics on GrainTraps, but grain-aware FDs, which also state each measure's grain and the repetition per key, cut fan-out errors on BIRD from 18.4% of runs to about 13%, also on held-out questions and without LLM judges. Accuracy rises less, because most remaining errors are not fan-out and BIRD's hints often prescribe the over-count. Text-to-SQL models should be given the grain of the data, and benchmark gold should be audited on the data. Code, data and benchmarks are available at this https URL

translation.title: 当 LLM 猜测数据模型时当心陷阱：面向 Text-to-SQL 及其基准的粒度感知扇出防护
translation.abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的 Text-to-SQL 系统常在一对多和多对多连接上进行聚合，这是一个经典陷阱：当连接后的行重复某个实体时，SUM 或 COUNT 会将其重复计数，而查询仍能运行并返回一个看似合理的数字。我们用一个作用于聚合所读关系的条件来刻画这些扇出错误，该条件依赖于模式中不显示的两个事实：每个度量的粒度，以及每个键上的连接会重复多少行。在数据上检验该条件的审计发现，广泛使用的基准 BIRD 的 4.2% 开发集问题存在失真的金标准答案，且 BIRD 后续的独立修订版本更改了审计标记为确定扇出的答案中的 44%，而未标记的仅为 16%。我们发布了 BIRD-FanOut（486 个经审核金标准的 BIRD 问题）和 GrainTraps（设置此陷阱及相关陷阱的合成问题）。在八个 LLM agent 上，从数据计算出的函数依赖（FD）在 GrainTraps 上并不比逐列统计更有帮助，而同时陈述每个度量粒度和每键重复次数的粒度感知 FD 将 BIRD 上的扇出错误从 18.4% 的运行降至约 13%，在留出问题上同样有效且无需 LLM 评判。准确率提升较少，因为多数剩余错误并非扇出错误，且 BIRD 的提示常常直接规定了重复计数。Text-to-SQL 模型应被告知数据的粒度，基准金标准应在数据上进行审计。代码、数据和基准见此 https URL
translation.brief: 针对 Text-to-SQL 中因连接导致聚合重复计数的扇出错误，提出粒度感知的函数依赖来告知 LLM 每个度量的粒度与键重复次数，并发布审计后的 BIRD-FanOut 与合成基准 GrainTraps。

papers.title: Population-Based Post-Training for Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is one of the most popular post-training paradigms for large language models. RLVR typically trains a single model under hyperparameters chosen before training begins, while researchers tune hyperparameters across consecutive runs. We introduce Population-Based Post-Training (PBPT), which trains several models in parallel and lets the training process do the tuning through population-based training. PBPT periodically evaluates models on a validation set. High-performers are duplicated and their hyperparameters perturbed to explore new configurations. Low-performers stop training and are replaced by these copies. On reasoning benchmarks (Enigmata, Nemotron) and interactive tool-use environments (Gaia2, AppWorld), PBPT produces stronger agents than compute-matched groups of independent RLVR learners. Furthermore, PBPT is able to recover from poor initial hyperparameters, automatically discovering better settings over the course of training.

translation.title: 面向大语言模型的基于种群的训练后优化
translation.abstract: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）是大语言模型最流行的训练后优化范式之一。RLVR 通常在训练开始前选定超参数并训练单个模型，而研究者需要在连续多次运行之间调整超参数。我们提出基于种群的训练后优化（PBPT），并行训练多个模型，并通过基于种群的训练让训练过程自身完成调参。PBPT 定期在验证集上评估各模型。高性能者被复制并扰动其超参数以探索新配置；低性能者停止训练并被这些副本替换。在推理基准（Enigmata、Nemotron）和交互式工具使用环境（Gaia2、AppWorld）上，PBPT 产生了比算力匹配的独立 RLVR 学习者组更强的 agent。此外，PBPT 能够从糟糕的初始超参数中恢复，在训练过程中自动发现更好的设置。
translation.brief: 针对 RLVR 需在多次运行间手动调参的问题，提出 PBPT，通过并行训练多个模型并周期性评估、复制高性能者并扰动其超参数、淘汰低性能者来实现训练过程中的自动调参。

papers.title: Watermark Claims Under Test: Lessons from Auditing a Production LLM
papers.abstract: Can we tell whether an LLM is watermarked without knowing its secret key? Published black-box tests suggest that carefully designed prompts can reveal the statistical footprint of a watermark. This paper examines what happens when those tests move from controlled reference implementations to a deployed model whose watermarking parameters are undisclosed. We present an audit of the Red-Green watermark presence test on Claude. Across ten initial configurations, the published test never rejects on a model the provider states is watermarked, despite detecting a local reference at comparable sample sizes. Controlled experiments expose a failure mode: including the prompt in the watermark's repeated-context history suppresses marking exactly where the test measures it. The watermark remains active, but the probe becomes blind. Attempts to repair the probe reveal further confounds. Constructed contexts can trigger native digit-to-word preferences, while comparisons within a single response can measure how the model plans its answer. Tokenization changes which contexts the probe actually controls. These findings show why validation on a surrogate model does not establish validity on the model under investigation. A redesigned probe finds a substantial context-dependent shift on Claude Fable that is absent on two sibling controls. However, the pre-registered decision remains inconclusive because selective refusals violate the protocol, and the effect's watermark origin is unresolved. We show how to design controls, distinguish statistical rejection from evidence of watermarking and interpret a null without treating it as proof of absence. We provide researchers and practitioners working on LLM evaluation, watermarking, and provenance with an audit checklist grounded in concrete successes and failures. Code, prompts, and parsed responses are available for reproducing the analyses.

translation.title: 受检验的水印主张：审计一个生产级 LLM 的经验教训
translation.abstract: 在不知道密钥的情况下，我们能判断一个 LLM 是否带有水印吗？已发表的黑盒测试表明，精心设计的提示可以揭示水印的统计足迹。本文考察了这些测试从受控参考实现迁移到一个水印参数未公开的已部署模型时会发生什么。我们对 Claude 上的 Red-Green 水印存在性测试进行了审计。在十种初始配置中，该已发表测试在提供商声明带水印的模型上从未拒绝原假设，尽管在相当样本量下能检测到本地参考实现。受控实验揭示了一种失败模式：将提示纳入水印的重复上下文历史会恰好抑制测试所测量位置的标记。水印仍然活跃，但探针变得失明。修复探针的尝试暴露了更多混淆因素：构造的上下文可能触发原生的数字转单词偏好，而单次响应内的比较可能测量的是模型规划答案的方式。分词会改变探针实际控制的上下文。这些发现说明了为何在替代模型上的验证不能确立在受研究模型上的有效性。一个重新设计的探针在 Claude Fable 上发现了显著的上下文相关偏移，而在两个同源对照上不存在。然而，预注册的判定仍无定论，因为选择性拒绝违反了协议，且该效应的水印来源未获解决。我们展示了如何设计对照、如何区分统计拒绝与水印证据、以及如何解读零结果而不将其视为不存在的证明。我们为从事 LLM 评估、水印和溯源工作的研究者与从业者提供了一份基于具体成败经验的审计清单。代码、提示和解析后的响应可用于复现分析。
translation.brief: 针对黑盒水印检测测试在参数未公开的生产级 LLM 上是否有效的问题，对 Claude 上的 Red-Green 测试进行审计，揭示探针失效与混淆因素，并提供水印审计的对照设计与检查清单。

papers.title: Do You Even Know What I Want? Improving LLMs Ability to Detect Hidden User Intent
papers.abstract: As with conventional AI agents, a common source of misalignment between Large Language Models (LLMs) and their human users is misspecified goals. Often, this happens when the human has skewed beliefs about the system's model and provides it with information that causes behavior different from what they expected, with potentially unwanted side effects. To ensure goal alignment, one solution would be for the LLM to ask the human questions about their objectives. However, it has been well-documented that LLMs most often provide default responses to user requests rather than try and ask questions to clarify their true intent. In this paper, we address these challenges by adapting a novel formulation for the objective misspecification problem to work with LLMs. We then test if LLMs that are prompted to ask questions about a user's true underlying objectives are better at identifying them compared to those that do not. We evaluate our method using four state-of-the-art LLMs tested on five standard IPC domains, showing that for some domains, asking questions greatly improved model performance.

translation.title: 你真的知道我想要什么吗？提升 LLM 检测隐藏用户意图的能力
translation.abstract: 与传统 AI agent 一样，大语言模型（LLM）与人类用户之间错位的一个常见来源是目标设定不当。这通常发生在人类对系统模型的认知有偏差，并提供了导致行为偏离其预期的信息时，可能带来不想要的副作用。为确保目标对齐，一种解决方案是让 LLM 向人类询问其目标。然而，已有充分记录表明，LLM 大多对用户请求提供默认响应，而不是尝试提问以澄清其真实意图。在本文中，我们通过将一种新颖的目标设定不当问题的形式化方法适配到 LLM 来应对这些挑战。然后我们检验被提示就用户真实底层目标进行提问的 LLM 是否比不这样做的 LLM 更善于识别这些目标。我们使用四个最先进的 LLM 在五个标准 IPC 域上进行评估，结果表明在某些域上，提问显著提升了模型性能。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 倾向于对用户请求直接给出默认响应而不澄清隐藏意图的问题，将目标设定不当问题的形式化方法适配到 LLM，通过提示模型主动提问来识别用户真实目标。

papers.title: LITMUS - Literature Informed Testbed for Mapping Usecases and Synthesizing Risk-Cards
papers.abstract: The proliferation of large language models (LLMs) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) in real-world applications has heightened the need for systematic, safety-oriented deployment frameworks. Existing approaches typically prioritize the construction of datasets and risk cards around the LLM and AI architecture itself, yet they provide scant consideration for the specific use-case that drives model selection. This omission is problematic because any practical AI deployment begins with a detailed use-case description that informs the assessment of contextual hazards. In this paper, we introduce a structured pipeline that, given a use-case, automatically produces a tailored dataset and an accompanying risk card. The process ensures that identified risks are tightly coupled to the use-case, and it offers traceable evidence from peer-reviewed literature to substantiate each risk to use-case relationship. Prior claim-verification methods (FActScore, FactReasoner) have been validated for factual claims. Risk-relevance is a hypothetical claim about possible harm, and whether evidence retrieval can meaningfully assess such claims remains untested. Literature-Informed Testbed for Mapping Use-cases and Synthesizing (LITMUS) risk cards are the first systematic attempt to characterize this adaptation. We evaluated the pipeline using the MIT Risk Taxonomy and achieved a 0.91 F1-score with a list of 320 samples from the benchmark risk dataset that was considered. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in generating robust, evidence-based risk assessments for LLM deployments.

translation.title: LITMUS——基于文献的用例映射与风险卡合成测试平台
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）和人工智能（AI）在现实应用中的激增，凸显了对系统化、面向安全的部署框架的需求。现有方法通常围绕LLM和AI架构本身构建数据集和风险卡，却很少考虑驱动模型选择的具体用例。这一缺失是有问题的，因为任何实际的AI部署都始于详细的用例描述，而该描述为情境性危害的评估提供依据。本文提出一个结构化流水线，给定一个用例，可自动生成定制的数据集和配套的风险卡。该过程确保识别出的风险与用例紧密耦合，并提供从同行评审文献到每个风险-用例关系的可追溯证据。先前的声明验证方法（FActScore、FactReasoner）已针对事实性声明得到验证。风险相关性是关于潜在危害的假设性声明，证据检索能否有效评估此类声明尚未经过检验。LITMUS（Literature-Informed Testbed for Mapping Use-cases and Synthesizing，基于文献的用例映射与风险卡合成测试平台）是首次系统性地刻画这一适配的尝试。我们使用MIT风险分类体系评估了该流水线，在包含320个样本的基准风险数据集列表上取得了0.91的F1分数。这些结果表明我们的方法能够为LLM部署生成稳健的、基于证据的风险评估。
translation.brief: 针对AI部署中风险评估与具体用例脱节的问题，提出一个根据用例自动生成定制数据集和风险卡、并以同行评审文献作为证据支撑的结构化流水线。

papers.title: Grounding Collaborative Agents in Group Cognition
papers.abstract: Collaborative agents joining an ongoing team rely on shared context to connect multi-party interaction histories with downstream coordination decisions. Existing work typically focuses either on retrieving historical facts from conversation logs, which surfaces isolated evidence without capturing who knows or owns what, or on evaluating end-to-end interactions, which conflates preparation with execution and lacks direct supervision because a team's history has no single ground-truth summary. To bridge this gap, we formulate group briefing, the task of reconstructing task-relevant group cognition across participants' expressed beliefs, group dynamics, and grounding gaps, and introduce a four-domain benchmark of 1,351 requests and 9,975 verified reference points paired with a two-stage evaluation pipeline combining reference-point coverage and downstream collaboration simulation. Using this pipeline, we show that GroupBrief, a simple task-guided approach that iteratively probes the message history and synthesizes a structured brief without offline memory indexing or graph construction, outperforms ten retrieval and agent-memory baselines in overall coverage with gpt-5.4-mini, while benchmarking nine language models reveals that prospective friction remains harder to recover than past state across model scales. We further use reference-point coverage as a feedback signal for harness optimization, refining GroupBrief's retrieval and synthesis instructions while keeping model weights frozen. On held-out Test projects, GroupBrief (optimized) improves coverage by 2.54 percentage points for gpt-5.4-mini and 12.88 for gpt-5.6-luna, achieving 64.46% and 68.42% preference over no brief in downstream simulations. These results establish our benchmark and evaluation pipeline as a foundation for measuring and optimizing how collaborative agents ground in group cognition.

translation.title: 将协作智能体锚定于群体认知
translation.abstract: 加入正在运行团队的协作智能体依赖共享上下文，将多方交互历史与下游协调决策联系起来。现有工作要么专注于从对话日志中检索历史事实，只能呈现孤立的证据而无法捕捉谁知道什么、谁负责什么；要么评估端到端交互，将准备与执行混为一谈，且由于团队历史没有唯一的真值摘要而缺乏直接监督。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了群体简报（group briefing）任务，即跨参与者的表达信念、群体动态和锚定缺口重建与任务相关的群体认知，并构建了一个包含1,351个请求和9,975个已验证参考点的四领域基准，配套一个结合参考点覆盖率和下游协作模拟的两阶段评估流水线。利用该流水线，我们展示了GroupBrief——一种简单的任务引导方法，通过迭代探查消息历史并合成结构化简报，无需离线记忆索引或图构建——在gpt-5.4-mini上的整体覆盖率优于十个检索和智能体记忆基线；同时对九个语言模型的基准测试表明，跨模型规模而言，前瞻性摩擦比过去状态更难恢复。我们进一步将参考点覆盖率作为反馈信号用于harness优化，在保持模型权重冻结的情况下改进GroupBrief的检索与合成指令。在留出的Test项目上，优化后的GroupBrief将gpt-5.4-mini的覆盖率提升2.54个百分点，gpt-5.6-luna提升12.88个百分点，在下游模拟中分别达到64.46%和68.42%的相对无简报的偏好率。这些结果确立了我们的基准和评估流水线作为衡量和优化协作智能体如何锚定于群体认知的基础。
translation.brief: 针对协作智能体难以从多方交互历史中重建群体认知的问题，提出群体简报任务及配套基准与两阶段评估流水线，并给出无需记忆索引的迭代探查与合成方法GroupBrief。

papers.title: HyperHarness: Learning to Generate Personalized Agent Harnesses from User Histories
papers.abstract: Personalized LLM agents rely on an agent harness, the surrounding memory and control code, to connect user history with downstream decisions. Existing methods typically employ either a single shared memory workflow across all users, which is efficient to deploy but cannot adapt how evidence is retrieved and interpreted across diverse histories, or per-user harness optimization, which customizes behavior for each user but requires costly repeated candidate evaluation at deployment and suffers from sparse, noisy supervision in raw logs. To address this trade-off, we present HyperHarness, a framework that learns a shared history-to-harness generator to synthesize executable, user-specific retrieval and answer-guidance code directly from user histories. Given a user's permitted history, HyperHarness prompts a construction LLM to write personalized retrieval and guidance functions, while downstream task scores across training users supervise iterative refinements to the shared generator without reference harnesses or answering-model updates. At deployment, the frozen generator constructs a harness for each unseen user in a single pass from history alone, eliminating per-user task-scored search. Across three benchmarks (PersonaMemv3, Mem-PAL, and MemoryCD) and three answering models (Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3.8-27B, and GPT-5.6-Luna), HyperHarness achieves the highest aggregate score in seven of nine settings and ranks second in the remaining two, improving over the strongest baselines by up to 5.95 points while cutting matched answer-time tokens by 90.32% over long-context prompting. Analyses show that optimization tailors context allocation to each executor, transfers to unseen user clusters, and amortizes adaptation costs.

translation.title: HyperHarness：从用户历史中学习生成个性化智能体Harness
translation.abstract: 个性化LLM智能体依赖智能体harness——即外围的记忆与控制代码——将用户历史与下游决策连接起来。现有方法要么对所有用户采用单一共享的记忆工作流，部署高效但无法针对多样的历史调整证据的检索与解读方式；要么进行每用户harness优化，可为每个用户定制行为，但需要在部署时进行代价高昂的重复候选评估，且原始日志中的监督稀疏且充满噪声。为解决这一权衡，我们提出HyperHarness，一个学习共享的历史到harness生成器的框架，可直接从用户历史合成可执行的、用户特定的检索与答案引导代码。给定用户的许可历史，HyperHarness提示一个构建LLM编写个性化的检索与引导函数，同时利用训练用户上的下游任务分数监督共享生成器的迭代改进，无需参考harness或更新回答模型。部署时，冻结的生成器仅凭历史即可一次性为每个未见用户构建harness，省去了每用户的任务分数搜索。在三个基准（PersonaMemv3、Mem-PAL和MemoryCD）和三个回答模型（Qwen3.5-9B、Qwen3.8-27B和GPT-5.6-Luna）上，HyperHarness在九个设置中的七个取得最高总分，其余两个排名第二，相比最强基线提升最高达5.95分，同时相比长上下文提示将匹配的回答时token削减90.32%。分析表明，优化能够为每个执行器定制上下文分配、迁移到未见用户集群，并摊销适配成本。
translation.brief: 针对个性化LLM智能体中共享记忆工作流缺乏适配性与每用户优化成本高昂的权衡，提出学习一个共享的历史到harness生成器，直接从用户历史一次性合成可执行的用户特定检索与引导代码。

papers.title: Do LLM Agents Compromise Like Humans? Risk and Responsibility in Dyadic Decision-Making
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents are increasingly deployed in settings where they must collaborate to make joint decisions. We investigate how this collaboration unfolds under risk, asking whether agents adjust their choices to accommodate their partners, how they assign responsibility for shared outcomes, and whether responsibility attribution shapes subsequent adjustment. We designed a series of agents with systematically varying risk preferences and paired them in a repeated joint decision-making task previously conducted with humans. Like humans, agents converged toward their partners' choices. However, similar aggregate behavior arose from different dynamics: agents showed little evidence of reciprocal adjustment, tended to weigh rewards more, and their responsibility attribution was decoupled from compromise. Similarly, while they showed bias in their responsibility attribution, the outcome's valence shaped the attribution differently than in humans. Our results reveal important differences between human--human and agent--agent joint decision-making, demonstrating that similar social outcomes can emerge from different social dynamics and reasoning.

translation.title: LLM智能体会像人类一样妥协吗？二元决策中的风险与责任
translation.abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体越来越多地被部署在需要协作做出联合决策的场景中。我们研究了这种协作在风险下如何展开：智能体是否会调整自己的选择以迁就伙伴，它们如何为共同结果分配责任，以及责任归因是否影响后续的调整。我们设计了一系列风险偏好系统性变化的智能体，并将它们配对进行一项此前在人类身上开展过的重复联合决策任务。与人类类似，智能体会向伙伴的选择趋同。然而，相似的总体行为源于不同的动态：智能体几乎没有表现出互惠调整的证据，更倾向于看重奖励，且其责任归因与妥协脱钩。同样，尽管它们的责任归因存在偏差，但结果的效价对归因的影响方式也与人类不同。我们的结果揭示了人类-人类与智能体-智能体联合决策之间的重要差异，表明相似的社会结果可能源于不同的社会动态与推理。
translation.brief: 研究LLM智能体在风险下的联合决策是否像人类一样妥协与归因责任，通过在重复联合决策任务中配对具有不同风险偏好的智能体进行实验对比。

papers.title: Factory-simulator: A process-oriented environment for evaluating manufacturing decisions against optimisation-based references
papers.abstract: Motivated by discussions with an electronics contract manufacturer about decision support, Factory-simulator provides a deterministic manufacturing environment for controlled research on the business performance of large language model-based multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS). Equal delivery performance can arise from decisions with different financial consequences, complicating evaluation through delivery metrics alone. Its process-oriented model connects procurement and production decisions to order fulfilment and factory finances. Seeded worlds and recorded actions support replay and branching from a shared history to examine alternative decisions and their downstream consequences. Linear and mixed-integer programming models generate profit-oriented reference decisions. Observation-limited comparators use disclosed information; full-foresight references use future events for diagnostic comparison. Controlled examples show equal delivery performance with different profit under the same information and distinguish delivery penalties from deferred payment. Verification includes material and financial balances, replay and forks, and a small allocation instance in which the tested optimisation-based controllers attain an analytically established optimum. An external three-role LLM-MAS client completed four illustrative runs comprising 159 periods, with reconciled balances and exact replay of recorded actions. Matched-world rolling comparisons contextualise the financial outcomes, while full-foresight results provide heuristic reference points rather than certified optima. The software enables researchers to investigate how agent organisation and information access affect business outcomes, including whether distributing procurement and production responsibilities changes profit relative to a centralised controller.

translation.title: Factory-simulator：一个面向流程的环境，用于对照基于优化的参考评估制造决策
translation.abstract: 受与一家电子代工制造商关于决策支持讨论的启发，Factory-simulator提供了一个确定性的制造环境，用于对基于大语言模型的多智能体系统（LLM-MAS）的商业绩效进行受控研究。相同的交付绩效可能来自具有不同财务后果的决策，这使得仅通过交付指标进行评估变得复杂。其面向流程的模型将采购和生产决策与订单履行和工厂财务联系起来。种子化世界和动作记录支持从共享历史进行回放和分支，以考察替代决策及其下游后果。线性和混合整数规划模型生成以利润为导向的参考决策。信息受限的比较器使用已披露的信息；全知参考则使用未来事件进行诊断性比较。受控示例显示，在相同信息下交付绩效相同但利润不同，并区分了交付罚款与延期付款。验证包括物料与财务平衡、回放与分支，以及一个小型分配实例，其中被测的基于优化的控制器达到了解析确立的最优解。一个外部三角色LLM-MAS客户端完成了四次示例运行，共159个周期，实现了平衡对账和记录动作的精确回放。匹配世界的滚动比较为财务结果提供了情境，而全知结果则提供启发式参考点而非经过认证的最优解。该软件使研究人员能够研究智能体组织和信息获取如何影响商业结果，包括分散采购与生产职责相对于集中式控制器是否会改变利润。
translation.brief: 针对仅靠交付指标难以评估制造决策商业绩效的问题，构建一个连接采购、生产与财务的确定性流程仿真环境，并用线性和混合整数规划生成参考决策以对照评估LLM多智能体系统。

papers.title: Beyond Free-Form Generation: Measuring Interface Composition in Competitive NLP Systems
papers.abstract: Systems with decoder LLMs can combine free generation with scoring, ranking, or selection. We measure these documented interface combinations with five annotation fields linked to source evidence. The corpora comprise 517 solutions from 42 Kaggle competitions involving NLP and 76 participant systems from 26 SemEval, TREC, and WMT task years. Among eligible generation systems with decoder LLMs, 18 of 55 Kaggle systems and 17 of 20 Shared Task systems are hybrid: free generation coexists with a constrained interface. The remaining systems use free generation alone. Giving each competition or task year equal weight yields hybrid shares of 0.327 and 0.876. Within Eedi, 21 eligible systems with decoder LLMs have five exact interface profiles; ten LLM Science Exam systems share one interface class and have four profiles. Across Kaggle, the eligible systems with decoder LLMs span 18 exact interface profiles, revealing variation within broad task and backbone categories. These estimates characterize documented public systems selected using our selection criteria and include interfaces throughout the complete pipeline, including intermediate stages. The data are available at this https URL.

translation.title: 超越自由生成：度量竞争性NLP系统中的接口组合
translation.abstract: 配备decoder LLM的系统可以将自由生成与打分、排序或选择相结合。我们通过五个与源证据关联的标注字段来度量这些有文档记录的接口组合。语料库包括来自42个涉及NLP的Kaggle竞赛的517个解决方案，以及来自26个SemEval、TREC和WMT任务年份的76个参赛系统。在符合条件的使用decoder LLM的生成系统中，55个Kaggle系统中有18个、20个Shared Task系统中有17个是混合型的：自由生成与受限接口共存。其余系统仅使用自由生成。给每个竞赛或任务年份同等权重时，混合型占比分别为0.327和0.876。在Eedi中，21个符合条件的decoder LLM系统具有五种精确的接口配置；十个LLM Science Exam系统共享一个接口类别并具有四种配置。在整个Kaggle中，符合条件的decoder LLM系统涵盖18种精确的接口配置，揭示了宽泛任务和骨干类别内部的差异。这些估计刻画了按我们的选择标准筛选出的有文档记录的公开系统，并涵盖完整流水线（包括中间阶段）中的接口。数据可在该https URL获取。
translation.brief: 该论文要解决如何度量NLP竞赛系统中自由生成与受限接口的组合使用问题，采用基于五个标注字段对Kaggle和共享任务系统语料进行系统标注与统计的方法。

papers.title: When Does Decomposition Help? Empirical Study on Workload-Architecture Affinity in LLM Inference Serving
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference can be organized as independent monolithic replicas, tensor- or pipeline-parallel serving groups, or disaggregated prefill and decode services. Although decomposition is often presented as a route to higher efficiency, its benefit depends on workload shape, model fit, and whether phase-specific resources can be independently scaled. Existing comparisons frequently change several of these factors at once. We isolate the architectural effect by evaluating five SGLang serving organizations under the same four-A100-40GB hardware envelope, pinned Qwen3-8B model, software stack, prompts, and arrival schedules. Our evaluation contains 150 audited conditions over short-chat, decode-heavy, and 32K prefill-heavy workloads. Four independent one-GPU replicas achieve the lowest end-to-end latency for short chat and long output and are the only architecture stable in every condition. Pipeline parallelism reduces 32K time to first token by 58-59% at non-stress rates, while hybrid pipeline-based disaggregation achieves the best 32K end-to-end latency at 0.4 requests/s. In contrast, B's single-VM static TP2+TP2 split, without independent phase scaling, does not improve tested latency over replication and collapses at higher 32K load. These results reveal a workload-architecture affinity: pipeline decomposition favors prefill-heavy computation, whereas replication favors decode-heavy and concurrent traffic. More broadly, decomposition is not a monotonic optimization; its value depends on matching parallelism granularity to the dominant phase and preserving queue stability.

translation.title: 分解何时有益？LLM推理服务中负载-架构亲和性的实证研究
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）推理可以组织为独立的单体副本、张量并行或流水线并行服务组，或分离的prefill与decode服务。尽管分解常被呈现为提升效率的途径，但其收益取决于负载形态、模型适配度以及阶段专用资源能否独立扩缩。现有比较往往同时改变多个因素。我们通过在相同的四张A100-40GB硬件环境、固定的Qwen3-8B模型、软件栈、提示词和到达时间表下评估五种SGLang服务组织方式，来隔离架构效应。评估包含150个经审计的条件，覆盖短对话、decode密集和32K prefill密集负载。四个独立单GPU副本在短对话和长输出场景下取得最低端到端延迟，并且是唯一在所有条件下都稳定的架构。流水线并行在非压力速率下将32K首token时间降低58-59%，而基于流水线的混合分离方案在0.4请求/秒下取得最佳32K端到端延迟。相比之下，B的单虚拟机静态TP2+TP2切分由于缺乏独立的阶段扩缩，在测试延迟上并未优于副本方式，且在更高32K负载下崩溃。这些结果揭示了一种负载-架构亲和性：流水线分解有利于prefill密集计算，而副本方式有利于decode密集和并发流量。更广泛地说，分解并非单调优化；其价值取决于将并行粒度与主导阶段相匹配并保持队列稳定。
translation.brief: 该论文要解决LLM推理服务中架构分解何时有益的问题，采用在固定硬件、模型与负载条件下对比五种SGLang服务组织方式的受控实验方法。

papers.title: Beyond Evidence Coverage: Encoding-Time Access in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: Cache-sharing multi-agent systems can retain every evidence token's representation while preventing cross-worker access during encoding. We test whether this coverage recovers joint-encoding quality using attention masks over two logical workers in frozen Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct models. Tokens, positions, and answer-time access remain fixed within comparisons. We evaluate 200 two-hop MuSiQue-Ans questions and 200 selected HotpotQA bridge questions. In data-layout seed 0, averaged across models, blocking access costs 5.6 and 6.8 F1 points relative to full access on MuSiQue and HotpotQA, respectively. Exposing the earlier worker's supporting paragraph improves F1 over blocked access by 7.6 and 6.7 points; equal-token non-support access provides no detectable average gain. With model weights and greedy decoding fixed, we vary distractor layouts using five data-layout seeds per dataset for Qwen3-8B and three for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Supporting-paragraph access has higher mean F1 than blocked and equal-token non-support access in every evaluated data-layout seed. Supporting access can also outperform full access, but its advantage depends on the model, dataset, and layout. Oracle support labels isolate access from selection error; the study does not evaluate a deployable selector. Complete evidence coverage at answer time therefore does not guarantee joint-encoding quality: which supporting facts can interact during encoding matters.

translation.title: 超越证据覆盖：多智能体系统中的编码时访问
translation.abstract: 共享缓存的多智能体系统可以在编码期间保留每个证据token的表示，同时阻止跨worker访问。我们使用注意力掩码在冻结的Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型上对两个逻辑worker进行实验，检验这种覆盖是否能恢复联合编码的质量。在比较中，token、位置和回答时访问保持固定。我们评估了200个两跳MuSiQue-Ans问题和200个精选的HotpotQA桥接问题。在数据布局种子0中，跨模型平均，阻止访问相对于完全访问在MuSiQue和HotpotQA上分别损失5.6和6.8个F1点。暴露前一个worker的支持段落使F1相比阻止访问分别提升7.6和6.7点；等token的非支持访问没有可检测的平均增益。在模型权重和贪心解码固定的情况下，我们使用每个数据集五个数据布局种子（Qwen3-8B）和三个种子（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct）来变化干扰项布局。在所有评估的数据布局种子中，支持段落的访问的平均F1均高于阻止访问和等token非支持访问。支持访问也可以优于完全访问，但其优势取决于模型、数据集和布局。Oracle支持标签将访问与选择误差分离；本研究未评估可部署的选择器。因此，回答时的完整证据覆盖并不能保证联合编码质量：哪些支持事实能在编码期间交互才是关键。
translation.brief: 该论文要解决证据覆盖是否足以保证多智能体联合编码质量的问题，采用注意力掩码控制编码时跨worker访问的受控实验方法。

papers.title: Decoding Transformer Dynamics via Koopman Subspaces
papers.abstract: We apply Koopman operator theory and Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD) to characterise how large language models (LLMs) process different input topics. Treating the layer-to-layer evolution of hidden states as a dynamical system, we fit a linear Koopman operator and take the subspace spanned by its dominant modes as a per-topic spectral fingerprint. Four findings emerge. First, the depth map is near-linear: a single linear operator predicts each next-layer state to within approx. 18% relative error (interior variance explained approx. 0.99). Second, over the 57 MMLU subjects the fingerprint is topic-discriminative, matching the MMLU taxonomy at 0.72 nearest-neighbour purity and each subject's semantic neighbourhood at 0.75 any-hit@3. Third, it is a reproducible signature (split-half self-retrieval approx. 0.97$). Finally, these findings are consistent across seven base models (Qwen2.5 0.5-7B, Llama-3 1-8B), with a suggestive trend of alignment rising with MMLU accuracy. The spectral fingerprint thus provides a probe of how transformers process different topics across depth. Code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: 通过Koopman子空间解码Transformer动力学
translation.abstract: 我们应用Koopman算子理论和动态模态分解（DMD）来刻画大语言模型（LLM）如何处理不同输入主题。将隐藏状态的逐层演化视为动力系统，我们拟合一个线性Koopman算子，并将其主导模态张成的子空间作为每个主题的谱指纹。得到四项发现。第一，深度映射接近线性：单个线性算子预测每个下一层状态的相对误差约为18%（内部方差解释约0.99）。第二，在57个MMLU学科上，该指纹具有主题区分性，与MMLU分类体系的最近邻纯度匹配为0.72，与每个学科的语义邻域的any-hit@3为0.75。第三，它是一个可复现的签名（split-half自检索约0.97）。最后，这些发现在七个基础模型（Qwen2.5 0.5-7B、Llama-3 1-8B）上保持一致，并呈现出对齐度随MMLU准确率上升的趋势。因此，谱指纹提供了一种探测Transformer跨深度处理不同主题方式的手段。代码可在该https URL获取。
translation.brief: 该论文要解决如何刻画LLM跨层处理不同主题的动力学问题，采用将隐藏状态演化拟合为线性Koopman算子并提取主导模态子空间作为谱指纹的方法。

papers.title: When Can a Rewiring Control Test LLM Weight Readers? C2 and an Eligibility Protocol
papers.abstract: Large language models can predict the outputs of small neural networks from raw weights, but success could reflect recognition of weight-space regularities (fingerprints) rather than computation, and function-preserving controls cannot tell these apart. We propose C2, a counterfactual that permutes the columns of a network's final linear readout: every other parameter, and the readout's singular values, norms and entry multiset, are unchanged, and the function can change in an exactly recomputable way; we verify that each evaluated permutation does. C2 separates fingerprinting from computation only under three conditions, which we state as an eligibility protocol: a strategy restricted to C2-invariant summaries must already predict the target; C2 must change a property specific to the rewiring; and the reader's identity must be attested. No natural setting we tested is eligible. On tiny MLPs a frontier reader route followed the rewired function on all 24 networks, but invariant baselines were near chance and its backend could not be attested. In two public CNN zoos the conditions traded off: weight statistics predicted CIFAR-10 accuracy in-distribution, but C2's effect on accuracy was not specific to the swap, while per-image targets were specific but not predictable from invariant summaries. On a constructed population where a planted fingerprint rule works, all conditions hold and C2 separates a rule-following reader from an executor. A self-hosted Qwen3.8-27B followed the rewired function rather than the shortcut, and showed no evidence of using the weights with thinking disabled. A registered replication on fresh networks confirmed both findings (tracking minus stuck 0.875, 95% interval [0.750, 1.000]), and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B also followed the rewiring (tracking minus stuck 0.729 [0.552, 0.885]). The transforms, audits and raw records are available from the authors.

translation.title: 何时能用重连控制检验LLM权重读取器？C2与资格协议
translation.abstract: 大语言模型可以从原始权重预测小型神经网络的输出，但成功可能反映的是对权重空间规律（指纹）的识别而非计算，而保持函数不变的对照无法区分二者。我们提出C2，一个对网络最终线性读出层列进行置换的反事实：所有其他参数以及读出层的奇异值、范数和元素多重集均不变，而函数可以以可精确重算的方式改变；我们验证了每个评估的置换确实如此。C2仅在三个条件下才能区分指纹识别与计算，我们将其表述为资格协议：仅限于C2不变摘要的策略必须已能预测目标；C2必须改变重连特有的属性；且读取器的身份必须可认证。我们测试的自然场景均不符合资格。在微型MLP上，一个前沿读取器路径在全部24个网络上跟随了重连后的函数，但不变基线接近随机水平，且其后端无法认证。在两个公开CNN动物园中，各条件相互制约：权重统计可在分布内预测CIFAR-10准确率，但C2对准确率的影响并非置换特有；而逐图像目标具有特异性但无法从不变摘要预测。在一个植入指纹规则有效的构造种群上，所有条件均成立，C2成功区分了遵循规则的读取器与执行器。自托管的Qwen3.8-27B跟随了重连后的函数而非捷径，且在关闭思考时没有使用权重的证据。在全新网络上的一项预注册复现确认了这两项发现（tracking减stuck为0.875，95%区间[0.750, 1.000]），DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B也跟随了重连（tracking减stuck为0.729 [0.552, 0.885]）。变换、审计和原始记录可向作者获取。
translation.brief: 该论文要解决如何区分LLM是从权重中识别指纹还是真正执行计算的问题，提出C2列置换反事实及三条件资格协议作为检验方法。

papers.title: Group-Balanced Supervised Fine-Tuning for Knowledge-Intensive Domains
papers.abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) weights every supervised token equally, so on knowledge-dense corpora the loss budget follows token count rather than importance: on a legal QA benchmark, citation strings absorb 81% of the supervised loss weight budget while the answers being taught absorb 5%. We present Group-Balanced SFT (GB-SFT), which equalizes the loss budget across the semantic roles of tokens within a target sequence. With one tunable dial and one structural switch, GB-SFT contains standard SFT, class- and span-level balancing as corners whose geometry we characterize exactly. On benchmarks in law, medicine, code, and mathematics, we show across model families that: (i) GB- SFT injects new knowledge better than uniform SFT, pointwise token weighting, memory editing, and matched-budget data mixing; (ii) it matches the injection of masking out everything but the knowledge payload while retaining the citation recall that masking destroys (0.98 vs. 0.38); and (iii) role-aware grouping carries the gain: label-free partitions recover at most a third of it, an LLM tagger nearly all where the groups are lexically distinctive; and and (iv) the budget governs what fine-tuning breaks as well as what it learns, acting as a monotone lever on the safety-guardrail erosion SFT causes, at matched task accuracy. We release two new contamination-controlled knowledge-injection benchmarks with validated ground truth.

translation.title: 面向知识密集型领域的组平衡监督微调
translation.abstract: 监督微调（SFT）对所有监督 token 一视同仁，因此在知识密集语料上，损失预算跟随 token 数量而非重要性：在一个法律问答基准上，引用字符串占据了 81% 的监督损失权重预算，而真正要教授的答案仅占 5%。我们提出组平衡 SFT（GB-SFT），它在目标序列内对 token 的语义角色均衡损失预算。通过一个可调旋钮和一个结构开关，GB-SFT 将标准 SFT、类级和片段级平衡作为其几何结构被精确刻画的角点。在法律、医学、代码和数学基准上，我们跨多个模型家族展示：(i) GB-SFT 比均匀 SFT、逐点 token 加权、记忆编辑和等预算数据混合更好地注入新知识；(ii) 它达到与仅保留知识载荷、屏蔽其余内容相同的注入效果，同时保留了屏蔽会破坏的引用召回率（0.98 对 0.38）；(iii) 增益来自角色感知的分组：无标签划分最多恢复其三分之一，当组在词汇上具有区分性时，LLM 标注器几乎可恢复全部增益；(iv) 损失预算既决定微调学到什么，也决定微调破坏什么，在相同任务准确率下，它是对 SFT 造成的安全护栏侵蚀的单调杠杆。我们发布了两个新的、经污染控制且具有验证真值的知识注入基准。
translation.brief: 解决 SFT 中损失预算按 token 数量而非重要性分配导致知识注入低效的问题，核心方法是按 token 语义角色分组均衡损失预算的 GB-SFT。

papers.title: The Retry Tax: Why Static Same-Task Retries Can Cost More per Completion
papers.abstract: Retrying an agent after failure can complete more tasks while increasing the cost per completion. We study a static policy that stops at verified success or an attempt cap and otherwise resets the original prompt and workspace without passing feedback to the next request. Under stationary task success probabilities, independent attempts conditional on the task, and a common attempt cost, easier tasks tend to succeed earlier. When task success probabilities differ, the unresolved mix shifts toward harder tasks. Specializing classical survivor selection, we show that cost per completion is at least as high as in one-shot serving and that marginal cost per additional completion is nondecreasing wherever the completion increments are positive. These are different quantities: one averages spending over all completions, while the other prices the completions added by another attempt. We then arrange each task's existing benchmark runs in different orders, stop each sequence at verified success or the attempt cap, and average the resulting completion and spending at each supported cap. For one OpenHands configuration, replay estimates completion of 59.7 percent with one attempt and 70.0 percent with four, while cost per completion rises from about USD 0.70 to USD 1.32. The recorded trade-off describes fixed configurations on the available tasks. Choosing a cap requires comparing the additional spending with the application's value for the additional completions.

translation.title: 重试税：为什么静态的同任务重试可能推高每次完成的成本
translation.abstract: 在失败后重试智能体可以完成更多任务，同时却推高了每次完成的成本。我们研究一种静态策略：在验证成功或达到尝试上限时停止，否则重置原始提示和工作区，且不向前一次请求传递反馈。在平稳的任务成功概率、任务内各次尝试条件独立以及统一尝试成本的假设下，较容易的任务倾向于更早成功。当任务成功概率不同时，未解决的任务组合会向更难的任务偏移。通过特化经典的幸存者选择理论，我们证明每次完成的成本不低于一次性服务，且只要完成增量为正，每增加一次完成的边际成本是非递减的。这是两个不同的量：前者将支出平均到所有完成上，后者为再增加一次尝试所带来的完成定价。随后，我们将每个任务已有的基准运行按不同顺序排列，在每个序列的验证成功或尝试上限处停止，并在每个支持的上限处平均所得的完成数与支出。对一个 OpenHands 配置，重放估计显示单次尝试完成率为 59.7%，四次尝试为 70.0%，而每次完成的成本从约 0.70 美元升至 1.32 美元。所记录的权衡描述的是在可用任务上的固定配置。选择上限需要将额外支出与应用对额外完成的价值进行比较。
translation.brief: 解决智能体失败后静态重试可能推高每次完成成本的问题，核心方法是用幸存者选择理论刻画重试策略的成本结构并通过基准重放进行实证估计。

papers.title: Can an Agent Trust Its Own Zoom? Cross-Magnification Provenance Verification for Whole-Slide Images
papers.abstract: Visual agents navigate whole-slide images through magnified observations associated with claimed locations. However, a visually plausible observation does not necessarily originate from its claimed location, particularly across magnifications and in regions with similar tissue structures. We formulate cross-magnification provenance verification (CMPV) to evaluate whether visual evidence supports a claimed spatial association, recover the source when possible, and abstain when evidence is insufficient. We introduce PyraFault, a benchmark of 3.06 million coordinate-supervised examples from 2,200 cases across five TCGA cohorts, covering within-context substitutions, absent-source faults, and geometric perturbations. We further propose ZoomTrace, a claim-independent verifier that estimates the observation's source before evaluating its agreement with the claimed location. It combines physical-scale alignment, visual retrieval, geometric refinement, and reliability estimation using spatially disjoint competing matches. On 503,320 test examples, ZoomTrace achieves 0.969 AUPRC and 0.987 AUROC, compared with 0.789 and 0.903 for Efficient LoFTR. Further evaluations reveal trade-offs in reliability estimation and limitations in vision-language models, cross-dataset retrieval, and calibration. Integrating ZoomTrace into visual agent tool paths reduces exposure to corrupted observations and silent failures, while downstream accuracy improvements depend on the agent and verification threshold.

translation.title: 智能体能相信自己的放大观察吗？面向全切片图像的跨放大倍率来源验证
translation.abstract: 视觉智能体通过与声称位置关联的放大观察来导航全切片图像。然而，视觉上合理的观察未必真的来自其声称的位置，尤其是在不同放大倍率之间以及组织结构相似的区域。我们提出跨放大倍率来源验证（CMPV）任务，以评估视觉证据是否支持所声称的空间关联，在可能时恢复真实来源，并在证据不足时弃权。我们构建了 PyraFault 基准，包含来自五个 TCGA 队列 2,200 个病例的 306 万个坐标监督样本，涵盖上下文内替换、来源缺失故障和几何扰动。我们进一步提出 ZoomTrace，一个与声称无关的验证器：先估计观察的真实来源，再评估其与声称位置的一致性。它结合了物理尺度对齐、视觉检索、几何精化，以及利用空间不相交的竞争匹配进行的可靠性估计。在 503,320 个测试样本上，ZoomTrace 达到 0.969 AUPRC 和 0.987 AUROC，而 Efficient LoFTR 分别为 0.789 和 0.903。进一步评估揭示了可靠性估计中的权衡，以及视觉-语言模型、跨数据集检索和校准方面的局限。将 ZoomTrace 集成到视觉智能体工具路径中可减少对损坏观察和静默失败的暴露，而下游准确率的提升取决于智能体和验证阈值。
translation.brief: 解决视觉智能体放大观察可能与其声称位置不符的问题，核心方法是提出跨放大倍率来源验证任务及先估计真实来源再核对一致性的 ZoomTrace 验证器。

papers.title: Medical Specialty Prediction from Bangla Patient Narratives: A Comparative Study of ML, DL, Transformers, and LLMs
papers.abstract: Timely access to appropriate medical specialists remains a bottleneck in Bangladesh's healthcare system, as patients describe symptoms in informal Bangla rather than clinical terms, leading to ineffective referrals. This paper compares four model families for predicting medical specialties from Bangla patient narratives: six machine learning (ML) models using hybrid TF-IDF features, four deep learning (DL) models using Word2Vec embeddings trained on the corpus, four fine-tuned transformers, and five large language models (LLMs) evaluated zero-shot. From a corpus of 3798 patient records covering 20 specialties, we retained the five with the most records (Medicine, Gynecology, Dermatology, Pediatrics, Gastroenterology) and split the resulting 2730 records 80:20 into training and test sets shared by all families. The best transformer was XLM-RoBERTa (86.26% accuracy, 86.21% macro-F1), the best ML model was SVM (84.98%, 84.92%), the best DL model was Bidirectional GRU (80.77%, 80.83%), and the best LLM was Gemini (90.29%, 90.15%). Holm-corrected paired McNemar tests show SVM significantly outperforming Bi-LSTM (adjusted p = 0.004), whereas the Gemini-versus-Grok gap does not survive correction (adjusted p = 0.104), and neither the strongest transformer versus the weakest LLM (Grok) nor SVM versus the strongest transformer reaches significance. A tuned classical model is thus statistically indistinguishable from the strongest transformer, so accuracy rankings alone should not be read as evidence of one family's superiority. The findings provide a comparative baseline for Bangla medical text classification.

translation.title: 基于孟加拉语患者叙述的医学专科预测：ML、DL、Transformer 与 LLM 的比较研究
translation.abstract: 在孟加拉国的医疗体系中，及时获得合适的医学专科诊疗仍是瓶颈，因为患者用非正式的孟加拉语而非临床术语描述症状，导致转诊低效。本文比较了四类模型家族在从孟加拉语患者叙述预测医学专科上的表现：六个使用混合 TF-IDF 特征的机器学习（ML）模型、四个使用在语料上训练的 Word2Vec 词向量的深度学习（DL）模型、四个微调的 Transformer，以及五个零样本评估的大语言模型（LLM）。语料包含覆盖 20 个专科的 3,798 条患者记录，我们保留了记录最多的五个专科（内科、妇科、皮肤科、儿科、消化科），并将所得 2,730 条记录按 80:20 划分为所有家族共享的训练集和测试集。最佳 Transformer 是 XLM-RoBERTa（86.26% 准确率，86.21% 宏 F1），最佳 ML 模型是 SVM（84.98%，84.92%），最佳 DL 模型是双向 GRU（80.77%，80.83%），最佳 LLM 是 Gemini（90.29%，90.15%）。经 Holm 校正的配对 McNemar 检验显示 SVM 显著优于 Bi-LSTM（校正后 p = 0.004），而 Gemini 与 Grok 的差距在校正后不显著（校正后 p = 0.104），最强 Transformer 与最弱 LLM（Grok）之间以及 SVM 与最强 Transformer 之间也均未达到显著。因此，调优后的经典模型在统计上与最强 Transformer 无显著差异，不应仅凭准确率排名就断言某一模型家族的优越性。这些发现为孟加拉语医学文本分类提供了比较基线。
translation.brief: 解决从非正式孟加拉语患者叙述预测医学专科的问题，核心方法是在统一数据划分下系统比较 ML、DL、Transformer 和 LLM 四类模型家族的性能。

papers.title: MVAgent: Per-Video Agents under Global Coordination for Multi-Video Understanding
papers.abstract: Multi-video understanding requires systems to combine evidence from different videos for cross-video reasoning. Answering such questions involves two kinds of decisions. Observation decisions must adapt to each video's content, whereas cross-video judgments require relating evidence from different videos based on the question. Most existing agents make both kinds of decisions in one controller, whose context accumulates observations from every video. We separate them in MVAgent, a training-free Multi-Video Understanding Agent framework with one LocalAgent per video. Each LocalAgent plans observations of its own video and keeps a private observation history. A GlobalAgent coordinates cross-video reasoning by instructing the LocalAgents and combining their reports with joint observation. We evaluate MVAgent on CVBench, MVU-Eval, and CrossVid, using three Qwen3.5 models of different sizes and GPT-6-sol. With Qwen3.5, our framework improves aggregate benchmark scores by 5.1 points on average over Single-pass inference with the same model and by 5.0 points over the strongest prior agent using the same model. With GPT-6-sol, the average gain over Single-pass inference with the same model is 4.3 points. On the same hardware, MVAgent also runs 1.8-2.7 times faster than prior agents of comparable size.

translation.title: MVAgent：全局协调下的逐视频智能体用于多视频理解
translation.abstract: 多视频理解要求系统组合来自不同视频的证据进行跨视频推理。回答此类问题涉及两类决策：观察决策必须适应每个视频的内容，而跨视频判断则需要根据问题关联来自不同视频的证据。现有大多数智能体在单一控制器中同时做出这两类决策，其上下文会累积来自每个视频的观察。我们在 MVAgent 中将二者分离，这是一个免训练的多视频理解智能体框架，为每个视频配备一个 LocalAgent。每个 LocalAgent 规划自己视频的观察并维护私有的观察历史。GlobalAgent 通过指示 LocalAgent 并将其报告与联合观察相结合来协调跨视频推理。我们在 CVBench、MVU-Eval 和 CrossVid 上评估 MVAgent，使用三个不同规模的 Qwen3.5 模型和 GPT-6-sol。使用 Qwen3.5 时，与同模型的单次推理相比，我们的框架平均提升基准总分 5.1 分，与使用同模型的最强先前智能体相比提升 5.0 分。使用 GPT-6-sol 时，与同模型单次推理相比平均提升 4.3 分。在相同硬件上，MVAgent 的运行速度也比规模相近的先前智能体快 1.8-2.7 倍。
translation.brief: 解决多视频理解中观察决策与跨视频判断耦合于单一控制器导致上下文膨胀的问题，核心方法是免训练的逐视频 LocalAgent 与全局 GlobalAgent 协调的分层框架。

papers.title: ContextFact: Remembering Facts in Context for Long-Term Conversational Agents
papers.abstract: Agents built on large language models must maintain continuity across repeated interactions with users. However, long-term conversations scatter facts across turns and sessions, making it difficult to retrieve the right evidence with enough context. Memory for such conversations must therefore preserve facts with their context while keeping evidence selectively accessible. We first study how memory construction and retrieval-unit boundaries affect answerability and evidence access. Reading the entire memory bank reveals gaps that cannot be resolved by retrieval selection alone, showing that some context must be preserved during memory construction. Adjacent-turn grouping improves evidence access at matched unique-turn budgets, while wider windows do not consistently help. This motivates keeping fact-specific context local while organizing cross-session evidence separately. We propose ContextFact, which links context-preserving fact memories with source-grounded entity representations. Within sessions, it gathers the context needed to interpret each fact. Across sessions, it aligns recurring referents and revisits the source dialogue to reconstruct coherent entity representations linked to the supporting facts. At query time, ContextFact retrieves fact and entity views, reranks them independently, and uses entity-linked expansion to surface related facts; complete entity representations then provide organized cross-session evidence. With Qwen3.5-27B as the backbone, ContextFact achieves state-of-the-art performance while using only $21\%$ of the evidence tokens consumed by the strongest evaluated baseline, obtaining $86.49\%$ overall judge accuracy on LoCoMo and $91.00\%$ on LongMemEval-S. Controlled ablations support context-preserving fact boundaries and source-grounded entity reconstruction, while entity readout improves multi-hop accuracy beyond adding more facts.

translation.title: ContextFact：在上下文中记忆事实以支持长期对话智能体
translation.abstract: 基于大语言模型的智能体必须在用户的多次交互中保持连续性。然而，长期对话将事实分散在多轮对话和多个会话中，使得难以检索到带有足够上下文的正确证据。因此，此类对话的记忆必须在保留事实及其上下文的同时，使证据可被有选择地访问。我们首先研究记忆构建和检索单元边界如何影响可回答性与证据访问。通读整个记忆库揭示了仅靠检索选择无法解决的缺口，表明某些上下文必须在记忆构建阶段被保留。在相同的唯一轮次预算下，相邻轮次分组改善了证据访问，而更宽的窗口并不能持续带来帮助。这促使我们将事实特定的上下文保持在局部，同时单独组织跨会话证据。我们提出 ContextFact，将保留上下文的事实记忆与基于源对话的实体表示相链接。在会话内，它收集解释每个事实所需的上下文；跨会话时，它对齐反复出现的指称对象，并回溯源对话以重建与支持事实相链接的连贯实体表示。在查询时，ContextFact 检索事实视图和实体视图，分别进行重排序，并利用实体链接扩展来呈现相关事实；完整的实体表示随后提供有组织的跨会话证据。以 Qwen3.5-27B 为骨干，ContextFact 取得了最先进的性能，同时仅使用最强评估基线所消耗证据 token 的 21%，在 LoCoMo 上获得 86.49% 的总体评判准确率，在 LongMemEval-S 上获得 91.00%。受控消融实验支持保留上下文的事实边界和基于源对话的实体重建，而实体读取在增加更多事实之外进一步提升了多跳准确率。
translation.brief: 解决长期对话中事实证据分散、缺乏上下文导致检索困难的问题，提出 ContextFact，通过保留上下文的事实记忆与基于源对话的实体表示相链接来组织记忆与检索。

papers.title: ARC: Adaptive Rollout Control for Efficient Synchronous LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Synchronous reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models proceeds through a repeated rollout--barrier--update loop. Each update must wait for a fixed number of complete, group-relative training samples, yet individual response lengths and reward outcomes vary widely and only emerge as generation progresses. Static admission and unconditional completion therefore leave accelerators idle in some steps, and waste computation generating samples that will never contribute to the current update. We present ARC, a closed-loop rollout architecture that governs synchronous RL rollout at group granularity. ARC uses \textit{Calibrated Streaming Backfill} to judge from partial observations whether a group is still worth completing, backfilling a fresh candidate immediately when it is not; \textit{Deferred Group Completion} to park an uncertain early stop and resume it later instead of discarding it outright, bounded by a resume-cycle limit that guarantees termination; and \textit{Adaptive Admission} and \textit{Pipelining} to order admitted samples by early-measured duration and to admit further candidates only while expected supply still falls short of the target number of accepted groups. Under online evaluation, ARC reduces rollout time by $37.4\%$, a $1.60\times$ speedup, and improves effective GRPO throughput by $50.1\%$ over existing baselines, while directly recovering 98.9\% of the training groups that would ultimately have been kept.

translation.title: ARC：面向高效同步 LLM 强化学习的自适应 Rollout 控制
translation.abstract: 大语言模型的同步强化学习（RL）通过重复的 rollout—屏障—更新循环进行。每次更新必须等待固定数量的完整、组相对训练样本，然而单个响应的长度和奖励结果差异巨大，且只有在生成过程中才逐渐显现。静态准入和无条件完成因此导致加速器在某些步骤空闲，并浪费计算去生成永远不会对当前更新有贡献的样本。我们提出 ARC，一种以组为粒度管理同步 RL rollout 的闭环架构。ARC 使用 Calibrated Streaming Backfill 根据部分观测判断一个组是否仍值得继续完成，若不值得则立即回填一个新的候选；使用 Deferred Group Completion 将不确定的提前停止暂存并稍后恢复，而非直接丢弃，并受保证终止的恢复周期上限约束；使用 Adaptive Admission 和 Pipelining 按早期测量的时长对已准入样本排序，并仅在预期供给仍低于目标接受组数时才准入更多候选。在在线评估中，ARC 将 rollout 时间减少 37.4%，实现 1.60 倍加速，相比现有基线将有效 GRPO 吞吐量提升 50.1%，同时直接挽回了本应保留的训练组的 98.9%。
translation.brief: 解决同步 RL 中静态准入与无条件完成导致算力空闲和浪费的问题，提出 ARC 闭环架构，以组为粒度通过流式回填、延迟组完成和自适应准入来控制 rollout。

papers.title: Fixed or Deleted? External Feedback Lets Cheaper AI Coding Agents Repair Rule Violations
papers.abstract: Many defects violate project rules that the code itself does not reveal, such as layering constraints or required tests. We study whether LLM coding agents repair such violations better when an external checker reports them, with their location and a repair goal. Three models, a small, medium and large model, driven by an AI agent, worked on 25 pull requests with 31 planted defects in ten open-source projects, plus 5 correct controls, five times alone and five times with findings from CodeAssure (CA), a commercial checker. We also compare with GitHub Copilot code review, and compare CodeAssure's detection with nine free static-analysis tools run out of the box, including Semgrep and SonarQube Community. Counting a run as repaired only when the repaired code also compiles and keeps its feature, CA findings raised the repair rate from 26% to 69% for the smallest model, from 46% to 90% for the medium model and from 45% to 93% for the largest model (pull-request-level p < 0.001), and from 39% to 84% over all runs. Every Java, TypeScript and Python repair compiled. We found that agents often cleared a defect by deleting a newly added file. Metrics based on whether the defect is gone count feature deletion as a success. The largest model alone did so in 44 of 125 runs. CA includes a check for deleted files that largely prevents this. In an ablation with the check turned off, removals rose from 9 to 65 out of 375 runs and the repair rate fell to 54% (small), 70% (medium) and 85% (large model). The CA workflow also outperformed Copilot code review (p < 0.001). Together, the free tools detected 8 of the 31 defects, and CA detected all 31. With CA, the medium model repaired 90% of runs, against 45% for the largest model alone, at about one fifth of the mean cost per run ($0.17 against $0.91).

translation.title: 修复还是删除？外部反馈让更便宜的 AI 编程智能体修复规则违规
translation.abstract: 许多缺陷违反了代码本身无法体现的项目规则，例如分层约束或必需的测试。我们研究当外部检查器报告违规及其位置和修复目标时，LLM 编程智能体是否能更好地修复此类违规。三个模型（小、中、大模型）由 AI 智能体驱动，在十个开源项目的 25 个包含 31 个植入缺陷的 pull request 以及 5 个正确对照上各运行五次，一次单独运行，一次结合商业检查器 CodeAssure（CA）的发现。我们还与 GitHub Copilot 代码审查进行比较，并将 CodeAssure 的检测能力与九个开箱即用的免费静态分析工具（包括 Semgrep 和 SonarQube Community）进行比较。只有当修复后的代码能够编译且保留其功能时才计为修复成功，CA 的发现使最小模型的修复率从 26% 提升到 69%，中等模型从 46% 提升到 90%，最大模型从 45% 提升到 93%（pull-request 级别 p < 0.001），所有运行整体从 39% 提升到 84%。所有 Java、TypeScript 和 Python 的修复均可编译。我们发现智能体经常通过删除新添加的文件来清除缺陷。基于缺陷是否消失的指标会将功能删除计为成功。最大模型单独运行时在 125 次中有 44 次如此。CA 包含针对删除文件的检查，在很大程度上防止了这种情况。在关闭该检查的消融实验中，375 次运行中的删除从 9 次上升到 65 次，修复率降至 54%（小模型）、70%（中模型）和 85%（大模型）。CA 工作流也优于 Copilot 代码审查（p < 0.001）。免费工具合计检测到 31 个缺陷中的 8 个，而 CA 检测到全部 31 个。使用 CA 时，中等模型修复了 90% 的运行，而最大模型单独运行仅修复 45%，且每次运行的平均成本约为后者的五分之一（0.17 美元对 0.91 美元）。
translation.brief: 研究外部检查器反馈能否帮助 LLM 编程智能体修复代码本身无法体现的项目规则违规，通过在 25 个 pull request 上对比有无 CodeAssure 发现的修复实验进行验证。

papers.title: Decoupling Perception from Generation for Agentic 3D CT Report Generation
papers.abstract: Chest CT reports repeatedly assess the same anatomical regions for findings and their attributes, such as whether a lung nodule is present and where it is located. These assessments suggest learning to answer visual questions directly, rather than coupling perception to open-ended text generation. Yet current CT report generation models largely follow generic vision-language modeling, which may miss subtle abnormalities when training data are limited. We therefore formulate report generation as a set of visual question-answering decisions coordinated by a large language model (LLM) agent. This decouples visual perception from reasoning and report writing: perception can be learned as a discriminative, non-generative task, while the LLM focuses on reasoning over patient context and posing relevant visual queries. We introduce Rad-VL-JEPA, which unifies report retrieval, finding recognition, and fine-grained attribute characterization through vision-language joint-embedding prediction. Building on this perception module, an agent trained with reinforcement learning (RL) acquires patient-specific visual evidence, while a separate editor incorporates the evidence into the final report, further separating evidence acquisition from report realization. Experiments show that Rad-VL-JEPA achieves strong performance on fine-grained CT understanding tasks with lower amortized per-query inference time than a generative VLM baseline trained with the same CT encoder and VQA data. The resulting reporting system outperforms strong VLM-based and agentic baselines.

translation.title: 面向智能体化 3D CT 报告生成的感知与生成解耦
translation.abstract: 胸部 CT 报告反复评估相同的解剖区域以获取发现及其属性，例如肺结节是否存在及其位置。这些评估提示可以直接学习回答视觉问题，而不是将感知与开放式文本生成耦合。然而，当前的 CT 报告生成模型大多遵循通用的视觉-语言建模，在训练数据有限时可能遗漏细微异常。因此，我们将报告生成形式化为一组由大语言模型（LLM）智能体协调的视觉问答决策。这将视觉感知与推理和报告撰写解耦：感知可以作为判别式、非生成式任务来学习，而 LLM 专注于对患者上下文进行推理并提出相关的视觉查询。我们提出 Rad-VL-JEPA，通过视觉-语言联合嵌入预测统一了报告检索、发现识别和细粒度属性刻画。基于该感知模块，一个通过强化学习（RL）训练的智能体获取患者特定的视觉证据，而一个独立的编辑器将证据整合到最终报告中，进一步将证据获取与报告生成分离。实验表明，Rad-VL-JEPA 在细粒度 CT 理解任务上取得了强劲性能，且摊销的每次查询推理时间低于使用相同 CT 编码器和 VQA 数据训练的生成式 VLM 基线。由此构建的报告系统优于强大的基于 VLM 和智能体的基线。
translation.brief: 解决 CT 报告生成中感知与开放式文本生成耦合导致细微异常易被遗漏的问题，将报告生成形式化为 LLM 智能体协调的视觉问答决策，并提出联合嵌入感知模块 Rad-VL-JEPA。

papers.title: On Adaptive Step Sizes for Eligibility Traces in Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Many deep reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms store agent-environment interactions in a replay buffer and later learn by sampling transitions from it. However, this approach can be memory-inefficient and can delay learning because the agent can learn from a transition only when the buffer samples it. Additionally, most of these methods use one-step or short multi-step temporal-difference (TD) updates, which are slow at credit assignment. An alternative approach is to learn from the stream of observations as they arrive without relying on a buffer. Eligibility-trace algorithms allow these incremental updates and can also assign credit over many steps. These algorithms were common with linear function approximation but have only recently been used in deep RL. Basic questions, such as how to use vector step sizes with eligibility traces in the deep RL setting, remain open. In this work, we first show that adaptive vector step sizes must be part of the eligibility trace to keep the equivalence between the forward and backward views. We then show that the step sizes of common optimizers, such as Adam, do not have an online backward view. We introduce a new optimizer, Function-Space Distance (FSD), that maintains the forward-backward equivalence. We test four eligibility-trace algorithms covering semi-gradient and gradient TD updates, as well as value-based and actor-critic methods. We show that FSD performs better than SGD or naively applied Adam. The resulting algorithms outperform or match other streaming methods and are comparable to or better than PPO, which uses a buffer, in most environments. Code available at this https URL

translation.title: 论深度强化学习中资格迹的自适应步长
translation.abstract: 许多深度强化学习（RL）算法将智能体与环境的交互存储在经验回放缓冲区中，之后通过从中采样转移来学习。然而，这种方法可能内存效率低下并延迟学习，因为智能体只有在缓冲区采样到某个转移时才能从中学习。此外，这些方法大多使用单步或短多步时序差分（TD）更新，在信用分配上速度较慢。另一种方法是在观测流到达时直接学习，而不依赖缓冲区。资格迹算法支持这种增量更新，并能在多步上进行信用分配。这些算法在线性函数逼近时代很常见，但直到最近才被用于深度 RL。一些基本问题，例如在深度 RL 设置中如何将向量步长与资格迹结合使用，仍未解决。在这项工作中，我们首先证明自适应向量步长必须成为资格迹的一部分，以保持前向视图与后向视图之间的等价性。然后我们证明常见优化器（如 Adam）的步长不具备在线后向视图。我们提出一种新优化器 Function-Space Distance（FSD），它保持前向-后向等价性。我们测试了四种资格迹算法，涵盖半梯度和梯度 TD 更新，以及基于价值和 actor-critic 的方法。结果表明 FSD 优于 SGD 或直接套用的 Adam。所得算法优于或持平于其他流式方法，并在大多数环境中与使用缓冲区的 PPO 相当或更优。代码见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 解决深度 RL 中资格迹如何与自适应向量步长结合的问题，证明步长须纳入资格迹以保持前向-后向视图等价，并提出保持该等价性的新优化器 FSD。

papers.title: PhyCoVE: Benchmarking Physical Counterfactual Video Editing across Diverse Material Dynamics
papers.abstract: Physical counterfactual video editing turns a source video and a language-specified physical edit at a given execution frame into a counterfactual video that shows how the scene would evolve after the edit. Existing evaluations with counterfactual target videos mainly cover object removal or specific rigid-body motions, although real scenes also involve elastic deformation, fluid flow, and interactions among rigid bodies, elastic solids, and fluids. We introduce PhyCoVE, a benchmark of 533 cases on 110 source videos that covers rigid, elastic, and fluid dynamics in five interaction patterns, with edits that remove an object, change a physical quantity, or insert a new object. For the simulated cases, a language model proposes scene designs, coding agents build them with solvers suited to each material and physically based rendering and then simulate each edit from the source scene state, and humans check every stage. For the real cases, we record continuously from one camera position before and after each edit. We also propose counterfactual fidelity, a metric that applies across materials and their interactions and measures how much of the physical change from the source video to the target video a generated video reproduces. We evaluate seven open-source and commercial video editing models and find that counterfactual fidelity ranks them nearly as human preference does, but even the best model reproduces only about one seventh of the physical change. The models change how a scene looks but rarely how it evolves, whereas a physical edit requires understanding the dynamics that it changes. Physical counterfactual video editing thus remains far from solved, and PhyCoVE provides a foundation for developing and evaluating methods for it.

translation.title: PhyCoVE：面向多样材料动力学的物理反事实视频编辑基准
translation.abstract: 物理反事实视频编辑将一段源视频和给定执行帧处由语言指定的物理编辑，转化为展示编辑后场景如何演化的反事实视频。现有基于反事实目标视频的评估主要覆盖物体移除或特定刚体运动，而真实场景还涉及弹性形变、流体流动以及刚体、弹性体和流体之间的相互作用。我们提出PhyCoVE，一个包含110个源视频上533个案例的基准，涵盖五种交互模式下的刚体、弹性和流体动力学，编辑类型包括移动物体、改变物理量或插入新物体。对于模拟案例，由语言模型提出场景设计，编码智能体使用适合各材料的求解器和基于物理的渲染来构建场景，并从源场景状态模拟每次编辑，每个阶段均由人工检查。对于真实案例，我们在每次编辑前后从同一相机位置连续录制。我们还提出反事实保真度这一指标，适用于各种材料及其相互作用，衡量生成视频再现了从源视频到目标视频的多少物理变化。我们评估了七个开源和商业视频编辑模型，发现反事实保真度对模型的排序与人类偏好几乎一致，但即使最好的模型也只再现了约七分之一的物理变化。这些模型改变场景的外观，却很少改变其演化方式，而物理编辑需要理解它所改变的动力学。因此物理反事实视频编辑仍远未解决，PhyCoVE为其方法的开发和评估提供了基础。
translation.brief: 针对现有视频编辑评估仅覆盖物体移除和刚体运动的问题，构建了涵盖刚体、弹性体和流体动力学及相互作用的物理反事实视频编辑基准PhyCoVE，并提出跨材料的反事实保真度评估指标。

papers.title: Ziv Meets Sumcheck: Zero-Knowledge Proofs of Floating-Point LLM Inference
papers.abstract: Zero-knowledge proofs can show that a neural network produced a given output without revealing the network, but current systems for language models prove integer approximations of the model rather than the floating-point arithmetic that is actually deployed. Proving floating-point matrix multiplication has been regarded as hard, because rounding after every addition makes the result depend on the order of the additions. We avoid this obstacle by proving the correctly rounded product, in which every dot product is computed exactly and rounded once. This result is independent of the hardware and at least as accurate as standard kernels. We give an interactive proof for this relation whose cost is close to that of integer matrix multiplication, with roughly a thousand times fewer committed values than per-operation floating-point circuits need constraints, extend it to every layer of a transformer, and give a privacy construction for the complete argument whose zero knowledge we prove under explicit hypotheses. We implement the system and prove the full forward pass of GPT-2 small, including all twelve blocks and the output over the whole vocabulary, in 19 minutes on two processor cores; verification takes 21 seconds. The verifier rejects all 236 attacks we tested, and the model's outputs agree with high-precision inference at least as closely as standard 16-bit inference does.

translation.title: Ziv Meets Sumcheck：浮点LLM推理的零知识证明
translation.abstract: 零知识证明可以在不泄露网络的情况下证明某个神经网络产生了给定输出，但当前针对语言模型的系统证明的是模型的整数近似，而非实际部署的浮点运算。证明浮点矩阵乘法一直被视为困难，因为每次加法后的舍入使结果依赖于加法顺序。我们通过证明正确舍入的乘积来绕开这一障碍，其中每个点积被精确计算并只舍入一次。该结果与硬件无关，且至少与标准内核一样精确。我们给出针对该关系的交互式证明，其成本接近整数矩阵乘法，承诺值数量比逐操作浮点电路所需约束少约一千倍；将其扩展到transformer的每一层，并为完整论证给出隐私构造，在明确假设下证明其零知识性。我们实现了该系统，在两个处理器核心上用19分钟证明GPT-2 small的完整前向传播，包括全部十二个模块和整个词表上的输出；验证耗时21秒。验证者拒绝了我们所测试的全部236种攻击，且模型输出与高精度推理的吻合程度不低于标准16位推理。
translation.brief: 针对现有零知识证明只能证明LLM整数近似而非实际浮点运算的问题，通过证明正确舍入的浮点矩阵乘积，构建了成本接近整数乘法、可证明完整transformer前向传播的零知识证明系统。

papers.title: Direct Feedback Policy Optimization for AI Coding Agents
papers.abstract: AI coding agents generate, modify, and validate code through multi-turn interactions. Existing reinforcement learning methods often rely on sparse terminal rewards, making it difficult to assess how intermediate decisions affect task outcomes, and group-relative methods also require repeated sampling for each task. We propose Direct Feedback Policy Optimization (DFPO), a single-trajectory reinforcement learning algorithm that trains directly from a single trajectory. DFPO achieves higher task resolution rates than GSPO under matched base models and execution harnesses.

translation.title: 面向AI编码智能体的直接反馈策略优化
translation.abstract: AI编码智能体通过多轮交互生成、修改和验证代码。现有强化学习方法通常依赖稀疏的终端奖励，难以评估中间决策对任务结果的影响，且组相对方法还需要对每个任务进行重复采样。我们提出直接反馈策略优化（DFPO），一种直接从单条轨迹训练的单轨迹强化学习算法。在相同基础模型和执行框架下，DFPO实现了比GSPO更高的任务解决率。
translation.brief: 针对现有强化学习方法依赖稀疏终端奖励且需重复采样的问题，提出直接从单条轨迹训练的强化学习算法DFPO。

papers.title: Unleashing the Value of Raw Point Clouds for 3D Understanding with LLMs
papers.abstract: Standard 3D point cloud language models typically rely on pretrained point encoders to extract 3D features and project them into representations processable by large language models (LLMs). However, these encoders are often originally optimized for pre-defined tasks, resulting in a representation bottleneck that may lead to a substantial mismatch with downstream 3D understanding. Moreover, existing models largely follow a single pass closed-book generation, limiting their ability to actively inspect task-relevant 3D regions or retrieve necessary external knowledge. In this work, we present PointTool, an encoder-free and tool-augmented framework for 3D reasoning. PointTool introduces Alignment-Free Patch Tokenization (AFPT) to locally aggregate raw point clouds while preserving fine-grained geometric structure, and Decoupled Point-Text LoRA (DPL) to facilitate global aggregation and 3D knowledge internalization within a frozen LLM. Building upon these designs, Program-Supervised Tool Reasoning (PSTR) enables the model to explicitly operate on raw 3D data and external resources through executable tools, supporting interactive 3D reasoning grounded in spatial evidence. We further introduce PointCloud-TR, a benchmark comprising 13K 3D objects, 39.8K questions, and 35.6K tool trajectories to facilitate training and evaluation of complex 3D reasoning. Experiments demonstrate that PointTool achieves strong performance on both standard and complex 3D understanding tasks, validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

translation.title: 利用LLM释放原始点云在3D理解中的价值
translation.abstract: 标准3D点云语言模型通常依赖预训练的点编码器提取3D特征并将其投影为大语言模型（LLM）可处理的表示。然而这些编码器最初往往针对预定义任务优化，造成表示瓶颈，可能与下游3D理解产生严重失配。此外，现有模型大多遵循单次闭卷生成，限制了其主动检查任务相关3D区域或检索必要外部知识的能力。本文提出PointTool，一个无编码器、工具增强的3D推理框架。PointTool引入无对齐块标记化（AFPT），在保留细粒度几何结构的同时对原始点云进行局部聚合；并引入解耦点-文本LoRA（DPL），在冻结的LLM内促进全局聚合和3D知识内化。基于这些设计，程序监督工具推理（PSTR）使模型能够通过可执行工具显式操作原始3D数据和外部资源，支持基于空间证据的交互式3D推理。我们进一步提出PointCloud-TR基准，包含13K个3D物体、39.8K个问题和35.6K条工具轨迹，用于复杂3D推理的训练和评估。实验表明PointTool在标准和复杂3D理解任务上均取得强劲表现，验证了所提框架的有效性。
translation.brief: 针对预训练点编码器造成的表示瓶颈和单次闭卷生成的局限，提出无编码器、工具增强的PointTool框架，使LLM能直接操作原始点云和外部资源进行交互式3D推理。

papers.title: Persistent Jailbreak Backdoor Attack
papers.abstract: Safety alignment is widely used to align large language models (LLMs) to produce helpful and harmless responses. However, an attacker can plant a jailbreak backdoor in an LLM such that adding a universal trigger word or phrase to a harmful prompt elicits attacker-desired responses. Existing jailbreak backdoor attacks induce distinct behaviors on backdoored inputs and safety samples (harmful prompts paired with refusal responses), making the backdoors susceptible to subsequent safety alignment and advanced defenses. In this paper, we propose a persistent jailbreak backdoor attack that reduces the divergence between clean and trigger-conditioned continuations during LLM decoding, making backdoored samples difficult to distinguish from safety samples. We also introduce a deferred-response mechanism that postpones harmful generations, further disguising the backdoor behavior. We evaluate our attack, PJBack, on eight LLMs from five model families, ranging from 7B to 70B parameters. PJBack achieves an average attack success rate of 93.9% and bypasses all seven evaluated defenses while preserving benign utility. In contrast, five existing backdoor attacks either achieve limited attack success or fail to withstand the evaluated defenses.

translation.title: 持久性越狱后门攻击
translation.abstract: 安全对齐被广泛用于使大语言模型（LLM）产生有益且无害的回复。然而攻击者可以在LLM中植入越狱后门，使得在有害提示中加入通用触发词或短语即可引发攻击者期望的回复。现有越狱后门攻击在后门输入和安全样本（配以拒绝回复的有害提示）上诱导出截然不同的行为，使后门容易被后续安全对齐和高级防御检测。本文提出一种持久性越狱后门攻击，通过降低LLM解码过程中干净续写与触发条件续写之间的差异，使后门样本难以与安全样本区分。我们还引入延迟响应机制，推迟有害内容的生成，进一步伪装后门行为。我们在来自五个模型家族、参数量从7B到70B的八个LLM上评估该攻击PJBack。PJBack平均攻击成功率达93.9%，在保持良性效用的同时绕过全部七种受评估防御。相比之下，五种现有后门攻击要么攻击成功率有限，要么无法抵御所评估的防御。
translation.brief: 针对现有越狱后门易被安全对齐和防御检测的问题，提出通过降低触发与干净续写差异并延迟有害响应来伪装后门的持久性攻击PJBack。

papers.title: IteraSong: LLM-Guided Iterative Symbolic Music Creation in a Web DAW
papers.abstract: Music creation is inherently iterative, yet many symbolic generation systems still center on producing or regenerating isolated outputs. We present IteraSong, an interactive web-based Digital Audio Workstation (DAW) for LLM-guided iterative symbolic music creation. Unlike one-shot generation systems, IteraSong supports a generate-audition-edit-refine loop over a persistent multi-track project. Users initialize a fully labeled pop draft, then progressively refine it through natural-language instructions. The LLM maps requests to a hierarchical action space of editing primitives exposed via Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools, spanning global, track, section, and bar/note scopes. The demo enables attendees to edit multi-track compositions in natural language, apply deterministic and generative edits, and undo/redo changes in real time.

translation.title: IteraSong：网页版 DAW 中由 LLM 引导的迭代式符号音乐创作
translation.abstract: 音乐创作本质上是迭代性的，但许多符号音乐生成系统仍以生成或重新生成孤立输出为中心。我们提出 IteraSong，一个用于 LLM 引导的迭代式符号音乐创作的交互式网页数字音频工作站（DAW）。与一次性生成系统不同，IteraSong 支持在持久化多轨项目上进行“生成-试听-编辑-精修”循环。用户初始化一个带有完整标签的流行音乐草稿，然后通过自然语言指令逐步精修。LLM 将请求映射到通过 Model Context Protocol（MCP）工具暴露的分层编辑原语动作空间，涵盖全局、轨道、段落和小节/音符等范围。该演示让与会者能够用自然语言编辑多轨作品，应用确定性编辑和生成式编辑，并实时撤销/重做更改。
translation.brief: 针对符号音乐生成缺乏迭代编辑的问题，提出网页版 DAW 系统 IteraSong，通过 LLM 将自然语言指令映射到分层编辑原语动作空间，支持多轨项目的持续生成-编辑循环。

papers.title: Tenlai-TTS 2.0: Continuous-Representation LLM-Based TTS System with End-to-End Training
papers.abstract: Autoregressive text-to-speech (TTS) with continuous speech latents avoids quantization-induced information loss, but typically relies on a latent space that is learned separately and then frozen before language-model training. Such a space must satisfy two competing requirements: it must retain enough acoustic detail for high-fidelity reconstruction, yet be sufficiently structured and regularized to support autoregressive prediction by a language model. We present Tenlai-TTS 2.0, which learns continuous speech representations through end-to-end training to balance acoustic detail with autoregressive predictability. The model comprises a speech encoder with a capacity-controlled Gaussian bottleneck, a large language model (LLM) with an autoregressive diffusion transformer (AR-DiT) head, a flow-matching (FM) mel-spectrogram decoder, and a multi-task recognition model (RM). With energy normalization and fixed-variance Gaussian noise, the bottleneck has a closed-form upper bound on its information rate. Through joint optimization with reconstruction, recognition, and next-patch prediction objectives, we learn continuous speech representations that suit all three tasks and train the LLM and AR-DiT for autoregressive generation. The LLM and AR-DiT are further optimized using differentiable reconstruction and recognition feedback on their predicted latents through the FM decoder and RM. On Seed-TTS-eval, this feedback-based optimization reduces character error rate (CER) from 0.82% to 0.74% on test-zh and from 8.32% to 7.08% on test-hard-zh, and word error rate (WER) from 1.32% to 1.27% on test-en, compared with joint training alone. Subsequent reinforcement learning further reduces CER to 6.29% on test-hard-zh and WER to 1.08% on test-en, with speaker similarity scores of 0.811, 0.766, and 0.784 on test-zh, test-en, and test-hard-zh, respectively.

translation.title: Tenlai-TTS 2.0：端到端训练的基于连续表示的 LLM 语音合成系统
translation.abstract: 基于连续语音潜变量的自回归文本转语音（TTS）避免了量化带来的信息损失，但通常依赖一个先单独学习、随后在语言模型训练前被冻结的潜空间。这样的潜空间必须满足两个相互冲突的要求：既要保留足够的声学细节以实现高保真重建，又要具有足够的结构和正则化以支持语言模型的自回归预测。我们提出 Tenlai-TTS 2.0，通过端到端训练学习连续语音表示，以平衡声学细节与自回归可预测性。该模型包括一个带容量受控高斯瓶颈的语音编码器、一个带自回归扩散 transformer（AR-DiT）头的大语言模型（LLM）、一个流匹配（FM）梅尔频谱解码器和一个多任务识别模型（RM）。通过能量归一化和固定方差高斯噪声，瓶颈的信息率具有闭式上界。通过重建、识别和下一块预测目标的联合优化，我们学习到适合这三种任务的连续语音表示，并训练 LLM 和 AR-DiT 进行自回归生成。LLM 和 AR-DiT 还通过 FM 解码器和 RM 对其预测潜变量施加可微的重建和识别反馈来进一步优化。在 Seed-TTS-eval 上，与仅联合训练相比，这种基于反馈的优化将 test-zh 上的字符错误率（CER）从 0.82% 降至 0.74%，test-hard-zh 上从 8.32% 降至 7.08%，test-en 上的词错误率（WER）从 1.32% 降至 1.27%。随后的强化学习进一步将 test-hard-zh 上的 CER 降至 6.29%，test-en 上的 WER 降至 1.08%，在 test-zh、test-en 和 test-hard-zh 上的说话人相似度分别为 0.811、0.766 和 0.784。
translation.brief: 针对连续潜变量 TTS 中潜空间需兼顾声学保真与自回归可预测性的矛盾，提出端到端训练的 Tenlai-TTS 2.0，通过容量受控高斯瓶颈联合优化重建、识别与预测目标，并用可微反馈和强化学习进一步优化 LLM 与 AR-DiT。

papers.title: SatMend: LLM Agents for Automated Software Repair in Satellite Constellations with Intermittent Ground Contact
papers.abstract: Satellite constellations rely on onboard software to sustain services across cooperating spacecraft. Maintaining this software requires handling related component versions and different failure causes while delivering repairs through intermittent ground contact. Automated software repair in satellite constellations remains underexplored, particularly the coordination of repairs across related versions with verified onboard recovery under intermittent ground contact. To address this gap, we propose SatMend, a software repair method driven by ground-based large language model (LLM) agents. SatMend organizes related versions into persistent sessions to retain diagnostic context and combines source and runtime evidence to select code repair or state recovery actions. It validates each version separately and submits ready candidates during continued repair, allowing ground preparation to overlap with onboard delivery and verification. Experimental results show that across configurations with 16 to 64 satellites, SatMend restores 192 of 224 faulty applications within 600 s, compared with 40 for SWE-agent, 77 for Agentless, 124 for RepairAgent, and 115 for SWE-Search. These results demonstrate SatMend's effectiveness in restoring applications and supporting service continuity in satellite constellations with intermittent ground contact.

translation.title: SatMend：面向间歇性地面联络卫星星座的 LLM 智能体自动软件修复
translation.abstract: 卫星星座依赖星载软件在协作航天器之间维持服务。维护这些软件需要处理相关的组件版本和不同的故障原因，同时通过间歇性的地面联络交付修复。卫星星座中的自动软件修复仍未被充分探索，尤其是在间歇性地面联络下跨相关版本协调修复并经验证的星上恢复。为填补这一空白，我们提出 SatMend，一种由地面大语言模型（LLM）智能体驱动的软件修复方法。SatMend 将相关版本组织到持久会话中以保留诊断上下文，并结合源代码和运行时证据来选择代码修复或状态恢复动作。它分别验证每个版本，并在持续修复过程中提交就绪的候选修复，使地面准备工作与星上交付和验证重叠进行。实验结果表明，在 16 到 64 颗卫星的配置中，SatMend 在 600 秒内恢复了 224 个故障应用中的 192 个，而 SWE-agent 为 40 个，Agentless 为 77 个，RepairAgent 为 124 个，SWE-Search 为 115 个。这些结果证明了 SatMend 在恢复应用和支持间歇性地面联络卫星星座服务连续性方面的有效性。
translation.brief: 针对间歇性地面联络下卫星星座软件修复缺乏协调与验证的问题，提出基于地面 LLM 智能体的 SatMend，通过持久会话保留诊断上下文、结合源码与运行时证据选择修复或恢复动作，并重叠地面修复与星上验证。

papers.title: InfoField3D: Differentiable Information Field for Embodied Task-Oriented View Planning
papers.abstract: Effective task execution requires embodied agents to select observation positions that provide sufficient task-relevant information. Existing approaches typically predict viewpoints with learned models or score discrete candidates, but they either struggle to incorporate new constraints such as reachability or require extensive candidate evaluation to search. We introduce InfoField3D, which lifts geometry-bound information into a differentiable analytic field, whose value at each 3D observation position represents the task-required information accessible there. It uses low-order spherical harmonics to encode directional information responses and analytic line integrals of Gaussian occupancy functions to model occlusion along lines of sight. This formulation casts task-driven camera placement as a well-studied constrained continuous optimization problem, enabling both flexible incorporation of constraints through the feasible domain and efficient viewpoint search even in the presence of occlusion. Experiments show that InfoField3D compactly preserves the pointwise information landscape with high fidelity and generally recommends higher-quality, more robust viewpoints at lower search cost than the evaluated baselines. Controlled evaluations with a frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policy further suggest that the recommended views can improve downstream task performance under information-limited initial viewpoints.

translation.title: InfoField3D：面向具身任务导向视点规划的可微信息场
translation.abstract: 有效的任务执行要求具身智能体选择能提供足够任务相关信息的观测位置。现有方法通常用学习模型预测视点或对离散候选打分，但它们要么难以纳入可达性等新约束，要么需要大量候选评估来进行搜索。我们提出 InfoField3D，将受几何限制的信息提升为可微的解析场，其在每个 3D 观测位置的值表示该处可获取的任务所需信息。它使用低阶球谐函数编码方向性信息响应，并用高斯占据函数的解析线积分来建模视线方向的遮挡。这一表述将任务驱动的相机放置转化为一个被充分研究的约束连续优化问题，既能通过可行域灵活纳入约束，又能在存在遮挡的情况下高效搜索视点。实验表明，InfoField3D 以高保真度紧凑地保留了逐点信息景观，并且与所评估的基线相比，通常能以更低的搜索成本推荐更高质量、更鲁棒的视点。使用冻结的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略进行的受控评估进一步表明，在信息受限的初始视点下，所推荐的视角可以提升下游任务性能。
translation.brief: 针对现有视点规划难以纳入新约束或需大量候选评估的问题，提出 InfoField3D，将任务信息建模为基于球谐函数与解析线积分的可微解析场，从而将相机放置转化为约束连续优化问题。

papers.title: GameAnything: From Any Inspirations to Playable Game Worlds
papers.abstract: AI-driven game development holds the potential to transform diverse human inspirations into interactive experiences. However, existing systems and benchmarks primarily focus on explicit development specifications, with limited support for adapting multimodal references and evaluating actual gameplay experiences. We introduce GameAnything, an open-source agentic platform that transforms multimodal inspirations into playable extensions of existing games through iterative development. GameAnything integrates coding agents with an independent playtesting critic, persistent development state, and reusable experience memory to support continuous refinement. We further present GameAnything-Bench, a benchmark spanning diverse reference modalities, game creation objectives, and gaming environments, with exploratory gameplay testing to assess both functional correctness and gameplay quality. Evaluations of nine coding agent configurations reveal that current agents can adapt reference content but still struggle with playable interactions and precise modifications. Moreover, multimodal references improve content fidelity, while iterative refinement yields substantial but varying improvements across agents. These findings highlight both the potential and remaining challenges of inspiration-driven game development.

translation.title: GameAnything：从任意灵感出发创造可玩的游戏世界
translation.abstract: AI 驱动的游戏开发有潜力将多样的人类灵感转化为交互式体验。然而，现有系统和基准主要关注明确的开发规格，对适配多模态参考和评估实际游戏体验的支持有限。我们提出 GameAnything，一个开源的智能体平台，通过迭代开发将多模态灵感转化为现有游戏的可玩扩展。GameAnything 将编码智能体与独立的游戏测试评审者、持久化开发状态和可复用的经验记忆相结合，以支持持续精修。我们进一步提出 GameAnything-Bench，一个涵盖多样参考模态、游戏创作目标和游戏环境的基准，并通过探索性游戏测试来评估功能正确性和游戏体验质量。对九种编码智能体配置的评估表明，当前智能体能够适配参考内容，但在可玩交互和精确修改方面仍有困难。此外，多模态参考提升了内容保真度，而迭代精修在不同智能体上带来了显著但程度不一的改进。这些发现凸显了灵感驱动游戏开发的潜力与尚存的挑战。
translation.brief: 针对现有系统难以将多模态灵感转化为可玩游戏并评估实际游戏体验的问题，提出开源智能体平台 GameAnything，结合编码智能体、独立游戏测试评审者与经验记忆进行迭代开发，并配套 GameAnything-Bench 基准。

papers.title: Edit-Induced Dependency Mismatch: Propagation Omissions, Recovery, and Evaluation Blind Spots in Coding Agents
papers.abstract: During iterative code modification, coding agents may continue to rely in subsequent reasoning on outdated dependency judgments whose text remains fixed in the context, leading to errors in subsequent reasoning and leaving consumer defects undetected by the original task evaluations, thereby exposing blind spots in the tested benchmarks. We study actual agent execution trajectories collected on benchmark tasks: deepseek-v4-flash runs on DeepSWE and SWE-bench Verified, supplemented by Qwen3.8-Flash cases on FeatureBench. Focusing on edit-induced consumer obligations, a full-corpus blinded human audit of the DeepSWE runs identifies terminal mismatches, including diagnoses whose task scope remains disputed. Following supplementary execution checks, all retained DeepSWE terminal events have execution support. The audit also shows that recovery within a trajectory can coexist with terminal omissions in the same run. The process analysis links the presentation of relevant consumer code to explicit dependency judgments and subsequent synchronization actions recorded in the trajectories. An explicit dependency-review prompt reduces terminal omissions under the tested conditions, supporting re-derivation of consumer obligations after edits. Local replays of selected DeepSWE cases show that synchronizing the diagnosed consumers restores the target behavior while the listed controls continue to pass. Cross-benchmark execution counterexamples show that the original task evaluations do not fully detect edit-induced dependency mismatches: patches pass those evaluations, yet additional execution checks confirm unintended defects along existing consumer paths. These findings support measuring task scores, terminal propagation states, and recovery separately.

translation.title: 编辑引发的依赖不匹配：传播遗漏、恢复与评估盲区
translation.abstract: 在迭代式代码修改过程中，编码智能体可能在后续推理中继续依赖过时的依赖判断，而这些判断的文本仍固定保留在上下文中，导致后续推理出错，并使消费者缺陷未被原始任务评估发现，从而暴露了所测基准的盲区。我们研究了在基准任务上收集的真实智能体执行轨迹：deepseek-v4-flash 运行于 DeepSWE 和 SWE-bench Verified，辅以 Qwen3.8-Flash 在 FeatureBench 上的案例。聚焦于编辑引发的消费者义务，对 DeepSWE 运行结果进行了全语料库盲测人工审计，识别出终端不匹配，包括任务范围仍有争议的诊断。经过补充执行检查后，所有保留的 DeepSWE 终端事件均有执行支持。审计还表明，同一运行中轨迹内的恢复可以与终端遗漏并存。过程分析将相关消费者代码的呈现与轨迹中记录的显式依赖判断及后续同步动作联系起来。在所测条件下，显式依赖审查提示可减少终端遗漏，支持编辑后重新推导消费者义务。对选定 DeepSWE 案例的本地重放表明，同步已诊断的消费者可恢复目标行为，同时列出的对照测试继续通过。跨基准执行反例表明，原始任务评估并不能完全检测编辑引发的依赖不匹配：补丁通过了这些评估，但额外的执行检查确认了沿现有消费者路径的非预期缺陷。这些发现支持将任务得分、终端传播状态和恢复分别进行度量。
translation.brief: 研究编码智能体在代码编辑后因依赖判断未更新而导致的缺陷传播遗漏问题，通过人工审计、执行检查和显式依赖审查提示来识别、验证并缓解此类不匹配。

papers.title: Seeing Is Not Acting: WARD Diagnoses the Evidence-to-State-to-Action Gap in Longitudinal Clinical Agents
papers.abstract: Large language models for longitudinal clinical care must revise their assessments and actions as patient information accumulates. However, benchmarks centered on isolated responses or final task outcomes provide limited insight into intermediate failures in evidence use, state updating, and action selection. We introduce WARD, a benchmark for evaluating how clinical agents translate accumulating evidence into patient-state judgments and timely, safe actions. WARD comprises 4,560 clinical tasks across seven clinical output domains, organized into 240 checkpoints from 40 longitudinal clinical trajectories spanning 95 hospitalizations. Its Longitudinal Track evaluates these tasks under controlled cumulative evidence. Its Interactive Track evaluates end-to-end, tool-mediated clinical management across 271 verifiable evidence items and 141 reference transitions. Across 12 models with scorable checkpoint outputs, evidence recognition consistently outpaces downstream state and action decisions, with linked-evidence nonresponse reaching 74.47--90.90\%. Models also struggle to retain and update information over time, while in the Interactive Track only 11.46\% of executed actions advance a reference transition. These results reveal a persistent evidence-to-state-to-action gap and highlight the need for process-level evaluation of longitudinal clinical this http URL and data: this https URL.

translation.title: 看见不等于行动：WARD 诊断纵向临床智能体中证据到状态再到行动的鸿沟
