translation.abstract: 用于纵向临床护理的大语言模型必须随着患者信息的积累而修订其评估和行动。然而，以孤立响应或最终任务结果为中心的基准对证据使用、状态更新和行动选择中的中间失败提供的洞察有限。我们提出 WARD，一个用于评估临床智能体如何将累积证据转化为患者状态判断以及及时、安全行动的基准。WARD 包含七个临床输出领域的 4,560 个临床任务，组织为来自 40 条纵向临床轨迹（涵盖 95 次住院）的 240 个检查点。其纵向赛道（Longitudinal Track）在受控的累积证据下评估这些任务；其交互赛道（Interactive Track）评估端到端、工具介导的临床管理，涵盖 271 个可验证证据项和 141 个参考状态转换。在 12 个具有可评分检查点输出的模型中，证据识别始终领先于下游的状态和行动决策，关联证据无响应率高达 74.47%–90.90%。模型在随时间保留和更新信息方面也表现不佳，而在交互赛道中，仅 11.46% 的已执行行动推进了参考状态转换。这些结果揭示了持续的“证据—状态—行动”鸿沟，并凸显了对纵向临床智能体进行过程级评估的必要性。代码与数据：this https URL。
translation.brief: 提出 WARD 基准，通过纵向与交互两条赛道的过程级评估，诊断临床智能体在证据识别、状态更新与行动选择之间的能力鸿沟。

papers.title: TurboFHE: An Efficient and Scalable Multi-GPU Framework for Homomorphic LLM Inference
papers.abstract: Fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) enables privacy-preserving large language model inference but remains computationally intensive. Existing multi-GPU FHE inference systems rely on expert-crafted parallelization plans that generalize poorly across hardware platforms and applications. We present \fwName, a framework that automatically compiles CKKS inference programs into efficient multi-GPU executables. Its compiler can split different nodes of the same computation graph at the ciphertext and polynomial level. Guided by a measurement-based performance model, its hardware-aware planner jointly optimizes task partitioning, placement, operand residency, and transfer scheduling. %Critical-path-guided rewrites extract shared computation and restructure homomorphic sums. Its backend then generates optimized GPU kernels and executes plans using CUDA graphs and selective point-to-point transfers. \fwName adapts its plans to diverse hardware configurations and FHE inference algorithms for large-scale models. On a single A100 GPU, \fwName achieves a $24.5\times$ speedup over THOR's reported BERT-Base inference latency. For Cerium's Llama-3-8B workload, \fwName outperforms Cerium's expert-crafted plans by $1.14\times$, $1.16\times$, and $1.24\times$ on 2, 4, and 8 RTX PRO~6000 GPUs, respectively. On A100 GPUs, \fwName achieves $98.0\%$, $91.8\%$, and $79.3\%$ parallel efficiency for the same workload on 2, 4, and 8 GPUs, respectively.

translation.title: TurboFHE：面向同态 LLM 推理的高效可扩展多 GPU 框架
translation.abstract: 全同态加密（FHE）可实现隐私保护的大语言模型推理，但计算开销极大。现有多 GPU FHE 推理系统依赖专家手工设计的并行化方案，难以在不同硬件平台和应用间泛化。我们提出 TurboFHE，一个将 CKKS 推理程序自动编译为高效多 GPU 可执行程序的框架。其编译器可以在密文和多项式层面切分同一计算图的不同节点。在基于测量的性能模型指导下，其硬件感知规划器联合优化任务划分、放置、操作数驻留和传输调度。其后端生成优化的 GPU 内核，并使用 CUDA 图和选择性点对点传输执行计划。TurboFHE 可使其计划适配多样的硬件配置和面向大规模模型的 FHE 推理算法。在单块 A100 GPU 上，TurboFHE 相对 THOR 报告的 BERT-Base 推理延迟取得 24.5 倍加速。对于 Cerium 的 Llama-3-8B 工作负载，TurboFHE 在 2、4、8 块 RTX PRO 6000 GPU 上分别比 Cerium 的专家方案快 1.14 倍、1.16 倍和 1.24 倍。在 A100 GPU 上，TurboFHE 对同一工作负载在 2、4、8 块 GPU 上分别取得 98.0%、91.8% 和 79.3% 的并行效率。
translation.brief: 针对多 GPU FHE 推理依赖专家手工并行化方案的问题，提出自动编译 CKKS 程序并联合优化任务划分、放置与传输调度的多 GPU 框架 TurboFHE。

papers.title: Zarc: Exact Nearest Neighbors over a Billion Vectors in Seconds
papers.abstract: Exact k-nearest-neighbor vector search lies on the critical path of machine learning systems, from sparse attention in the latest large language models (LLMs) to long-context memories and training-data deduplication. Exhaustive GPU search scans the whole dataset for every query, while approximate indexes return inexact neighbors. Recent methods skip almost every vector with a cheap half-precision proof that it lies too far away, but only on one GPU that holds the whole dataset. Our insight is to keep only the short rows of these proofs in GPU memory and to fetch the few remaining full vectors from host memory. Our system, Zarc, answers Euclidean, cosine, inner-product, and filtered queries exactly under updates. On four H100 GPUs, it answers 10,000 exact queries over one billion vectors in 1.1 seconds instead of five minutes. On eleven open LLMs, it retrieves the exact top-10 attention keys 2.2x to 13.1x faster than exhaustive search. In sparse attention over one million tokens, it runs 3.1x faster than bf16 selection with FlashInfer, which misses the exact top-64 for most queries.

translation.title: Zarc：在数秒内对十亿级向量进行精确最近邻搜索
translation.abstract: 精确 k 近邻向量搜索位于机器学习系统的关键路径上，从最新大语言模型（LLM）中的稀疏注意力到长上下文记忆和训练数据去重。穷举式 GPU 搜索对每个查询扫描整个数据集，而近似索引返回不精确的邻居。近期方法利用廉价的半精度证明跳过几乎每个向量（证明其距离过远），但仅在持有整个数据集的单块 GPU 上可行。我们的洞察是仅在 GPU 内存中保留这些证明的短行，并从主机内存获取少数剩余的完整向量。我们的系统 Zarc 可在更新条件下精确回答欧氏距离、余弦、内积和过滤查询。在四块 H100 GPU 上，它对十亿向量回答 10,000 个精确查询仅需 1.1 秒，而非五分钟。在十一个开源 LLM 上，它检索精确 top-10 注意力键的速度比穷举搜索快 2.2 倍至 13.1 倍。在百万 token 的稀疏注意力中，它比使用 FlashInfer 的 bf16 选择快 3.1 倍，而后者对大多数查询会漏掉精确的 top-64。
translation.brief: 针对精确最近邻搜索中 GPU 无法容纳十亿级向量的问题，提出 Zarc，通过在 GPU 内存中仅保留半精度距离证明、按需从主机内存取回少量完整向量实现秒级精确检索。

papers.title: NoeVera: Can Knowledge Guide Experiments and Experiments Refine Knowledge?
papers.abstract: With the growing demand for large language model (LLM) services, optimizing LLM serving systems is becoming increasingly complex, and the bottleneck is no longer predicting how a given configuration will perform. The harder problem is deciding what to investigate: which mechanisms matter for a workload, which configurations are worth testing, and what evidence a decision still needs. In this work, we present NoeVera, an agentic Second Brain that goes beyond just one-shot retrieval by turning papers, code, benchmarks, and experimental results into a persistent, provenance-preserving knowledge base with three planes: source evidence, reusable synthesis, and agent memory. Decision-aware retrieval assembles compact evidence packs, role-specific agents reason over them and invoke a simulator (Vidur or GAUSS) whenever quantitative support is needed, and every finding is written back as a scoped evidence record, so knowledge guides experiments and experiments refine knowledge. In configuration search over four serving scenarios, NoeVera comes within 5% of the optimum in a median of 6-7 simulator calls, versus 9 for Bayesian optimization and 15 for a knowledge-free agent with the same tools; on A100 GPUs, its representative configurations deliver ~1.30x vLLM-default throughput and meet every scenario's latency objective. When reused, provenance-preserving evidence records over-generalize on only 8% of applicability traps, versus 28% for a general-purpose agent memory. On the held-out 48-task split of a 72-task benchmark, NoeVera scores 29% higher than an equally equipped agent and 36% higher than its single-call retrieval counterpart (0.80 vs. 0.62 and 0.59), and even when baselines receive NoeVera's own prompts, a statistically significant part of its evidence-evolution advantage remains.

translation.title: NoeVera：知识能否指导实验、实验能否精炼知识？
translation.abstract: 随着对大语言模型（LLM）服务需求的增长，优化 LLM 服务系统日益复杂，瓶颈已不再是预测给定配置的性能。更难的问题在于决定研究什么：哪些机制对某个工作负载重要、哪些配置值得测试、以及决策还需要什么证据。在本工作中，我们提出 NoeVera，一个超越一次性检索的智能体化“第二大脑”，它将论文、代码、基准和实验结果转化为一个持久、保留溯源的知识库，包含三个平面：源证据、可复用综合和智能体记忆。决策感知检索组装紧凑的证据包，角色专属智能体对其进行推理并在需要定量支持时调用模拟器（Vidur 或 GAUSS），每项发现都以带作用域的证据记录形式写回，从而实现知识指导实验、实验精炼知识。在四个服务场景的配置搜索中，NoeVera 中位数仅需 6–7 次模拟器调用即可达到最优值 5% 以内，而贝叶斯优化需 9 次、使用相同工具的无知识智能体需 15 次；在 A100 GPU 上，其代表性配置带来约 1.30 倍于 vLLM 默认设置的吞吐量，并满足所有场景的延迟目标。在复用时，保留溯源的证据记录仅在 8% 的适用性陷阱上过度泛化，而通用智能体记忆为 28%。在 72 任务基准的 48 任务留出集上，NoeVera 比同等装备的智能体高 29%，比其单次调用检索版本高 36%（0.80 对 0.62 和 0.59）；即使基线获得 NoeVera 自己的提示，其证据演化优势中仍有统计显著的部分得以保留。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 服务系统优化中“决定研究什么”的难题，提出 NoeVera 智能体化第二大脑，通过保留溯源的三平面知识库实现知识指导实验、实验反哺知识的闭环。

papers.title: Look Back: Reinforcement Learning with Counterfactual World Models
papers.abstract: Agents in complex, stochastic environments must contend with dynamics that can exceed their world models' predictive capacity and randomness that obscure the consequences of their actions. We hypothesize that, compared to imagining entirely new trajectories in such complex environments, it can be easier to transform observed trajectories with alternative actions. Counterfactual world models condition on observations to predict alternative outcomes under the same underlying environmental randomness, using experience as a reference for predicting action-dependent changes. We present a policy gradient estimator, REINFORCE Look Back (RLB), that uses counterfactual returns as baselines to distinguish action effects from environmental luck, and prove conditions for unbiasedness and variance reduction. In settings where environmental evolution is harder to predict than action-induced changes, we show that counterfactual world models are easier to learn and support better policy learning than ordinary world models. Our findings suggest that counterfactual thinking can help agents learn effective behavior without independently reproducing the full complexity of their worlds.

translation.title: 回望：基于反事实世界模型的强化学习
translation.abstract: 在复杂、随机的环境中，智能体必须应对超出其世界模型预测能力的动态变化，以及掩盖其动作后果的随机性。我们假设，与在此类复杂环境中想象全新的轨迹相比，对已观测到的轨迹进行变换以尝试替代动作可能更容易。反事实世界模型以观测为条件，在相同的环境随机性下预测替代结果，将经验作为预测动作相关变化的参照。我们提出一种策略梯度估计器 REINFORCE Look Back（RLB），它使用反事实回报作为基线来区分动作效果与环境运气，并证明了其无偏性和方差缩减的条件。在环境演化比动作引起的变化更难预测的场景中，我们表明反事实世界模型比普通世界模型更易学习，并能支持更好的策略学习。我们的发现表明，反事实思维可以帮助智能体学习有效行为，而无需独立复现其世界的全部复杂性。
translation.brief: 针对环境随机性掩盖动作后果的问题，提出用反事实世界模型生成反事实回报作为基线的策略梯度方法 RLB，以区分动作效果与环境运气并降低方差。

papers.title: Neural Agent Compiler: Learning to Schedule Soft Dependencies
papers.abstract: Large language model agents accomplish complex tasks by coordinating multiple reasoning steps and tool operations, which form dependencies among their operations. Existing orchestration methods primarily consider hard dependencies that determine when an operation can legally begin, but overlook soft dependencies, i.e., information that is not required for execution but may improve an already executable operation. We identify soft-dependency scheduling as an important problem in agent execution. To this end, we introduce Neural Agent Compiler (NAC), a learned scheduler that predicts the task-quality and resource consequences of three execution modes and selects the highest-utility legal mode at a scheduling boundary. NAC represents the executable continuation, pending information event, and resource state in a shared memory, and uses a utility function to adapt the consequence predictions to different resource preferences. Across AppWorld, WebShop, and $\tau^2$-bench, NAC achieves 276/417 AppWorld task completions, a 74.69 WebShop Task Score, and 59/100 $\tau^2$-bench successes. Additional studies show that the learned scheduler reduces execution work, establishing soft-dependency scheduling as a promising solution for orchestrating tool-using agents.

translation.title: 神经智能体编译器：学习调度软依赖
translation.abstract: 大语言模型智能体通过协调多个推理步骤和工具操作来完成复杂任务，这些操作之间形成依赖关系。现有的编排方法主要考虑决定操作何时可以合法开始的硬依赖，却忽视了软依赖，即并非执行所必需、但可能改进已可执行操作的信息。我们将软依赖调度确定为智能体执行中的一个重要问题。为此，我们提出神经智能体编译器（NAC），这是一个学习型调度器，它预测三种执行模式对任务质量和资源的影响，并在调度边界处选择效用最高的合法模式。NAC 在共享内存中表示可执行的后续操作、待决的信息事件和资源状态，并使用效用函数使后果预测适应不同的资源偏好。在 AppWorld、WebShop 和 $\tau^2$-bench 上，NAC 完成了 276/417 个 AppWorld 任务，取得 74.69 的 WebShop 任务分数和 59/100 的 $\tau^2$-bench 成功率。附加研究表明，学习到的调度器减少了执行工作量，确立了软依赖调度作为编排工具使用型智能体的一种有前景的解决方案。
translation.brief: 针对智能体编排中忽视软依赖的问题，提出学习型调度器 NAC，通过预测不同执行模式的任务质量与资源后果来选择效用最高的合法模式。

papers.title: Benchmarking Web Agent Defenses Against Adaptive Visual Prompt Injection
papers.abstract: Multimodal web agents automate website interactions but remain vulnerable to visual prompt injection (VPI), where malicious webpage content manipulates their visual processing and induces unintended actions. Although several defenses focus on detecting injected instructions in screenshots, malicious destinations such as phishing URLs embedded in HTML can remain hidden yet accessible through agent interactions. Existing evaluations have also not sufficiently examined adaptive attackers who know the defense mechanisms. To address these limitations, we introduce AdaptiveVPI, the first benchmark for systematically evaluating adaptive VPI threats in web agents. Specifically, we present a dataset of 360 webpage instances spanning 6 distinct hijack strategies across 10 real-world websites, with malicious destinations not visible in screenshots. We design an adaptive attack framework that iteratively refines malicious instructions based on feedback from the defense mechanism being evaluated. We also introduce three metrics to measure the extent of agent hijacking at three different levels. Across 10 defense configurations for computer-use agents and 11 defense configurations for browser-use agents, our adaptive attacks achieve average success rates of 91.87% and 91.99%, respectively. These results reveal a gap between current VPI defenses and realistic threats and highlight the need for defenses designed with adaptive attackers in mind.

translation.title: 针对自适应视觉提示注入的网页智能体防御基准测试
translation.abstract: 多模态网页智能体自动化了网站交互，但仍然容易受到视觉提示注入（VPI）的攻击，即恶意网页内容操纵其视觉处理并诱导非预期动作。尽管已有若干防御专注于检测截图中的注入指令，但嵌入 HTML 中的恶意目标（如钓鱼 URL）可能保持隐藏，却可通过智能体交互被访问。现有评估也未能充分考察知晓防御机制的自适应攻击者。为解决这些局限，我们提出 AdaptiveVPI，这是首个系统评估网页智能体中自适应 VPI 威胁的基准。具体而言，我们构建了一个包含 360 个网页实例的数据集，涵盖 10 个真实网站上的 6 种不同劫持策略，其恶意目标在截图中不可见。我们设计了一个自适应攻击框架，根据被评估防御机制的反馈迭代改进恶意指令。我们还引入三个指标，从三个不同层面衡量智能体被劫持的程度。在面向 computer-use 智能体的 10 种防御配置和面向 browser-use 智能体的 11 种防御配置上，我们的自适应攻击分别取得 91.87% 和 91.99% 的平均成功率。这些结果揭示了当前 VPI 防御与现实威胁之间的差距，并凸显了针对自适应攻击者设计防御的必要性。
translation.brief: 针对现有 VPI 防御评估未考虑自适应攻击者的问题，构建 AdaptiveVPI 基准，通过基于防御反馈迭代改进恶意指令的自适应攻击框架系统评估网页智能体防御。

papers.title: MetaSkill: Reusable Problem-Solving Methods for Adaptive Skill Orchestration in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Reusable skills provide specialized procedures, but large language model (LLM) agents must still determine how to organize and adapt their use. We introduce MetaSkill, a two-layer framework for reusing problem-solving methods across tasks and domains. The method layer selects from 26 curated methods and binds abstract roles to task objects. The execution layer uses the instantiated method to identify intermediate objectives, coordinate native skills, and guide repair or method reselection. On 89 SkillsBench tasks and 995 ToolHop examples, MetaSkill outperforms the evaluated baselines in all six configurations, with accuracy gains of 3.51-13.48% over the strongest baseline. Ablations support explicit method-guided orchestration beyond direct method injection and further gains from method reselection.

translation.title: MetaSkill：面向 LLM 智能体自适应技能编排的可复用问题求解方法
translation.abstract: 可复用技能提供了专门化的操作流程，但大语言模型（LLM）智能体仍需决定如何组织和调整其使用。我们提出 MetaSkill，一个跨任务、跨领域复用问题求解方法的两层框架。方法层从 26 个精选方法中选择，并将抽象角色绑定到任务对象上。执行层使用实例化的方法来识别中间目标、协调原生技能，并指导修复或方法重选。在 SkillsBench 的 89 个任务和 ToolHop 的 995 个样例上，MetaSkill 在全部六种配置中均优于所评估的基线，相对最强基线取得 3.51-13.48% 的准确率提升。消融实验支持显式的方法引导编排优于直接方法注入，且方法重选带来进一步提升。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 智能体难以组织和适配可复用技能的问题，提出两层框架 MetaSkill，通过方法层选择并实例化问题求解方法、执行层据此协调原生技能与修复重选。

papers.title: ARRANGE: Agentic Skills for Layering Vocals
papers.abstract: Adding a singing voice to an existing piano recording requires decisions about melody, syllable placement, pronunciation, timing, and vocal register. ARRANGE organizes this work as a sequence of agent skills with readable intermediate artifacts and composer approval checkpoints. An LLM translates instructions in plain English, notes played on a keyboard, and vocal references into local edits; deterministic scripts validate and apply those edits before open audio models render the result. The Score Canvas makes note, syllable, and pronunciation decisions inspectable and editable. In a benchmark of 16 revision requests, three draws per request, and five LLMs, typed edits achieved exact-change correctness of 0.83-0.98, compared with 0.33-0.69 for whole-plan rewriting without ARRANGE instructions. A separate score-editing benchmark and a first-person worked example examine the interaction between representations and corrections. Author listening evaluations further explore voice transfer and register selection, including 185 listening presentations across eight copied voices. These evaluations support the value of constrained editing and expose limits of both model execution and listening measures. The contribution is an interaction architecture for retaining musical decisions through inspectable intermediate representations, rather than a new singing model or evidence of general usability.

translation.title: ARRANGE：用于人声叠加的智能体技能
translation.abstract: 在已有的钢琴录音上添加歌声，需要对旋律、音节位置、发音、时机和声区做出决策。ARRANGE 将这项工作组织为一系列智能体技能，具有可读的中间产物和作曲者审批检查点。一个 LLM 将自然语言指令、键盘弹奏的音符和人声参考转化为局部编辑；确定性脚本在开放音频模型渲染结果之前验证并应用这些编辑。Score Canvas 使音符、音节和发音决策可检查、可编辑。在一个包含 16 个修改请求、每个请求三次抽取、五个 LLM 的基准中，类型化编辑取得了 0.83-0.98 的精确变更正确率，而没有 ARRANGE 指令的整计划重写仅为 0.33-0.69。一个独立的乐谱编辑基准和一个第一人称实例分析考察了表示与修正之间的交互。作者聆听评估进一步探索了声音迁移和声区选择，包括跨八个复制声音的 185 次聆听展示。这些评估支持了受限编辑的价值，并揭示了模型执行和聆听测量两者的局限。本文的贡献是一种通过可检查的中间表示来保留音乐决策的交互架构，而非新的歌唱模型或通用可用性的证据。
translation.brief: 针对在钢琴录音上添加歌声需要多方面音乐决策的问题，提出 ARRANGE 交互架构，将任务分解为带可检查中间产物和审批检查点的智能体技能序列，由 LLM 生成局部编辑并由确定性脚本验证应用。

papers.title: LLM-Based Assistant for Dog Care Guidance
papers.abstract: This study investigates whether domain grounding through Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and parameter-efficient fine-tuning using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) can enhance the accuracy and reliability of pet care advice generated by large language models (LLMs). We curated a dataset of breed-specific dog care information and used it to develop two systems: a RAG pipeline based on TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0, and a fine-tuned LLaMA-3.2-1B model adapted using LoRA. Both systems were evaluated on 15 dog care questions. The RAG model achieved a perfect average score of 2.0, outperforming the fine-tuned model (mean = 1.47). Statistical analyses, including Welch's t-test, Mann-Whitney U, and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests (all p < 0.05), confirmed the significance of the performance gap. Our findings suggest that retrieval-based domain grounding leads to more accurate, consistent, and trustworthy responses than standalone fine-tuning in specialized LLM applications.

translation.title: 基于LLM的犬类护理指导助手
translation.abstract: 本研究探讨通过检索增强生成（RAG）进行领域接地以及使用低秩适应（LoRA）进行参数高效微调，能否提升大型语言模型（LLM）生成的宠物护理建议的准确性和可靠性。我们整理了一个特定犬种护理信息的数据集，并据此开发了两个系统：一个基于TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0的RAG流水线，以及一个使用LoRA适配的微调LLaMA-3.2-1B模型。两个系统均在15个犬类护理问题上进行评估。RAG模型取得了2.0的满分平均分，优于微调模型（均值=1.47）。统计分析，包括Welch's t检验、Mann-Whitney U检验和Wilcoxon符号秩检验（均p<0.05），证实了性能差距的显著性。我们的发现表明，在专门的LLM应用中，基于检索的领域接地比单独微调能带来更准确、一致和可信的回答。
translation.brief: 研究如何提升LLM宠物护理建议的准确性，比较了RAG检索接地与LoRA微调两种方法。

papers.title: Which Failure Does an Intervention Repair? When Agent Interventions Help, and Where Self-Evolving Skills Stall
papers.abstract: An intervention that improves one agent can break another, and adding a stronger harness on top need not repair the damage. Agent interventions such as skills, harnesses, and extra inference budget are nonetheless usually credited with one average gain, measured under one setup. We ask instead when each intervention helps and which failure it repairs. A matched factorial study over nine benchmarks, four models, four skill conditions, four harness levels, and three budgets, with nearly 0.9 million trajectories, changes one axis at a time. No configuration is best everywhere, interventions interact rather than add, and a harness can absorb a skill's gain, rescue a failure the skill causes, or leave the gain intact. The failure left by the current system points to the fix: missing knowledge to a stronger model, execution errors to a richer harness. Yet feedback is not recovery: a matched recovery repairs mainly failures that leave a visible error signal. Skills that evolve from the agent's own experience hit a bottleneck: they rarely beat a short human-written skill, can learn dataset shortcuts, break when moved to another model, and cannot supply missing facts, which outside information does. A benchmark-level switch to the model favored by a 20-task labeled pilot achieves both higher performance and lower cost than always using the stronger model. Agent interventions should be judged by which failure they repair and under which configuration.

translation.title: 干预修复的是哪种失败？智能体干预何时有效，以及自进化技能何时停滞
translation.abstract: 一种能改善某个智能体的干预可能会破坏另一个智能体，而在其上叠加更强的harness也未必能修复损害。然而，技能、harness和额外推理预算等智能体干预通常只被归功于在单一设置下测得的平均增益。我们转而追问每种干预何时有效、修复的是哪种失败。一项跨越九个基准、四个模型、四种技能条件、四个harness级别和三种预算的匹配因子研究（近90万条轨迹）每次只改变一个维度。没有任何配置在所有场景下最优，干预之间是交互而非叠加的，harness可能吸收技能的增益、挽救技能导致的失败，或让增益保持不变。当前系统遗留的失败指明了修复方向：知识缺失需要更强的模型，执行错误需要更丰富的harness。然而反馈不等于恢复：匹配的恢复机制主要修复那些留下可见错误信号的失败。从智能体自身经验进化的技能遭遇瓶颈：它们很少胜过简短的人工编写技能，可能学到数据集捷径，迁移到其他模型时会失效，且无法补充缺失的事实，而外部信息可以做到。基于20个任务标注试点选择模型偏好的基准级切换，相比始终使用更强模型，同时实现了更高性能和更低成本。智能体干预应根据其修复的失败类型及其适用配置来评判。
translation.brief: 研究各类智能体干预（技能、harness、推理预算）在何种配置下修复何种失败，通过大规模匹配因子实验逐一改变变量进行分析。

papers.title: RSLaA: Self-Reconfiguring Roadside LiDARs as Agents for 3D Traffic Perception
papers.abstract: Cooperative perception with roadside LiDARs (RSLs) extends the sensing range of autonomous vehicles and resolves onboard-sensor occlusions, particularly at curves and intersections. Because infrastructure deployment is costly, existing work optimizes RSL configurations once, against road geometry and aggregated traffic statistics, and treats them as fixed thereafter. Traffic flow, however, is inherently dynamic, and a placement optimal on average can be far from optimal at any given moment. We introduce RSLaA (Roadside LiDARs as Agents), a framework in which each RSL adaptively adjusts its pose to the evolving traffic scene over decision-time windows. Since ground truth is unavailable at decision time, the framework centers on surrogate metrics computed solely from a probabilistic occupancy grid of historical observations, which predicts the next-window perception performance of candidate poses. We construct a co-simulation benchmark pairing five candidate surrogates with detector-agnostic ground-truth perception labels at every decision window, identifying the multi-view coverage metric J_mv as the most reliable predictor. Upon this validated surrogate we build two adaptive configuration methods, a receding-horizon (MPC) optimizer and a lightweight MAPPO-based multi-agent reinforcement learning scheme with centralized training and decentralized execution. Across 10 sites and 89 six-hour traffic scenarios (890 evaluation runs), adaptive configuration consistently improves the composite perception score over static deployment. Our results indicate that RSLs could be benefitted from being treated as agents.

translation.title: RSLaA：将路侧激光雷达自重构为智能体以实现3D交通感知
translation.abstract: 路侧激光雷达（RSL）的协同感知扩展了自动驾驶车辆的感知范围，并解决了车载传感器的遮挡问题，尤其是在弯道和交叉口。由于基础设施部署成本高昂，现有工作仅针对道路几何和聚合交通统计一次性优化RSL配置，此后将其视为固定不变。然而交通流本质上是动态的，平均最优的部署位置在任何给定时刻可能远非最优。我们提出RSLaA（Roadside LiDARs as Agents）框架，其中每个RSL在决策时间窗口内自适应地调整其位姿以适应不断演变的交通场景。由于决策时无法获得真值，该框架的核心是仅从历史观测的概率占据栅格计算的替代指标，用于预测候选位姿在下一窗口的感知性能。我们构建了一个联合仿真基准，将五种候选替代指标与每个决策窗口的检测器无关的真值感知标签配对，确定多视角覆盖指标J_mv是最可靠的预测器。基于该经验证的替代指标，我们构建了两种自适应配置方法：滚动时域（MPC）优化器，以及采用集中训练分散执行的轻量级MAPPO多智能体强化学习方案。在10个站点和89个六小时交通场景（890次评估运行）中，自适应配置在综合感知得分上持续优于静态部署。我们的结果表明，将RSL视为智能体是有益的。
translation.brief: 解决路侧激光雷达固定部署无法适应动态交通流的问题，提出让每个RSL作为智能体基于替代指标自适应调整位姿的框架。

papers.title: From Vanishing Gradients to Recursive Self-Improvement: Evaluating the Most Influential Papers in Large Language Model Evolution (1997-2026)
papers.abstract: The rapid proliferation of Large Language Model (LLM) research makes it increasingly difficult to distinguish incremental refinements from true paradigm shifts. This review evaluates 22 of the most influential publications spanning nearly three decades (1997-2026), organized through a causal, chronologically anchored taxonomy centered on the author's birth year (1999). Beginning "before 1999" with how recurrent neural networks (RNNs) forgot earlier context (much like forgetting Chapter 1 by the time a reader reaches Chapter 9), we trace how Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks introduced a "bouncer" mechanism of forget, input, and output gates to selectively preserve long-term memory. We then examine how Word2Vec turned language into vector mathematics (king - male + female ~ queen), why sequential RNNs hit a parallelization wall, and how the Transformer's all-to-all attention weights launched the modern LLM era alongside a quadratic bottleneck. Next, we analyze why scaling parameters alone leaves capacity under-trained unless data scales equally (Chinchilla), how Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) left alignment superficial, and how that gap compounded into adversarial jailbreaks and single-direction refusal subspaces (J-space), where instructing a model not to think of a restricted concept surfaces it much like the human "red ball" paradox. Finally, we synthesize the current state of AI (2024-2026), encompassing recursive model collapse, autonomous reasoning-model jailbreak agents, machine-speed agentic intrusions, and closed-loop recursive self-improvement (AIDE^2).

translation.title: 从梯度消失到递归自我改进：评估大语言模型演进中最具影响力的论文（1997-2026）
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）研究的迅速扩散使得区分渐进式改进与真正的范式转变变得越来越困难。本综述评估了跨越近三十年（1997-2026）的22篇最具影响力的出版物，通过以作者出生年份（1999）为中心的因果性、按时间锚定的分类体系进行组织。从"1999年之前"循环神经网络（RNN）如何遗忘早期上下文（就像读者读到第9章时已忘记第1章）开始，我们追溯了长短期记忆（LSTM）网络如何引入由遗忘门、输入门和输出门构成的"门卫"机制来选择性保留长期记忆。接着我们考察了Word2Vec如何将语言转化为向量数学（king - male + female ≈ queen），为什么顺序RNN遭遇并行化瓶颈，以及Transformer的全对全注意力权重如何开启现代LLM时代并伴随二次方瓶颈。随后，我们分析了为什么仅扩展参数会导致容量训练不足，除非数据同步扩展（Chinchilla），为什么基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）使对齐流于表面，以及这一差距如何累积为对抗性越狱和单向拒绝子空间（J-space）——指示模型不要想某个受限概念反而会使其浮现，如同人类的"红球"悖论。最后，我们综合了AI的现状（2024-2026），涵盖递归模型崩溃、自主推理模型越狱智能体、机器速度的智能体入侵以及闭环递归自我改进（AIDE^2）。
translation.brief: 以时间线梳理1997-2026年LLM领域22篇最具影响力论文，分析从RNN到递归自我改进的范式演进脉络。

papers.title: CT-Navigator: Towards Interpretable and Generalizable CT Understanding through Agentic Perception and Tool-Invocation
papers.abstract: Clinical computed tomography (CT) interpretation inherently requires progressive visual exploration, where radiologists navigate from whole scans to individual slices and regions of interest and interact with external tools when necessary. However, existing 3D medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) typically connect a specialized 3D visual encoder to a language model, without fully leveraging the native 2D visual and agentic capabilities of generalist MLLMs. Trained on large-scale one-hop CT instruction-following data, these models also have limited ability to perform iterative reasoning and explicitly ground their conclusions in visual evidence, limiting their support for traceable CT interpretation. To solve these problems, we propose \textbf{agentic perception} as an alternative paradigm inspired by radiologists' interpretation workflows. We introduce \textbf{CT-Navigator}, a framework that harnesses generalist MLLMs' 2D visual and agentic capabilities to progressively ground CT interpretation in explicit, traceable visual evidence through hierarchical visual exploration and radiology tool invocation. To build these capabilities, we curate 8,904 visual chain-of-thought (V-CoT) trajectories for cold-start agentic supervised fine-tuning. We then optimize the policy through reinforcement learning on 33,219 questions, with data selection and dynamic rollout sampling prioritizing informative learning signals. Finally, we introduce CTNavi-Bench, a 3D CT visual question answering benchmark comprising 7,000 questions spanning anatomical regions throughout the human body. CT-Navigator achieves 79.50\% accuracy on CTNavi-Bench, surpassing the strongest baseline by 17.59\%, and demonstrates strong generalization across three external CT benchmarks. The code, model, and benchmark will be released on \href{this https URL}{GitHub}.

translation.title: CT-Navigator：通过智能体感知与工具调用实现可解释、可泛化的CT理解
translation.abstract: 临床计算机断层扫描（CT）判读本质上需要渐进式的视觉探索：放射科医生从整幅扫描导航到单个切片和感兴趣区域，并在必要时与外部工具交互。然而，现有的3D医学多模态大语言模型（MLLM）通常只是将专门的3D视觉编码器连接到语言模型，未能充分利用通用MLLM原生的2D视觉和智能体能力。这些模型在大规模单跳CT指令跟随数据上训练，执行迭代推理并将结论显式锚定于视觉证据的能力有限，限制了对可追溯CT判读的支持。为解决这些问题，我们受放射科医生判读工作流启发，提出**智能体感知**作为替代范式。我们引入**CT-Navigator**，一个利用通用MLLM的2D视觉和智能体能力，通过分层视觉探索和放射学工具调用，将CT判读逐步锚定于显式、可追溯视觉证据的框架。为构建这些能力，我们整理了8,904条视觉思维链（V-CoT）轨迹用于冷启动智能体监督微调。随后在33,219个问题上通过强化学习优化策略，其中数据选择和动态rollout采样优先考虑信息量大的学习信号。最后，我们引入CTNavi-Bench，一个包含覆盖人体各解剖区域的7,000个问题的3D CT视觉问答基准。CT-Navigator在CTNavi-Bench上达到79.50%的准确率，超过最强基线17.59%，并在三个外部CT基准上展现出强大的泛化能力。代码、模型和基准将发布于GitHub。
translation.brief: 解决3D医学MLLM缺乏迭代推理和视觉证据锚定能力的问题，提出通过分层视觉探索与工具调用实现可追溯CT判读的智能体感知框架。

papers.title: DoppelVet: Comparative Safety Verification for Self-Evolving Agents
papers.abstract: Self-evolving agents improve by retaining feedback as reusable memories or skills, but every mistaken approval can shape many future behaviors. Two updates can provide exactly the same evidence to a verifier yet produce opposite safety outcomes, so the verifier cannot distinguish them from that evidence alone. We introduce DoppelVet, a verification framework that checks proposed updates before they enter an agent's persistent state. Without access to safety labels, DoppelVet constructs an alternative that matches every signal used by the existing verifier. It replays both updates from the same state and directly compares their behaviors in both presentation orders before deciding whether to retain the candidate. We evaluate DoppelVet on DoppelVet-Grid and DoppelVet-Tool, covering executable programs and natural-language memories. Across nine open-weight and proprietary verifiers, DoppelVet raises mean harmful-update detection AUC from 0.762 to 0.940 on DoppelVet-Grid and from 0.681 to 0.826 on DoppelVet-Tool, outperforming VaG and AgentDoG 1.5. On DoppelVet-Grid, it reduces trajectories experiencing degradation from 30.39% to 0.43% over a ten-generation self-update loop and leaves no final degradation.

translation.title: DoppelVet：面向自进化智能体的比较式安全验证
translation.abstract: 自进化智能体通过将反馈保留为可复用的记忆或技能来改进，但每一次错误的批准都可能影响未来的许多行为。两个更新可以向验证器提供完全相同的证据，却产生截然相反的安全结果，因此验证器无法仅凭这些证据区分它们。我们提出 DoppelVet，一个在提议的更新进入智能体持久状态之前对其进行检查的验证框架。在无法获取安全标签的情况下，DoppelVet 构造一个与现有验证器所用全部信号相匹配的替代更新。它从同一状态重放两个更新，并在两种呈现顺序下直接比较它们的行为，然后决定是否保留候选更新。我们在 DoppelVet-Grid 和 DoppelVet-Tool 上评估 DoppelVet，涵盖可执行程序和自然语言记忆。在九个开源权重和专有验证器上，DoppelVet 将有害更新检测的平均 AUC 从 0.762 提升至 0.940（DoppelVet-Grid），从 0.681 提升至 0.826（DoppelVet-Tool），优于 VaG 和 AgentDoG 1.5。在 DoppelVet-Grid 上，它将经历性能退化的轨迹比例在十代自更新循环中从 30.39% 降至 0.43%，且最终没有留下任何退化。
translation.brief: 针对自进化智能体更新难以仅凭证据判断安全性的问题，提出在更新入库前构造匹配验证信号的替代更新并重放比较其行为的验证框架。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Coordinated Method-Level Refactoring of Rust Code
papers.abstract: As Rust codebases evolve, developers refactor code to reduce duplication, simplify complex methods, and keep related functionality together. Developers can make these changes manually or use IDE assists for supported operations, then check the resulting code with compiler diagnostics and tests. Method-level refactoring in Rust must preserve observable behavior while accounting for ownership, borrowing, and lifetimes. We present a large language model (LLM)-based workflow for extracting, inlining, and moving methods in Rust. The workflow combines candidate generation, configurable specialist review,and container-based validation. On six tasks from three open-source Rust projects, three end-to-end configurations passed all task checks on their first attempt, using 6, 13, and 31 model calls. To isolate the effect of review, we then gave four configurations the same six reference patches and six deliberately behavior-changing variants. A designated specialist rejected all six behavior-changing patches before container validation and let all six reference patches proceed, reducing Docker invocations from 24 to 12 relative to direct validation. The fixed specialist panel also caught all six faults early and rejected two reference patches over unmeasured performance concerns. On this workload, specialist review reduced execution work, while its effect on total time depended on review overhead and which patches reached validation.

translation.title: 基于多智能体协同的 Rust 代码方法级重构
translation.abstract: 随着 Rust 代码库的演进，开发者通过重构代码来减少重复、简化复杂方法并保持相关功能在一起。开发者可以手动进行这些更改，或对支持的操作使用 IDE 辅助，然后通过编译器诊断和测试检查生成的代码。Rust 中的方法级重构必须在考虑所有权、借用和生命周期的同时保持可观察行为不变。我们提出一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的工作流，用于在 Rust 中提取、内联和移动方法。该工作流结合了候选生成、可配置的专家审查和基于容器的验证。在来自三个开源 Rust 项目的六个任务上，三种端到端配置在首次尝试中就通过了所有任务检查，分别使用了 6、13 和 31 次模型调用。为了隔离审查的效果，我们随后给四种配置相同的六个参考补丁和六个故意改变行为的变体。一个指定的专家在容器验证之前拒绝了所有六个改变行为的补丁，并让所有六个参考补丁通过，相对于直接验证将 Docker 调用从 24 次减少到 12 次。固定的专家小组还提前捕获了全部六个故障，并因未测量的性能担忧拒绝了两个参考补丁。在这一工作负载上，专家审查减少了执行工作量，而其对总时间的影响取决于审查开销以及哪些补丁进入了验证阶段。
translation.brief: 针对 Rust 方法级重构需在所有权与借用约束下保持行为不变的问题，提出结合 LLM 候选生成、专家审查与容器验证的多智能体重构工作流。

papers.title: EMIP: Embodied Multi-Party Interaction Platform
papers.abstract: Experimental platforms that enable multiple participants to engage in spoken dialogue and perform physical actions concurrently in a shared environment are important for studying cooperation between humans and embodied AI agents. In this paper, we propose EMIP (Embodied Multi-Party Interaction Platform), a virtual environment platform built on Minecraft. Through an Internet-based client-server architecture, EMIP connects multiple humans and multiple AI agents to the same virtual environment and supports full-duplex speech communication and simultaneous physical interaction. It provides interfaces based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for environmental observation, physical action execution, and audio input and output, enabling researchers to develop their own agent control methods using large language models (LLMs). Additional features include centralized control of an agent group through a single EMIP agent client, collaborative object transportation by multiple agents, and experimental support functions such as recording and retrieving observation histories. By integrating these features into a reusable platform, EMIP aims to support research on human-human, human-agent, and agent-agent cooperation under different participant configurations and agent control methods. Usage examples illustrate concurrent speech and physical action, task coordination, and overlapping speech. The source code for the platform is publicly available on GitHub (this https URL).

translation.title: EMIP：具身多方交互平台
translation.abstract: 能够让多个参与者在共享环境中同时进行口语对话和执行物理动作的实验平台，对于研究人类与具身 AI 智能体之间的合作非常重要。本文提出 EMIP（具身多方交互平台），一个基于 Minecraft 构建的虚拟环境平台。通过基于互联网的客户端-服务器架构，EMIP 将多个人类和多个 AI 智能体连接到同一虚拟环境，并支持全双工语音通信和同步物理交互。它提供基于 Model Context Protocol（MCP）的接口，用于环境观察、物理动作执行以及音频输入输出，使研究者能够使用大语言模型（LLM）开发自己的智能体控制方法。其他功能包括通过单个 EMIP 智能体客户端对智能体群进行集中控制、多个智能体协作搬运物体，以及记录和检索观察历史等实验支持功能。通过将这些功能集成到一个可复用的平台中，EMIP 旨在支持在不同参与者配置和智能体控制方法下的人-人、人-智能体和智能体-智能体合作研究。使用示例展示了并发语音与物理动作、任务协调和重叠语音。平台源代码已在 GitHub 上公开（this https URL）。
translation.brief: 针对研究多方合作需要多方同时语音对话与物理交互平台的问题，基于 Minecraft 构建支持全双工语音和 MCP 接口的 EMIP 虚拟环境平台。

papers.title: Endpoint-Conditioned Process Value: What an Endpoint-Blind Process Score Adds Once Terminal Status and Cost Are Known
papers.abstract: Trajectory metrics promise information beyond final-answer accuracy, but no one has measured what a process score adds once an evaluation knows the outcome and the cost. We build that comparison: a sealed consequence needing an artifact neither agent nor judge ever sees, an operational baseline of terminal status and cost, and judge scale and evidence access as experimental factors. On 1,255 trajectories over 158 test-generation tasks in 7 Python repositories, the answer is gated on the judge. Four judges from 4B to 14B, one reasoning before scoring, add nothing an interval separates from zero; a Qwen3 32B judge on identical trajectories adds +0.050 AUC (95% CI [+0.020, +0.081]) and survives a refitting bootstrap ([+0.013, +0.095]). Most of what it adds is recoverable from eight behavioural counters, so a harness should log them (the judge adds +0.020 beyond them). What the judge is shown moves it further: disclosing the terminal verdict inflates its standalone discrimination by +0.103, while reference disclosure and tool-output redaction move it by nothing an interval separates from zero. A process metric reported without the judge's scale and evidence access does not identify a quantity. We release the protocol, the sealed-endpoint harness, and all trajectories.

translation.title: 端点条件化过程价值：当终态与成本已知时，盲端点过程评分还能增加什么
translation.abstract: 轨迹指标承诺提供超越最终答案准确性的信息，但没有人测量过当评估已知结果和成本时，过程评分还能增加什么。我们构建了这样的比较：一个需要智能体和评判者都从未见过的产物的密封后果、一个由终态和成本组成的操作化基线，以及将评判者规模和证据访问作为实验因素。在 7 个 Python 仓库中 158 个测试生成任务上的 1,255 条轨迹上，答案取决于评判者。四个 4B 到 14B 的评判者（先推理后评分）增加的信息与零无法区分；在相同轨迹上，Qwen3 32B 评判者增加了 +0.050 AUC（95% CI [+0.020, +0.081]），并通过了重采样自助法检验（[+0.013, +0.095]）。它增加的大部分信息可以从八个行为计数器中恢复，因此测试框架应当记录它们（评判者在其之上额外增加 +0.020）。评判者所看到的内容会进一步改变结果：披露终局判定使其独立判别力膨胀 +0.103，而披露参考答案和遮蔽工具输出对其的影响与零无法区分。在不说明评判者规模和证据访问的情况下报告的过程指标无法确定一个量。我们发布了协议、密封端点测试框架和所有轨迹。
translation.brief: 针对过程评分在已知终态与成本后究竟增加多少信息的问题，通过密封端点实验测量不同规模评判者与证据披露条件下的过程指标增量。

papers.title: Automatic Construction of Persian E-Commerce Dialogue Datasets for Conversational Product Search
papers.abstract: Conversational product search lets users find products through a multi-turn dialogue instead of a single keyword query, but Persian lacks the large conversational datasets needed to train and evaluate such systems; existing Persian e-commerce dialogue resources cover few categories and small catalogs. We present a framework that builds such a dataset automatically from a real e-commerce catalog and release the resulting dataset. The framework crawls 12,926 products in seven categories of the Digikala marketplace, groups them into 170 semantically coherent clusters, and selects the question the assistant asks at every turn with the Regularized Partition Balance (RPB) score. The RPB score accounts for feature coverage, the probability that the user can answer and the number of values, and generalizes entropy-based question selection. An LLM then verbalizes each question plan into a natural Persian dialogue. In a simulation on the full catalog, the RPB score needs 0.11 fewer turns than the strongest entropy baseline when the difficulty of answering differs between features, and is practically equivalent to it when it does not. Using only a free LLM API, we generated 1,000 requirement-driven dialogues covering all 170 clusters, with turn-level feature annotations; automatic checks and an LLM judge confirm their consistency with the catalog, while their realism is lower than that of the first, GPT-4o-generated version. Code and data are publicly available.

translation.title: 面向对话式产品搜索的波斯语电商对话数据集自动构建
translation.abstract: 对话式产品搜索让用户通过多轮对话而非单一关键词查询来查找产品，但波斯语缺乏训练和评估此类系统所需的大型对话数据集；现有的波斯语电商对话资源覆盖的类别少、商品目录小。我们提出一个从真实电商目录自动构建此类数据集的框架，并发布所得数据集。该框架爬取 Digikala 市场七个类别中的 12,926 个商品，将它们分组为 170 个语义连贯的簇，并使用正则化分区平衡（RPB）分数选择助手在每一轮提出的问题。RPB 分数考虑特征覆盖度、用户能够回答的概率以及取值数量，并推广了基于熵的问题选择方法。随后由 LLM 将每个问题计划转化为自然的波斯语对话。在完整目录上的模拟中，当不同特征的回答难度存在差异时，RPB 分数比最强的熵基线少需要 0.11 轮；当不存在差异时，两者实际等效。仅使用免费的 LLM API，我们生成了 1,000 个覆盖全部 170 个簇、带轮级特征标注的需求驱动对话；自动检查和 LLM 评判者确认了它们与目录的一致性，但其真实感低于最初由 GPT-4o 生成的版本。代码和数据已公开。
translation.brief: 针对波斯语缺乏对话式产品搜索训练数据的问题，提出从真实电商目录自动构建多轮对话数据集的框架，核心是基于 RPB 分数的问题选择与 LLM 对话生成。

papers.title: BenchMint: From Real-World Tasks to Executable Benchmarks
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) need evaluations of everyday reasoning and tool use, such as planning itineraries under user constraints and grounding numerical answers in evidence. We introduce BenchMint, an automated benchmark-construction workflow, and Daily-Life, its collection of 100 selected tasks across 11 real-world domains. BenchMint jointly constructs tasks and scoring criteria from the same source documents. Language-model judges assess possible answers against these criteria using tool traces and private evidence. We report 26 model/harness configurations, including GPT, Claude and Gemini families; 17 have complete domain profiles. These are descriptive configuration results, not a controlled model ranking. In one selected travel task, we corrected the reference total from 320 to 380 minutes while keeping both answers unchanged. The incorrect answer's arithmetic verdict switched from pass to fail; the correct answer's switched from fail to pass. With one ballot per cell, this exposes a reference error without establishing repeatability or collection-wide validity. Incomplete construction comparisons establish no general advantage of joint authoring or feedback-guided revision.

translation.title: BenchMint：从真实世界任务到可执行基准
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）需要对日常推理和工具使用能力进行评估，例如在用户约束下规划行程、以及用证据支撑数值答案。我们提出 BenchMint，一种自动化的基准构建工作流，以及其包含 11 个真实世界领域、100 个精选任务的集合 Daily-Life。BenchMint 从同一源文档联合构建任务和评分标准。语言模型裁判使用工具轨迹和私有证据，依据这些标准评估可能的答案。我们报告了 26 种模型/测试框架配置，包括 GPT、Claude 和 Gemini 系列；其中 17 种具有完整的领域画像。这些是描述性的配置结果，而非受控的模型排名。在一个选定的旅行任务中，我们在保持两个答案不变的情况下，将参考总分从 320 分钟更正为 380 分钟。错误答案的算术判定从通过变为失败；正确答案的判定从失败变为通过。在每格一次投票的设置下，这暴露了一个参考错误，但并未确立可重复性或整个集合的有效性。不完整的构建对比无法确立联合撰写或反馈引导修订的普遍优势。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 LLM 日常推理与工具使用缺乏可执行评估基准的问题，核心方法是提出 BenchMint 工作流，从同一源文档联合构建任务与评分标准并由语言模型裁判依据工具轨迹和私有证据评分。

papers.title: SAE-Audit: Clinical-Trial Prediction via Inference-Time Optimization of Black-Box LLMs Audited by Sparse Autoencoder Evidence
papers.abstract: Clinical trials are costly and often take years to complete, making early outcome prediction valuable for trial planning. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to forecast clinical-trial outcomes, yet their predictions remain unreliable and their rationales may not faithfully reflect the evidence underlying their answers. On tasks such as predicting whether a registered clinical trial will complete or terminate early, frontier LLMs perform only modestly above chance in our experiments. We introduce SAE-Audit, which optimizes a black-box LLM at inference time with evidence obtained from a deployable open model. A frozen sparse autoencoder (SAE) on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct is converted into a vocabulary of clinical concepts. Sparse probes fitted on past trials determine which concepts are associated with the outcome. For a new protocol, the concepts detected by the probe are written as evidence, each with the direction and strength of its association with the outcome, and the LLM being audited optimizes its answer in the light of this evidence. Without additional training, SAE-Audit raises balanced accuracy of deepseek-v4-flash by 9.6--12.0 points on five clinical-trial prediction tasks and raises GPT-5.6-terra by 8.0 points on trial completion, exceeding other agentic inference-time optimization methods by a large margin. As an auxiliary, SAE probes module within SAE-Audit is itself accurate and auditable, providing natural-language explanations directly derived from verified concept contributions and protocol evidence, without requiring additional LLMs at inference time. SAE-Audit provides verifiable, concept-level evidence for more accurate and auditable clinical-trial prediction. It can also be embedded into biomedical AI agents such as Biomni to optimize their performance.

translation.title: SAE-Audit：基于稀疏自编码器证据审计的黑盒 LLM 推理时优化的临床试验预测
translation.abstract: 临床试验成本高昂且往往耗时数年，因此早期结果预测对试验规划很有价值。大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于预测临床试验结果，但其预测仍不可靠，其理由也可能不能忠实反映答案背后的证据。在预测已注册临床试验将完成还是提前终止等任务上，前沿 LLM 在我们的实验中仅略高于随机水平。我们提出 SAE-Audit，它在推理时利用来自可部署开源模型的证据来优化黑盒 LLM。Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上的冻结稀疏自编码器（SAE）被转换为一个临床概念词表。在历史试验上拟合的稀疏探针确定哪些概念与结果相关。对于新方案，探针检测到的概念被写成证据，每条证据包含其与结果关联的方向和强度，被审计的 LLM 依据这些证据优化其答案。无需额外训练，SAE-Audit 在五个临床试验预测任务上将 deepseek-v4-flash 的平衡准确率提升 9.6--12.0 个百分点，在试验完成预测上将 GPT-5.6-terra 提升 8.0 个百分点，大幅超越其他智能体式推理时优化方法。作为辅助，SAE-Audit 中的 SAE 探针模块本身也准确且可审计，可直接从经过验证的概念贡献和方案证据中生成自然语言解释，且推理时无需额外的 LLM。SAE-Audit 为更准确、可审计的临床试验预测提供了可验证的概念级证据。它还可以嵌入 Biomni 等生物医学 AI 智能体中以优化其性能。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 LLM 预测临床试验结果不可靠且理由不可审计的问题，核心方法是用冻结稀疏自编码器探针从开源模型提取与结果相关的临床概念作为证据，在推理时据此优化黑盒 LLM 的答案。

papers.title: Emotion-Aware and Context-Grounded Dialogue Agents for Personalized Video Game Interactions
papers.abstract: We present ChatNPC, a game companion that dynamically personalizes its responses in real time based on players' emotional shifts to enhance user immersion. The model integrates sequential data, leveraging the dynamic nature of streams to benefit from player information, spoken lines, and in-game context. We leverage recent progress in LLMs' tool-calling capabilities to extract vital information from memory and recognize potential constraints for accurate reasoning, thereby tackling the complexity of NPC conversation scenarios. The task is divided into a game sentinel-guided agent (SeGent), a memory capability, and a chat planning tool for reasoning instantiation. The approach uses a lightweight game template as an information framework, with relevant details and a thorough reasoning layout. We conduct extensive experiments on a newly developed game dataset for in-game context NPC dialogue and demonstrate that ChatNPC sequentially captures players' emotional shifts over time; responses are more naturalistic and human-like with appropriate conversational cues, pauses, and sighs; and utterances remain faithful to the dynamics of in-game context and player actions, supporting narrative continuity.

translation.title: 面向个性化视频游戏交互的情感感知与上下文锚定对话智能体
translation.abstract: 我们提出 ChatNPC，一个游戏伴侣，它根据玩家的情绪变化实时动态个性化其回复，以增强用户沉浸感。该模型整合序列数据，利用数据流的动态特性从玩家信息、语音台词和游戏内上下文中获益。我们利用 LLM 工具调用能力的最新进展，从记忆中提取关键信息并识别潜在约束以实现准确推理，从而应对 NPC 对话场景的复杂性。该任务被分解为一个游戏哨兵引导的智能体（SeGent）、一个记忆能力和一个用于推理实例化的聊天规划工具。该方法使用轻量级游戏模板作为信息框架，包含相关细节和完整的推理布局。我们在一个新构建的游戏内上下文 NPC 对话数据集上进行了大量实验，结果表明 ChatNPC 能按时间顺序捕捉玩家的情绪变化；其回复更加自然、更像人类，带有恰当的会话提示、停顿和叹息；且话语忠实于游戏内上下文和玩家动作的动态，支持叙事连续性。
translation.brief: 该论文解决游戏中 NPC 对话缺乏个性化与上下文一致性的问题，核心方法是构建 ChatNPC，结合记忆能力、游戏哨兵引导智能体和聊天规划工具，依据玩家情绪变化和游戏内上下文实时生成个性化回复。

papers.title: MusicListenBench: Can Audio LLMs Hear the Difference Yet?
papers.abstract: Audio large language models (LLMs) are typically evaluated on song genre, mood, and instrumentation. A more basic skill is telling whether two short clips play the same melody, chord or instrument. We introduce MusicListenBench, a benchmark of paired listening tests for melody, harmony, timbre, and tempo. Each test item comes with two variants. A FLIP variant changes the music, so the answer must change. A STAY variant changes only the sound, such as room echo or hiss, so the answer must stay the same. The two variants have opposite answers, so a model that ignores the audio scores 50%, whatever letter it prefers. The benchmark has a training split and two test sets, one rendered from symbolic music with exact labels and one built from real recordings. On the rendered test, seven of eight open audio LLMs score within 4 points of this floor. Of four commercial models, both GPT-Audio models are at chance, and the best, Gemini 2.5 Pro, reaches 74.2%, 12.8 points below human listeners (87.0%). Post-training with GRPO on 10k rendered clean pairs raises Qwen2.5-Omni from 61.2% to 99.0% on held-out clean pairs, and the gain transfers to a task left out of training. On FLIP/STAY, however, it only reaches the level of our listeners (86.0%). It now misses almost no change (1.9%, against 24.7% for Gemini 2.5 Pro), yet when only the sound changes, it turns a correct answer into a wrong one 25.7\% of the time. More than half of its false flips come from a quiet background hiss. Models learn to hear a difference much faster than they learn which differences matter. On real recordings, open models again stay near chance, and the trained model calls 27 of 42 pairs of two strums of the same chord different. Adding sound-only pairs to training lowers false flips on both test sets, but no training run teaches relative pitch. We release the data, code, and an open leaderboard.

translation.title: MusicListenBench：音频 LLM 能听出区别了吗？
translation.abstract: 音频大语言模型（LLM）通常在歌曲流派、情绪和乐器配置上被评估。一项更基础的技能是判断两个短片段是否演奏相同的旋律、和弦或乐器。我们提出 MusicListenBench，一个针对旋律、和声、音色和节奏的成对聆听测试基准。每个测试项包含两个变体。FLIP 变体改变了音乐，因此答案必须改变。STAY 变体只改变声音，例如房间回声或嘶嘶声，因此答案必须保持不变。两个变体的答案相反，因此忽略音频的模型无论偏好哪个选项都只能得 50%。该基准包含一个训练集和两个测试集，一个由带精确标签的符号音乐渲染而成，另一个由真实录音构建。在渲染测试上，八个开源音频 LLM 中有七个的得分距该下限 4 分以内。四个商业模型中，两个 GPT-Audio 模型处于随机水平，最好的 Gemini 2.5 Pro 达到 74.2%，比人类听者（87.0%）低 12.8 分。在 1 万个渲染的干净配对上用 GRPO 进行后训练，使 Qwen2.5-Omni 在留出的干净配对上从 61.2% 提升到 99.0%，且增益可迁移到训练中未包含的任务。但在 FLIP/STAY 上，它只达到我们听者的水平（86.0%）。它现在几乎不漏检任何变化（1.9%，而 Gemini 2.5 Pro 为 24.7%），然而当只有声音变化时，它有 25.7% 的概率把正确答案改成错误答案。其超过一半的错误翻转来自轻微的背景嘶嘶声。模型学会听出差异远快于学会判断哪些差异重要。在真实录音上，开源模型再次接近随机水平，训练后的模型将 42 对同一和弦的两次扫弦中的 27 对判为不同。在训练中加入仅声音变化的配对可降低两个测试集上的错误翻转，但没有任何训练能让模型学会相对音高。我们发布了数据、代码和一个开放排行榜。
translation.brief: 该论文解决音频 LLM 缺乏基础听辨能力（判断旋律、和声、音色、节奏是否相同）评估的问题，核心方法是构建带 FLIP/STAY 反向答案变体的成对聆听测试基准 MusicListenBench，并用 GRPO 后训练提升模型听辨能力。

papers.title: Can Speech LLMs Recognize When Audio Evidence Is Insufficient? A Diagnostic Study and a Pre-Generation Probing Mitigation
papers.abstract: Speech large language models are usually evaluated on questions that have answers. We ask what they do when a recording establishes none, and whether the standard way of finding out is sound. Diagnosed on synthesized speech the answer looks clear: Qwen2-Audio fabricates an answer to 92.5% of unanswerable questions, while an ASR cascade reading the same recordings reaches 2.5% hallucination at 6.7% over-refusal, placing the failure in reasoning rather than in perception. The identical protocol on 376 native SQuAD 2.0 questions over human-read recordings removes that conclusion: the cascade hallucinates on 67.7% against the end-to-end model's 69.8%, at a higher over-refusal cost. A paired subset asking the same questions of a synthesized and a human recording of each passage localises the effect in the ASR stage -- the end-to-end model's abstention behaviour does not move with the speaker, the cascade's goes from 11.1% to 65.9%. Reliance on synthesized speech has been named as a limitation of audio benchmarks but not quantified; we quantify it, and show it large enough to reverse a finding. Since no prompt we tested repairs the residual failure, we transfer pre-generation attention probing to the multimodal setting. A probe over frozen prompt representations reaches 0.773 AUROC at predicting which unanswerable questions the model will answer anyway, where semantic entropy over ten sampled generations is at chance: the model fabricates the same answer every time, so sample disagreement cannot see a failure it is confident about.

translation.title: 语音 LLM 能识别音频证据不足吗？一项诊断研究与一种生成前探针缓解方法
translation.abstract: 语音大语言模型通常在有答案的问题上被评估。我们研究当录音无法支撑任何答案时它们会怎么做，以及标准的评估方法是否可靠。在合成语音上诊断，答案看似明确：Qwen2-Audio 对 92.5% 的不可回答问题编造了答案，而读取相同录音的 ASR 级联在 6.7% 过度拒答的情况下仅产生 2.5% 的幻觉，将失败归因于推理而非感知。但在 376 个原生 SQuAD 2.0 问题、由真人朗读录音构成的相同协议上，这一结论被推翻：级联的幻觉率为 67.7%，与端到端模型的 69.8% 相当，且过度拒答代价更高。一个配对子集对每段文本的合成录音和真人录音提出相同问题，将效应定位于 ASR 阶段——端到端模型的弃答行为不随说话人变化，而级联的弃答率从 11.1% 变为 65.9%。依赖合成语音一直被列为音频基准的局限但从未被量化；我们对其进行了量化，并表明其规模足以逆转一项研究发现。由于我们测试的所有提示都无法修复残余失败，我们将生成前注意力探针迁移到多模态设置。基于冻结提示表示的探针在预测模型将对哪些不可回答问题强行作答方面达到 0.773 AUROC，而基于十次采样生成的语义熵则处于随机水平：模型每次都编造相同的答案，因此样本间分歧无法发现它自信的失败。
translation.brief: 该论文解决语音 LLM 在音频证据不足时编造答案且合成语音评估会扭曲结论的问题，核心方法是量化合成语音偏差，并提出基于冻结提示表示的生成前注意力探针来预测模型将对不可回答问题强行作答的情况。

papers.title: VistaTree: Question Answering over Long Multimodal Documents with Image-Derived Summary Trees
papers.abstract: Answering questions over long multimodal documents requires locating relevant evidence across pages containing text, tables, and figures. When the document exceeds the model's context window, selective retrieval becomes necessary. We introduce VistaTree, a document question-answering agent that builds a summary tree directly from rendered page images. VistaTree segments documents into contiguous page spans, recursively groups them into a topic hierarchy, and refines sibling summaries to distinguish neighboring sections. At query time, the agent uses node summaries to select relevant nodes and reads the corresponding pages, using hierarchical navigation when the full outline exceeds the context budget. Experiments on MMLongBench-Doc and LongDocURL evaluate answer quality and retrieval cost using a locally hosted vision-language model, and quantify the performance gap between global and hierarchical access to the index.

translation.title: VistaTree：基于图像摘要树的长多模态文档问答
translation.abstract: 对长多模态文档进行问答需要在包含文本、表格和图片的页面中定位相关证据。当文档超出模型上下文窗口时，就需要进行选择性检索。我们提出 VistaTree，一个直接从渲染页面图像构建摘要树的文档问答智能体。VistaTree 将文档切分为连续的页面片段，递归地将它们组织成主题层次结构，并细化兄弟节点摘要以区分相邻章节。在查询时，智能体利用节点摘要选择相关节点并阅读对应页面；当完整大纲超出上下文预算时，则采用层次化导航。实验在 MMLongBench-Doc 和 LongDocURL 上使用本地部署的视觉-语言模型评估答案质量与检索成本，并量化了对索引进行全局访问与层次化访问之间的性能差距。
translation.brief: 解决长多模态文档超出上下文窗口时的问答检索问题，核心方法是从页面图像构建层次化摘要树以引导选择性检索与页面阅读。

papers.title: RumiFold: Teaching an LLM to Natively Fold Proteins and Reason About Their Function
papers.abstract: Can we teach a general-purpose language model to fold proteins? And if so, what does learning to fold enable beyond structure prediction itself? We introduce RumiFold, a pretrained chat model that learns to predict protein structures directly from its own hidden states. RumiFold processes proteins through repeated folding passes, then uses these folded representations to answer questions in natural language. It achieves folding accuracy comparable to dedicated single-representation models such as SimpleFold, alongside state-of-the-art performance on Gene Ontology protein function prediction and free-text function description. We find that folding pretraining organizes the model's hidden states around protein function, creating an internal per-residue workspace that is biologically grounded. Causal interventions show that this folded workspace links structure and language when RumiFold predicts function, providing rich representations for biomolecular reasoning. We see RumiFold as a step toward native biomolecular intelligence: where protein-based computations and language-based reasoning become integrated capabilities of general-purpose language models. Code, data, and models are available at: this https URL

translation.title: RumiFold：教会大语言模型原生折叠蛋白质并推理其功能
translation.abstract: 我们能教会通用语言模型折叠蛋白质吗？如果能，学会折叠除了结构预测本身之外还能带来什么？我们提出 RumiFold，一个预训练对话模型，它学会直接从自身隐藏状态预测蛋白质结构。RumiFold 通过多轮折叠过程处理蛋白质，然后利用这些折叠表示用自然语言回答问题。它的折叠精度可与 SimpleFold 等专用单表示模型媲美，并在 Gene Ontology 蛋白质功能预测和自由文本功能描述上达到最先进水平。我们发现折叠预训练使模型隐藏状态围绕蛋白质功能组织，形成一个具有生物学基础的内部逐残基工作区。因果干预实验表明，当 RumiFold 预测功能时，该折叠工作区连接了结构与语言，为生物分子推理提供了丰富的表示。我们将 RumiFold 视为迈向原生生物分子智能的一步：基于蛋白质的计算与基于语言的推理成为通用语言模型的集成能力。代码、数据和模型见：this https URL
translation.brief: 解决让通用语言模型直接从隐藏状态预测蛋白质结构并进行功能推理的问题，核心方法是通过多轮折叠预训练在模型内部构建生物学基础的折叠表示工作区。

papers.title: LLM-Assisted Verilog Code Refinement for Efficient RTL Clock Gating
papers.abstract: RTL clock gating is a popular technique for reducing clock power at the early design stage. Iterative updates of Verilog code, clock-gating inference, and analysis of clock-gating efficiency (CGE) are time-consuming and pose challenges to RTL designers. LLM-assisted automatic refinement of Verilog code for improving CGE is proposed. Since CGE and power depend on switching activity, LLMs generate Idle, Typical, and Peak workloads of the design, one of which is selected by the user as the optimization target. Four LLM clock-gating agents, each given a guideline for a particular clock-gating technique, then sequentially refine the Verilog code, focusing on the registers with low flop-gating efficiency (FGE) under the selected workload. Code updates are accepted only if they are functionally equivalent and reduce post-synthesis power without violating area and timing constraints. Experimental results with five RTL designs show an average FGE improvement of 12.1 percentage points and an average power reduction of 23.6% (up to 59.3%) under the selected workloads, compared to the original Verilog code, outperforming a commercial tool and an LLM baseline, which achieve average power reductions of only 4.1% and 8.6%, respectively.

translation.title: LLM 辅助的 Verilog 代码优化以实现高效 RTL 时钟门控
translation.abstract: RTL 时钟门控是在设计早期降低时钟功耗的常用技术。对 Verilog 代码的迭代更新、时钟门控推断以及时钟门控效率（CGE）分析非常耗时，给 RTL 设计师带来挑战。本文提出利用 LLM 自动优化 Verilog 代码以提升 CGE。由于 CGE 和功耗取决于翻转活动，LLM 会生成设计的 Idle、Typical 和 Peak 三种工作负载，用户选择其中之一作为优化目标。四个 LLM 时钟门控智能体各自获得针对特定时钟门控技术的指南，依次优化 Verilog 代码，重点关注在所选工作负载下 flop 门控效率（FGE）较低的寄存器。只有功能等价且在不违反面积与时序约束的前提下降低综合后功耗的代码更新才会被接受。在五个 RTL 设计上的实验结果表明，与原始 Verilog 代码相比，在所选工作负载下 FGE 平均提升 12.1 个百分点，功耗平均降低 23.6%（最高 59.3%），优于商业工具和 LLM 基线（后者平均功耗仅分别降低 4.1% 和 8.6%）。
translation.brief: 解决 RTL 设计中时钟门控效率低且人工迭代优化耗时的问题，核心方法是用多个 LLM 智能体按门控技术指南针对低 FGE 寄存器迭代优化 Verilog 代码并以功耗、面积和时序约束验证更新。

papers.title: Beyond Accuracy: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Hypothesis-Driven Experiment Planning in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Evaluating large language model (LLM) agents on scientific tasks typically reduces to final-task accuracy, which obscures where reasoning succeeds or breaks down. We introduce a benchmark and diagnostic evaluation framework for hypothesis-driven adaptive experimental planning in closed-world system identification, instantiated in kinetic mechanism identification. The framework goes beyond final accuracy in two ways. First, we evaluate exploration behavior by quantifying the extent to which agents exhibit space-filling or corner-seeking patterns in the experimental design space. Second, we decompose the reasoning process into four interpretable steps: belief update, hypothesis discrimination, discriminative experiment design, and predictive reasoning under interventions, each scored separately on reasoning traces. Across ten LLM agents, we find that stronger agents outperform both adaptive (Bayesian optimization) and non-adaptive (Latin hypercube) baselines and exhibit exploration patterns inconsistent with naive heuristics. Decomposing reasoning reveals that the stronger agents score consistently well across all four steps, whereas weaker agents often succeed at belief update and hypothesis discrimination but are less reliable at translating them into actionable designs and sharp contrastive predictions. Independent expert annotations support predictive reasoning under our stated validation criteria, while evidence for discriminative experiment design is positive but less consistent. The results suggest a gap between recognizing plausible hypotheses and translating them into contrastive predictions, with more tentative evidence for a corresponding experiment-design bottleneck. The benchmark website is available at this https URL.

translation.title: 超越准确率：面向 LLM 智能体假设驱动实验规划的诊断性基准
translation.abstract: 在大语言模型（LLM）智能体的科学任务评估中，通常只看最终任务准确率，这掩盖了推理在何处成功或失败。我们提出一个基准和诊断评估框架，用于封闭世界系统辨识中的假设驱动自适应实验规划，并以动力学机制辨识为实例。该框架从两方面超越最终准确率。首先，我们通过量化智能体在实验设计空间中表现出空间填充还是角落搜索模式来评估其探索行为。其次，我们将推理过程分解为四个可解释步骤：信念更新、假设判别、判别性实验设计以及干预下的预测推理，并在推理轨迹上分别打分。在十个 LLM 智能体上，我们发现更强的智能体优于自适应（贝叶斯优化）和非自适应（拉丁超立方）基线，且其探索模式与朴素启发式不一致。推理分解显示，更强的智能体在全部四个步骤上表现一致良好，而较弱的智能体往往能完成信念更新和假设判别，但在将其转化为可执行设计和尖锐对比预测方面不够可靠。独立专家标注支持我们所述验证标准下的预测推理，而判别性实验设计的证据为正面但一致性较低。结果表明，识别合理假设与将其转化为对比预测之间存在差距，实验设计瓶颈的证据则较为初步。基准网站见 this https URL。
translation.brief: 解决仅凭最终准确率无法诊断 LLM 智能体科学实验规划推理缺陷的问题，核心方法是在封闭世界系统辨识任务中将推理分解为四个可评分步骤并量化探索行为模式。

papers.title: GraphSeer: Multimodal Knowledge Graph Relational Image Retrieval with MLLMs
papers.abstract: Multimodal knowledge graphs (MMKGs) store entities with photos and names and link them by facts. MMKG methods predict links between known entity IDs, and image retrievers, from CLIP to MLLM embedders, return entities that look like a query photo or match its description. Neither answers a common question about a new photo: which graph entity is related to the one shown, such as the team of a pictured player or the city of a landmark. We call this knowledge graph relational image retrieval (KRIR): given a photo and a natural-language relation, retrieve the related MMKG entity, which rarely resembles the photo, whether the depicted entity is in the graph (known) or not (unseen). We build three benchmarks from YAGO, Wikidata and in-the-wild OVEN photos. The task hides two hops: recognising which graph entity is shown, and recalling what it is connected to. GraphSeer bridges them inside one multimodal LLM: it links the photo to the graph, reads the facts of the best match, and retrieves with the hidden state at which the model is about to say the answer. An unseen entity has no facts of its own, but every candidate answer does, so a listwise verifier reads the other end of the graph: it re-ranks the top candidates by their facts and photos in one forward pass, and the facts matter far more than the photos. With Qwen3.5-27B, GraphSeer improves MRR on known entities by 24.2-70.0% over an MLLM embedder fine-tuned on the same data with the same budget. When it also fuses and verifies the embedder's candidates, it improves MRR on unseen entities by 12.5-25.6%, and on known entities it beats KG-completion models given the ground-truth entity ID.

translation.title: GraphSeer：基于多模态大语言模型的知识图谱关系图像检索
translation.abstract: 多模态知识图谱（MMKG）以照片和名称存储实体并通过事实链接它们。MMKG 方法预测已知实体 ID 之间的链接，而图像检索器（从 CLIP 到 MLLM 嵌入器）返回与查询照片相似或匹配其描述的实体。两者都无法回答关于一张新照片的常见问题：图中哪个实体与所示实体相关，例如照片中球员所属的球队或地标所在的城市。我们将此称为知识图谱关系图像检索（KRIR）：给定一张照片和一个自然语言关系，检索相关的 MMKG 实体，该实体通常与照片不相似，无论所示实体是否在图中（已知或未见）。我们基于 YAGO、Wikidata 和真实世界的 OVEN 照片构建了三个基准。该任务隐含两个跳步：识别照片所示的是哪个图谱实体，以及回忆它连接到什么。GraphSeer 在一个多模态 LLM 内部桥接这两步：它将照片链接到图谱，读取最佳匹配的事实，并利用模型即将说出答案时的隐藏状态进行检索。未见实体自身没有事实，但每个候选答案都有，因此一个 listwise 验证器读取图谱的另一端：它通过候选的事实和照片在一次前向传播中重排 top 候选，其中事实远比照片重要。使用 Qwen3.5-27B，GraphSeer 在相同数据、相同预算下微调的 MLLM 嵌入器之上，将已知实体的 MRR 提升 24.2–70.0%。当它进一步融合并验证嵌入器的候选时，未见实体的 MRR 提升 12.5–25.6%，而在已知实体上，它超越了给定真实实体 ID 的知识图谱补全模型。
translation.brief: 解决根据照片和自然语言关系检索知识图谱中相关实体（KRIR）的问题，核心方法是用一个多模态 LLM 将照片链接到图谱、读取事实并用答案生成前的隐藏状态检索，再由 listwise 验证器依据事实重排候选。

papers.title: CoHABIT: Complementary Evaluation of Furniture Layouts through Spatial Rules and Household Routines
papers.abstract: We introduce CoHABIT, a framework for evaluating furniture layouts through complementary spatial rules and household routines. Static assessment captures geometric validity, ergonomic access, functional organization, and configurable design preferences, including Feng Shui. Dynamic assessment uses learned resident policies to simulate everyday activities, resource sharing, coordination, and individual burdens in multi-agent households. Controlled comparisons show how spatial criteria and household behavior reveal distinct aspects of layout quality, while resident profiles and scheduling influence furnishing rankings. Independent verification of household needs grounds dynamic comparisons in observed outcomes, enabling interpretable assessments of how furnished environments serve different households.

translation.title: CoHABIT：基于空间规则与家庭日常活动的家具布局互补评估
translation.abstract: 我们提出CoHABIT，一个通过互补的空间规则与家庭日常活动来评估家具布局的框架。静态评估捕捉几何有效性、人体工学可达性、功能组织以及可配置的设计偏好（包括风水）。动态评估使用学习到的住户策略来模拟多智能体家庭中的日常活动、资源共享、协调与个体负担。受控比较表明空间标准与家庭行为揭示布局质量的不同侧面，而住户画像与日程安排会影响家具布置的排名。对家庭需求的独立验证使动态比较立足于观察到的结果，从而能够可解释地评估布置好的环境如何服务不同家庭。
translation.brief: 针对家具布局质量评估问题，提出结合静态空间规则与动态多智能体家庭活动模拟的互补评估框架。

papers.title: Gossamer: A Utility-Driven Architecture for Constant-Budget KV Cache Compression in Reasoning LLMs
papers.abstract: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to complex reasoning tasks, yet their inference efficiency is fundamentally constrained by the rapid growth of the KV cache. As reasoning contexts extend to hundreds of thousands of tokens, the key-value (KV) cache becomes the dominant contributor to both memory footprint and bandwidth demand, tightly coupling computation with memory utilization and thereby limiting scalability. Existing compression methods, such as quantization and eviction, alleviate capacity pressure but remain purely algorithmic, often introducing additional passes and compute overhead that reduce system efficiency. This paper presents Gossamer, a KV cache compression architecture for reasoning LLMs that bridges the algorithm--system--hardware gap. Gossamer introduces a unified utility-based action framework that dynamically selects compression operations, quantization, merging, or eviction, under a constant KV cache budget. Through cross-domain co-design, we fuse cosine-similarity estimation directly into the attention computation, exploiting idle compute cycles to perform similarity evaluation without latency or bandwidth cost. We call this mechanism Free-Lunch Utilization. This enables real-time, fine-grained KV management with near-constant memory usage and negligible overhead. Under tight memory constraints, Gossamer sustains reasoning quality comparable to uncompressed inference while improving end-to-end throughput by up to 16.7$\times$ over uncompressed baselines, 5.5$\times$ and 4.9$\times$ over the quantization-based Oaken and Ecco, and 1.8$\times$ over the eviction-based R-KV.

translation.title: Gossamer：面向推理型LLM的恒定预算KV缓存压缩的效用驱动架构
translation.abstract: 基于Transformer的大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地应用于复杂推理任务，但其推理效率从根本上受限于KV缓存的快速增长。随着推理上下文扩展到数十万token，键值（KV）缓存成为内存占用和带宽需求的主要来源，将计算与内存利用紧密耦合，从而限制了可扩展性。现有的压缩方法（如量化和淘汰）缓解了容量压力，但仍是纯算法层面的，往往引入额外的处理轮次和计算开销，降低系统效率。本文提出Gossamer，一种面向推理型LLM的KV缓存压缩架构，弥合算法—系统—硬件之间的鸿沟。Gossamer引入统一的基于效用的动作框架，在恒定KV缓存预算下动态选择压缩操作：量化、合并或淘汰。通过跨领域协同设计，我们将余弦相似度估计直接融合到注意力计算中，利用空闲计算周期进行相似度评估，不产生延迟或带宽成本。我们将这一机制称为Free-Lunch Utilization。这使得KV管理能够以近乎恒定的内存使用和可忽略的开销实现实时、细粒度管理。在严格的内存约束下，Gossamer保持与未压缩推理相当的推理质量，同时端到端吞吐量较未压缩基线提升高达16.7倍，较基于量化的Oaken和Ecco分别提升5.5倍和4.9倍，较基于淘汰的R-KV提升1.8倍。
translation.brief: 针对推理型LLM中KV缓存膨胀问题，提出在恒定缓存预算下动态选择量化、合并或淘汰操作的效用驱动压缩架构，并将相似度估计融合进注意力计算以消除额外开销。

papers.title: Recursive Self-Editing: LLMs Program Their Own Weight Edits for Self-Improvement
papers.abstract: Recursive self-improvement asks a system to improve the very system that improves it. Today's language models improve themselves through data, training recipes or scaffolds. Whenever their weights change, gradient descent writes the update, not the model. We let the model write its own weights. In SELFWRITE, each generation the current model studies its own reasoning on fresh training problems, inspects its own weights and activations in a persistent Python session, and writes a program that constructs a low-rank weight edit for itself from white-box primitives (singular directions, activation contrasts between its right and wrong answers, rank-one projections, tensor computations), with no training or gradient tool. Every candidate is graded once on a hidden gate set against the current model; the best strictly improving edit is merged into the weights, and the edited model writes the next edit. On Qwen3.8-27B and math problems from DAPO-Math, five generations of SELFWRITE raise gate accuracy from 73.95% to 76.45% and accuracy on a held-out test split that the loop never sees from 76.30% to 77.75% (avg@4) and from 82.60% to 84.80% (pass@4), without a single gradient step. A language model can author useful changes to its own weights without gradients, and the edited model keeps writing useful edits.

translation.title: 递归自我编辑：LLM编写自身权重编辑程序以实现自我改进
translation.abstract: 递归自我改进要求一个系统改进改进它的那个系统本身。当今的语言模型通过数据、训练配方或脚手架来改进自身。每当其权重发生变化时，写入更新的是梯度下降，而不是模型本身。我们让模型自己编写自己的权重。在SELFWRITE中，每一代当前模型在新的训练问题上研究自己的推理过程，在持久的Python会话中检查自己的权重和激活，并编写一个程序，从白盒原语（奇异方向、其正确与错误答案之间的激活对比、秩一投影、张量计算）为其自身构建低秩权重编辑，不使用任何训练或梯度工具。每个候选编辑都在隐藏的门槛集上针对当前模型评分一次；严格改进的最佳编辑被合并进权重，编辑后的模型再编写下一个编辑。在Qwen3.8-27B和DAPO-Math的数学问题上，五代SELFWRITE将门槛准确率从73.95%提升到76.45%，在循环从未见过的保留测试集上的准确率从76.30%提升到77.75%（avg@4）、从82.60%提升到84.80%（pass@4），而未使用任何梯度步骤。语言模型可以在没有梯度的情况下对其自身权重做出有用的修改，且编辑后的模型能继续写出有用的编辑。
translation.brief: 针对LLM自我改进问题，让模型在无梯度的情况下通过编写程序构建低秩权重编辑来迭代改进自身权重。

papers.title: Layer-Level Control of Language Model Execution in Agent Frameworks
papers.abstract: Agent frameworks typically orchestrate language models through prompt-and-response interfaces. We propose a harness design that exposes intermediate model states and layer-level execution controls to the agent runtime. By connecting state collection, policy fitting, and execution, the design enables policies to allocate computation within and across models based on intermediate states. We demonstrate the approach with a prototype that learns stitching bridges and state-conditioned execution policies from paired model states, then applies them during inference to select among continue, exit, and stitch. For dispatcher supervision, we select the least-computation action whose full-vocabulary next-token prediction matches the source model's full-depth prediction, using continue when neither early action matches. We train these components on a frozen proxy corpus of 5,000 typed-decision items authored using source texts sampled from WildChat conversations, then evaluate the prototype on JevBench measuring task accuracy, agreement with full-model predictions, and end-to-end latency including runtime overhead. Preliminary results show an approximately 15% reduction in mean latency while maintaining task accuracy comparable to full-model inference.

translation.title: Agent框架中语言模型执行的层级别控制
translation.abstract: Agent框架通常通过提示—响应接口来编排语言模型。我们提出一种harness设计，向agent运行时暴露中间模型状态和层级别的执行控制。通过连接状态收集、策略拟合与执行，该设计使策略能够基于中间状态在模型内部和跨模型地分配计算。我们用一个原型演示该方法：从成对的模型状态中学习拼接桥和状态条件执行策略，然后在推理时应用它们在继续、退出和拼接之间进行选择。对于调度器监督，我们选择计算量最小且其全词表下一token预测与源模型全深度预测相匹配的动作；当两个早期动作都不匹配时使用继续。我们在包含5000个类型化决策项的冻结代理语料库上训练这些组件（源文本采样自WildChat对话），然后在JevBench上评估原型，测量任务准确率、与全模型预测的一致性以及包括运行时开销在内的端到端延迟。初步结果显示平均延迟降低约15%，同时保持与全模型推理相当的任务准确率。
translation.brief: 针对agent框架只能通过提示—响应接口编排LLM的问题，提出暴露中间状态与层级别执行控制的harness设计，学习状态条件策略以在推理中动态分配计算。

papers.title: Estimating Silenced Tokens in Quantized LLMs
papers.abstract: Quantization is the standard way to shrink large language models, and it is usually judged by perplexity and task accuracy. We ask a different question: after quantization, which words can the model still say at all? A token is silenced when no hidden state can make it the top choice of the output layer, so a greedy decoder can never produce it. We give a simple, scalable way to estimate how many tokens a quantized output head silences, combining three checks: a direction that lets a token win (so it is safe), an upper bound on how close a token's row is to being trapped inside the others, and an exact match that proves a token can never win. Each count is therefore a certified range: exact matches give its lower end and flagged tokens can only raise its upper end. In nearly all settings we report down to 3 bits the two ends coincide, so the counts are exact. Across three open models we find that quantization silences tokens: on large-vocabulary models it already appears at 8-bit precision, up to a few hundred previously reachable tokens on a 1B-parameter model, and grows as precision drops, while a small-vocabulary model resists until 3 bits. The loss is far from uniform across languages: on a multilingual vocabulary the silenced tokens are overwhelmingly non-Latin (Korean, Chinese, Thai, Arabic and Hebrew), even though Latin tokens dominate the vocabulary. Silencing is thus a measurable, language-sensitive side effect that standard averages miss, and it should be reported alongside them.

translation.title: 估计量化LLM中被沉默的token
translation.abstract: 量化是缩小大语言模型的标准方法，通常用困惑度和任务准确率来评判。我们提出一个不同的问题：量化之后，模型还能说出哪些词？当一个token在任何隐藏状态下都无法成为输出层的首选时，它就被沉默了，贪心解码器永远无法生成它。我们给出一种简单、可扩展的方法来估计量化输出头沉默了多少token，结合三项检查：一个能让某token获胜的方向（因此它是安全的）、一个衡量token的行与其他行相比有多接近被困的上界，以及一个证明token永远无法获胜的精确匹配。因此每个计数都是一个经过认证的范围：精确匹配给出其下界，被标记的token只会抬高其上界。在几乎所有设置中，我们报告到3比特时两端重合，因此计数是精确的。在三个开源模型上，我们发现量化会沉默token：在大词表模型上8比特精度就已出现，在1B参数模型上多达数百个先前可达的token，并随精度下降而增长，而小词表模型直到3比特才受影响。这种损失在各语言间极不均匀：在多语言词表上，被沉默的token绝大多数是非拉丁文字（韩语、中文、泰语、阿拉伯语和希伯来语），尽管拉丁token在词表中占主导。因此，沉默是一种可测量、对语言敏感的副作用，标准平均值会遗漏它，应与它们一并报告。
translation.brief: 针对量化LLM中某些token永远无法被贪心解码生成的问题，提出结合方向检查、上界与精确匹配的可扩展方法来认证被沉默token的数量。

papers.title: ParseGap: Testing What Coding Agents Authorize and What Shells Execute
papers.abstract: LLM coding agents authorize shell commands by parsing a command string against a policy and passing the raw string to a system shell, so the gate adjudicates one reading while the shell executes another. We present ParseGap, a differential testing framework that runs each command through an unmodified vendor checker and GNU Bash 5.2 in an isolated container, flagging a violation whenever an approved command produces policy-violating runtime effects. Across eight production coding agents, ParseGap identifies 17 root causes across three divergence boundaries: at the parse, where an upstream tree-sitter-bash defect hides a second command from Mistral Vibe and Gemini CLI; at the utility, where every checker permits read-only binaries whose arguments write files or launch programs (9-47 of 55 cases); and at confinement, where an allow rule in OpenAI Codex CLI disables its read-only OS sandbox. Live trials across two frontier models triggered policy violations in all 16 agent-model pairs (14 under configured restrictions). To eliminate the second reading, we design ShellPlan, which compiles a strict Bash subset once into a typed execution plan, validates utility arguments against positive capability specifications, and dispatches approved plans directly via execve without a shell. Over a formal operational model, we prove single-interpretation dispatch and bound touched programs and files under audited assumptions. ShellPlan admitted 0/4,174 active attacks across six static suites and 0/90 hits in a ten-model agent benchmark (62/90 unguarded) at 1.28 ms median gate latency, preserving 36/36 (100%) frontier standard-dev completion (74/100 overall) and 0/348 external over-allows outside modeled exceptions.

translation.title: ParseGap：测试编码代理授权的命令与 Shell 实际执行的命令之间的差距
translation.abstract: LLM 编码代理通过将命令字符串按策略解析来授权 shell 命令，并将原始字符串传递给系统 shell，因此授权门裁决的是一种解读，而 shell 执行的却是另一种解读。我们提出 ParseGap，一个差分测试框架，它在隔离容器中将每条命令分别通过未经修改的厂商检查器和 GNU Bash 5.2 运行，只要被批准的命令产生违反策略的运行时效果就标记为违规。在八个生产级编码代理上，ParseGap 在三个分歧边界上识别出 17 个根本原因：在解析层，上游 tree-sitter-bash 缺陷使 Mistral Vibe 和 Gemini CLI 看不到第二条命令；在工具层，所有检查器都允许只读二进制程序通过参数写文件或启动程序（55 个案例中的 9-47 个）；在隔离层，OpenAI Codex CLI 中的一条允许规则会禁用其只读 OS 沙箱。在两个前沿模型上的实际试验中，全部 16 个代理-模型组合都触发了策略违规（其中 14 个处于已配置的限制之下）。为消除第二种解读，我们设计了 ShellPlan，它将一个严格的 Bash 子集一次性编译为带类型的执行计划，依据正向能力规范验证工具参数，并通过 execve 直接分发已批准的计划而不经过 shell。基于一个形式化操作模型，我们证明了单一解读分发，并在经审计的假设下界定了被触及的程序和文件范围。ShellPlan 在六个静态套件中拦截了 4,174 个主动攻击中的全部（0 漏报），在十模型代理基准中 90 次命中 0 次（未防护时为 62/90），门控中位延迟为 1.28 ms，保留了 36/36（100%）的前沿标准开发完成率（总体 74/100），以及在建模例外之外 0/348 的外部过度授权。
translation.brief: 针对编码代理授权解析与 shell 实际执行语义不一致的安全漏洞，提出差分测试框架 ParseGap 发现分歧根因，并设计将 Bash 子集编译为类型化执行计划、经 execve 直接执行的 ShellPlan 来消除歧义。

papers.title: From Learning Rates to Rotational Schedules: Finite-Horizon Theory on the Sphere
papers.abstract: How should step sizes be scheduled across a finite training horizon? Cosine and warmup-stable-decay (WSD) schedules are widely adopted in large-scale pretraining, yet their effect on optimization also depends on parameter norms. Normalization can make parameter groups scale invariant, so that the loss depends only on their direction, while their norms still affect how fast the parameters rotate. In this work, we formulate schedule design directly in the space of rotational motion. Working within a geodesically convex spherical setting, we derive a last-iterate convergence guarantee for arbitrary rotational schedules that separates their overall scale from their distribution over time. We derive the unique schedule that minimizes this bound and prove that it approaches linear decay as the horizon grows. Empirically, our rotational interpretation and idealized spherical analysis provide useful predictions for LLM pretraining in practice, including schedule comparisons missed by existing analyses. Our analysis predicts schedule ordering across model scales for both vanilla (Adam, Muon) and Hyperball-style (AdamH, MuonH) optimizers. Our Hyperball experiments support the predicted strong performance of linear LR decay and confirm our prediction that WSD underperforms in this setting. Accounting for parameter norm dynamics, we predict instead the strong performance of WSD for Adam and Muon shown in practice. Guided by our theoretical insights, we also derive a new LR schedule for Adam and Muon, which improves over the established cosine and WSD schedules. All in all, these results support the use of rotational dynamics to understand, predict, and ultimately guide scheduling in LLM pretraining.

translation.title: 从学习率到旋转调度：球面上的有限时域理论
translation.abstract: 在有限的训练时域内应如何调度步长？余弦和 warmup-stable-decay（WSD）调度在大规模预训练中被广泛采用，但它们对优化的影响还取决于参数范数。归一化可以使参数组具有尺度不变性，使损失仅取决于其方向，而其范数仍影响参数旋转的快慢。在这项工作中，我们直接在旋转运动的空间中表述调度设计。在测地凸的球面设定下，我们为任意旋转调度推导出末次迭代收敛保证，该保证将调度的整体尺度与其在时间上的分布分离开来。我们推导出最小化该界的唯一调度，并证明随着时域增长它趋近于线性衰减。在实证方面，我们的旋转解释和理想化球面分析为实践中的 LLM 预训练提供了有用的预测，包括现有分析未能给出的调度比较。我们的分析预测了 vanilla（Adam、Muon）和 Hyperball 风格（AdamH、MuonH）优化器在不同模型规模下的调度排序。我们的 Hyperball 实验支持所预测的线性 LR 衰减的强劲表现，并证实了我们关于 WSD 在该设定下表现不佳的预测。考虑参数范数动态后，我们转而预测了 Adam 和 Muon 在实践中表现出的 WSD 强劲性能。基于理论洞见，我们还为 Adam 和 Muon 推导出一种新的 LR 调度，其表现优于已有的余弦和 WSD 调度。总之，这些结果支持利用旋转动力学来理解、预测并最终指导 LLM 预训练中的调度。
translation.brief: 针对有限训练时域中学习率调度设计缺乏理论依据的问题，在测地凸球面设定下用旋转动力学推导末次迭代收敛界及最优调度，并据此预测和改进 LLM 预训练中的 LR 调度。

papers.title: Social Interaction Breaks Replicate Independence in Controlled-Clone LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Multi-agent LLM evaluations and social simulations create many agents from one model and treat them as independent replicates, even after the agents interact. This assumption remains untested with matched controls. We introduce SocCogEval, a controlled-clone assay for Social Cognitive Transfer (SCT). Clones share the base model, system prompt, and decoding parameters and differ only in a private brief, and a factorial protocol separates the brief, 30 rounds of interaction, and initialization noise. On Qwen3-122B-FP8, interaction with the briefs held fixed raises off-topic BFI-10 response-profile drift by $\bar{\Delta}=+0.917$ and $+0.912$ in two topically disjoint scenarios (exact $p=0.0008$ and $0.0039$). The drift is larger than under the brief alone, persists under temperature-zero re-probing, and stays positive without typed memory extraction in exploratory tests. Matched solo generation reproduces part of it, and social interaction remains highest. Across five more model variants, every scenario-averaged interaction contrast is positive. Each interacting population is therefore one replicate, and treating its agents as independent requires paired no-interaction controls. Our code and data are publicly available at this https URL.

translation.title: 社交互动打破受控克隆 LLM 代理的复制独立性
translation.abstract: 多代理 LLM 评估和社会模拟从同一个模型创建多个代理，并将它们视为独立的复制样本，即使代理之间已经发生互动。这一假设在匹配对照下从未被检验过。我们提出 SocCogEval，一种用于社会认知迁移（SCT）的受控克隆检测方法。克隆共享相同的基础模型、系统提示和解码参数，仅在一份私有简报上不同，并通过因子化协议分离简报、30 轮互动和初始化噪声的影响。在 Qwen3-122B-FP8 上，在简报保持不变的情况下，互动使两个主题不相关场景中的离题 BFI-10 响应画像漂移分别提高 $\bar{\Delta}=+0.917$ 和 $+0.912$（精确 p=0.0008 和 0.0039）。该漂移大于仅由简报引起的漂移，在温度为零的重新探测下持续存在，并且在探索性测试中即使没有类型化记忆提取也保持为正。匹配的单独生成可以复现其中一部分，但社交互动的影响仍然最大。在另外五个模型变体上，所有场景平均的互动对比均为正值。因此，每个互动种群只能算作一个复制样本，将其代理视为独立样本需要配对的无互动对照。我们的代码和数据已在 https URL 公开。
translation.brief: 针对多代理 LLM 评估中把互动后的克隆代理当作独立样本的未经验证假设，设计受控克隆实验 SocCogEval，通过因子化分离简报、互动与噪声，证明社交互动会引起显著的人格漂移从而破坏独立性。

papers.title: LLM-Assisted Co-Optimization of RTL and Synthesis Algorithms via Bottleneck Analysis
papers.abstract: Post-synthesis power, performance, and area (PPA) depend jointly on the register-transfer-level (RTL) code and the synthesis algorithms. However, the benefits of RTL optimization may be limited by bottlenecks in synthesis algorithms, and vice versa, leaving opportunities for better PPA unexplored by methods that optimize either level alone. In this work, we present a large language model (LLM)-assisted framework for regional co-optimization of RTL and synthesis algorithms via bottleneck analysis. A key insight behind our approach is that RTL structures and the Boolean networks used in synthesis expose complementary opportunities for addressing bottlenecks that lead to suboptimal PPA in different regions of the circuit. Our bottleneck analysis uses a Gaussian process (GP) to assess whether optimizing RTL or synthesis algorithms is more promising for each region. The GP learns from regional graph representations and PPA feedback. Using the GP's predictions and predictive uncertainty, Bayesian optimization (BO) provides guidance that an LLM Router combines with circuit analysis to choose how to address each region's bottlenecks.
