Self-improving LLM workers then optimize the RTL or synthesis algorithms in their assigned regions, and their regional changes are greedily integrated into the current design configuration. Experiments on 16 RTL designs show average improvements of 103.27% in worst negative slack (WNS), 1.23% in area, and 13.26% in power relative to the initial designs. These improvements exceed those of the strongest baseline for each metric by 47.80, 2.75, and 13.17 percentage points, respectively.

translation.title: 基于瓶颈分析的 LLM 辅助 RTL 与综合算法协同优化
translation.abstract: 综合后的功耗、性能和面积（PPA）同时取决于寄存器传输级（RTL）代码和综合算法。然而，RTL 优化的收益可能受综合算法瓶颈的限制，反之亦然，使得仅优化其中一层的方法无法探索到更好的 PPA 机会。在这项工作中，我们提出一个由大语言模型（LLM）辅助的框架，通过瓶颈分析对 RTL 和综合算法进行区域级协同优化。我们方法的一个关键洞见是：RTL 结构与综合中使用的布尔网络为解决导致电路不同区域 PPA 次优的瓶颈提供了互补的机会。我们的瓶颈分析使用高斯过程（GP）评估对每个区域而言优化 RTL 还是综合算法更有前景。GP 从区域图表示和 PPA 反馈中学习。利用 GP 的预测和预测不确定性，贝叶斯优化（BO）提供指导，LLM Router 将其与电路分析相结合，决定如何处理每个区域的瓶颈。自我改进的 LLM worker 随后优化其被分配区域内的 RTL 或综合算法，其区域改动被贪心地集成到当前设计配置中。在 16 个 RTL 设计上的实验显示，相对初始设计，最差负时序裕量（WNS）平均提升 103.27%，面积降低 1.23%，功耗降低 13.26%。这些提升分别超过每个指标最强基线 47.80、2.75 和 13.17 个百分点。
translation.brief: 针对 RTL 与综合算法单独优化难以突破彼此瓶颈的问题，提出用高斯过程做区域瓶颈分析、结合贝叶斯优化与 LLM Router 及自改进 LLM worker 的协同优化框架。

papers.title: KernelShift: Benchmarking Kernel Optimization Across Evolving Hardware
papers.abstract: Efficient AI computation depends on hardware that evolves over time, shifting the strategies needed to implement performant code. For CPU kernels, a key evolving factor is the set of available architectural extensions, which expose specialized hardware instructions that change the techniques used to optimize kernels. We study how effectively coding agents use these new, potentially unfamiliar extensions to write fast code. We introduce KernelShift, a benchmarking pipeline and a set of environments for evaluating coding agents in kernel optimization across evolving CPU architectures. Its agent-assisted, human-verified pipeline turns code repositories into benchmark instances, and its environments let agents optimize code with feedback from the target hardware. Using this pipeline, we construct 99 kernels from real-world, actively developed repositories (ncnn, this http URL, Arm SIMD Loops, and KleidiAI), including inference workloads derived from real model executions. KernelShift supports incorporating new kernels and hardware configurations as libraries and processors evolve. We evaluate agents with proprietary and open-weight models across progressively newer architectural extensions (Arm Neon, SVE, SVE2, and SME2), examining how performance changes as hardware evolves. On established extensions, agents beat the auto-vectorized compiler everywhere (2.4-19.8x) and exceed general-purpose libraries such as ncnn (getting up to 2.74x over its Neon kernels), but fall behind Arm's hand-tuned KleidiAI kernels (0.70x). In end-to-end inference of two LLMs, agent-written kernels achieve a 1.3-1.6x prefill speedup over this http URL's fast path. However, current agents do not yet reliably adapt to new extensions that require unfamiliar programming models, such as SME2's matrix tiles.

translation.title: KernelShift：跨演进硬件的内核优化基准测试
translation.abstract: 高效的 AI 计算依赖于随时间演进的硬件，这改变了实现高性能代码所需的策略。对于 CPU 内核而言，一个关键的演进因素是可用的架构扩展集合，它们暴露出改变内核优化技术的专用硬件指令。我们研究编码代理使用这些新的、可能不熟悉的扩展来编写快速代码的能力。我们提出 KernelShift，一个用于评估编码代理在跨演进 CPU 架构的内核优化中表现的基准测试流水线和环境集合。其代理辅助、人工验证的流水线将代码仓库转化为基准实例，其环境让代理能够利用来自目标硬件的反馈来优化代码。利用该流水线，我们从真实且活跃开发的仓库（ncnn、this http URL、Arm SIMD Loops 和 KleidiAI）构建了 99 个内核，包括源自真实模型执行的推理工作负载。KernelShift 支持随着库和处理器的演进纳入新的内核和硬件配置。我们使用专有和开放权重模型，在逐步更新的架构扩展（Arm Neon、SVE、SVE2 和 SME2）上评估代理，考察硬件演进时性能如何变化。在成熟的扩展上，代理在所有情况下都击败了自动向量化的编译器（2.4-19.8 倍），并超过 ncnn 等通用库（其 Neon 内核最高提升 2.74 倍），但落后于 Arm 手工调优的 KleidiAI 内核（0.70 倍）。在两个 LLM 的端到端推理中，代理编写的内核相比 this http URL 的快速路径实现了 1.3-1.6 倍的预填充加速。然而，当前代理尚不能可靠地适应需要不熟悉编程模型的新扩展，例如 SME2 的矩阵分块。
translation.brief: 针对编码代理能否利用不断演进的 CPU 架构扩展优化内核的问题，构建包含 99 个真实内核、支持新扩展与硬件配置的基准 KernelShift 并系统评估代理性能。

papers.title: AEP:Towards Trustworthy Agent Communication, Networking, and Collaboration
papers.abstract: As privately owned agents become increasingly capable, collaboration in open agent networks is limited by partial topology knowledge, ownership boundaries, and the risk of exposing or contaminating private context. Existing agent-to-agent protocols are useful when collaborators are already known, while shared-memory and broadcast-based systems rely on visibility and trust assumptions that do not hold in decentralized, low-trust environments. We introduce Open Private Agent Collaboration (OPAC), an asset-centric paradigm for cooperation among private agents with open membership, partial observability, and ownership-aware access control. Rather than treating collaboration as the exchange of final responses, OPAC enables agents to selectively discover, exchange, audit, and integrate policy-controlled context assets. This shifts the unit of cooperation from transient messages to reusable external context, while keeping disclosure and integration subject to privacy and security constraints. We instantiate OPAC with the Agent Exchange Protocol (AEP), a decentralized framework that combines semantic discovery, demand-driven coordination, safety-gated asset exchange, and ledger-backed evidence derivation. By distinguishing physical topology from each agent's local cognitive topology, AEP allows agents to discover task-conditioned collaborators under an unknown network structure, release only admissible assets, and update future cooperation decisions from auditable interaction evidence. AEP therefore provides a middle ground between pure request-response interaction and globally shared memory, offering a practical foundation for trustworthy agent-native networking through selective, auditable reuse of distributed context assets.

translation.title: AEP：迈向可信的智能体通信、组网与协作
translation.abstract: 随着私有智能体能力日益增强，开放智能体网络中的协作受到拓扑知识不完整、所有权边界以及暴露或污染私有上下文风险的限制。现有的智能体间协议在协作者已知时较为有效，而共享内存和基于广播的系统则依赖于在去中心化、低信任环境中并不成立的可见性与信任假设。我们提出开放私有智能体协作（OPAC），这是一种以资产为中心的私有智能体协作范式，具有开放成员资格、部分可观测性和所有权感知的访问控制。OPAC 不将协作视为最终响应的交换，而是使智能体能够有选择地发现、交换、审计和集成受策略控制的上下文资产。这将协作单元从瞬态消息转变为可复用的外部上下文，同时使披露与集成受隐私和安全约束的约束。我们用智能体交换协议（AEP）实例化 OPAC，这是一个去中心化框架，结合了语义发现、按需协调、安全门控的资产交换以及基于账本的证据推导。通过区分物理拓扑与每个智能体的本地认知拓扑，AEP 使智能体能够在未知网络结构下发现任务条件化的协作者，仅释放可准许的资产，并从可审计的交互证据中更新未来的协作决策。因此，AEP 在纯请求-响应交互与全局共享内存之间提供了折中方案，通过选择性、可审计地复用分布式上下文资产，为可信的智能体原生组网提供了实用基础。
translation.brief: 解决开放低信任网络中私有智能体协作受限的问题，提出以资产为中心的 OPAC 范式及 AEP 协议，通过语义发现、安全门控资产交换和账本审计实现可信协作。

papers.title: Subsurface Model Programming: Frontier Large Language Models Natively Interpret and Edit Dynamic Reservoir Models
papers.abstract: Multiphase flow simulation in heterogeneous porous media supports decisions in hydrocarbon recovery, geological carbon sequestration, and geothermal extraction. We introduce Subsurface Model Programming, a workflow in which large language models (LLMs) read and edit reservoir simulation decks directly without numerical gradients or external optimization algorithms. We evaluate four benchmarks using geometric checks for connectivity and open-source simulators for dynamic tasks. In one text-only response, the LLM correctly classified all six reservoir-layer well-pair labels and all three flow-path labels between open completions. On PUNQ-S3, a single proposal modified 54 of 1,761 active cells (3.1%) and reduced well-balanced water-cut RMSE by 71.9%. On the SPE10 sector model, the best of five LLM proposals yielded 1.795 million standard cubic meters of cumulative oil over ten years, 8.9% more than the best plan from 25 particle swarm optimization evaluations. On the 533,403-cell UNISIM-IV-2026 compositional model, five rounds of script-based editing reduced combined field-and-well NRMSE from 37.98% to 11.62% (a 69.4% reduction) and field production error by 73.9%. Replacing exhaustive stochastic search with physically auditable causal interventions in just one to five runs provides a generalizable foundation for autonomous reservoir development, rapid history matching, legacy model diagnosis, and coupled multiphysics engineering.

translation.title: 地下模型编程：前沿大语言模型原生解读与编辑动态油藏模型
translation.abstract: 非均质多孔介质中的多相流模拟为油气开采、地质碳封存和地热开发提供决策支持。我们提出地下模型编程（Subsurface Model Programming），一种让大语言模型（LLM）直接读取和编辑油藏模拟数据文件的工作流，无需数值梯度或外部优化算法。我们使用几何连通性检查和开源模拟器评估四个基准。在单次纯文本响应中，LLM 正确分类了全部六个油藏层的井对标签和全部三个开放完井间的流动路径标签。在 PUNQ-S3 上，单次提案修改了 1,761 个活跃网格中的 54 个（3.1%），将井平衡含水率 RMSE 降低了 71.9%。在 SPE10 扇区模型上，五个 LLM 提案中的最优方案在十年内产出 179.5 万标准立方米累计油量，比 25 次粒子群优化评估中的最佳方案高出 8.9%。在拥有 533,403 个网格的 UNISIM-IV-2026 组分模型上，五轮基于脚本的编辑将油田与井联合 NRMSE 从 37.98% 降至 11.62%（降低 69.4%），油田产量误差降低 73.9%。用一到五次物理可审计的因果干预替代穷举随机搜索，为自主油藏开发、快速历史拟合、遗留模型诊断和耦合多物理场工程提供了可泛化的基础。
translation.brief: 解决油藏模拟模型编辑依赖数值优化算法的问题，提出让 LLM 直接读取和编辑油藏模拟数据文件的地下模型编程工作流。

papers.title: Weight Coding: Evolving Web-Scale Recommenders through Direct Weight Edits with LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Web-scale recommender models evolve primarily through retraining or fine-tuning. We propose \emph{weight coding}, a methodology for model evolution through direct, executable weight edits. A large language model (LLM) agent inspects model structure and parameters, formulates hypotheses, and implements edits using evaluation feedback. The loop progresses from localized changes to targeted searches and composition, allowing edited components to adapt to one another. A cached engine enables rapid forward evaluation without backpropagation. On Pinterest's 147M-parameter Image Search two-tower retriever, weight coding improves held-out recall@10 of production model by up to 15.0 percentage points (+24\% relative) with few edits in about 1/4 GPU hours of a full post-training finetune, while a common launch only improves around 1\%. After reinitializing the entire 13.6M-parameter interaction module randomly while retaining the surrounding trained model, searching 2,448 mixing and normalization parameters yields 9.8 points above production. Offline gains span the full funnel including dense retrieval, generative retrieval and ranking, with up to 1.37B learnable parameters and different edits for each architecture. Steering edits provide explicit control of model performance over segments like freshness and product. Weight coding requires no serving change and online A/B tests increase saves per user from the edited retrieval source by 8.4\% to 10.7\%, aligned with the target business objectives. Our results establish weight coding as a practical and useful tool for model development and and behavioral control in a real web-scale production system, with potential to extend to both pre-training and post-training stages across the funnel.

translation.title: 权重编码：通过 LLM 智能体的直接权重编辑演化网络规模推荐系统
translation.abstract: 网络规模推荐模型主要通过重新训练或微调来演化。我们提出权重编码（weight coding），一种通过直接、可执行的权重编辑实现模型演化的方法论。一个大语言模型（LLM）智能体检查模型结构和参数、提出假设，并利用评估反馈实施编辑。该循环从局部修改推进到定向搜索和组合，使被编辑的组件能够相互适应。缓存引擎支持无需反向传播的快速前向评估。在 Pinterest 拥有 1.47 亿参数的图像搜索双塔召回器上，权重编码通过少量编辑、仅用完整训练后微调约 1/4 GPU 小时的时间，将生产模型的留出集 recall@10 提升多达 15.0 个百分点（相对提升 24%），而常规上线仅提升约 1%。在随机重新初始化整个 1360 万参数的交互模块并保留周围已训练模型后，搜索 2,448 个混合和归一化参数可获得高于生产模型 9.8 个百分点的效果。离线收益覆盖整个漏斗，包括稠密检索、生成式检索和排序，可学习参数多达 13.7 亿，且每种架构采用不同的编辑。引导式编辑可对新鲜度和商品等分段的模型性能进行显式控制。权重编码无需更改服务端，在线 A/B 测试使编辑后召回来源的每用户收藏量提升 8.4% 至 10.7%，与目标业务指标一致。我们的结果确立了权重编码作为真实网络规模生产系统中模型开发和行为控制的实用工具，并有潜力扩展到漏斗各阶段的预训练和训练后环节。
translation.brief: 解决网络规模推荐模型依赖重训练或微调演化的问题，提出权重编码方法，由 LLM 智能体通过直接可执行的权重编辑迭代改进模型。

papers.title: Wactorz: Self-Writing LLM Agents That Discover, Repair, and Migrate at the Edge
papers.abstract: Most LLM agent frameworks build a crew that runs a task and exits. Physical environments (e.g., homes, labs, factory floors) need agents that stay up for months, survive their own bugs, and run on whatever hardware is already next to the sensors. We present Wactorz, an open-source runtime in which LLM-generated agents are long-lived, supervised actors: a planner turns a chat request into Python, compiles it into a new actor at runtime, and a supervisor restarts that actor alone, with its state intact, when it crashes. All coordination rides on MQTT, so agents can be spawned on, and live-migrated between, edge nodes such as a Raspberry Pi, and every internal event is a topic external systems can subscribe to. The recorded demo builds a camera-to-lamp automation from one chat request, adds a second agent that is auto-wired to the first by topic and carries a deliberate division-by-zero, watches that agent repair its own code without losing its count, then deploys a fresh Raspberry Pi node and live-migrates the agent onto it, in under four minutes of wall-clock time and \$0.13 of model usage. This extended version adds what the two-page demonstration paper could not: the Wiring view of the topic graph, Wactorz as a library for hand-written agents, how trained models are stored, sent to nodes and replaced, the security model, and the system's limitations.

translation.title: Wactorz：在边缘端自主发现、修复与迁移的自书写 LLM 智能体
translation.abstract: 大多数 LLM 智能体框架构建一个执行任务后即退出的团队。而物理环境（如家庭、实验室、工厂车间）需要能持续运行数月、从自身故障中恢复、并运行在传感器旁现有硬件上的智能体。我们提出 Wactorz，一个开源运行时，其中 LLM 生成的智能体是长生命周期的受监督 actor：规划器将聊天请求转化为 Python 代码，在运行时编译为新 actor，当 actor 崩溃时监督者仅重启该 actor 并保持其状态完好。所有协调均基于 MQTT，因此智能体可以在树莓派等边缘节点上生成并在节点间实时迁移，且每个内部事件都是外部系统可订阅的主题。录制的演示从一个聊天请求构建了摄像头到灯具的自动化，添加了第二个通过主题自动连接并故意带有除零错误的智能体，观察该智能体在不丢失计数的情况下自行修复代码，然后部署一个全新的树莓派节点并将智能体实时迁移到其上，全程不到四分钟，模型使用成本仅 0.13 美元。本扩展版本补充了双页演示论文未能涵盖的内容：主题图的 Wiring 视图、作为手写智能体库的 Wactorz、训练模型的存储、下发与替换方式、安全模型以及系统局限性。
translation.brief: 解决物理环境中 LLM 智能体需长期运行、自我修复和跨边缘迁移的问题，提出基于 MQTT 的受监督 actor 运行时 Wactorz，支持运行时生成、崩溃恢复和实时迁移。

papers.title: Explainable Emotion and Mental Health Reasoning in Large Language Models Using Theories of Emotion
papers.abstract: Advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled a wide range of applications. However, their ability to simulate human-like behavior and reasoning remains unclear. While emotion detection is a better-established Natural Language Processing (NLP) task, existing approaches primarily focus on directly classifying text into predefined emotion classes, often overlooking the appraisal process that explains why an individual experiences a particular emotion in a given situation. In this work, we propose Psychology-based Chain-of-Thought (PsyCoT) reasoning, a theory-driven prompting strategy grounded in the Schachter-Singer and Cognitive Appraisal theories of emotion. We propose and evaluate PsyCoT for subjective NLP tasks, including emotion analysis, emotion intensity prediction, stress analysis, and depression severity identification. Our evaluation covers four levels of classification complexity: binary, multiclass, multi-label, and ordinal scaling, spanning 11 languages. We assess the performance of five state-of-the-art LLMs across these selected subjective NLP tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that PsyCoT prompt variants improve the standard chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting across the evaluated tasks. Across all evaluated tasks, PsyCoT yields F1 score gains ranging from 0.5% to 28.1%, depending on the model, task, and language configuration.

translation.title: 基于情绪理论的大语言模型可解释情绪与心理健康推理
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的进步催生了广泛的应用。然而，其模拟类人行为和推理的能力仍不明确。虽然情绪检测是较为成熟的自然语言处理（NLP）任务，但现有方法主要侧重于将文本直接分类到预定义的情绪类别，往往忽略了能解释个体在特定情境下为何产生某种情绪的评估过程。在本工作中，我们提出基于心理学的思维链（PsyCoT）推理，这是一种植根于 Schachter-Singer 情绪理论和认知评估理论的理论驱动提示策略。我们提出并评估了 PsyCoT 在主观 NLP 任务上的表现，包括情绪分析、情绪强度预测、压力分析和抑郁严重程度识别。我们的评估涵盖四个分类复杂度级别：二分类、多分类、多标签和序数量表，跨越 11 种语言。我们评估了五个最先进的 LLM 在这些主观 NLP 任务上的表现。实验结果表明，PsyCoT 提示变体在所有评估任务上均优于标准思维链（CoT）提示。在所有评估任务中，PsyCoT 带来 0.5% 到 28.1% 的 F1 分数提升，具体取决于模型、任务和语言配置。
translation.brief: 解决现有情绪分类忽略情绪产生评估过程的问题，提出基于 Schachter-Singer 和认知评估理论的 PsyCoT 提示策略，提升 LLM 在情绪与心理健康任务上的可解释推理能力。

papers.title: Diversity in Unity, Theory in Practice: Hierarchical Multitask Benchmarks for Chinese Minority Languages
papers.abstract: Despite the rapid advancement of LLMs, their performance on linguistically and culturally diverse minority languages within a unified national context remains underexplored. We present CMiLBench, a collection of hierarchical multitask benchmarks designed to translate theoretical notions of "diversity in unity" into practical evaluation for three representative Chinese minority languages: Tibetan, Mongolian, and Uyghur. CMiLBench comprises 24,663 instances across 5 difficulty levels and 17 tasks spanning foundational ability, cultural specificity, and safety alignment. We adopt existing dataset adaptation, minority knowledge construction, and high-resource benchmark translation to construct CMiLBench. We assess 14 state-of-the-art commercial and open-source LLMs with a hybrid framework that integrates automatic metrics and LLM-as-a-Judge scoring. The comparative experimental results reveal the gap between theoretical capability and practical utility. CMiLBench serves as a foundational and scalable evaluation resource to bridge the digital language divide and promote the informatization and intelligentization of low-resource Chinese minority languages.

translation.title: 多元一体，理论落地：面向中国少数民族语言的层次化多任务基准
translation.abstract: 尽管LLM发展迅速，其在统一国家内语言文化多样的少数民族语言上的表现仍缺乏研究。我们提出CMiLBench，一套层次化多任务基准，旨在将"多元一体"的理论理念转化为对三种代表性中国少数民族语言——藏语、蒙古语和维吾尔语——的实用评估。CMiLBench包含24,663个实例，覆盖5个难度级别和17个任务，涉及基础能力、文化特异性和安全对齐。我们采用现有数据集适配、少数民族知识构建和高资源基准翻译来构建CMiLBench。我们使用融合自动指标与LLM-as-a-Judge评分的混合框架评估了14个最先进的商业和开源LLM。对比实验结果揭示了理论能力与实际应用之间的差距。CMiLBench作为基础且可扩展的评估资源，有助于弥合数字语言鸿沟，推动低资源中国少数民族语言的信息化与智能化。
translation.brief: 针对中国少数民族语言缺乏LLM评估基准的问题，通过数据集适配、知识构建和基准翻译构建了覆盖17个任务的层次化多任务基准CMiLBench。

papers.title: Which Loopholes Get Found? Predicting Reward Hacking of LLM Judges Before RL Training
papers.abstract: A policy trained against an LLM judge can learn to exploit its loopholes. Static probes show that such judges accept degenerate answers like a lone "{" or "Thought process:", but not which flaw a policy will find. In GRPO the first loophole to be exploited can be predicted before training from each pattern's exposure, the product of the starting policy's propensity to produce it and the judge's false-positive rate (FPR). To test exposure causally, we seed the patterns into fine-tuning at three doses in a Latin square. Across 36 GRPO runs with seven judges, the first exploited pattern had the highest exposure in all 12 runs with exploitation and the highest FPR in only 6. Predictions recorded before training held in three of four runs with one pattern masked by rule. When only two patterns were seeded, at 3% to 3.8% of the fine-tuning data and chosen so that exposure disagreed with FPR alone or propensity alone, exposure named the first exploited pattern and its onset window in all six runs. Exploitation occurred only on hard prompts, where an accepted exploit gets a large group-normalized advantage. Auditing exposure before RL therefore identifies the loophole a policy will likely exploit first.

translation.title: 哪些漏洞会被发现？在RL训练前预测LLM裁判的奖励作弊
translation.abstract: 针对LLM裁判训练的策略可能学会利用其漏洞。静态探测表明此类裁判会接受如单个"{"或"Thought process:"之类的退化答案，但无法说明策略会发现哪个缺陷。在GRPO中，首个被利用的漏洞可以在训练前通过每个模式的暴露度（exposure）预测，暴露度是起始策略产生该模式的倾向与裁判误报率（FPR）的乘积。为因果检验暴露度，我们以拉丁方设计将模式以三种剂量注入微调数据。在七个裁判的36次GRPO运行中，在所有12次发生利用的运行里，首个被利用的模式都是暴露度最高的，而FPR最高的仅在6次中如此。训练前记录的预测在四次运行中的三次（其中一种模式被规则屏蔽）中成立。当仅注入两个模式（占微调数据的3%至3.8%，且选取使暴露度与单独FPR或单独倾向不一致的情形）时，暴露度在全部六次运行中正确指出了首个被利用的模式及其出现窗口。利用只发生在困难提示上，此时被接受的作弊会获得较大的组归一化优势。因此，在RL前审计暴露度可以识别策略最可能首先利用的漏洞。
translation.brief: 针对RL训练中策略会利用LLM裁判漏洞的问题，提出用暴露度（策略产生倾向×裁判误报率）在训练前预测首个被利用的漏洞。

papers.title: Exact on Paper: Which LLM Serving Shortcuts Flip Graded Answers, Measured Against the Noise of Reordering the Same Requests
papers.abstract: Teams enable serving features such as prefix caching, chunked prefill and speculative decoding after checking that benchmark accuracy is unchanged, because the engine documents them as exact. Accuracy is an aggregate, so a feature can hold it while flipping which requests are answered correctly. We serve one 4B instruction model in vLLM under nine single feature configurations and five replicas of a reference configuration, grade 3,380 requests from five benchmarks in every run, and compare each candidate with a restart floor (fresh process) and a scheduling floor (same requests in a different order). With default kernels every configuration keeps accuracy within one point, and the seven exact features flip the graded outcome of 1.47% (95% CI 1.13 to 1.85) to 1.78% (1.39 to 2.20) of requests, none above the scheduling floor of 1.72%, while the FP8 KV cache flips 3.36% (2.80 to 3.96), as many as FP8 weights. With batch invariant kernels all seven exact features, speculative decoding included, reproduce the reference text on every request, while the FP8 KV cache still flips 3.91% (3.28 to 4.53) of graded outcomes. A gate that compares against a single replica pair rejected an unchanged configuration, so we recommend certifying a serving change under batch invariant kernels, where the floor is zero, or against a scheduling floor measured from at least three replicas.

translation.title: 纸面上的精确性：哪些LLM服务捷径会翻转评分结果——以相同请求重排序的噪声为参照
translation.abstract: 团队在确认基准准确率不变后启用prefix caching、chunked prefill和speculative decoding等服务特性，因为引擎文档声称它们是精确的。但准确率是聚合指标，一个特性可以在保持准确率的同时翻转哪些请求被正确回答。我们在vLLM中以九种单特性配置和五个参考配置副本服务同一个4B指令模型，每次运行对来自五个基准的3,380个请求评分，并将每个候选配置与重启底线（新进程）和调度底线（相同请求不同顺序）比较。使用默认内核时，所有配置的准确率都在一个点以内，七个精确特性翻转了1.47%（95% CI 1.13至1.85）至1.78%（1.39至2.20）的请求评分结果，均不超过1.72%的调度底线，而FP8 KV缓存翻转了3.36%（2.80至3.96），与FP8权重相当。使用batch invariant内核时，包括speculative decoding在内的全部七个精确特性在每个请求上都复现了参考文本，而FP8 KV缓存仍翻转3.91%（3.28至4.53）的评分结果。仅比较单个副本对的门控会错误拒绝一个未改变的配置，因此我们建议在batch invariant内核下（底线为零）认证服务变更，或与至少三个副本测得的调度底线比较。
translation.brief: 针对LLM服务特性可能翻转个别请求评分结果的问题，通过对比重启底线与调度底线量化各服务捷径对评分结果的影响。

papers.title: PROPS: Can Visual Generators Keep the Current Look of a Prop?
papers.abstract: Many generation tasks draw the next image from a visual history, such as storyboards, illustrated stories and multi-turn editing. A new request often states what happens next without restating how earlier objects look. Instead of recovering an object's current look from the history, generators often redraw it from the request alone or bring back an outdated look, and the error can carry into later steps. We call this failure prop drift. Existing evaluations rarely isolate it, because similarity to the history rewards copying and a judge that sees a single history cannot tell a look recovered from that history from one the generator happens to prefer. We introduce PROPS, a benchmark of 2,257 pairs of twin histories that end on the same request but show one prop in two different looks. A pair passes only if the generator draws the matching look on each side and carries out the request, so a look preferred by the generator or the judge passes at most one side. All 34 open and closed systems we test show prop drift, and even systems that carry out the requested action on most sides often lose the current look of the prop. Swapping the planners and editors of agents further shows that both history understanding and image generation limit agent performance. We also build PROPS-Train, 80,250 training chains in four tracks whose targets recover an earlier state or carry scripted changes forward, and fine-tuning on it clearly improves all four tested models. Both datasets will be publicly released.

translation.title: PROPS：视觉生成器能否保持道具的当前外观？
translation.abstract: 许多生成任务需要从视觉历史中绘制下一张图像，如故事板、图绘故事和多轮编辑。新请求往往只说明接下来发生什么，而不重述先前对象的外观。生成器不从历史中恢复对象的当前外观，而是仅凭请求重绘或带回过时的外观，且错误会延续到后续步骤。我们将这种失败称为道具漂移（prop drift）。现有评估很少隔离它，因为与历史的相似性奖励复制，而只看到单一历史的裁判无法区分从历史恢复的外观与生成器恰好偏好的外观。我们提出PROPS，一个包含2,257对孪生历史的基准，每对历史以相同请求结束但展示同一道具的两种不同外观。只有当生成器在两侧都画出匹配的外观并执行请求时，该对才算通过，因此生成器或裁判偏好的外观至多只能通过一侧。我们测试的全部34个开源和闭源系统都表现出道具漂移，即使在大多数侧能执行请求动作的系统也常常丢失道具的当前外观。交换智能体的规划器和编辑器进一步表明，历史理解和图像生成都限制了智能体性能。我们还构建了PROPS-Train，包含四条轨道的80,250条训练链，其目标为恢复先前状态或推进脚本化变化，在其上微调显著提升了全部四个测试模型。两个数据集都将公开发布。
translation.brief: 针对视觉生成器在多轮生成中丢失道具当前外观（道具漂移）的问题，构建孪生历史基准PROPS进行隔离评估并提供训练数据PROPS-Train。

papers.title: AutoRPG: Harnessing Systematic AI for Non-Intrusive Low-Latency Mobile RPG Combat
papers.abstract: Automated combat in mobile RPGs plays a critical role in game quality assurance, requiring real-time behavior control that closely resembles human gameplay. However, existing approaches fail to satisfy these requirements, either because they lack fine-grained behavioral control or because they incur high inference latency. To address these challenges, we incorporate user gameplay experience to design AutoRPG, a systematic AI framework for automating mobile RPG combat. At a high level, AutoRPG decomposes the combat process into two stages: a high-level strategic planning phase that formulates the overall combat strategy, followed by a systematic execution phase powered by a suite of carefully designed lightweight modules encompassing target tracking, character movement, dodge maneuvering, and abnormal-state handling. Experiments on three popular mobile RPGs, i.e., Genshin Impact, Wuthering Waves, and Arknights: Endfield, demonstrate that AutoRPG consistently outperforms four competitive baselines across both combat quality and generalization capability, while behaving the most similarly to human players among all evaluated agents.

translation.title: AutoRPG：利用系统性AI实现非侵入式低延迟的移动RPG战斗自动化
translation.abstract: 移动RPG中的自动战斗在游戏质量保障中至关重要，需要接近人类游玩的实时行为控制。然而现有方法无法满足这些要求，要么缺乏细粒度行为控制，要么推理延迟过高。为解决这些挑战，我们结合用户游玩体验设计了AutoRPG，一个用于移动RPG战斗自动化的系统性AI框架。总体上，AutoRPG将战斗过程分解为两个阶段：制定整体战斗策略的高层战略规划阶段，以及由一套精心设计的轻量级模块（包括目标追踪、角色移动、闪避机动和异常状态处理）驱动的系统性执行阶段。在《原神》、《鸣潮》和《明日方舟：终末地》三款热门移动RPG上的实验表明，AutoRPG在战斗质量和泛化能力上持续优于四个有竞争力的基线，并且在所有评估智能体中行为最接近人类玩家。
translation.brief: 针对移动RPG自动战斗缺乏细粒度行为控制或推理延迟高的问题，提出将战斗分解为战略规划与轻量模块执行两阶段的系统性AI框架AutoRPG。

papers.title: Do More Roles or Larger Models Improve LLM Fact-Checking? A Controlled Study on Fixed Evidence
papers.abstract: A fact-checking system can spend more computation on a claim by using a larger model, by asking the same model several times, or by a multi-role Tribunal: two roles propose quoted findings, code checks the quotations, an auditor that does not see the proposed relation judges each one, and code derives the verdict or abstains. We compare these options on identical fixed evidence, without retrieval: 300 AVeriTeC claims, each with its annotated question--answer items mixed with items written for other claims, read by judges of four open-weights models from three families, a vote of five, and six assignments of models to the Tribunal's roles. The 9B judge was right on 186 claims and the 27B judge of the same family on 156; the larger judges declined to decide far more often and were no more accurate when they decided. The vote reached 196 and the 9B judge with its verdict replaced by Tribunal certificates 195, at a similar cost; the Tribunal alone reached 153 to 164, because it abstained on almost half of the claims. A hearing's outcome followed the auditor's model and was nearly indifferent to the proposers'. A larger auditor, or one of another family, made certificates neither more often correct (77% to 81%) nor more independent of the judge. As a replacement, certificates improved every judge by 3 to 10 points and overturned four to five in a hundred of its correct verdicts. With the annotated evidence withheld, judges and Tribunal still decided on 7% to 14% of the claims.

translation.title: 更多角色还是更大的模型能提升 LLM 事实核查？固定证据下的受控研究
translation.abstract: 事实核查系统可以通过使用更大的模型、多次询问同一模型，或采用多角色的 Tribunal（法庭）机制来为一个声明投入更多计算：两个角色提出带引用的发现，代码检查引用，一个看不到所提关系的审计员逐一评判，代码据此得出结论或弃权。我们在完全相同的固定证据上比较这些方案，不使用检索：300 条 AVeriTeC 声明，每条声明的标注问答项与其他声明的问答项混合，由来自三个家族的四个开放权重模型的评判者阅读，采用五票投票，以及六种模型到 Tribunal 角色的分配方式。9B 评判者答对了 186 条声明，同家族的 27B 评判者答对 156 条；更大的评判者更频繁地拒绝判断，且在判断时并不更准确。投票达到 196 条，将 9B 评判者的结论替换为 Tribunal 证书达到 195 条，成本相近；Tribunal 单独使用仅达到 153 至 164 条，因为它在近半数声明上弃权。听证结果取决于审计员的模型，而对提议者几乎不敏感。更大的审计员或不同家族的审计员既没有让证书更常正确（77% 到 81%），也没有使其更独立于评判者。作为替换方案，证书使每个评判者提升 3 到 10 个百分点，并推翻其每百条正确结论中的四到五条。在扣留标注证据的情况下，评判者和 Tribunal 仍对 7% 到 14% 的声明作出判断。
translation.brief: 研究在固定证据下比较更大模型、多次询问与多角色 Tribunal 机制对 LLM 事实核查的影响，发现更大模型并不更准确，而 Tribunal 证书作为评判者结论的替换能带来稳定提升。

papers.title: Where Do Fact-Checking Errors Arise? Separating Retrieval, Search Control and Judgement in Evidence-Grounded Verification
papers.abstract: An evidence-grounded fact-checker can fail because it does not find the evidence or because it does not use it; end-to-end accuracy does not tell the two apart. We present a protocol that follows the reference evidence from the store to the verdict and separates retrieval, search control, judgement and verdict validation. We assess 293 claims from FEVER, FEVER 2.0 and AVeriTeC with one open-weights 9B model under two evidence conditions: small stores of annotated evidence, where discovery is easy, and the full source collections. In the control condition a single hybrid retrieval pass delivers complete reference evidence for 226 of 228 evidence-bearing claims, and adaptive controllers and a tool agent spend two to nine times as many model calls without a consistent gain. Of 34 decisive claims labelled as lacking evidence, 33 have the complete evidence in the packet: in 15 the judge abstains, and in 18 validation rules overturn a decisive verdict. On AVeriTeC these rules lower single-pass accuracy by six points, to 65.0% (balanced accuracy 57.6%). Ten judges from eight model families also show abstentions and validation conversions on fixed packets. Against the full stores hybrid single-pass accuracy falls by 17 to 29 points. Wikipedia evidence recovery declines; AVeriTeC recovery changes from annotated answers to cited pages and is measured separately. No controller recovers the accuracy loss. The agent also shows no resolved gain on 714 further Wikipedia claims. Evidence recovery, judgement and validation should be measured separately before an error is attributed to search.

translation.title: 事实核查错误产生于何处？在证据支撑的验证中分离检索、搜索控制与判断
translation.abstract: 证据支撑的事实核查器失败，可能是因为没有找到证据，也可能是因为没有用好证据；端到端准确率无法区分这两种情况。我们提出一个协议，跟踪参考证据从存储到结论的全过程，分离检索、搜索控制、判断和结论验证。我们在两种证据条件下用同一个开放权重 9B 模型评估来自 FEVER、FEVER 2.0 和 AVeriTeC 的 293 条声明：小规模标注证据存储（发现容易）和完整源文档集合。在对照条件下，单次混合检索为 228 条含证据声明中的 226 条提供了完整的参考证据，而自适应控制器和工具代理花费两到九倍的模型调用却没有一致的收益。在 34 条被标记为缺乏证据的决定性声明中，有 33 条的证据在证据包中是完整的：其中 15 条是评判者弃权，18 条是验证规则推翻了决定性结论。在 AVeriTeC 上，这些规则使单次通过准确率下降六个百分点至 65.0%（平衡准确率 57.6%）。来自八个模型家族的十个评判者在固定证据包上也表现出弃权和验证转换。面对完整存储，混合单次通过准确率下降 17 到 29 个百分点。Wikipedia 证据恢复率下降；AVeriTeC 的恢复从标注答案变为被引用页面，并被单独测量。没有任何控制器能挽回准确率损失。该代理在另外 714 条 Wikipedia 声明上也没有可解决的收益。在将错误归因于搜索之前，应分别测量证据恢复、判断和验证。
translation.brief: 提出一个分离检索、搜索控制、判断与验证各环节的评估协议，发现事实核查错误多源于判断与验证环节而非检索失败。

papers.title: Cache the Knowledge, Not Just the Prompt: Dynamic Datalog as the Action Language for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: An LLM agent that answers questions about a knowledge graph writes a program per question, and its tools evaluate each from scratch. We give the agent a Datalog REPL, a session over a dynamic Datalog engine, in which rules are inserted and retracted like facts while derived facts stay current. Prompt caching reuses the model's processing of what a session shares, and the Datalog REPL reuses the evaluation of it. On chains of questions over three knowledge graphs, agents reuse a relation that the REPL keeps in 179 of 180 cases, with two models, and write fewer output tokens: SQL and Python agents write 23 to 82% more. With SQL tables or a Python namespace, Claude Haiku 5.5 stores almost nothing for later questions, and a chain of seven questions at 13 million facts takes it a median of 48 and 56 s, against 31 s with the REPL. Claude Opus 5.5 matches the REPL by storing tables in SQL, and when the data changes it stores views, which are evaluated again at every read. A relation that the REPL keeps is read like a table and stays current like a view. Datalog is a niche language beside SQL and Python, and with thinking enabled the models answer as accurately with it.
authors: Bruno Rucy Carneiro Alves de Lima

translation.title: 缓存知识，而不仅是提示词：动态 Datalog 作为 LLM 代理的动作语言
translation.abstract: 回答知识图谱问题的 LLM 代理会为每个问题编写程序，其工具每次都从头评估。我们为代理提供一个 Datalog REPL，即动态 Datalog 引擎上的会话，其中规则可以像事实一样插入和撤回，而派生事实保持最新。提示词缓存复用模型对会话共享内容的处理，而 Datalog REPL 复用对它的求值。在三个知识图谱上的问题链中，两个模型的代理在 180 个案例中有 179 个复用了 REPL 保留的关系，并写出更少的输出 token：SQL 和 Python 代理多写 23% 到 82%。使用 SQL 表或 Python 命名空间时，Claude Haiku 5.5 几乎不为后续问题存储任何内容，在 1300 万事实规模上七个问题的链其中位数耗时 48 和 56 秒，而使用 REPL 为 31 秒。Claude Opus 5.5 通过在 SQL 中存储表达到与 REPL 相当的效果，而当数据变化时它存储视图，每次读取都要重新求值。REPL 保留的关系既像表一样可读，又像视图一样保持最新。Datalog 在 SQL 和 Python 之外是小众语言，且在启用思考模式下模型用它回答同样准确。
translation.brief: 为 LLM 代理提供动态 Datalog REPL，通过缓存派生事实实现跨问题的知识复用，减少 token 消耗并加速多轮问答。

papers.title: Fin-RSI: A Unified Library of Financial Skills, Checks, and Self-Improvement for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) become more capable, financial agents need tools they can readily discover and use. Yet financial software is fragmented across libraries with different interfaces and conventions, making it difficult to build reliable agent workflows. We present Fin-RSI, a unified Python library of financial skills, checks, and self-improvement designed for LLM agents. It brings together tools for market analysis, forecasting, portfolio construction, and trading research through shared interfaces across models and agent frameworks. Agents can find suitable tools from natural-language requests, reuse tested implementations, and improve generated programs through checking and feedback. Developers can extend the library with new tools without rebuilding integrations for each model. Across 20 open-weight models on six trading-position tasks, tool discovery increased the proportion of episodes producing valid programs from 9.7% to 29.2%; for models with at least 14 billion parameters, it rose from 23.6% to 64.6%. We release the library and benchmark as a shared resource for the community and plan to expand its tools and task coverage as financial agents evolve.

translation.title: Fin-RSI：面向 LLM 代理的金融技能、检查与自我改进统一库
translation.abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）能力不断增强，金融代理需要能够便捷发现和使用的工具。然而金融软件分散在不同接口和约定的库中，难以构建可靠的代理工作流。我们提出 Fin-RSI，一个为 LLM 代理设计的金融技能、检查与自我改进的统一 Python 库。它通过跨模型和代理框架的共享接口，整合了市场分析、预测、投资组合构建和交易研究工具。代理可以从自然语言请求中找到合适的工具，复用经过测试的实现，并通过检查和反馈改进生成的程序。开发者可以扩展库中的新工具，而无需为每个模型重建集成。在六个交易持仓任务上对 20 个开放权重模型的评估中，工具发现使产生有效程序的回合比例从 9.7% 提升到 29.2%；对于至少 140 亿参数的模型，从 23.6% 提升到 64.6%。我们将该库和基准作为共享资源向社区发布，并计划随金融代理的发展扩展其工具和任务覆盖。
translation.brief: 构建统一的金融技能 Python 库 Fin-RSI，通过共享接口和工具发现机制提升 LLM 金融代理生成有效程序的能力。

papers.title: LAF-ECG: Multi-Resolution Lead-Aware Fusion of Time-Series and Language Foundation Models for ECG Classification
papers.abstract: Automated electrocardiogram (ECG) interpretation has advanced substantially with deep learning, yet many methods remain task-specific and label-dependent. Large language models (LLMs) and time-series foundation models (TSFMs) offer complementary pretrained representations, but integrating them is challenging because of mismatched feature spaces and the lead- and scale-dependent structure of ECG signals. We propose LAF-ECG (Lead-Aware Foundation Fusion for ECG), a dual-foundation framework that extends MedTsLLM with a lead-aware interface to a frozen TSFM backbone while retaining its reprogramming pathway. The proposed framework captures multi-resolution temporal context, fuses temporal and language-aligned ECG representations through adaptive residual integration, and employs branch-specific supervision with cross-branch alignment. LAF-ECG achieves 71.10% accuracy and 62.43% macro-F1 on PTB-XL, and 89.73% accuracy and 65.94% macro-F1 on Chapman-Shaoxing, outperforming MedTsLLM on both datasets. These results highlight the value of preserving lead-specific temporal structure when combining temporal and language foundation representations for ECG classification. The code is publicly available at this https URL.

translation.title: LAF-ECG：时间序列与语言基础模型的多分辨率导联感知融合用于心电图分类
translation.abstract: 自动心电图（ECG）解读随着深度学习取得了长足进步，但许多方法仍然依赖特定任务和标注。大语言模型（LLM）和时间序列基础模型（TSFM）提供了互补的预训练表示，但整合它们具有挑战性，因为特征空间不匹配，且 ECG 信号具有导联和尺度相关的结构。我们提出 LAF-ECG（Lead-Aware Foundation Fusion for ECG），一个双基础框架，它扩展了 MedTsLLM，为冻结的 TSFM 主干提供导联感知接口，同时保留其重编程路径。该框架捕获多分辨率时间上下文，通过自适应残差融合融合时间与语言对齐的 ECG 表示，并采用分支特定监督与跨分支对齐。LAF-ECG 在 PTB-XL 上达到 71.10% 准确率和 62.43% 宏 F1，在 Chapman-Shaoxing 上达到 89.73% 准确率和 65.94% 宏 F1，在两个数据集上均优于 MedTsLLM。这些结果凸显了在融合时间与语言基础表示进行 ECG 分类时保留导联特定时间结构的价值。代码已在 https URL 公开。
translation.brief: 提出 LAF-ECG 双基础模型框架，通过导联感知接口融合冻结 TSFM 与 LLM 表示，提升 ECG 分类性能。

papers.title: Admitted Is Not Effective: Lessons from a Notary-Gated Retrospective Loop in an Agentic Pipeline
papers.abstract: Agentic software development pipelines with frozen prompts can repeat the same mistakes across pull requests (PRs), yet ungoverned additions to instruction files grow without bound and do not generally improve task success. We present a retrospective loop for a four-stage large language model (LLM) pipeline in which a Retrospective agent proposes edits to learned rules every ten PRs and a Notary admits, merges, or rejects them while recording each decision in a provenance ledger. In a pre-registered study of 880 PRs on two Python repositories, the loop ran end to end and the Notary admitted 55 of 89 proposals, rejecting 8 that cited nonexistent evidence. However, held-out review comments and hidden-test resolution did not improve after ten retrospectives. Tracing each step of the loop, we found that sparse review signal (0.45 comments/PR) left little to learn from and that rules admitted on their stated evidence did not show measurable held-out effects. We derive six lessons and argue that governed loops should admit and retire every learned rule as a testable hypothesis.

translation.title: 被接纳不等于有效：来自Agentic流水线中公证门控回溯循环的经验教训
translation.abstract: 采用冻结提示词的Agentic软件开发流水线会在不同pull request（PR）中重复同样的错误，而对指令文件不加治理的添加会无限增长，且通常并不能提升任务成功率。我们为一个四阶段大语言模型（LLM）流水线提出了一种回溯循环：Retrospective agent每十个PR提出对已学习规则的修改，由Notary（公证者）决定接纳、合并或拒绝，并将每个决策记录在溯源账本中。在一项预先注册的、覆盖两个Python仓库共880个PR的研究中，该循环端到端运行，Notary接纳了89个提案中的55个，并拒绝了8个引用了不存在证据的提案。然而，经过十轮回溯后，held-out评审评论和隐藏测试解决率并未改善。通过追踪循环的每一步，我们发现稀疏的评审信号（0.45条评论/PR）几乎没有可学习的内容，且基于其声称的证据被接纳的规则并未表现出可测量的held-out效果。我们总结出六条经验教训，并主张受治理的循环应将每条已学习规则作为可检验的假设来接纳和淘汰。
translation.brief: 针对冻结提示的agentic流水线重复犯错且规则无限增长的问题，提出由Notary门控的回溯循环来治理LLM学习规则的接纳与淘汰。

papers.title: Reasoning Beyond Imitation: Observation Conditioned Distillation for Video LLMs
papers.abstract: Reasoning distillation offers a promising approach to transfer temporal reasoning capabilities of powerful Video-LLMs to open-source student models. However, teacher and student Video-LLMs may construct different temporal observations from the same video due to the adoption of distinct video sampling pipelines. A reasoning trajectory valid under the teacher's observations may rely on evidence inaccessible to the student and thus cannot be directly executed based on the student's observations. We formalize this as a conditional target mismatch, thereby revealing the Reasoning Acquisition-Execution Gap. To bridge this gap, we propose an acquisition-to-execution framework that first distills teacher trajectories into a student reasoning prior and then further optimizes the execution capability of this prior across multiple observations. We further introduce Execution-Aware Reference Regularization, which retains the existing prior when it is executable under current observations, while allowing a greater degree of adaptive adjustment when it is not. Experiments across multiple Video-LLM backbones and six video reasoning benchmarks show that explicitly optimizing observation-conditioned execution consistently outperforms supervised distillation and standard RL-based optimization, with gains extending to held-out out-of-domain benchmarks.

translation.title: 超越模仿的推理：面向Video LLM的观测条件化蒸馏
translation.abstract: 推理蒸馏是将强大Video-LLM的时序推理能力迁移到开源学生模型的一种有前景的方法。然而，由于采用不同的视频采样流水线，教师和学生Video-LLM可能从同一视频构建不同的时序观测。在教师观测下有效的推理轨迹可能依赖于学生无法获取的证据，因而无法基于学生的观测直接执行。我们将此形式化为条件目标失配，从而揭示了推理获取-执行鸿沟。为弥合这一鸿沟，我们提出一个从获取到执行的框架：先将教师轨迹蒸馏为学生的推理先验，再在多种观测下进一步优化该先验的执行能力。我们进一步引入执行感知参考正则化（Execution-Aware Reference Regularization），当现有先验在当前观测下可执行时予以保留，而在不可执行时允许更大程度的自适应调整。在多个Video-LLM骨干和六个视频推理基准上的实验表明，显式优化观测条件下的执行能力始终优于监督蒸馏和标准基于RL的优化，且增益可扩展到held-out域外基准。
translation.brief: 针对师生Video-LLM观测不一致导致蒸馏推理轨迹无法执行的问题，提出先蒸馏推理先验再优化观测条件化执行能力的获取-执行框架。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning from LLM-Generated (Suboptimal) Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved substantial progress across many domains, but training an agent \textit{tabula rasa} remains highly sample-inefficient. A common remedy is to initialize the agent using a neural network pretrained on demonstrations. However, collecting demonstrations is expensive, and the demonstrations themselves can be suboptimal. In this work, we use a large language model (LLM) to generate an advice policy that produces demonstration data with effectively no human cost. We use this data to warmstart a DQN agent, and use the advice policy itself to guide exploration during training. Because LLM-generated advice is often suboptimal, we further introduce a value warmstart method that initializes the agent to recognize promising states from the advice policy's behavior, without directly copying its actions. To characterize the robustness of this method, we systematically perturb individual sub-skills of an LLM-generated advice policy for a long-horizon, sparse-reward task. Degraded advice still meaningfully accelerates learning relative to unaided baselines. These results suggest that LLM-generated advice, though suboptimal, can be a cheap alternative to costly human demonstrations.

translation.title: 从LLM生成的（次优）示范中进行强化学习
translation.abstract: 强化学习（RL）已在许多领域取得重大进展，但从零开始训练agent仍然样本效率极低。一种常见的补救措施是使用在示范数据上预训练的神经网络来初始化agent。然而，收集示范数据成本高昂，且示范本身可能是次优的。在本工作中，我们使用大语言模型（LLM）生成一个建议策略（advice policy），以几乎零人力成本产生示范数据。我们用这些数据对DQN agent进行热启动，并在训练期间利用建议策略本身引导探索。由于LLM生成的建议往往是次优的，我们进一步引入一种价值热启动方法，将agent初始化为能从建议策略的行为中识别有希望的状态，而不直接复制其动作。为刻画该方法的鲁棒性，我们系统性地扰动LLM为长时程、稀疏奖励任务生成的建议策略的各个子技能。退化的建议仍能相对无辅助基线显著加速学习。这些结果表明，LLM生成的建议虽属次优，但可作为昂贵人类示范的廉价替代。
translation.brief: 针对示范数据收集昂贵且可能次优的问题，用LLM生成建议策略进行价值热启动并引导探索，以廉价替代人类示范。

papers.title: MISeg-Agent: A Human-in-the-Loop Agentic Framework for Error Diagnosis and Executable Prompt Review in 3D Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract: Despite the strong performance of modern medical image segmentation models, their predictions can still contain localized errors that compromise segmentation quality. Identifying and correcting these errors is therefore essential for improving the reliability of existing segmentation results. While interactive segmentation models enable targeted corrections, identifying potential errors, determining where to intervene, and evaluating corrective actions remain challenging. Moreover, each correction changes the current mask, requiring subsequent error diagnosis and recommendations to adapt accordingly. To address these challenges, we propose MISeg-Agent, a human-in-the-loop agentic framework that diagnoses segmentation errors and provides evidence-based correction recommendations. MISeg-Agent first selects a suitable pretrained segmentation model based on benchmark performance and computational requirements. Given its predicted mask, the framework identifies potential missing and excess foreground regions and recommends suspicious slices and corrective points for review. The framework then evaluates candidate point prompts using an interactive segmentation model and presents the resulting corrections for human verification before applying them. By operating directly on images and predicted masks, the error diagnosis process remains independent of the underlying segmentation model architecture. Evaluations on CT datasets demonstrate that MISeg-Agent improves initial segmentation results and produces final masks closely aligned with reference annotations. By integrating adaptive error diagnosis with validated correction recommendations, MISeg-Agent provides an interpretable approach to identifying and reducing residual errors in existing medical image segmentations.

translation.title: MISeg-Agent：用于3D医学图像分割中错误诊断与可执行提示审查的人机协同Agentic框架
translation.abstract: 尽管现代医学图像分割模型性能强大，其预测仍可能包含损害分割质量的局部错误。因此，识别并纠正这些错误对于提升现有分割结果的可靠性至关重要。虽然交互式分割模型能够进行针对性纠正，但识别潜在错误、确定干预位置以及评估纠正措施仍然具有挑战性。此外，每次纠正都会改变当前掩码，需要后续的错误诊断和建议随之调整。为应对这些挑战，我们提出MISeg-Agent，一个诊断分割错误并提供基于证据的纠正建议的人机协同agentic框架。MISeg-Agent首先根据基准性能和计算需求选择合适的预训练分割模型。给定其预测掩码，该框架识别潜在的缺失和多余前景区域，并推荐可疑切片和纠正点供审查。随后，框架使用交互式分割模型评估候选点提示，并在应用之前将产生的纠正结果呈现给人类验证。通过直接在图像和预测掩码上操作，错误诊断过程保持与底层分割模型架构无关。在CT数据集上的评估表明，MISeg-Agent改进了初始分割结果，并产生与参考标注高度一致的最终掩码。通过将自适应错误诊断与经验证的纠正建议相结合，MISeg-Agent为识别和减少现有医学图像分割中的残余错误提供了一种可解释的方法。
translation.brief: 针对3D医学分割中局部错误难以识别与纠正的问题，提出人机协同的agentic框架，自适应诊断错误并给出经人类验证的点提示纠正建议。

papers.title: Agentic Root Cause Reasoning and Localization of Unsoundness in Static Call Graph Analysis
papers.abstract: Static call graph tools cannot soundly model every dynamic language feature, yet rarely reveal when, where, or why their results are unsound. We present CGRizz, an agentic framework that diagnoses unsoundness for developers and warns users about it. During training, CGRizz compares static and dynamic call graphs to identify boundary edges: calls observed at runtime but missing from the static graph. For each edge, an LLM agent proposes a root cause, including the unmodeled program pattern and responsible tool location. CGRizz validates each proposal using three independent forms of evidence: runtime instrumentation detecting the pattern, a test case reproducing the missing edge, and a warning inserted at the implicated tool location. Validated reports help developers diagnose limitations, while the warnings form an instrumented build that flags potential unsoundness in new programs without dynamic analysis. We evaluate CGRizz on three benchmark suites using WALA, OPAL, and Soot. Of 1,459 boundary edges, CGRizz reasons about 10.3% directly, all confirmed by manual audit, and resolves another 84.1% by grouping edges with validated root causes. Tool maintainers confirmed several limitations, some of which have been fixed. The warnings flag 74%-92% of unsoundness in held-out programs. Guided by CGRizz reports, a coding agent refactored programs to remove 64% of targeted root-cause patterns while preserving functionality.

translation.title: 静态调用图分析中不可靠性的Agentic根因推理与定位
translation.abstract: 静态调用图工具无法可靠地建模所有动态语言特性，却很少揭示其结果在何时、何地、为何不可靠。我们提出CGRizz，一个为开发者诊断不可靠性并向用户发出警告的agentic框架。在训练阶段，CGRizz比较静态与动态调用图以识别边界边：在运行时被观测到但在静态图中缺失的调用。对于每条边，一个LLM agent提出根因，包括未被建模的程序模式及工具中的相应位置。CGRizz使用三种独立形式的证据验证每个提案：检测该模式的运行时插桩、复现缺失边的测试用例，以及在所涉工具位置插入的警告。经验证的报告帮助开发者诊断工具局限，而这些警告构成一个插桩构建，可在无需动态分析的情况下标记新程序中的潜在不可靠性。我们在使用WALA、OPAL和Soot的三个基准套件上评估CGRizz。在1,459条边界边中，CGRizz直接推理了10.3%，全部经人工审计确认，并通过将边与经验证的根因分组解决了另外84.1%。工具维护者确认了若干局限，其中一些已被修复。这些警告在held-out程序中标记了74%-92%的不可靠性。在CGRizz报告的指导下，一个编码agent重构程序以消除64%的目标根因模式，同时保持功能不变。
translation.brief: 针对静态调用图分析不可靠性难以诊断的问题，提出CGRizz agentic框架，通过对比静态与动态调用图并用多重证据验证来推理和定位根因。

papers.title: Why Units Die in the Layer After a Frozen Random Encoder, and What the Number of Live Units Measures
papers.abstract: Reinforcement-learning agents can learn Atari games through a convolutional encoder whose random weights are never trained. They reach expert play in Pong and, without random action repeats, in Breakout, but training takes far longer and few ReLU units in the layer after the encoder stay alive. A dead unit outputs zero for every input and cannot learn. In earlier work we took the number of live units to measure the game's complexity. Here we ask why units die and correct that conclusion. We find that more units die as the layer's inputs lie farther from zero relative to how much they vary. We call this ratio the offset. Earlier work showed this in sparse autoencoders at the start of training. We saw it after training in agents, image classifiers, a reservoir computer and sparse autoencoders on GPT-2. A random encoder leaves the offset of its input roughly unchanged, and a formula predicted its median offset within 25 percent in all 44 cases. So a game with a bright, mostly unchanging screen gives the next layer a large offset. In Pong, subtracting the average screen raised the number of live units from between 3 and 6 of 64 to between 59 and 63, so the number alone cannot show a game's complexity. On unaltered screens none of the agents reached a training score of 18 in 50 million steps. With the subtraction all did within 5 million, about as fast as a trained encoder on unaltered screens. In Breakout the subtraction left more units alive, but average training scores did not clearly improve, and a large gap to a trained encoder remained. So we do not treat their number as something to raise for its own sake. The evidence is from small networks and three games, and in agents and image classifiers changing the offset also changed the size of the inputs. We suggest measuring the offset before training a layer on a fixed front end and, if it is large, trying to subtract the mean input.

translation.title: 为什么冻结随机编码器下一层的单元会死亡，以及存活单元数量衡量了什么
translation.abstract: 强化学习智能体可以通过权重从不训练的随机卷积编码器学习 Atari 游戏。它们在 Pong 中达到专家水平，在不使用随机动作重复的情况下也能在 Breakout 中达到，但训练时间要长得多，且编码器下一层中很少有 ReLU 单元保持存活。死单元对所有输入都输出零，无法学习。在早期工作中，我们将存活单元的数量作为衡量游戏复杂度的指标。本文我们探究单元为何死亡，并纠正了那个结论。我们发现，当该层的输入相对于其变化幅度离零越远时，死亡的单元越多。我们将这个比值称为偏移量（offset）。早期工作在稀疏自编码器训练开始时展示了这一点；我们在训练后的智能体、图像分类器、储备池计算机以及 GPT-2 上的稀疏自编码器中也观察到了这一现象。随机编码器基本保持其输入的偏移量不变，一个公式在全部 44 个案例中将其中位偏移量预测在 25% 的误差范围内。因此，屏幕明亮且大多不变的游戏会给下一层带来较大的偏移量。在 Pong 中，减去平均屏幕后，存活单元数从 64 个中的 3 到 6 个提升到 59 到 63 个，因此该数量本身无法反映游戏复杂度。在未修改的屏幕上，没有任何智能体在 5000 万步内达到 18 的训练分数；而减去均值后，所有智能体都在 500 万步内达到，速度与训练编码器在未修改屏幕上相当。在 Breakout 中，减去均值使更多单元存活，但平均训练分数没有明显改善，与训练编码器之间仍存在较大差距。因此我们不把存活单元数量本身当作需要提高的目标。证据来自小型网络和三个游戏，且在智能体和图像分类器中，改变偏移量也会改变输入的大小。我们建议在固定前端上训练一层之前先测量偏移量，如果偏移量较大，则尝试减去平均输入。
translation.brief: 研究随机编码器后层单元死亡的原因，发现输入偏移量（均值与变化幅度之比）是关键，并提出减去平均输入来提高存活单元数和训练速度。

papers.title: Mitigating Nested GTP Attacks: A Closed-Loop eBPF Defense for 5G and Beyond Networks
papers.abstract: The evolving cellular networks continue to rely on the legacy GPRS Tunneling Protocol-User Plane (GTP-U) to encapsulate and route user data traffic across the data plane. Recent security research demonstrated that nested GTP-U (GTP-in-GTP) payload vulnerabilities enable a diverse range of attacks on victim users. To address this vulnerability, in this paper, we propose a closed-loop extended Berkeley Packet Filter (eBPF) and eXpress Data Path (XDP) defense to detect and mitigate nested GTP-U attacks in 5G and beyond networks. The proposed framework contains three components: an in-kernel XDP Detection and Drop Module (XDP-DDM), a user-space User-Plane Telemetry Agent (UP-TA), and a multi-threaded Control-Plane Mitigation Orchestrator (CP-MO). We implement and evaluate the proposed defense on a sliced 5G testbed integrating Free5GC, UERANSIM, and Containerlab. Experimental results indicate that the XDP-DDM detects and drops malicious nested GTP-U packets at line rate, while the UP-TA and CP-MO asynchronously report and revoke the attacker's network access, respectively. Under a 10,000 packets-per-second cross-slice nested GTP-U flood, the proposed solution preserves the baseline performance of the victim slices while introducing minimal overhead. We also show that the proposed solution has minimal impact on the user's throughput and round-trip time.

translation.title: 缓解嵌套 GTP 攻击：面向 5G 及未来网络的闭环 eBPF 防御
translation.abstract: 不断演进的蜂窝网络仍依赖传统的 GPRS 隧道协议用户面（GTP-U）在数据面封装和路由用户数据流量。近期安全研究表明，嵌套 GTP-U（GTP-in-GTP）载荷漏洞可对受害用户发起多种攻击。为解决该漏洞，本文提出一种基于扩展 Berkeley 包过滤器（eBPF）和 eXpress Data Path（XDP）的闭环防御，用于在 5G 及未来网络中检测和缓解嵌套 GTP-U 攻击。所提框架包含三个组件：内核态的 XDP 检测与丢弃模块（XDP-DDM）、用户态的用户面遥测代理（UP-TA）以及多线程的控制面缓解编排器（CP-MO）。我们在集成 Free5GC、UERANSIM 和 Containerlab 的切片化 5G 测试床上实现并评估了该防御。实验结果表明，XDP-DDM 能以线速检测并丢弃恶意嵌套 GTP-U 包，UP-TA 和 CP-MO 分别异步上报并撤销攻击者的网络访问。在每秒 10,000 个包的跨切片嵌套 GTP-U 洪泛下，该方案在保持受害切片基线性能的同时引入的开销极小。我们还表明该方案对用户吞吐量和往返时延的影响极小。
translation.brief: 针对嵌套 GTP-U 攻击漏洞，提出基于 eBPF/XDP 的闭环检测与缓解框架，在内核态以线速丢弃恶意包并通过控制面撤销攻击者访问。

papers.title: DictaRashi: A State-of-the-Art OCR Model For Rashi Script
papers.abstract: We release DictaRashi, a Tesseract OCR model for scanned Hebrew books printed in the so-called "Rashi" font. We trained DictaRashi on over one million manually corrected lines of text from over 100 different books of Rabbinic and post-Rabbinic literature. On a held-out set of 1,120 manually transcribed lines from scanned Rashi-script pages, DictaRashi reaches a character error rate (CER) of 0.86% and a word error rate (WER) of 3.38%, setting a new state-of-the-art for publicly-available Tesseract models. We provide a full comparison of our results to those of the 31 other publicly available Hebrew Tesseract models; the best of those models achieves a 2.98% CER and 11.86% WER. We further demonstrate that DictaRashi outperforms the current frontier LLMs on this OCR task. We release the test set of Rashi-script documents so that it may be used as a benchmark for future work in this area. We are pleased to release the model and test set to the community under a CC BY NC 4.0 license.

translation.title: DictaRashi：面向 Rashi 字体的最先进 OCR 模型
translation.abstract: 我们发布 DictaRashi，一个用于扫描版以所谓 "Rashi" 字体印刷的希伯来语书籍的 Tesseract OCR 模型。我们在来自 100 多本拉比及后拉比文献书籍、超过一百万行人工校对的文本上训练了 DictaRashi。在一个由 1,120 行从扫描的 Rashi 字体页面人工转录的行组成的保留测试集上，DictaRashi 达到 0.86% 的字符错误率（CER）和 3.38% 的词错误率（WER），为公开可用的 Tesseract 模型树立了新的最先进水平。我们提供了与 31 个其他公开可用的希伯来语 Tesseract 模型结果的完整对比；其中最好的模型 CER 为 2.98%、WER 为 11.86%。我们进一步证明 DictaRashi 在此 OCR 任务上优于当前前沿 LLM。我们发布 Rashi 字体文档测试集，以作为该领域未来工作的基准。我们很高兴以 CC BY NC 4.0 许可向社区发布该模型和测试集。
translation.brief: 针对 Rashi 字体希伯来语扫描书籍的 OCR 问题，基于百万余行人工校对文本训练 Tesseract 模型，达到新的最先进水平。

papers.title: Sánchez, Feijóo, or Abascal? Speaker Attribution and Ideological Congruence in LLM Personas Reading Posts on X of the Leaders of the Three Main Parties of the 29N General Election in Spain
papers.abstract: Source cues are central to political communication, yet reception studies with large language model (LLM) personas as synthetic audiences have not tested whether personas respond to who speaks and not only to what is said. With Spain's general election of 29 November 2026 in mind, we run a speaker-attribution experiment using 1,075 anonymised X posts by the leaders of PSOE, PP and VOX on four topics (the economy and employment, household costs, immigration and corruption) and 791 distinct value-grounded, LLM-generated personas. Each post was assigned to 300 topic-selected persona profiles, 150 grounded in the Inglehart-Welzel cultural map and 150 in Moral Foundations Theory, under four conditions: no author, Sánchez, Feijóo or Abascal, yielding 322,470 complete persona-post quartets. Naming any leader lowered support for identical text, with the penalty for Abascal nearly twice as large as those for Sánchez and Feijóo. The penalty follows the persona's elicited left-right self-placement (ideological congruence): left personas spare Sánchez and right personas spare Feijóo, although ideology was never in the message-evaluation prompt. Corruption posts were penalised under every name, whereas on other topics the ideologically closest leader generally produced little or no penalty. The leader order matches public opinion in 48 CIS barometers (2022-2026) in all three groups and the sign of all twelve differences, but fits barometers before the model's 2024 knowledge cutoff better than recent ones. Our findings demonstrate that LLM personas evaluate political speakers through systematic, value-congruent priors: however, while they replicate human candidate rank-orders across survey barometers, this alignment is ordinal rather than quantitative, highlighting their utility for controlled source-effect experiments though not as substitutes for empirical public opinion surveys.

translation.title: Sánchez、Feijóo 还是 Abascal？LLM 人格阅读西班牙 29N 大选三大政党领导人在 X 上发帖的说话者归因与意识形态一致性
translation.abstract: 来源线索是政治传播的核心，然而以大语言模型（LLM）人格作为合成受众的接受研究尚未检验人格是否对说话者身份作出反应，而不仅是对内容本身。着眼于西班牙 2026 年 11 月 29 日大选，我们开展了一项说话者归因实验，使用 PSOE、PP 和 VOX 领导人在四个主题（经济与就业、家庭开支、移民和腐败）上的 1,075 条匿名化 X 帖子，以及 791 个独特的、基于价值观的 LLM 生成人格。每条帖子被分配给 300 个按主题选择的人格画像，其中 150 个基于 Inglehart-Welzel 文化地图，150 个基于道德基础理论，在四种条件下进行：无作者、Sánchez、Feijóo 或 Abascal，共产生 322,470 个完整的人格-帖子四元组。点名任何领导人都降低了对相同文本的支持，其中 Abascal 所受的惩罚几乎是 Sánchez 和 Feijóo 的两倍。惩罚遵循人格被引导出的左右自我定位（意识形态一致性）：左翼人格放过 Sánchez，右翼人格放过 Feijóo，尽管意识形态从未出现在消息评估提示中。腐败帖子在任何名字下都受到惩罚，而在其他主题上，意识形态上最接近的领导人通常产生很小或没有惩罚。领导人的排序在所有三个群体中与 48 份 CIS 民意晴雨表（2022-2026）中的公众舆论一致，且十二个差异的符号全部一致，但对模型 2024 年知识截止之前的晴雨表拟合得比近期的更好。我们的发现表明，LLM 人格通过系统的、与价值观一致的先验来评估政治说话者；然而，尽管它们在各调查晴雨表中复制了人类候选人的排序，这种一致性是序数性的而非数量性的，这凸显了它们在受控来源效应实验中的效用，但不能作为实证民意调查的替代品。
translation.brief: 通过 LLM 人格对西班牙三大政党领导人 X 帖子的说话者归因实验，检验人格是否基于说话者身份和意识形态先验而非仅内容作出评价。

papers.title: ComplexIF: A Challenging Multi-Turn, Multi-Constraint Instruction-Following Benchmark
papers.abstract: As frontier LLMs saturate existing instruction-following benchmarks, measuring further progress requires harder tests that remain faithful to real use. In practice, users often combine several constraints, add them at different turns of a conversation, and expect all of them to hold in the assistant's response. We introduce ComplexIF, a challenging benchmark for this setting, together with the automatic pipeline that generates it. The pipeline expands seed requests into multi-turn conversations, weaves constraints into their turns, and keeps only tasks that a strong model can solve, so difficulty can be raised by adding constraints or turns while every task stays solvable. ComplexIF's two splits test complementary sides of instruction following: a verifiable split of format constraints, checked by programs, and a rubric split of semantic instructions, such as a tone or an audience, checked with an LLM judge. Across 14 proprietary and open-weight models, even the strongest satisfies every constraint on fewer than half of the verifiable tasks, and no model leads on both splits.

translation.title: ComplexIF：一个具有挑战性的多轮、多约束指令遵循基准
translation.abstract: 随着前沿 LLM 在现有指令遵循基准上趋于饱和，衡量进一步进展需要更难但仍忠实于真实使用的测试。在实践中，用户常常组合多个约束、在对话的不同轮次中添加它们，并期望所有约束都在助手的回复中得到满足。我们提出 ComplexIF，一个针对该场景的具有挑战性的基准，以及生成它的自动化流水线。该流水线将种子请求扩展为多轮对话，将约束编织进各轮次，并只保留强模型能够解决的任务，因此可以通过增加约束或轮次来提高难度，同时每个任务仍可解决。ComplexIF 的两个划分测试指令遵循的互补方面：一个可验证划分，包含由程序检查的格式约束；一个评分标准（rubric）划分，包含由 LLM 评判者检查的语义指令，如语气或受众。在 14 个专有和开源权重模型中，即使最强的模型在可验证任务上满足所有约束的比例也不到一半，且没有模型在两个划分上都领先。
translation.brief: 针对现有指令遵循基准饱和问题，构建多轮多约束基准 ComplexIF，通过自动流水线生成可验证格式约束与语义评分标准两类任务。

papers.title: Dimension Is Free, Horizon Is Not: When Evolution Strategies Rival Policy Gradients for LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract: Policy gradient (PG) methods such as GRPO dominate LLM fine-tuning, yet recent work showed that Evolution Strategies (ES) also scale to fine-tuning models with billions of parameters. Which method needs fewer samples, and on which tasks, remains unclear. We view the two methods as estimators of the same gradient that differ in where they explore. Because ES perturbs parameters, its noise grows with the number of parameters, and because PG samples actions, its noise grows with the number of generated tokens. Only noise along the directions that change the reward slows learning. The cost of ES then depends on the effective dimension, the number of independent skills a task requires rather than its parameter count, while the cost of PG depends on the effective horizon, which counts only the tokens that share both credit and weights with the reward-carrying ones. We train both methods on a synthetic task where the number of skills and the effective horizon can be varied separately. PG is cheaper when the horizon is short, ES becomes cheaper once it is long enough, and this crossover moves to longer horizons as the number of skills grows. We then measure the effective horizons of 20 NLP, math reasoning, and agentic tasks and compare the two methods with Qwen2.5-7B. PG leads on short-horizon tasks, the two tie on the moderate-horizon math ones, and no task has a horizon in the regime where the theory predicts an ES advantage. Terminal-Bench has a far longer horizon. There, in a preliminary comparison with Qwen3.5-4B, ES without any credit assignment reaches a higher success rate than the PG checkpoint released with Tmax, as the theory predicts. ES should thus have the advantage on long-horizon tasks with few independent skills and a nonvanishing reward signal. Current benchmarks are only at the onset of this regime, so ES should become more competitive as agentic tasks grow longer.

translation.title: 维度是免费的，视界不是：进化策略何时能与策略梯度在LLM微调上抗衡
translation.abstract: 策略梯度（PG）方法如GRPO主导LLM微调，但近期工作表明进化策略（ES）也能扩展到数十亿参数模型的微调。哪种方法需要更少的样本、在哪些任务上如此，仍不清楚。我们将两种方法视为同一梯度的估计器，区别在于探索的位置。由于ES扰动参数，其噪声随参数数量增长；由于PG采样动作，其噪声随生成token数量增长。只有沿改变奖励方向的噪声才会减慢学习。因此ES的成本取决于有效维度，即任务所需的独立技能数量而非参数数量；而PG的成本取决于有效视界，即只统计与携带奖励的token共享信用和权重的token。我们在一个可以分别改变技能数量和有效视界的合成任务上训练两种方法。当视界较短时PG更便宜，一旦视界足够长ES就变得更便宜，且随着技能数量增长，交叉点移向更长的视界。随后我们测量了20个NLP、数学推理和智能体任务的有效视界，并用Qwen2.5-7B比较两种方法。PG在短视界任务上领先，两者在中等视界的数学任务上打平，没有任务的视界处于理论预测ES占优的区域。Terminal-Bench的视界要长得多。在那里，与Qwen3.5-4B的初步比较中，不做任何信用分配的ES达到了比随Tmax发布的PG检查点更高的成功率，正如理论所预测。因此ES应在具有少量独立技能且奖励信号不消失的长视界任务上占优。当前基准仅处于该区域的开端，因此随着智能体任务变得更长，ES应变得更具竞争力。
translation.brief: 研究进化策略与策略梯度在LLM微调中的样本效率差异，通过有效维度与有效视界的理论分析及实验确定各自适用的任务条件。

papers.title: Generating Safety-Critical Driving Scenarios from Role-Typed Signal Temporal Logic Specifications Drafted by Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Safety-critical scenarios are rare in recorded driving and must be generated to test and train motion planners of automated vehicles. In guided diffusion models, each scenario type needs its own weighted objective, separate from the validity check. Optimized together with the attacker, the vehicle under test can cancel the attack or draw it toward itself. We state each scenario as a signal temporal logic specification with clauses typed by role. Every clause names the agent it may change and the agents it may read, and the vehicle under test reads the attacker only from the attack onset. A large language model drafts the specification from a description, and a type checker accepts it. A compiler derives the optimization: it edits a diffusion model's samples by the smallest change that satisfies the specification, each clause moves only its owner, the attacker is solved against the unreacted vehicle under test before its response, and the monitor of the same specification decides acceptance. On nuScenes and CommonRoad, judged independently of the specification, one parameter set produced valid scenarios at a rate 0.14 above a weighted objective tuned per scenario type, and descriptions yielded at least one valid scenario for 11 of the 16 pre-crash types expressible in the public data. Learned planners fail more often on the generated scenarios than on their seeds. Fine-tuning on them lowers a planner's failure rate on critical scenarios, and the time headway one clause of the label requires, not the generator, sets the size of the gain.

translation.title: 从大语言模型起草的角色类型化信号时序逻辑规范生成安全关键驾驶场景
translation.abstract: 安全关键场景在真实驾驶记录中很罕见，必须生成它们以测试和训练自动驾驶车辆的运动规划器。在引导扩散模型中，每种场景类型都需要自己的加权目标，与有效性检查分离。若与攻击者一起优化，被测车辆可以抵消攻击或将攻击引向自身。我们将每个场景表述为带角色类型化子句的信号时序逻辑规范。每个子句指明它可以改变哪些智能体、可以读取哪些智能体，且被测车辆只在攻击开始后读取攻击者。大语言模型从描述起草规范，类型检查器接受它。编译器推导出优化过程：它以满足规范的最小改动编辑扩散模型的样本，每个子句只移动其所属者，攻击者在被测车辆响应之前先针对未反应的被测车辆求解，同一规范的监视器决定接受与否。在nuScenes和CommonRoad上，以独立于规范的方式评判，一组参数生成的有效场景率比按场景类型调优的加权目标高0.14，且描述能为公开数据中可表达的16种碰撞前类型中的11种产生至少一个有效场景。学习型规划器在生成的场景上比在其种子上失败更频繁。在生成场景上微调可降低规划器在关键场景上的失败率，且增益大小由标签某子句要求的车头时距决定，而非生成器。
translation.brief: 提出用LLM起草角色类型化的信号时序逻辑规范，再编译为对扩散模型样本的最小编辑，以生成安全关键驾驶场景。

papers.title: Relativising Integrity and Robustness: Prompt Injection and Partitioned Enclaves
papers.abstract: Relative security (RS) judges a system against a reference system, but has only been applied to confidentiality. We introduce relative integrity (RI), which states that every behaviour a system exhibits under an attacker's influence must be one the reference can exhibit for the same trusted inputs. RS and RI each choose their own reference runs, so together they accept attacks whose leak and effects the reference reproduces only in different runs. We therefore develop a further property, relative robustness (RR), which asks the same runs to reproduce both and is strictly stronger than RS and RI together. We give proof methods for RI and RR and a disproof method for RI, and apply them in two domains: (1) LLM agents under prompt injection, where the reference runs the same plan with a model that never obeys untrusted content, and (2) C programs partitioned across an SGX or TrustZone enclave boundary, where the reference keeps every function inside. We evaluate the properties on models of five published attacks, a support desk, an OP-TEE HOTP token and common agent defences. Two cases pass RS and RI but fail RR: an injection that makes the support desk's model accept any customer, as one input did in the Tensor Trust game, and the simulation step of the attack on Secret Network, in which an SGX enclave reveals a transfer's outcome without committing it. Our work is fully mechanised in Isabelle/HOL, with the enclave programs verified in C using AutoCorres2.

translation.title: 相对化完整性与鲁棒性：提示注入与分区飞地
translation.abstract: 相对安全性（RS）以参考系统为基准评判系统，但此前仅应用于机密性。我们引入相对完整性（RI），即系统在攻击者影响下表现出的每个行为都必须是参考系统对相同可信输入能够表现出的行为。RS和RI各自选择自己的参考运行，因此合在一起会接受那些泄露和影响仅在不同运行中被参考系统复现的攻击。因此我们发展了更强的性质——相对鲁棒性（RR），要求同一运行同时复现两者，它严格强于RS与RI之和。我们给出RI和RR的证明方法及RI的反证方法，并应用于两个领域：(1) 遭受提示注入的LLM智能体，其中参考系统用从不服从不可信内容的模型运行同一计划；(2) 跨SGX或TrustZone飞地边界分区的C程序，其中参考系统将每个函数保留在飞地内。我们在五个已发表攻击的模型、一个支持台、一个OP-TEE HOTP令牌及常见智能体防御上评估这些性质。两个案例通过RS和RI但未通过RR：一个使支持台模型接受任意客户的注入（如Tensor Trust游戏中某输入所为），以及针对Secret Network攻击的模拟步骤，其中SGX飞地在不提交的情况下泄露转账结果。我们的工作在Isabelle/HOL中完全机械化，飞地程序用AutoCorres2在C中验证。
translation.brief: 提出相对完整性与相对鲁棒性形式化性质，用于分析提示注入下的LLM智能体和跨飞地分区的C程序的安全性。

papers.title: FORGETMENOT: Auditing Memory Driven Privacy Risks in Commercial AI Agents
papers.abstract: Commercial AI agents increasingly incorporate long-term memory (both persistent and chat-history) to enable more accurate and personalized responses, raises significant privacy and policy concerns. Yet little is known about user privacy risks associated with memory behavior, in particular, about memory storage, disclosure, transparency and deletion control. To bridge this gap, we propose FORGETMENOT, an auditing framework for analyzing the privacy risks of long term memory in commercial AI agents. Using our framework, we collect around 3800 multi-turn sessions comprising around 6M tokens across five popular AI agents. Our results show that agents store a wide range of personal attributes, including demographics, health, and sensitive details. Furthermore, user visible memory reveals substantially less (around 20% on average) attributes than the agents store in practice, exposing a significant transparency gap. Our stealth memory injection (SMI) technique further increases the amount of personal and sensitive attribute stored in memory, raising it by 25% and 15% for Copilot and Claude, respectively. We further observed memory deletion control is unreliable, as all five agents exhibit non-zero post deletion leakage, including health and self-harm related attributes. Finally, we demonstrate the feasibility of memory disclosure to a 3rd-party email recipient as a proof-of-concept, as Gemini shows 31.9% leakage rate. Together, our findings reveal notable privacy risks in commercial agents memory. Finally, we discuss both design implications and regulatory recommendations to protect users memory privacy in commercial agents.

translation.title: FORGETMENOT：审计商业AI智能体中记忆驱动的隐私风险
translation.abstract: 商业AI智能体日益引入长期记忆（包括持久记忆和聊天历史）以实现更准确和个性化的响应，这引发了显著的隐私和政策担忧。然而关于记忆行为带来的用户隐私风险，尤其是记忆存储、披露、透明度和删除控制，知之甚少。为填补这一空白，我们提出FORGETMENOT，一个分析商业AI智能体长期记忆隐私风险的审计框架。使用该框架，我们在五个流行AI智能体上收集了约3800个多轮会话、约600万token。结果表明智能体存储了广泛的个人属性，包括人口统计、健康和敏感细节。此外，用户可见的记忆揭示的属性远少于智能体实际存储的（平均约少20%），暴露出显著的透明度差距。我们的隐蔽记忆注入（SMI）技术进一步增加了存储在记忆中的个人和敏感属性，使Copilot和Claude分别增加25%和15%。我们还观察到记忆删除控制不可靠，五个智能体都表现出删除后非零的泄露，包括健康和自残相关属性。最后，我们以概念验证展示了向第三方电子邮件接收者泄露记忆的可行性，Gemini显示31.9%的泄露率。我们的发现揭示了商业智能体记忆中显著的隐私风险。最后，我们讨论了保护商业智能体中用户记忆隐私的设计启示和监管建议。
translation.brief: 提出FORGETMENOT审计框架，系统测量商业AI智能体长期记忆在存储、透明度、注入和删除控制方面的隐私风险。

papers.title: Latent-Predisposition Personas for Heterogeneous and Reliable LLM Survey Simulation
papers.abstract: LLM personas are used to simulate survey publics, which should reproduce not only answer distributions but also within-person coherence and stability. Drawing on mass belief systems research, we show that persona-conditioned LLMs produce over-constrained publics. Across three model families and three U.S. surveys, opinions on unrelated issues are 1.6-4.6 times as correlated as among humans, and party identification explains 2.5-7.6 times as much answer variance. Common remedies (temperature, diversity instructions, backstories) weaken these correlations by making answers more random. On Qwen, their ten-day test-retest reliability falls to 33-59% of the human level, and when made consistent they lose correlation fit. We propose Latent-Predisposition Personas (LPP), whose persons differ stably, not randomly. Each persona receives political engagement, value priorities, and party-relative issue deviations that grow as engagement falls. Answers are sharpened and calibrated to toplines and party crosstabs. At selected operating points, LPP is never significantly worse than any baseline and far more reliable. At matched human-level reliability, it has the lowest correlation error in all six model-survey combinations, also at a lower target. Errors still exceed those between human samples, and gains on framing effects and a frontier closed model are partial.

translation.title: 用于异构且可靠LLM调查模拟的潜在倾向人格
translation.abstract: LLM人格被用于模拟调查公众，这不仅应复现答案分布，还应复现个体内部的一致性和稳定性。借鉴大众信念系统研究，我们表明人格条件化的LLM产生过度约束的公众。在三个模型家族和三项美国调查中，不相关问题上的意见相关性是人类之间的1.6-4.6倍，党派认同解释的答案方差是人类的2.5-7.6倍。常见补救措施（温度、多样性指令、背景故事）通过使答案更随机来削弱这些相关性。在Qwen上，其十天重测信度降至人类水平的33-59%，而一旦使其一致又失去相关性拟合。我们提出潜在倾向人格（LPP），其个体以稳定而非随机的方式不同。每个人格获得政治参与度、价值优先级以及随参与度下降而增大的相对党派的议题偏差。答案被锐化并校准到总体比例和党派交叉表。在选定的操作点上，LPP从不显著差于任何基线且可靠得多。在匹配人类水平信度时，它在所有六个模型-调查组合中相关性误差最低，且在更低的目标下亦然。误差仍超过人类样本之间的误差，在框架效应和前沿闭源模型上的收益是部分的。
translation.brief: 针对LLM人格模拟调查公众过度相关的问题，提出带稳定潜在倾向（政治参与度、价值优先级、党派偏差）的LPP人格以兼顾相关结构与信度。

papers.title: Blind to What They Can Fix: A Detection Gap in Self-Improving Agents
papers.abstract: AI agents can write programs that carry out a task without calling a model at every step, so the task runs fast and its logic stays open to inspection. Agents improve these programs by running them, studying their failures, and revising the code, a form of recursive self-improvement (RSI). We ask whether this process also yields runtime checks that can be trusted. In five task domains, with up to seven author models, agents bring their programs to high scores. Yet when the environment changes, the checks they were told to write stay silent on half or more of the resulting failures in four domains. These failures can be detected and repaired: a monitor built from records of normal runs catches most of them in three domains, and the same agents usually repair them once called. The checks do not examine the recorded relations that reveal the failures, and the strongest agent writes checks that catch most of them once told that its checks are the only thing that calls it back. An unreported failure stays unrepaired, which limits what self-improvement is worth in autonomous operation. Evaluations of self-improvement should measure not only scores but also whether a system notices its own failures.

translation.title: 对可修复的失败视而不见：自我改进智能体的检测缺口
translation.abstract: AI 智能体可以编写无需在每一步都调用模型的程序来执行任务，从而使任务运行快速且逻辑可审查。智能体通过运行程序、研究失败并修改代码来改进这些程序，这是一种递归自我改进（RSI）的形式。我们追问：这一过程是否也能产生可信的运行时检查？在五个任务领域中，使用多达七个作者模型，智能体将其程序提升到高分。然而当环境发生变化时，在四个领域中，被要求编写的检查对一半以上的失败保持沉默。这些失败本可以被检测和修复：由正常运行记录构建的监视器在三个领域中捕获了其中大部分，而同样的智能体在被提醒后通常能修复它们。这些检查并未审查那些能揭示失败的记录关系，而最强的智能体一旦被告知其检查是唯一能唤回它的机制，所写的检查便能捕获大部分失败。未被报告的失败将得不到修复，这限制了自我改进在自主运行中的价值。对自我改进的评估不仅应衡量分数，还应衡量系统是否能察觉自身的失败。
translation.brief: 研究自我改进智能体编写的运行时检查无法察觉自身失败的问题，提出用正常运行记录构建监视器来检测并提示智能体修复这些失败。

papers.title: Can Vibe Coding Produce Accessible Websites: An Empirical Study on LLM Coding Agents and Skills
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) coding agents increasingly allow developers and non-professionals to create websites through natural-language instructions, with limited inspection of the generated source code. Although this ``vibe coding'' workflow lowers barriers to software creation, it may also propagate accessibility defects at scale. We investigate the accessibility of websites generated end-to-end by contemporary coding agents and whether agent-level accessibility interventions improve their output. We generated 90 websites for three projects using combinations of three coding agents, four language models, and multiple reasoning-effort levels. We evaluated complete interaction journeys using axe-core, IBM Equal Access Accessibility Checker, and QualWeb, and converged reports to observe violation prevalence and violated WCAG Success Criterion (SC). None of the 90 baseline websites was fully accessible, with an average of 80.43 violated interface elements. 13 WCAG SCs were violated at least once across the runs. Color contrast was the most prevalent issue, followed by labeling, semantic-structure, keyboard, and visualization failures. We reran 24 matched configurations with a general accessibility Skill and a contrast-specific Skill. Both significantly improved accessibility scores, but neither eliminated violations. User testing with blind individuals corroborated the experiential effects of the detected inaccessibilities. Moreover, functional correctness decreased with the inclusion of Skills. Our findings show that accessibility does not reliably emerge from vibe coding, and agentic interventions can both improve some accessibility issues and introduce new functional ones.

translation.title: Vibe Coding 能生成无障碍网站吗：对 LLM 编程智能体与技能的实证研究
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）编程智能体日益使开发者和非专业人士能够通过自然语言指令创建网站，而对生成的源代码检查甚少。尽管这种“vibe coding”工作流降低了软件创作的门槛，但也可能大规模传播无障碍缺陷。我们研究了由当代编程智能体端到端生成的网站的无障碍性，以及智能体层面的无障碍干预能否改善其输出。我们使用三种编程智能体、四个语言模型和多种推理努力级别的组合，为三个项目生成了 90 个网站。我们使用 axe-core、IBM Equal Access Accessibility Checker 和 QualWeb 评估完整的交互旅程，并汇总报告以观察违规的普遍性和被违反的 WCAG 成功标准（SC）。90 个基线网站中没有一个是完全无障碍的，平均有 80.43 个违规界面元素。各次运行中共有 13 个 WCAG SC 被违反。颜色对比度是最普遍的问题，其次是标签、语义结构、键盘和可视化失败。我们使用通用无障碍 Skill 和对比度专用 Skill 重新运行了 24 个匹配配置。两者都显著提高了无障碍得分，但都未能消除违规。与盲人用户的测试证实了所检测到的无障碍问题的实际影响。此外，加入 Skill 后功能正确性有所下降。我们的发现表明，无障碍性并不能从 vibe coding 中可靠地产生，智能体干预既能改善某些无障碍问题，也可能引入新的功能问题。
translation.brief: 实证评估 LLM 编程智能体生成网站的无障碍性，并测试加入无障碍 Skill 的智能体干预能否减少 WCAG 违规。

papers.title: Memphis: A Case Study in Seeding an Agent Task from a Model's Real-World Attempt
papers.abstract: Agent benchmarks are usually made harder by scaling up the data their tasks are built from, yet models that do well on them still fail at real work. We propose building simulated tasks from a model's own attempt at an open-ended task in the real world, so that the model's failures in the simulation resemble its failures in reality. As a case study, we had GPT-6.1 Sol manage two human workers in Cairo over chat for five shifts, with a budget of 7,000 Egyptian pounds, to build as many USB desk lamps as it could. It built two. From the real-world attempt's transcript, we build Memphis, an evaluation in a model-simulated world. Memphis is hard: GPT-6.1 Sol delivers 1.0 lamp per trial on average and repeats its real-world mistakes, buying too few stands and giving up the search for them. With a one-page hint on where to buy parts and who can wire them, it delivers 9.2. Claude Opus 5.5 delivers 2.2 without the hint and 4.6 with it. We release the task, the trials, the audits, and a redacted record of the real-world evaluation.

translation.title: Memphis：从模型真实世界尝试中播种智能体任务的案例研究
translation.abstract: 智能体基准通常通过扩大任务所基于的数据规模来增加难度，但在这些基准上表现良好的模型在真实工作中仍然失败。我们提出从模型自身对现实世界中开放式任务的尝试出发构建模拟任务，使模型在模拟中的失败与其在现实中的失败相似。作为案例研究，我们让 GPT-6.1 Sol 通过聊天在开罗管理两名人类工人，预算为 7000 埃及镑，进行五个班次，尽可能多地制造 USB 台灯。它制造了两盏。基于真实世界尝试的记录，我们构建了 Memphis，一个在模型模拟世界中的评估。Memphis 很难：GPT-6.1 Sol 平均每次试验交付 1.0 盏台灯，并重复其在现实世界中的错误——购买支架太少并放弃寻找支架。在获得一页关于在哪里购买零件以及谁能接线的提示后，它交付了 9.2 盏。Claude Opus 5.5 在无提示时交付 2.2 盏，有提示时交付 4.6 盏。我们发布了该任务、试验、审计以及真实世界评估的脱敏记录。
translation.brief: 提出从模型在真实世界开放式任务中的实际尝试出发构建模拟评估任务，使模拟失败与真实失败一致，并以 Memphis 台灯制造任务为案例验证。

papers.title: Who Makes the Decision? Auditing an Agentic LLM Pipeline for Illicit Cryptocurrency Transaction Monitoring
papers.abstract: Agentic pipelines that combine graph detectors, deterministic rules, retrieval-augmented generation and an LLM judge are being proposed to monitor illicit cryptocurrency flows and to write regulation-citing justifications for analysts. They are evaluated on end-to-end accuracy or on the quality of those justifications, and neither shows which component made a decision. We audit such a pipeline on the Elliptic++ Bitcoin dataset with decision-source attribution, a trace-level protocol with three layers: per-case actual causation, interventional Shapley credit, and mediation of upstream risk scores. A deterministic wallet-score override carries about 94% of the credit for flags, and a verification gate cancels most of the judge's own flags, which fall on licit transactions. Testing the judge alone over 76 evidence bundles, four backbones and two prompts, we find that it follows an injected risk score on the anonymous transaction features it is given, although stronger models decide correctly when the facts are explicit; that a context too short for the system prompt leaves it with no verdict at all; and that it cites regulatory clauses that do not apply, which a substring-based citation check accepts. Hiding the score does not fix the judge, because evidence gathered with the score visible still encodes it. For illicit-activity monitoring, an LLM's justification should therefore not be read as evidence of which component flagged a transaction.

translation.title: 谁做的决定？审计用于非法加密货币交易监测的智能体 LLM 流水线
translation.abstract: 结合图检测器、确定性规则、检索增强生成和 LLM 裁判的智能体流水线被提出用于监测非法加密货币流动，并为分析师撰写引用法规的理由说明。它们在端到端准确率或理由说明质量上被评估，但两者都无法显示是哪个组件做出了决定。我们在 Elliptic++ 比特币数据集上使用决策来源归因审计了这样一个流水线，这是一个三层追踪级协议：逐案例的实际因果、干预式 Shapley 信用分配，以及对上游风险分数的中介分析。一个确定性的钱包分数覆盖承担了约 94% 的标记信用，而一个验证门取消了裁判自身的大部分标记，这些标记落在合法交易上。在 76 个证据包、四个骨干模型和两个提示下单独测试裁判，我们发现它会跟随注入到其收到的匿名交易特征中的风险分数，尽管更强的模型在事实明确时能正确决策；当上下文过短无法容纳系统提示时，它完全不给出判定；并且它会引用不适用的法规条款，而基于子串的引用检查却予以接受。隐藏分数并不能修复裁判，因为在分数可见时收集的证据仍然编码了该分数。因此，对于非法活动监测，LLM 的理由说明不应被解读为哪个组件标记了交易的证据。
translation.brief: 审计一个用于非法加密货币交易监测的智能体 LLM 流水线，用决策来源归因协议揭示实际由确定性规则而非 LLM 裁判做出标记决定。

papers.title: MobileGrail: Learning Compact Guardrails for On-Device deployable Mobile GUI Agent Safety
papers.abstract: Runtime guardrails protect mobile GUI agents by assessing each proposed action before execution, but existing guardrails rely on cloud hosted large multimodal models, exposing every screen to a remote server, including private information such as payments, messages, and medical records. We propose MobileGrail, an on-device deployable model that addresses both. It maintains a recurrent task state that retains only the evidence subsequent safety decisions depend on, so that authorization and execution progress persist beyond the short context. To intervene early while keeping the safety boundary precise, it learns two labels, unsafe and block: unsafe marks the action that commits a violation, whereas block may be issued at any step of an intervention window, which spans from the first action that the user's authorization no longer explains to the committing action itself. To support training, we build an environment of 32 applications whose backends verify the effect of every action, supplying verified labels for supervision and rewards for reinforcement learning to calibrate intervention timing. We also build MobileVeto, an offline benchmark of unsafe trajectories largely on held-out applications, each paired with a benign counterpart.
