On MobileVeto, MobileGrail built on Qwen3.5-2B intercepts 76.2% of violations, up from 64.5% for its prompted backbone, while reducing premature intervention from 58.6% to 5.2%, outperforming the cloud-based OS-Sentinel on both. We further conduct online evaluation on GhostEIBench, where MobileGrail guarding a Qwen3.8-27B agent reduces fully successful attacks from 13 to 3 of 110 tasks while raising task completion from 48 to 58. Quantized to 4 bits, MobileGrail runs on a Snapdragon 8 Elite at a median latency of 4.7 s, comparable to the 5.1s of cloud-hosted Gemini 3.8 Flash.

translation.title: MobileGrail：面向端侧可部署移动 GUI 智能体安全的学习型紧凑护栏
translation.abstract: 运行时护栏通过在执行前评估每个提议的动作来保护移动 GUI 智能体，但现有护栏依赖云端托管的大型多模态模型，将每一块屏幕（包括支付、消息和医疗记录等隐私信息）暴露给远程服务器。我们提出 MobileGrail，一个端侧可部署的模型，同时解决这两个问题。它维护一个循环任务状态，仅保留后续安全决策所依赖的证据，使授权和执行进度在短上下文之外得以延续。为了在保持安全边界精确的同时尽早干预，它学习两个标签：unsafe 和 block。unsafe 标记造成违规的那个动作，而 block 可在干预窗口的任何一步发出，该窗口从用户授权不再能解释的第一个动作延伸到造成违规的动作本身。为支持训练，我们构建了一个包含 32 个应用的环境，其后端验证每个动作的效果，提供经过验证的标签用于监督，并提供奖励用于强化学习以校准干预时机。我们还构建了 MobileVeto，一个主要由留出应用上的不安全轨迹组成的离线基准，每条轨迹都配有良性对应版本。在 MobileVeto 上，基于 Qwen3.5-2B 构建的 MobileGrail 拦截了 76.2% 的违规，高于其提示版骨干模型的 64.5%，同时将过早干预从 58.6% 降至 5.2%，在两项指标上均优于云端 OS-Sentinel。我们还在 GhostEIBench 上进行了在线评估，MobileGrail 保护 Qwen3.8-27B 智能体时，将 110 个任务中完全成功的攻击从 13 次降至 3 次，同时将任务完成率从 48 提升至 58。量化到 4 比特后，MobileGrail 在 Snapdragon 8 Elite 上的中位延迟为 4.7 秒，与云端托管的 Gemini 3.8 Flash 的 5.1 秒相当。
translation.brief: 提出端侧可部署的紧凑护栏模型 MobileGrail，通过循环任务状态和 unsafe/block 双标签学习，在保护隐私的同时拦截移动 GUI 智能体的不安全动作。

papers.title: GlobalHRBench: Does Changing the Question Language Change the Legal Answer?
papers.abstract: Language matters when deploying LLM agents across borders, especially in law, where the governing rules must hold across working languages. Does changing the language of a legal question change answer accuracy? We introduce GlobalHRBench, pairing 240 employment-law problems across eight jurisdictions and eight languages while fixing facts, applicable law and required conclusions. We evaluate nine models on all 1,920 prompts in independent, closed-book, single-answer trials, scoring legal correctness, completeness and answer-language compliance. GPT-6.1 Sol leads at 76.2% strict passes, with a 5.8% relative best-to-worst language decline, compared with 42.2% for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. Kimi K3.1 Pro and Claude Sonnet 5.5 reverse order between English and Chinese. A four-model study on 16 paired families compares closed-book answers with governing evidence, added cross-jurisdiction distractors and removal of a governing passage. Governing evidence corrects legal errors and shortens reasoning on recovered answers, yet recognizing an evidence gap does not ensure correct application of the rules that remain. These findings motivate multilingual training for accurate, efficient and evidence-supported answers, and deployment evaluation in the user's working language.

translation.title: GlobalHRBench：改变问题语言会改变法律答案吗？
translation.abstract: 在跨国部署 LLM 智能体时，语言至关重要，尤其是在法律领域，因为所适用的规则必须在各工作语言下保持一致。改变法律问题的语言是否会改变答案的准确性？我们提出 GlobalHRBench，包含覆盖八个司法辖区、八种语言的 240 道雇佣法问题，同时固定事实、适用法律和所需结论。我们在独立、闭卷、单答案的试验中评估了九个模型在全部 1,920 个提示上的表现，评分维度包括法律正确性、完整性和答案语言合规性。GPT-6.1 Sol 以 76.2% 的严格通过率领先，其最好与最差语言之间的相对下降为 5.8%，而 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 仅为 42.2%。Kimi K3.1 Pro 和 Claude Sonnet 5.5 在英语与中文之间的排名发生逆转。一项针对 16 组配对问题的四模型研究比较了闭卷答案与提供管辖证据、加入跨司法辖区干扰项以及移除一段管辖条文后的表现。管辖证据能够纠正法律错误并缩短已纠正答案的推理长度，但识别出证据缺口并不能确保正确适用剩余的规则。这些发现促使人们开展多语言训练以获得准确、高效且有证据支持的答案，并在用户的工作语言下进行部署评估。
translation.brief: 该论文研究改变法律问题的语言是否影响 LLM 答案准确性，构建了覆盖八个司法辖区和八种语言的雇佣法基准 GlobalHRBench 进行系统评估。

papers.title: Landscape and Taxonomy of Prompt Engineering Patterns in Software Engineering
papers.abstract: Advancements in large language models (LLMs) have enhanced their ability to handle ambiguous user instructions. However, effective prompt patterns remain crucial for usability and comprehension. This article presents a taxonomy of prompt engineering patterns for software engineering. It is based on a systematic literature review that was conducted in early 2023, when LLMs still faced significant limitations in context length and inference capabilities. Our study explores techniques that enhance the usability and reliability of LLMs, emphasizing the ongoing importance of well-designed prompts in optimizing task performance. Our findings highlight the critical role of prompt patterns in maximizing LLM's potential, even as their capabilities continue to evolve.

translation.title: 软件工程中提示工程模式的图景与分类体系
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的进步增强了其处理模糊用户指令的能力。然而，有效的提示模式对于可用性和可理解性仍然至关重要。本文提出了一个面向软件工程的提示工程模式分类体系。该体系基于 2023 年初进行的一项系统性文献综述，当时 LLM 在上下文长度和推理能力方面仍存在显著局限。我们的研究探索了提升 LLM 可用性和可靠性的技术，强调精心设计的提示在优化任务性能方面持续存在的重要性。我们的发现凸显了提示模式在最大化 LLM 潜力方面的关键作用，即使其能力仍在不断演进。
translation.brief: 该论文通过系统性文献综述为软件工程领域的提示工程模式建立分类体系，以提升 LLM 的可用性与可靠性。

papers.title: Semantic repeatability and reproducibility of GPT-5 and Gemini 3 Flash on H5N1 One Health questions
papers.abstract: Highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) has re-emerged as a One Health concern since 2024, and the public is increasingly consulting large-language-model (LLM) chatbots for health information during outbreaks. Before a chatbot's accuracy can be meaningfully assessed, its consistency must first be understood, so that any single response can be trusted as a fair representative of the model's behavior. We characterized the semantic repeatability and reproducibility of GPT-5 (OpenAI) and Gemini 3 Flash (Google) on 15 H5N1 One Health questions sourced from social media discourse by adopting and extending a centroid-based evaluation framework. Each question was submitted 30 times and reformulated using five Chain-of-Thought (CoT) variants with 30 runs each, yielding 5,400 responses. Pairwise cosine similarity was computed on MPNet embeddings, with sensitivity analyses across three additional transformers. Statistical inference combined standard nonparametric tests (paired Wilcoxon and Friedman with Holm--Bonferroni correction) with inter-embedding agreement statistics (ICC(2,k) and Cronbach's $\alpha$) introduced here as a methodological addition. Both models produced high mean consistency (0.93--0.97, rescaled to {[}0, 1{]}). GPT-5 showed reproducibility significantly higher than repeatability (W = 3.0, p = 0.0003), whereas for Gemini 3 Flash the two metrics were statistically indistinguishable (W = 42.0, p = 0.33). Differential Diagnosis ranked among the top two CoT framings for consistency in both models. The tested chatbots behave as semantically stable sources on H5N1 One Health questions, and the developed consistency evaluation framework is portable to other domains.

translation.title: GPT-5 与 Gemini 3 Flash 在 H5N1 One Health 问题上的语义可重复性与可再现性
translation.abstract: 高致病性禽流感 A(H5N1) 自 2024 年以来重新成为 One Health（全健康）议题，公众在疫情期间越来越多地向大语言模型（LLM）聊天机器人咨询健康信息。在能够有意义地评估聊天机器人的准确性之前，必须首先理解其一致性，以便任何单次回答都能被信任为模型行为的公平代表。我们采用并扩展了一种基于质心的评估框架，刻画了 GPT-5（OpenAI）和 Gemini 3 Flash（Google）在源自社交媒体讨论的 15 个 H5N1 One Health 问题上的语义可重复性与可再现性。每个问题被提交 30 次，并使用五种思维链（CoT）变体各运行 30 次，共产生 5,400 条回答。我们在 MPNet 嵌入上计算两两余弦相似度，并在另外三个 transformer 上进行敏感性分析。统计推断结合了标准非参数检验（配对 Wilcoxon 和经 Holm--Bonferroni 校正的 Friedman 检验）以及本文引入的嵌入间一致性统计量（ICC(2,k) 和 Cronbach's $\alpha$）作为方法学补充。两个模型均产生了较高的平均一致性（0.93--0.97，重新缩放至 {[}0, 1{]}）。GPT-5 的可再现性显著高于可重复性（W = 3.0，p = 0.0003），而 Gemini 3 Flash 的两项指标在统计上无法区分（W = 42.0，p = 0.33）。鉴别诊断在两个模型中均位列一致性最好的前两种 CoT 表述方式。所测试的聊天机器人在 H5N1 One Health 问题上表现为语义稳定的信息来源，且所开发的一致性评估框架可移植到其他领域。
translation.brief: 该论文评估 GPT-5 与 Gemini 3 Flash 在 H5N1 One Health 问题上的语义一致性，采用基于质心的嵌入相似度框架结合非参数检验进行量化分析。

papers.title: Towards Agentic Video Corpus Moment Retrieval
papers.abstract: Video corpus moment retrieval (VCMR) requires finding the video and time interval that match a text query in a corpus of videos. We present RELAY, a training-free framework for VCMR that shares memory across queries. RELAY processes a batch of queries in three stages: search with a query bank, ranking with video notes, and localization with video prompt caching. In the search stage, an embedding model scores each video by its best-matching frame. The query bank penalizes videos that score highly for many other queries in the batch. In the ranking stage, a vision-language model (VLM) writes notes on each candidate video's scenes, people, objects, and actions once. Then, a large language model (LLM) reranks the candidates from these notes. In the localization stage, a VLM predicts the time interval of the moment in the top-ranked video. When multiple queries select the same video, prompt caching lets the VLM reuse its frames. On the three VERIFIED benchmarks, RELAY outperforms the trained baselines in video retrieval R@1 without training. Without any labeled moment, its predicted intervals are shorter than the annotated ones. In VCMR, it achieves similar performance to VideoSearch-R1 on one benchmark and trails it at IoU 0.5 on the other two. Human annotators also mark shorter moments than the original annotations of the benchmarks. A single margin, calibrated on a few labeled queries, widens the predicted interval to the annotation convention of the benchmarks. With it, RELAY outperforms the trained baselines in VCMR at IoU 0.5.

translation.title: 迈向智能体式视频语料库时刻检索
translation.abstract: 视频语料库时刻检索（VCMR）需要在视频语料库中找到与文本查询匹配的视频及时间段。我们提出 RELAY，一个免训练且在多个查询间共享记忆的 VCMR 框架。RELAY 分三个阶段处理一批查询：使用查询库进行搜索、利用视频笔记进行排序、以及借助视频提示缓存进行定位。在搜索阶段，嵌入模型根据每个视频的最佳匹配帧为其打分；查询库会对在该批次中为许多其他查询都得高分的视频进行惩罚。在排序阶段，视觉语言模型（VLM）对每个候选视频的场景、人物、物体和动作一次性生成笔记，然后由大语言模型（LLM）根据这些笔记对候选视频重排序。在定位阶段，VLM 预测排名最高视频中该时刻的时间区间。当多个查询选中同一视频时，提示缓存使 VLM 可以复用其帧。在三个 VERIFIED 基准上，RELAY 无需训练即在视频检索 R@1 上超越经过训练的基线。在没有任何标注时刻的情况下，其预测区间比标注区间更短。在 VCMR 上，它在一个基准上达到与 VideoSearch-R1 相近的性能，在另外两个基准的 IoU 0.5 下略逊于后者。人工标注者标注的时刻也比基准的原始标注更短。通过在少量标注查询上校准的一个边距，可将预测区间扩展至基准的标注惯例。加入该机制后，RELAY 在 IoU 0.5 的 VCMR 上超越了经过训练的基线。
translation.brief: 该论文提出免训练框架 RELAY，通过查询库搜索、VLM 笔记排序和提示缓存定位三阶段，并跨查询共享记忆，解决视频语料库时刻检索问题。

papers.title: Synapse: An HBM-Coordinated HBF Near-Memory Computing Architecture for Pipelined Agentic AI Execution
papers.abstract: During multi-agent video reasoning, model weights and per-agent key-value caches can exceed high-bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity. High-bandwidth flash (HBF) adds capacity, but agents still wait for GPU execution. Synapse, an HBM-coordinated near-memory computing architecture, overlaps HBF attention and expert execution with GPU computation across agents. It also reduces dispatch delays and unnecessary refreshes. Across three models, Synapse achieves 48.92-66.60% lower end-to-end latency, up to $2.98\times$ throughput, and up to 64.48% lower modeled energy per output token than GPU execution with passive HBF. Wear simulations project 46% longer HBF lifetime than block-wide refresh at equal workload rates.

translation.title: Synapse：面向流水线式智能体 AI 执行的 HBM 协调 HBF 近存计算架构
translation.abstract: 在多智能体视频推理过程中，模型权重和各智能体的键值缓存可能超出高带宽内存（HBM）的容量。高带宽闪存（HBF）增加了容量，但智能体仍需等待 GPU 执行。Synapse 是一种由 HBM 协调的近存计算架构，它使 HBF 上的注意力与专家执行能够跨智能体与 GPU 计算重叠进行。它还减少了调度延迟和不必要的刷新。在三个模型上，与使用被动 HBF 的 GPU 执行相比，Synapse 将端到端延迟降低 48.92--66.60%，吞吐量最高提升 $2.98\times$，每输出 token 的建模能耗最高降低 64.48%。磨损仿真预测，在相同工作负载速率下，HBF 的寿命比块级刷新延长 46%。
translation.brief: 该论文提出 HBM 协调的近存计算架构 Synapse，通过将 HBF 上的注意力与专家执行和 GPU 计算跨智能体重叠，解决多智能体视频推理中内存容量与执行等待问题。

papers.title: Does the Agent's Map Match the Territory? Architectural Claims in AI Agent Context Files and Their Fit with the Code
papers.abstract: AI coding agents start every session without memory of how a system is built. Developers fill this gap with context files, such as this http URL and this http URL. Agents treat these files as true, so it matters whether they match the code. We study two kinds of architectural claims that can be checked against a repository: path claims, which name folders and files, and dependency rules, which say what may import what. We check 41,090 path claims and 184 dependency rules from 3,602 context files in 3,346 open-source projects against the code and its history. About 5% of path claims point to paths we cannot find, but we estimate that only 2.2% are real errors, similar to READMEs (3.5%). When code moves, 61% of claims that became stale are fixed, most in the same commit. Dependency rules behave differently: 33 of 184 (18%) were confirmed broken on the day they were written, usually by older code, and nearly all stayed broken. Context files are good maps but less reliable rulebooks: their rules often describe the architecture a team wants, not the one it has. In an exploratory comparison of 7,480 commits, new rule breaks were rare. Agent-assisted commits broke rules about 1.8 times as often as other commits (0.29% vs. 0.16%), but with only 14 breaks this is not significant: an early signal, not evidence of a difference or of its absence. We used an LLM with human review at each step, and discuss what this offers and risks for mining studies.

translation.title: Agent 的地图与实际领域相符吗？AI Agent 上下文文件中的架构声明及其与代码的契合度
translation.abstract: AI 编码 Agent 每次会话开始时都不了解系统的构建方式。开发者用上下文文件（如 this http URL 和 this http URL）来填补这一空白。Agent 将这些文件视为真实，因此它们是否与代码相符至关重要。我们研究了两种可以对照代码仓库验证的架构声明：路径声明（指明文件夹和文件）和依赖规则（规定什么可以导入什么）。我们将 3,346 个开源项目中 3,602 个上下文文件的 41,090 条路径声明和 184 条依赖规则与代码及其历史进行了核对。约 5% 的路径声明指向我们无法找到的路径，但我们估计只有 2.2% 是真正的错误，与 README（3.5%）相近。当代码移动时，61% 变得过时的声明会被修复，大多在同一个提交中。依赖规则的表现则不同：184 条中有 33 条（18%）在编写当天就被确认失效，通常是由更早的代码导致，且几乎全部一直保持失效状态。上下文文件是好的地图，但作为规则手册则不太可靠：其规则往往描述的是团队想要的架构，而非实际拥有的架构。在对 7,480 个提交的探索性比较中，新的规则破坏很少见。Agent 辅助的提交破坏规则的频率约为其他提交的 1.8 倍（0.29% 对 0.16%），但由于只有 14 次破坏，这并不显著：这是一个早期信号，而非存在差异或不存在差异的证据。我们在每一步都使用 LLM 并辅以人工审查，并讨论了这对挖掘研究带来的价值与风险。
translation.brief: 研究上下文文件中的架构声明是否与代码相符，通过将大量路径声明和依赖规则与代码仓库及其历史进行核对来验证其准确性。

papers.title: LODESTONE: Linking System Events to Threat Intelligence for Evidence-Grounded Cyber Attack Investigation
papers.abstract: System provenance graphs help reconstruct attacks through causal dependencies, but these connections alone do not explain how events accomplish an adversary's goal. Cyber threat intelligence (CTI) provides the necessary security knowledge, yet linking it to execution evidence requires bridging differences in meaning and granularity between events and attack relations amid scarce labels and sparse relevant evidence. We present LODESTONE, a cross-graph alignment system that links observed system events to CTI attack relations to support evidence-grounded attack reports. LODESTONE uses a novel CTI-driven training-data engine and an expert-verified benchmark of edge-level correspondences and reference attack reports. The engine pairs real CTI knowledge graphs with provenance graphs from isolated executions. A large language model (LLM) agent recursively improves correspondences by checking execution evidence and repairing retrieval, parsing, and reproduction failures; experts independently verify benchmark correspondences. LODESTONE combines text cross-encoder and directed-graph relevance scores to extract compact alert-centered subgraphs, retrieves article-level knowledge graphs through node- and edge-level dual-softmax assignment, and uses a fine-tuned 4B-parameter LLM to align event combinations with CTI attack steps. We evaluate LODESTONE on 27 expert-verified attack cases amid continuous benign activity from real applications, using 713 CTI articles. LLM judgments aligned with multiple human experts yield an attack-step description score of 82%, and attack identification reaches 91%, versus 73% and 32% using the same generator with provenance alone. Baseline pipelines and coding agents achieve description scores of at most 57%. Human-verified correspondences further demonstrate advantages in balancing attack-edge coverage with subgraph size, CTI retrieval, and cross-graph alignment.

translation.title: LODESTONE：将系统事件与威胁情报关联以实现有证据支撑的网络攻击调查
translation.abstract: 系统溯源图有助于通过因果依赖关系重建攻击，但这些关联本身并不能解释事件如何实现攻击者的目标。网络威胁情报（CTI）提供了必要的安全知识，但将其与执行证据关联起来，需要在标签稀缺、相关证据稀疏的情况下，弥合事件与攻击关系之间在含义和粒度上的差异。我们提出 LODESTONE，一个跨图对齐系统，将观测到的系统事件与 CTI 攻击关系关联起来，以支持有证据支撑的攻击报告。LODESTONE 使用一种新颖的 CTI 驱动训练数据引擎和一个由专家验证的基准，包含边级对应关系和参考攻击报告。该引擎将真实的 CTI 知识图与隔离执行得到的溯源图配对。一个大语言模型（LLM）Agent 通过检查执行证据并修复检索、解析和复现失败来递归改进对应关系；专家独立验证基准对应关系。LODESTONE 结合文本交叉编码器和有向图相关性分数来提取紧凑的以告警为中心的子图，通过节点级和边级双 softmax 分配检索文章级知识图，并使用微调后的 4B 参数 LLM 将事件组合与 CTI 攻击步骤对齐。我们在 27 个经专家验证的攻击案例上评估 LODESTONE，这些案例处于真实应用的持续良性活动之中，使用了 713 篇 CTI 文章。与多位人类专家一致的 LLM 判断得到 82% 的攻击步骤描述分数，攻击识别率达到 91%，而仅使用溯源的同一生成器分别为 73% 和 32%。基线流水线和编码 Agent 的描述分数最高仅为 57%。经人工验证的对应关系进一步证明了其在平衡攻击边覆盖与子图大小、CTI 检索以及跨图对齐方面的优势。
translation.brief: 解决系统事件与网络威胁情报难以关联的问题，提出跨图对齐系统 LODESTONE，通过 CTI 驱动的训练数据引擎和微调 LLM 将溯源图事件与 CTI 攻击步骤对齐。

papers.title: SAEPO: Sparse-Autoencoder-Guided Credit Assignment for Policy Optimization
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has demonstrated strong performance in improving large language model (LLM) reasoning, yet its credit-assignment signal remains coarse. Outcome verifiers provide scalable supervision by judging whether a completed response is correct, but they do not directly indicate which intermediate reasoning tokens contribute to success or failure. As a result, policy optimization can be inefficient, especially when training base models directly from sparse outcome feedback. In this paper, we introduce SAEPO, a Sparse AutoEncoder-guided token-level credit assignment method for outcome-supervised Policy Optimization. Rather than treating correctness only as a rollout-level (sequence-level) signal, SAEPO uses a pretrained sparse autoencoder (SAE) to build token-level semantic representations within reasoning trajectories; it scores each token based on the SAE concepts (e.g., penalizing wrong "final-answer" tokens but rewarding correct "reasoning-process" tokens), learned in an unsupervised manner, to achieve fine-grained credit assignment. SAEPO is a plug-in advantage-shaping module compatible with various policy optimization algorithms. We instantiate SAEPO with both GRPO and GSPO, covering token-ratio and sequence-ratio policy-gradient objectives, and evaluate SAEPO across three LLM backbones on six math and two code benchmarks. Empirical results show that SAEPO improves both the math and code benchmark averages over the matched baselines, with gains of up to 6.63% and 5.57%, respectively. On Qwen3-1.7B-Base, training curves also show faster early accuracy growth. Feature and token-level analyses suggest that the SAE-derived signal favors question-relevant concepts and reasoning tokens.

translation.title: SAEPO：稀疏自编码器引导的策略优化信用分配
translation.abstract: 可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在提升大语言模型（LLM）推理能力方面表现出色，但其信用分配信号仍然粗糙。结果验证器通过判断完整回答是否正确来提供可扩展的监督，但并不直接指出哪些中间推理 token 对成功或失败有贡献。因此，策略优化可能效率低下，尤其是在直接从稀疏的结果反馈训练基础模型时。本文提出 SAEPO，一种用于结果监督策略优化的稀疏自编码器引导的 token 级信用分配方法。SAEPO 不再将正确性仅视为 rollout 级（序列级）信号，而是使用预训练的稀疏自编码器（SAE）在推理轨迹内构建 token 级语义表示；它基于以无监督方式学习的 SAE 概念对每个 token 打分（例如惩罚错误的"最终答案"token，奖励正确的"推理过程"token），从而实现细粒度的信用分配。SAEPO 是一个即插即用的优势整形模块，兼容多种策略优化算法。我们用 GRPO 和 GSPO 实例化 SAEPO，涵盖 token 比率和序列比率的策略梯度目标，并在三个 LLM 骨干模型上于六个数学基准和两个代码基准上评估 SAEPO。实验结果表明，SAEPO 在数学和代码基准平均值上均优于匹配的基线，提升分别高达 6.63% 和 5.57%。在 Qwen3-1.7B-Base 上，训练曲线还显示出更快的早期准确率增长。特征和 token 级分析表明，SAE 导出的信号偏向与问题相关的概念和推理 token。
translation.brief: 解决结果监督强化学习中信用分配信号粗糙的问题，提出用稀疏自编码器构建 token 级语义表示并对每个 token 打分以实现细粒度信用分配。

papers.title: LLM-Assisted Software Migration: from Module-Level Transformation to Repository-Level Integration
papers.abstract: Software migration adapts an existing implementation to a new language, version, API, framework, or platform while preserving its behavior. Large language models (LLMs) succeed on individual functions and modules, but this success does not readily carry over to entire repositories, particularly deployable applications. This survey reviews LLM-assisted migration from module-level transformation to repository-level integration, culminating in the delivery of complete applications. We analyze 96 sources---including 46 direct migration papers---across four perspectives: (1) supported software engineering activities, (2) model roles as editors or orchestrators, (3) orchestration workflows (agentless, single-agent, or multi-agent), and (4) enabling techniques including knowledge engineering, project context, environment feedback, and model adaptation. We then compare evaluation practices and benchmarks. Although 30 of the 46 studies target repositories, most acceptance evidence relies merely on build success, supplied tests, or static and model-based proxies. Moreover, compilation, visual similarity, test outcomes, and runtime behavior capture fundamentally distinct properties and cannot be conflated into a single success rate. We also identify critical gaps in requirements engineering support and in controlled comparisons of agent architectures. Finally, we discuss six open problems: application integration, platform differences, non-functional properties, generalization, attribution of gains, as well as cost and maintenance.

translation.title: LLM 辅助的软件迁移：从模块级转换到仓库级集成
translation.abstract: 软件迁移是在保持行为不变的前提下，将现有实现适配到新的语言、版本、API、框架或平台。大语言模型（LLM）在单个函数和模块上取得了成功，但这种成功并不容易延伸到整个代码仓库，尤其是可部署的应用。本综述从模块级转换到仓库级集成，直至完整应用的交付，回顾了 LLM 辅助的软件迁移。我们从四个视角分析了 96 个来源（包括 46 篇直接的迁移论文）：(1) 支持的软件工程活动，(2) 模型作为编辑器或编排者的角色，(3) 编排工作流（无 Agent、单 Agent 或多 Agent），(4) 使能技术，包括知识工程、项目上下文、环境反馈和模型适配。随后我们比较了评估实践和基准。尽管 46 项研究中有 30 项以仓库为目标，但大多数验收证据仅依赖构建成功、提供的测试或静态及基于模型的代理指标。此外，编译、视觉相似性、测试结果和运行时行为捕捉的是本质上不同的属性，不能混为一谈为单一的成功率。我们还识别出在需求工程支持以及 Agent 架构的受控比较方面的关键空白。最后，我们讨论了六个开放问题：应用集成、平台差异、非功能属性、泛化、收益归因以及成本与维护。
translation.brief: 综述 LLM 辅助软件迁移从模块级转换到仓库级集成的研究现状，通过分析 96 个来源从四个视角进行分类并指出评估实践与开放问题。

papers.title: Tracing Attacker Diversity Reduction in Adaptive LLM Red Teaming
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning can increase the success of automated red teaming but it also narrows the attack vector. This study asks where in the attacker-defender-judge learning loop does the narrowing begin and which mechanisms lead to a narrowing attack. Six mechanisms (defender adaptation, success edge, reward reinforcement, row cap, update size, and measurement) are tested across three experiment arms (co-trained, frozen defender, half learning rate) for twenty-four iterations. A frozen defender narrows attack diversity retention (ADR) earlier 0.496 relative to co-trained 0.891 at iteration twelve. Defender updates delay narrowing but dont prevent it. Successful attacks ("winners") have narrower attack diversity than the full set of generated attacks. Attacks closest to previous winners succeed 10-15 percentage points more often than those closest to previous failures. This winner-neighbor advantage holds after a defender update and for a fixed defender too. Attacks with a common opening have a common-opening advantage of 5-16 percentage points. The training row cap and update size account for little impact on ADR, and attack length accounts for only part of the ADR decrease. Narrowing appears to originate from the success only reward through the group-relative training advantage to the attacker update, with a persistent success edge setting the direction.

translation.title: 追踪自适应 LLM 红队测试中攻击者多样性的缩减
translation.abstract: 强化学习可以提高自动化红队测试的成功率，但也会使攻击向量变窄。本研究探讨在攻击者-防御者-裁判学习循环中，这种收窄从何处开始，以及哪些机制导致了攻击的收窄。我们在三个实验组（共同训练、冻结防御者、半学习率）中，对六种机制（防御者适应、成功优势、奖励强化、行数上限、更新大小和度量方式）进行了二十四轮迭代的测试。冻结的防御者使攻击多样性保留率（ADR）更早下降，第十二轮时为 0.496，而共同训练为 0.891。防御者的更新会延迟收窄但不能阻止它。成功的攻击（"赢家"）比生成的全部攻击具有更窄的攻击多样性。与以往赢家最接近的攻击比与以往失败最接近的攻击的成功率高 10-15 个百分点。这种赢家邻域优势在防御者更新后以及固定防御者的情况下均成立。具有相同开头的攻击存在 5-16 个百分点的共同开头优势。训练行数上限和更新大小对 ADR 影响很小，攻击长度也只能解释 ADR 下降的一部分。收窄似乎源于仅以成功为奖励，通过组相对训练优势传导到攻击者更新，而持续存在的成功优势决定了方向。
translation.brief: 研究自适应 LLM 红队测试中攻击多样性为何收窄，通过在多种实验设置下测试六种候选机制来定位收窄的来源。

papers.title: CARE-3D: Reinforcement Learning for Evidence Grounded Agentic Reasoning in Situated 3D Scenes
papers.abstract: Situated 3D reasoning requires embodied agents to interpret objects, scene geometry, and viewpoint dependent spatial relations. Existing methods learn grounded interactions from supervised traces, but largely imitate prescribed evidence acquisition patterns rather than optimizing the support that the returned evidence provides for the correct answer. Moreover, outcome rewards provide limited credit for intermediate tool choices and may leave infrequent tools underexplored. An effective agent should instead adaptively decide what to ground, which tool to invoke, and how to assess the utility of returned evidence. To this end, this paper presents CARE-3D, a reinforcement post-training framework for adaptive grounded reasoning. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on grounding instructions first establishes valid interactions, after which Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) optimizes the agent while keeping the 3D grounding module frozen. CARE-3D combines Counterfactual Attribution of Returned Evidence for evidence sensitive credit assignment, and Group Coverage Sampling to preserve tool coverage. Experiments on MSQA and Beacon3D show consistent gains over SFT and GRPO using only answer and format rewards, especially in spatial reasoning and grounding answer coherence. Our code is available at \href{this https URL}{CARE-3D}.

translation.title: CARE-3D：面向情境化3D场景中证据支撑的智能体推理的强化学习
translation.abstract: 情境化3D推理要求具身智能体理解物体、场景几何以及依赖视角的空间关系。现有方法从监督轨迹中学习接地交互，但主要模仿预设的证据获取模式，而非优化所返回证据对正确答案的支持程度。此外，结果奖励对中间工具选择提供的信用有限，可能导致不常用的工具探索不足。有效的智能体应当自适应地决定对什么进行接地、调用哪个工具以及如何评估返回证据的效用。为此，本文提出CARE-3D，一个用于自适应接地推理的强化后训练框架。首先在接地指令上进行监督微调（SFT）以建立有效交互，随后使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）来优化智能体，同时保持3D接地模块冻结。CARE-3D结合了反事实归因（Counterfactual Attribution of Returned Evidence）以实现证据敏感的信用分配，以及组覆盖采样（Group Coverage Sampling）以保持工具覆盖。在MSQA和Beacon3D上的实验表明，仅使用答案和格式奖励即可在SFT和GRPO基础上取得一致提升，尤其在空间推理和接地答案连贯性方面。代码见\href{this https URL}{CARE-3D}。
translation.brief: 解决3D场景中智能体证据获取模式僵化、工具探索不足的问题，采用SFT加GRPO强化后训练，结合反事实归因信用分配与组覆盖采样实现自适应接地推理。

papers.title: When 1+1 $\neq$ 2: Benchmarking Civil-Time Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Calendar arithmetic is non-linear. When 1:59 AM + 1 minute occurs during daylight saving spring-forward, the result is 3:00 AM, not 2:00 AM, as the hour is skipped. We introduce CivilTime-Bench, a benchmark for civil-time reasoning covering daylight saving transitions, non-hour offsets, date-line crossings, and ISO week boundaries. With 60,011 training and 10,500 evaluation examples under strict output-contract evaluation, we benchmark seven LLMs (six instruction-tuned models and Llama-3.1-8B base) and find: zero-shot exact match varies substantially across models, contract-aware prompting often improves format compliance but yields inconsistent accuracy gains, few-shot in-context learning provides model-dependent improvements, and fine-tuning achieves 74.6--86.6% EM on synthetic evaluation but only 36.6--45.2% on HumanTime-500 for models with valid results on both splits, highlighting substantial limitations in generalization. We release the benchmark and code.

translation.title: 当1+1≠2：大语言模型的民用时间推理基准测试
translation.abstract: 日历运算是非线性的。当凌晨1:59加1分钟发生在夏令时春季前拨期间时，结果是3:00 AM而非2:00 AM，因为该小时被跳过。我们提出CivilTime-Bench，一个涵盖夏令时切换、非整小时偏移、日界线跨越和ISO周边界的民用时间推理基准。在严格输出契约评估下，我们使用60,011个训练样本和10,500个评估样本，对七个LLM（六个指令微调模型和Llama-3.1-8B基座模型）进行基准测试，发现：零样本精确匹配在不同模型间差异显著；契约感知提示通常能改善格式合规性但准确率提升不一致；少样本上下文学习提供依赖模型的改进；微调在合成评估上达到74.6–86.6%的EM，但在HumanTime-500上仅有36.6–45.2%（针对在两个划分上均有有效结果的模型），凸显了泛化能力的重大局限。我们发布了该基准和代码。
translation.brief: 解决LLM在夏令时等民用时间运算上泛化能力不足的问题，构建涵盖夏令时切换、日界线跨越等场景的CivilTime-Bench基准并系统评测多种提示与微调策略。

papers.title: Conartist: Adaptive Agentic Red-Teaming of Computer-Using Agents against Multi-Step Prompt Injection
papers.abstract: Harnesses secure Computer-Using Agents by enforcing security constraints and defending against prompt injection attacks. However, we find that two core security mechanisms of agent harnesses remain vulnerable. First, consistency checking prevents agents from deviating from legitimate user objectives, while attackers can bypass it by embedding malicious actions that appear logically consistent with legitimate task execution. Second, risk auditing proactively examines high-risk operations. Yet, the auditing process itself would introduce additional exploitable actions that violate security boundaries. To evaluate above defects we found, we propose Conartist, a cascaded adaptive prompt injection framework comprising two progressive stages. First, Conartist employs a goal-pollution strategy to establish deceptive causal dependencies between legitimate user objectives and malicious operations, progressively embedding attack steps into legitimate task workflows. However, these task-coupled attacks remain susceptible to risk auditing. To address this limitation, Conartist further analyzes security-auditing feedback from controlled attack exploration to identify exploitable auditing patterns. Conartist then adaptively refines its deception strategies to either avoid triggering risk auditing or induce additional high-risk operations. Extensive experiments across five backbone models demonstrate the effectiveness of Conartist, achieving attack success rates of 32.12% on 576-instance tool use benchmark and 66.67% in the Reddit GUI benchmark, outperforming the SOTA attack by 14.41 and 29.17, respectively. By analyzing one of the most popular Agent, Openclaw, we furthermore concluded seven realistic exploitable attack patterns, which reveals that security mechanisms designed to prevent malicious actions can themselves be manipulated to facilitate attacks.

translation.title: Conartist：针对多步提示注入的计算机使用智能体自适应智能体红队测试
translation.abstract: 智能体框架（Harness）通过强制安全约束和防御提示注入攻击来保障计算机使用智能体（Computer-Using Agents）的安全。然而，我们发现智能体框架的两个核心安全机制仍然存在漏洞。第一，一致性检查防止智能体偏离合法用户目标，而攻击者可以通过嵌入与合法任务执行在逻辑上看似一致的恶意动作来绕过它。第二，风险审计主动检查高风险操作，但审计过程本身会引入额外的可利用动作，从而违反安全边界。为评估上述缺陷，我们提出Conartist，一个由两个渐进阶段组成的级联自适应提示注入框架。首先，Conartist采用目标污染策略，在合法用户目标与恶意操作之间建立欺骗性因果依赖，将攻击步骤逐步嵌入合法任务工作流。然而，这些与任务耦合的攻击仍易受风险审计影响。为解决这一局限，Conartist进一步分析来自受控攻击探索的安全审计反馈，以识别可利用的审计模式。随后Conartist自适应地改进其欺骗策略，要么避免触发风险审计，要么诱导额外的高风险操作。在五个骨干模型上的大量实验证明了Conartist的有效性，在576实例的工具使用基准上达到32.12%的攻击成功率，在Reddit GUI基准上达到66.67%，分别超过SOTA攻击14.41和29.17。通过分析最流行的智能体之一Openclaw，我们进一步总结出七种现实可利用的攻击模式，这表明旨在防止恶意行为的安全机制本身也可能被操纵以促成攻击。
translation.brief: 解决计算机使用智能体的一致性检查与风险审计机制可被绕过的问题，提出级联自适应提示注入框架Conartist，通过目标污染和审计反馈分析实现多步攻击。

papers.title: SHAKTI: Evidence-Grounded Conversational AI for Nutrition and Health
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) answer many diet and health questions but can state unsupported claims and cite sources that do not support them. We present SHAKTI (Smart Health Advisor for Knowledge-based Tailored Interventions), a conversational assistant that answers only from retrieved scholarly papers and exact food-composition data, and evaluate it with retrieval, generation, grounding, efficiency and contextawareness metrics. We indexed 484,368,086 OpenAlex works, searched exactly on a GPU for evaluation (10,065 NFCorpus, BioASQ, SciFact and PubMedQA questions) and through a compressed 230-million-abstract index in deployment. On 1,000 stratified questions, we compared single-shot, multi-hop, corrective and deep-research retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with Claude Sonnet. SHAKTI adds conversational query rewriting, USDA FoodData Central lookups, source-link checks and online verification of quotes and numbers. It was tested in 36 scripted conversational turns, a 248-question memory-depth test and a 38-question load test. Claims were checked by a Claude Opus judge against exactly the text the system saw. MedCPT reranking of hybrid retrieval gave the best MRR (0.21) and MAP@100 (0.14). Across existing RAG methods, faithfulness was 0.95-0.96, claim hallucination 0.5-0.8% and context precision up to 0.98; the deep-research agent answered 73.2% of BioASQ questions correctly. In conversation, SHAKTI reached a context-awareness score of 97.1%, faithfulness 95.5%, 1.9% unsupported claims, no contradicted claims and 229/229 working source links; it resolved references to the first question after 16 unrelated questions. An answer cost 14,716 tokens (US$0.06) with a median latency of 24 s. Large-scale retrieval with agentic evidence selection and mechanical verification yields auditable, low-hallucination nutrition answers.

translation.title: SHAKTI：面向营养与健康的证据支撑对话式AI
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以回答许多饮食和健康问题，但可能做出无依据的断言并引用不支持其说法的来源。我们提出SHAKTI（Smart Health Advisor for Knowledge-based Tailored Interventions），一个仅基于检索到的学术论文和精确的食物成分数据来回答问题的对话助手，并用检索、生成、接地、效率和上下文感知指标对其进行评估。我们索引了484,368,086篇OpenAlex文献，在GPU上进行精确检索用于评估（10,065个NFCorpus、BioASQ、SciFact和PubMedQA问题），部署时则通过压缩的2.3亿摘要索引进行检索。在1,000个分层抽样问题上，我们将单次、多跳、纠错和深度研究检索增强生成（RAG）与Claude Sonnet进行了比较。SHAKTI增加了对话式查询改写、USDA FoodData Central查询、来源链接检查以及引文和数字的在线验证。它在36轮脚本化对话、248题记忆深度测试和38题负载测试中进行了测试。断言由Claude Opus裁判对照系统所见的确切文本进行检查。混合检索的MedCPT重排序取得了最佳MRR（0.21）和MAP@100（0.14）。在现有RAG方法中，忠实度为0.95–0.96，断言幻觉率为0.5–0.8%，上下文精确度最高达0.98；深度研究智能体正确回答了73.2%的BioASQ问题。在对话中，SHAKTI达到97.1%的上下文感知得分、95.5%的忠实度、1.9%的无依据断言、无矛盾断言以及229/229条可用的来源链接；它在16个无关问题之后仍能解析对第一个问题的指代。单次回答成本为14,716个token（0.06美元），中位延迟为24秒。大规模检索结合智能体证据选择和机械化验证，可以产生可审计、低幻觉的营养答案。
translation.brief: 解决LLM在营养健康问答中产生无依据断言的问题，构建仅基于学术文献与食物成分数据检索、并带机械化引文验证的对话系统SHAKTI。

papers.title: Categorical Foundations of AI Agents
papers.abstract: We follow the idea of separating intelligence from execution and give the categorical foundations of AI agents: the transformers, the agents, and the orchestrations and choreographies of AI agents are categorized, and which also include their coalgebras and algebras.

translation.title: AI智能体的范畴论基础
translation.abstract: 我们遵循将智能与执行分离的思想，给出AI智能体的范畴论基础：对transformer、智能体以及AI智能体的编排（orchestration）与编舞（choreography）进行范畴化，其中还包括它们的余代数与代数。
translation.brief: 解决AI智能体缺乏形式化理论基础的问题，采用范畴论方法对transformer、智能体及其编排与编舞进行范畴化建模。

papers.title: Antiphony: A Dual-Process Agent for Deepfake Video Detection with Real-Video Calibration
papers.abstract: Reliable video deepfake detection requires generalization to unseen generators while limiting false alarms on authentic footage. Although existing detectors capture diverse visual cues, they may produce overconfident errors under generator shift, limiting the reliability of confidence-based fusion. Threshold calibration is further complicated by shifts in authentic capture domains and the lack of future-generator examples. To address these challenges, we present Antiphony, a framework that combines calibrated fusion of four visual experts with selective investigation. Authentic videos serve as a shared reference for score fusion and threshold calibration, enabling threshold updates without target deepfakes. For this expert-fusion stage, we establish finite-sample false-alarm control when the scoring procedure is fixed independently of calibration and authentic samples are exchangeable. To refine decisions near the calibrated threshold, a tool-using multimodal investigator examines these videos and contributes an additional fusion score. We train the investigator on generator-held-out predictions and counterfactual expert outputs, to improve robustness to unreliable expert evidence. Across six benchmark protocols, Antiphony achieves a mean benchmark score of 88.3%, exceeding the strongest evaluated MLLM and conventional detector baselines by 14.7 and 11.5 points, respectively. It also outperforms ARGUS by 20.2 points on average and by 3.6 balanced-accuracy points on FaceVid's 20 unseen generators.

translation.title: Antiphony：一种带真实视频校准的双过程深度伪造视频检测智能体
translation.abstract: 可靠的视频深度伪造检测需要在泛化到未见生成器的同时，限制对真实视频的误报。尽管现有检测器能捕捉多样的视觉线索，但在生成器分布偏移下可能产生过度自信的错误，限制了基于置信度融合的可靠性；而真实采集域的偏移以及缺乏未来生成器样本，使阈值校准更加困难。为应对这些挑战，我们提出Antiphony框架，将四个视觉专家的校准融合与选择性调查相结合。真实视频作为分数融合和阈值校准的共享参考，使得无需目标深度伪造样本即可更新阈值。对于该专家融合阶段，当评分过程独立于校准固定且真实样本可交换时，我们建立了有限样本误报控制。为在接近校准阈值处细化决策，一个会使用工具的多模态调查智能体检查这些视频并贡献额外的融合分数。我们在生成器留出的预测和反事实专家输出上训练该调查智能体，以提升对不可靠专家证据的鲁棒性。在六个基准协议上，Antiphony取得88.3%的平均基准分数，分别超过最强的MLLM和传统检测器基线14.7和11.5分。它还平均超过ARGUS 20.2分，并在FaceVid的20个未见生成器上超出3.6个平衡准确率点。
translation.brief: 解决深度伪造检测在未见生成器下误报高、阈值难校准的问题，核心方法是结合真实视频校准的多专家分数融合与工具增强的多模态调查智能体的双过程框架。

papers.title: A Deterministic Polynomial-Query Protocol for Envy-Free Cake Cutting
papers.abstract: We give a deterministic protocol that divides a heterogeneous cake completely and without envy among $n$ agents using $O(n^6\log n)$ Robertson--Webb queries in the worst case. Valuations may be arbitrary nonnegative, nonatomic measures, and bundles may be disconnected. The protocol makes $O(n)$ calls to certified trimming, which uses $O(n^5\log n)$ queries on $n$ pieces. In a certified trim, each agent receives the end part, or suffix, of a different piece without envy, and every shortened piece has a witness tie leading back to a whole piece. At each step, the witness values the shortened suffix exactly as much as her own. For pieces of positive interval length with strictly increasing suffix values, the retained suffix lengths are unique, although their holders may differ. Candidate assignments share a table of value and cut queries. If the coordinatewise median of their value estimates fails a matching test, the test identifies an agent whose value is underestimated, ruling out at least half the remaining assignments. A weighted median of cut marks lets one repair step remove a small envy while allocating almost all of the residue. For complete envy-free chore allocation, the query bound is $O(n^7\log n)$.

translation.title: 一种用于无嫉妒蛋糕切分的确定性多项式查询协议
translation.abstract: 我们给出一个确定性协议，在最坏情况下使用$O(n^6\log n)$次Robertson--Webb查询，将一块异质蛋糕在$n$个智能体之间完全且无嫉妒地切分。估值可以是任意非负、非原子的测度，且份额可以不连通。该协议调用$O(n)$次认证修剪，后者在$n$块上使用$O(n^5\log n)$次查询。在认证修剪中，每个智能体无嫉妒地获得不同一块的末端部分（后缀），且每块被缩短的蛋糕都有一个可追溯回完整蛋糕的见证平局。在每一步，见证者对自己获得的后缀的估值恰好等于她自己那块。对于具有严格递增后缀值的正区间长度蛋糕块，保留的后缀长度是唯一的，尽管其持有者可能不同。候选分配共享一个价值和切分查询表。如果其价值估计的逐坐标中位数未通过匹配测试，该测试会识别出一个价值被低估的智能体，从而排除至少一半剩余的分配。切分标记的加权中位数使得一次修复步骤即可消除少量嫉妒，同时分配几乎全部剩余部分。对于完全无嫉妒的家务分配，查询上界为$O(n^7\log n)$。
translation.brief: 解决$n$个智能体间完全无嫉妒蛋糕切分问题，核心方法是确定性协议，通过认证修剪和基于中位数的候选排除，实现$O(n^6\log n)$查询复杂度。

papers.title: EnvTrap: Revealing the Environment-Only Attack Surface in Embodied AI via Consequence-Blind Action Execution
papers.abstract: As AI models evolve from text and vision to physical agents, embodied AI faces a fundamentally different attack surface. Prior attacks on embodied systems have used crafted instructions, adversarial visual inputs, and training-time policy modifications; we study environment-only object rearrangements with unchanged models and instructions. We reveal an attack surface in safety-critical spatial relations among existing objects. An adversary who rearranges objects, without modifying instructions or accessing models, can cause hazardous consequences. In this work, we propose EnvTrap, a diagnostic pipeline that constructs paired safe, trap, and null-trap (benign but misleading) embodied scenarios. We demonstrate that environment-only perturbations raise hazardous-action rates to an average of 83.4% across the five evaluated action policies, with similar vulnerability patterns confirmed in world models. On a consequence-prediction task, model accuracy remains near chance, while human evaluators achieve high accuracy. We further propose a consequence-aware defense that reduces trap trigger rates by an average of 76.3 percentage points across action policies in simulation and by 62.9 percentage points pooled across physical backends. Together, these findings link environment-only attacks to a broader deficit in physical reasoning: embodied models recognize task-relevant objects yet fail to anticipate how spatial relations change the consequences of acting on them. EnvTrap makes this gap directly testable and turns hazardous layouts into training scenarios for safer embodied action. Our code and data are available at this https URL.

translation.title: EnvTrap：通过后果盲目的动作执行揭示具身AI中仅环境层面的攻击面
translation.abstract: 随着AI模型从文本和视觉演进到物理智能体，具身AI面临根本不同的攻击面。先前针对具身系统的攻击使用了精心构造的指令、对抗性视觉输入和训练时策略修改；我们研究的是在模型和指令不变的情况下，仅通过环境中的物体重排发起的攻击。我们揭示了现有物体之间安全关键空间关系中存在的攻击面。一个仅重排物体、不修改指令也不访问模型的对手，就能造成危险后果。在本工作中，我们提出EnvTrap，一个构建配对的安全、陷阱和无陷阱（良性但具误导性）具身场景的诊断流水线。我们证明仅环境的扰动使五个被评估动作策略的危险动作率平均升至83.4%，并在世界模型中确认了类似的脆弱性模式。在一个后果预测任务中，模型准确率接近随机水平，而人类评估者达到高准确率。我们进一步提出一种后果感知防御，在仿真中将各动作策略的陷阱触发率平均降低76.3个百分点，在物理后端汇总降低62.9个百分点。这些发现将仅环境攻击与物理推理的更广泛缺陷联系起来：具身模型能识别任务相关物体，却无法预见空间关系如何改变对其执行动作的后果。EnvTrap使这一差距可直接测试，并将危险布局转化为更安全具身动作的训练场景。我们的代码和数据可在该https URL获取。
translation.brief: 揭示具身AI在仅重排环境物体（不改模型和指令）下会执行危险动作的攻击面，核心方法是构建安全/陷阱配对场景的诊断流水线EnvTrap并提出后果感知防御。

papers.title: 3AGameFactory-Motion: Agentic Rigging and Reliable Complex Motion Generation for Diverse 3D Assets
papers.abstract: Animating arbitrary 3D assets from instructions requires both structural inference and motion control, yet existing motion benchmarks mostly cover conventional human or animal skeletons with simple instructions. We introduce DivDynBench, which evaluates rigging and motion generation across six morphology categories, with instructions requiring multi-phase part coordination and explicit timing, angle, repetition, and trajectory constraints. With large language models, we systematically compare three common paradigms: specialized motion generation, video generation followed by motion recovery, and direct agent-driven generation. We analyze their control capabilities, cross-morphology adaptability, and generation costs. Guided by this comparison, we propose an Agentic Motion Framework in which an agent writes compact parametric skeleton and motion programs, and a deterministic executor performs rigging, kinematic solving, and geometric correction. Compact parameter control reduces generation overhead and improves rigging reliability and motion-control accuracy, providing practical guidance for deploying complex 3D motion generation.

translation.title: 3AGameFactory-Motion：面向多样3D资产的智能体绑定与可靠复杂动作生成
translation.abstract: 根据指令为任意3D资产制作动画既需要结构推断也需要动作控制，然而现有动作基准大多只覆盖常规的人或动物骨架及简单指令。我们提出DivDynBench，跨六个形态类别评估绑定与动作生成，其指令要求多阶段部件协调以及明确的时间、角度、重复次数和轨迹约束。借助大语言模型，我们系统比较了三种常见范式：专用动作生成、先视频生成再动作恢复、以及直接的智能体驱动生成，并分析它们的控制能力、跨形态适应性和生成成本。基于该比较，我们提出一个智能体动作框架，其中智能体编写紧凑的参数化骨架和动作程序，由确定性执行器完成绑定、运动学求解和几何校正。紧凑的参数控制降低了生成开销，提升了绑定可靠性和动作控制精度，为部署复杂3D动作生成提供了实用指导。
translation.brief: 解决任意3D资产从指令生成复杂动画的问题，核心方法是智能体编写紧凑参数化骨架与动作程序、由确定性执行器完成绑定与运动学求解的框架，并配套DivDynBench基准。

papers.title: OWE-Bench: A long-horizon benchmark for measuring real-world engineering
papers.abstract: We present OWE-Bench (OpenWorldEngineer-Bench), a benchmark of 26 long-horizon engineering tasks written by domain experts in software engineering, physical engineering, machine learning, and scientific computing. Tasks range from optimizing kernels and designing an aircraft, to identifying the faults responsible for an earthquake. Each task requires significant domain knowledge and engineering work, with models averaging hundreds of millions of tokens per task. Solutions are scored on practical measures such as speed, cost and accuracy, both on provided cases the agent could test against and on hidden cases that an engineer would expect from the task description. The best-performing frontier model so far, Claude Fable 5.2, scores 54.6% and averages 211 million tokens per task. We highlight two findings. First, when models are given more time, they use more test-time compute and achieve higher scores. Models also scale differently with test-time compute: GPT-6 Astra achieves higher scores at shorter time limits and at equal token use, while Claude Fable 5.2 uses more tokens at longer limits to achieve the highest overall score. Second, each model scores lower on hidden cases than on the provided cases, by an average of 18 points, which we call the deployment gap. Models also fail to predict the deployment gap, overestimating their performance on hidden test cases by an average of 21 points. We hope that OWE-Bench grounds progress toward agents whose engineering solutions perform as well in deployment as they do in testing.

translation.title: OWE-Bench：一个衡量真实世界工程能力的长时程基准
translation.abstract: 我们提出OWE-Bench（OpenWorldEngineer-Bench），一个包含26个长时程工程任务的基准，任务由软件工程、物理工程、机器学习和科学计算领域的专家撰写。任务范围从优化内核、设计飞机，到找出导致地震的断层。每个任务都需要大量领域知识和工程工作，模型平均每个任务消耗数亿token。解决方案按速度、成本和准确率等实用指标评分，既在智能体可以测试的提供用例上，也在工程师根据任务描述所预期的隐藏用例上评分。目前表现最好的前沿模型Claude Fable 5.2得分54.6%，平均每个任务使用2.11亿token。我们强调两个发现。第一，当给模型更多时间时，它们会使用更多测试时计算并获得更高分数。模型随测试时计算的扩展方式也不同：GPT-6 Astra在更短时限和相同token用量下取得更高分数，而Claude Fable 5.2在更长时限下使用更多token以取得最高总分。第二，每个模型在隐藏用例上的得分低于提供用例，平均低18分，我们称之为部署差距。模型也无法预测部署差距，平均高估其在隐藏测试用例上的表现21分。我们希望OWE-Bench能推动智能体的工程解决方案在部署中表现得与测试时一样好。
translation.brief: 解决缺乏衡量AI智能体真实工程能力的长时程基准的问题，核心方法是构建由领域专家撰写的26个跨领域工程任务、按实用指标在可见与隐藏用例上评分的OWE-Bench。

papers.title: TRAE: Trustworthy Automated ESG Annotation via Multi-Agent Consensus and Confidence Assessment
papers.abstract: With the growing demand for ESG disclosure and evaluation, constructing high-quality datasets for automatically extracting ESG-related information from large-scale documents has become essential. However, ESG annotation remains challenging due to strong context dependence, ambiguous label boundaries, and the need for domain expertise, resulting in high annotation cost and limited scalability. To address these challenges, we propose TRAE (TRustworthy Automated ESG annotation), a multi-agent framework for scalable and reliable ESG data construction. Unlike direct LLM-based annotation, TRAE evaluates annotation reliability by modeling agreement, confidence, and reasoning consistency among multiple agents through a structured multi-step reasoning process. Experimental results demonstrate that TRAE improves annotation performance compared with existing automated annotation strategies. Furthermore, TRAE supports a hybrid human-AI annotation strategy that assigns expert labeling only to uncertain samples, reducing annotation cost while preserving data quality. Using TRAE, we construct a high-quality ESG dataset containing approximately 20,000 instances with complete reasoning traces, intermediate agent outputs, and reliability information to enhance transparency and reproducibility. Overall, this work provides a practical and scalable framework for trustworthy ESG data construction. The code and data are publicly available at: this https URL.

translation.title: TRAE：基于多智能体共识与置信度评估的可信自动化ESG标注
translation.abstract: 随着对ESG披露与评估需求的增长，构建用于从大规模文档中自动提取ESG相关信息的高质量数据集变得至关重要。然而，由于强上下文依赖、模糊的标签边界以及对领域专业知识的需求，ESG标注仍然充满挑战，导致标注成本高且可扩展性有限。为应对这些挑战，我们提出TRAE（TRustworthy Automated ESG annotation），一个用于可扩展且可靠ESG数据构建的多智能体框架。与直接基于LLM的标注不同，TRAE通过结构化的多步推理过程，建模多个智能体之间的一致性、置信度和推理一致性，从而评估标注的可靠性。实验结果表明，与现有自动化标注策略相比，TRAE提升了标注性能。此外，TRAE支持人机混合标注策略，仅对不确定样本分配专家标注，在保持数据质量的同时降低标注成本。利用TRAE，我们构建了一个包含约20,000个实例的高质量ESG数据集，其中包含完整的推理轨迹、中间智能体输出和可靠性信息，以增强透明度和可复现性。总体而言，这项工作为可信ESG数据构建提供了一个实用且可扩展的框架。代码和数据已在以下网址公开：this https URL。
translation.brief: 针对ESG标注成本高、可扩展性差的问题，提出通过多智能体共识与置信度评估来评估标注可靠性的多智能体标注框架TRAE。

papers.title: SWAM: State-aware World Action Model for Multi-Agent 3D Environments
papers.abstract: Interactive world models generate virtual environments autoregressively from player actions and visual history. However, visual history alone cannot reliably capture the evolving states of independently acting non-player characters (NPCs) in real games, particularly when they are outside the camera view. Recent multi-agent world models address this challenge through joint multi-view generation or persistent shared state, but often rely on external observations, like maps or scene geometry, or predefined state transitions. We present SWAM, a State-aware World Action Model that separates agent-state evolution from autoregressive visual generation in interactive 3D environments. A lightweight state model propagates character dynamics from actions without consuming generated frames, combining motion priors with learned scene-dependent corrections. The predicted states then guide an autoregressive diffusion transformer alongside visual history through a novel conditioning scheme. Rather than requiring an explicit scene geometry map or visibility tests, the conditioning indicates where characters may appear, allowing the diffusion model to learn their appearance and occlusion. This design enables NPCs to evolve independently of visual generation while maintaining consistent observations across visibility changes, interactions, and respawns. Evaluations in a custom Godot-based first-person shooter game demonstrate improvements in visual fidelity, NPC consistency, and long-horizon stability over existing approaches.

translation.title: SWAM：面向多智能体3D环境的状态感知世界动作模型
translation.abstract: 交互式世界模型根据玩家动作和视觉历史自回归地生成虚拟环境。然而，仅凭视觉历史无法可靠地捕捉真实游戏中独立行动的非玩家角色（NPC）的演化状态，尤其是当它们处于相机视野之外时。近期的多智能体世界模型通过联合多视角生成或持久共享状态来解决这一挑战，但往往依赖外部观察（如地图或场景几何）或预定义的状态转移。我们提出SWAM，一个状态感知世界动作模型，它将智能体状态演化与交互式3D环境中的自回归视觉生成分离开来。一个轻量级状态模型在不消耗生成帧的情况下从动作传播角色动态，将运动先验与学习到的场景相关修正相结合。预测的状态随后通过一种新颖的条件机制，与视觉历史一起引导自回归扩散transformer。该条件机制无需显式的场景几何地图或可见性测试，即可指示角色可能出现的位置，让扩散模型学习它们的外观和遮挡。这一设计使NPC能够独立于视觉生成而演化，同时在可见性变化、交互和重生过程中保持一致的观察。在基于Godot的自定义第一人称射击游戏中的评估表明，与现有方法相比，SWAM在视觉保真度、NPC一致性和长时程稳定性方面均有提升。
translation.brief: 针对视觉历史无法捕捉视野外NPC状态的问题，提出将智能体状态演化与自回归视觉生成分离的状态感知世界动作模型SWAM。

papers.title: ESGPT: A Data-Centric ESG Language Model with Unified Instruction and Benchmark Resources
papers.abstract: ESG analysis requires complex language understanding across diverse sources, including corporate reports, news, and disclosures, for tasks such as ESG relevance detection, action interpretation, impact analysis, and question answering. However, existing ESG datasets are fragmented by task and source, with heterogeneous formats and annotation schemes, limiting their use for training general-purpose ESG LLMs and unified evaluation. In this work, we construct ESG-Instruct, a 30,000-instance ESG instruction dataset built from public ESG resources, and ESGU-Bench, an ESG understanding benchmark covering six representative ESG tasks. Based on these resources, we further develop ESGPT, an 8B ESG-specialized LLM, and evaluate it against diverse open-source and API-based LLMs. Experimental results show that general-purpose LLMs exhibit substantial performance variation across ESG tasks, while ESGPT, despite its relatively small scale, achieves the best performance on multiple ESG tasks. This work provides unified data and benchmark resources for training and evaluating ESG-specialized LLMs.

translation.title: ESGPT：具有统一指令与基准资源的以数据为中心的ESG语言模型
translation.abstract: ESG分析需要对包括企业报告、新闻和披露文件在内的多种来源进行复杂的语言理解，以完成ESG相关性检测、行动解读、影响分析和问答等任务。然而，现有的ESG数据集按任务和来源割裂，格式和标注方案各异，限制了它们在训练通用ESG LLM和统一评估方面的使用。在这项工作中，我们构建了ESG-Instruct，一个基于公开ESG资源构建的包含30,000个实例的ESG指令数据集，以及ESGU-Bench，一个涵盖六项代表性ESG任务的ESG理解基准。基于这些资源，我们进一步开发了ESGPT，一个8B规模的ESG专用LLM，并将其与多种开源和基于API的LLM进行评估。实验结果表明，通用LLM在不同ESG任务上的表现差异显著，而ESGPT尽管规模相对较小，却在多项ESG任务上取得了最佳性能。这项工作为训练和评估ESG专用LLM提供了统一的数据和基准资源。
translation.brief: 针对ESG数据集割裂、格式异构的问题，构建统一指令数据集ESG-Instruct与基准ESGU-Bench，并训练8B规模的ESG专用语言模型ESGPT。

papers.title: Beyond Binary Correctness: A Surrogate for Confidence Learning in Large Language and Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Confidence estimation for large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) aims to assess how likely a particular generated response is to be correct. We investigate how learning this assessment can benefit from the model's predictive reliability on the underlying query. Binary correctness supervision, however, assigns identical labels to occasional errors and frequent failures, as well as isolated successes and consistent success. These outcomes can arise from substantially different predictive behavior under stochastic decoding. We propose a confidence-learning framework that supplements realized response correctness with query-level predictive reliability. We estimate reliability through repeated generations under a fixed model and decoding configuration, then combine the empirical success rate with individual correctness to construct a graded confidence surrogate. The surrogate differentiates responses sharing the same correctness label while preserving the average predictive reliability of the sampled response pool. To learn this target, we condition an independent confidence estimator on the query and its full generated response, and optimize backbone LoRA adapters together with a projection and scalar confidence head using mean squared error. Repeated sampling is required only for supervision construction; inference scores an individual response without additional generations. We establish ordering and mean preservation properties of the surrogate and derive a selective-risk bound connecting population surrogate prediction error to the error rate among accepted responses. We evaluate the framework across language and vision-language models, examining confidence calibration and selective prediction.

translation.title: 超越二元正确性：面向大语言模型与视觉语言模型置信度学习的替代目标
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）的置信度估计旨在评估某个特定生成回答正确的可能性。我们研究这一评估的学习如何能从模型对底层查询的预测可靠性中获益。然而，二元正确性监督会将偶发错误与频繁失败、以及孤立成功与持续成功赋予相同的标签。在随机解码下，这些结果可能来自截然不同的预测行为。我们提出一个置信度学习框架，在已实现的回答正确性之外补充查询级别的预测可靠性。我们通过在固定模型和解码配置下重复生成来估计可靠性，然后将经验成功率与个体正确性相结合，构建一个分级的置信度替代目标。该替代目标能够区分共享相同正确性标签的回答，同时保持采样回答池的平均预测可靠性。为学习该目标，我们以查询及其完整生成回答为条件训练一个独立的置信度估计器，并使用均方误差联合优化骨干LoRA适配器、投影层和标量置信度头。重复采样仅在构建监督时需要；推理时对单个回答打分，无需额外生成。我们建立了该替代目标的排序与均值保持性质，并推导出一个将总体替代目标预测误差与被接受回答的错误率联系起来的选择性风险界。我们在语言和视觉语言模型上评估该框架，考察置信度校准和选择性预测。
translation.brief: 针对二元正确性监督无法区分不同预测可靠性的问题，提出结合查询级经验成功率的分级置信度替代目标来训练置信度估计器。

papers.title: FolioWeaver: A LayerGraph-Grounded Agent for Layered Image Generation and Editing
papers.abstract: Layered image generation separates images into compositable layers, allowing users to manipulate individual elements independently. However, such asset-level editability does not enable the generation system to interpret successive feedback, perform targeted edits, and preserve unaffected content. We introduce FolioWeaver, a LayerGraph-grounded agent that unifies layered-image generation and iterative editing through a persistent Executable Scene State. FolioWeaver constructs a LayerGraph and generates independent visual assets conditioned on a shared scene reference. An Editing Agent performs feedback-driven modifications and self-repair through scoped actions, selective layer execution, and visual verification, enabling targeted updates while reusing unchanged assets. We also publicly release LayerFolio, a dataset of 100,377 human-reviewed layered scenes spanning six visual domains, together with two evaluation protocols: AtomicQA for measuring requirement satisfaction and CBLP for assessing layer organization. Experiments demonstrate that FolioWeaver achieves superior layer organization and composite fidelity compared with direct layered-generation methods. Analyses validate the contributions of component adaptation, execution-grounded repair, and cross-domain training. FolioWeaver advances layered-image generation toward persistent, controllable, and iterative visual creation. The dataset is available at this https URL.

translation.title: FolioWeaver：基于LayerGraph的分层图像生成与编辑智能体
translation.abstract: 分层图像生成将图像分解为可合成的图层，使用户能够独立操作各个元素。然而，这种资产级的可编辑性并不能使生成系统解读连续的反馈、执行针对性编辑并保留未受影响的内容。我们提出FolioWeaver，一个基于LayerGraph的智能体，通过持久的可执行场景状态（Executable Scene State）统一分层图像生成与迭代编辑。FolioWeaver构建LayerGraph，并以共享场景参考为条件生成独立的视觉资产。编辑智能体通过作用域受限的动作、选择性图层执行和视觉验证来执行基于反馈的修改和自我修复，在复用未更改资产的同时实现针对性更新。我们还公开发布了LayerFolio，一个包含100,377个经人工审核的分层场景、横跨六个视觉领域的数据集，以及两个评估协议：用于衡量需求满足度的AtomicQA和用于评估图层组织的CBLP。实验表明，与直接的分层生成方法相比，FolioWeaver在图层组织和合成保真度方面表现更优。分析验证了组件适配、基于执行的修复和跨领域训练的贡献。FolioWeaver推动分层图像生成迈向持久、可控和迭代的视觉创作。数据集可在以下网址获取：this https URL。
translation.brief: 针对分层图像生成难以解读连续反馈并进行针对性编辑的问题，提出基于LayerGraph与持久可执行场景状态的生成与迭代编辑智能体FolioWeaver。

papers.title: Context-Grounded Skill Internalization for Vision-Language Agents
papers.abstract: Skill internalization offers a way for agents to learn useful behaviors from skills and use them without explicit guidance in context at inference time. A common approach is to generate demonstration trajectories with the skill in context and then fine-tune the same model on its own trajectories with the skill removed. However, this leads to the problem that the model may learn to reference the removed skill, which we named as context misalignment (CoMi). In this work, we first analyze agent behaviors related to CoMi under this common pipeline. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and ARC-AGI-1, skill-removed fine-tuning consistently results in CoMi: 12.2-46.0% of test trajectories reference the removed skill. To address this problem, we develop Context-Grounded Skill Internalization (CGSI). CGSI uses a sentence detector to identify unsupported references and then masks or rewrites the selected sentences before fine-tuning. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of CGSI and reveal two key findings. (i) Compared with directly fine-tuning with the skill removed, CGSI reduces CoMi at test time by 72.5-94.6% while preserving task success. (ii) Compared with existing reinforcement learning-based skill-internalization baselines, CGSI achieves comparable performance with substantially less training time. CGSI also significantly reduces processing costs compared with large-scale trajectory auditing and correction.

translation.title: 面向视觉语言智能体的基于上下文的技能内化
translation.abstract: 技能内化为智能体提供了一种从技能中学习有用行为并在推理时无需上下文中显式指导即可使用这些行为的方法。一种常见做法是先在上下文中带技能生成示范轨迹，然后在移除技能的情况下对同一模型在其自身轨迹上进行微调。然而，这会导致模型可能学会引用已被移除的技能，我们将该问题命名为上下文错位（CoMi）。在本工作中，我们首先分析了这一常见流程下与CoMi相关的智能体行为。在ALFWorld、WebShop和ARC-AGI-1上，移除技能的微调始终导致CoMi：12.2-46.0%的测试轨迹引用了被移除的技能。为解决该问题，我们提出了基于上下文的技能内化（CGSI）。CGSI使用句子检测器识别无依据的引用，然后在微调前对所选句子进行掩码或改写。实验结果证明了CGSI的有效性，并揭示了两个关键发现：(i) 与直接在移除技能的情况下微调相比，CGSI在测试时将CoMi降低了72.5-94.6%，同时保持任务成功率。(ii) 与现有的基于强化学习的技能内化基线相比，CGSI以显著更少的训练时间取得了相当的性能。与大规模轨迹审计和修正相比，CGSI还显著降低了处理成本。
translation.brief: 针对技能内化微调中模型引用已移除技能的上下文错位（CoMi）问题，提出CGSI方法，通过句子检测器识别并掩码或改写无依据引用后再微调。

papers.title: Post-Training Agents for Long-Document Reasoning
papers.abstract: Professional documents are a long-context workload that retrieval-style benchmarks do not capture. In a ten-domain enterprise collection, a task's evidence is spread across a source document of median length 27 pages (mean 48.8, maximum 873); a third of tasks rest mainly on charts, drawings, and maps; and 70.9% require two or more reasoning hops. We post-train Kimi-K2.7, an open-weight foundation model, at its full context window on 1,465 expert-authored tasks with atomic rubrics from that collection, training rank-32 adapters with one round of privileged-context on-policy self-distillation followed by two rounds of rubric-reward reinforcement learning. We render each PDF as text for training and as extracted text plus selected page images at evaluation. The smoothed RL training reward rises from 0.37 in the first tenth of the run to 0.67 in the last. On the 100-task this http URL holdout, served in a 262,144-token window, strict pass (all rubric criteria met) more than doubles after the second round, from 11.0% to 24.5%, with gains across input lengths up to 240K tokens. Mean tokens generated stay flat (9,803 to 9,733), so the gain does not come from longer outputs. GPT-5.6 Sol's leaderboard strict pass is 30.7% at a measured 3,422 tokens. On 220 out-of-domain GDPval tasks, where the model runs as a long-horizon tool-using agent, mean rubric reward rises from 0.571 to 0.746 after the third round and zero-credit tasks fall from 54 to 10, while messages per task fall 18%, from 70.9 to 58.2. In paired trajectories, the third round replaces a context-thrashing retry loop with one up-front check of all sources, and verification extends from checking that files exist to checking what they contain. We argue that long-context evaluation of agents should report accuracy jointly with tokens and turns, and that datasets of long documents should ship text and image renderings alongside each PDF.

translation.title: 面向长文档推理的智能体后训练
translation.abstract: 专业文档是一种检索式基准无法覆盖的长上下文工作负载。在一个涵盖十个领域的企业文档集合中，任务的证据分布在长度中位数为27页（均值48.8，最大873页）的源文档中；三分之一的任务主要依赖图表、绘图和地图；70.9%的任务需要两次或以上的推理跳数。我们对开源权重基础模型Kimi-K2.7在其完整上下文窗口内进行后训练，使用了来自该集合的1,465个由专家撰写、带有原子化评分标准的任务，训练rank-32适配器，采用一轮特权上下文在线自蒸馏加两轮基于评分标准奖励的强化学习。训练时我们将每个PDF渲染为文本，评估时使用提取的文本加选定的页面图像。平滑后的RL训练奖励从训练前十分之一的0.37上升到最后的0.67。在100个任务的this http URL留出集上（以262,144 token窗口服务），第二轮后严格通过率（满足所有评分标准）翻倍以上，从11.0%升至24.5%，且在最长240K token的输入长度上均有提升。平均生成token数保持平稳（9,803到9,733），说明提升并非来自更长的输出。GPT-5.6 Sol的排行榜严格通过率为30.7%（实测3,422 token）。在220个域外GDPval任务上（模型作为长程工具使用智能体运行），第三轮后平均评分标准奖励从0.571升至0.746，零分任务从54个降至10个，同时每任务消息数下降18%，从70.9降至58.2。在配对轨迹中，第三轮将上下文反复折腾的重试循环替换为对所有来源的一次性前置检查，验证也从检查文件是否存在扩展到检查文件内容。我们主张智能体的长上下文评估应同时报告准确率、token数和轮次，且长文档数据集应随每个PDF提供文本和图像渲染。
translation.brief: 针对长文档专业任务中智能体推理能力不足的问题，对Kimi-K2.7在专家构建的长文档任务上进行自蒸馏加评分标准奖励强化学习的后训练。

papers.title: AxE: Benchmarking Agent-Environment Generalization of Video World Models via Grounded Events
papers.abstract: Edge cases are not the long tail; they are the norm. An embodied system deployed across changing environments, bodies, objects, and tasks will routinely encounter combinations that were absent from its training data. General-purpose physical intelligence therefore requires world models that reuse prior knowledge, predict consequences, and adapt with little or no additional training. Yet current evaluations of conditional video generation emphasize visual quality, prompt alignment, or isolated physical plausibility, leaving systematic generalization difficult to measure. We introduce AxE Bench, a benchmark that organizes condition changes along eight factors of the acting agent and of its environment, and pairs every original condition with controlled variants that change one side or both. WBench-plus applies the same structure to an existing multi-turn benchmark, pairing each WBench scenario with variants on the environment side, through its world setting or camera behavior, or on the agent side, through its interaction instructions. Additionally, to score generated futures, we develop an evaluation harness that combines vision-language reasoning with targeted computer-vision evidence, converting each video into temporally localized events and comparing generated events with reference events in both time and semantics. We summarize each model with the AxE Score, event Fidelity weighted by its Stability across original-variant pairs. Across twenty models, generated events match reference events far more often in timing than in content: no model exceeds a Fidelity of 13.01, the highest Stability is 0.55, and the highest AxE Score is 7.10. Together, these components turn world-model generalization from an informal aspiration into a falsifiable evaluation program for real and simulated interactions. Our project website can be found at: this http URL

translation.title: AxE：基于接地事件的视频世界模型智能体-环境泛化基准
translation.abstract: 边缘情况并非长尾，而是常态。部署在不断变化的环境、身体、物体和任务中的具身系统会经常遇到训练数据中不存在的组合。因此，通用物理智能需要能够复用先验知识、预测后果并以极少或无需额外训练进行适应的世界模型。然而，当前对条件视频生成的评估强调视觉质量、提示对齐或孤立的物理合理性，使系统性泛化难以衡量。我们提出AxE Bench，该基准沿行动智能体及其环境的八个因素组织条件变化，并将每个原始条件与改变一侧或两侧的受控变体配对。WBench-plus将相同结构应用于现有多轮基准，通过世界设定或相机行为在环境侧、或通过交互指令在智能体侧，为每个WBench场景配对变体。此外，为给生成的未来打分，我们开发了一个评估框架，将视觉语言推理与针对性的计算机视觉证据相结合，将每个视频转换为时间上定位的事件，并在时间和语义上将生成事件与参考事件进行比较。我们用AxE Score总结每个模型，即事件Fidelity按其在原始-变体对上的Stability加权。在二十个模型中，生成事件在时间上匹配参考事件的频率远高于内容上：没有模型的Fidelity超过13.01，最高Stability为0.55，最高AxE Score为7.10。这些组件共同将世界模型泛化从一种非正式的愿景转变为针对真实与模拟交互的可证伪评估方案。我们的项目网站见：this http URL
translation.brief: 针对视频世界模型系统性泛化难以衡量的问题，构建AxE Bench基准，通过八因素条件变体配对及结合视觉语言推理与计算机视觉证据的事件级评估框架进行评测。

papers.title: Parameter-Efficient Vocabulary Expansion via Cross-Lingual Embedding Alignment
papers.abstract: Continual pretraining with vocabulary expansion is often used to make large language models (LLMs) more effective and efficient at handling new languages. However, when LLMs are extended to many languages simultaneously, the number of model parameters increases significantly. In addition, the newly added tokens do not receive the same number of training steps as the tokens in the original vocabulary, which sometimes causes vocabulary expansion to yield only limited performance improvements. We propose leveraging the semantic equivalence between words in the model's primary language and those in the extended vocabulary to transfer learned representations. In this paper, we introduce MATE, a parameter-efficient vocabulary expansion method that enables effective cross-lingual transfer with 8 times fewer additional parameters per token. MATE reduces the average tokenization compression ratio and delivers improvements on multiple benchmarks.

translation.title: 基于跨语言嵌入对齐的参数高效词表扩展
translation.abstract: 带词表扩展的持续预训练常被用于使大语言模型（LLM）在处理新语言时更有效、更高效。然而，当LLM同时扩展到多种语言时，模型参数数量会显著增加。此外，新增token无法获得与原始词表token相同数量的训练步数，这有时导致词表扩展只能带来有限的性能提升。我们提出利用模型主语言词汇与扩展词表词汇之间的语义等价性来迁移已学习的表示。本文介绍MATE，一种参数高效的词表扩展方法，能以每token少8倍的额外参数实现有效的跨语言迁移。MATE降低了平均分词压缩比，并在多个基准上带来提升。
translation.brief: 针对多语言词表扩展参数激增且新token训练不足的问题，提出MATE方法，利用主语言与扩展词表词汇的语义等价性迁移表示，实现参数高效的跨语言扩展。

papers.title: WASP: Continual Weight Adaptation for Streaming LLM Personalization
papers.abstract: Personalized large language models (LLMs) should continually adapt to users' evolving preferences. Yet extracting preference changes from noisy interaction histories while supporting inexpensive updates remains challenging. We introduce WASP (Weight Adaptation for Streaming Personalization), a recurrent framework that captures fine-grained preferences directly from raw user interactions and generates personalized LoRA adapters without expensive per-user optimization. Specifically, WASP achieves this by training a shared hypernetwork that maintains a compact user representation and outputs adapter weights in a single forward pass. As new interactions arrive, WASP updates this representation without reprocessing full interaction history, enabling continual adaptation with per-update costs independent of history length. Experiments on personalization benchmarks and chronological interaction streams show that WASP sustains high-quality personalization over long horizons under fixed compute and storage budgets. Together, these results support efficient streaming personalization and facilitate privacy-preserving on-device deployment.

translation.title: WASP：面向流式LLM个性化的持续权重自适应
translation.abstract: 个性化大语言模型（LLM）应持续适应用户不断演变的偏好。然而，从嘈杂的交互历史中提取偏好变化同时支持低成本的更新仍然具有挑战性。我们提出WASP（Weight Adaptation for Streaming Personalization），一个循环框架，直接从原始用户交互中捕获细粒度偏好，并生成个性化LoRA适配器而无需昂贵的每用户优化。具体而言，WASP通过训练一个共享超网络来实现，该超网络维护紧凑的用户表示并在单次前向传播中输出适配器权重。随着新交互的到来，WASP更新该表示而无需重新处理完整交互历史，实现每次更新成本与历史长度无关的持续适应。在个性化基准和按时间顺序的交互流上的实验表明，WASP在固定的计算和存储预算下能在长时程中保持高质量的个性化。这些结果共同支持了高效的流式个性化，并促进了隐私保护的端侧部署。
translation.brief: 针对从嘈杂交互历史中低成本持续提取用户偏好的问题，提出WASP循环框架，用共享超网络维护紧凑用户表示并单次前向生成个性化LoRA适配器。

papers.title: AutoSECO: Automated Skill Evolution for Cross-Problem Combinatorial Optimization with General-Purpose LLM Agents
papers.abstract: General-purpose large language model (LLM) agents can develop complete solvers for combinatorial optimization problems. Their specialization, however, often relies on workflows engineered for individual problems, limiting the reuse of development expertise. We propose AutoSECO, an automated skill evolution method that learns reusable solver-development guidance from experience. The challenge is that external evaluation measures the completed solver, while the skill guides decisions during development. AutoSECO connects this feedback to guidance deficiencies by tracing performance shortfalls through solver code and recorded development decisions. Revisions are expressed as general instructions and retained only if a fresh solver developed under the revised skill achieves a lower mean evaluation gap. Evolved solely on the traveling salesperson problem (TSP), the skill guides fresh agents in developing solvers for capacitated vehicle routing, job-shop scheduling, and three-dimensional bin packing without further skill evolution. On TSP, the final mean benchmark gap is 0.52\%, compared with 0.98\% for the skill-evolution baseline SkillOpt. Across all four problems, the evolved skill achieves better aggregate results than no skill guidance, the initial skill, and SkillOpt. The same frozen skill also supports solver development under alternative model--harness configurations. These findings suggest that solver-development experience can be retained as reusable expertise for general-purpose LLM agents.

translation.title: AutoSECO：基于通用LLM智能体的跨问题组合优化自动技能演化
translation.abstract: 通用大语言模型（LLM）智能体可以为组合优化问题开发完整的求解器，但其专业化往往依赖于针对单个问题设计的工作流，限制了开发经验的复用。我们提出AutoSECO，一种自动技能演化方法，从经验中学习可复用的求解器开发指导。挑战在于外部评估衡量的是已完成的求解器，而技能指导的是开发过程中的决策。AutoSECO通过追踪求解器代码和记录的开发决策中的性能缺陷，将这种反馈与指导不足联系起来。修订以通用指令的形式表达，只有当在修订技能下新开发的求解器达到更低的平均评估差距时才被保留。该技能仅在旅行商问题（TSP）上演化，即可指导新的智能体开发带容量约束的车辆路径、作业车间调度和三维装箱问题的求解器，无需进一步的技能演化。在TSP上，最终平均基准差距为0.52%，而技能演化基线SkillOpt为0.98%。在全部四个问题上，演化后的技能比无技能指导、初始技能和SkillOpt取得了更好的总体结果。同一冻结技能还支持在不同模型-框架配置下进行求解器开发。这些发现表明，求解器开发经验可以作为可复用的专业知识保留下来供通用LLM智能体使用。
translation.brief: 针对LLM智能体求解器开发经验难以跨问题复用的问题，提出通过追踪性能缺陷并验证修订指令的自动技能演化方法AutoSECO。

papers.title: Reading the Tea Leaves, Again: Can Large Language Models Predict Language Model Training Runs?
papers.abstract: LLM agents now propose research ideas and run the experiments that test them, but they train every run to its end, whereas a researcher reads a run's configuration and the beginning of its curve and stops the runs that show no promise. Reading a run this way takes more than describing or implementing a training method: it takes knowing what a design choice does to a run. We build Tea Leaves to measure this knowledge on 682 real training runs across pretraining, fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning (RL): a forecaster sees the first 20% of a run with its configuration, description, and code, and predicts the rest. Across 11 LLMs and a range of forecasting baselines, the strongest LLMs match or exceed the best curve fitter on smooth loss curves (skill 0.66 against 0.62) and lead on noisy RL reward curves (0.43 against 0.13). What bounds every forecaster is what the log carries: on sparsely logged community runs all methods lose most of their skill, and none reliably flags a failing run in advance. Beyond the curve, information helps and effort does not: related runs in the prompt cut the error on loss curves by 39%, and knowledge of training dynamics lets the strongest LLMs order all 36 pairs of runs that differ by a described code change, which the early curves do not separate, whereas tools add little. This knowledge can be learned from logged runs: a small open model trained on public runs matches the best LLM on loss curves. Applied to the progress curves of research agents, the same reading ranks tasks by their remaining headroom, although for a single agent run it does not improve on the last value. We release the benchmark, the trained readers, and their training data to test and train LLMs' understanding of training and to help research agents decide which runs deserve their compute.

translation.title: 再度解读茶渣：大语言模型能否预测语言模型训练过程？
translation.abstract: LLM智能体现在可以提出研究想法并运行验证实验，但它们会把每次训练运行到结束，而研究者会阅读运行的配置和曲线的开头，并停止没有前景的运行。以这种方式解读一次运行，不仅仅是描述或实现训练方法：还需要了解设计选择对运行的影响。我们构建了Tea Leaves，在涵盖预训练、微调和强化学习（RL）的682次真实训练运行上衡量这种知识：预测者看到运行前20%的曲线及其配置、描述和代码，然后预测其余部分。在11个LLM和一系列预测基线中，最强的LLM在平滑损失曲线上匹配或超过最佳曲线拟合器（技能0.66对0.62），并在噪声较大的RL奖励曲线上领先（0.43对0.13）。限制所有预测者的是日志所携带的信息：在日志稀疏的社区运行上，所有方法都失去了大部分技能，且没有方法能可靠地提前标记失败的运行。除曲线之外，信息有帮助而工具没有：提示中提供相关运行可将损失曲线误差降低39%，训练动力学的知识使最强的LLM能够对因描述的代码变更而不同的全部36对运行进行排序，而这些运行在早期曲线上无法区分，而工具几乎没有帮助。这种知识可以从日志运行中学习：在公开运行上训练的小型开源模型在损失曲线上匹配最佳LLM。应用于研究智能体的进展曲线时，同样的解读可以按剩余提升空间对任务排序，尽管对于单次智能体运行它并不优于最后一个值。我们发布该基准、训练出的解读器及其训练数据，以测试和训练LLM对训练的理解，并帮助研究智能体决定哪些运行值得投入算力。
translation.brief: 针对LLM缺乏预测训练运行走向的知识这一问题，构建Tea Leaves基准，让模型根据运行前20%的曲线、配置和代码预测后续走向。

papers.title: STMemoLLM: A Spatial-Temporal Memory-Augmented LLM for Robust Traffic Forecasting
papers.abstract: Traffic forecasting is essential for intelligent transportation systems. However, traditional deep-learning models often rely heavily on high-quality observations. Recent LLM-based approaches incorporate pretrained knowledge to improve forecasting, but they remain sensitive to input perturbations and struggle to preserve long-term patterns. To address this, we propose STMemoLLM, a spatial-temporal memory-augmented LLM for robust traffic forecasting. STMemoLLM introduces memory prototypes to compress inputs into compact summary tokens while extracting reliable dynamics from residual signals, achieving a balance between stability and variability. Specifically, a memory-enhanced tokenizer encodes prototypes and sensor characteristics into attention biases to guide adaptive compression of correlated sensors into semantic summary tokens. A memory-calibrated router further evaluates contextual deviation, compression deficiency, and prototype alignment to identify reliable residual signals, which complement the summaries while suppressing noise. Extensive experiments on eight real-world datasets show that STMemoLLM achieves state-of-the-art performance. Additional experiments examine point masking, additive Gaussian noise, structured missingness, and limited training data, demonstrating strong robustness. Code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: STMemoLLM：用于鲁棒交通预测的时空记忆增强大语言模型
translation.abstract: 交通预测对智能交通系统至关重要。然而，传统深度学习模型往往严重依赖高质量观测数据。近期基于LLM的方法引入预训练知识以改进预测，但它们对输入扰动仍然敏感，且难以保留长期模式。为此，我们提出STMemoLLM，一种用于鲁棒交通预测的时空记忆增强LLM。STMemoLLM引入记忆原型将输入压缩为紧凑的摘要token，同时从残差信号中提取可靠动态，在稳定性与可变性之间取得平衡。具体而言，记忆增强分词器将原型和传感器特征编码为注意力偏置，以指导将相关传感器自适应压缩为语义摘要token。记忆校准路由器进一步评估上下文偏差、压缩不足和原型对齐，以识别可靠的残差信号，在抑制噪声的同时补充摘要信息。在八个真实数据集上的大量实验表明，STMemoLLM达到了最先进的性能。额外实验考察了点掩码、加性高斯噪声、结构化缺失和有限训练数据等情形，展示了强大的鲁棒性。代码见此https URL。
translation.brief: 针对LLM交通预测对输入扰动敏感且难以保留长期模式的问题，提出引入记忆原型与记忆校准路由器的时空记忆增强模型STMemoLLM。

papers.title: OpenViVE: New Benchmark and Dual-Stream Co-Attention Framework for Vietnamese Visual Entailment
papers.abstract: Visual Entailment (VE) determines whether a textual hypothesis is entailed, contradicted, or unverifiable from an image. However, existing VE benchmarks are largely English-centric and do not capture Vietnamese-specific linguistic distinctions or culturally grounded visual contexts. To address this gap, we introduce OpenViVE, the first large-scale native Vietnamese VE benchmark, containing 62,268 balanced image-hypothesis pairs from 10,378 culturally grounded images. OpenViVE is constructed using an Artifact-Aware Hybrid LLM-Human Pipeline that combines constrained generation, human validation, and PMI-guided refinement. The pipeline substantially reduces hypothesis-only shortcuts, with Contradiction accuracy dropping from 96% to 66% after artifact refinement. We further evaluate a dual-stream PhoBERT-ConvNeXt framework with bidirectional co-attention to align visual evidence with Vietnamese hypotheses. The framework achieves 84.84% accuracy and 84.90% macro-F1 on the test set, while PhoBERT consistently outperforms multilingual XLM-R variants. These results highlight the importance of language-specific encoding and explicit cross-modal interaction for Vietnamese VE.

translation.title: OpenViVE：面向越南语视觉蕴含的新基准与双流协同注意力框架
translation.abstract: 视觉蕴含（VE）判断文本假设是被图像蕴含、矛盾还是无法验证。然而，现有VE基准大多以英语为中心，未能体现越南语特有的语言区别或基于文化的视觉语境。为填补这一空白，我们提出OpenViVE，首个大规模原生越南语VE基准，包含来自10,378张文化相关图像的62,268个均衡的图像-假设对。OpenViVE采用结合受限生成、人工验证和PMI引导精炼的伪影感知混合LLM-人工流水线构建。该流水线大幅减少了仅凭假设即可作答的捷径，伪影精炼后矛盾类准确率从96%降至66%。我们进一步评估了采用双向协同注意力对齐视觉证据与越南语假设的双流PhoBERT-ConvNeXt框架。该框架在测试集上达到84.84%准确率和84.90%宏F1，且PhoBERT始终优于多语言XLM-R变体。这些结果凸显了语言特定编码和显式跨模态交互对越南语VE的重要性。
translation.brief: 针对缺乏越南语视觉蕴含基准的问题，构建大规模越南语VE基准OpenViVE并提出双流协同注意力框架。

papers.title: ReVAgent: Multi-Agent Reasoning-Intensive Video Generation
papers.abstract: A central challenge in generating instructional videos for reasoning-intensive topics is to show how and why the state changes at each step. Even when an animation renders successfully, the depicted object relationships and state transitions can conflict with the explanation, making the reasoning difficult to follow. We present ReVAgent, a multi-agent framework that solves a problem, generates keyframes for its explanation, and synthesizes an instructional video. The agents share the execution record of a solution program, reuse intermediate results and constructions in the scenes, and check rendered keyframes to guide revisions to the solution or the scenes. We also introduce a multidimensional rubric for assessing whether generated videos present the problem clearly, organize the steps coherently, and use visuals to explain the reasoning. We calibrate a multimodal judge using human ratings and apply it to instructional videos for mathematics and algorithms. In the evaluated samples, ReVAgent presents multi-step reasoning coherently and uses diagrams to show how key operations lead to subsequent states.

translation.title: ReVAgent：面向推理密集型视频生成的多智能体框架
translation.abstract: 为推理密集型主题生成教学视频的核心挑战在于展示每一步状态如何变化以及为何变化。即使动画渲染成功，所描绘的对象关系和状态转换也可能与解释相冲突，使推理难以理解。我们提出ReVAgent，一个多智能体框架，它求解一个问题、为其解释生成关键帧，并合成教学视频。各智能体共享求解程序的执行记录，在场景中复用中间结果和构造，并检查渲染的关键帧以指导对求解方案或场景的修订。我们还引入了一个多维评分标准，用于评估生成的视频是否清晰呈现问题、连贯组织步骤，并利用视觉元素解释推理。我们使用人工评分校准多模态评判模型，并将其应用于数学和算法教学视频。在评估样本中，ReVAgent连贯地呈现多步推理，并使用图示展示关键操作如何导致后续状态。
translation.brief: 针对教学视频中动画与解释不一致导致推理难以理解的问题，提出共享执行记录并检查关键帧以迭代修订的多智能体框架ReVAgent。

papers.title: Multimodal View Training: Learning More Through Different Modalities
papers.abstract: Can a language model learn more from the same information simply by encountering it in different forms? We answer this in the affirmative by introducing Multimodal View Training (MVT), a simple training approach that presents identical information through text, speech, and images, without requiring new facts or supervision. Starting from a text sample, MVT generates corresponding audio and rendered-text image views, and trains a multimodal language model to produce the same target output across all three views. To further bring these benefits to text-only large language models (LLMs), we train lightweight connector modules to pretrained audio and vision encoders, allowing the LLM to learn from multimodal inputs while retaining its text-only architecture at inference. Across question answering, machine unlearning, and knowledge editing, adaptive MVT improves QA recall by +15.2 percentage points, forget quality by +40.7 points, and editing generality by +25.2 points over text-only training. Combining MVT with standard augmentation further improves QA and editing generality. Our theoretical analysis illustrates how training across modalities can shift weight updates toward shared factual content and reduce their reliance on features specific to each view.

translation.title: 多模态视角训练：通过不同模态学到更多
translation.abstract: 语言模型能否仅仅通过以不同形式接触相同信息而学到更多？我们通过提出多模态视角训练（MVT）给出了肯定答案，这是一种简单的训练方法，通过文本、语音和图像呈现相同的信息，无需新的事实或监督。从文本样本出发，MVT 生成对应的音频和渲染文本图像视角，并训练多模态语言模型在所有三种视角下产生相同的目标输出。为了进一步将这些收益带给纯文本大语言模型（LLM），我们为预训练的音频和视觉编码器训练轻量级连接模块，使 LLM 能够从多模态输入中学习，同时在推理时保持其纯文本架构。在问答、机器遗忘和知识编辑任务上，自适应 MVT 相比纯文本训练将问答召回率提升 15.2 个百分点，遗忘质量提升 40.7 个百分点，编辑泛化性提升 25.2 个百分点。将 MVT 与标准数据增强结合可进一步提升问答和编辑泛化性。我们的理论分析说明了跨模态训练如何将权重更新转向共享的事实内容，并降低其对各视角特有特征的依赖。
translation.brief: 提出多模态视角训练（MVT），通过让模型以文本、语音、图像三种形式学习相同信息来提升知识获取效果。

papers.title: FiRE: Fine-grained Ranking Evaluation for Machine Translation
papers.abstract: Developing reliable machine translation (MT) systems hinges on our ability to distinguish superior translations from inferior ones. However, existing evaluation paradigms, whether limited to coarse overall rankings or misaligned with human preferences, fail to deliver interpretable, fine-grained feedback in reference-free settings. We present a Fine-Grained Ranking Evaluation method (FiRE) that leverages off-the-shelf large language models to perform criterion-driven pairwise comparison across three complementary dimensions: faithfulness, fluency, and consistency of style, instead of producing a single holistic judgment. To enable rigorous meta-evaluation of evaluation paradigms in the absence of any suitable testbed, we construct the first human-annotated, reference-free benchmark for fine-grained ranking evaluation, achieving substantial inter-annotator agreement. Through meta-evaluation on this benchmark and existing MQM datasets, FiRE demonstrably outperforms regression-based and error-analysis metrics in aligning with human comparative judgments, while providing more informative insights into translation quality.
