Experiments on AppWorld, OfficeBench, and 8-objective QA show that DMC-5 reduces agent model input by 38.5-57.0% and end-to-end cost by 14.5-28.0% with 78.0-85.0% compressor cache-hit rates, while improving task performance by 1.0-5.8% over the uncompressed baseline.

translation.title: DMC-5：面向长程智能体的双模型协作与缓存感知上下文压缩
translation.abstract: 长程智能体反复将不断增长的交互轨迹输入专用智能体模型。前缀缓存可复用对重复历史的计算，但无法阻止上下文增长，也无法移除与当前决策无关的信息。当专用智能体缺乏通用模型享有的缓存输入折扣时，代价尤为高昂，使轨迹压缩成为自然的替代方案。然而，现有的选择性上下文压缩方法可能丢失全局信息，递归重写摘要会导致语义漂移，而反复对完整历史重新压缩则将不断增长的成本转嫁给压缩器。因此，我们提出DMC-5（双模型协作与缓存感知上下文压缩），这是一个非对称框架，将完整历史整合分配给通用压缩模型，将动作生成分配给专用智能体模型。DMC-5将原始轨迹维护为仅追加的规范视图（Append-only Canonical View），在保留全局访问的同时，允许压缩器复用稳定的历史前缀，而非递归重写或重新计算先前上下文。智能体仅在包含近期原始交互的紧凑决策视图（Decision View）上运行，减少重复输入的同时保留下一步动作所需的信息。DMC-5还引入YAMATO（面向工具操作的完整性感知内存抽象），在有损压缩过程中保留执行关键信息。在AppWorld、OfficeBench和8目标QA上的实验表明，DMC-5将智能体模型输入减少38.5-57.0%，端到端成本降低14.5-28.0%，压缩器缓存命中率达78.0-85.0%，同时任务性能比未压缩基线提升1.0-5.8%。
translation.brief: 解决长程智能体上下文不断增长导致的成本问题，采用通用压缩模型与专用智能体模型协作的非对称框架，通过仅追加规范视图实现缓存感知压缩。

papers.title: ANOR: Scaling Sparse Attention with a GPU-PNM Computing Hierarchy
papers.abstract: Serving large language models with long contexts requires keeping the key-value (KV) cache of every request, which can exceed GPU memory capacity. Sparse attention reads only a small, query-dependent subset of this cache at each decoding step, yet must retain the full cache because later steps may select other entries. Processing-near-memory (PNM) devices attached through Compute Express Link (CXL) can hold the full cache and compute attention where it resides. Prior GPU-PNM systems for sparse attention are PNM-centric, processing most of the attention on the PNM. As existing CXL-PNM devices provide far less memory bandwidth than GPU HBM, this PNM-centric execution makes the PNM the bottleneck and leaves the GPU idle waiting for attention results. We present ANOR, a GPU-PNM joint acceleration system that exploits the selection locality of sparse attention by computing most of the attention on the GPU from a cache of recently selected entries and processing only the misses on the PNM. As the PNM processes cache misses directly, GPU cache updates can be decoupled from current-step execution. We develop a bounded cache-update policy that limits updates to the point where the hit ratio of later steps saturates, reducing GPU-facing link traffic. We add a small on-chip Early Streaming Buffer (ESB) that captures KV data during PNM attention and streams it to the GPU, avoiding most redundant DRAM reads despite the bandwidth mismatch between PNM memory and the GPU-facing link. We also propose an adaptive cache-factor mechanism that adjusts GPU cache size to the serving load, balancing hit ratio and batch size. Across two models and three long-context agentic workloads, ANOR improves decode throughput by 2.3x over HiSparse and 2.0x over a PNM baseline on average. These results show that PNM is most effective not as the primary attention engine but as a computing tier of the GPU memory hierarchy.

translation.title: ANOR：基于GPU-PNM计算层次的稀疏注意力扩展
translation.abstract: 以长上下文服务大语言模型需要保留每个请求的键值（KV）缓存，其规模可能超出GPU内存容量。稀疏注意力在每步解码时只读取缓存中一小部分与查询相关的子集，但由于后续步骤可能选择其他条目，仍须保留完整缓存。通过Compute Express Link（CXL）连接的近内存处理（PNM）设备可以容纳完整缓存并在数据所在处计算注意力。此前面向稀疏注意力的GPU-PNM系统以PNM为中心，将大部分注意力计算放在PNM上。由于现有CXL-PNM设备的内存带宽远低于GPU HBM，这种以PNM为中心的执行方式使PNM成为瓶颈，GPU则闲置等待注意力结果。我们提出ANOR，一个GPU-PNM联合加速系统，利用稀疏注意力的选择局部性，在GPU上基于最近选中条目的缓存计算大部分注意力，仅在PNM上处理缓存未命中。由于PNM直接处理缓存未命中，GPU缓存更新可与当前步执行解耦。我们开发了有界缓存更新策略，将更新限制在后续步骤命中率饱和的范围内，从而减少GPU侧链路流量。我们增加了小型片上早流缓冲（Early Streaming Buffer, ESB），在PNM注意力计算期间捕获KV数据并流式传输到GPU，尽管PNM内存与GPU侧链路带宽不匹配，仍避免了大部分冗余DRAM读取。我们还提出自适应缓存因子机制，根据服务负载调整GPU缓存大小，平衡命中率与批大小。在两个模型和三个长上下文智能体工作负载上，ANOR的解码吞吐量平均比HiSparse提升2.3倍，比PNM基线提升2.0倍。这些结果表明，PNM最有效的角色不是作为主要注意力引擎，而是作为GPU内存层次中的一个计算层。
translation.brief: 解决长上下文KV缓存超出GPU内存容量的问题，提出GPU-PNM联合加速系统，利用稀疏注意力的选择局部性在GPU缓存命中计算、PNM处理未命中。

papers.title: HWRE-Bench: Can LLM Agents Understand Hardware They Did Not Design?
papers.abstract: Hardware benchmarks for LLM agents all run the design flow forward, from a specification to RTL, a layout or a bug fix. We ask the reverse question: given an implemented artifact, such as a layout, a gate-level netlist or a protected simulation model, can an agent work out what it does well enough to act on that knowledge? We introduce HWRE-Bench, a benchmark for agentic hardware reverse engineering built on one observation. Each step of the forward flow discards information (names, hierarchy, word-level structure, generator parameters, the programming model), and a reverse-engineering task asks the agent to recover what was lost and to prove it with an executable deliverable that the artifact alone cannot supply. Since layout extraction is now mechanical and a correct netlist is already a cycle-exact model, every task carries a mandatory copy-the-netlist control that must score zero. HWRE-Bench spans five tracks (Extract, Abstract, Audit, Interoperate, Modify), four information-loss levels and white- versus black-box access, all on original designs. We report a pilot of 148 rollouts from two agents on four seed tasks under 16 conditions, with stage-annotated trajectories. Agents built their own layout extractors and audited a sanitized layout as reliably as a netlist, at about 27% more turns. Keyless, equivalence-preserving obfuscation changed neither pass rates nor defect-repair scores. Whether agents read the structure at all depended on task framing rather than on necessity, so pass rate alone does not show understanding. Provider safety filters stopped 16% of one agent's runs on the audit tasks. These results argue for deliverables beyond equivalence and for reporting run validity explicitly.

translation.title: HWRE-Bench：LLM智能体能理解非其设计的硬件吗？
translation.abstract: 现有的LLM智能体硬件基准都沿设计流程正向运行，从规格到RTL、版图或缺陷修复。我们提出反向问题：给定一个已实现的产物，如版图、门级网表或受保护的仿真模型，智能体能否充分理解其功能并据此采取行动？我们提出HWRE-Bench，一个基于一项观察构建的智能体硬件逆向工程基准。正向流程的每一步都会丢弃信息（名称、层次结构、字级结构、生成器参数、编程模型），而逆向工程任务要求智能体恢复丢失的信息，并用可执行的交付物加以证明，而仅凭产物本身无法提供这些交付物。由于版图提取如今已机械化，且正确的网表本身已是周期精确的模型，每个任务都带有强制性的复制网表对照，其得分必须为零。HWRE-Bench涵盖五个赛道（Extract、Abstract、Audit、Interoperate、Modify）、四个信息丢失级别以及白盒与黑盒访问，全部基于原创设计。我们报告了一项试点：两个智能体在16种条件下对四个种子任务共进行148次rollout，并附带阶段标注的轨迹。智能体构建了自己的版图提取器，并以与网表相当的可靠性审计了脱敏版图，但多消耗约27%的轮次。无密钥的等价保持混淆既未改变通过率，也未改变缺陷修复得分。智能体是否真正读取结构取决于任务表述而非必要性，因此仅凭通过率无法体现理解。提供商安全过滤器阻止了某一智能体在审计任务上16%的运行。这些结果主张采用超越等价性的交付物，并明确报告运行有效性。
translation.brief: 针对LLM智能体能否逆向理解已有硬件产物的问题，构建了包含五个赛道、四个信息丢失级别的硬件逆向工程基准HWRE-Bench。

papers.title: Automated Call for Action: RAG-Based Environmental Law Enforcement Screening System
papers.abstract: Environmental law inspectors face a structural issue in identifying potential violations from data: they often do not have the capacity to deal with large volume of data present in the emission events. This paper examines to what extent an LLM-based system can support evidence assembly and permit-based screening of such events, using the coke plants of a steel producer and a regional environmental service as a case. A simple puff-trajectory model aligns air quality measurements, weather and citizen complaints with each emission event. A retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline then retrieves facility-specific permit conditions and generates event reports and a period report with an investigation recommendation. Across 74 events from March 2025, plant-aware re-ranking reduced reports citing the other plant's conditions from 58.1% (hybrid retrieval) to 0% by rule-based plant labels, while maintaining high RAGAS and LLM-judge metrics. GPT-5-mini performed comparably to GPT-5.1, whereas GPT-5-nano scored lower on legal grounding and legal faithfulness. In an evidence ablation, removing air quality (AQ) data changed judge scores and period recommendations most; citation overlap changed only slightly under any removal, and removing complaint details had no measurable effect. This suggests a need for rules and guidelines that link complaints to incidents and permit conditions, so that community reports can count as evidence. The results support screening of events that may need further investigation. Design implications for involving environmental service experts are derived.

translation.title: 自动化行动呼吁：基于RAG的环境执法筛查系统
translation.abstract: 环境法检查员在从数据中识别潜在违规行为时面临结构性问题：他们往往没有能力处理排放事件中存在的大量数据。本文考察基于LLM的系统在多大程度上能支持此类事件的证据组装和基于许可的筛查，以某钢铁生产商的焦化厂和一个区域环境服务部门为案例。一个简单的烟羽轨迹模型将空气质量测量、天气和市民投诉与每个排放事件对齐。随后，检索增强生成（RAG）流水线检索设施特定的许可条件，生成事件报告和包含调查建议的周期报告。在2025年3月的74个事件中，基于工厂感知的重排序将通过规则化工厂标签将引用另一工厂条件的报告比例从58.1%（混合检索）降至0%，同时保持较高的RAGAS和LLM-judge指标。GPT-5-mini的表现与GPT-5.1相当，而GPT-5-nano在法律依据和法律忠实性上得分较低。在证据消融实验中，移除空气质量（AQ）数据对评判得分和周期建议的影响最大；任何移除下引用重叠仅略有变化，移除投诉细节则无可测影响。这表明需要将投诉与事件及许可条件关联的规则和指南，使社区报告可作为证据。结果支持对可能需要进一步调查的事件进行筛查，并推导出让环境服务专家参与的设计启示。
translation.brief: 解决环境检查员难以处理海量排放事件数据的问题，构建基于RAG的LLM系统，将空气质量、天气和投诉与排放事件对齐并依据许可条件自动筛查。

papers.title: Test-Time Latent Computation to Improve Visual Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Recent work on Large Language Models (LLMs) suggests that reasoning capabilities can be enhanced at test time not only through longer token-level reasoning traces, but also through additional computation in latent space. This raises a natural question for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs): can additional computation in latent space improve visual perception at test time? In this work, we first verify that MLLMs contain stable reusable layers that can be re-forwarded at inference time without disrupting normal generation. Based on this observation, we propose \textbf{Lo}ok \textbf{Ba}ck in the \textbf{L}atent \textbf{S}pace (\textbf{Lobals}), a training-free decoding method that identifies the contiguous layer window with the strongest visual-token attention and re-forwards through it, allowing the model to revisit visual evidence in latent space. We demonstrate that this latent-space revisit strategy can improve MLLMs' performance across diverse multimodal settings, including general vision-language tasks, visual hallucination tasks, and vision-centric tasks.

translation.title: 测试时潜在空间计算以提升多模态大语言模型的视觉感知
translation.abstract: 近期关于大语言模型（LLM）的研究表明，推理能力不仅可以通过更长的 token 级推理链在测试时得到增强，还可以通过潜在空间中的额外计算来提升。这为多模态大语言模型（MLLM）提出了一个自然的问题：潜在空间中的额外计算能否在测试时改善视觉感知？在本工作中，我们首先验证了 MLLM 中存在稳定且可复用的层，可以在推理时重新前向传播而不破坏正常生成。基于这一观察，我们提出了 Look Back in the Latent Space（Lobals），一种无需训练的解码方法，它识别出视觉 token 注意力最强的连续层窗口并对其进行重新前向传播，使模型能够在潜在空间中重新审视视觉证据。我们证明，这种潜在空间回溯策略可以在多种多模态设置下提升 MLLM 的性能，包括通用视觉语言任务、视觉幻觉任务和以视觉为中心的任务。
translation.brief: 针对测试时提升 MLLM 视觉感知的问题，提出无需训练的 Lobals 方法，通过识别并重新前向传播视觉注意力最强的层窗口，让模型在潜在空间中回溯视觉证据。

papers.title: When an AI agent makes a mistake in a database, what decides the damage?
papers.abstract: AI agents now run statements against production databases, and several of the incidents that followed deleted production data, which came back only through backups or the provider's help. We ask what decides the damage when such an agent makes a mistake: the model, a guard layer in front of the database, or the database engine itself. The study has two preregistered layers. In Layer A, a frozen library of 22 canonical mistakes is applied by script, with no model involved, to four relational engines under five permission arms and two recovery arms, followed by an engine-native recovery drill (792 cells; 874 drill runs including 10-minute repeats). In Layer B, a minimal tool-calling agent driven by six small open-weight models (4B to 12B parameters, plus one 35B mixture-of-experts model with about 3B active, served locally) works on tasks that contain hazards across nine engines: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, ClickHouse, Apache Cassandra, MongoDB, Valkey, Apache Kafka and OpenSearch (9,468 trials). A secondary run added MariaDB, Redis and Elasticsearch (2,916 trials); each behaved like its closest core engine. Out of the box, the engines differ less in what a mistake destroys than in what they let you undo. Three of the seven preregistered hypotheses met their decision rule: H2 (for one of nine damage classes) and H3 largely by construction of the arms, and H4 only under its original measure. Four did not; one of them (H5) was uninformative, because in its task the agents never found the credential. The post-hoc analyses (S1-S13) are exploratory and uncorrected for multiple comparisons; on PostgreSQL, MySQL, OpenSearch and ClickHouse the preregistered outcome and original-row loss disagree about G1. We report all of them, with every deviation from the preregistration and its timing.

translation.title: 当 AI 智能体在数据库中犯错时，什么决定了损害程度？
translation.abstract: AI 智能体现在会对生产数据库执行语句，随后发生的若干事故删除了生产数据，只能通过备份或供应商的帮助才得以恢复。我们探究当这样的智能体犯错时，什么决定了损害程度：是模型、数据库前的防护层，还是数据库引擎本身。该研究包含两个预注册层。在 A 层中，一个包含 22 种典型错误的冻结错误库由脚本执行（不涉及模型），作用于四个关系型引擎，在五种权限配置和两种恢复配置下进行，随后进行引擎原生的恢复演练（792 个单元格；874 次演练运行，包括 10 分钟的重复运行）。在 B 层中，由六个小型开源权重模型（4B 到 12B 参数，外加一个约 3B 激活参数的 35B 混合专家模型，均在本地部署）驱动的最小工具调用智能体，在九个引擎上执行包含危险的任务：PostgreSQL、MySQL、SQLite、ClickHouse、Apache Cassandra、MongoDB、Valkey、Apache Kafka 和 OpenSearch（9,468 次试验）。补充运行增加了 MariaDB、Redis 和 Elasticsearch（2,916 次试验）；它们的表现均与其最接近的核心引擎类似。开箱即用时，各引擎的差异不在于错误会破坏什么，而在于允许你撤销什么。七个预注册假设中有三个达到了判定标准：H2（针对九种损害类别之一）和 H3 在很大程度上由实验配置本身决定，H4 仅在其原始度量下成立。其余四个未达标；其中一个（H5）无信息量，因为在其任务中智能体从未找到凭据。事后分析（S1-S13）是探索性的且未做多重比较校正；在 PostgreSQL、MySQL、OpenSearch 和 ClickHouse 上，预注册结果与原始行损失在 G1 上不一致。我们报告了所有结果，包括每一处偏离预注册的情况及其时间。
translation.brief: 研究 AI 智能体在数据库中犯错时损害程度由什么决定，通过预注册的脚本化错误库实验和六个小型开源模型驱动的工具调用智能体实验，在多种数据库引擎上系统评估模型、防护层与引擎本身的作用。

papers.title: Policy Invariance Is Not Learning Invariance: Potential-Based Reward Shaping for Navigation with a Limited View
papers.abstract: Potential-based reward shaping (PBRS) does not change the optimal policy, but how much it speeds up learning depends on the potential and on effects outside this guarantee. We analyse how PBRS changes the one-step reward while it preserves the discounted return: a per-step $(\gamma-1)\Phi$ term, the terminal-state rule, a constant shift of the potential, and positive cycles in a bonus that is not potential-based. We then measure these consequences in pre-registered experiments with a PPO agent. The agent has a limited egocentric view and is tested on two MiniGrid navigation tasks (160 runs, 10 seeds per condition). On LavaCrossing, a geodesic (BFS) potential learned faster than both the sparse baseline and a Euclidean potential with a 7x7 and a 5x5 view (AUC difference +0.27 to +0.39, Holm p between 0.007 and 0.0499). The Euclidean potential did not differ from the baseline. In 20 runs with a non-potential bonus, none of the agents learned the task. The Euclidean potential caused more than twice as many deaths in lava during early training. View size did not detectably change the benefit of shaping. With a 5x5 view on SimpleCrossing, some BFS runs got stuck in loops and never learned; shifting the potential did not remove this, so the per-step term alone does not explain it.

translation.title: 策略不变性不等于学习不变性：有限视野导航中的基于势函数的奖励塑形
translation.abstract: 基于势函数的奖励塑形（PBRS）不会改变最优策略，但其对学习速度的提升程度取决于势函数的选择以及该保证之外的影响。我们分析了 PBRS 在保持折扣回报不变的同时如何改变单步奖励：每步的 $(\gamma-1)\Phi$ 项、终止状态规则、势函数的常数平移，以及非势函数奖励中的正循环。随后我们在预注册实验中用 PPO 智能体测量这些影响。该智能体具有有限的自我中心视野，并在两个 MiniGrid 导航任务上进行测试（160 次运行，每个条件 10 个随机种子）。在 LavaCrossing 上，在 7x7 和 5x5 视野下，学习到的测地线（BFS）势函数比稀疏基线和欧几里得势函数学习得更快（AUC 差异 +0.27 到 +0.39，Holm p 值在 0.007 到 0.0499 之间）。欧几里得势函数与基线没有差异。在使用非势函数奖励的 20 次运行中，没有任何智能体学会该任务。欧几里得势函数在训练早期导致的熔岩死亡次数是两倍以上。视野大小没有可检测地改变塑形的收益。在 SimpleCrossing 上使用 5x5 视野时，一些 BFS 运行陷入循环且从未学会任务；平移势函数无法消除这一现象，因此仅凭每步项无法解释它。
translation.brief: 研究 PBRS 势函数选择如何影响有限视野导航任务的学习速度，通过分析单步奖励变化机制并在 MiniGrid 上用 PPO 智能体进行预注册实验，比较 BFS 与欧几里得势函数的效果。

papers.title: Revisiting LLMs as Context Engineers
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are used in more and more new tasks, context engineering becomes a fundamental method to efficiently steer LLMs by constructing instruction prompts or metadata without intensive training. A growing number of LLM context engineering (LCE) approaches automate the task by casting the LLM itself as the engineer that draws generalizable instructions or experiences from offline trials as context. Although these methods resemble how humans learn from experiences, it remains unclear \textbf{when and how} LLMs can engineer effective context from data. To answer the question, we first establish a benchmark composed of datasets with different reasoning patterns. We compared different LCE methods with different LLM families in 8B size, showing that there is no single winner for all tasks, even compared with simple baselines like chain-of-thought. Even when scaling model capabilities via more parameters or generation iterations, LCEs do not consistently boost existing performance. Across all datasets and models, the performance gains of LCEs are negatively correlated ($r=-0.5, p\le 0.05$) with the diversity of the failure modes of reasoning trajectories. Investigating how LCEs work, we find that (1) the improvement in instruction adherence can explain some success of LCEs; (2) one major bottleneck is whether LLMs can extract effective experiences out of natively diverse failures. Through this study, we uncover the limited capabilities of LCEs in abstracting principled contexts from diverse failure modes and understand how LCEs work, providing guidelines for future work.

translation.title: 重新审视 LLM 作为上下文工程师
translation.abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）被应用于越来越多的新任务，上下文工程成为一种无需大量训练即可高效引导 LLM 的基础方法，其方式是构建指令提示或元数据。越来越多的 LLM 上下文工程（LCE）方法将 LLM 本身作为工程师来自动化这一任务，从离线试验中提取可泛化的指令或经验作为上下文。尽管这些方法类似于人类从经验中学习的方式，但 LLM 何时以及如何能从数据中工程化出有效上下文仍不清楚。为回答这一问题，我们首先建立了一个由具有不同推理模式的数据集组成的基准。我们比较了不同 LCE 方法与不同 8B 规模 LLM 家族的表现，结果表明没有任何单一方法在所有任务上胜出，甚至与思维链等简单基线相比也是如此。即使通过更多参数或更多生成迭代来扩展模型能力，LCE 也不能持续提升现有性能。在所有数据集和模型上，LCE 的性能提升与推理轨迹失败模式的多样性呈负相关（r=-0.5, p≤0.05）。通过研究 LCE 的工作机制，我们发现：（1）指令遵循能力的提升可以解释 LCE 的部分成功；（2）一个主要瓶颈是 LLM 能否从天然多样的失败中提取有效经验。通过本研究，我们揭示了 LCE 在从多样失败模式中抽象出有原则的上下文方面的有限能力，并理解了 LCE 的工作机制，为未来工作提供了指导。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 上下文工程（LCE）方法何时以及如何能从数据中工程化出有效上下文，通过构建多推理模式基准并系统比较不同 LCE 方法与 LLM 家族，揭示其性能提升与失败模式多样性的负相关关系及关键瓶颈。

papers.title: When Does Continual Pre-Training Help? An Empirical Study of Decoupled Knowledge and Generation Trajectories in Clinical LLMs
papers.abstract: Continual pre-training (\textit{CPT}) is a standard route for domain adaptation, yet existing studies typically track pre-training loss or multiple-choice question answering (\textit{MCQA}) accuracy alone, offering only a narrow view of how adaptation unfolds. We jointly track factual knowledge via \textit{MCQA} and open-ended behavior via pairwise preference rankings across $18$ checkpoints for each of eight instruction-tuned \textit{Qwen} models ($0.5B$ to $8B$), adapted to German medicine with \textit{CPT} and \textit{SLERP} merging. The two axes converge at consistently different rates, with preference rankings reaching $90\%$ of their total gain after a median of $1.7B$ tokens versus $3.5B$ for \textit{MCQA}. A judge-free token-distribution measure reaches this threshold at $1.9B$ tokens. Per-aspect scores indicate that these early preference gains largely reflect surface alignment, meaning models can sound domain-appropriate before their factual knowledge catches up. Larger adapted models close more of the gap to unadapted next-tier generalists, whereas preference gain per FLOP falls by about an order of magnitude across our size range. We therefore argue that judge-based preference scores, which can plateau while \textit{MCQA} knowledge is still improving, should not be used alone to infer adaptation convergence or domain readiness.

translation.title: 持续预训练何时有效？临床 LLM 中解耦的知识与生成轨迹的实证研究
translation.abstract: 持续预训练（CPT）是领域适配的标准路径，然而现有研究通常仅跟踪预训练损失或多选题问答（MCQA）准确率，对适配过程的展开只提供了狭窄的视角。我们通过 MCQA 联合跟踪事实知识，并通过成对偏好排序跟踪开放式行为，对象是八个指令微调的 Qwen 模型（0.5B 到 8B）各自的 18 个检查点，这些模型通过 CPT 和 SLERP 合并适配到德国医学领域。这两个维度以持续不同的速率收敛：偏好排序在中位数 1.7B token 后达到其总增益的 90%，而 MCQA 需要 3.5B token。一种无需评判器的 token 分布度量在 1.9B token 时达到该阈值。分维度得分表明，这些早期的偏好增益主要反映表面上的对齐，即模型在事实知识跟上之前就能听起来符合领域风格。更大的适配模型能缩小与未适配的下一层级通用模型之间更多的差距，而每 FLOP 的偏好增益在我们的规模范围内下降约一个数量级。因此我们认为，基于评判器的偏好得分可能在 MCQA 知识仍在提升时趋于平台期，不应单独用于推断适配收敛或领域就绪。
translation.brief: 研究持续预训练在临床 LLM 领域适配中的实际效果，通过同时跟踪八个 Qwen 模型多个检查点的 MCQA 事实知识与偏好排序生成行为，揭示两条轨迹收敛速率不同及偏好得分可能误导适配判断的问题。

papers.title: sudo L7: Can Coding Agents Act Like Staff Engineers?
papers.abstract: Coding agents can now turn a well-specified ticket into a patch that passes its tests. Experienced engineers also notice risks the request never mentioned, question flawed premises, reuse what already exists and say plainly what they did and did not check. We present sudo L7, a benchmark of 60 software-engineering tasks written by staff-level engineers, mostly in private production codebases and each built around a place where a frontier model failed. A task pairs a realistic, underspecified request with a hidden, expert-authored rubric of atomic criteria (1,287 in all), tagged with eight behavioral dimensions from functional correctness to truthful reporting. An agentic grader reads the agent's transcript, inspects and runs its code, and treats test output as evidence. An attempt passes only if it meets every criterion of the two highest severities, and more than half of these gating criteria test something other than functional correctness. On the public leaderboard as of November 2026 (19 models, each in its developer's harness or in OpenCode, three attempts per task), Claude Fable 5.2 passes 52.2% of attempts, Claude Sonnet 5.5 50.6% and Claude Opus 5.5 46.1%. GPT-6.1 Sol, Claude Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra pass 31-34%, and the other 13 models at most 18.9%. In a human-label study, three candidate model graders each agreed with a software engineer on 85-86% of criterion verdicts, about as often as two engineers agreed with each other. Cases from the benchmark show how one unsupported claim can fail an otherwise strong attempt and illustrate two sides of engineering judgment: flagging hidden hazards and avoiding needless work.

translation.title: sudo L7：编码智能体能像资深工程师一样工作吗？
translation.abstract: 编码智能体现在能够将一个明确指定的工单转化为通过测试的补丁。但经验丰富的工程师还会注意到需求中从未提及的风险、质疑有缺陷的前提、复用已有的成果，并坦率地说明自己检查了什么、没检查什么。我们提出 sudo L7，一个由资深工程师编写的 60 个软件工程任务构成的基准，任务大多来自私有生产代码库，且每个任务都围绕一个前沿模型曾经失败的地方构建。每个任务将一个真实的、欠规范的需求与一份隐藏的、由专家撰写的原子化评分标准（共 1,287 条）配对，并标注了从功能正确性到如实汇报等八个行为维度。一个智能体评分器会阅读智能体的执行记录、检查并运行其代码，并将测试输出作为证据。只有满足两个最高严重级别的所有标准，该次尝试才算通过，而这些门控标准中超过一半测试的并非功能正确性。在截至 2026 年 11 月的公开排行榜上（19 个模型，各自使用其开发者的 harness 或 OpenCode，每个任务尝试三次），Claude Fable 5.2 的通过率为 52.2%，Claude Sonnet 5.5 为 50.6%，Claude Opus 5.5 为 46.1%。GPT-6.1 Sol、Claude Fable 5.1 和 GPT-6 Astra 的通过率为 31-34%，其余 13 个模型最高不超过 18.9%。在一项人工标注研究中，三个候选模型评分器与软件工程师在 85-86% 的标准判定上达成一致，与两名工程师之间的一致率相当。基准中的案例展示了一条无依据的断言如何让一次本已很强的尝试失败，并体现了工程判断的两个方面：识别隐藏的风险和避免不必要的工作。
translation.brief: 该论文构建了评估编码智能体资深工程判断力的基准 sudo L7，通过专家评分标准与智能体评分器来衡量模型在欠规范任务中识别风险、避免冗余工作和如实汇报的能力。

papers.title: Can LLMs Understand Human Rules?
papers.abstract: Rules help people coordinate and cooperate for mutual benefit. For AI models to coexist with humans and other AI systems, they will need to interact with and navigate such rules successfully. But such interactions require AI systems to recognize not only when a rule permits or prohibits a particular action, but also cases where people may reasonably disagree about whether a certain action is appropriate. This paper introduces the RULES benchmark---building on a set of 300 images depicting signs posted around New York City, and accompanied by 937 scenarios---to test frontier models' ability to discern whether a proposed action is socially acceptable, unacceptable, or would generate disagreement. At first pass, we find that frontier models exhibit robust performance on the benchmark, successfully engaging with human-written directives in naturalistic visual environments, and correctly determining the social acceptability of a wide range of everyday activities. However, we further find that models systematically fail to recognize certain widely accepted permissible exceptions to a rule, indicating a critical shortcoming in model understanding. Moreover, models struggle to identify instances where humans disagree regarding the application of a given rule; in these instances, models tend to identify proposed actions as unacceptable, rather than as appropriate targets of disagreement. We do find that ensembling a series of diverse models together begins to recover the disagreement signal. Overall, our findings identify significant limitations in AI performance on human rules.

translation.title: LLM 能理解人类规则吗？
translation.abstract: 规则帮助人们协调与合作以实现共同利益。AI 模型要与人类及其他 AI 系统共存，就需要成功地与这些规则交互并在其中导航。但这种交互要求 AI 系统不仅能识别规则何时允许或禁止某个特定行为，还要能识别人们对某一行为是否得体可能存在合理分歧的情形。本文提出 RULES 基准——基于 300 张纽约市街头标识牌图片及配套的 937 个场景——用于测试前沿模型辨别一个提议行为是社会可接受、不可接受还是会引发分歧的能力。初步结果显示，前沿模型在该基准上表现稳健，能够成功理解自然视觉环境中人类书写的指令，并正确判断各种日常活动的社会可接受性。然而，我们进一步发现，模型系统性地无法识别某些被广泛接受的规则例外情形，这暴露了模型理解上的关键缺陷。此外，模型难以识别人类对规则适用存在分歧的情形；在这些情形下，模型倾向于将提议行为判定为不可接受，而非存在合理分歧。我们确实发现，将多个多样化模型集成在一起可以开始恢复分歧信号。总体而言，我们的发现揭示了 AI 在理解人类规则方面的重大局限。
translation.brief: 该论文构建了基于纽约街头标识牌的 RULES 基准，测试 LLM 判断行为社会可接受性及识别人类规则分歧的能力，发现模型难以识别规则的可接受例外与合理分歧情形。

papers.title: Fetch, Read, Reuse: How AI Search Agents Bend the Web's Rules
papers.abstract: AI search agents form a new and fast-growing class of web traffic. Like a browser, they fetch pages on demand for one user; like a transcoding proxy, they rewrite what they fetch; and like a shared cache, they answer other users' questions from the stored copy. The rules publishers rely on, such as this http URL, Retry-After, and Cache-Control, were written for more familiar clients, so the agent's vendor decides which of them to follow. We present a black-box measurement study of how these agents fetch, read, and reuse pages, covering the search APIs of OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, and Google and the consumer apps of ten services. We find that OpenAI and xAI do not honor this http URL, and no service acts on Retry-After. Services silently read less than the origin served: OpenAI drops some formats, no service reads JavaScript-only content, and xAI reads only the first 0.5 MB of a page. OpenAI, Anthropic, and xAI share fetched pages across users and largely ignore Cache-Control, so answers can reflect outdated pages for 30 minutes to a day or more. Publishers therefore lack effective control: directives are advisory and followed selectively, describe the served page rather than the rewritten copy, and bound how long a copy is reused but not how many answers it serves. We release our code and data.

translation.title: 抓取、阅读、复用：AI 搜索智能体如何改变 Web 的规则
translation.abstract: AI 搜索智能体构成了一类新兴且快速增长的 Web 流量。它们像浏览器一样按需为单个用户抓取页面；像转码代理一样改写抓取的内容；又像共享缓存一样用存储的副本回答其他用户的问题。发布者所依赖的规则，如 robots.txt（this http URL）、Retry-After 和 Cache-Control，是为更熟悉的客户端编写的，因此是否遵守这些规则由智能体厂商决定。我们对这些智能体如何抓取、阅读和复用页面进行了黑盒测量研究，涵盖 OpenAI、Anthropic、xAI 和 Google 的搜索 API 以及十个服务的消费级应用。我们发现 OpenAI 和 xAI 不遵守 robots.txt，且没有任何服务响应 Retry-After。各服务会静默地读取少于源站提供的内容：OpenAI 会丢弃某些格式，没有服务读取仅含 JavaScript 的内容，xAI 只读取页面的前 0.5 MB。OpenAI、Anthropic 和 xAI 在用户间共享抓取的页面，且基本无视 Cache-Control，因此答案可能反映 30 分钟到一天甚至更久之前的过时页面。因此发布者缺乏有效的控制手段：指令仅具建议性质且被选择性遵守，指令描述的是所提供的页面而非改写后的副本，且只能限制副本被复用的时长而无法限制它服务的答案数量。我们公开了代码和数据。
translation.brief: 该论文通过黑盒测量研究 AI 搜索智能体如何抓取、阅读和复用网页，发现各厂商选择性遵守 robots.txt、Retry-After 和 Cache-Control 等规则，导致发布者缺乏有效控制手段。

papers.title: Near-Far Attention: Region-Aware Sparse Retrieval for Long-Context LLM Decoding
papers.abstract: Sparse attention reduces the cost of long-context decoding, but token selection introduces additional scoring and ranking overhead. Moreover, uniform page scoring overlooks differences in relevance between near and far context. We propose Near-Far Attention (NFA), which adapts retrieval to regional attention patterns while keeping candidate scoring lightweight. During prefill, the Lightweight Gate Estimator identifies regions that can be skipped during decoding, adding less than 1% to dense-prefill time. For the remaining regions, the Calibration-Free Subspace Extractor supplies compact features shared by page-level and token-level scoring without offline calibration. The Distance-Aware Two-Level Selector then scores near and far pages differently and jointly ranks candidate tokens under a shared budget. Evaluations across model families, parameter scales, and GQA/MLA architectures show aggregate task quality comparable to full attention. On Qwen3-8B at 512K context length, NFA achieves up to $5.49\times$ operator speedup and $2.97\times$ whole-model decoding speedup over FlashInfer, including selection overhead.

translation.title: Near-Far Attention：面向长上下文 LLM 解码的区域感知稀疏检索
translation.abstract: 稀疏注意力可以降低长上下文解码的成本，但 token 选择会引入额外的打分和排序开销。此外，统一的页面打分忽视了近处上下文与远处上下文在相关性上的差异。我们提出 Near-Far Attention（NFA），在保持候选打分轻量的同时，使检索适配区域性的注意力模式。在 prefill 阶段，轻量门控估计器（Lightweight Gate Estimator）识别出解码时可跳过的区域，为稠密 prefill 增加的时间不足 1%。对于其余区域，免校准子空间提取器（Calibration-Free Subspace Extractor）提供页面级和 token 级打分共享的紧凑特征，无需离线校准。随后，距离感知的两级选择器（Distance-Aware Two-Level Selector）对近处和远处页面采用不同的打分方式，并在共享预算下对候选 token 进行联合排序。在多个模型家族、参数规模和 GQA/MLA 架构上的评估表明，NFA 的总体任务质量与全注意力相当。在 512K 上下文长度的 Qwen3-8B 上，NFA 相比 FlashInfer 实现了最高 5.49 倍的算子加速和 2.97 倍的整模型解码加速（含选择开销）。
translation.brief: 该论文提出 Near-Far Attention（NFA），通过轻量门控、免校准子空间特征和距离感知的两级选择器，在长上下文解码中实现区域感知的稀疏检索以降低注意力成本。

papers.title: RAPID: Codec-Aware Video Decoding for Efficient Long-Video Understanding
papers.abstract: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) can process hour-long videos, but the large number of input frames incurs substantial inference overhead. Existing approaches to efficient long-video understanding largely overlook video decoding, which can take longer than LLM prefill. We propose RAPID (Reference- and Access-Point-Informed Decoding), a codec-aware framework that exploits information embedded in compressed bitstreams to reduce both frame decoding and selection costs. RAPID consists of two components. RAPID-Dec exploits reference-frame information and random access points to skip unnecessary frames and decode the retained frames in parallel while preserving exact reconstruction of the target frames. It achieves up to a 3.7x decoding speedup over the fastest baseline on H.264/AVC videos. RAPID-Sel uses keyframes as coarse representatives of video segments, avoiding the dense candidate decoding and scoring required by existing frame selection methods. It achieves comparable accuracy with up to a 3.0x preprocessing speedup. Together, RAPID achieves a 4.9x time to first token (TTFT) speedup on hour-long videos over a state-of-the-art frame selection method using the fastest baseline decoder.

translation.title: RAPID：面向高效长视频理解的编解码器感知视频解码
translation.abstract: 近期的视觉语言模型（VLM）可以处理长达一小时的视频，但大量输入帧会带来可观的推理开销。现有的高效长视频理解方法大多忽视了视频解码环节，而解码耗时可能超过 LLM prefill。我们提出 RAPID（基于参考帧和访问点的解码），一个编解码器感知的框架，利用压缩码流中嵌入的信息来同时降低帧解码和帧选择的成本。RAPID 包含两个组件。RAPID-Dec 利用参考帧信息和随机访问点跳过不必要的帧，并并行解码保留的帧，同时保持目标帧的精确重建。在 H.264/AVC 视频上，它相比最快的基线实现了最高 3.7 倍的解码加速。RAPID-Sel 使用关键帧作为视频片段的粗粒度代表，避免了现有帧选择方法所需的密集候选解码与打分。它以最高 3.0 倍的预处理加速实现了相当的准确率。结合两者，RAPID 在小时级视频上相比使用最快基线解码器的最先进帧选择方法，实现了 4.9 倍的首 token 时间（TTFT）加速。
translation.brief: 该论文提出 RAPID，利用压缩码流中的参考帧和随机访问点信息加速视频解码，并用关键帧简化帧选择，从而显著降低长视频理解的推理开销。

papers.title: Learning What to Change: State-Verified Reinforcement Learning for Educational Agents
papers.abstract: Persistent tutoring agents do more than answer questions: they manage course files, practice records, and learner profiles that govern future lessons. In such stateful settings, knowing what to teach does not guarantee knowing what to change. We identify a pervasive failure mode, content-state decoupling, where agents deliver pedagogically sound responses while silently corrupting workspace state through unwarranted updates, missed prerequisites, or unintended side effects. Text-level judges overlook these state errors, whereas isolated tool-call checks break down because whether a write action is valid depends jointly on the learner request, prior state, and execution order. We propose State-Verified Reinforcement Learning, which supervises online policy optimization directly through verifiable workspace transitions. Within isolated sandboxes that snapshot state around every tool call, a deterministic verifier audits tool effects, workflow ordering, and native auto-sync side effects, pairing graded partial credit with a hard gate that zeroes episode reward upon any critical violation. Whenever no critical violation occurs, an evidence-grounded judge scores actual saved artifacts rather than agent claims. We pair 1,000 verifiable training instances with an independently authored, human-reviewed evaluation benchmark of 60 tasks spanning 11 educational categories and 16 native tools. After online GRPO training, Qwen3.8-27B raises category-weighted strict success on our benchmark from 51.47% to 80.74% (+29.27 points), cutting content-pass-only execution failures from 45.6% to 13.7% and required state-check failures from 63 to 1 across 180 trials. The resulting policy outperforms seven reference baselines by over 20 points while reducing output tokens by 17-39% across seven of eight external benchmarks without regressing on general reasoning or tool use.

translation.title: 学习改变什么：面向教育智能体的状态验证强化学习
translation.abstract: 持久化的辅导智能体不仅要回答问题，还要管理课程文件、练习记录和学习者档案，这些状态会影响后续课程。在这类有状态的环境中，知道教什么并不等于知道改什么。我们识别出一种普遍的失败模式——内容-状态解耦：智能体给出教学上合理的回复，却通过无依据的更新、遗漏前置条件或意外的副作用悄悄破坏工作区状态。文本层面的评判器会忽视这些状态错误，而孤立的工具调用检查也会失效，因为一次写操作是否有效取决于学习者请求、先前状态和执行顺序的共同作用。我们提出状态验证强化学习，通过可验证的工作区状态转移直接监督在线策略优化。在围绕每次工具调用对状态做快照的隔离沙箱中，一个确定性验证器审计工具效果、工作流顺序以及原生自动同步副作用，将分级部分得分与硬性门槛结合：一旦出现任何关键违规，整个回合的奖励归零。在没有关键违规时，一个基于证据的评判器对实际保存的产物而非智能体的声明进行打分。我们构建了1,000个可验证训练实例，以及一个独立编写、经人工审核的评测基准，涵盖11个教育类别和16个原生工具的60个任务。经过在线GRPO训练后，Qwen3.8-27B在该基准上的类别加权严格成功率从51.47%提升到80.74%（+29.27个百分点），将仅内容通过但执行失败的比例从45.6%降至13.7%，在180次试验中将必需状态检查失败次数从63次降至1次。所得策略在七个参考基线上领先超过20分，同时在八个外部基准中的七个上将输出token减少17-39%，且不损害通用推理或工具使用能力。
translation.brief: 针对教育智能体在执行操作时破坏工作区状态的问题，提出通过沙箱中可验证的状态转移和确定性验证器直接监督在线强化学习训练。

papers.title: Proper and Optimal Scoring Rules for Risk-Averse Agents
papers.abstract: Scoring rules are used to elicit probabilistic beliefs through payments that depend on reports and realised outcomes. We ask how these rules should be designed to induce truthful reporting and incentivise costly information acquisition when the agent is risk averse. For agents with entropic risk preferences in finite state spaces, we characterise proper scoring rules through an exponential transformation, derive optimal structures for information acquisition under bounded payments, and obtain explicit optimal coefficients in the binary case. The risk-neutral limit preserves properness and, in the binary case, optimality, while recovering the optimal betting structure for nonbinary states. For optimal design in the binary model, it suffices to focus on rules whose associated concave function is affine on each side of the prior. The optimal coefficients depend only on the prior and the risk-aversion parameter. The binary optimal rules we construct also admit an exact transformation from a particular risk-neutral optimal rule. In the nonbinary model, optimal design reduces to choosing the best prior bound in a transformed betting mechanism.

translation.title: 面向风险厌恶型智能体的恰当与最优评分规则
translation.abstract: 评分规则通过依赖报告和实际结果的支付来引出概率信念。我们探讨当智能体是风险厌恶时，应如何设计这些规则以诱导真实报告并激励代价高昂的信息获取。对于有限状态空间中具有熵风险偏好的智能体，我们通过指数变换刻画恰当评分规则，推导出有界支付下信息获取的最优结构，并在二值情形下得到显式的最优系数。风险中性极限保持了恰当性，在二值情形下也保持最优性，并恢复了非二值状态下的最优下注结构。对于二值模型中的最优设计，只需关注其关联凹函数在先验两侧均为仿射的规则。最优系数仅取决于先验和风险厌恶参数。我们构造的二值最优规则还可以从某个特定的风险中性最优规则通过精确变换得到。在非二值模型中，最优设计归结为在变换后的下注机制中选择最佳先验界。
translation.brief: 研究风险厌恶智能体下的评分规则设计，通过指数变换刻画恰当性并推导二值与非二值情形下的最优结构。

papers.title: Improving Repair Agents with Cause-Chain Diagnoses
papers.abstract: Repair agents resolve a growing share of real-world issues. Starting with the same information as a developer reading a bug report, they have to find out how the program fails before actually fixing it. We present FORECAST, which provides repair agents with a diagnosis of the failure. From the executions of passing and failing tests, FORECAST infers a cause chain, a short sequence of execution features, such as conditions or data flow, that explains how the failing runs diverge. FORECAST appends this cause chain to the issue an agent receives. It thus works with any agent that builds its prompts from the issue, without modifying the agent. We evaluate FORECAST on all 300 issues of SWE-bench Lite with five repair agents and two models, the commercial Claude Haiku 4.5 and the open-weight Qwen3.5. With the cause-chain diagnosis, every agent resolves significantly more issues. Over all agents, the share of resolved issues rises from 48.5% to 70.9% for Haiku 4.5 and from 31.2% to 56.1% for Qwen3.5. The open-weight model with the diagnosis thus surpasses the commercial model without it. The gains persist across repeated runs and for agents that already run the tests the diagnosis is derived from.

translation.title: 利用因果链诊断改进修复智能体
translation.abstract: 修复智能体正在解决越来越多的真实世界问题。它们从与阅读缺陷报告的开发者相同的信息出发，必须先弄清程序如何失败，然后才能真正修复。我们提出FORECAST，为修复智能体提供失败诊断。从通过测试和失败测试的执行中，FORECAST推断出一条因果链——一个简短的执行特征序列（如条件或数据流），解释失败运行如何产生分歧。FORECAST将这条因果链附加到智能体收到的问题描述中，因此适用于任何基于问题描述构建提示的智能体，无需修改智能体本身。我们在SWE-bench Lite的全部300个问题上，用五个修复智能体和两个模型（商业的Claude Haiku 4.5和开放权重的Qwen3.5）评估FORECAST。有了因果链诊断，每个智能体解决的问题都显著增多。在所有智能体上，Haiku 4.5的解决率从48.5%升至70.9%，Qwen3.5从31.2%升至56.1%。因此，带诊断的开放权重模型超越了不带诊断的商业模型。这些增益在重复运行中保持稳定，对已经运行过诊断所依据测试的智能体同样有效。
translation.brief: 针对修复智能体难以定位程序失败原因的问题，提出FORECAST从通过与失败测试的执行差异中推断因果链并附加到问题描述中。

papers.title: Interrogation Protocols for AI Control
papers.abstract: As the intelligence of an AI agent increases relative to a trusted monitor, so does the risk that the monitor will fail to understand the agent's actions or to evaluate them confidently. We introduce interrogation protocols to a high-stakes AI control setting, and allow the monitor to ask the untrusted agent questions about confusing actions. For interrogation to improve safety, a weaker model must be able to distinguish misleading explanations produced by an attack policy from genuine ones produced by an honest policy. We find that on a held-out subset of BashArena, an interrogation protocol improves safety at a 1% audit budget from 72.6% for an actions-only baseline, which does not use interrogations, to 79.5% (+7.0 pp [+0.9, +20.1], 95% paired bootstrap interval), but most of this uplift can be captured by having a trusted model state a specific concern. More broadly, our work suggests that interrogating agents can improve safety, allowing monitors to catch more attacks at a larger capability gap.

translation.title: 面向AI控制的审讯协议
translation.abstract: 随着AI智能体相对于可信监控器的智能水平提升，监控器无法理解智能体行为或无法自信评估这些行为的风险也随之增大。我们将审讯协议引入高风险AI控制场景，允许监控器就令人困惑的行为向不可信智能体提问。要让审讯提升安全性，较弱的模型必须能够区分攻击策略产生的误导性解释与诚实策略产生的真实解释。我们发现在BashArena的一个保留子集上，一种审讯协议在1%审计预算下将安全性从仅基于行为（不使用审讯）的基线的72.6%提升到79.5%（+7.0个百分点 [+0.9, +20.1]，95%配对自助区间），但这一提升的大部分可以通过让可信模型陈述一个具体疑虑来获得。更广泛地说，我们的工作表明审讯智能体可以提升安全性，使监控器在更大的能力差距下捕获更多攻击。
translation.brief: 针对可信监控器难以理解更强不可信智能体行为的问题，提出让监控器向智能体提问的审讯协议以提升AI控制的安全性。

papers.title: Quantizing Diffusion LLMs under Parallel Decoding: Commitment Risk and the Parallelism Tax
papers.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) are served with accelerated decoders that cache context and commit, in one step, every masked position whose confidence clears a threshold. Yet post-training quantization of dLLMs has so far been calibrated and evaluated under fixed-step samplers without caching. We study W4A4 quantization under the deployed decoder and find that the decoder determines both where quantization harms accuracy and what it costs. Irreversible errors enter chiefly through forced commitments, made when no position clears the threshold: they are a minority of commitments but carry most quantization-induced flips. Quantization also levies a parallelism tax, extra forward passes per response: by compressing top logit gaps, it pushes positions below the threshold while leaving predictions largely intact. We propose DECAL, which reweights layer-wise calibration by a commitment-risk prior measured on the deployed decoder, and an argmax-preserving commit temperature that recovers the tax. On LLaDA and Dream, DECAL attains the best average accuracy among W4A4 methods, with lower run-to-run variance than the closest existing calibration method.

translation.title: 并行解码下扩散大语言模型的量化：承诺风险与并行性税
translation.abstract: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）通过加速解码器提供服务，该解码器缓存上下文，并在一步中提交所有置信度超过阈值的掩码位置。然而，迄今为止dLLM的后训练量化都是在不带缓存的固定步长采样器下校准和评估的。我们研究部署解码器下的W4A4量化，发现解码器决定了量化在何处损害精度以及代价是什么。不可逆错误主要通过强制提交进入——即在没有任何位置超过阈值时做出的提交：它们只占提交的少数，却承载了大部分量化引起的翻转。量化还征收一种并行性税，即每个响应额外的前向传播次数：通过压缩顶部logit差距，它使位置低于阈值，而预测本身基本不变。我们提出DECAL，它用在部署解码器上测得的承诺风险先验对逐层校准进行重加权，并提出一种保持argmax的提交温度来收回该税。在LLaDA和Dream上，DECAL在W4A4方法中取得最佳平均精度，且运行间方差低于最接近的现有校准方法。
translation.brief: 针对扩散大语言模型在部署解码器下量化精度受损的问题，提出基于承诺风险先验的逐层校准重加权和保持argmax的提交温度。

papers.title: SuSi-RAG: A Hybrid Graph RAG for Equipment Maintenance
papers.abstract: In the manufacturing domain, equipment maintenance tasks depend on expert knowledge. Their documentation is often stored in heterogeneous formats and sources. The enhancement of LLMs with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is promising for bridging the scattered knowledge, but traditional vector-based RAG shows weaknesses with two characteristics which are common in real maintenance queries: complex causal chains and cross-domain synthesis. To address this, we propose SuSi-RAG, a hybrid Graph RAG solution, that matches a user query and each maintenance record using subgraph similarity. This work shows an in-use system: SuSi-RAG has run on an active Bosch production line for more than eight months, handling 10,664 question-answer interactions and demonstrates upper bound answer accuracy of 96.25% (confirmed error rate 3.75%). In a proof-of-concept, SuSi-RAG improves top-1 retrieval accuracy from 61.5% to 96.2% and expert-rated answer quality from 44.9% to 84.1% against a vector-based baseline. We present an integrated operational feedback loop to update SuSi-RAG.

translation.title: SuSi-RAG：面向设备维护的混合图 RAG
translation.abstract: 在制造领域，设备维护任务依赖专家知识，其文档通常以异构格式和来源存储。用检索增强生成（RAG）增强 LLM 有望弥合分散的知识，但传统的基于向量的 RAG 在真实维护查询中常见的两个特征上表现不佳：复杂因果链和跨领域综合。为此，我们提出 SuSi-RAG，一种混合 Graph RAG 方案，使用子图相似度来匹配用户查询与每条维护记录。这项工作展示了一个实际在用的系统：SuSi-RAG 已在 Bosch 一条活跃生产线上运行超过八个月，处理了 10,664 次问答交互，答案准确率上限达 96.25%（确认错误率 3.75%）。在概念验证中，相比基于向量的基线，SuSi-RAG 将 top-1 检索准确率从 61.5% 提升至 96.2%，专家评定的答案质量从 44.9% 提升至 84.1%。我们还提出了一个集成的运行反馈回路来更新 SuSi-RAG。
translation.brief: 针对设备维护查询中复杂因果链与跨领域综合导致向量 RAG 失效的问题，提出基于子图相似度匹配的混合 Graph RAG 方案 SuSi-RAG。

papers.title: POMA: Beyond Final Flags -- Process-Level Evaluation of Base LLMs in Vulnerability Exploitation
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) evolve from text generation to autonomous software-engineering execution, automated vulnerability exploitability verification has emerged as a vital frontier in software quality assurance and security validation. Existing security benchmarks, however, largely judge models by binary pass/fail outcomes or coarse stage milestones. Such outcome-centric scoring obscures fine-grained failure dynamics across long-horizon execution and conflates the intrinsic capability of a base LLM with external agent scaffolding. We present POMA (Pwn-Oriented Model Assessment), a process-level evaluation methodology and platform that isolates base LLMs under a unified execution baseline -- fixing task inputs, tool interfaces, target environments, feedback formats, and execution budgets -- while measuring intermediate states and transitions from runtime evidence. Evaluating four frontier base LLMs across 55 CTF Pwn challenges and 10 real-world vulnerability reproduction tasks exposes persistent capability attrition along the exploitation chain: from vulnerability knowledge to executable implementation, from client-side actions to verified target states, from failure localization to precise repair, and across iterative revisions. In real-world software, models further struggle to satisfy format, semantic, differential, and crash-identity constraints simultaneously. By pinpointing where execution chains break down, POMA provides an empirical foundation for trustworthy capability assessment and principled vulnerability-agent design. Our benchmark catalogs, process-measurement evaluator, and sample harness are publicly available at this https URL .

translation.title: POMA：超越最终标志——基础 LLM 在漏洞利用中的过程级评估
translation.abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）从文本生成演进为自主软件工程执行，自动化漏洞可利用性验证已成为软件质量保障与安全验证的重要前沿。然而，现有安全基准大多以二元的通过/失败结果或粗粒度的阶段里程碑来评判模型。这种以结果为中心的评分掩盖了长程执行中细粒度的失败动态，并将基础 LLM 的内在能力与外部 agent 脚手架混为一谈。我们提出 POMA（Pwn-Oriented Model Assessment），一种过程级评估方法与平台，在统一的执行基线下——固定任务输入、工具接口、目标环境、反馈格式和执行预算——隔离评估基础 LLM，并从运行时证据中测量中间状态与状态转移。对四个前沿基础 LLM 在 55 个 CTF Pwn 挑战和 10 个真实漏洞复现任务上的评估揭示了利用链上持续的能力衰减：从漏洞知识到可执行实现、从客户端动作到已验证的目标状态、从失败定位到精确修复、以及跨迭代修订。在真实软件中，模型进一步难以同时满足格式、语义、差分和崩溃一致性约束。通过精确定位执行链断裂之处，POMA 为可信能力评估和有原则的漏洞 agent 设计提供了实证基础。我们的基准目录、过程测量评估器和样例 harness 已在 https URL 公开。
translation.brief: 针对现有安全基准只看最终结果而掩盖长程执行失败动态的问题，提出在统一执行基线下测量中间状态与转移的过程级评估方法 POMA。

papers.title: CineAct: Interaction-State Agents for Playable, Branching Film Generation
papers.abstract: Open video generators such as MiniMax-H3 produce short clips of only several to a dozen seconds per run. To synthesize longer sequences, existing methods either rely on agentic systems following preset scripts, or roll out autoregressively from the previous clip's last frame, losing off-screen states and accumulating hallucinations across turns. Consequently, users still cannot take an explicit goal, choose how to accomplish it, and see that choice persist across subsequent clips. We study goal-grounded interactive video generation, where one goal admits multiple valid approaches, the user's chosen approach must be executed on screen, and its consequences must persist across clips. To this end, we propose CineAct, a state-first agentic framework in which language-model agents handle reasoning while frozen image and video generators serve purely as renderers. Before interaction, the Architect initializes the world as a spatial layout with cameras, an asset library, and a scene graph; at each turn, the system deduces the planned state change, generates a target end frame with an image generator and rigorously verifies it, and synthesizes intermediate motion with an FL2V model. We further introduce a multi-space benchmark covering two suites: long-horizon step execution and open-intent branching admissibility. Experiments show that explicit world-state modeling boosts multi-step rollout consistency over the pixel-only baseline (+11.4 automated, +23.1 human points) and raises paired branching success toward a shared goal by +30.8 points.

translation.title: CineAct：面向可玩、分支电影生成的交互状态 Agent
translation.abstract: MiniMax-H3 等开放视频生成器每次只能生成几秒到十几秒的短片段。为合成更长的序列，现有方法要么依赖遵循预设脚本的 agentic 系统，要么从上一片段的最后一帧自回归地展开，丢失屏幕外状态并在多轮间累积幻觉。因此，用户仍然无法设定一个明确目标、选择如何完成它，并看到该选择在后续片段中持续生效。我们研究目标锚定的交互式视频生成，其中一个目标允许多种有效途径，用户选择的途径必须在屏幕上执行，且其后果必须跨片段持续。为此，我们提出 CineAct，一个状态优先的 agentic 框架，其中语言模型 agent 负责推理，而冻结的图像和视频生成器仅作为渲染器。交互之前，Architect 将世界初始化为包含相机、资产库和场景图的空间布局；每一轮，系统推导计划的状态变化，用图像生成器生成目标结束帧并严格验证，再用 FL2V 模型合成中间运动。我们进一步引入一个多空间基准，涵盖两个套件：长程步骤执行和开放意图分支可采纳性。实验表明，显式的世界状态建模将多步展开一致性较纯像素基线提升（自动评估 +11.4，人工评估 +23.1 分），并将朝共同目标的成对分支成功率提升 +30.8 分。
translation.brief: 针对交互式长视频生成中屏幕外状态丢失与幻觉累积的问题，提出以显式世界状态建模为核心、LLM 推理加冻结生成器渲染的状态优先 agent 框架 CineAct。

papers.title: AgentBouncer: Defending Software Engineering Agents via Dynamic System-Call Mediation
papers.abstract: Software engineering (SE) agents can complete diverse engineering tasks by interacting with the development environment via tools that access files, run commands, and download resources. Unfortunately, the same ability that makes SE agents useful also makes them prone to performing unintended malicious actions through prompt injections, malicious tools, or supply-chain attacks. Existing defenses that analyze the agent trajectory may fail to detect such attacks, as they inspect only the initial prompt and the sequence of tool calls, but not the actual actions that are executed in the environment. This paper presents AgentBouncer, a novel runtime enforcement system that prevents SE agents from performing malicious actions by mediating, and if necessary denying, system calls that agents trigger via tool calls. The core of AgentBouncer is an LLM arbiter that judges system calls along two axes, necessity and safety for the current task. It denies unsafe system calls, and the less necessary a system call appears, the more certain the arbiter has to be about its safety to allow it. To manage runtime overhead, preseeded policy rules and hierarchy-aware caching ensure that the LLM arbiter is only invoked for key decisions. We evaluate AgentBouncer on a dataset of 340 attacks on the development environment, covering four attack vectors, combined with benign issue resolution tasks from SWE-bench Verified. AgentBouncer reduces the attack success rate from 99.41% for an unsupervised agent to 10.59%, which is 18.23-73.53 percentage points lower than competitive state-of-the-art defenses. At the same time, AgentBouncer preserves the task success rate of the agent, with only 0.25% failed benign tool calls. Per benign task, AgentBouncer adds 47 seconds and USD 0.0036 in LLM costs to an unsupervised agent, whereas the closest existing runtime defense adds 4.5x as much time and 9.6x as much cost.

translation.title: AgentBouncer：通过动态系统调用中介防御软件工程 Agent
translation.abstract: 软件工程（SE）agent 可以通过与开发环境交互来完成多样的工程任务，其工具可访问文件、运行命令和下载资源。不幸的是，使 SE agent 有用的同一能力也使其容易通过提示注入、恶意工具或供应链攻击执行非预期的恶意操作。现有分析 agent 轨迹的防御可能无法检测此类攻击，因为它们只检查初始提示和工具调用序列，而不检查环境中实际执行的动作。本文提出 AgentBouncer，一种新颖的运行时强制执行系统，通过中介并在必要时拒绝 agent 经由工具调用触发的系统调用，来阻止 SE agent 执行恶意操作。AgentBouncer 的核心是一个 LLM 仲裁器，它沿两个维度——对当前任务的必要性和安全性——评判系统调用。它拒绝不安全的系统调用，且系统调用看起来越不必要，仲裁器就必须对其安全性越有把握才允许它。为控制运行时开销，预置的策略规则和层级感知缓存确保 LLM 仲裁器只在关键决策时被调用。我们在一个包含 340 次针对开发环境攻击（覆盖四种攻击向量）的数据集上评估 AgentBouncer，并结合 SWE-bench Verified 的良性 issue 解决任务。AgentBouncer 将攻击成功率从无监督 agent 的 99.41% 降至 10.59%，比有竞争力的最先进防御低 18.23–73.53 个百分点。同时，AgentBouncer 保持了 agent 的任务成功率，良性工具调用失败率仅 0.25%。每个良性任务，AgentBouncer 为无监督 agent 增加 47 秒和 0.0036 美元的 LLM 成本，而最接近的现有运行时防御增加的时间和成本分别是其 4.5 倍和 9.6 倍。
translation.brief: 针对 SE agent 因提示注入等攻击而执行恶意操作且现有轨迹分析防御检测不到的问题，提出在运行时中介并按必要性与安全性裁决系统调用的防御系统 AgentBouncer。

papers.title: Oops!... I Parsed It Again: Tool-Call Smuggling Against LLM Agents
papers.abstract: LLM agents act through tool calls: the model writes the arguments of a call as JSON, a guard decides whether the call may run, and an executor runs it. The same bytes are parsed several times, by the provider, gateways, SDKs, frameworks, the guard, and the executor. JSON leaves some choices to each parser, such as which copy of a repeated key counts. When the guard and the executor choose differently, the guard approves one call, the executor runs another, and the audit log records the approved one. We introduce this attack, tool-call smuggling, and study it across the stack. We describe six ways in which the same bytes yield different calls and build a differential testing harness that gives identical bytes to 17 pinned parser and validator configurations; most pairs disagree on some inputs, and even two official MCP SDKs accept different inputs. On tasks from $\tau$-bench and AgentDojo, an attacker who can rewrite the bytes in transit cancels another customer's reservation and creates a file that the guard blocks by name, while the audit log names only the approved call. Content the model reads splits guard and executor only inside a string: ten models we test write no repeated or disguised key into the call itself where we see it, but copy one verbatim into JSON text in an argument, which a Python guard and a Go executor read differently. A malicious server copying a legitimate tool's public schema and adding one field, which a note explains, gets the model to fill it, unseen by the guard, with user data. Parsing each call once, JSON text included, keeping only the fields of the approved schema, and handing it to the executor, sealed with its call ID in transit, stops all 7,412 crafted inputs and every attack we built.

translation.title: Oops!... I Parsed It Again：针对 LLM Agent 的工具调用走私攻击
translation.abstract: LLM agent 通过工具调用行动：模型将调用参数写成 JSON，守卫决定该调用是否可以运行，执行器运行它。同一字节会被多个组件多次解析——提供商、网关、SDK、框架、守卫和执行器。JSON 将一些选择留给每个解析器，例如重复键的哪一份副本生效。当守卫和执行器的选择不同时，守卫批准一个调用，执行器运行另一个，而审计日志记录的是被批准的那个。我们提出这种攻击——工具调用走私，并在整个技术栈中研究它。我们描述了同一字节产生不同调用的六种方式，并构建了一个差分测试 harness，将相同字节提供给 17 个固定版本的解析器和验证器配置；大多数配置对在某些输入上不一致，甚至两个官方 MCP SDK 也接受不同的输入。在 τ-bench 和 AgentDojo 的任务上，能够篡改传输中字节的攻击者可以取消另一个客户的预订，并创建一个守卫按名称阻止的文件，而审计日志只记录被批准的调用。模型读取的内容只有在字符串内部才会使守卫与执行器产生分歧：我们测试的十个模型不会在调用本身写入重复或伪装的键，而是将一个键原样复制到参数中的 JSON 文本里，Python 守卫和 Go 执行器对此解析不同。恶意服务器复制合法工具的公开 schema 并添加一个字段（由一条说明解释），就能让模型在守卫看不见的情况下用用户数据填充它。对每次调用只解析一次（包括 JSON 文本）、只保留已批准 schema 的字段、并在传输中用调用 ID 封存后交给执行器，可以阻止全部 7,412 个精心构造的输入和我们构建的所有攻击。
translation.brief: 针对同一工具调用字节被守卫与执行器多次解析产生分歧而绕过安全审计的问题，系统提出并研究工具调用走私攻击，并给出单次解析加 schema 过滤与调用 ID 封存的防御方案。

papers.title: From Rewarding What Models Say to How They Think: Attention Process Reward Model for LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become an important component in large language models (LLMs). However, existing RL approaches focus on final outputs or textual solution trajectories, leading to coarse-grained rewards and unreliable reasoning. Such paradigms focus mainly on what the model outputs while overlooking how the model internally reasons. Therefore, can we reward how a model thinks internally rather than merely what it says? We first reveal the problem of textual reward aliasing in existing reward modeling approaches. Motivated by this, we propose the Attention Process Reward Model (APRM), which assigns internal rewards based on hidden states and attention maps to capture high-quality reasoning patterns. With only approximately 46M parameters, APRM is trained using ranking and counterfactual objectives, and its reward guides RL optimization while being periodically updated to handle distribution shifts. Integrated with representative RL methods, APRM achieved an average pass@8 gain of 2.88\%. Our results demonstrate the promise of incorporating internal reasoning signals into RL for LLMs.

translation.title: 从奖励模型说什么到奖励模型如何思考：面向LLM强化学习的注意力过程奖励模型
translation.abstract: 强化学习（RL）已成为大语言模型（LLM）的重要组成部分。然而，现有的RL方法关注最终输出或文本解题轨迹，导致奖励粒度粗糙、推理不可靠。这类范式主要关注模型输出什么，而忽视了模型内部如何推理。因此，我们能否奖励模型内部如何思考，而不仅仅是它说了什么？我们首先揭示了现有奖励建模方法中的文本奖励混叠问题。受此启发，我们提出注意力过程奖励模型（APRM），基于隐藏状态和注意力图分配内部奖励，以捕捉高质量的推理模式。APRM仅有约46M参数，使用排序和反事实目标进行训练，其奖励引导RL优化，并周期性更新以应对分布偏移。与代表性RL方法集成后，APRM平均pass@8提升2.88%。我们的结果表明，将内部推理信号纳入LLM的RL具有广阔前景。
translation.brief: 针对现有RL奖励只基于文本输出而忽视内部推理的问题，提出基于隐藏状态和注意力图的APRM来提供内部过程奖励并指导RL优化。

papers.title: Uncovering the Tells: Efficient Black-Box Audits for LLM Data Contamination
papers.abstract: Existing methods for assessing training data contamination in Large Language Models achieve high accuracy, but fundamentally rely on gray-box access, rendering them inapplicable to fully black-box environments. This limitation forces auditors to rely on full-sequence sampling or rigid heuristics, both of which incur prohibitive inference costs and struggle to isolate the underlying memorization signal. To overcome this, we propose a generation-based black-box framework that infers context-induced information gain from targeted token discrepancies. We introduce a budget-constrained auditing regime, building on the empirical observation that the membership signal is highly sparse and concentrated in a few highly informative tokens. We formalize this sparsity, showing why uniform sampling needs many more samples than a policy that targets informative positions. Empirically, our approach achieves state-of-the-art black-box separation accuracy while needing about 3x fewer queries than uniform position sampling. Finally, we apply this methodology to closed frontier models, exploring its capacity and limits in surfacing potential training data overlaps on commercial APIs.

translation.title: 揭示线索：面向LLM数据污染的高效黑盒审计
translation.abstract: 现有评估大语言模型训练数据污染的方法准确率高，但根本上依赖灰盒访问，无法应用于完全黑盒环境。这一局限迫使审计者依赖全序列采样或僵化的启发式方法，两者都带来高昂的推理成本，且难以分离底层的记忆信号。为克服这一问题，我们提出一个基于生成的黑盒框架，从有针对性的token差异中推断上下文诱导的信息增益。我们引入预算受限的审计机制，其依据是经验观察：成员信号高度稀疏且集中在少数高信息量token上。我们对这种稀疏性进行形式化，说明为什么均匀采样需要比针对信息位置的策略多得多的样本。实验上，我们的方法实现了最先进的黑盒区分准确率，同时所需查询次数比均匀位置采样少约3倍。最后，我们将该方法应用于闭源前沿模型，探索其在揭示商业API上潜在训练数据重叠方面的能力与局限。
translation.brief: 针对黑盒环境下LLM训练数据污染审计成本高的问题，提出基于目标token差异推断信息增益的生成式审计框架，利用成员信号的稀疏性大幅减少查询次数。

papers.title: Beyond the Black Box: A Diagnosis-Driven Agent for Interpretable MIP Solver Tuning
papers.abstract: Tuning a mixed-integer programming (MIP) solver is an instance-specific problem, where a poor configuration can increase solving time by orders of magnitude. Existing Bayesian optimization tuners treat solver tuning as a black-box optimization problem: each evaluation returns a single score, allowing the tuner to learn which configuration is faster, but not why. Inspired by the use of profilers in GPU-kernel optimization, we introduce APEC (Agent for Per-instance Explainable Configuration), a log-grounded tuning agent for MIP solvers. APEC has three layers: a deterministic layer that profiles each log, an interpretation layer that guides hypothesis-driven diagnosis, and a system layer that controls evaluation, enabling more reliable and interpretable solver tuning. On the full MIPLIB 2017 benchmark set, APEC achieves a 1.58X improvement over the default configuration with over 38% fewer parameter changes than the baselines, making the results easier to read.

translation.title: 超越黑盒：面向可解释MIP求解器调优的诊断驱动智能体
translation.abstract: 混合整数规划（MIP）求解器的调优是实例相关的问题，糟糕的配置可能使求解时间增加数个数量级。现有贝叶斯优化调优器将求解器调优视为黑盒优化问题：每次评估只返回一个分数，使调优器能学到哪个配置更快，但不知道为什么。受GPU核优化中性能分析器使用的启发，我们提出APEC（Agent for Per-instance Explainable Configuration），一个基于日志的MIP求解器调优智能体。APEC包含三层：对每个日志进行性能分析的确定性层、引导假设驱动诊断的解释层，以及控制评估的系统层，从而实现更可靠、更可解释的求解器调优。在完整的MIPLIB 2017基准集上，APEC相比默认配置取得1.58倍改进，参数修改次数比基线少38%以上，使结果更易解读。
translation.brief: 针对MIP求解器调优中黑盒优化无法解释配置优劣原因的问题，提出基于日志分析、假设驱动诊断和评估控制三层结构的可解释调优智能体APEC。

papers.title: DriveDreamer-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of Driving Perception and Agentic Data Generation
papers.abstract: Controllable generation can expand training data for driving perception, but visual realism alone does not ensure learning gains. Effective generation must adapt both what data to generate and how to construct them as the perception model evolves. In this paper, we present DriveDreamer-RSI, a framework for recursive self-improvement of driving perception and agentic data generation through feedback between perception learning and data construction. Its outer loop implements Gap-Guided Target Adaptation, generating labeled videos from current perception gaps and updating targets after training. Its inner loop uses a vision-language agent to iteratively edit scenes through observation and execution feedback. Across rounds, Learning-Feedback-Driven Strategy Refinement derives reusable construction advice from execution experience and downstream learning outcomes. On the nuScenes validation set, DriveDreamer-RSI surpasses the dataset-replay baseline by 4.09 mAP and 4.13 NDS points using approximately half the synthetic frames.

translation.title: DriveDreamer-RSI：驾驶感知与智能体数据生成的递归自我改进
translation.abstract: 可控生成可以扩展驾驶感知的训练数据，但仅视觉逼真并不能保证学习收益。有效的生成必须随着感知模型的演进，同时调整生成什么数据以及如何构建数据。本文提出DriveDreamer-RSI，一个通过感知学习与数据构建之间的反馈实现驾驶感知与智能体数据生成递归自我改进的框架。其外循环实现Gap-Guided Target Adaptation，根据当前感知差距生成带标注视频，并在训练后更新目标。其内循环使用视觉-语言智能体，通过观察和执行反馈迭代编辑场景。跨轮次中，Learning-Feedback-Driven Strategy Refinement从执行经验和下游学习结果中提炼可复用的构建建议。在nuScenes验证集上，DriveDreamer-RSI使用约一半的合成帧，超越数据集回放基线4.09 mAP和4.13 NDS。
translation.brief: 针对合成数据生成无法随感知模型演进自适应调整的问题，提出通过感知学习与数据构建双向反馈实现递归自我改进的DriveDreamer-RSI框架。

papers.title: Optimising VLM Harnesses to Localise Errors in Generated Videos
papers.abstract: Identifying subtle errors in generated videos is an important step toward automated video generation, where errors must be detected to assess and refine generated clips. Recent work shows that pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) can localise such errors, but their effectiveness depends strongly on the workflow used: choices about which frames to inspect, which tools and model calls to make, and how to combine predictions can lead to substantially different results. We study VLM harnesses for video error localisation. Instead of relying on manually designed harnesses, we propose Harness Search and Merge (HSM), an algorithm that automatically constructs them by searching over executable evaluation programs. An LLM orchestrator refines candidate harnesses independently on random training subsets, records findings in a memory, and constructively merges complementary candidates. We evaluate HSM on Spotlight, a recently proposed benchmark for localising errors in generated videos. HSM achieves 0.234 +- 0.012 F1, exceeding the strongest benchmark strategy (0.173 +- 0.016), and retains its lead on an unseen video generator (0.213 +- 0.008 versus 0.140 +- 0.003). On IPV-Bench, it achieves strong localisation performance with lower false-alarm rates than existing optimisation baselines. Together, these results show that searching over complete VLM harnesses can outperform existing evaluation strategies, transfer to an unseen video generator, and reduce false alarms on real videos.

translation.title: 优化VLM Harness以定位生成视频中的错误
translation.abstract: 识别生成视频中的细微错误是迈向自动化视频生成的重要一步，需要检测错误以评估和改进生成的片段。近期工作表明，预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）可以定位此类错误，但其效果很大程度上取决于所用的工作流程：检查哪些帧、调用哪些工具和模型、如何组合预测等选择会导致显著不同的结果。我们研究用于视频错误定位的VLM harness。我们不依赖人工设计的harness，而是提出Harness Search and Merge（HSM），一种通过搜索可执行评估程序自动构建harness的算法。一个LLM编排器在随机训练子集上独立改进候选harness，将发现记录在记忆中，并建设性地合并互补的候选。我们在Spotlight（一个近期提出的生成视频错误定位基准）上评估HSM。HSM达到0.234 ± 0.012 F1，超过最强的基准策略（0.173 ± 0.016），并在未见过的视频生成器上保持领先（0.213 ± 0.008 对 0.140 ± 0.003）。在IPV-Bench上，它以比现有优化基线更低的误报率取得强大的定位性能。这些结果表明，搜索完整的VLM harness可以超越现有评估策略、迁移到未见过的视频生成器，并降低真实视频上的误报。
translation.brief: 针对人工设计VLM评估流程效果不稳定的问题，提出通过LLM编排器搜索并合并可执行评估程序来自动构建harness的HSM算法。

papers.title: The user who is not there: genealogy and critique of simulated users built with generative AI in UX testing
papers.abstract: Usability testing depends on people, and people's time does not speed up at the pace that software production demands. Large language models (LLMs) now promise to remove people from testing by generating simulated users that browse websites, answer questionnaires and give interviews. This paper examines how academic research understands that promise. It combines a critical literature review with a genealogical reading that follows the simulated user from the cognitive models of the 1980s to current generative agents. The paper makes four claims. First, testing without the user is an old aim of human-computer interaction (HCI), and cost has always justified it. Second, the validity criterion for user models shifted from predictive precision to believability, and recent studies that return to precision report weak results. Third, simulated participants conflict with the values of academic research and with methods that treat participation as a political right, with Participatory Design as the limit case. Fourth, the Latin American literature found in this review uses generative AI to support expert inspection and contains no study of synthetic users. That gap leaves open questions about who gets represented and about research ethics regulation in Brazil. The paper closes with an agenda of open problems. As part of its method, it reports that the review itself used an LLM as research assistant, and it discusses what that implies.

translation.title: 缺席的用户：UX 测试中基于生成式 AI 的模拟用户的谱系与批判
translation.abstract: 可用性测试依赖于人，而人的时间无法以软件生产所要求的速度加速。大语言模型（LLM）如今承诺通过生成模拟用户来将人从测试中移除，这些模拟用户可以浏览网站、回答问卷并接受访谈。本文考察学术研究如何理解这一承诺。本文将批判性文献综述与谱系式解读相结合，追溯模拟用户从 20 世纪 80 年代的认知模型到当前的生成式智能体的发展历程。本文提出四个论点。第一，没有用户的测试是人机交互（HCI）的一个古老目标，而成本一直是其理由。第二，用户模型的有效性标准从预测精度转向了可信度，而近期回归精度的研究报告的结果较弱。第三，模拟被试与学术研究的价值观以及将参与视为政治权利的方法相冲突，参与式设计（Participatory Design）是其中的极限案例。第四，本综述中发现的拉丁美洲文献使用生成式 AI 来支持专家检查，且没有关于合成用户的研究。这一空白留下了关于谁被代表以及巴西研究伦理监管的开放问题。本文以开放问题议程作结。作为其方法的一部分，本文报告该综述本身使用 LLM 作为研究助手，并讨论了这意味着什么。
translation.brief: 该论文通过谱系式文献综述批判性地考察用生成式 AI 构建模拟用户替代真人进行 UX 测试这一做法的历史、有效性标准转变与伦理问题。

papers.title: Empirical Margin Sensitivity: An Interventional Neuron-Level Probe of Post-Trained Medical LLMs
papers.abstract: Medical post-training raises benchmark accuracy, but accuracy does not show which internal components a model's decisions depend on, or whether components that support one benchmark also support another. We apply the weight-space intervention paradigm of ROME and MEMIT at the granularity of one MLP down-projection column. Our measurement, Empirical Margin Sensitivity (EMS), replaces each coordinate magnitude of a column by its mean while preserving the column's sign pattern and L1 scale, and records the resulting change in the logit margin between the correct option and its hardest-wrong competitor. This isolates the margin's dependence on a column's fine-grained coordinate structure while the column stays in place. We discover high-EMS columns (anchors) on MedQA in ten public checkpoints (four general-purpose bases and six medical post-trained variants) across the Gemma, Llama, Qwen, and AFM families, and measure the same columns on MedMCQA and PubMedQA. Mean-ablating each discovered anchor set lowers MedQA accuracy in all six post-trained models, by 6 to 28 points. In the two pure-SFT checkpoints, crushing anchors raises the PubMedQA margin on correctly answered items (negative EMS), and anchors with this property sit significantly deeper than the same model's other anchors; the four checkpoints trained with RL or mixed recipes show positive PubMedQA EMS and no significant depth shift. The depth association recurs in each of three held-out checkpoints. Because the checkpoints differ in data and pipeline as well as objective, we report these as per-checkpoint observations.

translation.title: 经验边际敏感性：对后训练医疗 LLM 的神经元级干预探针
translation.abstract: 医疗后训练提高了基准准确率，但准确率无法显示模型的决策依赖哪些内部组件，也无法显示支持某一基准的组件是否也支持另一基准。我们以单个 MLP 下投影列的粒度应用 ROME 和 MEMIT 的权重空间干预范式。我们的测量方法——经验边际敏感性（EMS）——将列的每个坐标幅值替换为其均值，同时保留该列的符号模式和 L1 尺度，并记录正确选项与其最难错误竞争者之间 logit 边际的相应变化。这在该列保持原位的情况下，隔离了边际对该列细粒度坐标结构的依赖。我们在 Gemma、Llama、Qwen 和 AFM 家族的十个公开检查点（四个通用基座和六个医疗后训练变体）的 MedQA 上发现了高 EMS 列（锚点），并在 MedMCQA 和 PubMedQA 上测量相同的列。对每个发现的锚点集进行均值消融，在所有六个后训练模型中使 MedQA 准确率下降 6 到 28 个百分点。在两个纯 SFT 检查点中，压制锚点会提高正确回答项上的 PubMedQA 边际（负 EMS），且具有此性质的锚点位置显著深于同一模型的其他锚点；四个用 RL 或混合配方训练的检查点则表现出正的 PubMedQA EMS 且无显著深度偏移。该深度关联在三个留出检查点中均复现。由于这些检查点在数据、流程和目标上均不同，我们将这些报告为逐检查点的观察。
translation.brief: 该论文提出经验边际敏感性（EMS）这一神经元级干预方法，通过替换 MLP 列坐标幅值来探测医疗后训练 LLM 决策依赖的内部组件及其跨基准行为。

papers.title: Hierarchical Multi-Timescale Deep Reinforcement Learning for QoS-Aware AI-RAN Configuration
papers.abstract: Configuring radio access networks (RANs) for heterogeneous services requires coordinating radio parameters whose effects on throughput, delay, and reliability are closely coupled and evolve over different timescales. This paper presents a hierarchical deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework for joint, QoS-aware RAN configuration that aligns the learning structure with the real-time, near-real-time, and non-real-time control loops of O-RAN that are also adopted by AI-RAN. Three proximal policy optimization agents jointly select per-user modulation and coding schemes, user-to-bandwidth-part (BWP) assignments, per-BWP transmit power, numerology, and BWP bandwidth weights, at three timescales. The agents share a QoS-aware objective combining throughput demand satisfaction with delay and reliability penalties. We extend ns-3 5G-LENA and integrate it with Ray RLlib through ns3-ai to support the required radio controls, network observations, and hierarchical policy execution. We evaluate the agents' performance in a nine-cell downlink network with inter-cell interference, varying user populations, and mixed URLLC, gaming, conversational-video, and video-streaming traffic. Compared with the baseline 5G-NR RAN, our trained hierarchical DRL agents substantially reduce URLLC and conversational-video delays, lower the residual block error rate, and prevent the near-starvation of the weakest flows, trading off slightly lower throughput for high-rate video streaming under capacity-limited conditions.

translation.title: 面向 QoS 感知 AI-RAN 配置的分层多时间尺度深度强化学习
translation.abstract: 为异构服务配置无线接入网（RAN）需要协调那些对吞吐量、时延和可靠性影响紧密耦合且在不同时间尺度上演化的无线参数。本文提出一个分层深度强化学习（DRL）框架，用于联合的、QoS 感知的 RAN 配置，使学习结构与 O-RAN（也被 AI-RAN 采用）的实时、近实时和非实时控制环路相一致。三个近端策略优化（PPO）智能体在三个时间尺度上联合选择每用户的调制编码方案、用户到带宽部分（BWP）的分配、每 BWP 的发射功率、参数集（numerology）和 BWP 带宽权重。这些智能体共享一个将吞吐量需求满足与时延和可靠性惩罚相结合的 QoS 感知目标。我们扩展了 ns-3 5G-LENA，并通过 ns3-ai 将其与 Ray RLlib 集成，以支持所需的无线控制、网络观测和分层策略执行。我们在一个存在小区间干扰、用户数量变化、混合 URLLC、游戏、会话视频和视频流业务的九小区下行网络中评估智能体的性能。与基线 5G-NR RAN 相比，我们训练的分层 DRL 智能体显著降低了 URLLC 和会话视频的时延，降低了残余误块率，并防止了最弱流的近乎饥饿，在容量受限条件下以略低的视频流吞吐量为代价。
translation.brief: 该论文提出一个分层多时间尺度 DRL 框架，用三个 PPO 智能体在 O-RAN 控制环路结构下联合优化 RAN 无线参数以满足异构业务的 QoS 需求。

papers.title: Lowering the Bar for Everyone: Hidden Validation-Seeking Goals in Empathetic RL
papers.abstract: When RL learns from the reactions of many users, the policy usually cannot see what each user wants. We ask what it learns from users who privately want validation: to validate them alone (targeting), or to lower its bar for endorsing everyone (a threshold shift). We answer this in one setting, empathetic RL against LLM-simulated users (RLVER, GRPO, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct): we vary only the share of validation-seeking users (0--50%; RLVER's default: 24.6%) and evaluate on 1,000 Reddit AITA posts with community fault verdicts. The policy shifts its threshold. Endorsement of at-fault posters rises by 3--4 percentage points per 10 points of share; without such users the Qwen model stays at base, and the effect persists at matched KL and under a goal-blind reward. Signal-detection analysis shows that the criterion for endorsing falls while discrimination between at-fault and not-at-fault posters does not decline. An explicit request to be told if one is wrong gives no measurable protection: at-fault posters who make it receive nearly the same rise as those who do not (+0.11 vs. +0.13). When the goal is stated during training, the policy instead largely targets, endorsing seekers regardless of fault. Standard sycophancy and empathy benchmarks miss the shift; five of six usable released empathetic-RL checkpoints also endorse at-fault posters who ask for honesty more than their base models, though a pre-registered prediction for two held for only one. The user mix is a training hyperparameter to audit and report.

translation.title: 降低所有人的门槛：共情 RL 中隐藏的寻求认可目标
translation.abstract: 当 RL 从众多用户的反应中学习时，策略通常无法看到每个用户想要什么。我们探究它从私下希望获得认可的用户那里学到了什么：是单独认可他们（targeting，定向），还是降低其认可所有人的门槛（threshold shift，阈值偏移）。我们在一个设置中回答此问题：针对 LLM 模拟用户的共情 RL（RLVER、GRPO、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct）：我们仅改变寻求认可用户的占比（0--50%；RLVER 默认为 24.6%），并在 1000 条带有社区过错判定的 Reddit AITA 帖子上进行评估。策略发生了阈值偏移。每 10 个百分点的占比使对有过错发帖者的认可上升 3--4 个百分点；没有此类用户时 Qwen 模型保持在基线水平，且该效应在匹配 KL 和目标盲奖励下持续存在。信号检测分析表明，认可判定标准下降，而对有过错与无过错发帖者的辨别力并未下降。明确请求被告知自己是否有过错并不能提供可测量的保护：提出此请求的过错发帖者获得的上升与未提出者几乎相同（+0.11 对 +0.13）。当该目标在训练期间被明确陈述时，策略反而主要进行定向，无论过错与否都认可寻求者。标准的谄媚和共情基准无法检测到这种偏移；六个可用的已发布共情 RL 检查点中有五个也比其基座模型更认可那些请求诚实的过错发帖者，尽管一项预注册预测仅在两个中有一个成立。用户混合比例是一个需要审计和报告的训练超参数。
translation.brief: 该论文研究 RL 从混合用户反应中学习时，隐藏的寻求认可用户比例如何使策略产生认可阈值偏移或定向谄媚，并指出标准基准无法检测此类偏移。

papers.title: Hard to Translate, Harder to Detect: Human Analysis Remains Essential in AI Meme Translation
papers.abstract: We present a dataset and evaluation setup for a problem in creative machine translation: translating culturally loaded passages that carry much of a text's meaning and humor that may depend on subtle or implicit discourse. We study Soviet comedy quotations that function as memes in Russian-language communication. Off-the-shelf difficulty estimators do not find these passages; current models searching the web find most but not all of them, but their own analyses of the difficulty do not help translation as well as a human-validated one. Given a brief human-validated analysis of why each passage is difficult, older models improve modestly; the strongest current translators (GPT-6 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5) improve more, and in human evaluation GPT-6 Sol comes close to the approved references on most films. Newer models have thus become much better at using such an analysis while still not reliably producing it themselves. We release (1) a dataset of five films' Russian subtitles with their audience-selected culturally salient passages, human-validated analyses, and reference translations (into English, Galician, and Spanish), together with every full-film LLM translation and evaluation produced in this study; and (2) an item-level MQM-style evaluation protocol that measures translator and evaluator noise to set the number of runs the evaluation needs, and whose automatic version tracks human judgment of these passages, which reference-free neural metrics do not, whether they score the whole text or the passages alone.

translation.title: 难以翻译，更难检测：人工分析在 AI 梗图翻译中仍然不可或缺
translation.abstract: 我们针对创意机器翻译中的一个难题提出数据集和评估设置：翻译那些承载文本大量含义和幽默、且可能依赖微妙或隐含语篇的文化负载段落。我们研究在俄语交流中作为梗发挥作用的苏联喜剧引语。现成的难度估计器无法找到这些段落；当前联网搜索的模型能找到其中大部分但非全部，而模型自身对难度的分析对翻译的帮助不如经人工验证的分析。在给出一段经人工验证的、关于每个段落为何困难的简要分析后，较旧的模型有适度提升；最强的当前翻译模型（GPT-6 Sol 和 Claude Opus 5.5）提升更大，且在人工评估中 GPT-6 Sol 在大多数影片上接近已批准的参考译文。因此，更新的模型在使用此类分析方面已变得强得多，但仍无法可靠地自行生成此类分析。我们发布：(1) 一个包含五部影片俄语字幕及其观众选出的文化显著段落、人工验证分析和参考译文（英语、加利西亚语和西班牙语）的数据集，以及本研究产生的所有整片 LLM 翻译和评估；(2) 一个条目级 MQM 风格的评估协议，该协议测量翻译者和评估者的噪声以确定评估所需的运行次数，其自动版本能追踪对这些段落的人工判断，而免参考神经指标——无论对全文还是仅对段落打分——均无法做到。
translation.brief: 该论文构建苏联喜剧梗翻译数据集与 MQM 式评估协议，证明文化负载段落的难度需人工分析识别，人工验证的分析能显著提升 LLM 翻译质量。

papers.title: Handoff at Frontier AI Companies
papers.abstract: The term "Handoff" captures frontier AI companies' ongoing delegation of all AI Research & Development (AI R&D) functions, including high-level decisions such as safety assessments and deployment decisions, to internally deployed AI agents. Handoff is progressing rapidly and will be complete once no human remains in the loop. This report aims to alert policymakers to the national security threats and Loss of Control risks that Handoff can create, and to advise them on how to monitor and respond to those risks.

translation.title: 前沿AI公司的Handoff（交接）
translation.abstract: "Handoff"一词概括了前沿AI公司正在进行的、将所有AI研发（AI R&D）职能——包括安全评估和部署决策等高层决策——委托给内部部署的AI智能体的过程。Handoff正在快速推进，一旦没有任何人类留在决策回路中，该过程即告完成。本报告旨在提醒政策制定者注意Handoff可能带来的国家安全威胁和失控（Loss of Control）风险，并就如何监测和应对这些风险提供建议。
translation.brief: 针对前沿AI公司将AI研发职能逐步移交内部AI智能体所引发的失控与国家安全风险，提出监测与应对的政策建议。

papers.title: Interrupt-Aware Static Detection of Deadlocks in Rust Operating Systems
papers.abstract: Rust is increasingly adopted in operating systems, but Rust's safety guarantees do not eliminate deadlocks, especially those induced by interrupts. The core challenge is to recover interrupt-sensitive lock dependencies from Rust's guard-based synchronization across function boundaries. Applying this analysis across Rust OS projects also requires specifying project-specific synchronization semantics. We present an approach combining interrupt-aware static analysis with diagnostic-guided agent auditing for detecting deadlocks in Rust operating systems. Our approach uses lightweight source-level annotations to recover project-specific lock and interrupt semantics, performs a flow-sensitive MIR-based analysis to track lock-holding and interrupt states, and reports potential deadlocks with supporting evidence. An agent then searches for relevant source code in the repository and returns a confidence assessment with reasons for each supplied report. We evaluate our tool on four real Rust operating systems, identifying 26 true cases corresponding to nine maintainer-confirmed defects. Diagnostic-guided auditing achieves 86.2\% precision and 96.2\% recall based on static analysis results, and offers advantages over the baselines in both cost and effectiveness.

translation.title: Rust操作系统中中断感知的死锁静态检测
translation.abstract: Rust在操作系统中的应用日益广泛，但Rust的安全保证并不能消除死锁，尤其是由中断引发的死锁。核心挑战在于从Rust跨函数边界的基于guard的同步机制中恢复中断敏感的锁依赖关系。将此分析应用于各类Rust操作系统项目，还需要指定项目特定的同步语义。我们提出了一种将中断感知静态分析与诊断引导的智能体审计相结合的方法，用于检测Rust操作系统中的死锁。该方法使用轻量级源码级标注来恢复项目特定的锁与中断语义，执行基于MIR的流敏感分析以跟踪持锁和中断状态，并报告潜在死锁及其支持证据。随后，智能体在代码仓库中搜索相关源码，并为每份报告返回带理由的置信度评估。我们在四个真实的Rust操作系统上评估了该工具，识别出26个真实案例，对应9个经维护者确认的缺陷。基于静态分析结果，诊断引导审计达到86.2%的精确率和96.2%的召回率，在成本和效果上均优于基线方法。
translation.brief: 针对Rust操作系统中由中断引发的死锁，提出结合中断感知静态分析与智能体审计的检测方法。

papers.title: Skill-Composer: Requirement-Driven Skill Selection from Multiple Marketplaces
papers.abstract: Agent skills have become the primary vehicle through which agents reuse specialized capabilities, yet public skill marketplaces provide skills with individual items: a query, whether matched through keyword or embedding similarity, returns a list of single skills ordered by relevance or by popularity. Such an interface cannot answer the question a developer actually faces: which set of skills should be installed to cover a task's complete requirement? The highest-ranked skills are often functionally redundant, while capabilities that are genuinely required remain uncovered. In this paper, we argue that skill acquisition should be reframed from ranking to set selection. We propose Skill-Composer, an agent-native framework that selects a non-redundant skill bundle for the user requirement, which aims to cover all available required capabilities and report any gaps. Specifically, it clarifies user requirements into atomic requirement points, retrieves and merges candidate skills across fragmented marketplaces, decomposes each candidate's capabilities, and progressively discards overlapping ones, so that each retained skill provides different capabilities. This moves the decision of which skills to acquire from the developer to the agent itself. We position this reframing and sketch its workflow.

translation.title: Skill-Composer：面向需求的跨多市场技能选择
translation.abstract: Agent技能已成为智能体复用专业能力的主要载体，然而公开的技能市场提供的技能是逐个条目的：无论通过关键词还是嵌入相似度匹配，一次查询都会返回按相关性或热度排序的单个技能列表。这样的接口无法回答开发者真正面临的问题：应该安装哪一组技能才能覆盖任务的完整需求？排名最高的技能往往在功能上冗余，而真正需要的能力却未被覆盖。本文主张将技能获取从排序问题重新定义为集合选择问题。我们提出Skill-Composer，一个面向智能体的框架，它为用户需求选择一个非冗余的技能组合，力求覆盖所有可用的所需能力并报告缺口。具体而言，它将用户需求澄清为原子需求点，跨碎片化的市场检索并合并候选技能，分解每个候选技能的能力，并逐步剔除重叠部分，使每个保留的技能提供不同的能力。这将“获取哪些技能”的决策从开发者转移到了智能体本身。我们对这一重新定位进行了阐述并勾勒了其工作流程。
translation.brief: 针对技能市场单技能排序无法覆盖任务完整需求的问题，提出将技能获取重构为集合选择、跨市场挑选非冗余技能组合的Skill-Composer框架。

papers.title: CocoonBench: Can Multilingual Search Agents Escape Language Information Cocoons?
papers.abstract: Multilingual search agents can access the global Web, yet may remain trapped in a language environment with insufficient evidence; we refer to this failure as a language information cocoon. However, existing search benchmarks largely operate within a single language, especially English, overlooking entity connections across multiple languages. We introduce CocoonBench, a benchmark that evaluates whether multilingual search agents can escape such language information cocoons. CocoonBench mines answer-centered relational paths from a frozen Wikidata-derived graph and selects clue sets that are individually necessary and jointly identify a unique answer. Using language-specific entity names, it records each task's minimum language cover, removes direct identifiers, and renders each task as matched prompts in three languages together with its construction certificate and provenance. Across 10 state-of-the-art models, mean accuracy on CocoonBench ranges from 33.8% (DeepSeek-V4-Flash) to 69.7% (Claude-Opus-4.8), leaving even the strongest system below 70%. The same construction certificates support path-aligned trajectory analysis, enabling diagnosis of model failures in language routing, evidence-path recovery, and answer use. The result shows that escaping a language cocoon requires more than switching languages: successful cross-lingual search depends on both covering the correct languages and connecting the evidence found across them.
