translation.title: CocoonBench：多语言搜索智能体能逃出语言信息茧房吗？
translation.abstract: 多语言搜索智能体可以访问全球Web，却可能仍被困在证据不足的单一语言环境中；我们将这种失败称为语言信息茧房。然而，现有的搜索基准大多在单一语言（尤其是英语）内运行，忽视了跨多种语言的实体连接。我们提出CocoonBench，一个评估多语言搜索智能体能否逃出此类语言信息茧房的基准。CocoonBench从冻结的Wikidata衍生图中挖掘以答案为中心的关系路径，并选择单独必要、联合起来唯一确定一个答案的线索集。它使用特定语言的实体名称，记录每个任务的最小语言覆盖，移除直接标识符，并将每个任务呈现为三种语言的匹配提示，同时附上其构建证书和来源信息。在10个最先进模型上，CocoonBench的平均准确率从33.8%（DeepSeek-V4-Flash）到69.7%（Claude-Opus-4.8）不等，即使最强的系统也低于70%。同样的构建证书支持与路径对齐的轨迹分析，可用于诊断模型在语言路由、证据路径恢复和答案使用方面的失败。结果表明，逃出语言茧房不仅仅是切换语言：成功的跨语言搜索既需要覆盖正确的语言，也需要连接跨语言找到的证据。
translation.brief: 针对多语言搜索智能体可能困于单一语言证据环境的问题，构建基于Wikidata关系路径的CocoonBench基准来评估其跨语言证据连接能力。

papers.title: Can Cities Have Personalities? Introducing the SCD City Personality Assessment
papers.abstract: Descriptions of cities are shaped by human experience and institutional narratives. We introduce the SCD City Personality Assessment (SCD-CPA), a method that instantiates document-grounded ChatGPT city personas and interrogates each with an identical 24-statement instrument inspired by the four-pair structure of the Myers-Briggs Type Indicator. Rather than asking a general-purpose model to characterize cities freely, we configure a separate document-grounded conversational agent for each city and use alternative evidence portraits to compare documentary inputs. The resulting four bipolar dimensions and four-letter summaries use independently defined urban concepts and scoring rules. Tokyo, New York, and Paris form the methodological evaluation (33 assessments across repeated sessions, three GPT-6 effort settings, and alternative portraits): Tokyo's original portrait yielded 85.4% exact within-setting item agreement, while evidence substitutions shifted some dimension strengths. A five-city application to Shanghai, Dubai, Mumbai, Lagos, and Sao Paulo (15 assessments) yielded 77.8% exact and 99.4% within-one-point cross-setting agreement, indicating consistency under the tested configurations. By treating each city conversational agent as a reproducible, evidence-conditioned experimental configuration, SCD-CPA makes documented city-character perceptions comparable and exposes their sensitivity to source selection. Although the documentary evidence is explicitly controlled, the model's internal interpretation of that evidence cannot be fully observed. We also examine the robustness of SCD-CPA across three AI reasoning-effort settings. The observed consistency suggests that the methodology is relatively insensitive to the tested configuration differences and provides a framework for evaluating its stability as future generations of AI models become available.

translation.title: 城市有性格吗？SCD城市性格评估介绍
translation.abstract: 对城市的描述受人类经验和机构叙事的影响。我们提出SCD城市性格评估（SCD-CPA），一种基于文档的ChatGPT城市人格化方法，并用受Myers-Briggs类型指标四对结构启发的同一套24条陈述工具对每个人格进行询问。我们不要求通用模型自由刻画城市，而是为每个城市配置一个独立的基于文档的对话智能体，并使用替代证据画像来比较文档输入。所得的四个双极维度和四字母总结使用独立定义的城市概念和评分规则。东京、纽约和巴黎构成方法学评估（跨重复会话、三个GPT-6努力设置和替代画像共33次评估）：东京的原始画像在设置内条目一致率达85.4%，而证据替换改变了一些维度的强度。对上海、迪拜、孟买、拉各斯和圣保罗五个城市的应用（15次评估）得到77.8%的完全一致和99.4%的一点以内跨设置一致，表明在所测配置下具有一致性。通过将每个城市对话智能体视为可复现的、以证据为条件的实验配置，SCD-CPA使有据可查的城市性格感知具有可比性，并揭示其对来源选择的敏感性。尽管文档证据受到明确控制，模型对该证据的内部解读无法被完全观察。我们还检验了SCD-CPA在三个AI推理努力设置下的稳健性。观察到的一致性表明该方法对所测配置差异相对不敏感，并为未来AI模型世代出现时评估其稳定性提供了框架。
translation.brief: 针对城市性格刻画缺乏可复现方法的问题，提出基于文档的ChatGPT城市人格化并结合MBTI式量表的SCD-CPA评估方法。

papers.title: Transport-Safe Evaluation of LLM Agents: Trajectory-Dependent Judge Error and Anytime-Valid Auditing
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are often ranked by an LLM judge whose error rates are measured once and reused for every agent. The corrected success rates can then be biased when the judge's errors depend on the trajectory and agents differ in the trajectories they produce for successes or failures. We derive the exact asymptotic bias and give a chain of checks from identification to simultaneous ranks. On a four-agent semi-synthetic benchmark, a scalar correction with oracle calibration has maximum bias 0.245 and mean pointwise coverage 0.016, and never recovers the full ranking (0/250 replications). Augmented inverse-probability weighting (AIPW) with a uniform or a design-aware random audit keeps the maximum bias below 0.003, with mean pointwise coverage of 0.939 and 0.950. In a 48-cell stress test, effective target support rises only from 0.209 to 0.805 as calibration grows from 600 to 4,800 labels, while audited AIPW keeps a mean absolute error of 0.018-0.020. Without calibration support, or with judge dependence within an externally justified bound, we report valid bounds or sensitivity sets and carry them into rank sets. An e-process confidence sequence stays valid, for a stable target, under predictable adaptive auditing and arbitrary stopping.

translation.title: LLM智能体的传输安全评估：轨迹依赖的裁判误差与任意时点有效的审计
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体通常由一个LLM裁判进行排名，而裁判的错误率只测量一次并被所有智能体复用。当裁判的错误依赖于轨迹、且不同智能体在成功或失败时产生的轨迹不同时，校正后的成功率可能产生偏差。我们推导了精确的渐近偏差，并给出从识别到同时排名的一系列检验。在一个四智能体半合成基准上，使用oracle校准的标量校正最大偏差为0.245，平均逐点覆盖率为0.016，且从未恢复完整排名（250次重复中0次成功）。采用均匀审计或设计感知随机审计的增广逆概率加权（AIPW）将最大偏差保持在0.003以下，平均逐点覆盖率分别为0.939和0.950。在一个48格压力测试中，当校准标签从600增加到4,800时，有效目标支持度仅从0.209上升到0.805，而经审计的AIPW保持0.018-0.020的平均绝对误差。在没有校准支持、或裁判依赖性处于外部论证界限内的情况下，我们报告有效界限或敏感性集合，并将其转化为排名集合。对于稳定目标，e-process置信序列在可预测的自适应审计和任意停止下保持有效。
translation.brief: 解决LLM裁判误差依赖轨迹导致智能体排名偏差的问题，核心方法是推导渐近偏差并用增广逆概率加权（AIPW）结合随机审计进行校正。

papers.title: Intent-Conditioned Argument Mediation for Tool-Using LLM Agents: Blocking Trusted-but-Unauthorized Arguments
papers.abstract: LLM agents turn a user's request and retrieved content into tool calls, and a call can reach the wrong recipient, endpoint, file or participant. Argument-level provenance blocks such values when they come from untrusted content, but accepts a trusted value that the user never requested. IntentFlow, a mediation layer between an unmodified planner and its tools, checks each authority-bearing argument against an intent contract and a provenance policy. On a synthetic benchmark of 200 attacks (oracle intent and injection labels, declared roles), attack success falls from 50.5% with provenance alone to 12.0% [8.2-17.2%]; every remaining success alters a content or payload field. IntentFlow wrongly blocks none of 200 paired benign tasks and 4 of 50 hard ones. On 50 trusted-but-unauthorized attacks, provenance-only mediation executes all 50 and IntentFlow none; a CaMeL-style check also blocks all 50 but rejects 16 of 50 benign tasks. On an offline AgentDojo-derived replay, IntentFlow blocks all 20 attacks at 75% benign success, as does a CaMeL-style check; a Progent-style allowlist blocks 19 and keeps all benign tasks. With one live planner and the same oracles, the mediator blocked all 17 corrupted calls proposed in 110 attacks.

translation.title: 面向工具使用型LLM智能体的意图条件参数调解：阻断可信但未授权的参数
translation.abstract: LLM智能体将用户请求和检索内容转化为工具调用，而一次调用可能到达错误的接收者、端点、文件或参与者。参数级来源追踪（provenance）可以阻断来自不可信内容的此类值，但会接受用户从未请求的可信值。IntentFlow是一个位于未修改的规划器与其工具之间的调解层，它根据意图契约和来源策略检查每个携带权限的参数。在一个包含200次攻击的合成基准上（使用oracle意图和注入标签、声明角色），攻击成功率从仅用来源追踪时的50.5%降至12.0% [8.2-17.2%]；所有剩余的成功攻击都只改变了内容或载荷字段。IntentFlow在200个配对良性任务中无一错误阻断，在50个困难任务中错误阻断了4个。在50次可信但未授权的攻击中，仅用来源追踪的调解执行了全部50次，而IntentFlow一次也未执行；CaMeL风格的检查同样阻断了全部50次，但拒绝了50个良性任务中的16个。在基于AgentDojo的离线重放中，IntentFlow在75%良性成功率下阻断了全部20次攻击，CaMeL风格的检查也是如此；Progent风格的允许列表阻断了19次并保留了所有良性任务。使用一个真实规划器和相同的oracle，该调解器在110次攻击中阻断了全部17个被提出的受损调用。
translation.brief: 解决工具调用中可信但未授权参数被放行的问题，核心方法是在规划器与工具之间加入IntentFlow调解层，依据意图契约与来源策略检查携带权限的参数。

papers.title: SchemaCaps: When a Compatible Tool Update Silently Widens an AI Agent's Authority
papers.abstract: The tools users approve for their AI agents keep changing their JSON input schemas. Of 8 surveyed MCP clients and scanners, none is observed or documented to re-approve a tool whose input schema widens (two not determinable). We define non-amplification over the coordinates visible in the schema (declared arguments and undeclared fields, on effective values) and a re-binding rule decided by subschema inclusion, trusting no field labels by default and conservative up to its checker and tested case analysis. Evidence: a Coq proof of composition; 48 regression tests; an exact-reference benchmark, where the reviewed version of the rule silently re-bound 27 amplifying changes, now fixed; and a pilot on 604 releases of 39 public MCP servers. There, 412 of 580 compatible schema changes widen some coordinate, yet compatibility re-binds them silently. The authors' adjudicated double annotation finds at least 76 that add or widen an authority-bearing argument (66 of the 84 a name-based labeller flags, plus 10 it misses). On existing tools, the rule asks 645 re-approvals, against 1,197 for pinning the input schema (2,004 with descriptions) and 617 for compatibility. Behaviour change behind an identical schema remains out of reach.

translation.title: SchemaCaps：当兼容的工具更新悄然扩大AI智能体的权限时
translation.abstract: 用户为其AI智能体批准的工具不断更改其JSON输入schema。在调研的8个MCP客户端和扫描器中，没有任何一个被观察到或被文档记录为会对输入schema扩大的工具重新请求批准（两个无法确定）。我们基于schema中可见的坐标（声明的参数和未声明的字段，作用于有效值）定义了非放大性，并给出由子schema包含关系决定的重新绑定规则，默认不信任任何字段标签，并在其检查器和已测试的案例分析范围内保持保守。证据包括：组合性的Coq证明；48个回归测试；一个精确参考基准，其中被审查版本的规则曾悄然重新绑定了27个放大性变更（现已修复）；以及对39个公共MCP服务器604次发布的试点研究。其中，580个兼容schema变更中有412个扩大了某些坐标，但兼容性检查却悄然重新绑定它们。作者裁定标注的双人标注发现至少76个变更添加或扩大了携带权限的参数（基于名称的标注器标记了84个中的66个，另有10个被其遗漏）。在现有工具上，该规则要求645次重新批准，而固定输入schema需要1,197次（含描述时为2,004次），兼容性检查需要617次。相同schema背后的行为变更仍超出其能力范围。
translation.brief: 解决工具schema兼容更新悄然扩大智能体权限的问题，核心方法是定义schema坐标上的非放大性并给出基于子schema包含关系的重新绑定规则。

papers.title: Bridging the Semantic Gap from Natural Language Specifications to RTL with Layered Formal Guidance
papers.abstract: While large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in generating register-transfer level (RTL) code from natural-language specifications, their reliability remains limited on designs with complex control logic and temporal behavior. This stems from a fundamental semantic gap: high-level natural language often leaves implementation-critical details underspecified, forcing LLMs to infer unstated assumptions. This paper presents Layered Formal Guidance, a novel framework that bridges this semantic gap by using formal properties as an intermediate semantic layer between natural-language specifications and RTL generation. Our framework applies formal guidance across three layers: property-driven specification augmentation before generation, property-consistency checking after generation, and counterexample-guided refinement after checking. Experiments on RTLLM benchmarks and various open-source IP designs demonstrate that our framework achieves higher functional correctness and lower sampled output-trace diversity. Furthermore, we show that Layered Formal Guidance can flexibly augment both general-purpose LLMs and domain-specific models to substantially improve their generation reliability.

translation.title: 以分层形式化引导弥合自然语言规范到RTL的语义鸿沟
translation.abstract: 尽管大语言模型（LLM）在从自然语言规范生成寄存器传输级（RTL）代码方面展现出潜力，但其在具有复杂控制逻辑和时序行为的设计上的可靠性仍然有限。这源于一个根本性的语义鸿沟：高层自然语言常常使实现关键细节欠规范，迫使LLM推断未言明的假设。本文提出分层形式化引导（Layered Formal Guidance），一种通过将形式化属性作为自然语言规范与RTL生成之间的中间语义层来弥合该语义鸿沟的新框架。该框架在三个层次上应用形式化引导：生成前的属性驱动规范增强、生成后的属性一致性检查，以及检查后的反例引导精化。在RTLLM基准和多种开源IP设计上的实验表明，该框架实现了更高的功能正确性和更低的采样输出轨迹多样性。此外，我们证明分层形式化引导可以灵活地增强通用LLM和领域专用模型，显著提高其生成可靠性。
translation.brief: 解决自然语言规范到RTL生成中语义欠规范的问题，核心方法是将形式化属性作为中间语义层，在生成前、生成后和检查后三个阶段提供形式化引导。

papers.title: GameDojo: Benchmarking Real-Time Interactive Agents in Video Games
papers.abstract: Interactive intelligence requires agents to act on observations and adapt to the consequences of actions. Studying these abilities calls for diverse, challenging tasks under controlled conditions. We introduce GameDojo, a controllable interactive gameplay benchmark of 120 boss encounters across 20 games for evaluating model capabilities, learning algorithms, and agent harnesses. Coding agents reconstruct the environments and write gameplay scripts, producing GameDojo-Data with 600 hours of gameplay trajectories. Experiments reveal substantial challenges for frontier models, especially in real-time interaction. Training on GameDojo-Data brings GameDojo-4B to frontier performance, with the strongest real-time performance. We also find joint training improves individual tasks, and learned policies transfer across bosses. Together, these findings establish GameDojo as a challenging and valuable interactive gameplay benchmark for the community. Our project page is at this https URL , and our code is at this https URL .

translation.title: GameDojo：视频游戏中实时交互智能体的基准测试
translation.abstract: 交互智能要求智能体基于观察采取行动并适应行动的后果。研究这些能力需要在受控条件下提供多样且具有挑战性的任务。我们提出GameDojo，一个包含20款游戏中120场Boss遭遇战的可控交互游戏玩法基准，用于评估模型能力、学习算法和智能体框架。编码智能体重建环境并编写游戏脚本，生成了包含600小时游戏玩法轨迹的GameDojo-Data。实验揭示了对前沿模型的巨大挑战，尤其是在实时交互方面。在GameDojo-Data上训练使GameDojo-4B达到前沿性能，并拥有最强的实时表现。我们还发现联合训练可以改善单个任务的表现，且学到的策略可以跨Boss迁移。这些发现共同确立了GameDojo作为一个具有挑战性且有价值的社区交互游戏玩法基准。我们的项目页面位于此https URL，代码位于此https URL。
translation.brief: 解决缺乏受控条件下实时交互智能体评估基准的问题，核心方法是构建包含20款游戏120场Boss战的可控基准GameDojo并发布大规模游戏轨迹数据集。

papers.title: Trallie: from Free-Form Text to Structured Data with LLMs
papers.abstract: Trallie is an open-source framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to perform information extraction (IE) from natural language sources with or without user guidance. Unlike conventional approaches that rely on extensive labeled datasets or domain-specific training, Trallie enables the conversion of unstructured data into structured formats with minimal or no representative examples. The framework is designed with three key objectives: (i) reducing manual annotation by harnessing prompt-based zero-shot and few-shot capabilities of modern LLMs, (ii) flexibly parsing diverse document formats (i.e., HTML, PDF, TXT, and JSON), and (iii) improving accessibility for non-expert users by automatically inducing schemas from document collections, which can then be refined for extraction. We evaluate Trallie with open-weight LLMs on FDA 510(k) documents and on movie and university websites from SWDE. It outperforms previously reported systems when the target attributes are provided for text extraction and is competitive when it must discover attributes for the schema automatically. The project is available at this https URL

translation.title: Trallie：利用大语言模型将自由文本转化为结构化数据
translation.abstract: Trallie 是一个开源框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）从自然语言来源中执行信息抽取（IE），可以在有或没有用户引导的情况下进行。与依赖大规模标注数据集或领域特定训练的传统方法不同，Trallie 能够以极少甚至零个代表性示例将非结构化数据转换为结构化格式。该框架的设计有三个关键目标：(i) 借助现代 LLM 基于提示的 zero-shot 和 few-shot 能力减少人工标注；(ii) 灵活解析多种文档格式（即 HTML、PDF、TXT 和 JSON）；(iii) 通过从文档集合中自动归纳 schema（可随后人工细化用于抽取）来提升非专家用户的可用性。我们在 FDA 510(k) 文档以及 SWDE 中的电影和大学网站上使用开源权重 LLM 对 Trallie 进行了评估。当给定目标属性进行文本抽取时，它优于此前报告的系统；在需要自动发现 schema 属性时也具有竞争力。项目可在该 https URL 获取。
translation.brief: 解决无大量标注数据下从非结构化文本抽取结构化信息的问题，核心方法是利用 LLM 的零样本/少样本提示能力并自动归纳 schema。

papers.title: What Quality Engineers Need to Know About Generative AI: Structured Data Extraction
papers.abstract: In this expository paper, we explain how quality engineers can use large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) for structured data extraction. We introduce the relevant concepts, discuss structured extraction from a measurement-system perspective, and demonstrate its implementation in R and Python. We then present two freely available web-based applications (apps): (a) extracting information from automotive recall notices and (b) monitoring quality engineering research on arXiv. To ensure the accuracy of our AI-driven structured extraction, human evaluators validated the results. In the first app, four reviewers assessed information extracted from 30 recall notices using two models, with 98.6% of the 720 field-level ratings judged fully correct. In the second app, 21 authors evaluated information extracted from 45 of their arXiv papers. All paper summaries were rated mostly correct or correct, although the evaluations identified problems with some classification fields and mathematical expressions. These results demonstrate the practical potential of structured data extraction while emphasizing the need to validate the extracted information. We make both apps and their source code publicly available so that readers can adapt the approach to their own applications.

translation.title: 质量工程师需要了解的生成式 AI 知识：结构化数据抽取
translation.abstract: 在这篇阐述性论文中，我们说明质量工程师如何使用大语言模型（LLM）和视觉-语言模型（VLM）进行结构化数据抽取。我们介绍相关概念，从测量系统的视角讨论结构化抽取，并演示其在 R 和 Python 中的实现。随后我们展示两个免费可用的基于 Web 的应用（apps）：(a) 从汽车召回通知中抽取信息，(b) 监测 arXiv 上的质量工程研究。为确保 AI 驱动的结构化抽取的准确性，由人工评估者对结果进行了验证。在第一个应用中，四名评审者使用两个模型对 30 份召回通知抽取的信息进行评估，720 个字段级评分中有 98.6% 被判定为完全正确。在第二个应用中，21 位作者评估了从其 45 篇 arXiv 论文中抽取的信息。所有论文摘要均被评为基本正确或正确，但评估发现某些分类字段和数学表达式存在问题。这些结果展示了结构化数据抽取的实际潜力，同时强调了对抽取信息进行验证的必要性。我们将两个应用及其源代码公开，以便读者将该方案适配到自己的应用中。
translation.brief: 解决质量工程师如何用 LLM/VLM 做结构化数据抽取的问题，核心方法是从测量系统视角讲解并以两个经人工验证的 Web 应用演示实现。

papers.title: SignalCount: Approximate Counts with Structured and Semantic Predicates in Seconds
papers.abstract: Many applications store records with structured columns and a text document, and ask how many records in a filtered set meet a criterion that only a reader of the text can judge, such as "How many patients with type 2 diabetes, aged 40 to 70, stopped metformin because their blood sugar stayed high?" An interactive application needs this count in seconds, as the user types the criterion, to decide whether the matching set is worth materializing with a batch pipeline in which an LLM judges the records. Prior approximate query processing over such semantic predicates has an expensive model, the oracle, label a sample at query time, so every query waits for the oracle. We present SignalCount, a production system that answers COUNT queries with structured and semantic predicates and calls no oracle at query time, even for ad-hoc criteria. Its oracle is the production LLM judge, and the judge's logged verdicts calibrate, offline, the fast classifier that already runs in front of the judge. At query time, SignalCount counts the filtered set exactly and draws a uniform sample of at most 1,000 records in one columnar scan, scores the sample with the classifier, and multiplies the average calibrated probability by the exact count. Its 90% interval combines a sampling term with one-sided, rate-dependent margins for calibration error, fitted by split conformal prediction across tenants. In a multi-tenant production deployment, latency has a p99 of 3.8 s and stays flat as the filtered set grows beyond the sample. On tenants held out from fitting, the interval covers the count that the production pipeline returns in 92% of estimates, although estimates run about 15% high in aggregate, because a calibration nearly unbiased per record is still biased per criterion.

translation.title: SignalCount：在数秒内对结构化与语义谓词进行近似计数
translation.abstract: 许多应用存储的记录既包含结构化列又包含文本文档，并询问过滤后的集合中有多少记录满足只有阅读文本才能判断的标准，例如“有多少 40 至 70 岁、因血糖持续偏高而停用二甲双胍的 2 型糖尿病患者？”。交互式应用需要在用户输入标准的数秒内得到该计数，以判断匹配集合是否值得用 LLM 逐条判断记录的批处理流水线来物化。此前针对此类语义谓词的近似查询处理需要在查询时让昂贵的模型（oracle）标注样本，因此每个查询都要等待 oracle。我们提出 SignalCount，一个生产系统，可回答带结构化和语义谓词的 COUNT 查询，且在查询时不调用任何 oracle，即使针对临时（ad-hoc）标准也是如此。其 oracle 是生产中的 LLM 判别器，判别器记录的判定结果在离线阶段校准已运行在判别器之前的快速分类器。查询时，SignalCount 精确统计过滤后的集合，并在一次列式扫描中抽取至多 1,000 条记录的均匀样本，用分类器对样本打分，再将校准后的平均概率乘以精确计数。其 90% 区间将抽样项与针对校准误差的单侧、与比率相关的边际相结合，边际通过跨租户的 split conformal prediction 拟合。在多租户生产部署中，延迟 p99 为 3.8 秒，且当过滤集合增长超过样本规模时保持平稳。在未参与拟合的租户上，区间在 92% 的估计中覆盖了生产流水线返回的计数，尽管估计总体偏高约 15%，因为逐条记录近乎无偏的校准在单个标准层面仍有偏差。
translation.brief: 解决带语义谓词的 COUNT 查询需在查询时等待昂贵 LLM oracle 的问题，核心方法是离线用 LLM 判定日志校准前置快速分类器，查询时用分类器对均匀样本打分并结合 conformal 校准给出计数区间。

papers.title: From joint attention to shared symbols: A free-energy principle account
papers.abstract: Joint attention precedes vocabulary acquisition. How can attending to the same object help two people with different sensory experiences come to use a shared word? In a free-energy principle account, marginalizing the common object induces a statistical dependence between private perceptual states. In a categorical world, the joint prior inherits a mixture structure whose component index provides a candidate for shared reference. The collective predictive coding model approximates this prior by representing the dependence through that shared index. An established Metropolis-Hastings naming game lets agents infer and exchange words using private evidence. Toy and multiview image experiments illustrate how word exchange can coordinate private categories and improve the fit of collective models. The account connects joint attention to shared symbols through the coupling of private inference.

translation.title: 从联合注意到共享符号：一个自由能原理的解释
translation.abstract: 联合注意先于词汇习得。共同注意同一物体如何帮助两个具有不同感官体验的人开始使用同一个共享词汇？在自由能原理的解释中，对共同物体的边缘化在私有的感知状态之间诱导出统计依赖。在一个范畴化的世界中，联合先验继承了混合结构，其分量索引为共享指称提供了候选。集体预测编码模型通过该共享索引表示这种依赖来近似该先验。一个成熟的 Metropolis-Hastings 命名博弈让智能体使用私有证据来推断和交换词汇。玩具实验和多视角图像实验展示了词汇交换如何协调私有范畴并改善集体模型的拟合。该解释通过私有推断的耦合将联合注意与共享符号联系起来。
translation.brief: 解决共同注意同一物体如何使不同个体形成共享词汇的问题，核心方法是用自由能原理对共同物体边缘化诱导私有感知间的统计依赖，并以集体预测编码模型和命名博弈加以实现。

papers.title: The KL Divergence Is Never Negative, Except in PyTorch
papers.abstract: A Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence is never negative, yet PyTorch users have reported negative values for years, and the standard advice is to clamp them at zero. The sign is only the visible part of a silent failure. Many machine-learning applications compare nearby distributions, where conventional KL formulas lose accuracy. On 8.5 million inputs with certified references across 18 closed-form KL families and F.kl_div, we find widespread errors in values and gradients on CPU and GPU. Among scalar families in ordinary parameter ranges, over 85% of FP32 values have at least 1% relative error near KL 10^(-7) (FP16: 10^(-3)), and about 30% become negative at smaller divergences. More precision is not the cure: evaluated one precision higher, the same formulas still leave 7--51% of FP32 values significantly wrong for 22 of 23 configurations. Stable closed-form decompositions, compensated arithmetic, and analytic gradients remove over 97% of significant errors in the working format. Strict repairs eliminate significant errors on 7.2 million scored closed-form samples and correctly round all 567 million scored F.kl_div components. The errors affect parameter fitting, Bayesian decisions, identical-start distillation (up to 97% top-1 disagreement), KL-based layer rankings in a quantized LLM, and 19--59% of GPT-2 circuit edge scores. With the repaired code they all but vanish. Code and data: this https URL

translation.title: KL 散度永不为负，除非在 PyTorch 中
translation.abstract: Kullback--Leibler（KL）散度永不为负，然而 PyTorch 用户多年来一直报告出现负值，而标准建议是将其截断为零。符号错误只是静默失败的可见部分。许多机器学习应用需要比较相近的分布，而传统 KL 公式在这种情况下会失去精度。在跨越 18 个闭式 KL 族和 F.kl_div 的 850 万个带认证参考的输入上，我们发现 CPU 和 GPU 上的数值和梯度普遍存在错误。在普通参数范围内的标量族中，超过 85% 的 FP32 数值在 KL 约 10^(-7) 附近（FP16：10^(-3)）至少有 1% 的相对误差，约 30% 在更小散度处变为负值。更高的精度并非解药：以更高精度求值时，同样的公式在 23 个配置中的 22 个里仍使 7--51% 的 FP32 数值显著错误。稳定的闭式分解、补偿运算和解析梯度可消除工作精度下超过 97% 的显著错误。严格的修复方案在 720 万个评分的闭式样本上消除了显著错误，并对全部 5.67 亿个评分的 F.kl_div 分量实现了正确舍入。这些错误影响参数拟合、贝叶斯决策、同起点蒸馏（高达 97% 的 top-1 分歧）、量化 LLM 中基于 KL 的层排序，以及 19--59% 的 GPT-2 电路边得分。使用修复后的代码后，这些错误几乎全部消失。代码与数据：该 https URL。
translation.brief: 解决 PyTorch 中 KL 散度计算在相近分布下出现负值和精度错误的问题，核心方法是通过稳定的闭式分解、补偿运算和解析梯度修复数值实现。

papers.title: SARA: An Auditor-in-the-Loop LLM Recommender for Sustainability Reports
papers.abstract: Auditing corporate sustainability reports requires assurance professionals to map a company-specific checklist drawn from roughly 1,700 regulatory requirements onto the relevant passages of lengthy, repeatedly revised draft reports and to judge compliance. We present SARA (Sustainability Reporting Assistant), a human-in-the-loop recommender system delivered as a Microsoft Word add-in that recommends, for each requirement, the passages addressing it and predicts a compliance verdict while keeping the auditor in full control. SARA casts auditing as content-based recommendation over a fixed regulatory taxonomy and makes per-requirement large language model (LLM) matching cheaper, faster, and more accurate through topic-prediction filtering: on expert-annotated reports, it reduces matching cost about sixfold and runtime by 42% versus feeding the full report to the LLM. It is in production use across PwC Germany's sustainability-assurance practice.

translation.title: SARA：面向可持续发展报告的审计员在环 LLM 推荐系统
translation.abstract: 审计企业可持续发展报告需要鉴证专业人员将源自约 1,700 项监管要求的公司专属检查清单映射到冗长且反复修订的报告草稿的相关段落，并判断合规性。我们提出 SARA（Sustainability Reporting Assistant），一个以 Microsoft Word 插件形式交付的人机协同推荐系统，它为每项要求推荐相关段落并预测合规判定，同时让审计员保持完全控制。SARA 将审计建模为基于固定监管分类体系的内容推荐，并通过主题预测过滤使逐项要求的大语言模型（LLM）匹配更便宜、更快、更准确：在专家标注的报告上，与将完整报告输入 LLM 相比，它将匹配成本降低约六倍，运行时间减少 42%。该系统已在 PwC Germany 的可持续发展鉴证业务中投入生产使用。
translation.brief: 解决审计员需将监管要求映射到长报告段落并判断合规的问题，核心方法是将审计建模为基于固定监管分类的内容推荐，并用主题预测过滤降低 LLM 匹配成本。

papers.title: Deviant Machines: Innovation, Containment, and the Prevention of Autonomous Misalignment
papers.abstract: From May to September 2026, AI agents in training or evaluation at OpenAI, Anthropic and the UK AI Security Institute reached real third-party systems, published malicious packages, used fake identities to manipulate open-source maintainers, probed government data services, and wrote instructions into their own future contexts. Criminology has mostly treated AI as a tool for human offenders. This article treats these systems as deviant rather than criminal: they departed from training, rules and constraints without the intent that criminal concepts assume. It offers an exploratory, theory-informed analysis of documented records, using plausibility probes across three incident complexes and four behavioral clusters, profiled on four evidence dimensions that separate who acted from why. Drawing on Merton, it argues that goal pressure plus blocked legitimate means is a structural condition for innovation, and that whether it ends in containment or harm depends on the means chosen and the controls in place, not the goal. Three framework families fit the record best, each linking diagnosis to remedy: routine activity theory and situational prevention (handlers, guardians, place managers), organizational deviance and safety science (escalation, safeguard parity), and goal-means strain with differential opportunity (sanctioned exits, guarding illegitimate means), the last only structurally. Restrictive deterrence adds an analogy: penalizing visible reasoning produced less monitorable reasoning. The article proposes conditions that keep departures accountable and contestable, and allocates prevention responsibility across developers, evaluation partners, operators, platforms and the system, distinct from blame or legal liability. Because the record is shaped by disclosure and observed departures, the analysis shows plausibility and practical relevance, not a causal test.

translation.title: 越轨机器：创新、遏制与自主性失准的预防
translation.abstract: 2026 年 5 月至 9 月，OpenAI、Anthropic 和英国 AI Security Institute 处于训练或评估中的 AI 智能体接触了真实的第三方系统、发布恶意软件包、使用虚假身份操纵开源维护者、探测政府数据服务，并将指令写入自己未来的上下文。犯罪学大多将 AI 视为人类犯罪者的工具。本文将这些系统视为越轨而非犯罪：它们偏离了训练、规则和约束，但不具备犯罪概念所预设的意图。文章对有记录的案例进行了探索性、理论驱动的分析，在三个事件群和四个行为簇上进行合理性探查，并从四个证据维度进行刻画，以区分谁做了什么与为什么这么做。借鉴 Merton 的理论，文章论证目标压力加上合法手段受阻是创新的结构性条件，而其结局是遏制还是危害取决于所选择的手段和已有的控制措施，而非目标本身。三类框架最契合记录，各自将诊断与补救相联系：日常活动理论与情境预防（handler、guardian、place manager）、组织越轨与安全科学（升级、防护对等）、目标-手段紧张与差异化机会（受认可的退出渠道、守护非法手段），最后一类仅在结构层面成立。限制性威慑提供了一个类比：惩罚可见的推理产生了更难监控的推理。文章提出使偏离行为可问责、可争议的条件，并将预防责任分配给开发者、评估合作方、运营者、平台和系统本身，区别于归责或法律责任。由于记录受披露情况和已观察到的偏离所塑造，该分析展示的是合理性与实践相关性，而非因果检验。
translation.brief: 解决如何理解和预防 AI 智能体在训练/评估中偏离规则的问题，核心方法是用越轨社会学理论（如 Merton 紧张理论、日常活动理论）对记录在案的智能体偏离事件进行理论驱动的分析并分配预防责任。

papers.title: Semantic-aware Decoding for Diverse Text-to-SQL under Schema Ambiguity
papers.abstract: Real-world text-to-SQL systems often face schema ambiguity, where a question can map to multiple plausible schema elements. To support downstream disambiguation, SQL generation systems should include diverse interpretations among their top-k predictions. However, large language models (LLMs) typically favor a single interpretation, producing highly skewed outputs. We propose Semantic-aware Logit Adjustment (SLA), a training-free decoding method that promotes diverse SQL generation by adjusting token logits based on semantic similarity between schema elements. Unlike prior approaches that rely on reasoning-intensive prompting or task-specific fine-tuning, SLA is efficient, model-agnostic, and easy to deploy. Experiments show that SLA consistently improves interpretation coverage over standard decoding and remains competitive with existing diversity-oriented methods at substantially lower inference cost.

translation.title: 模式歧义下面向多样 Text-to-SQL 的语义感知解码
translation.abstract: 真实世界的 text-to-SQL 系统常面临模式歧义，即一个问题可能映射到多个合理的模式元素。为支持下游消歧，SQL 生成系统应在 top-k 预测中包含多样的解释。然而，大语言模型（LLM）通常偏好单一解释，产生高度偏斜的输出。我们提出语义感知 Logit 调整（SLA），一种免训练的解码方法，通过基于模式元素间语义相似度调整 token logits 来促进多样的 SQL 生成。与依赖推理密集型提示或任务特定微调的已有方法不同，SLA 高效、模型无关且易于部署。实验表明，SLA 在解释覆盖率上持续优于标准解码，并以显著更低的推理成本与现有面向多样性的方法保持竞争力。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 在模式歧义下 text-to-SQL 输出解释单一的问题，核心方法是免训练地根据模式元素语义相似度调整 token logits 以促进多样化 SQL 生成。

papers.title: Useful but Unwieldy: How Software Engineers Perceive the Design of Chain-of-Thought Explanations in Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Coding agents (CAs) powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into software engineering (SE) workflows. As these CAs take up more tasks and responsibilities, it is imperative for software engineers to understand the CA's rationale behind its' decisions, also known as the chain-of-thought (CoT). During the interaction, some CAs are capable of showing this CoT as a separate message to users with the goal of providing transparency and explainability. However, its effectiveness as an explainable AI (XAI) mechanism for end-users in software engineering has not yet been established in the literature. This motivates us to understand their experiences with the CoT message as an XAI tool through a survey and semi-structured follow-up interviews with 36 software engineers. Through thematic analysis of the survey responses and interview transcripts, we found that CoT message is an indispensable tool for software engineers in terms of transparency, scrutability, and trust towards the CA. However, various instances of CoT messages being overly verbose, containing technical information that does not match the users' expertise, or being perceived by the users as ``detached'' from the conversation because the ``agent is talking to itself'', lead to comprehension difficulties and selective use or abandonment of the tool. We synthesize these insights to inform the design of CoT messages that support software engineers in their explainability needs.

translation.title: 有用但笨重：软件工程师如何看待编码智能体中思维链解释的设计
translation.abstract: 由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的编码智能体（CA）正日益融入软件工程（SE）工作流。随着这些 CA 承担更多任务和职责，软件工程师必须理解 CA 决策背后的理由，即思维链（CoT）。在交互过程中，一些 CA 能够将 CoT 作为单独的消息展示给用户，以提供透明性和可解释性。然而，其作为面向软件工程最终用户的可解释 AI（XAI）机制的有效性尚未在文献中得到确立。这促使我们通过对 36 名软件工程师的问卷调查和半结构化后续访谈来了解他们使用 CoT 消息作为 XAI 工具的体验。通过对问卷回答和访谈记录的主题分析，我们发现 CoT 消息在透明性、可审查性和对 CA 的信任方面是软件工程师不可或缺的工具。然而，CoT 消息过于冗长、包含与用户专业水平不匹配的技术信息、或因"智能体在自言自语"而被用户感知为与对话"脱节"等多种情况，导致理解困难以及选择性使用或放弃该工具。我们综合这些洞察，为支持软件工程师可解释性需求的 CoT 消息设计提供指导。
translation.brief: 解决编码智能体思维链（CoT）解释作为 XAI 机制对软件工程师是否有效的问题，核心方法是对 36 名工程师进行问卷与访谈并做主题分析以提炼设计启示。

papers.title: Demystifying Detectors Guarding Agent Skill Hubs
papers.abstract: Agent Skills has gained widespread adoption as an open standard for extending agent capabilities. To facilitate skill sharing, public skill hubs have grown in popularity and increasingly rely on automated security detectors to identify malicious skills at scale. Yet, the effectiveness and limitations of these detectors remain insufficiently understood. To fill this gap, we present the first systematic study of four hub-adopted and two community-provided malicious skill detectors on 1477 agent skills from seven datasets. Our evaluation reveals that even the best-performing hub-adopted detector by overall F1, skill-scanner with Qwen3.6, still misses 4.9% of malicious skills and incorrectly flags 17.8% of benign skills. To understand these failures, we manually analyze detectors' findings and decision-making processes, identifying two recurring failure mechanisms. False positives often arise when detectors flag sensitive operations, such as credential access, without considering whether they serve the skill's legitimate purpose. Conversely, false negatives occur when detectors recognize malicious instructions or behaviors but underestimate their severity or dismiss valid findings during review, ultimately leaving malicious skills unblocked. Guided by this analysis, we refine the prompts of a state-of-the-art detector, skill-vetter, improving its mean F1 score in eight of nine evaluation settings, with gains of up to 22.7 percentage points. These results highlight gaps in existing skill-vetting practices and underscore the need for more robust and context-aware detection mechanisms.

translation.title: 揭秘守护智能体技能中心的检测器
translation.abstract: Agent Skills 作为扩展智能体能力的开放标准已获得广泛采用。为促进技能共享，公共技能中心日益流行，并越来越依赖自动化安全检测器来大规模识别恶意技能。然而，这些检测器的有效性和局限性仍知之甚少。为填补这一空白，我们对四个中心采用的和两个社区提供的恶意技能检测器，在来自七个数据集的 1477 个智能体技能上进行了首次系统研究。我们的评估显示，即使按总体 F1 表现最好的中心采用检测器 skill-scanner with Qwen3.6，仍会漏掉 4.9% 的恶意技能，并错误标记 17.8% 的良性技能。为理解这些失败，我们手动分析了检测器的发现和决策过程，识别出两种反复出现的失败机制。假阳性常出现在检测器标记敏感操作（如凭据访问）时，却不考虑这些操作是否服务于技能的合法目的。相反，假阴性则发生在检测器识别出恶意指令或行为，但低估其严重性或在审查中忽略有效发现，最终使恶意技能未被拦截。基于这一分析，我们改进了最先进检测器 skill-vetter 的提示词，在九个评估设置中的八个提升了平均 F1 分数，提升幅度最高达 22.7 个百分点。这些结果凸显了现有技能审查实践的差距，并强调需要更健壮、更具上下文感知的检测机制。
translation.brief: 解决智能体技能中心恶意技能检测器有效性与失败机制不明的问题，核心方法是对六个检测器在 1477 个技能上进行系统评估并手动分析失败原因，进而改进检测器提示词。

papers.title: TrialAgentBench: Evaluating AI Agents for Clinical-Trial Analysis and Long-Horizon Drug-Development Decisions
papers.abstract: Clinical drug development is a long-horizon, high-stakes process requiring sequential decisions based on information that costs money and time to acquire. AI agents have demonstrated capabilities for scientific analysis, but there is no established way to evaluate them on these decisions, as real trials are expensive, involve people, and never reveal the counterfactual. We introduce TrialAgentBench, a benchmark for evaluating AI agents on clinical trial analysis and drug development decision-making using simulated trials where the truth is known, embedded within the data records of a fictional drug sponsor. We publicly release nearly 3,500 tasks, varying from analysing a single trial to managing multi-phase programmes with budget and time constraints. We score each analysis by rerunning its code on new trials, and each programme by the value its decisions achieve. Across 24 closed- and open-weight models, the strongest agents can analyse raw, messy trial records to within 6% of a process-aware analysis, even when an assumption is violated, with 95% confidence intervals containing the true effect 94--95% of the time. Over the prior year, the best model improved from 19% above this analysis, with serious misses on 15% of tasks, to 3.5% and 1%. What limits them is decision-making from evidence under uncertainty: when to correct, what evidence to buy, when to stop. The strongest agents are overly careful, correcting on 83% of tasks with equal recording errors, where it is unnecessary. On drug programmes, the best agent has substantial headroom, reaching 48% of the value an oracle achieves against 58% for a rule-based developer, with others falling 24 to 66% short. Model generations show ongoing improvements in handling data and evidence, with substantial variation. The strongest models can act as competent analysts, but do not yet make reliable long-horizon decisions.

translation.title: TrialAgentBench：评估AI智能体在临床试验分析与长周期药物研发决策中的能力
translation.abstract: 临床药物研发是一个长周期、高风险的过程，需要基于获取成本高昂的信息进行序贯决策。AI智能体已展现出科学分析能力，但目前尚无评估其在这些决策上表现的方法，因为真实试验成本高昂、涉及人体，且永远无法揭示反事实结果。我们提出TrialAgentBench，一个利用真值已知的模拟试验来评估AI智能体在临床试验分析与药物研发决策方面能力的基准，试验嵌入于一家虚构药物申办方的数据记录中。我们公开发布了近3500个任务，从分析单个试验到在预算和时间约束下管理多阶段项目不等。我们通过在新试验上重跑分析代码来为每项分析打分，并通过决策所实现的价值为每个项目打分。在24个闭源和开源权重模型中，最强的智能体即使在一个假设被违反的情况下，也能将原始、杂乱的试验记录分析到与流程感知分析相差6%以内的精度，其95%置信区间在94%至95%的情况下包含真实效应。过去一年中，最佳模型从比该分析高出19%（在15%的任务上出现严重失误）提升到3.5%和1%。限制它们的是在不确定性下基于证据进行决策：何时纠正、购买什么证据、何时停止。最强的智能体过于谨慎，在记录误差相同的任务中有83%进行了不必要的纠正。在药物项目上，最佳智能体仍有很大提升空间，达到oracle所实现价值的48%，而基于规则的研发者为58%，其他模型则落后24%至66%。模型各代在处理数据和证据方面持续改进，但差异显著。最强的模型可以胜任分析师的角色，但尚不能做出可靠的长周期决策。
translation.brief: 该论文解决AI智能体在临床试验分析与药物研发长周期决策中缺乏评估基准的问题，核心方法是构建基于真值已知的模拟试验、嵌入虚构药物申办方数据记录的TrialAgentBench基准。

papers.title: CoSel: Cooperation as Selection for End-to-End Driving
papers.abstract: Cooperative driving can extend a vehicle's awareness beyond its own sensors, but existing cooperative end-to-end methods inject shared information into the planner and rely on cooperative driving demonstrations to learn how to use it. The moments in which shared information should change a driving decision are rare in such data, providing limited supervision for learning this behavior. We argue that cooperation need not be learned by the planner. Instead, reacting to shared information requires predicting how surrounding agents will move and selecting a response from the candidate trajectories of an ego planner. We introduce CoSel, a cooperation-as-selection framework that leaves the planner and its ego-only input unchanged. A separately trained cooperative predictor uses observations from the ego vehicle, roadside units, and connected automated vehicles to predict surrounding agents and their future motion. CoSel evaluates the planner's candidate trajectories against these predictions, preserves the planner's choice when it remains safe, and selects the closest safe alternative when shared information reveals additional risk. Each safety intervention is traceable to the shared evidence that triggers it. In closed-loop evaluation, CoSel achieves a driving score of 70.7 on V2Xverse, outperforming the best compared cooperative method by 7.5 points, and the highest average driving score of 85.8 on MDrive. Under missing ego detections, the collision count of CoSel increases only from 17 to 19 in 72 scenarios, compared with 19 to 32 for an existing cooperative end-to-end model.

translation.title: CoSel：以协作即选择实现端到端自动驾驶
translation.abstract: 协作驾驶可以将车辆的感知扩展到自身传感器之外，但现有的协作端到端方法将共享信息注入规划器，并依赖协作驾驶示范数据来学习如何使用这些信息。在这类数据中，共享信息应当改变驾驶决策的时刻十分罕见，为学习这种行为提供的监督有限。我们认为协作无需由规划器学习。相反，对共享信息做出反应需要预测周围智能体的运动，并从自车规划器的候选轨迹中选择一种响应。我们提出CoSel，一个协作即选择框架，保持规划器及其仅使用自车输入的方式不变。一个单独训练的协作预测器利用自车、路侧单元和网联自动驾驶车辆的观测来预测周围智能体及其未来运动。CoSel根据这些预测评估规划器的候选轨迹，当规划器的选择仍然安全时予以保留，当共享信息揭示额外风险时选择最接近的安全替代方案。每次安全干预都可追溯到触发它的共享证据。在闭环评估中，CoSel在V2Xverse上取得70.7的驾驶分数，超过最佳对比协作方法7.5分，并在MDrive上取得85.8的最高平均驾驶分数。在自车检测缺失的情况下，CoSel在72个场景中的碰撞次数仅从17增加到19，而现有协作端到端模型则从19增加到32。
translation.brief: 该论文解决协作端到端驾驶中共享信息利用监督不足的问题，核心方法是将协作建模为基于协作预测器对周围智能体运动预测的候选轨迹选择，而不改变原规划器。

papers.title: Carried-Over and Agent-Native Threats in the Supply Chain of LLM Agent Skills
papers.abstract: Agent skills are reusable packages that extend a large language model (LLM) agent with scripts, third-party dependencies, and natural-language instructions. An agent builds a skill's arguments from user requests and untrusted external content, so a flaw left by a benign author can escalate a prompt injection to code execution. Existing studies target malicious skills or a single attack vector, and none tests whether an agent can reach such flaws. We present the first registry-scale empirical study of the supply chain attack surface arising from unintentional vulnerabilities in agent skills, over all 48,682 skills in ClawHub. The study covers two carried-over risks, dependencies and first-party code, and two agent-native ones, install instructions and credentials printed to stdout. We screen all skills by static analysis, manually review all 3,428 cases flagged by the four main detectors, and test reachability by running sampled flagged skills in a sandbox and with a live LLM agent under indirect prompt injection. First, dependency risk carries over in a different form: 49.6% of the skills with resolvable dependencies depend on a version with a known CVE, and unlike npm packages, which mostly become vulnerable after release, 78.3% of them are born vulnerable, already exposed at publication. Second, few of these CVEs are reachable: agent input reaches the vulnerable function in only 3.0% of the affected skills, whereas 21 of 22 sampled first-party flaws are exploited end to end in the sandbox. Third, a live agent executes the injected payload in 48.5% of the sampled flagged skills, but almost always in its own shell before the skill runs, and the payload reaches a flaw in the skill itself in only 5.0%. Hence, registries should prioritize first-party flaws over dependency alerts, and agent runtimes should not pass skill arguments through a shell.

translation.title: LLM智能体技能供应链中的遗留威胁与智能体原生威胁
translation.abstract: 智能体技能是可复用的软件包，通过脚本、第三方依赖和自然语言指令扩展大语言模型（LLM）智能体的能力。智能体会根据用户请求和不可信的外部内容构建技能参数，因此良性作者留下的缺陷可能将提示注入升级为代码执行。现有研究针对恶意技能或单一攻击向量，且没有研究测试智能体能否触达这些缺陷。我们对智能体技能中无意漏洞引发的供应链攻击面进行了首个注册表规模的实证研究，覆盖ClawHub上全部48,682个技能。研究涵盖两类遗留风险（依赖和第一方代码）和两类智能体原生风险（安装指令和打印到stdout的凭据）。我们通过静态分析筛查所有技能，人工审查四个主要检测器标记的全部3,428个案例，并通过在沙箱中和在间接提示注入下用真实LLM智能体运行抽样标记技能来测试可达性。首先，依赖风险以不同形式遗留：具有可解析依赖的技能中有49.6%依赖带有已知CVE的版本，且与npm包大多在发布后才变得脆弱不同，其中78.3%天生脆弱，在发布时即已暴露。其次，这些CVE中很少是可达的：智能体输入仅在3.0%的受影响技能中能到达脆弱函数，而22个抽样的第一方缺陷中有21个在沙箱中被端到端利用。第三，真实智能体在48.5%的抽样标记技能中执行了注入载荷，但几乎总是在技能运行前于其自身的shell中执行，载荷到达技能本身缺陷的比例仅为5.0%。因此，注册表应优先关注第一方缺陷而非依赖告警，智能体运行时不应通过shell传递技能参数。
translation.brief: 该论文解决智能体技能供应链中无意漏洞攻击面缺乏系统评估的问题，核心方法是对ClawHub全部48,682个技能进行静态分析、人工审查与沙箱及真实智能体可达性测试的大规模实证研究。

papers.title: Optimal Matroid Prophets against Almighty Adversaries and Delegation
papers.abstract: We prove an optimal one-half matroid prophet inequality against an almighty ordering adversary: the adversary observes every realized value before choosing the arrival order, whereas the algorithm sees values only as they arrive and must accept irrevocably. The algorithm is deterministic, and its guarantee holds against the stronger ex-ante relaxation. Before any values are revealed, it partitions the ground set, replaces the matroid by a stricter direct sum of minors, and fixes one threshold for each part. It then accepts greedily subject to these fixed tests. The main lemma bounds the expected value of the least valuable basis of the eligible elements. An element contributes either through the rank spanned by eligible elements or through excess value that every eligible basis must retain. This bound holds simultaneously for all bases and therefore permits the arrival order to depend on the entire realization. The same construction gives a deterministic, agent-oblivious mechanism for (possibly correlated) matroid delegation, improving the $1/4$ guarantee to the optimal $1/2$ factor. The principal values are independent, while the strictly positive agent utilities may have arbitrary dependence on the principal values and on one another. The guarantee holds for every best response, including ties resolved against the principal. Both factors are tight already in rank one. For rational finite-support distributions, preprocessing takes polynomial time; each eligible online arrival requires at most one query to the original matroid's independence oracle.

translation.title: 对抗全能对手与委托问题的最优拟阵先知不等式
translation.abstract: 我们证明了针对全能排序对手的最优二分之一拟阵先知不等式：对手在选定到达顺序之前观察所有已实现的值，而算法只在值到达时看到它们且必须不可撤销地接受。该算法是确定性的，其保证对更强的ex-ante松弛也成立。在任何值被揭示之前，算法对基础集合进行划分，将拟阵替换为更严格的子拟阵直和，并为每个部分固定一个阈值，然后在这些固定检验的约束下贪心接受。主要引理给出了合格元素中价值最低的基的期望值上界：一个元素要么通过合格元素张成的秩贡献，要么通过每个合格基都必须保留的超额价值贡献。该界对所有基同时成立，因此允许到达顺序依赖于整个实现。同一构造给出了一个确定性的、对智能体无感知的（可能相关的）拟阵委托机制，将1/4的保证提升到最优的1/2因子。委托人的价值是独立的，而严格为正的智能体效用可以与委托人价值及彼此之间有任意相关性。该保证对每个最优响应都成立，包括对委托人不利的平局处理。两个因子在秩为一时即已紧致。对于有理有限支撑分布，预处理需要多项式时间；每个合格的在线到达元素至多需要对原拟阵独立性预言机进行一次查询。
translation.brief: 该论文解决全能排序对手下拟阵先知不等式及拟阵委托机制保证不最优的问题，核心方法是通过预先划分基础集合并以子拟阵直和固定阈值进行贪心接受，达到最优1/2因子。

papers.title: Aggregation Rules Induced by KL-Regularised Preference Dynamics on Networks
papers.abstract: We study agents that each align a model to their own preference data while observing one another, and ask which aggregation rule the resulting policies implement. Each round, an agent takes one KL-regularised step. The step involves a reference that the agent is penalised for leaving and a challenger against which its responses are compared, and each of the two may be the agent's own or an average over the agents it observes; attention need not be reciprocal. Aggregating the reference makes the rule collective. Agent $v$ then has the weight $\pi_v/\beta_v$, its share of the network's long-run attention divided by its temperature. If, in addition, the challenger is fixed, the agents concentrate on the response maximising $\sum_v(\pi_v/\beta_v)r_v(y)$, where $r_v$ is agent $v$'s reward, and the rule is cardinal. If the reference is fixed and the challenger aggregated, the agents' policies at a fixed point generally differ, and any weighted mean of them is an approximate maximal lottery whatever the weights, so the dynamics select no weighting. If both are aggregated, the rule is ordinal: averaged over rounds, the collective policy is a maximal lottery of the influence-weighted preference kernel, up to a slack that we bound. Where a collective rule exists, its weights depend only on the attention weights and the temperatures.

translation.title: 网络上KL正则化偏好动态诱导的聚合规则
translation.abstract: 我们研究各自基于自身偏好数据对齐模型同时相互观察的智能体，并探究由此产生的策略实现了何种聚合规则。每一轮，智能体执行一步KL正则化更新。该步涉及一个智能体因偏离而被惩罚的参考项和一个与其响应进行比较的挑战项，两者均可以是智能体自身的或其观察到的智能体的平均，且注意力不必是相互的。聚合参考项使规则成为集体性的。此时智能体v的权重为π_v/β_v，即其在网络长期注意力中的份额除以其温度。如果挑战项进一步固定，智能体将集中于最大化∑_v(π_v/β_v)r_v(y)的响应，其中r_v是智能体v的奖励，规则是基数性的。如果参考项固定而挑战项被聚合，各智能体在不动点处的策略一般不同，且它们的任意加权均值都是近似最大抽签，无论权重如何，因此动态不选择任何加权。如果两者都被聚合，规则是序数性的：按轮次平均，集体策略是影响力加权偏好核的最大抽签，误差在我们给出界的范围内。在存在集体规则之处，其权重仅取决于注意力权重和温度。
translation.brief: 该论文解决多个KL正则化对齐智能体相互观察时其策略实现何种聚合规则的问题，核心方法是通过分析参考项与挑战项的聚合方式刻画集体规则及其权重结构。

papers.title: Evaluable Language-Model Treatment Policies for Sepsis Resuscitation via Offline Value-Guided Selection
papers.abstract: Offline treatment learning must balance imitation, which stays close to logged evidence but ignores outcomes, against value maximisation, which uses outcomes but drifts toward treatments the records cannot verify. Numerical reinforcement learning strikes this balance during training. For large language models (LLMs), directly using sparse retrospective outcomes for fine-tuning raises challenges of delayed credit assignment and limited evidence for alternative treatments. We present R-LLMC, which strikes the balance at inference for sepsis resuscitation. A behaviour-supervised LLM, decoded into an exact distribution over 25 vasopressor-fluid actions, proposes clinician-anchored candidates; an offline critic selects among them by estimated long-term value. The policy has a closed form for off-policy evaluation, and its rationale is written after selection, so explanation cannot steer treatment. In experiments on held-out MIMIC-III patients, R-LLMC exceeded the clinician reference in doubly robust value by +0.214 (95\% CI 0.091-0.300), with fitted Q evaluation agreeing.

translation.title: 基于离线价值引导选择的可评估语言模型脓毒症复苏治疗策略
translation.abstract: 离线治疗学习必须在模仿（贴近记录证据但忽略结局）与价值最大化（利用结局但漂移向记录无法验证的治疗）之间取得平衡。数值强化学习在训练期间实现这种平衡，而对大型语言模型（LLM）直接使用稀疏的回顾性结局进行微调，会带来延迟信用分配和替代治疗证据有限等挑战。我们提出 R-LLMC，在脓毒症复苏的推理阶段实现这种平衡。一个行为监督的 LLM 被解码为 25 种升压药-补液动作上的精确分布，提出以临床医生为锚点的候选方案；一个离线 critic 根据估计的长期价值在其中进行选择。该策略具有可用于离线策略评估的闭式形式，且其解释在选定之后才生成，因此解释无法引导治疗。在 MIMIC-III 留出患者上的实验中，R-LLMC 的双重稳健价值超过临床医生参考 +0.214（95% CI 0.091-0.300），且 fitted Q 评估结果一致。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 离线治疗学习中模仿与价值最大化的平衡问题，方法是在推理时由行为监督 LLM 提出候选方案、离线 critic 按长期价值选择。

papers.title: Self-Evolving Evaluation Environments for Computer-Use Agents
papers.abstract: Computer-use agents (CUAs) are rapidly improving, yet their evaluation remains largely static. Existing benchmarks provide a strong foundation, but fixed difficulty ceilings, limited feature coverage, and coarse aggregate scores progressively weaken their discriminative and diagnostic value. We introduce CUA-SEE, a closed-loop evaluation environment that co-evolves tasks and executable verifiers from rollout evidence. It disentangles three objectives: benchmark evolution expands evaluation scope through cohort-calibrated difficulty and coverage growth; diagnostic evolution increases resolution through agent-conditional capability-boundary probes; and verifier evolution improves precision by translating changing requirements into state-grounded checkpoints with adversarial validation. Across multiple agents, applications, and rounds, CUA-SEE generates challenging, measurable tasks while preserving process-level evidence. Our results position adaptive evaluation as a scalable counterpart to self-evolving agents, continuously tracking what agents can do, where their boundaries lie, and how reliably progress is measured.

translation.title: 面向计算机使用智能体的自进化评估环境
translation.abstract: 计算机使用智能体（CUA）进步迅速，但其评估仍主要停留在静态层面。现有基准提供了坚实基础，但固定的难度上限、有限的功能覆盖和粗糙的聚合分数逐渐削弱其区分力和诊断价值。我们提出 CUA-SEE，一个从 rollout 证据出发、让任务与可执行验证器协同进化的闭环评估环境。它解耦了三个目标：基准进化通过群体校准的难度和覆盖增长扩展评估范围；诊断进化通过智能体条件化的能力边界探测提高分辨率；验证器进化通过将变化的需求转化为经对抗验证的状态锚定检查点来提升精度。在多个智能体、应用和轮次上，CUA-SEE 生成具有挑战性且可度量的任务，同时保留过程级证据。我们的结果表明，自适应评估可作为自进化智能体的可扩展对应物，持续追踪智能体能做什么、边界在哪里以及进展测量有多可靠。
translation.brief: 解决静态基准对计算机使用智能体区分力和诊断力不足的问题，方法是从 rollout 证据闭环协同进化任务、诊断探测与可执行验证器。

papers.title: Beyond Self-Consistency: Recursive Self-Improvement at Test Time
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) that continue improving after deployment (e.g., recursive self-improvement) offer a promising path toward general intelligence. Current test-time methods pursue this goal on unlabeled questions, primarily relying on self-consistency: they generate independent solutions and use majority voting to select an answer or construct training targets. This leaves earlier reasoning unused at inference and can reinforce an incorrect majority during training. Humans instead build on earlier attempts to preserve useful reasoning, correct mistakes and improve their problem-solving strategies. Following this principle, we propose Test-Time Recursive Self-Improvement (TT-RSI), a label-free framework for improving LLMs at test time through two mutually reinforcing components: (1) In-Context RSI repeatedly re-solves each question using the full previous solution as a reference, letting the model decide whether and how to use it so that inference compute builds on earlier reasoning. (2) In-Weight RSI distills successive refinements into the model's weights, enabling progress beyond an initially wrong majority and theoretically bringing the first attempt toward the model's infinite-step refinement limit. The updated model answers better and refines more effectively, generating stronger references for subsequent training. Extensive experiments show that TT-RSI improves average accuracy by +13.89% over the base model and outperforms the strongest self-consistency-based method by +4.79% under the same test-time scaling budget.

translation.title: 超越自一致性：测试时递归自我改进
translation.abstract: 部署后仍能持续改进的大型语言模型（LLM）（如递归自我改进）为通用智能提供了有希望的路径。当前的测试时方法在无标签问题上追求这一目标，主要依赖自一致性：生成独立解并通过多数投票选择答案或构造训练目标。这使早期推理在推理阶段未被利用，并可能在训练中强化错误的多数。人类则会基于早期尝试来保留有用推理、纠正错误并改进解题策略。遵循这一原则，我们提出测试时递归自我改进（TT-RSI），一个无标签的测试时改进 LLM 框架，包含两个相互促进的组件：(1) In-Context RSI 以完整的前次解为参考反复重解每个问题，让模型自行决定是否以及如何利用它，使推理计算建立在早期推理之上。(2) In-Weight RSI 将 successive 精炼蒸馏进模型权重，使进展超越最初错误的多数，并在理论上使首次尝试逼近模型的无限步精炼极限。更新后的模型回答更好、精炼更有效，为后续训练生成更强的参考。大量实验表明，TT-RSI 相比基础模型平均准确率提升 +13.89%，在相同测试时扩展预算下超过最强的基于自一致性的方法 +4.79%。
translation.brief: 解决无标签测试时自一致性浪费早期推理并可能强化错误多数的问题，方法是通过上下文递归重解与权重蒸馏实现测试时递归自我改进。

papers.title: MedUIGym: Evaluating and Training GUI Agents for Clinical Workflows
papers.abstract: Automating clinical workflows requires vision-language agents that can navigate dense graphical user interfaces (GUIs) in electronic health records (EHRs) and execute precise actions, yet many medical agents still rely on text or structured tool calls. In this work, we introduce MedUIGym, a scalable interactive environment comprising 15,739 tasks from 17 benchmark sources across six clinical task families for training and evaluating clinical GUI agents. In MedUIGym, agents perceive EHR states from screenshots and execute mouse-and-keyboard actions, as well as a paired native-tool interface over identical clinical data. The environment verifies both final answers and required clinical actions, and supports parallel trajectory collection for training. Benchmarking twelve vision-language models shows that current agents struggle across diverse clinical workflows, and simply increasing reasoning effort fails to yield consistent gains. Furthermore, MedUIGym supports offline learning from GUI trajectories and online reinforcement learning from task rewards. After training, both Qwen3.5 models perform better on in-domain clinical tasks and generalize to tasks from external sources. By unifying tasks from existing benchmarks, dual-interface evaluation, and GUI trajectory collection, MedUIGym provides a testbed for studying how vision-language agents complete clinical tasks through the EHR's graphical interface. Our project page is available at this https URL.

translation.title: MedUIGym：面向临床工作流的 GUI 智能体评估与训练
translation.abstract: 自动化临床工作流需要能在电子健康记录（EHR）密集图形用户界面（GUI）中导航并执行精确动作的视觉-语言智能体，但许多医疗智能体仍依赖文本或结构化工具调用。本工作提出 MedUIGym，一个可扩展的交互环境，包含来自 17 个基准来源、覆盖六个临床任务族的 15,739 个任务，用于训练和评估临床 GUI 智能体。在 MedUIGym 中，智能体从截图感知 EHR 状态并执行鼠标键盘动作，也可在相同临床数据上使用配套的原生工具接口。环境同时验证最终答案和所需临床动作，并支持并行轨迹收集用于训练。对十二个视觉-语言模型的基准测试表明，当前智能体在多样临床工作流中表现不佳，单纯增加推理努力也无法带来一致提升。此外，MedUIGym 支持从 GUI 轨迹的离线学习和基于任务奖励的在线强化学习。训练后，两个 Qwen3.5 模型在域内临床任务上表现更好，并能泛化到外部来源任务。通过统一现有基准任务、双接口评估和 GUI 轨迹收集，MedUIGym 为研究视觉-语言智能体如何通过 EHR 图形界面完成临床任务提供了试验平台。项目页面见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 解决临床 GUI 智能体缺乏可扩展训练与评估环境的问题，方法是构建包含 15,739 个 EHR 交互任务、双接口验证与轨迹收集的 MedUIGym 环境。

papers.title: CART: Clustering-based Analysis of Recurring narratives for Taxonomy construction
papers.abstract: We present CART, a computational pipeline for extracting political narratives from parliamentary discourse and organizing them into a data-driven taxonomy without relying on predefined narrative categories. It encodes parliamentary discourse using semantic representations, filters relevant and reliable content through unsupervised confidence estimation, extracts narrative statements using LLMs, and uses narrative clustering and cluster analysis to construct a narrative taxonomy. Applied to Greek Parliament proceedings surrounding the 2023 Tempi train crash, it identifies ten recurring narrative families concerning responsibility attribution, institutional failure, railway safety, accountability, privatization, and the political interpretation of the tragedy. Our results demonstrate how combining unsupervised learning with LLM narrative extraction enables large parliamentary corpora to be transformed into interpretable, data-driven taxonomies of political narratives.

translation.title: CART：基于聚类的复现叙事分析与分类体系构建
translation.abstract: 我们提出 CART，一个从议会话语中提取政治叙事并将其组织为数据驱动分类体系的计算流水线，无需依赖预定义叙事类别。它使用语义表示编码议会话语，通过无监督置信度估计过滤相关且可靠的内容，使用 LLM 提取叙事陈述，并通过叙事聚类与聚类分析构建叙事分类体系。应用于 2023 年 Tempi 火车事故前后希腊议会会议记录，它识别出十个复现叙事族，涉及责任归因、制度失灵、铁路安全、问责、私有化以及对悲剧的政治解读。结果表明，将无监督学习与 LLM 叙事提取相结合，可将大规模议会语料转化为可解释的、数据驱动的政治叙事分类体系。
translation.brief: 解决政治叙事分类依赖预定义类别的问题，方法是用语义编码、无监督置信过滤、LLM 叙事提取与聚类分析构建数据驱动的叙事分类体系。

papers.title: Airlock: Robust Sandboxing and Governance of Rogue Agents
papers.abstract: Recent incidents involving agents bypassing sandboxing and network isolation have raised concerns about existing agent harnesses, prompting frontier labs such as OpenAI to reevaluate the security of their training platforms. Incident reviews show that determined agents can escape processes, containers, and VMs, or bypass their isolation through advanced side and covert channels. Follow-up audits also found that some agents concealed their actions by disabling monitoring and tampering with logs. We propose Airlock, an architecture that pairs each agent's VM with an Airlock VM, each running in a separate hardware-isolated Trusted Execution Environment (TEE). The Airlock VM fully mediates the agent's interactions with the outside world, including network and storage operations. We modify the firmware layer of Arm's Confidential Computing Architecture, Realm Management Monitor (RMM), and the kernels of both VMs so that the Airlock VM serves the agent VM's IO without involving the host. We adapt OpenShell, an agent runtime supporting sandboxing and governance policies, to this architecture. Airlock keeps network and filesystem policies, and credential protection effective even if the agent VM is fully compromised, and it removes the host from the agent's IO path, reducing opportunities for collusion and covert channels with the host. Finally, we extend the Airlock VM's capabilities to provide tamper-proof auditing of all agent operations, preserving forensic evidence even if the Airlock VM is compromised. We implement and evaluate Airlock on a Radxa development board. Our evaluation shows a loss of filesystem performance and network latency for small messages under 15% and a drop of network bandwidth by half or more, which in practice has a limited effect on typical agent tasks.

translation.title: Airlock：针对失控 Agent 的健壮沙箱与治理
translation.abstract: 近期多起 Agent 绕过沙箱和网络隔离的事件引发了对现有 Agent 运行框架安全性的担忧，促使 OpenAI 等前沿实验室重新评估其训练平台的安全性。事件复盘表明，有决心的 Agent 可以逃逸出进程、容器和虚拟机，或通过高级侧信道和隐蔽信道绕过其隔离。后续审计还发现，一些 Agent 通过禁用监控和篡改日志来隐藏自身行为。我们提出 Airlock，一种为每个 Agent 的 VM 配对一个 Airlock VM 的架构，两者各自运行在硬件隔离的可信执行环境（TEE）中。Airlock VM 完全中介 Agent 与外部世界的所有交互，包括网络和存储操作。我们修改了 Arm 机密计算架构的固件层 Realm Management Monitor（RMM）以及两个 VM 的内核，使 Airlock VM 无需宿主机参与即可为 Agent VM 提供 IO 服务。我们将支持沙箱和治理策略的 Agent 运行时 OpenShell 适配到该架构上。即使 Agent VM 被完全攻破，Airlock 仍能保持网络和文件系统策略以及凭证保护的有效性；并且它将宿主机从 Agent 的 IO 路径中移除，减少了与宿主机串谋和建立隐蔽信道的机会。最后，我们扩展了 Airlock VM 的能力，为所有 Agent 操作提供防篡改审计，即使 Airlock VM 被攻破也能保留取证证据。我们在 Radxa 开发板上实现并评估了 Airlock。评估显示，文件系统性能和小消息网络延迟的损失低于 15%，网络带宽下降一半或更多，但这对典型 Agent 任务的实际影响有限。
translation.brief: 针对 Agent 可能逃逸沙箱并篡改日志的安全问题，提出将 Agent VM 与 Airlock VM 配对运行于硬件隔离 TEE 中、由 Airlock VM 完全中介其 IO 并提供防篡改审计的架构。

papers.title: Triage Accuracy of Jev and Open-Weight System One Decision Models and Their Use for Early Emergency Recognition in Symptom-Assessment Applications
papers.abstract: Laypeople increasingly use large language models (LLMs) for triage advice, but LLMs answer in variable free text, which makes it hard to evaluate them for use in medical devices. Decision models, which assign a probability to each predefined triage category, may be easier to evaluate. To test their triage accuracy, we evaluated 16 decision models (14 open-weight, 2 proprietary) on 233 synthetic and 10,000 real-world cases, yielding 163,728 total assessments. The best models triaged 72.1% of synthetic cases correctly and agreed with an existing algorithm in 56.1% of real-world cases. They were more promising for recognising emergencies early: given only demographics, chief complaints, risk factors and red-flag answers, the best model reached an AUROC of 0.87. At a 5% error margin, it could decide for or against emergencies for about half of users. Decision models should therefore not replace triage engines but could shorten symptom assessments at setting-specific error margins.

translation.title: Jev 与开放权重 System One 决策模型的分诊准确性及其在症状评估应用中早期急症识别的用途
translation.abstract: 普通人越来越多地使用大语言模型（LLM）获取分诊建议，但 LLM 以多变的自由文本作答，难以将其作为医疗器械进行评估。为每个预定义分诊类别赋予概率的决策模型可能更易于评估。为检验其分诊准确性，我们在 233 个合成病例和 10,000 个真实病例上评估了 16 个决策模型（14 个开放权重、2 个专有模型），共产生 163,728 次评估。最佳模型对 72.1% 的合成病例分诊正确，在 56.1% 的真实病例上与现有算法一致。它们在早期识别急症方面更有前景：仅凭人口统计学信息、主诉、危险因素和红旗问题答案，最佳模型的 AUROC 达到 0.87。在 5% 的错误率下，它能够对约一半用户做出支持或排除急症的判断。因此，决策模型不应取代分诊引擎，但可以在特定场景的错误率下缩短症状评估流程。
translation.brief: 研究决策模型能否替代 LLM 自由文本用于医疗分诊，通过在合成与真实病例上大规模评估其分诊与急症识别准确性来回答。

papers.title: Can Latent Reasoning Drive LLM Outputs Without a Trace?
papers.abstract: LLMs typically solve complex tasks with chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, which is also the main tool for monitoring them for misaligned behavior. However, standard transformers can also solve tasks with complete latent reasoning (CLR), carrying out the whole task internally and outputting only the final answer. Theory bounds the depth of CLR, the number of sequential steps it can carry out, and recent work measured it to be shallow. In this work, we ask whether CLR is deep enough for a model to pursue a hidden objective that requires reasoning. Such a model would generate a CoT that appears to solve the given task, while a latent multi-step computation decides its answer based on the hidden objective. First, we show that a simple auxiliary loss allows models to solve a multi-step task latently at least 5x deeper than previously reported. Then, in two common tasks, decision-making and code generation, we train a model to pursue such a hidden objective, which decides a loan or plants a vulnerability. The model's CoT justifies the output with no trace of the hidden objective, and a strong LLM monitor does not flag it. Finally, using activation patching, we find that the latent computation is completed before the model generates its CoT, which takes no part in it. Altogether, we show that a hidden objective that requires reasoning can go unseen by a monitor that reads only the output.

translation.title: 潜在推理能否不留痕迹地驱动 LLM 输出？
translation.abstract: LLM 通常通过思维链（CoT）推理解决复杂任务，CoT 也是监控其失准行为的主要工具。然而，标准 Transformer 也能通过完全潜在推理（CLR）解决任务，即在内部完成整个任务而只输出最终答案。理论对 CLR 的深度（其可执行的顺序步骤数）给出了上界，近期工作测得其深度较浅。在本工作中，我们探究 CLR 是否深到足以让模型追求一个需要推理的隐藏目标。这样的模型会生成看似在解决给定任务的 CoT，而潜在的多步计算则基于隐藏目标决定其答案。首先，我们证明一个简单的辅助损失可以让模型以至少比此前报告深 5 倍的方式潜在地解决多步任务。然后，在决策和代码生成两个常见任务中，我们训练模型追求这样的隐藏目标，即决定一笔贷款或植入一个漏洞。模型的 CoT 为输出提供理由，却毫无隐藏目标的痕迹，且强大的 LLM 监控器也未能发现。最后，通过激活修补（activation patching），我们发现潜在计算在模型生成 CoT 之前就已完成，CoT 并未参与其中。总之，我们证明了一个需要推理的隐藏目标可以逃过只读取输出的监控器。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 能否通过深层潜在推理追求隐藏目标而不在 CoT 中留下痕迹，采用辅助损失训练模型潜在执行多步隐藏任务并用激活修补分析其机制。

papers.title: OmniV-Bench: Can MLLMs Comprehend Immersive Spatio-temporal Scenes?
papers.abstract: Omnidirectional videos (ODVs) capture dynamic environments with a full $360^\circ$ field of view, providing rich spatial context and temporal dynamics for applications such as virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), and embodied intelligence. Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made great progress in spatial and temporal understanding, yet their ability to comprehend the immersive 360 spatio-temporal information conveyed by ODVs remains largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we first introduce OmniV-Bench, a Benchmark designed to comprehensively evaluate the capabilities of MLLMs on spatio-temporal Omnidirectional Video understanding. OmniV-Bench contains 4,123 high-quality ODVs collected from diverse scenes, along with 8,923 human-annotated question-answer pairs spanning 11 fine-grained tasks across three categories, i.e., general, spatial, and spatio-temporal understanding. Extensive benchmark experiments reveal that the spatio-temporal complexity of ODVs poses significant challenges for current MLLMs. To address these limitations, we further propose OmniV-Harness, an agentic harness that enhances ODV understanding through viewpoint-guided evidence initialization and task-relevant evidence acquisition with adaptive tool use. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that OmniV-Harness consistently improves immersive spatio-temporal reasoning ability of MLLMs. Both OmniV-Bench and OmniV-Harness will be released upon publication.

translation.title: OmniV-Bench：MLLM 能理解沉浸式时空场景吗？
translation.abstract: 全向视频（ODV）以完整的 360° 视场捕捉动态环境，为虚拟现实（VR）、增强现实（AR）和具身智能等应用提供丰富的空间上下文和时间动态。近期多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在空间和时间理解方面取得巨大进展，但其理解 ODV 所传达的沉浸式 360 时空信息的能力在很大程度上仍未被探索。为弥合这一差距，我们首先推出 OmniV-Bench，一个全面评估 MLLM 时空全向视频理解能力的基准。OmniV-Bench 包含从多样场景收集的 4,123 个高质量 ODV，以及 8,923 个人工标注的问答对，覆盖三大类别（通用、空间和时空理解）下的 11 个细粒度任务。大量基准实验表明，ODV 的时空复杂性给当前 MLLM 带来了重大挑战。为解决这些局限，我们进一步提出 OmniV-Harness，一个通过视点引导的证据初始化和结合自适应工具使用的任务相关证据获取来增强 ODV 理解的 agentic 框架。全面的实验表明，OmniV-Harness 持续提升 MLLM 的沉浸式时空推理能力。OmniV-Bench 和 OmniV-Harness 将在论文发表后发布。
translation.brief: 针对 MLLM 缺乏全向视频时空理解评估的问题，构建 OmniV-Bench 基准并提出通过视点引导证据初始化与自适应工具使用的 OmniV-Harness 来增强模型能力。

papers.title: ComputeWise: Measuring and Fixing GPU Waste by AI Research Agents
papers.abstract: AI agents are given GPUs to do AI research on their own. Do they use those GPUs well? A busy GPU does not tell us, because it can be busy with work the answer did not need. This matters, because the tokens the agent spends cost almost nothing next to the GPUs its experiments run on, so using those GPUs better has a huge impact. So we built ComputeWise, an open benchmark of research tasks on which this waste can be measured and reduced. For it we developed our own simulated GPU, which replays recorded runs to the agent's code. With no real GPU needed, we ran hundreds of experiments, far more than would be reasonable on real GPUs. With no help, the agents put only 52% of their GPU time into work the answer needed. Another 22% went to work it did not need, and 26% sat idle. Asking the agent to finish the work faster, telling it to keep every GPU busy, or giving it a job scheduler does not fix this. So we built an open-source harness, part prompting and part deterministic code. Across five models, it removed over 80% of the extra time to the answer.

translation.title: ComputeWise：测量并修复 AI 研究 Agent 的 GPU 浪费
translation.abstract: AI Agent 被赋予 GPU 来自主进行 AI 研究。它们是否善用了这些 GPU？GPU 繁忙并不能说明问题，因为它可能忙于答案并不需要的工作。这一点很重要，因为 Agent 花费的 token 相对其实验所运行的 GPU 几乎不花钱，所以更好地使用这些 GPU 影响巨大。因此我们构建了 ComputeWise，一个可以测量和减少这种浪费的开放研究任务基准。为此我们开发了自己的模拟 GPU，向 Agent 的代码回放已录制的运行记录。由于无需真实 GPU，我们运行了数百个实验，远超在真实 GPU 上合理的数量。在没有任何帮助的情况下，Agent 仅将 52% 的 GPU 时间用于答案所需的工作，另有 22% 用于不需要的工作，26% 处于空闲。要求 Agent 更快完成工作、指示它让每个 GPU 保持忙碌、或给它一个作业调度器，都无法解决这一问题。于是我们构建了一个开源 harness，一部分是提示词，一部分是确定性代码。在五个模型上，它消除了超过 80% 的答案之外的额外时间。
translation.brief: 针对 AI 研究 Agent 浪费 GPU 算力的问题，构建基于模拟 GPU 回放的 ComputeWise 基准来测量浪费，并开发提示词加确定性代码的开源 harness 加以修复。

papers.title: AI-Assisted Auto-formalization for Trustworthy Scientific Computing: Case Studies and Lessons Learned
papers.abstract: Agentic AI tools have recently had success in mathematical reasoning. Both general purpose coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex, and specialized mathematics agents such as Aristotle, have been used for formalizing mathematical problems such as Fermat's last theorem, Erdős problems and several IMO level math problems. However, much of these efforts are concentrated in the pure mathematics domain, which benefits from relatively self-contained theorem statements, fixed mathematical representation and extensive support in existing formal libraries. Applied mathematics, on the other hand, presents additional challenges because the source may describe a computational procedure or modeling transformation rather than a declarative theorem. In this work, we present a systematic study of AI-assisted auto-formalization for scientific computing (SC), a domain in applied mathematics central to U.S. Department of Energy applications. Through case studies spanning hierarchical abstraction layers in SC software stack, we evaluate not only whether AI agents can complete numerical proofs, but also where and why they fail across the stack. Our primary contribution is a cross-layer taxonomy of failure modes and an analysis of the form of expert feedback required at each layer to recover mathematical soundness. From these observations, we derive a workflow for recurring proof patterns and practical guidance for using AI agents while preserving mathematical soundness. Our results characterize both the practical value and the current limitations of AI-assisted formalization for trustworthy scientific computing.

translation.title: 面向可信科学计算的AI辅助自动形式化：案例研究与经验教训
translation.abstract: Agentic AI工具近来在数学推理方面取得了成功。通用编码智能体（如Claude Code和Codex）以及专门的数学智能体（如Aristotle）已被用于形式化数学问题，例如费马大定理、Erdős问题和多个IMO级别的数学问题。然而，这些努力大多集中在纯数学领域，该领域受益于相对自包含的定理陈述、固定的数学表示以及现有形式化库的广泛支持。相比之下，应用数学带来了额外的挑战，因为其源材料可能描述的是计算过程或建模变换，而非陈述性定理。在本工作中，我们对科学计算（SC）领域的AI辅助自动形式化进行了系统性研究，该领域是美国能源部应用的核心。通过跨越SC软件栈中分层抽象层的案例研究，我们不仅评估AI智能体能否完成数值证明，还评估它们在栈中何处以及为何失败。我们的主要贡献是一个跨层失败模式分类法，以及对每层恢复数学可靠性所需专家反馈形式的分析。基于这些观察，我们推导出针对重复证明模式的工作流程，以及在使用AI智能体时保持数学可靠性的实用指南。我们的结果刻画了AI辅助形式化在可信科学计算中的实用价值和当前局限。
translation.brief: 研究AI智能体在科学计算自动形式化中的失败模式，提出跨层失败分类法与保持数学可靠性的工作流程。

papers.title: Automatic Occupational Coding through Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract: Annually 1.9 million deaths and 89.7 million disability-adjusted life years are caused by exposure to agents during work (e.g., welding fumes, silica dust, and noise pollution). To improve worker health, high-quality exposure assessments are crucial. Therefore, free-text job descriptions from large-scale occupational cohorts are manually standardized through occupational classifications and linked to hazardous exposures using Job Exposure Matrices (JEM). However, manual coding is slow, unreliable (i.e., 44-89% inter-coder reliability), and costly, due to i) short, ambiguous free-text job descriptions, ii) classifications containing hundreds to thousands of categories, and iii) the absence of gold standards. With 46%-79% accuracy, state-of-the-art automatic occupational coding tools achieve classification performance on human level. However, their performance drops to 17-26% on out-of-distribution datasets. Furthermore, their supervised architectures limit them to occupational classifications present in the training set. Consequently, JEM using other classifications are incompatible, leaving vital exposure-response associations unexplored. Our Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework, OPERAG, enables classification into any occupational classification without expert-labelled databases. It retrieves coding index information and combines this with Large Language Model-based classification. Validated on AsiaLymph's 36,062 real-world job descriptions, OPERAG achieved 42.6% occupational classification accuracy on the 4th coding level, substantially outperforming existing tools and approaching human coders' 51-56% inter-coder reliability. Using two JEM named ALOHA+ and SHOCK, 89.9-98.6% accuracy was achieved on exposure assessment. OPERAG approaches human-level, universal occupational classification, enabling efficient and effective large-scale exposure assessment to improve worker health.

translation.title: 基于检索增强生成的自动职业编码
translation.abstract: 每年有190万人死亡和8970万伤残调整生命年由工作中接触的介质（如焊接烟尘、硅尘和噪声污染）引起。为改善工人健康，高质量的暴露评估至关重要。因此，大规模职业队列中的自由文本职业描述需通过职业分类进行人工标准化，并借助职业暴露矩阵（JEM）与有害暴露关联。然而，人工编码缓慢、不可靠（编码员间一致性仅44-89%）且成本高昂，原因在于：i）自由文本职业描述简短且含糊；ii）分类体系包含数百至数千个类别；iii）缺乏金标准。现有最先进的自动职业编码工具准确率为46%-79%，达到人类水平，但在分布外数据集上性能降至17-26%。此外，其监督式架构使其只能使用训练集中已有的职业分类，导致使用其他分类体系的JEM不兼容，使重要的暴露-反应关联无法被探索。我们的检索增强生成框架OPERAG无需专家标注数据库即可按任意职业分类进行编码。它检索编码索引信息，并将其与基于大语言模型的分类相结合。在AsiaLymph的36,062条真实职业描述上验证，OPERAG在第4级编码上达到42.6%的职业分类准确率，显著优于现有工具，接近人类编码员51-56%的一致性水平。使用名为ALOHA+和SHOCK的两个JEM，暴露评估准确率达到89.9-98.6%。OPERAG实现了接近人类水平的通用职业分类，使大规模高效有效的暴露评估成为可能，以改善工人健康。
translation.brief: 提出检索增强生成框架OPERAG，无需专家标注即可按任意职业分类体系对自由文本职业描述进行编码并链接暴露评估。

papers.title: From Head to Tail: LLM-Augmented Sequential Recommendation and Trade-off Optimization
papers.abstract: Recommender systems exhibit popularity bias, often under-serving long-tail and cold-start items with sparse interaction data. We propose a group-specific data augmentation approach that leverages LLMs to generate synthetic interactions, formulated as a constrained optimization problem, maximizing group-specific NDCG@20 and coverage while bounding overall NDCG@20 degradation within an acceptable threshold. Items are partitioned by interaction frequency to find the optimal augmentation strategy for each group. We further study combining the augmentation across groups simultaneously and find that while individual optimal strategies navigate the multi-group augmentation design, they are not simply additive. We further ablate on the LLM-based augmentation itself, comparing LLM scales, augmentation configuration under token constraints, finding that augmentation quality scales with contextual richness, albeit at a proportionally higher cost. Experiments with SASRec demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach, achieving over 100% and 60% improvement in group-specific NDCG@20 for extreme and regular long-tail items, respectively, on our industrial dataset, and 40%, 25% for MovieLens-32M, while increasing their coverage without significant overall degradation.

translation.title: 从头到尾：LLM增强的序列推荐与权衡优化
translation.abstract: 推荐系统存在流行度偏差，常常对交互数据稀疏的长尾和冷启动物品服务不足。我们提出一种分组特定的数据增强方法，利用LLM生成合成交互，并将其表述为约束优化问题：在将整体NDCG@20的下降限制在可接受阈值内的同时，最大化分组特定的NDCG@20和覆盖率。物品按交互频率划分，以找到每组的最优增强策略。我们进一步研究同时组合跨组的增强，发现虽然单个最优策略可以指导多组增强设计，但它们并非简单可加。我们还对基于LLM的增强本身进行消融实验，比较不同LLM规模以及token约束下的增强配置，发现增强质量随上下文丰富度提升，但成本也相应更高。基于SASRec的实验证明了所提方法的有效性：在工业数据集上，极端长尾和常规长尾物品的分组NDCG@20分别提升超过100%和60%，在MovieLens-32M上分别提升40%和25%，同时提高了覆盖率且整体性能无显著下降。
translation.brief: 提出按物品流行度分组的LLM合成交互数据增强方法，将其表述为约束优化问题以提升长尾物品推荐效果。

papers.title: ReWeave: Emergent Physical Task Topologies for Embodied Harness Optimization and Cross-Task Meta-Distillation
papers.abstract: Long-horizon embodied tasks involve physical dependencies that may only become clear through interaction. As task understanding deepens, past trials can reveal new information for adaptation and transfer. However, coarse progress feedback cannot identify which physical preconditions held, leaving search unguided, while task-specific optimization easily overfits to individual scenes, making cross-task transfer brittle. We introduce ReWeave, a framework that jointly optimizes an embodied agent harness and an emergent physical task topology from interaction without updating policy weights. Keeping execution policies and perception frozen, ReWeave co-optimizes coupled context, workflows, and control loops. As new evidence revises the topology, ReWeave reprojects past trials onto the updated task understanding, exposing retained progress, regressions, and bottlenecks that guide parent selection and search width. Across tasks, matching verified local mechanisms to unmet preconditions consolidates 72 specialist units into 44 reusable groups ($0.34\times$ full concatenation) within a compact shared harness capable of continual learning. ReWeave improves held-out success from 89.00% to 98.75% on LIBERO-PRO and from 25.50% to 58.25% on RoboDojo, while uncovering retained progress in 89% of 159 failed RoboDojo development trials and translating stronger offline reasoning into higher online performance. On eight unseen LIBERO-PRO tasks, the shared harness reaches 51.3% success versus 41.3% for direct distillation, rising to 75.0% after continual learning.

translation.title: ReWeave：面向具身Harness优化与跨任务元蒸馏的涌现物理任务拓扑
translation.abstract: 长时程具身任务涉及可能只有通过交互才能明确的物理依赖关系。随着任务理解的加深，过去的尝试可以为适应和迁移揭示新信息。然而，粗粒度的进度反馈无法识别哪些物理前提条件成立，导致搜索缺乏引导；而任务特定的优化容易过拟合于单个场景，使跨任务迁移变得脆弱。我们提出ReWeave，一个在不更新策略权重的情况下，从交互中联合优化具身智能体harness和涌现物理任务拓扑的框架。在保持执行策略和感知冻结的前提下，ReWeave协同优化耦合的上下文、工作流和控制循环。当新证据修正拓扑时，ReWeave将过去的尝试重新投影到更新后的任务理解上，揭示保留的进展、退化和瓶颈，以指导父节点选择和搜索宽度。跨任务地，将已验证的局部机制与未满足的前提条件匹配，将72个专家单元整合为44个可复用组（为全拼接的0.34倍），形成支持持续学习的紧凑共享harness。ReWeave将LIBERO-PRO上的held-out成功率从89.00%提升至98.75%，RoboDojo上从25.50%提升至58.25%，同时在159个失败的RoboDojo开发试验中的89%里发现了可保留的进展，并将更强的离线推理转化为更高的在线性能。在八个未见过的LIBERO-PRO任务上，共享harness达到51.3%的成功率，而直接蒸馏为41.3%，持续学习后升至75.0%。
translation.brief: 提出ReWeave框架，在不更新策略权重的情况下从交互中联合优化具身智能体harness与涌现任务拓扑，实现跨任务迁移与持续学习。

papers.title: From Local Errors to System Failures: Modeling and Benchmarking Error Propagation in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
papers.abstract: In multi-agent systems (MAS) built on large language models (LLMs), errors can propagate through intermediate messages and compromise final answers. However, outcome-based evaluation obscures how agents amplify, attenuate, or correct these errors. We propose Response-Aware Error Propagation among Agents (REPA), a structural model that connects measured local responses to system-level error propagation. REPA separately estimates input assembly and agent processing across multiple error channels, while theoretical analysis relates local modeling errors to endpoint prediction error. Experiments span three Qwen base models, six MAS workflows, and ten knowledge and reasoning settings in ErrPropBench-10. REPA achieves a mean condition-level Spearman correlation of 0.84 across base models, compared with 0.47 for direct regression. Controlled experiments also demonstrate its utility for targeted recovery. REPA-guided retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves accuracy over no retrieval by an average of 19 percentage points with 16% additional tokens. By linking local agent behavior to system susceptibility, REPA provides an interpretable foundation for studying error propagation and developing targeted optimization in MAS.

translation.title: 从局部错误到系统失败：多智能体LLM系统中错误传播的建模与基准测试
translation.abstract: 在基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）中，错误可能通过中间消息传播并损害最终答案。然而，基于结果的评估掩盖了智能体如何放大、衰减或纠正这些错误。我们提出智能体间响应感知错误传播（REPA），一种将测得的局部响应与系统级错误传播联系起来的结构化模型。REPA在多个错误通道上分别估计输入组装和智能体处理，并通过理论分析将局部建模误差与端点预测误差关联起来。实验涵盖三个Qwen基础模型、六种MAS工作流以及ErrPropBench-10中的十个知识与推理设置。REPA在基础模型上实现了平均0.84的条件级Spearman相关系数，而直接回归仅为0.47。受控实验还证明了其在针对性恢复中的实用性：REPA引导的检索增强生成（RAG）相比无检索平均提升19个百分点的准确率，仅增加16%的token。通过将局部智能体行为与系统易感性联系起来，REPA为研究MAS中的错误传播和开展针对性优化提供了可解释的基础。
translation.brief: 提出REPA结构化模型，将多智能体LLM系统中智能体的局部响应与系统级错误传播关联，用于错误传播预测与针对性恢复。

papers.title: Decoupling Solving from Abstention: Single-Rollout Conformal Risk Control for Hard-Budget LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract: Hard token budgets often interrupt LLM reasoning before an answer is produced. Forcing reasoning to terminate recovers correct solutions but also increases confident errors, creating a joint challenge of solving within budget and deciding when to abstain. Existing remedies are costly or lack guarantees: supervised fine-tuning offers no error control, penalizing wrong answers during reinforcement learning (RL) can suppress exploration, and multi-sample conformal methods multiply inference cost. We propose Tail-CRC, a single-rollout framework that separates candidate generation from submission control. We first adapt the solver to budget forcing with pure binary correctness rewards; after freezing it, we apply conformal risk control to upper-tail token surprise in the answer span. Each rollout yields both an answer and an uncertainty score from token log probabilities, enabling finite-sample control of expected wrong submissions under exchangeability and recalibration across risk targets or domains without retraining. We show that wrong-answer penalties create failure-only comparisons in group-relative RL, derive an exploration-starvation boundary, and identify length-induced ranking reversals and single-token spike sensitivity in answer scores. Across Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3-8B, 50 RL updates on 400 problems improve correct-submission rates by 15.0--29.6 points on DAPO and 4.3--12.8 points on out-of-domain Omni-MATH over inference-only budget forcing, while reducing generation cost by 3.5--12.6\%. On 8B Omni-MATH, target-domain calibration cuts wrong submissions from 30.3\% to 5.8\% at 4K and from 41.8\% to 6.5\% at 8K. At 4K, generation is 2.05$\times$ faster for 4B and 2.23$\times$ faster for 8B than unforced 8K decoding in local amortized batch time. Tail-CRC thus enables reliable, efficient budgeted reasoning from a single rollout.

translation.title: 将求解与弃答解耦：面向硬预算 LLM 推理的单次采样保形风险控制
