translation.abstract: 硬性 token 预算常常在 LLM 产生答案之前就中断推理。强制推理终止虽能恢复正确解，但也会增加自信的错误，从而带来在预算内求解并决定何时弃答的联合挑战。现有补救方法要么代价高昂，要么缺乏保证：监督微调无法控制错误，强化学习（RL）中惩罚错误答案会抑制探索，多样本保形方法则成倍增加推理成本。我们提出 Tail-CRC，一个将候选生成与提交控制分离的单次采样框架。我们首先用纯二值正确性奖励使求解器适应预算强制；冻结之后，对答案区间的上尾 token 惊异度应用保形风险控制。每次采样同时产生一个答案和基于 token 对数概率的不确定性分数，从而在可交换性假设下实现对期望错误提交的有限样本控制，并可在不同风险目标或领域间重新校准而无需重新训练。我们证明错误答案惩罚会在组相对 RL 中产生仅含失败样本的比较，推导出探索匮乏边界，并识别出答案分数中由长度引起的排名反转和单 token 尖峰敏感性。在 Qwen3.5-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 上，仅用 400 道题进行 50 次 RL 更新，相比仅推理的预算强制，DAPO 上正确提交率提升 15.0--29.6 个百分点，域外 Omni-MATH 上提升 4.3--12.8 个百分点，同时生成成本降低 3.5--12.6%。在 8B Omni-MATH 上，目标域校准将 4K 下的错误提交率从 30.3% 降至 5.8%，8K 下从 41.8% 降至 6.5%。在 4K 下，按本地摊销批处理时间计算，4B 和 8B 的生成速度分别比无强制的 8K 解码快 2.05 倍和 2.23 倍。Tail-CRC 由此实现了基于单次采样的可靠、高效预算推理。
translation.brief: 解决硬 token 预算下 LLM 推理的求解与弃答权衡问题，核心方法是先用二值奖励 RL 适配预算强制，再用保形风险控制对答案 token 惊异度进行单次采样的错误提交风险控制。

papers.title: AlphaDefect: Expert-Level AI for Slay the Spire 2
papers.abstract: Slay the Spire 2 (STS2) is a single-player deck-building game that requires long-term planning under heavy randomness. We present AlphaDefect, an expert-level AI system for STS2: for each character, one network trained with proximal policy optimization (PPO) makes every decision of a run, in combat and outside it. At the highest difficulty, Ascension 10, on two versions of the game current in November 2026 and on test seeds not played in training, AlphaDefect wins 62-77% of runs across six characters with greedy play and 68-80% with test-time search, after 1.3 to 6.7 billion decisions of training per character; runs uploaded by human players of all levels are won 11-20% of the time at the same difficulty. The networks read the game as entity records that identify each card, relic and enemy through a learned embedding and attributes from the game data, together with consequences of public information computed by the engine. Ablations show how much the agent depends on this encoding: without these identities, the network did not win a single run, and without the computed consequences it won 8.3 points fewer. To our knowledge, AlphaDefect is the strongest publicly reported STS2 agent as of November 2026.

translation.title: AlphaDefect：面向 Slay the Spire 2 的专家级 AI
translation.abstract: Slay the Spire 2（STS2）是一款单人卡组构筑游戏，需要在高度随机性下进行长期规划。我们提出 AlphaDefect，一个 STS2 的专家级 AI 系统：对每个角色，用一个由近端策略优化（PPO）训练的网络做出一局游戏中的所有决策，包括战斗内外。在最高难度 Ascension 10 下，在 2026 年 11 月的两个现行游戏版本以及未参与训练的测试种子上，AlphaDefect 在六个角色上以贪婪策略赢得 62-77% 的对局，结合测试时搜索赢得 68-80%，每个角色经过 13 亿至 67 亿次决策的训练；而各水平人类玩家上传的对局在同一难度下胜率仅为 11-20%。网络将游戏读取为实体记录，通过学习到的嵌入和游戏数据属性识别每张卡牌、遗物和敌人，并结合引擎计算的公开信息后果。消融实验显示了智能体对该编码的依赖程度：没有这些身份标识，网络一局未胜；没有计算出的后果信息，胜率下降 8.3 个百分点。据我们所知，截至 2026 年 11 月，AlphaDefect 是公开报道中最强的 STS2 智能体。
translation.brief: 解决在高度随机卡牌游戏中构建专家级 AI 的问题，核心方法是用 PPO 训练单一网络基于实体嵌入编码做出整局所有决策并结合测试时搜索。

papers.title: ChiProgramBench: Can LLM Agents Rebuild Efficient Circuits from Pin-Level Experiments?
papers.abstract: Understanding a system that can be run but not inspected is a core engineering skill: one designs experiments, forms hypotheses about hidden state and timing, discards those that observations refute, and finally builds a replacement that works and is efficient. To evaluate this capability of LLM agents in the hardware domain, we present ChiProgramBench, 18 tasks derived from open-source processors, accelerators, codecs, transforms, interconnects, and control circuits. Agents can only drive and read the pins of a hidden, stateful simulated reference, then submit a gate-level netlist made of public library cells. Agents work in two settings: black-box discovery gives only anonymized functional pins and the interfaces of fixed memories, while function-guided reconstruction adds the circuit's purpose and each pin's role. Hidden test cases compare outputs with the reference cycle by cycle; power, delay, and area earn credit relative to the reference only when every case passes. Across 432 trials of 6 LLM agent configurations, successful agents recover algorithms and numerical conventions, yet only 12.0% of black-box and 14.8% of function-guided trials pass every case. Function-guided reconstruction raises the mean functional score, the cycle-weighted share of passed cases, from 24.6% to 30.9%. Of the 58 fully passing designs, only three improve on the reference's combined power, area, and delay, so behavioral recovery and efficient implementation remain distinct challenges.

translation.title: ChiProgramBench：LLM 智能体能从引脚级实验重建高效电路吗？
translation.abstract: 理解一个可运行但不可查看内部的系统是一项核心工程技能：需要设计实验、对隐藏状态与时序形成假设、丢弃被观测否定的假设，最终构建一个可用且高效的替代品。为评估 LLM 智能体在硬件领域的这一能力，我们提出 ChiProgramBench，包含源自开源处理器、加速器、编解码器、变换、互连和控制电路的 18 个任务。智能体只能驱动和读取一个隐藏的、有状态的模拟参考电路的引脚，然后提交由公开库单元构成的门级网表。智能体在两种设置下工作：黑盒发现仅提供匿名化的功能引脚和固定存储器的接口，而功能引导重建额外提供电路用途和每个引脚的角色。隐藏测试用例逐周期比较输出与参考电路；只有全部用例通过时，功耗、延迟和面积才相对参考电路获得评分。在 6 种 LLM 智能体配置共 432 次试验中，成功的智能体能恢复算法和数值约定，但仅有 12.0% 的黑盒试验和 14.8% 的功能引导试验通过全部用例。功能引导重建将平均功能分数（通过用例的周期加权占比）从 24.6% 提升至 30.9%。在 58 个完全通过的设计中，仅有 3 个在功耗、面积和延迟的综合指标上优于参考电路，说明行为恢复与高效实现仍是两个不同的挑战。
translation.brief: 评估 LLM 智能体仅凭引脚级黑盒实验重建隐藏电路的能力，核心方法是构建基于开源电路的 18 任务基准，要求智能体提交门级网表并按功能与功耗、延迟、面积评分。

papers.title: Orthogonally Mixed Sign Coding with Progressive Residual Refinement for Transformer Weight Compression
papers.abstract: LLM quantization reduces storage but often degrades predictive fidelity at low bit rates. We propose a training-free, CDF-free, Gaussian-CLT-motivated progressive residual-sign quantization framework that uses randomized orthogonal mixing to promote Gaussian-like residual distributions and improve sign based reconstruction of Transformer weights. Each stage independently normalizes residuals and analytically calibrates reconstruction, progressively recovering quantization errors. The framework enables flexible storage-fidelity trade-offs without learned codebooks, empirical CDFs, or trellis optimization. We evaluate GPT-2 Large and Llama-3-8B across attention and MLP projections. At five residual stages, joint quantization preserves near-baseline predictive fidelity, achieving perplexities of 32.16 and 12.73, compared with full-precision values of 29.89 and 11.07, respectively. Ablations further demonstrate that orthogonal mixing substantially improves reconstruction over identity-based sign coding, while activation-aware scaling improves output fidelity and reduced-precision statistics lower storage overhead with negligible perplexity degradation. Comparisons with conventional quantizers establish the method's progressive fidelity recovery and characterize its storage-quality and runtime trade-offs. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of orthogonally mixed residual-sign coding for flexible, training-free Transformer weight compression.

translation.title: 面向 Transformer 权重压缩的正交混合符号编码与渐进残差精化
translation.abstract: LLM 量化能减少存储，但在低比特率下常会降低预测保真度。我们提出一个免训练、免 CDF、由高斯-CLT 启发的渐进残差-符号量化框架，利用随机正交混合促进类高斯残差分布，并改进基于符号的 Transformer 权重重建。每个阶段独立归一化残差并通过解析方式校准重建，逐步恢复量化误差。该框架无需学习码本、经验 CDF 或格状优化即可实现灵活的存储-保真度权衡。我们在 GPT-2 Large 和 Llama-3-8B 的注意力与 MLP 投影上进行评估。在五个残差阶段下，联合量化保持接近基线的预测保真度，困惑度分别为 32.16 和 12.73，而全精度值为 29.89 和 11.07。消融实验进一步表明，正交混合相比基于恒等映射的符号编码显著改善重建，激活感知缩放提升输出保真度，而降低统计精度的方法在困惑度几乎不受影响的情况下降低存储开销。与传统量化器的对比确立了该方法的渐进保真度恢复能力，并刻画了其存储-质量与运行时间的权衡。这些结果证明了正交混合残差-符号编码在灵活、免训练的 Transformer 权重压缩中的有效性。
translation.brief: 解决低比特量化下 LLM 权重保真度下降的问题，核心方法是免训练的渐进残差-符号量化框架，用随机正交混合使残差分布趋于高斯以改进符号重建。

papers.title: Revisiting Learning to Delegate: LLM Discovered Heuristics for Large-Scale Vehicle Routing
papers.abstract: Efficient vehicle routing is critical to logistics and transportation, yet solving large-scale capacitated vehicle routing problems (CVRP) remains computationally challenging due to their combinatorial complexity. One approach to solve large-scale vehicle routing optimization is to identify promising subproblems and then optimize them using solvers. In this paper, we propose a framework of automatic heuristic design (AHD) in which a large language model (LLM) autonomously refines heuristics for selecting subproblems, enabling effective optimization of large-scale CVRP instances. Compared to prior approaches that train task-specific neural networks to select among heuristically constructed subproblems, our method discovers generalizable, interpretable LLM-generated heuristics to directly construct subproblems. Experiments show that our approach achieves comparable in-distribution performance while outperforming neural network-based policies on out-of-distribution instances with large-scale problems.

translation.title: 重新审视学习委派：LLM 发现的启发式方法用于大规模车辆路径问题
translation.abstract: 高效的车辆路径规划对物流和运输至关重要，然而由于组合复杂性，求解大规模带容量约束的车辆路径问题（CVRP）在计算上仍具挑战性。求解大规模车辆路径优化的一种方法是识别有前景的子问题，然后用求解器对其进行优化。本文提出一个自动启发式设计（AHD）框架，其中大语言模型（LLM）自主精化用于选择子问题的启发式方法，从而实现对大规模 CVRP 实例的有效优化。与先前训练任务特定神经网络在启发式构造的子问题中进行选择的方法相比，我们的方法发现可泛化、可解释的 LLM 生成启发式方法来直接构造子问题。实验表明，我们的方法在分布内性能相当的同时，在大规模问题的分布外实例上优于基于神经网络的策略。
translation.brief: 解决大规模 CVRP 求解中子问题选择困难的问题，核心方法是让 LLM 自动设计并迭代精化构造子问题的启发式规则，替代任务特定神经网络。

papers.title: Unlocking the Power of Loops in Pretrained LLMs with Loop Residuals
papers.abstract: Looped Transformers iterate a shared block of layers to increase computation without adding parameters, offering stronger performance and test-time scaling. However, this power has so far required training from scratch and yielded only modest gains for LLMs. Finetuning existing models into loops is far cheaper, yet also brings only marginal gains over SFT. We propose LoopRes, an effective, scalable, and simple approach that turns loops into significant and consistent gains for pretrained LLMs. Building on Attention Residuals, LoopRes lets each looped layer attend directly to the outputs of earlier loops. Since these outputs are iterates of the same layers and become harder to tell apart, we give each a trainable loop-aware key that encodes its structural identity. Attending to all earlier loops also lets layers skip intermediate ones, so we restrict each layer to a residual window of the latest W loops, forcing every loop to build incrementally on recent ones. Across 6 pretrained LLMs from 3 model families and 9 benchmarks, LoopRes delivers significant and consistent gains: at 2x compute, it improves Qwen3-1.7B-Base by 29.1% over SFT, more than doubling the gain of the state-of-the-art baseline. The gains hold on larger models up to 30B and across all three families. More importantly, from 1.7B to 8B, LoopRes scales more steeply than SFT as compute grows, reaching a higher ceiling while needing less compute on long outputs. These results establish LoopRes as an effective looping approach, delivering both better performance and better test-time scaling.

translation.title: 利用 Loop Residuals 释放预训练 LLM 中循环结构的潜力
translation.abstract: Looped Transformer 通过迭代共享的层块来增加计算量而无需增加参数，提供了更强的性能和测试时扩展能力。然而，这种能力此前需要从头训练，且对 LLM 只带来有限的收益。将现有模型微调成循环结构成本要低得多，但相比 SFT 也只带来边际收益。我们提出 LoopRes，一种有效、可扩展且简单的方法，能将循环结构转化为预训练 LLM 的显著且一致的收益。基于 Attention Residuals，LoopRes 让每个循环层直接关注更早循环的输出。由于这些输出是同一层的迭代结果且越来越难以区分，我们为每个输出赋予一个可训练的、感知循环的 key，用于编码其结构身份。关注所有更早的循环还允许层跳过中间的循环，因此我们将每层限制在最近 W 个循环的残差窗口内，迫使每个循环在最近的循环基础上增量构建。在来自 3 个模型家族的 6 个预训练 LLM 和 9 个基准上，LoopRes 带来了显著且一致的收益：在 2 倍计算量下，它使 Qwen3-1.7B-Base 相比 SFT 提升 29.1%，是最先进基线收益的两倍多。这些收益在高达 30B 的更大模型上以及所有三个家族中都成立。更重要的是，从 1.7B 到 8B，随着计算量增长，LoopRes 的扩展比 SFT 更陡峭，达到更高的上限，同时在长输出上需要更少的计算。这些结果确立了 LoopRes 作为一种有效的循环方法，同时带来更好的性能和更好的测试时扩展。
translation.brief: 针对循环 Transformer 微调预训练 LLM 收益有限的问题，提出 LoopRes，通过让每个循环层借助可训练的循环感知 key 直接关注更早循环的输出并限制残差窗口，实现显著且可扩展的性能提升。

papers.title: Tradeoffs between objective outcomes and human enjoyment of work in human-AI task allocation
papers.abstract: For people, tasks at work are defined by more than their outcome: they are colored by the experience of engaging in that task. As AI systems become increasingly capable of performing human-level work they may be deployed to tasks that people find enjoyable while simultaneously creating comparatively more aversive tasks such as monitoring AI outputs. This creates a thorny tradeoff for managers: whether work should be assigned purely based on the expected performance of the workers in question, or also account for the subjective experience of the person potentially doing the task. Most economic accounts focus on expected utility calculations based on the former. Here, we assess how people balance objective outcomes and more subjective qualities like enjoyment. In a series of large-scale (N=800) behavioral studies in which people allocate tasks to either an AI or human worker we find that people's allocation decisions are best captured by a model that systematically balances relative objective performance with the human worker's expected enjoyment, weighting human experience higher when a task is framed as inducing less enjoyment and adjusting based on the stakes of the task. As AI also makes decisions about work allocation, we compare a set of LLMs. We find many models also deviate from purely objective decisions, particularly when the project stakes are low, but there is wide heterogeneity as to how much and in what manner they weigh enjoyment. These results raise questions about what role human experience may play in decisions around where and how to integrate AI into workplaces. Integration may be jagged across settings due to consideration not only of the relative capabilities of workers, but also the human experience of work, the valence of that experience (e.g., more strongly weighing aversion), the context (e.g., stakes), and who is making or guiding such choices (human or LLM).

translation.title: 人机任务分配中客观结果与人类工作愉悦感的权衡
translation.abstract: 对人们而言，工作中的任务不仅仅由其结果定义：还受到从事该任务体验的影响。随着 AI 系统越来越有能力执行人类水平的工作，它们可能被部署到人们觉得愉快的任务上，同时创造出相对更令人厌恶的任务，例如监控 AI 输出。这给管理者带来了一个棘手的权衡：工作应该纯粹基于相关工作者的预期表现来分配，还是也要考虑潜在执行者的主观体验。大多数经济学论述聚焦于基于前者的期望效用计算。本文评估人们如何平衡客观结果与更主观的品质如愉悦感。在一系列大规模（N=800）行为研究中，人们将任务分配给 AI 或人类工作者，我们发现人们的分配决策最能被一个系统性地平衡相对客观表现与人类工作者预期愉悦感的模型所刻画：当任务被框定为带来较少愉悦感时，人类体验的权重更高，并根据任务的利害程度进行调整。由于 AI 也会做出工作分配决策，我们比较了一组 LLM。我们发现许多模型也会偏离纯客观决策，尤其是在项目利害较低时，但它们在多大程度上以及以何种方式权衡愉悦感方面存在很大异质性。这些结果提出了关于人类体验在将 AI 融入工作场所的决策中可能扮演何种角色的问题。由于不仅考虑工作者的相对能力，还考虑人类的工作体验、该体验的效价（如更强烈地权衡厌恶感）、情境（如利害程度）以及由谁做出或指导这些选择（人类还是 LLM），这种整合在不同场景下可能是不平滑的。
translation.brief: 研究人机任务分配中客观绩效与人类愉悦感的权衡问题，通过大规模行为实验发现人类决策可由平衡相对绩效与预期愉悦感的模型刻画，并比较了 LLM 在此类决策上的异质性。

papers.title: SayWhen: Set-Valued Semantic Commitment for Low-Regret Early Speech
papers.abstract: Speaking early turns a prediction into an irreversible public commitment. We introduce SayWhen, a test-time controller that selects a task-directed act shared across typed continuation plans and controls its release as speech. A persistent veto blocks playback when intervening transcripts invalidate the candidate. We define regret-free early speech (RFES) to measure supported pre-endpoint releases without scored incompatibility. On a 72-prefix branching diagnostic, the generated-plan frontier attains 6.0% RFES with zero observed mean regret, versus 8.2% RFES and 0.068 regret for Matched Top-One. Measured planner latency constrains this path; a deterministic retail schema attains 31.7% RFES, compared with 32.0% for the complete policy. In a separate 30-task $\tau$-Voice simulation, schema-derived candidates with cached text-to-speech (TTS) audio attain 21/30 task-level RFES. Eligible audio begins 1.51 seconds before the user-audio endpoint among the 22 tasks with early speech, or 1.11 seconds over all 30 tasks with zero for tasks without eligible early speech. Semantic veto and endpoint waiting each pass 16/30 tasks. Together, the studies demonstrate a controlled coverage-compatibility trade-off and schema-based pre-endpoint operation, making the supported public commitment an explicit unit of voice-agent control.

translation.title: SayWhen：面向低遗憾早期语音的集合值语义承诺
translation.abstract: 过早说话会将预测转化为不可撤销的公开承诺。我们提出 SayWhen，一个测试时控制器，它选择一个跨类型化续写计划共享的任务导向行为，并控制其作为语音的释放。一个持久的否决机制在中间转录使候选内容失效时阻止播放。我们定义了无遗憾早期语音（RFES）来衡量在无评分不兼容情况下的、有依据的端点前释放。在一个 72 前缀分支诊断上，生成计划的前沿达到 6.0% 的 RFES 且观测平均遗憾为零，而 Matched Top-One 为 8.2% RFES 和 0.068 遗憾。测得的规划器延迟限制了这条路径；一个确定性的零售 schema 达到 31.7% RFES，而完整策略为 32.0%。在另一个 30 任务的 $\tau$-Voice 仿真中，使用缓存文本转语音（TTS）音频的 schema 派生候选在 30 个任务中达到 21 个任务级 RFES。在 22 个有早期语音的任务中，合格音频在用户音频端点前 1.51 秒开始，或在全部 30 个任务上平均提前 1.11 秒，无合格早期语音的任务为零。语义否决和端点等待各通过 16/30 个任务。这些研究共同展示了一种受控的覆盖-兼容性权衡和基于 schema 的端点前操作，使有依据的公开承诺成为语音代理控制的一个显式单元。
translation.brief: 针对语音代理过早说话造成不可撤销承诺的问题，提出 SayWhen 测试时控制器，通过集合值语义承诺、持久否决机制和 RFES 度量来控制早期语音的释放时机。

papers.title: LiveLoRA: Exact KV Cache Migration Across LoRA Updates for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Updating an LLM adapter should not require replaying the full interaction history of every active session. Yet reusing key-value (KV) cache entries computed under an earlier version mixes model versions, while full-history re-prefill becomes increasingly costly as histories and session fleets grow. We introduce LiveLora, a model-runtime co-design for exact final-block KV cache migration. Frozen lower decoder blocks and fixed K/V adapter down-projections preserve each token's base projections and low-rank coordinates across adapter versions. The runtime reconstructs candidate K/V, reevaluates the latest token through the final block, and commits the adapter, cache, and next-token logits together. We prove continuation equivalence to full-history re-prefill in exact arithmetic under the stated model assumptions. On Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, median paired publication speedups over full-history re-prefill average $68.98\times$ across five runs for 32 active sessions with 8K tokens each. Serving benchmarks show approximately 4.8% decoding overhead relative to native cached decoding. Compared with retained-boundary replay, compact retention gives a $3.42\times$ reduction in additional session storage at 8K, with similar measured publication-plus-decoding cost. LiveLora allows persistent LLM agents to adopt new adapter versions without replaying their full interaction histories.

translation.title: LiveLoRA：跨 LoRA 更新的精确 KV 缓存迁移（面向 LLM 智能体）
translation.abstract: 更新 LLM 适配器不应需要重放每个活跃会话的完整交互历史。然而，复用在早期版本下计算的键值（KV）缓存条目会混合模型版本，而完整历史的重新预填充随着历史和会话规模的扩大变得越来越昂贵。我们提出 LiveLora，一种模型-运行时协同设计，用于精确的最终块 KV 缓存迁移。冻结的较低解码器块和固定的 K/V 适配器下投影在每个适配器版本间保留每个 token 的基础投影和低秩坐标。运行时重建候选 K/V，通过最终块重新评估最新 token，并一起提交适配器、缓存和下一 token 的 logits。我们证明了在所述模型假设下，精确算术中与完整历史重新预填充的续写等价性。在 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 上，对于 32 个各含 8K token 的活跃会话，五次运行中相对完整历史重新预填充的中位配对发布加速平均为 $68.98\times$。服务基准显示相对原生缓存解码约有 4.8% 的解码开销。与保留边界重放相比，紧凑保留在 8K 时将额外会话存储减少 $3.42\times$，且测得的发布加解码成本相近。LiveLora 使持久 LLM 智能体无需重放完整交互历史即可采用新的适配器版本。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 适配器更新需重放完整会话历史的问题，提出 LiveLora 模型-运行时协同设计，通过冻结低层块和固定 K/V 下投影实现精确的最终块 KV 缓存迁移，大幅加速适配器发布。

papers.title: Preflight: Agentic Last-Mile Verification for AI Software Supply Chains
papers.abstract: Software dependencies execute within the trust boundary of downstream applications, yet provenance, static analysis, and package-level behavioral approaches do not directly determine how a released artifact behaves for a specific program. We present Preflight, a program-scoped pre-execution verifier for Python dependencies that extracts application-referenced symbols, iteratively synthesizes and validates function-level harnesses, executes resolved artifacts in a restricted environment, records behavioral fingerprints, and compares target behavior against prior versions when suitable baselines exist. We evaluate Preflight on four real software-supply-chain incidents under five application contexts, a 100-package benign corpus, and a controlled function-level versus import-only ablation. Preflight returns malicious verdicts in four incident contexts and a clean verdict in the LiteLLM client context, where the affected proxy-server path is not exercised. All 100 evaluated benign packages receive clean verdicts, with zero observed false positives. In a controlled ablation on Ultralytics and ctx, function-level harnesses expose malicious behavior in both incidents, whereas import-only probing exposes neither. Together, these results show that conditioning behavioral verification on the downstream program can expose security-relevant dependency behavior while remaining selective on benign workloads.

translation.title: Preflight：面向 AI 软件供应链的智能体化最后一公里验证
translation.abstract: 软件依赖在下游应用的信任边界内执行，然而来源验证、静态分析和包级行为方法并不能直接确定一个发布的制品对特定程序的行为。我们提出 Preflight，一个针对 Python 依赖的程序级预执行验证器，它提取应用引用的符号，迭代地合成并验证函数级 harness，在受限环境中执行解析后的制品，记录行为指纹，并在存在合适基线时将目标行为与先前版本进行比较。我们在五个应用上下文下的四起真实软件供应链事件、一个 100 包的良性语料库以及一个受控的函数级与仅导入消融实验上评估 Preflight。Preflight 在四个事件上下文中返回恶意判定，在 LiteLLM 客户端上下文中返回干净判定（受影响的代理服务器路径未被触发）。所有 100 个被评估的良性包都获得干净判定，观测到的误报为零。在 Ultralytics 和 ctx 上的受控消融中，函数级 harness 在两起事件中都暴露了恶意行为，而仅导入探测均未暴露。这些结果共同表明，将行为验证条件化于下游程序可以暴露与安全相关的依赖行为，同时在良性工作负载上保持选择性。
translation.brief: 针对软件依赖安全验证无法反映其对特定程序实际行为的问题，提出 Preflight，通过提取应用引用符号、合成函数级 harness 并在受限环境中执行来检测恶意依赖行为。

papers.title: TideSand: Performance-Accurate Sandbox Multiplexing for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: We propose TideSand, a sandbox system that intelligently multiplexes resources for performance-sensitive LLM agents, such as auto research agents working on system measurement tasks. TideSand combines three key ideas: agent-aware scheduling, which schedules sandbox execution intelligently at the tool call level to avoid resource contention; speculative swapping, which offloads the memory of sandboxes waiting on inference and restores it before their next tool call; and selective rollback, which checkpoints selected sandboxes when contention occurs and restores them when machines are idle. We evaluate TideSand across six model-workload pairs on AlgoTune, Terminal-Bench 4.0, and Terminal-Bench Science. TideSand achieves 3.8-10x higher throughput than strict reservation while maintaining tool-call fidelity, or 7-44% higher fidelity than overcommit baselines at similar throughput. Moreover, TideSand reduces the evaluation error on Algotune by 19x through improved tool-call fidelity. We hope the work motivates future research to maintain tool call fidelity while keeping resource utilization high through statistical multiplexing.

translation.title: TideSand：面向LLM Agent的性能精确沙箱复用系统
translation.abstract: 我们提出TideSand，一个为性能敏感的LLM Agent（如从事系统测量任务的自动化研究Agent）智能复用资源的沙箱系统。TideSand结合三个关键思想：Agent感知调度，在工具调用层面智能调度沙箱执行以避免资源争用；投机式换出，将等待推理的沙箱内存卸载，并在其下一次工具调用前恢复；选择性回滚，在发生争用时对选定的沙箱做检查点，在机器空闲时恢复。我们在AlgoTune、Terminal-Bench 4.0和Terminal-Bench Science上对六个模型-工作负载组合评估了TideSand。TideSand在保持工具调用保真度的同时，比严格预留实现3.8-10倍的更高吞吐；或在相近吞吐下比超卖基线高7-44%的保真度。此外，通过提升工具调用保真度，TideSand将AlgoTune上的评估误差降低了19倍。我们希望这项工作能启发未来研究，通过统计复用在保持高资源利用率的同时维持工具调用保真度。
translation.brief: 解决LLM Agent沙箱资源复用中吞吐与工具调用保真度的权衡问题，核心方法是将Agent感知调度、投机式内存换出与选择性回滚相结合的沙箱复用系统。

papers.title: Deneb-Vritra: Descriptions, Edges and Names Examined by Blocking Via Restoring Token Representations and Attention
papers.abstract: Laya is a 421M-parameter encoder that answers a question about a text in one pass: each answer option, written as a name plus a description, gets a marker token, and one score is read from the network at each marker. We first confirm that such models can follow an option's name when it contradicts the description; the question is where in the network this happens. We locate it. On 951 synthetic questions we move each name onto another option's description and count how often the model picks the option with the right name (the name shortcut): 53% for the released checkpoint, 59% for our fine-tune v1, 11% for a fine-tune with name randomisation. On a 320-item sample, blocking attention from each marker to its own name tokens in layers 14 to 17 of 28 cuts v1's shortcut from 67% to 16% (19% on two schemas held out from component selection) while accuracy with the original names stays at 90%; blocking marker edges to the question, other options or text has no effect. No single head matters (largest effect 9 points), and restoring clean marker states undoes the swap from layer 16. Attention mass tracks the window by layer but not by head. Repeated on 5 checkpoints (released, fine-tuned, name-randomised, and a pair trained without two schemas), the knockout finds similar layers; in the name-randomised ones, blocking the description edges instead brings the shortcut back to 56-58%, so the read persists and is outvoted. Marker states decode the name from layer 0; a one-direction probe erasure changed nothing but was weaker than a random edit. Copying layers 0-13 or 14-27 of a name-randomised sibling into a fine-tune recovers 66% and 65% (v1); 21% and 45% (pair A) of its shortcut reduction. 9 of the 12 predictions we could score, written before running, failed. Head sweeps cover 5 of 5 checkpoints; data are synthetic and LLM-labelled; one architecture.

translation.title: Deneb-Vritra：通过恢复Token表示与注意力来检验描述、边与名称
translation.abstract: Laya是一个4.21亿参数的编码器，可一次性回答关于文本的问题：每个答案选项（由名称加描述构成）获得一个标记token，网络在每个标记处读出一个分数。我们首先确认此类模型在名称与描述矛盾时能遵循名称；问题在于这发生在网络的哪个位置。我们定位了它。在951个合成问题上，我们将每个名称移到另一个选项的描述上，统计模型选择名称正确选项的频率（名称捷径）：发布checkpoint为53%，我们的微调v1为59%，名称随机化微调为11%。在320项样本上，在28层中的第14至17层阻断每个标记到其自身名称token的注意力，将v1的捷径从67%降至16%（在组件选择时留出的两个模式上为19%），而使用原始名称的准确率保持在90%；阻断标记到问题、其他选项或文本的边则无效果。没有任何单个注意力头起关键作用（最大效应9个百分点），且恢复干净的标记状态可从第16层起撤销交换。注意力质量按层而非按头追踪该窗口。在5个checkpoint（发布版、微调版、名称随机化版，以及一对在缺少两个模式的情况下训练的版本）上重复该消融实验，找到的层相似；在名称随机化的版本中，改为阻断描述边会使捷径回升至56-58%，说明该读取通路仍然存在只是被压制。标记状态从第0层起即可解码出名称；单向探针擦除没有改变任何东西，但效果弱于随机编辑。将名称随机化兄弟模型的第0-13层或14-27层复制进微调模型，分别恢复了其捷径降低量的66%和65%（v1）；21%和45%（对A）。我们事先写下的12个可评分预测中有9个失败。注意力头扫描覆盖了全部5个checkpoint；数据为合成且由LLM标注；仅一种架构。
translation.brief: 解决LLM多选模型中名称捷径（依赖选项名称而非描述）发生在网络何处的问题，核心方法是通过交换名称、阻断注意力边和恢复激活的机制可解释性分析来定位该行为。

papers.title: Habitats: A Framework for Open-Ended Evolution of Agent Objectives
papers.abstract: Designing what an agent should optimize can be as difficult as optimizing the agent itself. Existing language-model-based reward-generation methods typically refine objectives for predefined tasks and couple the decision of what to explore with the synthesis of how to implement it, potentially narrowing the resulting behavioral repertoire. We introduce Habitats, a framework for open-ended evolution of executable agent objectives. Habitats maintains a population of reward-policy pairs and evaluates every policy under every population reward, producing a cross-fitness matrix that exposes self-mastery, transfer, and functional diversity. A population-level Planner uses this information to select parent rewards and issue targeted mutation directives, while a separate Mutator translates those directives into validated reward programs. We evaluate Habitats in a discrete Card Sandbox and three continuous-control environments (Cart-Pole, Hopper, and Cheetah) against Independent Generation and Direct Mutation baselines. Across four environments and three random seeds, Habitats achieves the highest macro-averaged final Specialist Quality and Behavioral Diversity, with final diversity reaching 1.8x that of Direct Mutation and 2.5x that of Independent Generation. Finally, across ten downstream objectives unseen during evolution, frozen Habitats policy libraries achieve higher paired win rates than size-matched Direct Mutation and Independent Generation libraries at 10,000 adaptation episodes, while also surpassing task-specific policies trained from scratch for 20,000 episodes. These results suggest that separating population-level planning from reward synthesis enables the discovery of diverse, learnable, and reusable behaviors.

translation.title: Habitats：Agent目标开放式演化框架
translation.abstract: 设计Agent应该优化什么，可能与优化Agent本身一样困难。现有的基于语言模型的奖励生成方法通常为预定义任务细化目标，并将探索什么与如何实现的决策耦合在一起，可能缩小最终的行为库。我们提出Habitats，一个可执行Agent目标的开放式演化框架。Habitats维护一个奖励-策略对种群，并在种群中每个奖励下评估每个策略，产生一个揭示自我掌控、迁移和功能多样性的交叉适应度矩阵。种群级Planner利用该信息选择父代奖励并发出定向变异指令，而独立的Mutator将这些指令转化为经过验证的奖励程序。我们在离散Card Sandbox和三个连续控制环境（Cart-Pole、Hopper和Cheetah）中，与Independent Generation和Direct Mutation基线对比评估Habitats。在四个环境和三个随机种子上，Habitats取得了最高的宏平均最终Specialist Quality和行为多样性，最终多样性达到Direct Mutation的1.8倍和Independent Generation的2.5倍。最后，在十个演化期间未见过的下游目标上，冻结的Habitats策略库在10000个适应回合时取得了比规模匹配的Direct Mutation和Independent Generation库更高的配对胜率，同时超过了从头训练20000回合的任务专用策略。这些结果表明，将种群级规划与奖励合成分离能够发现多样、可学习且可复用的行为。
translation.brief: 解决Agent奖励目标设计受限的问题，核心方法是通过维护奖励-策略种群并用交叉适应度矩阵驱动的Planner-Mutator分离架构来开放式演化可执行目标。

papers.title: Precision-Aware Learning Rate Transfer Across Block Count in LLM Post-Training
papers.abstract: The post-training of pretrained large language models, including supervised finetuning (SFT), direct preference optimization (DPO), and reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR), is very sensitive to the learning rate, and tuning it through grid search is costly in both computation and memory. In this work, we propose \textbf{TipSweep}, a method to transfer the learning rate across the number of trainable transformer blocks. To do so efficiently, we search for the best learning rate by training only the last $k_0$ blocks (in our experiments, typically $k_0=1$), and provide scaling rules that predict the optimal learning rate when training any set of $k$ blocks, including when $k=L$ (the full transformer). Across experiments with models ranging from 1 to 7 billion parameters, we observe that the optimal learning rate follows precision-dependent scaling rules: the optimal rate scales approximately as $k^{-1}$ with float32 (FP32) master weights, but as $k^{-1/2}$ when updates are applied directly to bfloat16 (BF16) weights without a master copy. We explain both rules using an analytical model that accounts for update rounding, under assumptions supported by profiling experiments. Finally, we develop two prototypes of the learning rate search for a 6.7-billion-parameter model. The first fits the search on a single consumer GPU with 16 GiB of memory. The second speeds up the search on a high-end GPU by evaluating all candidate learning rates in a single pass over the data, so that a five-candidate search takes about half the GPU hours of one full-depth ($k=L$) run.

translation.title: LLM后训练中跨可训练块数量的精度感知学习率迁移
translation.abstract: 预训练大语言模型的后训练，包括监督微调（SFT）、直接偏好优化（DPO）和可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR），对学习率非常敏感，而通过网格搜索调优学习率在计算和内存上都很昂贵。在本工作中，我们提出TipSweep，一种跨可训练transformer块数量迁移学习率的方法。为高效实现，我们只训练最后$k_0$个块（实验中通常$k_0=1$）来搜索最佳学习率，并提供缩放规则来预测训练任意$k$个块（包括$k=L$即完整transformer）时的最优学习率。在参数量从10亿到70亿的模型实验中，我们观察到最优学习率遵循依赖精度的缩放规则：使用float32（FP32）主权重时，最优学习率近似按$k^{-1}$缩放；而当更新直接应用于bfloat16（BF16）权重且无主副本时，则按$k^{-1/2}$缩放。我们用一个考虑更新舍入的分析模型解释了这两条规则，其假设得到了性能剖析实验的支持。最后，我们为一个67亿参数模型开发了两个学习率搜索原型。第一个将搜索适配到单个16 GiB内存的消费级GPU上。第二个通过在单次数据遍历中评估所有候选学习率来加速高端GPU上的搜索，使五候选搜索只需约一次全深度（$k=L$）运行一半的GPU小时。
translation.brief: 解决LLM后训练中学习率网格搜索成本高的问题，核心方法是只训练最后少量块搜索学习率，并依据精度相关的缩放规则预测训练任意块数时的最优学习率。

papers.title: Needwise: Generation-Free Conversational Recommendation from Need-Level Typed Decisions
papers.abstract: Conversational recommenders must rank items against needs that catalogs record only in part, while users add, withdraw and reverse needs and switch between requests. LLM rankers re-read the dialogue at every turn: they are slow, and their ordering does not show which needs an item meets. We show that a conversational recommender can be built from typed decisions instead: named questions over fixed options, answered with option probabilities rather than generated text. On each turn, one typed request maps the message onto the catalog's fields, keeps what no field expresses in the user's words, and decides how the turn changes each earlier need. Needwise then ranks candidates must-first: the needs on the kind of item, its place and its price form a tier, and within it one holistic decision and need-level verdicts (supported, contradicted or unknown) are combined with equal weight (Needwise-HF). With the graded attributes withheld from the records, so that needs must be inferred from names, descriptions and reviews, Needwise-HF ranks Google Local requests significantly better than GPT-6 Sol (0.383 against 0.343 nDCG@10) and is not significantly different from the strongest LLM ranker on Google Local and Yelp; these comparisons keep their sign under every treatment of unrecorded attributes we test. It costs a fraction of GPT-6 Sol's API price and answers in 2.5 s at the median on Google Local, against 5.6 s for GPT-6 Sol. In conversations, the typed state keeps the ranking across switches and returns, but it recognizes only 19-27% of withdrawn needs.

translation.title: Needwise：基于需求层级类型化决策的无生成式对话推荐
translation.abstract: 对话推荐系统必须针对目录中仅部分记录的需求对物品排序，而用户会添加、撤回和反转需求并在请求之间切换。LLM排序器每轮都要重读对话：速度慢，且其排序结果不显示物品满足了哪些需求。我们证明对话推荐系统可以由类型化决策构建：即在固定选项上的命名问题，用选项概率而非生成文本来回答。每一轮，一个类型化请求将消息映射到目录字段，保留字段无法表达的用户原话，并决定该轮如何改变每个先前需求。Needwise随后按必须优先排序候选：关于物品类型、地点和价格的需求构成一个层级，在其中一个整体决策与需求级判定（支持、矛盾或未知）以等权重结合（Needwise-HF）。在记录中隐去分级属性、需求必须从名称、描述和评论推断的设定下，Needwise-HF在Google Local请求上的排序显著优于GPT-6 Sol（nDCG@10为0.383对0.343），且在Google Local和Yelp上与最强LLM排序器无显著差异；在我们测试的所有未记录属性处理方式下，这些比较的符号保持不变。其成本仅为GPT-6 Sol API价格的一小部分，在Google Local上中位数2.5秒内回答，而GPT-6 Sol为5.6秒。在对话中，类型化状态能在切换和返回时保持排序，但只能识别19-27%的撤回需求。
translation.brief: 解决对话推荐中LLM排序器慢且不透明的问题，核心方法是用类型化决策（固定选项上的概率判定）和需求层级排序替代生成式排序。

papers.title: CO-GRAFT: Attributing Reinforcement Learning Gains in Search Agents via Role-Level Policy Grafting
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) improves large language model search agents by up to 32 exact-match (EM) points over their pre-RL initializations, yet overall accuracy gains do not identify which underlying functional capabilities improve or interact during training. We introduce CO-GRAFT, a reward-agnostic interventional attribution framework in which an RL-trained agent and its pre-RL initialization jointly generate a single trajectory under closed-loop execution with live retrieval. Each policy controls a mutually exclusive subset of four functional roles: intermediate reasoning, search-or-answer decision, search query generation, and final answer extraction. Evaluating all 2^4=16 role assignments without modifying weights or retraining defines a cooperative game whose Shapley values decompose the total RL gain across roles, while M"obius interaction terms distinguish standalone role improvements from multi-role coupling. Applying CO-GRAFT to Search-R1 agents across Qwen2.5 and Llama-3.2 models (spanning two sizes, base and instruction-tuned initializations, GRPO and PPO optimizers, and NQ and HotpotQA datasets), we show that query generation never exceeds 15% of the total gain; instead, gains are governed by pre-RL answer validity, search retention, model scale, and fixed task-level search budgets, shifting credit from reasoning toward answer extraction in larger or well-formatted answer response checkpoints while smaller base models rely on reasoning--decision coupling.

translation.title: CO-GRAFT：基于角色级策略嫁接的搜索智能体强化学习增益归因
translation.abstract: 强化学习（RL）可使大型语言模型搜索智能体相比其RL前初始化提升多达32个精确匹配（EM）点，但整体准确率提升无法识别训练过程中哪些底层功能能力得到改善或相互作用。我们提出CO-GRAFT，一个与奖励无关的干预式归因框架：RL训练的智能体与其RL前初始化在带实时检索的闭环执行下共同生成单条轨迹。每个策略控制四个功能角色中互斥的子集：中间推理、搜索或回答决策、搜索查询生成以及最终答案抽取。在不修改权重或重新训练的情况下评估全部2^4=16种角色分配，定义了一个合作博弈，其Shapley值将总RL增益分解到各角色，而Möbius交互项则区分单角色改进与多角色耦合。将CO-GRAFT应用于基于Qwen2.5和Llama-3.2模型的Search-R1智能体（涵盖两种规模、base与instruction-tuned初始化、GRPO与PPO优化器以及NQ与HotpotQA数据集），我们发现查询生成占总增益从不超过15%；相反，增益由RL前答案有效性、搜索保留、模型规模和固定任务级搜索预算主导，在更大或答案格式良好的检查点上信用从推理转向答案抽取，而较小的base模型则依赖推理-决策耦合。
translation.brief: 该论文解决RL搜索智能体整体增益无法归因到具体功能能力的问题，提出通过RL前后策略联合执行并按四个功能角色分配控制权、用Shapley值和Möbius交互项分解增益的干预式归因框架。

papers.title: Know When to Abstain: Conformal Confidence Estimation for Text-to-SQL
papers.abstract: Text-to-SQL systems often return queries that execute successfully but answer the wrong question. Detecting these errors at deployment is hard because execution correctness is defined against a gold query, which exists only in labeled data. We formulate confidence estimation for Text-to-SQL as probabilistic query validation under a latent correctness variable that is observable at calibration time through gold-SQL execution and latent at deployment. Our estimator separates generation from validation. A generator LLM writes and executes the query, and a different critic LLM judges the query and its execution result. The critic's validation and execution-grounded alignment scores are fused with the generator's verbalized confidence, token-level uncertainty, and SQL-structural features in a Random Forest, using two sequential LLM calls. Two calibration steps give finite-sample guarantees. A Learn-then-Test threshold ensures, with probability $1-\delta$, that the error rate among accepted queries stays below a user-chosen budget. A conformal p-value bounds the false abstention rate. On Spider we use GPT-OSS-120B as generator and Gemma-4-31B as critic. The estimator obtains an AUARC of 0.899. Without abstention, 22.6% of queries are wrong. With a 15% risk budget ($\delta=0.1$), a threshold is certified on all 10 resampled splits, and the system accepts 52.4% of queries on average with 9.1% observed error. Five different critic models give similar results. In a controlled comparison on Spider with Olmo-3-32B as generator, the estimator obtains an AUARC of 89.5, compared with 81.2 for the strongest logit-based baseline. Applied to BIRD without retraining, the confidence scores remain informative (AUROC 0.72, against 0.79 on Spider), but the risk guarantee does not transfer, as expected without exchangeability.

translation.title: 知道何时弃答：面向Text-to-SQL的共形置信度估计
translation.abstract: Text-to-SQL系统常常返回能成功执行却回答错误问题的查询。在部署时检测这些错误很困难，因为执行正确性是相对于gold query定义的，而gold query只存在于有标注数据中。我们将Text-to-SQL的置信度估计形式化为潜在正确性变量下的概率查询验证，该变量在校准阶段可通过gold-SQL执行观测，在部署时则是潜在的。我们的估计器将生成与验证分离：生成器LLM编写并执行查询，另一个批评者LLM评判查询及其执行结果。批评者的验证分数与基于执行的对齐分数，与生成器的口头置信度、token级不确定性和SQL结构特征一起在Random Forest中融合，仅需两次顺序LLM调用。两步校准提供有限样本保证：Learn-then-Test阈值以概率1-δ确保被接受查询的错误率保持在用户设定的预算之下；共形p值则约束错误弃答率。在Spider上我们使用GPT-OSS-120B作为生成器、Gemma-4-31B作为批评者，估计器获得0.899的AUARC。不弃答时22.6%的查询是错误的；在15%风险预算（δ=0.1）下，阈值在全部10个重采样划分上均获认证，系统平均接受52.4%的查询，观测错误率为9.1%。五个不同的批评者模型给出相似结果。在以Olmo-3-32B为生成器的Spider受控比较中，估计器AUARC为89.5，而最强的基于logit的基线为81.2。无需重新训练应用于BIRD时，置信度分数仍有信息量（AUROC 0.72，Spider上为0.79），但如预期在缺乏可交换性时风险保证不能迁移。
translation.brief: 该论文解决Text-to-SQL部署时无法检测执行成功但答案错误查询的问题，提出生成器与批评者分离、融合多源置信度特征并通过两步共形校准提供错误率与弃答率保证的置信度估计框架。

papers.title: ToolSmith: An Automatic Tool-Generation Framework for Multimodal Search Agents
papers.abstract: Recent multimodal search agents use reasoning, vision, and live web search across many turns to answer questions beyond parametric knowledge by orchestrating a small library of hand-crafted search and visual tools. However, the library is laborious to create and maintain, and frozen when new query types, evidence formats, and failure modes are encountered in the wild. Human practitioners, by contrast, cope with insufficient tools by fashioning new ones from familiar parts and reusing them across tasks. Inspired by this, we propose ToolSmith, an automatic tool-generation framework that grows and reuses modules on top of a lean base tool library. We evaluate ToolSmith on three in-domain multimodal search benchmarks and ten out-of-domain benchmarks under a VLM-as-a-Judge protocol. ToolSmith consistently improves over the base library across deployed agents of varying scales, with larger backbones reaping greater gains, demonstrating the scalability of the approach. Our code and data are available at this https URL.

translation.title: ToolSmith：面向多模态搜索智能体的自动工具生成框架
translation.abstract: 近期的多模态搜索智能体通过多轮推理、视觉和实时网络搜索，编排一个小型手工制作的搜索与视觉工具库，来回答超出参数化知识的问题。然而该工具库创建和维护费力，且在野外遇到新查询类型、证据格式和失败模式时是冻结的。相比之下，人类从业者在工具不足时会用熟悉的部件制作新工具并跨任务复用。受此启发，我们提出ToolSmith，一个在精简基础工具库之上生长和复用模块的自动工具生成框架。我们在三个域内多模态搜索基准和十个域外基准上，采用VLM-as-a-Judge协议评估ToolSmith。ToolSmith在不同规模的已部署智能体上均持续优于基础工具库，且更大的骨干模型获得更大增益，展示了该方法的可扩展性。我们的代码和数据见此https URL。
translation.brief: 该论文解决多模态搜索智能体手工工具库难以创建维护且无法适应新查询类型的问题，提出在精简基础工具库之上自动生成并复用工具模块的框架ToolSmith。

papers.title: Verifying the Outputs of PDE Solvers: From Finite Elements to Neural Surrogates
papers.abstract: Physics simulation outputs increasingly come from solvers that no expert inspects, such as third-party packages in automated pipelines, programs written by large language models (LLMs), and learned surrogates. In earlier work on cardiac pulsed field ablation, we proposed that solvers return a certificate with their answers. The certificate consists of an admissible potential and an exactly charge-conserving current, and a small independent checker turns it into guaranteed error bounds against a written specification of the physics. Here, the same checker verifies the outputs of other solvers on the same problem. Specifically, FEniCSx computes both fields and receives the same bounds as our own solver. Five plausible bugs in a correct solver, one of them about 0.2% from the true impedance, all converge and pass a grid convergence study, yet the certificate rejects or refutes all five. Of three solvers written by LLMs, one is correct and certified to 0.1%, and one never solves the equation but converges. Neural networks that predict the coefficients of a reduced basis emit admissible fields and receive valid per-prediction bounds, at most 0.0021% wide inside their training range and 0.3-25% wide outside it, where 90% conformal intervals cover none of 14 tests. Untuned Fourier neural operators with free nodal outputs receive valid but uninformative bounds. On a uniform grid, interpolation onto the certificate grid limits them, and on the certificate grid, thin cells turn small nodal errors into large energy errors. Energy-norm training narrows the certified interval tenfold, and projecting the nodal-loss outputs onto the reduced basis narrows it by two to four orders of magnitude, still uninformative. The guarantee concerns the stated model and holds for any output, wherever its input lies. It is informative only when the output is accurate in energy on a grid that resolves the problem.

translation.title: 验证PDE求解器的输出：从有限元到神经代理模型
translation.abstract: 物理仿真输出越来越多地来自没有专家检查的求解器，例如自动化流水线中的第三方软件包、由大型语言模型（LLM）编写的程序以及学习得到的代理模型。在早先关于心脏脉冲电场消融的工作中，我们提出让求解器随答案返回一个证书。该证书由一个可容许电位和一个严格电荷守恒的电流组成，一个小型独立检查器将其转化为针对书面物理规范的保证误差界。本文中，同一检查器验证其他求解器在同一问题上的输出。具体而言，FEniCSx计算两个场并获得与我们自己求解器相同的界。正确求解器中的五个貌似合理的bug（其中一个距真实阻抗约0.2%）全部收敛并通过网格收敛性研究，但证书拒绝或驳倒了全部五个。三个由LLM编写的求解器中，一个正确并被认证到0.1%，一个从未真正求解方程却收敛了。预测约化基系数的神经网络输出可容许场并获得有效的逐预测界：训练范围内宽度至多0.0021%，范围外为0.3-25%，而90%共形区间在14次测试中无一覆盖。未调优、节点输出自由的Fourier neural operators获得有效但无信息量的界：在均匀网格上受证书网格插值限制，在证书网格上细单元将小的节点误差放大为大的能量误差。能量范数训练将认证区间缩小十倍，将节点损失输出投影到约化基上则缩小两到四个数量级，但仍无信息量。该保证针对所述模型并对任意输出成立，无论其输入位于何处；只有当输出在能分辨问题的网格上能量准确时才具有信息量。
translation.brief: 该论文解决无专家检查的PDE求解器（第三方包、LLM程序、神经代理）输出无法验证的问题，提出让求解器返回可容许场与守恒电流组成的证书、由独立检查器转化为保证误差界的验证方法。

papers.title: A Mixed-Methods Study of Personal Software Creation
papers.abstract: People have long wanted software shaped around their own data, routines, and preferences. We refer to such software as \emph{personal software}. For decades, programming expertise limited who could build it: people without that expertise could build software only within constrained end-user programming tools, such as spreadsheets. AI coding agents seem to remove this bottleneck by letting people build full applications from natural-language descriptions, and many people now build and share personal software publicly. Yet personal software has rarely been studied at scale: we know little about what people build and why, how they build it, and what opportunities and challenges they encounter. We investigate these questions with a mixed-methods study. A grey-literature review examines 6,168 web and Reddit posts, and an observation study follows eight people as they build software for their own needs with AI coding agents and use it for up to a week. We find that creators value personal software for how closely it fits a particular person or community. The software takes shape as creators react to what the agent builds: most functionality emerged during building, and creators' effort shifted from writing code to checking it.

translation.title: 个人软件创作的混合方法研究
translation.abstract: 人们长期以来希望软件围绕自己的数据、日常习惯和偏好来塑造。我们将这类软件称为个人软件。数十年来，编程专业知识限制了谁能构建它：缺乏专业知识的人只能在受限的终端用户编程工具（如电子表格）中构建软件。AI编程智能体似乎消除了这一瓶颈，让人们能从自然语言描述构建完整应用，如今许多人公开构建和分享个人软件。然而个人软件很少被大规模研究：我们对人们构建什么、为何构建、如何构建以及遇到哪些机遇与挑战知之甚少。我们用混合方法研究这些问题：一项灰色文献综述考察了6,168条网页和Reddit帖子，一项观察研究跟踪八个人使用AI编程智能体为自己的需求构建软件并使用长达一周。我们发现创作者重视个人软件对特定个人或社区的贴合程度。软件在创作者对智能体构建结果的反应中成形：大部分功能在构建过程中涌现，创作者的精力从编写代码转向检查代码。
translation.brief: 该论文解决个人软件创作缺乏大规模研究、人们构建什么及如何构建不明的问题，采用灰色文献综述（6,168条帖子）与八人观察研究相结合的混合方法进行调查。

papers.title: Agentic AI for Intent Management and Control in Autonomous Communication Networks
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI)-driven automation will help future mobile networks translate high-level network intents into concrete network optimization or control actions. However, existing approaches often focus on intent management and orchestration, leaving the adaptation of underlying network optimization and control functions largely unaddressed. This article proposes a triadic agentic AI framework that co-designs intent management and intent fulfillment through three agents: an interpreter, powered by a language model, that translates and refines intents into machine-readable optimization templates; an optimizer that adapts controller policies to intent specifications; and a controller that performs fast decision-making. We discuss the design space of each agent and how the workflow can be embedded across network architectural domains. Finally, we develop a concrete realization combining a language-model interpreter with Bayesian optimization for the optimizer and multi-objective reinforcement learning for the controller, and evaluate it in a radio resource management case study for differentiated connectivity. Results demonstrate how the agentic AI framework can connect high-level intents with runtime network control, showing adaptability of intent specifications and control policies to service requirements and changing network conditions.

translation.title: 面向自主通信网络意图管理与控制的智能体AI
translation.abstract: AI驱动的自动化将帮助未来移动网络把高层网络意图转化为具体的网络优化或控制动作。然而，现有方法往往聚焦于意图管理与编排，而对底层网络优化与控制功能的适配基本未予解决。本文提出一个三元智能体AI框架，通过三个智能体协同设计意图管理与意图履行：由语言模型驱动的解释器，将意图翻译并细化为机器可读的优化模板；优化器，根据意图规格调整控制器策略；以及控制器，执行快速决策。我们讨论了每个智能体的设计空间，以及该工作流如何嵌入到网络架构的各个域中。最后，我们构建了一个具体实现，将语言模型解释器与用于优化器的贝叶斯优化以及用于控制器的多目标强化学习相结合，并在差异化连接的无线资源管理案例研究中进行评估。结果表明，该智能体AI框架能够将高层意图与运行时网络控制相连接，展示出意图规格和控制策略对服务需求及网络条件变化的适应性。
translation.brief: 针对意图管理与底层网络优化控制脱节的问题，提出由解释器、优化器和控制器三个智能体组成的协同框架，将高层意图转化为运行时网络控制动作。

papers.title: Language Models Steer on Injected Uncertainty Tokens, but Fail to Self-Monitor In Situ
papers.abstract: Prompting language models to verbalize stepwise numerical confidence during generation is an increasingly popular approach for triggering backtracking and error correction in agentic reasoning. This strategy presupposes two capabilities: (1) in-situ monitoring fidelity (does confidence drop when an error occurs?) and (2) downstream steering control (does an uncertainty token causally steer the model to repair its error?). We evaluated four open-weights models (Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B, and Phi-4, 14.7B) across 15,200 math benchmark attempts, isolating 2,017 reasoning errors within each model's capability frontier. Applying 27,568 counterfactual continuations across these failure points, we demonstrate a consistent decoupling between monitoring and control. On monitoring, all four models fail to detect their own errors. Verbalized confidence does not distinguish mistake steps from sound reasoning, yielding near-chance within-position AUROCs between 0.500 and 0.561. Even at a model's first reasoning error, trajectory confidence remains saturated at 95.1% to 99.9%, with noticeable drops ($\ge 10$ points) appearing on fewer than 9% of errors in Llama and under 1.6% in the other three models. In contrast, models respond readily to external uncertainty: injecting a low-confidence tag (10%) at the error step significantly increases downstream correction across all models (+3.7 to +22.5 points over format-matched 95% certainty; all $p \le 0.0022$), reaching up to 38.5% under active rethinking instructions. However, injecting doubt onto already-correct steps causes models to discard valid reasoning, reducing solve rates by up to 22.8 points. Inference-time self-correction is thus bottlenecked by in-situ error detection rather than downstream repair capacity: models readily steer toward recovery when prompted with doubt, yet fail to self-monitor during generation.

translation.title: 语言模型能被注入的不确定性标记所引导，却无法在生成过程中自我监控
translation.abstract: 提示语言模型在生成过程中逐步以数值形式表达置信度，是在智能体推理中触发回溯与纠错的日益流行的方法。该策略预设了两种能力：(1) 原位监控保真度（错误发生时置信度会下降吗？）和 (2) 下游引导控制（不确定性标记能否因果地引导模型修复其错误？）。我们在15,200次数学基准尝试上评估了四个开源权重模型（Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B 和 Phi-4, 14.7B），并在每个模型能力边界内分离出2,017个推理错误。在这些失败点上应用27,568个反事实续写，我们展示了监控与控制之间一致的脱钩。在监控方面，四个模型均无法检测自身错误。口头表达的置信度无法区分错误步骤与正确推理，位置内 AUROC 仅在0.500到0.561之间，接近随机水平。即使在模型首次推理错误处，轨迹置信度仍饱和在95.1%到99.9%，在 Llama 中仅不到9%的错误出现明显下降（≥10分），其他三个模型中不足1.6%。相比之下，模型对外部不确定性反应灵敏：在错误步骤注入低置信度标记（10%）显著提高了所有模型的下游纠错率（相比格式匹配的95%确定性提升3.7至22.5分；所有 p ≤ 0.0022），在主动重新思考指令下最高可达38.5%。然而，向已经正确的步骤注入怀疑会导致模型丢弃有效推理，使解题率最多下降22.8分。因此，推理时自我纠正的瓶颈在于原位错误检测而非下游修复能力：模型在被提示怀疑时容易转向恢复，却在生成过程中无法自我监控。
translation.brief: 针对语言模型自我纠错失效的问题，通过反事实注入实验揭示其瓶颈在于生成过程中无法检测自身错误，而非缺乏被不确定性提示引导修复的能力。

papers.title: TowerBridge: Bridging the Dual-Encoder Modality Gap via Weight-Space Programming
papers.abstract: CLIP-style dual encoders map images and text through two separate towers into a shared embedding space, where the two modalities occupy distinct regions separated by a modality gap. Retrieval fails when wrong matches, or hard negatives, outrank the correct one, and the gap is the usual suspect. Yet removing it post hoc degrades retrieval on every CLIP checkpoint we test. We introduce a paired statistic that identifies directions where the two towers agree more on hard negatives than on matched pairs. Mildly attenuating these directions improves retrieval while largely preserving the gap. We arrive at this correction through weight-space programming: guided by the statistic, an LLM agent inspects both towers and writes closed-form weight edits without backpropagation. Free to edit any component, the agent improves COCO test retrieval on all 13 CLIP checkpoints and edits an output projection in 12 of the 13. We distill and refine its recurring correction into TowerBridge, a closed-form recipe motivated by a first-order analysis of the hard-negative margin. Computed in seconds from 25,000 labelled pairs, it requires no model-specific tuning and leaves the architecture and inference cost unchanged. TowerBridge improves COCO test retrieval by 16.8 RSUM and Flickr30k test retrieval by 6.6 on average across all 21 evaluated CLIP checkpoints, including 8 unseen by the agent, while limiting any drop in ImageNet zero-shot accuracy to 0.5 points. It also reduces hubness on all 21 checkpoints and improves retrieval on 4 of 5 dual encoders from other families.

translation.title: TowerBridge：通过权重空间编程弥合双编码器模态鸿沟
translation.abstract: CLIP 风格的双编码器通过两个独立的塔将图像和文本映射到共享嵌入空间，其中两种模态占据被模态鸿沟分隔的不同区域。当错误匹配或难负样本的排序超过正确匹配时，检索就会失败，而这一鸿沟通常是嫌疑对象。然而，事后消除该鸿沟会降低我们测试的每个 CLIP 检查点的检索性能。我们引入一种配对统计量，用于识别两个塔在难负样本上比在匹配对上更一致的方向。轻微衰减这些方向可以在基本保留鸿沟的同时改善检索。我们通过权重空间编程得到这一修正：在该统计量的引导下，一个 LLM 智能体检查两个塔并写出闭式权重编辑，无需反向传播。由于可以自由编辑任何组件，该智能体在全部13个 CLIP 检查点上提升了 COCO 测试检索性能，并在13个中的12个上编辑了输出投影。我们将其反复出现的修正提炼并精炼为 TowerBridge——一个由难负样本间隔的一阶分析启发的闭式配方。它仅需25,000个标注对即可在数秒内计算完成，无需针对特定模型的调优，且不改变架构和推理成本。TowerBridge 在全部21个评估的 CLIP 检查点（包括智能体未见过的8个）上平均将 COCO 测试检索提升16.8 RSUM、Flickr30k 测试检索提升6.6，同时将 ImageNet 零样本准确率的任何下降限制在0.5分以内。它还在全部21个检查点上降低了 hubness，并提升了来自其他家族的5个双编码器中4个的检索性能。
translation.brief: 针对CLIP双编码器模态鸿沟导致的检索失败问题，提出基于难负样本间隔统计的闭式权重编辑方法 TowerBridge，无需反向传播即可提升检索性能。
